<sup>v</sup>anasthaḥ asthirahitaḥ sa cāvayavaḥ <sup>v</sup>ūruḥ uharvastīrṇaḥ <sup>v</sup>avarambamāṇaḥ atidīrghatvenādhomukhaṃ lambamānaḥ |

<sup>v</sup>śaśvatī nāmāṅgirasaḥ sutā <sup>v</sup>nārī tasyāsañjasya bhāryā <sup>v</sup>abhicakṣya evaṃ-bhūtabhavayavaṃ niśi dṛṣṭvā he <sup>v</sup>artha svāmin bhartaḥ <sup>v</sup>subhadram atiśayena kalyāṇaṃ <sup>v</sup>bhojanaṃ bhogasādhanaṃ <sup>v</sup>bibharṣi dhārayasīti <sup>v</sup>āha brūte ||
‘idaṃ vaso’ iti dvicatvāriṃśadacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya medhātitherāṅgirasasya ca priyamedha-syārṣam |
tathā cānukrāntam— ‘idaṃ vaso dvicatvāriṃśanmedhātithirāṅgirasaśca priyamedhaḥ svādavo'nuṣṭubantyābhyāṃ medhātithirvibhi-ndordānaṃ tuṣṭāva’ iti |
sūyate hi— ‘idaṃ vaso sutamandha iti marutvatīyasya pratipadanucarau’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 14) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ‘idaṃ vaso sutamandha indrehi matsyandhasaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ‘taṃ tvā yajñabhirīmaha idaṃ vaso sutamandha iti marutvatīyasya pratipadanucarau’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 11) iti ||
idam | vaso iti | sutam | andhaḥ | piba | supūrṇam | udaram | anābhayin | ririma | te ||1||
he <sup>v</sup>vaso vāsayitarindra <sup>v</sup>idaṃ purovartamānaṃ <sup>v</sup>sutam abhiṣutam <sup>v</sup>andhaḥ annaṃ somalakṣaṇaṃ <sup>v</sup>piba |
yathā <sup>v</sup>udaraṃ tvadīyaṃ jaṭharaṃ <sup>v</sup>supūrṇam atiśayena saṃpūrṇaṃ bhavati tathetyarthaḥ |
tādṛśa he indra <sup>v</sup>te tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ <sup>v</sup>ririma utkalakṣaṇaṃ somaṃ dadhmaḥ |
nṛbhiḥ | dhūtaḥ | sutaḥ | aśvaiḥ | anyaiḥ | vāraiḥ | paripūtaḥ | aśvaḥ | na | niktaḥ | nadīṣu ||2||

<sup>v</sup>nṛbhiḥ adhvarasya netṛbhirtvigbhiḥ <sup>v</sup>dhūtaḥ ādhūta'dābhyagrahaṃ ādhavanaina saṃskṛtaḥ <sup>v</sup>aśvaiḥ aśmabhirgāvābhiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ <sup>v</sup>sutaḥ adhvaryubhirabhiṣutaḥ <sup>v</sup>avyaḥ avermeṣasya <sup>v</sup>vāraiḥ vālaiḥ <sup>v</sup>paripūtaḥ |
daśāpavitrasya nābhimabhūtayā ūrṇāstukayā hi somaḥ paripyūyate |
taduktaṃ bhagavatā āpastambena— ‘śuklāmūrṇāstukaṃ yajamānāya prayacchati tāṃ śakaṭe daśāpavitrasya nābhiṃ kurute śuklaṃ valakṣmyāḥ pavitra-mamotaṃ bhavati’ iti |
yathāpsu snāto'śvo'pagatamalaḥ san dīpto bhavati evaṃ vasatīvaryālyābhiraṅgirabhiṣutaḥ somo dīpto bhavatītyarthaḥ |
īdṛśo yaḥ somaḥ ‘taṃ te yavam’ ityuttarayā sambandhaḥ ||
taṃ te yavaṃ yathā gobhiḥ svādumarkama śrīṇantaḥ |
tam | te | yavam | yathā | gobhiḥ | svādum | arkam | śrīṇantaḥ | indra | tvā | asmin | sadhamādai ||3||

^taṃ pūrvoktaguṇaṃ somaṃ he indra ^te ^tvadartha ^yavaṃ ^yathā yavamayaṃ savanīyapuroḍāśamiva ^gobhiḥ gavi bhavaḥ kṣīrādibhiḥ śrayaṇadravyaiḥ ^śrīṇantaḥ miśrīkurvantaḥ ^svāduṃ rasatvena svādanīyam ^akarma akāpmaṃ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt he ^indra ^tvā tvāṃ tādṛśaṃ somaṃ pātum ^asmin vartamāne ^sadhamāde sahamadane yajñe āhūyāmīti śeṣaḥ ||
mahāvrate niṣkevalye gāyatratṛcāśitau ‘indra itsomapāḥ ’ ityetadādisūktaśeṣaḥ śaṃsanīyaḥ |
anyāstistro varjayitvā tatrāpi ‘svādavaḥ ’ ityetāṃ parityajya tatra sthāne ‘na hyanyaṃ baḻākaram ’ ityetāmāvapet |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam—‘indra itsomapā eka ityetatprabhṛtīnāṃ tisra uttamā uddharati |
jālādibhirupāyairnindhānā vyādhāḥ mṛgaṃ na yathā mṛga.manviṣyanti tadvadanadhikāriṇa edha balā- dindrasyānveṣaṇe vartanta ityarthaḥ |
vāgbhiḥ stutibhiśca abhisaranti abhimukhaṃ kutsitaṃ gacchanti |
daśarātre tṛtīye'hani maruvatītyasya ‘traya indrasya ’ iti tṛco'nucaraḥ |
sūyyate hi—‘taṃ tamidrādhase mahe traya indrasya somā iti maruvatītyasya pratipadanucarau ’ (ādha. śrau. 7. 10) iti ||

traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya | sve kṣaye sutapāḥ || 7 || trayaḥ | indrasya | somāḥ | sutāsaḥ | santu | devasya | sve | kṣaye | suta'pāḥ || 7 || devasya dānādiguṇayuktasya indrasya pānādhaṃ trayaḥ savanatrayarūpeṇa tridhā vartamānāḥ sve kṣaye svakīye yajñagṛhe sutāsaḥ abhiputāḥ santu bhavantu | sutapāḥ | hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇametat | yasmādayamindro'bhiputasyaiva somasya pātā tasmādabhiputāḥ sanvityarthaḥ ||

trayaḥ kośasaḥ śrotanti tisraścambaḥ | supūrṇāḥ | samāne adhi bhārman || 8 || trayaḥ | kośasaḥ | śrotanti | tisraḥ | cambaḥ | su'pūrṇāḥ | samāne | adhi | bhārman || 8 || trayaḥ trisaṃkhyākāḥ kośasaḥ kośaḥ somasyāśrayabhūtā droṇakalaśapūtabhṛdādhavanīyākhyāḥ śrotanti kṣaranti | indrārthaṃ somaṃ srāvayanti | tisraḥ trividhāḥ savanatraye vartamānāḥ cambaḥ camasāśca supūrṇāḥ indrayāgāya somaḥ supūritā āsan | etatsarvaṃ kutreti ceducyate | samāne eka- sminneva bhārman bharmaṇi bhare ṛtvigbhiścriyamāṇe yajñe | adhi saptamyarthānuvādī ||

śucirasi puruniḥṣṭhāḥ kṣīrairmadhyata āśīrttaḥ | dabhā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya || 9 || śuciḥ | asi | puruniḥṣṭhāḥ | kṣīraiḥ | madhyataḥ | ā'śīrttaḥ | dabhā | mandiṣṭhaḥ | śūrasya ||9|| he soma tvaṃ śucirasi | daśāpavitreṇa śodhito bhavasi | sa tvaṃ puruniṣṭhāḥ purupu bahuṣu pātreṣu prahacamasādipu niḥśeṣeṇa sthātā madhyataḥ madhye maitrāvaruṇagrahādau kṣīraiḥ payaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ śrayaṇadravyaiḥ āśīrttaḥ miśraṇena saṃskṛtaḥ | tṛtīye savane dabhā dākṣā āśīrttaḥ | evaṃbhūtastvaṃ śūrasya vikrāntasyendrasya mandiṣṭhaḥ mādayitṛtamo bhava ||

ime te indra somāstīvrā asme sutāsaḥ | śukrā āśīraṃ yācante || 10 || ime | te | indra | somāḥ | tīvrāḥ | asme | iti | sutāsaḥ | śukrāḥ | ā'śiram | yācante || 10 || he indra te tvadīyāḥ ime somāḥ tīvrāḥ tīvramadāḥ asme asmābhiradhvaryubhiḥ sutāsaḥ abhiputāḥ śukrāḥ śuddhāḥ santaḥ āśiraṃ kṣīrādikaṃ śrayaṇadravyaṃ tvāṃ yācante | tānstrīṇīhītyuttarānvayaḥ || || 18 ||
tāṃ āśīraṃ puroḻāśamindramaṃ somaṃ śrīṇīhi | revantaṃ hi tvā śṛṇomi || 11 || tāṃ | ā'śiram | puroḻāśam | indram | imam | somam | śrīṇīhi | revantam | hi | tvā | śṛṇomi || 11 ||
1. jña-ta1-2-4-adhiḥ | 2. kha-sthā; bha-sthāḥ; śa-sthāpitaḥ | 3. kha-śa-śrapaṇadravyaiḥ | 4. śa-śrapaṇadravya |
he 'indra 'tān pūrvoktān somān 'āśiraṃ śrayaṇadravyaṃ ca kṣīrādikaṃ 'śriṇīhi miśraya yāgārtham|
tadanantaraṃ 'puroḻāśaṃ dhānākarambhādilakṣaṇaṃ savanīyapuroḻāśam 'imam asmadīyaṃ 'somaṃ ca śriṇīhi miśraya|
prathama bhakṣitaṃ puroḻāśaṃ paścātpītena somena saṃyojayedityarthaḥ|
bahuladhanaṃ tvāṃ 'śṛṇomi tvaṃ bahudhana iti sarvatra śrūyate ataḥ kāraṇāt tvāmeva prārthayāmahe ||
hṛtsu pītāsau yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām| ūrdhvaṃ nagnā jarante || 12 || hṛt'su | pītāsaḥ | yudhyante | duḥ'madāṃsaḥ | na | surāyām | ūrdhvaḥ | na | nagnāḥ | jarante ||12||
he indra 'pītāsaḥ tvayā pītāḥ somāḥ 'hṛtsu hṛdayeṣu tvadīyeṣu 'yudhyante |
duṣṭamadā yathā pātāraṃ mādayanti tadvattvāṃ mādayituṃ parasparaṃ yudhyanta ityarthaḥ |
te ca 'ūrdhvaṃ payasā pūrṇaṃ gavāderiva somapūrṇaṃ tvāṃ 'jarante stuvanti |
paṣṭhe'hani yadi raivatasāmasādhyaṃ pṛṣṭhastotraṃ tadā niṣkevalye ‘revā~ it’ ityanurūpastatraḥ |
sūyate hi—‘revatīrnaḥ sadhamāde revā~ idevataḥ stoteti stotriyānurūpau’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 1) iti ||
revā~ idevataḥ stotā syāttvāvato maghonaḥ| predu harivaḥ śrutasya || 13 || revān | it | revataḥ | stotā | syāt | tvā'vataḥ | maghonaḥ | pra | it | ū~ iti | hari'vaḥ | śrutasya || 13 ||
tadvacchindra 'revataḥ rayimato bahudhanopetasya tava 'stotā 'revān syāt rayimān bhavet |
dhanavān bhavedeva na tu dāridryaṃ prāpnoti |
'maghonaḥ maghavato dhanāḍhyasya 'śrutasya viśrutasya sarvatra prakhyātasyānyasyāpi stotā 'predu |
kimu vaktavyaṃ tava stotā dhanavān bhavedeveti ||
ukthaṃ cana śasyamānamagaurirā ciketa | na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam || 14 || uktham | cana | śasyamānam | agauḥ | ariḥ | ā | ciketa | na | gāyatram | gīyamānam ||14||

vadhaśīlāya hiṃsākāriṇe śatrave ᐁnaḥ asmān ᐁmā ᐁparā ᐁdāḥ mā parityākṣīḥ |
ᐁmā ca ᐁśardhate abhivitre asmān mā parā ᐁdāḥ |
api tu he ᐁśacīvaḥ śaktimannindra ᐁśacībhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ karmabhiḥ ᐁśikṣa asmānanuśādhi |
śakeḥ sanantasya ‘ sani mīmā ’ iti isādeśo'bhyāsalope ca kṛte loṭi rūpametat ||
prathame rātriparyāye brahmaśastre ‘ vayamu tvā ’ iti stotriyastṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘vayamu tvā tadidarthā vayamindra tvāyavo'bhi ’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
vayamu tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ | kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante || 16 || vayam | ū~ iti | tvā | tadida'arthāḥ | indra | tvāyantaḥ | sakhāyaḥ | kaṇvāḥ | ukthebhiḥ | jarante || 16 ||
he ᐁindra ᐁtvāyantaḥ tvāmāramana icchantaḥ ᐁsakhāyaḥ samānasthānāḥ ᐁvayaṃ ᐁtadidarthāḥ yattvadviṣayaṃ stotraṃ tadittedavārthaḥ prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ tādṛśāḥ santaḥ ᐁtvā tvāṃ arāmahe stumahe |
ᐁkaṇvāḥ kaṇvagotrotpannā asmadīyāḥ putrādayaśca ᐁukthebhiḥ ukthaiḥ śastraiḥ ᐁjarante tvāṃ stuvanti ||
na ghaimanyadā papana vajrinnapaso naviṣṭhai | tavedu stomaṃ ciketa || 17 || na | gha | īm | anyat | ā | papana | vajrin | apasaḥ | naviṣṭhai | tava | ita | ū~ iti | stomam | ciketa || 17 ||
he ᐁvajrin vajravannindra ᐁapasaḥ apasvinḥ karmavataḥ tava saṃbandhini ᐁnaviṣṭhau abhinave yāge vartamāno'ham ᐁanyat tvadviṣayādanyat stotraṃ ᐁna ᐁghaṃ naiva ᐁā ᐁpapana abhiṣṭaumi |
panateḥ stutikarmaṇa uttame ṇali liṭi rūpam |
api tu ᐁtavedu tavaiva ᐁstomaṃ stotraṃ ᐁciketa abhijānāmi |
icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svaprāya spṛhayanti | yanti pramādamandraḥ || 18 || icchanti | devāḥ | sunvantam | na | svaprāya | spṛhayanti | yanti | pra'mādam | andraḥ || 18 ||
ᐁsunvantaṃ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvantaṃ yajamānaṃ ᐁdevāḥ indrādayaḥ sarve ᐁicchanti rakṣitum |
‘ spṛhe- rīpsitaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 36 ) iti karmaṇi caturthī |
yata eva- mataḥ kāraṇāt ᐁatandrāḥ analasā devāḥ ᐁpramādaṃ prakaryeṇa madakaraṃ tadīyaṃ somaṃ ᐁyanti prāpnuvanti ||
o ṣu pra yāhi vājairbhirmā haṇīthā abhya'smān | mahā~iva yurvajāniḥ || 19 || o iti | su | pra | yāhi | vājaibhiḥ | mā | haṇīthāḥ | abhi | asmān | mahān'iva | yurva'jāniḥ || 19 ||
he indra ᐁvājaibhiḥ vājairasmabhyaṃ dātavyairannaiḥ sārtham ᐁasmān ᐁabhi ābhimukhyena ᐁsu suṣṭhu ᐁpra prakaryeṇa ᐁo ā u ᐁyāhi śīghramāyāhyeva āgacchaiva |
īdṛśo mahān guṇairadhiko'pi yathā svabhāryā prati nirlajaḥ san śīghraṃ gacchati tadvat||
mo ṣv|dya duharṇāvāntsāyaṃ karadāre asmata| aśrīraiva jāmātā || 20 || mo iti| su| adha| duḥ'harṇāvān| sāyam| karat| āre| asmata| aśrīraḥ'iva| jāmātā || 20 ||

^duharṇāvān| parairduḥsahahananaṃ duharṇam| tadvānnindraḥ ^adya idānīm ^asmata ^āre asmākaṃ samīpa āgacchatu| ^su suṣṭhu atiśayena ^sāyaṃ divasasyāvasānaṃ sāyaṃkālaṃ ^mo ^karat mā kārṣīt| karotermāṅi luṅi ‘kṛmṛdṛhibhyaḥ’ iti cleraṅādeśaḥ| ^jāmātā| jāyata iti jā apatyam| tasya nirmātā duhituḥ patiḥ| ^aśrīraiva| na śrīraśrīḥ| tadasyāstītyaśrīraḥ| mattvarthīyo raḥ| guṇairvihīnaḥ kutsito jāmātāsakṛdāhūyamāno'pyāyaṃkālaṃ vilambate| tadvattvaṃ kālavilambaṃ mā kṛthā ityarthaḥ|| ||20||
vibā hasya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṃ sumatim| triṣu jñātasya manāṃsi || 21 || vibā| hi| asya| vīrasya| bhūri'dāvarīm| su'matim| triṣu| jñātasya| manāṃsi ||21||
^asya indrasya ^vīrasya vikrāntasya ^bhūridāvarīṃ bahudhanasya dātrīṃ ^sumatiṃ kalyāṇīṃ matimanugrahabuddhi ^vibā ^hi jānīmaḥ khalu|
tathā ^triṣu bhūmyādiṣu triṣu lokeṣu ^jātasya tatkāryārtha prādurbhūtasya ^manāṃsi hṛdayāni ca jānīmaḥ|
atastasyendrasya yathā prītirjaniṣyate tathā stotraṃ kurma ityarthaḥ||
ā tū biṃśca kaṇvamantaṃ na ghā viba śavasānāta| yaśastaraṃ śatabhūteḥ ||22|| ā| tu| siñca| kaṇva'mantam| na| gha| vibā| śavasānāta| yaśaḥ'taram| śatam'ūteḥ||22||

he adhvaryo ^kaṇvamantam| kaṇatiḥ śabdakarmā| kaṇvāḥ stotāraḥ| yadvā| kaṇvagotrā ṛṣayaḥ| tairyuktamindramuddiśya ^tu kṣipram ^ā ^siñca somaṃ juhudhi| ^śavasānāta| śavo balam| tadivācarato'tibalāt ^śatabhūteḥ| śataṃ bahūnāmetat| bahva uttayo rakṣā yasmin sa śatabhūtiḥ| tādṛśādasmādindrāt ^yaśastaraṃ yaśasvitaraṃ puruṣaṃ ^na ^gha naiva ^vibā jānīmaḥ| atastamevoddiśya somaṃ juhudhītyarthaḥ||
jyeṣṭhena sotṛndrāya somaṃ vīrārya śakrāya| bharā pibanvaryāya || 23 || jyeṣṭhena| sotaḥ| indrāya| somam| vīrārya| śakrāya| bhara| piban| aryāya || 23 ||
abhiṣotaradhvaryo ^vīrārya vikrāntāya ^śakrāya śaktiyuktāya ^naryāya nṛbhyo hitāya ^indrāya ^jyeṣṭhena mukhyenaindravāyavagraheṇa|
yo vediṣṭho anyathivaśvāvantaṃ jaritṛbhyaḥ| vājaṃ stotṛbhyo gomantam ||24|| yaḥ| vediṣṭhaḥ| anyathivaḥ| aśva'vantam| jaritṛbhyaḥ| vājam| stotṛbhyaḥ| go'mantam ||24||

ya: indra: avyathiṣu avyathayitṛṣu sukhakareṣu stotṛṣu vediṣṭa: atiśayena veditā kṛtasya stotrasya jñātā sa indra: jaritṛbhya: śaṃsitṛbhyo hotrādibhya: stotṛbhya: prastotrādibhyaśca aśvāvantaṃ bahubhiraśvairupetaṃ gomantaṃ bahubhirgobhirupetaṃ santaṃ vājam annaṃ balaṃ vā dadātīti śeṣa: ||
ahīnāntargate'tirātre prathame paryāye hotu: śastre ‘panthaṃpanyam’ iti stotriyastvaca: chandogairasya tṛcasya sstūyamānatvāt|
‘chandogapratyayaṃ stoma: stotriya:’ (ābha. śrau. 8. 13) iti hi smaryate ||
pantham'panyam| it| sotāra:| ā| dhāvata| madyāya| somam| vīrāya| śūrāya| || 25 || he sotāra: abhiṣotāro'dhvaryava: madyāya mādayitavyāya vīrāya vikra
vna saṃprati vayaṃ stotā vsadhamādaṃ saha mādayitavyaṃ svām vaccha abhimukhaṃ stautiti śeṣaḥ |
stutaśca yāstvā vardhanti muhe rādhase numṇāya | indre kāriṇaṃ vṛdhantaḥ ||29|| stutaḥ | ca | yāḥ | tvā | vardhanti | muhe | rādhase | numṇāya | indraṃ | kāriṇam | vṛdhantaḥ ||29||
he vindra vkāriṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ kartāraṃ vvṛdhantaḥ vardhanto ye vstutaḥ stotāraḥ vyāḥ vca tadīyāḥ stutayaḥ vtvā tvāṃ vvardhanti vardhayanti |
vmahe mahate vrādhase dhanāya vnumṇāya balāya ca |
uttaratra te satrā dadhire śavāṃsi iti sambandhaḥ ||

mandī stutyaḥ sa indrastānanu gṛhātīti śeṣaḥ|

ᵥitthā itthamenanenoktena prakāreṇa ᵥdhīvantaṃ stutimantaṃ ᵥkāṇvaṃ kaṇaputraṃ ᵥmedhyātithiṃ yajñāītithimetatsaṃjjñamṛṣiṃ he ᵥadrivaḥ vajravannrda ᵥmeṣo ᵥbhūtaḥ meparūpatāṃ prāptaḥ ᵥabhi ᵥyan abhigacchan |
yastvam ᵥathaḥ agamayaḥ taṃ tvāṃ stuma ityarthaḥ |
‘medhātithemaṃ’ (tai. ā. 1. 12. 3) iti subrahmaṇyāmantraikadeśasya vyākhyānarūpaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ chandogairavamāmnāyate— ‘medhātithiṃ hi’ kāṇvāyanaṃ meṣo bhūtvājahāra’ (pa. brā. 1. 1) iti |
śikṣā | vibhindo iti vi'bhindo | asmai | catvāri | ᵥayutā | dardat | aṣṭa | puraḥ | sahasrā || 41 ||
vibhindanāmno rājñaḥ sakāśādahu dhanaṃ labdhvā tadīyaṃ dānamidamādikena ṛcena praśaṃsati |
he ᵥvibhindo rājan ᵥdadat dātā tvam ᵥasmai mahāmṛṣaye ᵥcatvāri ᵥayutā ayutāni daśasahasrāṇi catvāriśatsahasrāṇi ᵥśikṣa aśikṣaḥ dattavānasi |
ᵥparaḥ parastāt ūrdhvamapi aṣṭasaṃkhyākāni ᵥsahasrā sahasrāṇi ca dattavānasi||
uta su tye payovṛdhā mākī raṇasya nṛpyā |
uta | su | tye iti | payaḥ'vṛdhā | ᵥmākī iti | raṇasya | nṛpyā | ᵥjani'tvanārya | mamahe ||42||
uta api ca su suṣu vye te sarvatra prasiddhe payovṛdhā payasa udakasya vardhayitavyau mākī nirmāvyau bhūtajātasya raṇasya|
stotuḥ napyā napyau na pātayitavyau sarvadānugraha- śīle dyāvāpṛthivyau janivanāya pūrvoktadhanasya jananāya prādurbhāvāya lābhāya mamahe stutavānasmi|
dyāvāpṛthivyau: prasannayorevedaṃ dānaṃ labhyate nānyadeti dānamāhātmyapraśaṃsādhigantavyā|
'pibā sutasya' iti caturviṃśatyṛcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya medhyātitherārṣam|
ayujo bṛhatyo yujaḥ satobṛhattyaḥ ekaviṃśatyanuṣṭubdvāviṃśatitrayoviṃśatyau gāyatryau caturviṃśatī bṛhatī|
etāścatasraḥ kurayāṇasya putrasya pākasthāmanāmno rājño dānastutipratipādikāḥ|
tathā cānu- krāntaṃ—'piba caturviṃśatimedhyātithiḥ prāgārthaṃ tvanuṣṭubgāyatryau bṛhatī cānyāḥ|
mahāvrate niṣkevalye bārhatatṛcāśītau dānastutirvinedaṃ sūktaṃ saptamyaṣṭa- myoścoddhāraḥ|
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ—'pibā sutasya rasina iti viṃśateḥ saptamīṃ aṣṭamīṃ coddharati' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 4) iti|
sūyate hi—'pibā sutasya rasina iti sāmapragāthaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 15) iti|
sūyate hi—'ukto rathantarasyobhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na iti bṛhataḥ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 3) iti|
evamanyatrāpi yadi rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati tatra sarvatrāyaṃ pragātho draṣṭavyaḥ|
pañcame'- hani praugaśastre 'pibā sutasya' ityayamaindraḥ pragāthaḥ|
sūtritaṃ ca—'pibā sutasya rasino devadevaṃ voḍvase' (āśva. śrau. 7. 12) iti|
pibā sutasya rasino matsavā na indra gomataḥ| āpinau bodhi sadhamādyau vṛdhe'smā~ avantu te dhiyaḥ|| 1||
piba| sutasya| rasinaḥ| matsavā| naḥ| indra| gomataḥ| āpinau| naḥ| bodhi| sadhamādyau| vṛdhe| asmān| avantu| te| dhiyaḥ|| 1||
he indra rasinaḥ rasavataḥ gomataḥ govikāraiḥ payaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ śrayaṇadravyairyuktasya naḥ asmadīyasya sutasya abhiputasya|
api ca sadhamādyaḥ saha mādayitavyaḥ sahitai- rasmābhistarpayitavyasvam āpiḥ āpayitā bandhuḥ san naḥ asmākaṃ vṛdhe vardhanāya bodhi budhyasva|
te tvadīyāḥ dhiyaḥ buddhayo'nugrahātmikāḥ asmān stotṛn avantu rakṣantu|
bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vaya mā naḥ starabhimātaye|

imā u tvā puruvaso girau vardhantu yā mama |

tathā ᵥpāvakavarṇāḥ agnisamānatejaskāḥ ata eva ᵥśucayaḥ śuddhā

indro mahā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryamarocayat | indra hu viśvā bhuvanāni yemire indra suvānāsa indavaḥ || 6 || indraḥ | mahā | rodasī iti | paprathat | śavaḥ | indraḥ | sūryam | arocayat | indrai | hu | viśvā | bhuvanāni | yemire | indrai | suvānāsaḥ | indavaḥ || 6 ||
ayam indraḥ śavaḥ śavasa ātmīyasya balasya mahā mahimnā mahattvena rodasī dyāvā- pṛthivyau paprathat aprathayat vistāritavān |
tathā svarbhānunāvṛtaṃ sūryam ayameva indraḥ arocayat adīīpayat |
api ca indre ha asminnevendre viśvā viśvāni vyāptāni bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni yemire uparamante |
tathā suvānāsaḥ sūyamānā abhipūyamāṇāḥ indavaḥ somāśca asminneva indre niyamyante antarbhavantītyarthaḥ ||
yathā pūrvasmin kāle'stuvan evamidānīmapi tenaiva krameṇa stuvantītyarthaḥ ||
jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdinasavane brahmasatre ‘tatvā yāmi’ iti pragātho'nurūpaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tatvā yāmi suvīryamiti pragāthau stotriyānurūpau’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 16) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tatvā yāmi suvīryamabhi pra vaḥ surādhasam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti ||
yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvirtha ||
tat | tvā | yāmi | su'vīryam | tat | brahma | pūrva'cittaye | yena | yati'bhyaḥ | bhṛgave | dhanai | hite | yena | praskaṇvam | āvirtha || 9 ||
tathā 'tat 'brahma parivṛḍhamannaṃ 'pūrvacittaye pūrvaprajñānāyānyebhyaḥ pūrvameva lābhāya tvāṃ yācāmi |
'dhane 'hite abhīṣṭe sati 'yena suvīryeṇa 'yatibhyaḥ karmasuparatebhyo'yaṣṭabhyo janebhyaḥ sakāśāddhanamāhṛtya 'bhṛgave maharṣaye prayacchasi |
'yena ca brahmaṇā 'praskaṇvaṃ kaṇvaprabhavaṃ kaṇvasya putramṛṣim 'āvitha rarakṣita |
yenā samudramaṃsṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ |
sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade ||
yena | samudram | asṛjaḥ | mahīḥ | apaḥ | tat | indra | vṛṣṇi | te | śavaḥ | sadyaḥ | saḥ | asya | mahimā | na | sam'naśe | yam | kṣoṇīḥ | anu'cakrade || 10 ||
he 'indra 'yena ātmīyena’ balena 'samudram aṃdhī prati 'mahīḥ mahatīḥ 'apaḥ udakāni 'asṛjaḥ vyasṛjaḥ |
mahān samudro yāvadbhirajaiḥ pūryate tāvanti jalāni purā tvaṃ sṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ |
śugdhī na indra yatvā rayiṃ yāmi suvīryam |
śugdhi vājāya prathamaṃ sirṣāsate śugdhi stomāya pūrvya ||
śugdhi | naḥ | indra | yat | tvā | rayim | yāmi | su'vīryam | śugdhi | vājāya | prathamam | sirṣāsate | śugdhi | stomāya | pūrvya || 11 ||
ᵥyat ᵥrayiṃ dhanaṃ svāṃ ᵥyāmi yācāmi|
tasmāt loṭi hau chāndaso vikaraṇasya luk|
sanateḥ sani 'manīvantadhaṃ' iti vikalpanādidabhāve 'jana- sanakhanām' ityātvam|
haviṣmate yaja- mānāya ᵥprathamaṃ sarvebhyaḥ pūrvameva ᵥśagdhi dhanaṃ prayaccha|
karmabhirasvāṃ saṃbhakumicchate janāya prathamaṃ vājāya vājamannaṃ śagdhi dehi|
paścāt ᵥstomāya stotre he ᵥpuṣṭhya pūrvasmin kāle bhava ciraṃtanendra ᵥśagdhi dehi|
śudhī nau asya yadvū pauramāvitha dhiyaṃ indra sipāsataḥ |
śudhi yathā ruśamaṃ iyāvakaṃ kṛpamindra prāvaḥ svarṇaram ||
śagdhi | naḥ | asya | yat | ha | pauram | āvitha | dhiyaḥ | indra | sipāsataḥ | śagdhi | yathā | ruśamam | iyāvakam | kṛpam | indra | pra | āvaḥ | svaḥ | 'naram || 12 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥdhiyaḥ karmāṇi stotrāṇi vā ᵥsipāsataḥ saṃbhaktavataḥ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ saṃbandhinaḥ ᵥasya yajamānasya taddhanaṃ ᵥśagdhi pradehi ᵥyaddha yena khalu dhanena ᵥpauram|
api ca he ᵥindra ᵥruśamaṃ ᵥiyāvakaṃ ᵥkṛpaṃ caitannāmakāṃstrīn rājarṣīn ᵥyathā yena prakāreṇa ᵥprāvaḥ prārakṣaḥ tathā ᵥsvarṇaraṃ sarvasya haviṣo netāraṃ prāpayitāram|
svaḥ svargaṃ prati netavyamimaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵥśagdhi śakte kuru|
dhanādisaṃpattyā yāgānuṣṭhānāya yathā śaktto bhavati tathā kurvityarthaḥ|
sūtritaṃ ca— 'kanvavyo atasīnāṃ kadvatsyākṛtamiti kadvantaḥ pragāthāḥ|
sūyate hi—'ārambhaṇīyāḥ paryāsān kadvato'- harahaḥśasyānīti hotrakā dvitīyādiṣveva' (āśva. śrau. 7. 1) iti||
kanvavyaḥ | atasīnām | turaḥ | gṛṇīta | martyaḥ | nu | nu | asya | mahimānam | indriyam | svaḥ | guṇantaḥ | ānuśuḥ || 13 ||
ᵥatasīnām atantīnāṃ matatagāminīnāṃ stutīnāṃ ᵥturaḥ prerayitā ᵥmartyaḥ maraṇadharmā ᵥnavyaḥ abhinava idānīṃtanaḥ ᵥkankū ko nāma stotā ᵥgṛṇīta indraṃ stuyāt|
ᵥnu purā pūrva- sminnapi kāle vidyamānāḥ ᵥsvaḥ sarve ᵥguṇantaḥ stotāraḥ|
svaḥ suṣṭuvaraṇīya prāptavyamindraṃ guṇantaḥ stuvanto janāḥ|
ᵥasya indrasya ᵥmahi- mānaṃ mahattvaṃ ᵥnahi ᵥānuśuḥ na khalu prāpnuvan|

kadu stuvanta ṛtayanta devat ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate | kadā havaṃ maghavabhindra sunvataḥ kadu stuvata ā gamaḥ || 14 || kat | ū~ iti | stuvantaḥ | ṛta'yanta | devatā | ṛṣiḥ | kaḥ | vipraḥ | ohate | kadā | havam | magha'van | indra | sunvataḥ | kat | ū~ iti | stuvataḥ | ā | gamaḥ || 14 ||
he indra kadu stuvantaḥ stotraṃ kurvantaḥ kadu ke khalu janāḥ devatā |
ṛṣiḥ draṣṭā vipraḥ medhāvī kaḥ stotā ohate vahati |
yata evamataḥ kāraṇāt he maghavan dhanavan indra anugrahahītrā tvayaivāgantavyam |
sa tvaṃ kadā kasmin kāle sunvataḥ somābhipavaṃ kurvato yajamānasya havam āhvānaṃ prati ā gamaḥ āgacchaḥ |
kadu kadā ca kasmiṃśca kāle stuvataḥ kevalaṃ stotraṃ kurvato yajamānasya havamāhvānamā gamaḥ abhyagacchaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome mādhyandinasavane brahmaśastre ‘udu tye’ iti pragātho'nurūpāntaraṃ śaṃsanīyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘udu tye madhumattamā indraḥ pūrbhit’ (ādha. śrau. 5. 16) iti |
cāturvaiṃśike mādhyandinasavane tasminneva śastre'yaṃ pragātho vaikalpiko'nurūpaḥ |

vemi tvā pūṣañjhase vemi stotarva āghuṇe |
na tasya vemyaraṇaṃ hi tadvaso stuṣe pujāya sāmne ||
vemi | tvā | pūṣan | ṛñjase | vemi | stotave | āghṛṇe | na | tasye | vemi | araṇam | hi | tat | vaso iti | stuṣe | pajñāya | sāmne || 17 ||
he pūṣan poṣakandra etatsaṃjña' vā' deva tvā tvām ṛñjase prasādhayituṃ vemi kāmaye |
āghṛṇe āgatadīpte stotave tvāṃ stotuṃ vemi kāmaye |
yastvyatiriktaṃ devatāntaraṃ tasya stotraṃ na vemi na kāmaye |
he vaso vāsaka stuṣe stuvate pajñāya prājñakāya2 stotrāṇāṃ sāmne |
āmnātaṃ hi— 'yadvāṃ pajñrāso adhinā havante ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 117. 10) iti |
parā gāvo yavasaṃ kaścidāghṛṇe nityaṃ rekṇo amartya |
asmākaṃ pūṣanvitā śivo bhava maṃṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
parā gāveḥ | yavasam | kat | cit | āghṛṇe | nityam | rekṇaḥ | amartya | asmākam | pūṣan | avitā | śivaḥ | bhava | maṃṃhiṣṭhaḥ | vāja'sātaye || 18 ||
he āghṛṇe āgatadīpte pūṣannindra vā kaścit kasmiṃścit kāle asmadīyāḥ gāvo yavasaṃ tṛṇaṃ bhakṣituṃ parā gacchanti |
he amartya amaraṇa deva tadānīṃ rekṇaḥ tadrūpaṃ dhanaṃ nityam asmākaṃ dhuvamastu |
api ca he pūṣan poṣayitaḥ asmākam avitā rakṣitā bhūtvā śivaḥ sukhakaraḥ bhava |
tathā vājasātaye vājasyānnasya balasya vā saṃbhajanārthaṃ maṃṃhiṣṭhaḥ dāttamo bhava ||
sthūram | rādhaḥ | śata'aśvam | kuruṅgasya | diviṣṭiṣu | rājñaḥ | tveṣasya | su'bhagasya | ratiṣu | turvaśeṣu | amanmahi || 19 ||
idamādikena ṛcena devātithiḥ kuruṅganāmno rājño dānaṃ stauti |
kuruartuṃ gacchati kulaṃ gacchatīti vā kuruṅgaḥ |

etatsaṃjñasya tveṣasya dīptasya subhagasya śobhanadhanasya evaṃbhūtasya rājñaḥ saṃbandhinīṣu diviṣṭiṣu divaḥ svargasyaiṣaṇeṣu prāptihetubhūtāsu yāgakriyāsu ratiṣu dāneṣu dakṣiṇārūpeṣu satsu turvaśeṣu |
manuṣyeṣu madhye vayaṃ sthūraṃ sthūlaṃ prabhūtaṃ śatāśvam aśvānāṃ śatena yuktaṃ rādhaḥ dhanam amanmahi ajñātasiṣma |
dhībhi: | sātāni | kāṇvasya | vājina: | priya'maidhai: | abhidyu'bhi: | pṛṣṭham | sahasrā | anu | ni:'rmajām | aje | ni: | yuthāni | gavām | ṛṣi: || 20 ||

^kāṇvasya kaṇvaputrasya ^vājina: haviṣmato medhātithe: saṃbandhibhi: ^dhībhi: dhyātṛbhi: stotṛbhi: ^sātāni saṃbhaktāni ^abhidyubhi: abhigatadīptibhi: ^priyamaidhai: etatsaṃjñairṛṣibhi: sevitāni ^nirmajāṃ ni:śeṣeṇa śuddhānāṃ ^gavāṃ ^paṣṭhi ^sahasrā ṣaṣṭhisaṃkhyākāni sahasrāṇi ^yūthāni ^ṛṣi: devātithirham ^anu paścāt ^ni: ^aje ni:śeṣeṇāgaccham |
yathā priyamedhānāṃ kāṇvānāṃ ca gavāṃ yūthāni rājñā dattāni tai: pratigṛhītāni evaṃ tena dattāni mayā prati- gṛhyanta ityartha: ||
vṛkṣāścinme abhipitve arāraṇu: | gāṃ bha̭janta mehanātha̭ṃ bhajanta mehanā̭ ||21|| vṛkṣā: | cit | me | abhi'pitve | araraṇu: | gām | bhajanta | mehanā | aśvam | bhajanta | mehanā || 21 ||
^me mayā ^abhipitve pūrvokte dhane abhiprāpte sati ^vṛkṣāścit vṛkṣā api ^arāraṇu: aśabda- yan |
ime ṛṣaya: ^mehanā mahanīyāṃ praśasyāṃ ^gāṃ ^bhajanta asevanta alabhanta |
mehaneti ma iha neti padatrayātmakamekaṃ padam |
yadāha yāska:—‘ yadindra citraṃ ’ cāyanīyaṃ mahanīyaṃ dhanamasti |
yanma iha nāstīti vā trīṇi madhyamāni padāni ’ ( niru. 4. 4 ) |
ihāsmin rājani praśastasya dhanasya tahānaṃ mama nāsīnmama nāsīditi vṛkṣapramukhā: sarve'pi janā: procurityartha: ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye pañcamāṣṭake saptamo'dhyāya: ||
yasya ni:śvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
aṣṭame maṇḍale prathame'nuvāke catvāri sūktāni vyākhyātāni |
‘ dūrāt ’ ityekonacatvāriṃśacca pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kaṇvagotrasya pragāthātitherārṣam |
anyeṣu pañcasvarceṣu cediputrasya kaśunāmno rājño dānaṃ stūyate |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘ dūrādekāñcatvāriṃśadbrahmā- tithiraśvinaṃ dvibṛhatyanuṣṭubantamantyā: pañcārdharcaiśca kaśordānastuti: ’ iti |
prātaranuvākā- dhinaśastrayorāśvine kratau gāyatre chandasi anyattvacavarjamidaṃ sūktam |
sūyate hi—‘ dūrādiheveti tisra uttamā uddharet ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 15 ) iti ||
durādiheva yattyaruṇappurarśitat | vi bhānuṃ viśvadhātatant || 1 || durāt | iha'iva | yat | sutī | aruṇappuḥ | aśiśitat | vi | bhānum | viśvadhā | atatant || 1 ||
durāt dūrata eva viprakṛṣṭa eva nabhasaḥ prākpradeśe vartamānā 'iheva 'satī iha samīpe vidyamāneva |
prātaranuvākya2 upasyena3 kāṇḍena uṣāḥ stutā satī prādurbabhūva |
he aśvinau śaṃsiṣyamāṇāśvinaṃ kratuṃ śrotuṃ yuvāmapi prādurbhavatamityadhyāhāreṇa vākyaṃ pūraṇīyam ||
nuvatsnā manojujā rathaina pṛthupārjasā | sacaithe aśvinopasamm || 2 || nu'vat | dastrā | manaḥ'yujā | rathaina | pṛthu'pārjasā | sacaithe iti | 'aśvinā | upasam || 2 ||
'idaśī he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'nuvat nṛbhiḥ netṛbhistulyaṃ vartamānau yuvām |
tadāha yāskaḥ—'sacasvā naḥ svastaye sevasva naḥ svastaye' (niru. 3. 21) iti |
'manojujā manasaiva vyāpārāntaranirapekṣeṇa smaraṇamātreṇaiśvaryyyamānena 'pṛthupārjasā vistīrṇabalena bahusena vā |
yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasu prati stomā adakṣata | vācaṃ dūto yarthohiṣe || 3 || yuvābhyām | vājinī'vasu iti vājinī'vasu | prati | stomāḥ | 'adakṣata | vācam | dūtaḥ | yathā | 'ohiṣe || 3 ||
tasyāṃ vasu dhanaṃ yayorasti tau tathoktau |
annayuktaṃ stotṛbhyo deyaṃ vasu dhanaṃ yayorasti tādṛśau |
he aśvinau 'yuvābhyāṃ 'stomāḥ asmābhiḥ kṛtāni stotrāṇi 'prati 'adakṣata pratidṛśyantām |
ahaṃ ca 'yathā yena prakāreṇa 'vūtaḥ preṣyaḥ 'vācaṃ svāmino vākyaṃ yācate tathā yuvayoḥ prītipūrvikāṃ vācam 'ohiṣe |
dūto yathā svāminoktāṃ vācaṃ videśasthamanyaṃ prāpayati evamaha mapi stutirūpāṃ vācamohiṣe vahe yuvāṃ prāpayāmi ||
puru'priyā | naḥ | ūtaye | puru'mandrā | puruvasu iti puru'vasū | stuṣe | kaṇvasaḥ | aśvinā || 4 ||
purupriyā bahūnāṃ priyo purumandrā bahumadau bahūnāṃ mādayitārau vā |
puruvasū bahudhanau īdṛśau aśvinā aśvinau naḥ asmākam ūtaye rakṣaṇāya kaṇvasaḥ kaṇvagotrā vayaṃ stuṣe stumahe |
he antarātman kaṇvasaḥ kaṇvagotrastvaṃ stuṣe aśvinau stuhi ||
maṃhiṣṭhā | vāja'sātamā | iṣyantā | śubhaḥ | patī iti | gantārā | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛham || 5 ||
maṃhiṣṭhā maṃhiṣṭhau maṃhanīyau pūjanīyau yadvā dātṛtamau vājasātamā |
śubhaḥ śobhanasya dhanasyodayakasya vā patī svāminau |
dāśuṣaḥ carupuroḍāśādīni datsavato yajamānasya gṛhaṃ gantārā gamana- śīlau |
ataḥ 'na lokāvyaya' ' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
tā | su'devāya | dāśuṣe | sumedhām | avi'tāriṇīm | ghṛtaiḥ | gavyūtim | ṛkṣatam || 6 ||
he aśvinau tā tau tādṛśau yuvāṃ sudevāya |
śobhanā devā yena yaṣṭavyāḥ sa tathoktaḥ |
ā | naḥ | stomam | upa | dravata | tūryam | śyenebhiḥ | āśu'bhiḥ | yātam | aśvaibhiḥ | aśvinā ||7||
he aśvinau aśvinau naḥ asmākaṃ stomaṃ stotram aśvebhiḥ aśvaiḥ |
tūrya kṣipram upa ā yātam upāgacchatam |
yebhi̭stisraḥ pa̭rāva॒tau di॒vo vi॒śvāni̭ roca॒nā | śrīra̭ktūna॒pari̭dīryathaḥ ||8|| yebhi̭: | ti॒sraḥ | pa॒rā॒'va॒taḥ | di॒vaḥ | vi॒śvāni̭ | roca॒nā | trīn | a॒ktūn | pa॒ri॒'dīryathaḥ ||8||
he aśvinau 'tisraḥ 'divaḥ trīn divasān 'trīn 'aktūn tisro rātrīśca |
etāvantaṃ kālaṃ 'viśvāni sarvāṇi vyāptāni vā 'rocanā rocamānāni nakṣatrarūpāṇi devagṛhāṇi 'parāvataḥ dūradeśāt 'yebhiḥ yairaśvaiḥ 'paridīryathaḥ parigacchathaḥ |
u॒ta no॒ goma̭tīri॒ṣa u॒ta sā॒tīra̭harvidā | vi॒ pṛ॒thaḥ sā॒tayḙ si॒tam ||9|| u॒ta | naḥ | go'ma̭tīḥ | i॒ṣaḥ | u॒ta | sā॒tīḥ | a॒haḥ'vidā | vi | pṛ॒thaḥ | sā॒tayḙ | si॒tam ||9||
'uta api ca 'sātīḥ saṃbhajanīyā dātavyā vā rāyaścāsmabhyaṃ dattam |
api cāsmākaṃ 'sātaye uktānāṃ gavādīnāṃ lābhāya saṃbhajanāya vā 'pathaḥ tadupāyarūpān mārgān 'vi 'sitaṃ viśeṣeṇa badhnītam |
tasya śasi ṭilopa udāttannivṛttiścareṇa śasa udāttatvam ||
ā no̭ goma̭nta॒maśva̭nā su॒vīra̭ṃ su॒ratha̭ṃ ra॒yim | vo॒ḻhamaśvā̭vatīri॒ṣaḥ ||10|| ā | naḥ | go'ma̭ntam | a॒śva॒nā | su॒'vīra̭m | su॒'ratha̭m | ra॒yim | vo॒ḻham | a॒śva'vatīḥ | i॒ṣaḥ ||10||

he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'rathaṃ dhanam 'ā 'voḻham āvahatam āharatam | vaherloṭi chāndasaḥ śāpo luk | 'rathavattvadavalopeṣu kṛteṣu ‘sahibahorudavarṇastha’ ityotvam | kīdṛśaṃ rayim | 'gomantaṃ bahubhirgobhiryuktaṃ 'suvīram | vīryājāyanta iti vīrāḥ putrāḥ | śobhanaistairupetam | vividhamīrayanti śatrūniti vā vīrāḥ śūrāḥ | tairupetam | 'surathaṃ śobhanarathena yuktam | api ca 'aśvāvatīḥ aśvayuktāḥ | ‘mantre somāśva’ iti matau dīrghaḥ | 'iṣaḥ ipyamāṇānyannāni cāsmabhyāvahatam || ||2||
sūyate hi—‘hotā yakṣadaśvinā nāsatyā vāvṛdhānā śubhaspatī’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||

vāvṛ̭dhānā śu॒bhaspa̭tī da॒strā hi॒ra॒ṇyava̭rtanī | pi॒ba̭ta॒ṃ somya॒ṃ madhṷ ||11|| va॒vṛ॒dhānā | śu॒bhaḥ | pa॒tī iti̭ | da॒strā | hi॒ra॒ṇyava̭rtanī iti hi॒ra॒ṇya'va̭rtanī | pi॒ba̭tam | somya̭m | madhṷ ||11||
he 'śubhaspatī śubhaḥ śobhanasyālaṃkārasyodakasya vā patī svāmī he aśvinau ||

dastrā darśanīyau śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitārau vā hiraṇyavartanī hiraṇyamāgau | yadvā | vartate'sminniti vartanī rathaḥ | hiraṇyayo ratho yayostau | yadvā | vartani vartanamacaraṇam | hitaramaṇīyācaraṇau | vavṛdhānā pravṛddhau | vṛdherliṭ: kānac | īdṛśau yuvāṃ somyaṃ somamayaṃ madhu mādhuryopetaṃ madakaraṃ vā rasaṃ pibatam || asmabhyaṃ vājinīvasū maghavaddyaśca saprathaḥ | chardiyaintarmadābhyam || 12 || asmabhyam | vājinīvasū iti vājinīvasū | maghavat'bhyaḥ | ca | su'prathaḥ | chardiḥ | yantam | adābhyam || 12 || he vājinīvasū | vājinī haviryuktā yāgakriyā | tasyāṃ vasu dhanaṃ havirbhāgalakṣaṇaṃ yayostathā- vidhau he aśvinau asmabhyaṃ stotṛbhyaḥ maghavadbhyaḥ | maghaṃ dhanaṃ havirlakṣaṇam | taddvayo yajamānebhyaḥ ca saprathaḥ sarvataḥ pṛthu vistīrṇam adābhyaṃ kenāpyahiṃsyaṃ chardiḥ | gṛhaṇāmaitat | gṛhaṃ yantaṃ niyacchataṃ dattamiti yāvat || yameichāndasaḥ | śapo luk | 'chandasyubhayathā' ityārṣadhātukaravena ṅitvābhāvādamunāsikalopābhāvaḥ || ni ṣu brahma janānāṃ yāviṣṭhaṃ tūyamā gatam | mo ṣvnyā~ upāratam ||13|| ni | su | brahma | janānām | yā | aviṣṭham | tūyam | ā | gatam | mo iti | su | anyān | upa | aratam || 13 || he aśvinau yā yau yuvāṃ janānāṃ prāṇināṃ madhye brahma brāhmaṇajātiṃ su suṣṭhu ni nitarām aviṣṭham arakṣitam | yadvā | janānāṃ yajamānānāṃ brahma parivṛḍhaṃ stotraṃ havirlakṣaṇamaṃ vā yau yuvāṃ nyaviṣṭaṃ nyagacchatam | avatirgatyarthaḥ | tau yuvāṃ tūyaṃ kṣipram ā gatam asmānapyāgacchatam | anyān asmadyatiriktān yajamānān mo maiva su upāratam upagatam | kadācidapi maiva prāpnumityarthaḥ || artairmāṅi luṅi 'sartiśāsrtibhyaśca' iti chleraḍādeśaḥ || āprāhnike pravargye dharmasya haviṣaḥ : 'asya pibatama' iti dvitīyā yājyā | sūtritaṃ ca- 'asya pibatamaśvineti cāpreṣito hotā' (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti || asya pibatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madasya cāruṇaḥ | madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā ||14|| asya | pibatama | aśvinā | yuvam | madasya | cāruṇaḥ | madhvaḥ | rātasya | dhiṣṇyā || 14 || he aśvinā aśvinau he dhiṣṇyā | dhiṣaṇā stutiḥ | tadahau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ madasya madakarasya cāruṇaḥ śobhanasya rātasya asmābhirdattasya asya madhvaḥ madhurasya somasya svāṃśalakṣaṇaṃ bhāgaṃ pibatama | yadvā | dvitīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī | imaṃ somaṃ pibatama || asme ā vaṃhataṃ rayiṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam | purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam ||15|| asme iti | ā | vahatam | rayim | śata'vantam | sahasriṇam | puru'kṣum | viśva'dhāyasam ||15|| he aśvinau asme asmabhyaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ ā vahatam ānayatam | kathaṃbhūtam | śatavantaṃ śatasaṃkhyāopetaṃ sahasriṇaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyāopetaṃ ca purukṣuṃ bahunivāsaṃ yadvā purubhirbahubhiḥ stutyaṃ viśva- dhāyasaṃ viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāmasmadīyānāṃ dhārakam | 'vahihādhābhyaśchandasi' iti dadhāterasun | 'ṇit' ityanuvṛtterṇidbhāvena yugāgamaḥ || || 3 || 1. jha-ta3-vāgdhānā |

purutrā ciddhi vāṃ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ | vāghadbhirśvinā gatam ||16|| purutrā | cit | hi | vām | narā | vi'hvayante | manīṣiṇaḥ | vāghadbhiḥ | aśvinā | ā | gatam || 16 || he narā narau stotṛṇāṃ dhanasya netāvaśvinau manīṣiṇaḥ manasa īśitāraḥ stotāraḥ vāṃ yuvāṃ purutrā ciddhi bahuṣu hi deśeṣu vihvayante vividhamāhvayanti | tathā sati he aśvinau vāghadbhiḥ vāhakairaśvaiḥ ā gatam asmānevāgacchatam ||

janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṃkṛtaḥ | yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||17|| janāsaḥ | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | haviṣmantaḥ | aram'kṛtaḥ | yuvām | havante | aśvinā || 17 || vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | vṛktaṃ chinnaṃ barhiryastai tathoktāḥ | haviṣmantaḥ havirbhiryuktāḥ | araṃkṛtaḥ paryāpta- kāriṇaḥ yadvā havirādīnāmalaṃkartāraḥ janāsaḥ ṛtviglakṣaṇā janā he aśvinā aśvinau yuvāṃ havante āhvayanti | ata āgacchatamiti śeṣaḥ ||

asmākamadya vāmayaṃ stomo vāhiṣṭho antam | yuvābhyāṃ bhūtadhvinā ||18|| asmākam | adya | vām | ayam | stomaḥ | vāhiṣṭhaḥ | antam | yuvābhyām | bhūtam | aśvinā || 18 || adya idānīm asmākam ayaṃ stomaḥ asmadīyaṃ stotraṃ he aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ vāhiṣṭhaḥ vāhayitṛtamaḥ prāpayitṛtamaḥ san yuvābhyām antam antikatamaḥ atiśayena samīpavartī bhūta bhavatu | 'tame tādeśa' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 149. 1) ityantikaśabdasya tādirlupte | bhavateśchāndasaḥ śapo luk ||

yo ha vāṃ madhunā datirāhaṃto rathacarṣaṇe | tataḥ pibatamaśvinā ||19|| yaḥ | ha | vām | madhunā | datiḥ | ā'hitaḥ | ratha'carṣaṇe | tataḥ | pibatam | aśvinā || 19 || he aśvinā aśvinau rathacarṣaṇe rathasya carṣaṇe draṣṭavye madhye deśe yaḥ datiḥ madhunā madhurasyāsmābhirdattasya somasya saṃbandhī tena madhunā pūrṇaḥ āhitaḥ sthāpito vartate tataḥ dateḥ sakāśāt somaṃ pibatam ||

tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṃ gave | vahataṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ || 20 || tena | naḥ | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū | paśve | tokāya | śam | gave | vahatam | pīvarīḥ | iṣaḥ || 20 || he vājinīvasū | vājo'nnaṃ balaṃ vā | tadyuktadhanau naḥ asmākaṃ paśve paśave aśvādilakṣaṇāya || 'jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam' iti 'verḍiti' iti guṇasya vikalpitatvādyaṇ || 'tokāya putrāya gave ca | jātyabhiprāyaṃ sarvatraikavacanam | paśuprabhṛtibhyaḥ śaṃ sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pīvarīḥ pravṛddhān iṣaḥ annāni tena bhavadīyena rathena vahatam āvahataṃ prāpayatam | dattamityarthaḥ || 4 ||
uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhūairahaviṃdā |
uta | naḥ | divyāḥ | iṣaḥ | uta | sindhūn | ahaḥ'vidā | arpa | dvārā'iva | varṣyaḥ ||21||

ā nau yumnairā śravobhirā rāyā yātamāśvinā |
na ca nāmantritavidyamānatvaniṣedho dhījavetyasya viśeṣaṇatvena sāmānyavacanatvā- bhāvāt |
aśvaiḥ yuktena hiraṇyayena hiraṇmayena svarṇamayena rathena āgatamiti śeṣaḥ |
dhījavānā nāstyā ityetadvaya- mapi prathamāntameva nāmantritam |
īdṛśena rathena śīghragamanau nāstyāvaśvinau āgacchatamiti śeṣaḥ ||
yuvaṃ mṛgaṃ jāguvāṃsaṃ svardatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū |
yuvam | mṛgam | jāgu'vāṃsam | svardathaḥ | vā | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇ'vasū | tā | naḥ | pṛṅktam | iṣā | rayim || 36 ||
api ca he vṛṣaṇvasū varṣaṇadhanāvaśvinau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ jāguvāṃsaṃ jāgaraṇaśīlaṃ svakārye madajanane vyagraṃ mṛgaṃ mṛgyamanveṣaṇīyaṃ somaṃ svadathaḥ āsvādayathaḥ |
jāguvāṃsaṃ jāgrataṃ mṛgaṃ mṛganāmānamasuraṃ svadathaḥ svādayathaḥ |
tā tau yuvāṃ naḥ asmadartham iṣā annena rayiṃ dhanaṃ pṛṅktaṃ saṃpraṅktaṃ kurutam |
tā me aśvinā sanīnāṃ vidhātuṃ navānām |
yathā ciccaidyaḥ kuśaḥ śatamuṣṭrānāṃ dadatsahasrā daśa gonām ||
tā | me | aśvinā | sanīnām | vidhātum | navānām | yathā | cit | caidyaḥ | kuśaḥ | śatam | uṣṭrānām | dadat | sahasrā | daśa | gonām || 37 ||
he aśvinā aśvinau tā tādṛśau yuvāṃ navānām abhinavānāṃ śreṣṭhānāṃ sanīnāṃ saṃbhajanī- yānāṃ dhanānām |
īdṛśāni dhanāni me mahyaṃ dāpayituṃ vidhātaṃ jānītam |
yathā cit yena khalu prakāreṇa caidyaḥ cediputraḥ kuśaḥ etatsaṃjño rājā uṣṭrānāṃ śataṃ tathā gonāṃ gavāṃ daśa sahasrā daśasaṃkhyāni sahasrāṇi dadat dadyāt tathā viyātam iti pūrvatrānvayaḥ ||
yo me hiraṇyasaṃdṛśo daśa rājño amaṃhata |
yaḥ | me | hiraṇya'saṃdṛśaḥ | daśa | rājñaḥ | amaṃhata | adhaḥ'padā | ita | caidyasya | kuṣṭhyaḥ | carma'ghnāḥ | abhitaḥ | janāḥ || 38 ||
yaḥ kuśasaṃjño rājā me mahyaṃ hiraṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ hiraṇyasaṃdarśanān hiraṇyasamānatejaskān daśa rājñaḥ amaṃhata dattavān |
daśasaṃkhyākān rājño yuddhe parājitān gṛhītvā dāsatvenāsmai dattavānityarthaḥ |
nanvīdṛśānāṃ bahuvidhānāṃ rājñāṃ dāna ekaḥ kathaṃ śaknuyāditi tatrāha |
kuṣṭhyaḥ sarvāḥ prajāstasya caidyasya cediputrasya kaśoḥ |
abhitaḥ sarvato vartamānāḥ janāḥ carmaghnāḥ carmamayasya kavacā- derdhāraṇe kṛtābhyāsāḥ |

tatra ‘mahā~ indraḥ’ ityaṣṭāccatvāriṃśadacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya vatsasyārṣaṃ gāyatram |
tasmin2 paraśunāmno rājñaḥ putrasya tirindrasya dānaṃ stūyate |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘mahā~ indro'ṣṭāccatvāriṃśatstṛco'nyasti- rindrasya pāraśavyasya dānastutiḥ’ iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūyate—‘mahā~ indro ya ojaseti tisra uttamā uddharati’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 3) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘mahā~ indro ya ojasāto devā avantu na ityaindrībhivaiṣṇavībhiśca stomamatiśayasya’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 7) iti |
tṛtīye paryāye hotṛḥ śakhtre ‘mahā~ indraḥ’ iti tṛco'nurūpaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘mahā~ indro ya ojasā samasta manye viśa iti’ (āśva. śrau. 36. 4) iti |
sūyate hi—‘mahā~ indro ya ojasā nūnamaśvinā’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti |
sūyate hi—‘mahā~ indro ya ojasā bhuvastramindra brahmaṇā mahān’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 6) iti ||
mahā~ indro ya ojasā parjanyau vṛṣṭimā~iva | stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe || 1 || mahān | indraḥ | yaḥ | ojasā | parjanyaḥ | vṛṣṭimān'iva | stomaiḥ | vatsasya | vavṛdhe || 1 ||
yathā ^vṛṣṭyā yuktaḥ ^parjanyaḥ rasānāṃ prārjayitā devo mahān sa ivetyarthaḥ |
sa indraḥ ^vatsasya^ putrasthānīyasya stotṛvatsanāmna evaṃparyaiḥ stotraiḥ ^vavṛdhe pravardhate ||
prajāmṛtasya piprataḥ pra yaddharantu vahvayaḥ | viprā ṛtasya vāhasā || 2 || pra'jām | ṛtasya | piprataḥ | pra | yat | bharanta | vahvayaḥ | viprāḥ | ṛtasya | vāhasā || 2 ||

^ṛtasya yajñasya satyasya vā ^prajāṃ prakarṣeṇa jātamindraṃ ^piprataḥ nabhasaḥ pradeśān pūrayantaḥ ^vahvayaḥ vāhakā aśvāḥ ^yat yadā ^pra ^bharanta prakarṣeṇa bharanti vahanti tadā ^viprāḥ medhāvinaḥ^ ^ṛtasya yajñasya ^vāhasā prāpakena stotreṇa tamindraṃ stuvantīti śeṣaḥ ||
1. kha-na-bha-śa-kaṇvasya | 2. kha-na-bha-tasya | 3. bha-vṛṣṭimān parjanya iva | 4. jha-yathā vṛṣṭimān | 5. ta1-vatsasya putrasya | 6. śa-medhāvinaḥ stotāraḥ |
kaṇvā indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādhanam | jāmi bruvata āyudham || 3 || kaṇvāḥ | indram | yat | arkata | stomaiḥ | yajñasya | sādhanam | jāmi | bruvate | āyudham ||3||
stotāraḥ kaṇvagotrā vā vindraṃ vstomaiḥ stotraiḥ vyajñasya yāgasya vsādhanaṃ sādhayitāraṃ niṣpādakaṃ vyat yadā vakrata akṛṣata |
tadānīm vāyudhaṃ śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsakaṃ bāṇādikaṃ vjāmi |
āyudhamāyodhanaśīlamindraṃ jāmi jāmi bhrātaraṃ bruvate vadanti |
tṛtīye paryāye hotuḥ śastre ‘samasya manyave’ ityādyā dvicatvāriṃśadṛcaḥ |
sūyate hi— ‘samasya manyave viśa iti dvicatvāriṃśadṛdhvajite’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ | samudrāyaiva sindhavaḥ || 4 || sam | asya | manyave | viśaḥ | viśvāḥ | namanta | kṛṣṭayaḥ | samudrāya'iva | sindhavaḥ || 4 ||
vviśaḥ viśantyaḥ vviśvāḥ sarvāḥ vkṛṣṭayaḥ prajāḥ vasya indrasya vmanyave krodhāya |
tadarthaṃ vsaṃ vnamanta samyak svata eva namanti |
vsamudrāyaiva yathā samudramadhi prati vsindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā nadyaḥ svayameva namante tadvat ||
ojastadasya tiviṣa ubhe yatsamavartayat | indraścaiva rodasī || 5 || ojaḥ | tat | asya | tiviṣe | ubhe iti | yat | sam'avartayat | indraḥ | carma'iva | rodasī iti || 5 ||
vasya indrasya vtat vojaḥ balaṃ vtiviṣe dīdīpe |
vyat yena ojasā ayam vindraḥ vubhe vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vcarmeva vsamavartayat samyagvartayati |
yathā kaścit kiñciccarma kadācidvistārayati kadācit saṃkocayati evaṃ tadadhīne abhūtāmityarthaḥ ||
vi cidvṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā || 6 || vi | cit | vṛtrasya | dodhataḥ | vajreṇa | śata'parvaṇā | śiraḥ | bibheda | vṛṣṇinā || 6 ||

vvṛtrasya vcit āvarakasyāpi vdodhataḥ atyarthaṃ jagatkampa- yato'surasya vśiraḥ mūrdhānaṃ vśataparvaṇā śatasaṃkhyākaparvāṇā dhārā yasya tādṛśena vvṛṣṇinā vīryavatā vvajreṇa indraḥ vvi vbibheda viviccheda ||
ābhilavikeṣukhyepu tṛtīyasavane praśastaḥ śakhe ‘imā abhi ’ iti tṛco vaikalpiko'nurūpaḥ |

imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipāmagreṣu dhītaraḥ | agreḥ śocinaṃ dvidyutaḥ ||7|| imāḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ | vipām | agreṣu | dhītaraḥ | agreḥ | śociḥ | na | dvidyutaḥ ||7||
'vipāṃ stotṛṇām 'agreṣu purastāt 'imāḥ asmadīyāḥ 'dhītayaḥ dhiyaḥ stotrāṇi 'abhi 'pra 'jotumaḥ ābhimukhyena punaḥpunaḥ pravadāmaḥ |

ahaṃ pratanena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat |
aham | pratanena | manmanā | giraḥ | śumbhāmi | kaṇva'vata | yena | indraḥ | śuṣmam | it | dudhe ||11||
'kaṇvavat mama janakaḥ kaṇva iva 'ahaṃ 'pranena niyena vedarūpeṇa 'manmanā manasādhanenendra- viṣayeṇa stotreṇa 'giraḥ vācaḥ 'śumbhāmi alaṃkāromi |
yadā hīndraviṣaye prayujyante tadānīṃ yathārtha- tvāccā'laṃkṛtā bhavanti |
'yena khalu stotreṇa 'indraḥ 'śuṣmaṃ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ balaṃ 'dadhe 'it dhatta eva dhārayatyeva |
yastotramindre īdṛśaṃ balamadadhaṃ janayati tena manmanetyarthaḥ ||

sūrya paritaḥ sūrya- maṇḍalasyopari dharmeva dhārakaṃ poṣakamudakaṃ yathā raśmayo garbharūpeṇa bibhrati tadvat |
yathā sūryaḥ paritaḥ sarvaṃ jagaddhatte tadvat |

oṣadhyādirūpeṇa pariṇatasyendravīryasya gobhirātmani dhāraṇam 'indrasya vṛtra jaghanuṣaḥ' ityārabhya taittirīyake vispaṣṭamāmnātai- 'tapaśāva oṣadhībhyo'dhyātmansamasanayan tanpratyaduhan' (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 3. 3) iti |
payorūpeṇa pariṇataṃ tadvīryamimā gāva āśirārthaṃ duhata iti pūrvasyāmapyanvayaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca- 'svāmicchavaspate taṃ pratnathā' (āśva. śrau. 9. 9) iti ||

tvāmicchavaspate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ | tvāṃ sutāsa indavaḥ || 21 || tvām | it | śavasaḥ | pate | kaṇvāḥ | ukthena | vāvṛdhuḥ | tvām | sutāsaḥ | indavaḥ || 21 || he śavasaspate balasya svāminnindra tvām eva kaṇvāḥ stotāraḥ kaṇvagotrā vā ṛṣayaḥ ukthena śāstreṇa vāvṛdhuḥ vardhayanti | sutāsaḥ adhvaryubhirabhiputāḥ indavaḥ somāśca tvām eva vardhayanti ||

tavedindra praṇītiṣut praśastiradrivaḥ | yajño vitantusāvyaḥ || 22 || tave | it | indra | pra'nītiṣu | uta | pra'śastiḥ | adri'vaḥ | yajñaḥ | vitantusāvyaḥ || 22 || uta api ca he adrivaḥ | āhananasādhanenyasyadrivaḥ | tadvan he indra tavet tavaiva praṇītiṣu prakṛteṣu nayaneṣu dhanapradāneṣu satsu praśastiḥ prakṛṣṭā stutiḥ kriyate | tathā vitantasāvyaḥ vitatata-
1. jha-ta1-2-4-bhṛgugotrāsvā tvāṃ; śa-bhṛgugotrotpannāsvā tvāṃ | 2. śa-pṛśnavarṇāḥ | 3. jha-ta4-śa-enaṃ | 4. gha-śa-tvāmittvāmeva |
tamaḥ | tanoteśchandasametadvṛpam | yadvā | tantasiḥ kaṇvādirvṛddhayarthaḥ | tasmādauṇādika āyapratyayaḥ | bhavṛddho 'yajñaḥ ca tavaiva kriyate ||

ā na̭ indra॒ mahīmiṣa̭ṃ puraṃ na da̭rṣi॒ gomatī̭m | uta pra॒jāṃ su॒vīrya̭m || 23 || ā | naḥ | indra | mahīm | iṣam | puram | na | darṣi | go'matīm | uta | pra'jām | su'vīryam ||23|| he indra 'naḥ asmabhyam asmadarthaṃ 'mahīṃ mahatāṃ 'gomatīṃ gobhiryuktām 'iṣam annam 'ā 'darṣi ādriyasva dātuṃ kāmayasva | na śabdaścārthe | 'puraṃ 'na | pālanaṃ pūḥ | pālanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cāsmabhyaṃ kartumādriyasva ||

uta tyadā̭śva॒vyaṃ yadi̭ndra nāhṷṣīṣvā | agne॒ viśva॒ pradī̭dayat || 24 || uta | tyat | āśu'arvyam | yat | indra | nāhuṣīṣu | ā | agne | viśva | pra'dīdayat ||24|| he indra 'nāhuṣīṣu | nahuṣā iti manuṣyanāma | tatsambandhinīṣu | yadvā | nahuṣo nāma kaścidrājā | tadīyāsu 'viśva prajāsu 'agne purastāt 'yat 'āśvavyaṃ śīghragamyaśvasaṃghātmakaṃ balaṃ 'pradīdayat prādīdyat 'uta api ca 'tyat tadapi asmabhyaṃ dehīti śeṣaḥ | ākāraḥ pūrakaḥ ||

abhi vrajaṃ na ta̭lniṣe॒ sūra̭ u॒pāka̭rcakṣasam | yadi̭ndra mṛ॒ḻayā̭si naḥ || 25 || abhi | vrajam | na | talniṣe | sūraḥ | upāka'cakṣasam | yat | indra | mṛḻayāsi | naḥ ||25|| na saṃpratyarthe | 'na saṃpratīdānīṃ he indra 'sūraḥ prājñastvaṃ 'vrajaṃ goṣṭham 'upākacakṣasam | upāka ityantikanāma | antike draṣṭavyam 'abhi 'talniṣe abhitoṣi abhivistārayasi | gobhiḥ pūrṇaṃ karoṣītyarthaḥ | tanoteśchandase liṭi 'tanipatyośchandasi' ityupadhālopaḥ | 'yat yadā he 'indra tvaṃ 'naḥ asmān 'mṛḻayāsi mṛḻayasi sukhayasi || || 13 ||

yadaṅga ta̭vi॒īyasa indra॒ prarā̭jasi kṣitīḥ | ma॒hā~ a̭pā॒ra oja̭sā || 26 || yat | aṅga | tavipī'yasai | indra | pra'rājasi | kṣitīḥ | mahān | apāraḥ | ojasā ||26|| 'aṅga ityabhivukhīkaraṇe | he indra 'yat yastvaṃ 'tavipīyase | tavipīti balanāma | balamivā- carasi | hastyaśvarathādikaṃ balaṃ yathā sarvaṃ śatrujātaṃ bhanakti' tadvattvamasahāya eva san sarvameva śatrujātaṃ mārayasītyarthaḥ | yaśca tvaṃ 'kṣitīḥ | manuṣyanāmaiṭat | manuṣyān 'prarājasi prakarṣeṇeśiṣe | rājati- raiśvaryakarmā | asyāpi yadvṛttayogānna nighātaḥ | sa indraḥ 'ojasā balena 'mahān sarvebhyo'dhikaḥ ata eva 'apāraḥ pārarahitaḥ | kenāpyavasānaṃ prāpayitumaśakya ityarthaḥ ||

taṃ tvā̭ ha॒viṣmatī̭rviśa॒ upa̭ bruvata ū॒tayḙ | u॒ru॒vya̭sami॒ndurbhi̭ḥ || 27 || tam | tvā | haviṣmatīḥ | viśaḥ | upa | bruvate | ūtaye | uru'vyasam | indu'bhiḥ ||27|| he indra 'taṃ pūrvoktaguṇam 'uruvyasaṃ vistīrṇavyāpinaṃ tvāṃ 'haviṣmatīḥ havirmiśrapuroḍāśādi- bhiryuktāḥ 'viśaḥ prajāḥ 'upa 'bruvate upetya stuvanti | kimartham | 'indubhiḥ somaḥ 'ūtaye tarparṇāya3 | yadvā | indubhiḥ somaḥ uruvyasaṃ vistīrṇajavamūtaye rakṣaṇāya stuvanti ||

upahvare girīṇāṃ saṃgathe ca nadīnām | dhiyā vipro ajāyata || 28 || upa'hvare | girīṇām | sam'gathe | ca | nadīnām | dhiyā | vipraḥ | ajāyata || 28 || ^girīṇāṃ parvatānām ^upahvare upaharttavye prānte ^nadīnāṃ saritāṃ ^saṃgathe saṃgamane ^ca īdṛgvidhe deśe kriyamāṇā ^dhiyā yāgakriyayā stutyā vā ^vipraḥ ^medhāvīndraḥ ^ajāyata prādurbhavati | ato vayamapi tādṛśe deśe yajāmaḥ stumo veti bhāvaḥ | girīṇāmityatra ‘nāmanyatarasyām’ iti nāma udāttatvam ||

ataḥ samudramudtaścikitvā~ arba paśyati | yato vipāna ejati || 29 || ataḥ | samudram | ut'vataḥ | cikitvān | arba | paśyati | yataḥ | vipānaḥ | ejati ||29|| ^yataḥ yasmin dyuloke ^vipānaḥ vyāpyunvan viśiṣṭapānayukto vā indraḥ ^ejati ceṣṭate ^udvataḥ udgatāt | ‘upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe’ (pā. sū. 5. 1. 118) iti vatiḥ | ^ataḥ asmāt dyulokāt ^cikitvān jānan sa indraḥ ^samudraṃ samundanaśīlaṃ yajamānardīyamānaṃ somam ^ava ^paśyati avāṅmukhaḥ samīkṣate | yadvā | sūryātmanendraḥ stūyate | yasminnabhasi vipānaḥ vyāpyunvan sūryātmendra ejati vartate cikisvāñjānan vidvān sa indra uddata uddanādato'smādantarikṣāt samudram | upalakṣaṇametat | samudropalakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadava paśyati | avāṅmukhaṃ prasṛtaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ prakāśayati ||

āditpratnasya retaso jyotiṣpaśyanti vāsaram | puro yadidhyate divā ||30|| āt | ita | pratnasya | retasaḥ | jyotiḥ | paśyanti | vāsaram | puraḥ | yat | idhyate | divā ||30|| ^paraḥ ^divā divaḥ parastāt dyulokasyopari ^yat yadā ayamindraḥ sūryātmanā ^idhyate dīpyate ^ādit anantarameva ^pratnasya ciraṃtanasya ^retasaḥ gantuḥ | ‘rī gatireṣaṇayoḥ’ | asmāt ‘surībhyāṃ tuṭ ca’ (u. sū. 4. 641) ityasun tuḍāgamaśca || yadvā | reta ityudakanāma | retasvin udakavataḥ | sāmarthyāt matvartho lakṣyate | īdṛśasyendrasya sūryātmanaḥ ^vāsaraṃ nivāsakaṃ vāsarasya nivā- sasya hetubhūtaṃ vā ^jyotiḥ dyotamānaṃ tejaḥ ^paśyanti sarve janāḥ | yadvā | vāsaramiti atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | kṛtsnamahṛdayaprabhṛtyāntamanaṃ yāvajjyotiṣpaśyantītyarthaḥ | ‘isumoḥ sāmarthye’ iti visarjanīyasya phavam || || 14 ||

kaṇvāsa indra te matiṃ viśve vardhanti pauṃsyam | uto śavṭha vṛṣaṇyam ||31|| kaṇvāsaḥ | indra | te | matim | viśve | vardhanti | pauṃsyam | uto iti | śavṭha | vṛṣaṇyam ||31|| he ^indra ^te tvadīyāṃ ^matiṃ buddhiṃ ^pauṃsyam | balanāmaitat | balaṃ ca ^viśve sarve ^kaṇvāsaḥ kaṇvāḥ stotāraḥ kaṇvagotrā vā ṛṣayaḥ ^vardhanti vardhayanti | ‘chandasyubhayathā’ iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt ‘ṇeraniṭi’ iti ṇilopaḥ | ^uto api ca he ^śaviṣṭha śavasvitama balavattama | ‘vinmatorluk’ | ‘ṭeḥ’ iti ṭilopaḥ | īdṛśendra ^vṛṣaṇyaṃ tvadīyaṃ nītha balaṃ karma ^ca kaṇvāso vardhayantyeva ||
imāṃ me indra suṣṭutiṃ juṣasva pra su māmava | uta pra vardhayā matim || 32 || imām | me | indra | su'stutim | juṣasva | pra | su | mām | ava | uta | pra | vardhaya | matim ||32||
1. śa-evaṃvidho vipraḥ | 2. kha-bha-loke | 3. kha-jha-śa-balaṃ karma | 4. jha-ta1-2-4-vardhayantītyeva |
he indra imāṃ purovartinīṃ me madīyāṃ suṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ jupasva sevasva |
sevitvā ca stotāraṃ māṃ su śobhanaṃ pra ava prakarṣeṇa rakṣa |
uta api ca matiṃ asmadīyāṃ buddhiṃ pra vardhaya pravṛddhāṃ kuru |
uta brahmaṇya vayaṃ tubhyaṃ pravṛddha vajrivaḥ | viprā atakṣama jīvasai || 33 || uta | brahmaṇya | vayam | tubhyam | pra'vṛddha | vajrivaḥ | viprāḥ | atakṣam | jīvasai || 33 ||
uta api ca he pravṛddha stutibhiḥ prakṛṣṭāṃ vṛddhiṃ prāpta he vajrivaḥ vajravannindra |
vayaṃ brahmaṇya brahmāṇaṃ stotrāṇi havirlakṣaṇānyannāni vā |
abhi kaṇvā anuṣatāpo na pravatā yatīḥ | indraṃ vananvatī matiḥ || 34 || abhi | kaṇvāḥ | anupata | āpaḥ | na | pravatā | yatīḥ | indram | vanan'vatī | matiḥ || 34 ||
āpo na āpa iva matiḥ mananīyā kaṇvaiḥ kriyamāṇā stutiḥ stutyam indraṃ vananvatī svayameva saṃbhajanavatī bhavati |
indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ | anuttamanyumajaram || 35 || indram | ukthāni | vavṛdhuḥ | samudram'iva | sindhavaḥ | anutta'manyum | ajam || 35 ||
ukthāni śastrāṇyasmābhiḥ śasyamānāni indraṃ vavṛdhuḥ vardhayanti |
sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā nadyaḥ samudramiva samudraṃ jaladhiṃ yathā vardhayanti tadvat |
anutto' preritaḥ parairanabhibhūto manyuḥ krodho yasya tādṛśam |
ā nau yāhi parāvato haribhyāṃ haryatābhyām | imamindra sutaṃ piba || 36 || ā | naḥ | yāhi | parā'vataḥ | hari'bhyām | haryatābhyām | imam | indra | sutam | piba || 36 ||
he indra parāvataḥ parāgādūre vartamānāt dyulokāt haryatābhyāṃ kāntābhyāṃ haribhyām aśvābhyāṃ naḥ asmān ā yāhi āgaccha |
āgatya ca imam asmadīyaṃ sutam abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ piba ||
tvāmidvṛtrahantam janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | havante vājasātaye || 37 || tvām | it | vṛtrahan'tamam | janāsaḥ | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | havante | vāja'sātaye || 37 ||
he vṛtrahantama atiśayena vṛtrāṇāmāvṛṇvatāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantaḥ tvāmit tvāmeva vṛktabarhiṣaḥ vṛktaṃ yāgārthaṃ chinnaṃ barhiryeṣāṃ tathāvidhoktāḥ pravṛttayajñāḥ |
vājasya sātiryasmin saṃgrāme tatra sāhāyyāya tvāmāhvayantītyarthaḥ ||
anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṃ na vṛtyartham | anu suvānāsa indavaḥ || 38 || anu | tvā | rodasī iti | ubhe iti | cakram | na | vṛti | ertaśam | anu | suvānāsaḥ | indavaḥ || 38 ||
he indra tvā tvām ubhe rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau anuvartate |
puro gacchantamaśvam anu varti anuvartate tadvat |
api ca suvānāsaḥ ṛtvigbhirabhiṣūyamāṇāḥ indavaḥ somāśca tvām anu vartante ||
mandasvā su svarnara utendra śaryaṇāvati | matsvā vivasvato mutī ||39|| mandasva | su | svaḥ'nare | uta | indra | śaryaṇā'vati | matsva | vivasvataḥ | mutī || 39 ||
uta api ca he indra śaryaṇāvati |
tasmin sarasi vidyamāne svarnere sarvairṛtvigbhiranaṃtavye yajñe su suṣṭhu mandasva mādya tṛpto bhava |
api ca vivasvataḥ paricaraṇavato yajamānasya matī mathyā ca matsva madaṃ prāpnuhi |
vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajryoravīt | vṛtrahā saumapārtamaḥ || 40 || vāvṛdhānaḥ | upa | dyavi | vṛṣā | vajrī | arovīt | vṛtra'hā | soma'pārtamaḥ || 40 ||

vāvṛdhānaḥ vṛddhaḥ vajrī vajravān eva vṛtrahā vṛtrasya meghasyāsurasya vā hantā soma- pātamaḥ atiśayena somasya pātā indraḥ vṛṣā udakānāṃ varṣitā dyavi dyuloke'ntarikṣe upa samīpe yathāsmābhiḥ śrūyate tathā arovīt bhṛśaṃ stanayitnu lakṣaṇaṃ śabdamakarot |
ṛṣirhi pūrvajā asyeka īśāna ojasā | indraṃ coṣkūyase vasu || 41 || ṛṣiḥ | hi | pūrva'jāḥ | asi | ekaḥ | īśānaḥ | ojasā | indra | coṣkūyase | vasu || 41 ||
he indra pūrvajāḥ sarvebhyo devebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ jāta utpannaḥ |
tvam ṛṣirhi draṣṭā sarvajñaḥ khalu asi bhavasi |
api ca sarveṣu deveṣu madhye ekaḥ mukhyaḥ ojasā balena īśānaḥ īśvaro bhavasi |
eko'sahāya eva saojasā ātmīyenaiva balena īśānaḥ sarvasya jagata īśvaro bhavasi |
sa tvaṃ vasu dhanaṃ coṣkūyase punaḥpunaḥ stotṛbhyo dadāsi |
tathā coktaṃ— coṣkūyamāṇa indra bhūri vāmaṃ dadadindra bahu vananīyam (niru. 6. 22) iti ||
asmākaṃ tvā sutā~ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ | śataṃ vahantu harayaḥ ||42|| asmākam | tvā | sutān | upa | vīta'pṛṣṭhāḥ | abhi | prayaḥ | śatam | vahantu | harayaḥ || 42 ||
dhānākarambhādi- havilakṣaṇamacaṃ cābhilakṣya 'vītapṛṣṭhāḥ praśastoparibhāgāḥ 'śataṃ śatasaṃkhyākāḥ 'harayaḥ aśvāḥ tvāṃ 'vahantu prāpayantu ||
imāṃ su pūyāṃ dhiyaṃ madhorghṛtasya pipyuṣīm | kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ ||43|| imām | su | puṇyām | dhiyam | madhoḥ | ghṛtasya | pipyuṣīm | kaṇvāḥ | ukthena | vāvṛdhuḥ ||43||

'imām idānīṃ kriyamāṇāṃ 'su suṣṭhu 'pūyāṃ pūrvaiḥ pitrādibhiḥ kṛtāṃ 'madhoḥ madhurasya 'ghṛtasya kṣaraṇaśīlasyodakasya 'pipyuṣīṃ vardhayitrīṃ yadvā madhureṇa ghṛtenājyena pravṛddhāṃ 'dhiyaṃ yāgakriyāṃ 'kaṇvāḥ kaṇvagotrā ṛṣayaḥ 'ukthena śasreṇa 'vāvṛdhuḥ indrārthaṃ vardhayanti |
sahasrāṇi ca pannāya stutīnāṃ prārjakāya sājhe etatsaṃjñāyarpaye | yadvā | sājhe | māma stotram | tadte pannāya pannakulajātāya kakṣīvate | vadu: tirindarākhyā rājāno dattavantaḥ ||
udānkuhuo divumuṣṭrāṛturyujo dardata | śravasā yādṛṃ janam || 48 || uta | ānaṭ | kakuhaḥ | divam | uṣṭrān | catuḥ'yujaḥ | dardata | śravamā | yādṛm | janam || 48 ||
atha rājā kakuhaḥ ucchritaḥ san śravasā kīrtyā divaṃ svargam udān utkṛṣṭataraṃ vyāpyanot |
caturyujaḥ caturbhiḥ svarṇabhārairyuktān uṣṭrān dardata prayacchan |
tathā yādṛṃ janaṃ ca dāsatvena prayacchan |
'pra yadvaḥ' iti ṣaṭtriṃśadca dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ kaṇvagotrasya punarvatsasyārṣaṃ mārutaṃ gāyatram |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'pra yadvaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatpunarvatso mārutam' iti |
vyūḍhe daśarātre prathame chandoma ābhi- mārutaśastra idaṃ sūktaṃ mārutanidvidvānam |
sutritaṃ ca—'pra yadvastriṣṭubhaṃ dūtaṃ va ityābhimārutam' (āśva. śrau. 8. 9) iti |
pra yadvastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ maruto vipro akṣarata | vi parvateṣu rājatha || 1 || pra | yat | vaḥ | tri'stubham | iṣam | marutaḥ | vipraḥ | akṣarata | vi | parvateṣu | rājatha || 1 ||
he marutaḥ mitarāviṇo mitarocino vā etatsaṃjñā mādhyamakā devagaṇāḥ |

vaḥ yuṣmabhyaṃ vipraḥ medhāvī stotā triṣṭubhaṃ triṣu savaneṣu praśasyāṃ tribhirdevaiḥ stutāṃ vā yadvā triṣṭupchandasā saṃbaddhāṃ mādhyaṃ- dinasavanikīm iṣaṃ somalakṣaṇamannaṃ yat yadā pra akṣarata prāsiñcat abhau prākṣipan |
triṣṭubhaṃ triṣṭupchandaskaṃ stotramiṣaṃ somaṃ ceti yojyam |
tadānīṃ yūyaṃ parvateṣu parvatavatsu śiloccayeṣu vi rājatha |
tena somena labdhabalāḥ santo viśeṣeṇa dīptā bhavatha |
yaduṅga tavipīyavo yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam | ni parvatā ahāsata || 2 || yat | aṅga | tavipī'yavaḥ | yāmam | śubhrāḥ | acidhvam | ni | parvatāḥ | ahāsata || 2 ||
he śubhrāḥ śobha- mānāḥ aṅga he marutaḥ yāmam yāni gacchantīti yāmo rathaḥ |

taṃ yat yadā acidhvaṃ samacinudhvaṃ aśvādibhiḥ sādhanaiḥ saṃcitaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ kurutha gamanāthaṃ tadānīṃ parvatāḥ girayo'pi ni ahāsata nitarāṃ gacchanti yuṣmadrathavegādbhītāḥ santaḥ svasthānāt pracalanti |
udīrayanta vāyubhirvāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ | dhukṣanta pipyuṣīmiṣam || 3 || uta | īrayanta | vāyu'bhiḥ | vāśrāsaḥ | pṛśni'mātaraḥ | dhukṣanta | pipyuṣīm | iṣam || 3 ||
sā mātā jananī yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |
pṛṣatībhirvāhanabhūtābhiḥ svāvayavabhūtairvāyubhireva vā udīrayanta udgamayanti meghādikam |
tathā pipyuṣīṃ vardhayitrīma iṣam annaṃ ca stotṛbhyaḥ dhukṣanta duhanti |
3. jha-vā mahadravaṃtīti veti niruktaṃ; ta1 (prānte) -vā mahadravaṃtīti vā |
varpanti maruto mihaṃ pra vaipayanti parvatān | yadhāmaṃ yānti vāyubhiḥ ||4|| varpanti | marutaḥ | miham | pra | vepayanti | parvatān | yat | yāmam | yānti | vāyubhiḥ ||4||
ᵥmarutaḥ etatsaṃjñā devāḥ ᵥmihaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ ᵥvapanti vikiranti vikṣipanti |
tathā ᵥparvatān girīn ᵥpra ᵥvepayanti prakampayanti |
ᵥyat yadā ᵥvāyubhiḥ sārdhaṃ ᵥyāmaṃ rathaṃ gamanaṃ vā ᵥyānti prāpnuvanti tadānīmityarthaḥ ||
ni yadhāmāya vo girini sindhavo vidharmaṇe |
ni | yadhāmāya | vaḥ | giriḥ | ni | sindhavaḥ | vi'dharmaṇe | mahe | śuṣmāya | yemire ||5||
he marutaḥ ᵥvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ᵥyāmāya rathāya gamanāya vā ᵥgiriḥ |
girayaḥ parvatāḥ ᵥyat yadā ᵥni ᵥyemire svayameva niyamyante |
tathā ᵥsindhavaḥ syandanaśīlāḥ samudrā nadyo vā ᵥvidharmaṇe vidharaṇāya ᵥmahe mahate ᵥśuṣmāya śoṣakāya yuṣmadīyāya balāya ᵥni yemire svayameva niyamyante |
girayo nadyaśca yuṣmadājñālla bhiyā ekatraiva sthāne niyatā vartanta ityarthaḥ |
yuṣmā~ u naktamūtaye yuṣmāndivā havāmahe | yuṣmānprayatyadhvare || 6 || yuṣmān | ū~ iti | naktam | ūtaye | yuṣmān | divā | havāmahe | yuṣmān | prayati | adhvare || 6 ||
he marutaḥ ᵥyuṣmā~ ᵥu yuṣmāneva ᵥnaktaṃ rātrau ᵥūtaye rakṣaṇārthaṃ ᵥhavāmahe |
ᵥdivā ahni ca ᵥyuṣmān eva āhvayāmahe |
yāge ᵥprayati pragacchati pravartamāne sati rakṣaṇārthaṃ ᵥyuṣmān evāhvayāmahe ||
udu tye aruṇapsevacitrā yāmaibhirīrate | vāśrā adhi snunā divaḥ || 7 || ut | ū~ iti | tye | aruṇapsevaḥ | citrāḥ | yāmaibhiḥ | īrate | vāśrāḥ | adhi | snunā | divaḥ || 7 ||

ᵥtye te pūrvoktaguṇāḥ ᵥaruṇapsevaḥ aruṇavarṇarūpāḥ ᵥcitrāḥ cāyanīyāḥ āścaryabhūtā vā ᵥvāśrāḥ śabdakāriṇaḥ evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ ᵥyāmaibhiḥ yāmairyānaiḥ ᵥdivaḥ ᵥadhi dyulokasyopari ᵥsnunā sānunā samucchritapradeśena ᵥut ᵥīrate udgacchanti |
sūyate hi—‘sṛjanti raśmi- mojasā vahiṣṭhebhirhiranyāsi tantum’ (ādha. śrau. 2. 13) iti ||
sṛjanti raśmimojasā panthāṃ sūryāya yātave | te bhānubhirvitasthire ||8|| sṛjanti | raśmim | ojasā | panthām | sūryāya | yātave | te | bhānubhiḥ | vi | tasthire ||8||
▽te marutaḥ ▽bhānubhiḥ tejobhiḥ ▽vi ▽tasthire krasnaṃ jagat vyāpya avatiṣṭhante ||

imām | me | marutaḥ | giram | imam | stomam | ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ | imam | me | vanata | havam ||9|| he marutaḥ ▽imāṃ purovartinīṃ ▽me mama ▽giraṃ śakharūpāṃ vācaṃ ▽vanata saṃbhajata | he ▽ṛbhu- kṣaṇaḥ | mahajjāmaitat | mahāntaḥ | jasi 'ito'ssarvanāmasthāne' ityakāraḥ | 'vā ṣūparvasya nigame' iti dīrghābhāvaḥ | te yūyam ▽imaṃ ▽stomaṃ stotraṃ pragītamantrasādhyaṃ ▽me mama ▽imaṃ purovartinīṃ ▽havam āhvānarūpaṃ ca yājuṣaṃ mantraṃ vanata saṃbhajata sevadhvam ||
trīṇi saro~si pṛśrayo duduhe vajriṇe madhu |
indrārtha ▽madhu madhuraṃ kṣīrādikamāśrayaṇadravyaṃ ▽trīṇi ▽saro~si sara iva somaḥ pūritāni trīṇi savanāni trivapa savaneṣu śrayaṇārthaṃ ▽duduhe duduhire |
madhu madhuraṃ somaṃ vajriṇe vajrayuktāya marudgaṇāya trīṇi saro~si droṇakalaśādhavaniyapūtabhakṣaṇāni prati pṛśrayaḥ mādhyamikā vāco duduhe vṛṣṭidvārā duhanti |
yadvā pṛbhaya iti mātṛvācinā śabdena putrā ucyante |
pṛbhimātaro maruta indrārtha trīṇi saro~si droṇakalaśā- dīni madhu madhunā somena pūrayitum ▽utsam utsravaṇaśīlaṃ ▽kavndham udakam ▽udriṇam udakavantaṃ meghaṃ duduhe duhate |
maruto yad vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe |

marutaḥ | yat | vo | divaḥ | sumna'yantaḥ | havāmahe | ā | tu | naḥ | upa | gantana || 11 || he ▽marutaḥ ▽yad yadā khalu ▽vaḥ yuṣmān ▽sumnāyantaḥ sumnaṃ sukhamātmana icchanto vayaṃ ▽divaḥ dyulokāt ▽havāmahe stutibhirāhvayāmahe | ▽ā ▽tu anantarameva śīghraṃ ▽naḥ asmān ▽upa ▽gantana upagacchata | gameloṭi 'tasanasanathanāśca' iti tanabādeśaḥ ||
yuyaṃ hi chā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame |

yuyam | hi | stha | su'dānavaḥ | rudrāḥ | ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ | dame | uta | pra'cetasaḥ | made || 12 || ▽uta api ca he ▽sudānavaḥ śobhanadānā he ▽rudrāḥ rudraputrāḥ | pādāditvādāmantrita- nighātābhāvaḥ | he ▽ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ mahāntaḥ | urutejaskā vā īdṛśā he marutaḥ ▽yuyaṃ ▽hi khalu ▽dame yajñagṛhe ▽made madakare some pīte sati ▽pracetasaḥ ▽stha prakṛṣṭajñānā bhavata ||
ā nau rayiṃ maḍhyutaṃ purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam |

ā | naḥ | rayim | mada'cyutam | puru'kṣum | viśva'dhāyasam | iryata | marutaḥ ||13|| he marutaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ rathi dhanaṃ divaḥ dhulokāt ā iyataṃ āgatamayata | 'ṛ gatau' ityasmādantarbhāvitaṇyarthāt jauhotyādikālloṭi tasya 'tasanasana' iti tabādeśaḥ | 'anudātte ca' ityabhyastādyudāttatvam | kīdṛśaṃ rayim | madacyutaṃ madaṃ sravantaṃ yadvā śātravasya madasya cyāvayitāraṃ purukṣuṃ bahunivāsaṃ bahubhiḥ stūyamānaṃ vā viśvadhāyasaṃ viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāsmadīyānāṃ dhāraṇāya poṣaṇāya paryāptam ||

adhīva yadgirīṇāṃ yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam | suvānairmandadhva indubhiḥ ||14|| adhi'iva | yat | girīṇām | yāmam | śubhrāḥ | acidhvam | suvānaiḥ | mandadhve | indu'bhiḥ ||14|| he śubhrāḥ śobhamānā marutaḥ girīṇāṃ parvatānām adhīva uparīva yat yadā yāmaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ ratham acidhvaṃ gamanasādhanairaśvādibhiḥ upacitaṃ kurutha tadānīṃ suvānaiḥ abhiṣūyamāṇaiḥ indubhiḥ somaiḥ mandadhve mādayadhve ||

etāvatścideṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ | adābhyasya manmabhiḥ || 15 || etāvat | cit | eṣām | sumnam | bhikṣeta | martyaḥ | adābhyasya | manma'bhiḥ || 15 || martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ stotā manmabhiḥ stotraiḥ sumnaṃ sukhaṃ dhanaṃ vā eṣāṃ marutāṃ svabhūtaṃ bhikṣeta yāceta | idānīṃ gaṇābhiprāyeṇaikavadāha | etāvatścit yatparimāṇasya ca adābhyasya kenāpi hiṃsitumaśakyasya marudraṇasya sumnaṃ bhikṣeta || etacchabdāt 'yattadetebhyaḥ' iti parimāṇe'rthe vatup | 'ā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam || ||20||

ye dṛpsā'iva rodasī dhamantyanu vṛṣṭibhiḥ | utsa~ duhanto akṣitam || 16 || ye | dṛpsāḥ'iva | rodasī | dhamanti | anu | vṛṣṭi'bhiḥ | utsam | duhantaḥ | akṣitam || 16 || ye marutaḥ dṛpsā iva udabindava iva rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vṛṣṭibhiḥ anu dhamanti anugacchanti sākalyena vyāpyanvanti | yadvā | anudhamante uccchritāvayave kurvanti | kiṃ kurvanti | akṣitam akṣīṇamudakam utsaṃ meghaṃ duhantaḥ pūrayanto meghadāvāṅmukhaṃ pātayantaḥ | duheḥ 'lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 126) iti hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ | yata evaṃ duhanti tato rodasī anudhamantītyarthaḥ ||

udu svānebhirīrata udrairudu vāyubhiḥ | utstomaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ || 17 || ut | ū~ iti | svānebhiḥ | īrate | ut | rayaiḥ | ut | vāyu'bhiḥ | ut | stomaiḥ | pṛśni'mātaraḥ || 17 || svānebhiḥ svānaiḥ śabdairmarutaḥ ut īrate utcchanti | 'svana śabde' | 'svanahasorvā' (pā. sū. 3. 3. 62) ityapo vikalpitatvāt pakṣe ghañ | 'karṣātvataḥ' ityantodāttatvam | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti bhisa aisabhāvaḥ | u iti pūraṇaḥ | tathā rayaiḥ rathamukhaiḥ vāhanaiścodīrate | pṛśnimātaraḥ --- ||
4. gha-jña-ta1-2-mu- pṛśnimātaraḥ marutastathā stomaiḥ stotraiḥ udīrate; śa- pṛśnimātaraḥ pṛśneḥ putrā marutaḥ stomairasmābhiḥ kṛtaiḥ stotraiḥ eva evaṃ bahudhā udīrate utcchantiḥ |

‘bṛha- nmahatorupasaṃkhyānam’ iti mahataḥ parasya ṅīp udāttatvam |
tathā kṣoṇī kṣoṇyau dyāvāpṛthivyau ca te marutaḥ saṃ dudhuḥ |
yathā sve sve sthāne'- vatiṣṭhate tathā dhārayanti |

tathā sūrya sarvasya prerakamādityaṃ cāntarikṣe saṃ dudhuḥ samyagdhārayanti |
ihaśāstre marutaḥ vajram ātmīyamāyudhaṃ parvvaśaḥ parvvaṇi parvvaṇi vṛtrasya sarvveṣvavayava- sambandheṣu hananāt saṃ dudhuḥ samayuyujan’ ||
vi vṛtraṃ parvvaśo yayurvi parvvatā~ arājanaḥ | cakrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṃsyam || 23 || vi | vṛtram | pūrvvaśaḥ | yayuḥ | vi | parvvatān | arājanaḥ | cakrāṇāḥ | vṛṣṇi | pauṃsyam || 23 ||
rājā svāmī asya na vidyata itya- rājendraḥ |
vṛṣṇi vīryyavat pauṃsyaṃ balaṃ cakrāṇāḥ kurvāṇā marutaḥ |
vṛtram āvarakamasuraṃ meghaṃ vā parvvaśaḥ parvvaṇi parvvaṇi bhedena vi yayuḥ viśiṣṭaṃ vadhamagamayan |
tathā parvvatān girīṃśca viśiṣṭaṃ vadhaṃ prāpayana ||
anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmamāvabhṛta kratum | anvindraṃ vṛtratūryye || 24 || anu | tritasya | yudhyataḥ | śuṣmam | āvan | uta | kratum | anu | indram | vṛtratūryye || 24 ||
tritasya āpyasyaitatsaṃjñasya yudhyataḥ śatrūn saṃpraharato rājarṣeḥ śuṣmaṃ pareṣāṃ śoṣakaṃ balaṃ marutaḥ anu āvan sāhāyyārthamanvagacchan |
uta api ca kratuṃ tadīyaṃ karma cārakṣan |
api ca vṛtratūryye vṛtravadhārthe saṃgrāme indraṃ ca anu āvan arakṣan ||
vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprrāḥ śīrṣanhiraṇyayīḥ | śubhā vyañjata śriye || 25 || vidyuthastāḥ | abhidyavaḥ | śiprrāḥ | śīrṣan | hiraṇyayīḥ | śubhāḥ | vi | añjata | śriye || 25 ||
śubhāḥ śobhamānāḥ marutaḥ śīrṣan śīrṣan śirasyātmīyeṣu śiraḥsu hiraṇyayīḥ hiraṇmayīḥ svarṇamayāni śiprrāḥ śirastrāṇāni śriye śobhārthaṃ vyañjata vyañjayanti |
uśanā yatparāvata ukṣṇo randhrmayātan | dyaurna cakradadbhiyā || 26 || uśanā | yat | parāvataḥ | ukṣṇaḥ | randhram | aryātan | dyauḥ | na | cakradat | bhiyā || 26 ||
he marutaḥ uśanāḥ | vyatyayena prathamā | uśanasā kāvyenarṣiṇā stūyamānā yūyam | yadvā | uśanaḥśabdāt ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti jasaḥ suḥ || uśanasaḥ stotṛn kāmayamānā yūyam ukṣṇaḥ sephaḥ 1. śa-samayojanam |
kāmanānāṃ varṣiturāmīyasya rathasya vṛṣṭihetorantarikṣasya vā randhraṃ madhyaṃ parāvataḥ dūradeśāt yat yadā ayātana agacchata ||
dyuloke vartamāno janasaṃgha iva pārthivamapi sarvaṃ bhūtajātaṃ bhiyā yuṣmadvegajanitayā bhītyā cakradat aśabdayat akampata vā ||
ā nau makhasya dāvane'śvairhiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ | devāsa upa gantana ||27|| ā | naḥ | makhasya | dāvanai | aśvaiḥ | hiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ | devāsaḥ | upa | gantana || 27 ||
he devāsaḥ dānādiguṇayuktā marutaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ makhasya yajñasya dāvane dānāya |
hiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ suvarṇamayapādaiḥ suvarṇālaṃkṛtairharamaṇīyapādairvā aśvaiḥ ā upa gantana upāgacchata prāpnuta ||
yadaiṣāṃ pṛṣatī rathe pṛṣṭivarhati rohitaḥ | yānti śubhrā riṇanpaḥ || 28 || yat | eṣām | pṛṣatī | rathe | pṛṣṭiḥ | vahati | rohitaḥ | yānti | śubhrāḥ | riṇan | apaḥ || 28 ||
eṣāṃ marutāṃ rathe pṛṣatīḥ pṛṣadbhiḥ śvetabindubhiryuktā mṛgyaḥ yat yadā vahanti yadā ca pṛṣṭiḥ prāśuḥ śīghragāmī |
rohitaḥ pṛṣataḥ pṛṣadbhiryukto mṛgaḥ vahati tadānīṃ śubhrāḥ śobhamānā marutaḥ yānti gacchanti |
teṣāṃ gamane ca sati apaḥ udakāni vṛṣṭilakṣaṇāni riṇan ariṇan agacchan |
‘samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 18. 5) iti vacanādatra pūrvapadasya vākyāntaragatatvāt ‘ṅitutiṅaḥ’ iti nighātābhāvaḥ ||
suṣome śaryāṇavatyārnīke pustyāvati | yuyunirccakrayā naraḥ || 29 || suṣome | śaryāṇavati | ārnīke | pustyāvati | yuyuḥ | ni'cakrayā | naraḥ || 29 ||
suṣome śobhanamomayukte ārnīke ṛjīkā nāma deśāḥ |
tatsambandhini śaryāṇavati kuru- kṣetrasya jaghanāthe śaryāṇavatsaṃjñe sarasi pastyāvati |
yajñagṛhopete somapānāya naraḥ netāro marutaḥ nicakrayā nīcīnacakrayā avāṅmukhaṃ pravartamānayā rathacakrayā yuyuḥ yānti gacchanti |
naro netāra ṛtvija uktaguṇaviśiṣṭe śaryāṇavati marudāgāyā somamāhartuṃ nicakrayā nīcīnacakrayā śakaṭyā yayuḥ gacchanti ||
kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṃ havamānam | mārḍīkebhirnādhamānam || 30 || kadā | gacchātha | marutaḥ | itthā | vipram | havamānam | mārḍīkebhiḥ | nādhamānam || 30 ||

he marutaḥ itthā ittham anena prakāreṇa havamānam āhvayantaṃ stuvantaṃ nādhamānaṃ yācamānaṃ vipraṃ medhāvinaṃ stotāraṃ māṃ kadā kasmin kāle mārḍīkebhiḥ sukhahetubhirdhanaiḥ sārdhaṃ gacchātha gacchatha |
kadvai nūnaṃ kaṃdhapriyo yadindramarjahātana | ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate || 31 || kat | ha | nūnam | kat'priyaḥ | yat | indram | arjehātana | kaḥ | vaḥ | sakhitve | ohate || 31 ||
īdṛśā he marutaḥ vṛtreṇa saha yudhyamānam <sup>v</sup>indraṃ <sup>v</sup>nūnaṃ satyam <sup>v</sup>ajahātana paryalyajateti <sup>v</sup>yat etat tat <sup>v</sup>kaddha kadā khalu kasmin kāle jātam |
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ—‘maruto hainaṃ nājahuḥ prahara bhagavo jahi vīryasva’ (ai. brā. 3. 20) iti |
‘vṛtrasya tvā śvasathādīṣamāṇāḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 96. 7) ityādi ca nigamantaram |
saho ṣu ṇe vajrahastaiḥ | kaṇvaso agni marudbhiḥ | stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ ||32|| saho iti | su | naḥ | vajra'hastaiḥ | kaṇvasaḥ | agnim | marudbhiḥ | stuṣe | hiraṇya'vāśībhiḥ || 32 ||
stotāraḥ kaṇvagotrā vā ṛṣayaḥ yūyaṃ <sup>v</sup>stuṣe studhvam |
o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ paryajyūnā narvyase suvitārya | vavṛtyāṃ citravājān || 33 || o iti | su | vṛṣṇaḥ | pra'yajyūn | ā | narvyase | suvitārya | vavṛtyām | citra'vājān || 33 ||

<sup>v</sup>vṛṣṇaḥ varṣitṝn abhīṣṭaphaladān <sup>v</sup>prayajyūn prakarṣeṇa yaṣṭavyān <sup>v</sup>citravājān vicitragamanān vicitrabalān vicitradhanān vā evaṃbhūtān marutaḥ <sup>v</sup>su suṣṭhu <sup>v</sup>o ā u <sup>v</sup>vavṛtyāṃ āvartayāmi |
api ca <sup>v</sup>narvyase navīyase navatarāya atyantaṃ praśastāya <sup>v</sup>suvitāya suṣṭhu prāptavyāya dhanāya ca tān <sup>v</sup>ā vavṛtyām āvartayāmi ||
giraryaścibhi jihate parśānāsau manyamānāḥ | parvatāścibhi yemire ||34|| girayaḥ | cit | ni | jihate | parśānāsaḥ | manyamānāḥ | parvatāḥ | cit | ni | yemire || 34 ||
