ata eva <sup>v</sup>manyamānāḥ abhimanyamānā bādhyamānāḥ santaḥ <sup>v</sup>ni <sup>v</sup>jihate nitarāṃ gacchanti |
tathā <sup>v</sup>parvatāścit parvavanto meghā api tadīyena gamanena <sup>v</sup>ni <sup>v</sup>yemire niyamyante |
ākṣṇayāvāno vahantyantarikṣeṇa patataḥ | dhātāraḥ stuvate vayaḥ || 35 || ā | akṣṇa'yāvānaḥ | vahanti | antarikṣeṇa | patataḥ | dhātāraḥ | stuvate | vayaḥ || 35 ||
īdṛśā aśvā: vantarikṣeṇa ākāśamārgeṇa vpatataḥ gacchanto marutaḥ vā vvahanti ānayanti |
vstuvate stotraṃ kurvate janāya vvaya: annaṃ vdhātāra: vidhātāra: kurvāṇā: ||
agniṃ hiṃ jāniṃ pūryyaśchando na sūrau arciṣā | te bhānubhirvai tasthire ||36|| agni: | hi | jāniṃ | pūryya: | chanda: | na | sūra: | arciṣā | te | bhānubhi: | vi | tasthire ||36||
vagnihiṃ agni: khalu varciṣā tejasā vpūryya: sarveṣu deveṣu mukhya: |
vchanda: upacchandanīya: vsūra: vna sūrya iva |
tadanantaraṃ vte pūrvoktaguṇā marutaḥ vbhānubhi: dīptibhi: vvi vtasthire vividhamavatiṣṭhante |
tadapekṣayā ca pūrvottarayo- rarthayo: krameṇābhirmarutaśca stūyante ||
'ā no viśvābhi: ' iti trayoviṃśatyacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ sadhvaṃsālyasya kāṇvasyārṣamānuṣṭubham |
tathā cānukrāntam—'ā nasyadhikā sadhvaṃsa āśvinaṃ ṣṭuṣṭubhaṃ tu' iti |
sūyate hi—'ā no viśvābhistyaṃ cidatrimityānuṣṭubham' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā no viśvābhi: prātaryāṃvānā' (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā no viśvā- bhirūtibhirasya vo aprahaṇam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 11) iti ||

ā no viśvābhirūtibhiraśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | dastrā hiraṇyavartanī pibaṃtaṃ somyaṃ madhu || 1 || ā | na: | viśvābhi: | ūti'bhi: | aśvinā | gacchatam | yuvam | dastrā | hiraṇyavartanī iti hiraṇya'vartanī | pibaṃtam | somyam | madhu || 1 ||
he vaśvinā aśvinau aśuvantau sarvaṃ jagadvāpnuvantau yadvā aśvairyuktau vyuvaṃ yuvāṃ vviśvābhi: sarvābhirsābhirvā vūtibhi: rakṣābhi: dātavyābhi: sārdhaṃ vna: asmān vā vgacchatam |
āgatya ca he vdastrā dastau darśanīyau śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitārau vā he vhiraṇyavartanī hiraṇmayarathau hitaramaṇī- yācaraṇau vā īdṛśau he aśvinau vsomyaṃ somamayaṃ vmadhu vpibatama ||

ā nūnaṃ yātamāśvinā rathena sūryatvacā | bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā || 2 || ā | nūnam | yātam | aśvinā | rathena | sūrya'tvacā | bhujī iti | hiraṇya'peśasā | kavī iti | gambhīra'cetasā || 2 ||
he vbhujī haviṣāṃ bhoktārau yadvā stotṛbhiraśvānāṃ bhojayitārau sarvasya jagata: pālakau vā he vhiraṇyapeśasā hiraṇyamayālaṃkārau hiraṇyayācayavau vā he vkavī krāntadarśinau stotṛbhyau vā
gambhīracetasā praśastajñānau īdṛśau he aśvinau aśvinau sūryatvacā sūryavadbhāsamānena rathena nūtnam avaśyamasmān ā yātam āgacchatam |
ā yātaṃ nahuṣaparyantarāikṣātsuvṛktibhiḥ | pibātho aśvino madhu kaṇvanāṃ sarvane sutam || 3 ||
ā | yātam | nahuṣaḥ | pari | ā | antarikṣāt | suvṛkti'bhiḥ | pibāthaḥ | aśvina | madhu | kaṇvanām | sarvane | sutam || 3 ||
suvṛktibhiḥ suṣṭhu doṣavarjitābhiḥ suvṛttābhirvā stutibhirhetubhūtābhiḥ ā yātam āgacchatam |
āgatya ca kaṇvanāṃ kaṇvagotrāṇāmasmākaṃ savane yajñe prāta:savanādau sutam abhiṣutaṃ madhu madhuraṃ somaṃ he aśvinau pibāthaḥ pibatam |
ā nau yātam divasparyantarāikṣādadhapriyā | putra: kaṇvasya vāmiha suṣāvaṃ somyaṃ madhu || 4 ||
ā | naḥ | yātam | divaḥ | pari | ā | antarikṣāt | adha'priyā | putraḥ | kaṇvasya | vām | iha | suṣāva | somyam | madhu || 4 ||
he aśvinau divaspari divo'dhi dyulokāt naḥ asmān ā yātam āgacchatam |
he adhapriyā adho'dhastādarima~lloke vidyamānena somena prīyamāṇau |
iha asmin‌yajñe kaṇvasya ṛṣeḥ putraḥ somyaṃ somamayaṃ madhu vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ yuvayorthaṃ suṣāva abhiṣuṇoti |
ā nau yātupaśrutyaśvinā somapītaye | svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhirnarā || 5 ||
ā | naḥ | yātam | upa'śruti | aśvina | soma'pītaye | svāhā | stomasya | vardhanā | pra | kavī iti | dhīti'bhiḥ | narā || 5 ||
he aśvinau aśvinau naḥ asmākam upaśruti |
upagatā śruyasmin tasmin yajñe somapītaye somapānāya ā yātam āgacchatam |
he vardhanā vardhanau kavī krānta- darśināvaśvinau svāhā svāhākṛtau svāhākāreṇa samyagiṣṭau santau |
stutirūpayā vācā stutau vācā stomasya stotuḥ pravarthakau bhavatam |
tathā he narā netārāvaśvinau dhītibhiḥ karmabhiḥ yadyaśca pravarthakau bhavatam |
he svāhā svāhākṛtau stomasya stotrasya stoturvā he pravarthanā pravarthitārau he kavī krāntadarśinau dhītibhirbuddhibhirātmīyai:
karmabhirvāṃ he narā sarveṣāṃ netārāvaśvinau somapānāya ā yātamityevameva vākyam|
dhītibhiryāntābhiyuṣmadīyābhiritibhiḥ sārdham ā yātamiti kriyā sambandhaḥ|
yacchiddhi vāṃ pura ṛṣayo juhure'vase narā| ā yātamaśvinā gatumapemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ marma || 6 ||
yat | cit | hi | vām | purā | ṛṣayaḥ | juhure | avase | narā | ā | yātam | aśvinā | ā | gatam | urpa | imām | su'stutim | marma || 6 ||
he narā netārāvaśvinau yacchiddhi yadā khalu vāṃ yuvāṃ purā pūrvasmin kāle ṛṣayaḥ atīndriyārthadarśinaḥ stotāraḥ avase rakṣaṇāya juhure juhuvire stutibhirāhvayan|
tadānīṃ he aśvinau ā yātam āgacchatam āgatavantau sthaḥ|
ataḥ mama madīyām imāṃ suṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutimapi upa ā gatam upāgacchatam|
divaścidrocanādadhyā nau gantaṃ sarvvidā| dhībhirvatsapracetasā stomairhavanaśrutā || 7 ||
divaḥ | cit | rocanāt | adhi | ā | naḥ | gantam | svaḥ'vidā | dhībhiḥ | vat'pracetasā | stomaiḥ | havan'śrutā || 7 ||
he sarvvidā svaḥ sūryyasya dyulokasya vā lambhayitārāvaśvinau divaścit dyulokācca rocanā- dadhi rocamānādantarikṣācca naḥ asmān ā gantam āgacchatam|
vatsaṃ nivāsakaṃ veditavyaṃ vā prakṛṣṭaṃ ceto jñānaṃ yayostau tathoktau|
he havanaśrutā havanasyā- smadīyasyāhvanasya stotrasya śrotārau stomebhiḥ stotrairasaṃskṛtairyujyamānau santāvāgacchatam|
kimanye paryāsate'smatstomairaśvinā| putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat || 8 ||
kim | anye | pari | āsate | asmat | stomaiḥ | aśvinā | putraḥ | kaṇvasya | vām | ṛṣiḥ | gīḥ'bhiḥ | vatsaḥ | avīvṛdhat || 8 ||
asmat asmattaḥ anye vyatiriktāḥ stotāraḥ stomebhiḥ stotraiḥ aśvinā aśvinau devau kiṃ paryāsate|
kaṇvasya ṛṣeḥ putraḥ ṛṣiḥ mantradraṣṭā vatsaḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhirhe aśvinau vāṃ yuvām avīvṛdhat avardhayat|
ā vāṃ vipra ihāvase'hvastomairaśvinā| ariṃrā vṛtrahantamā tā nau bhūtaṃ mayobhuvā || 9 ||

ā | vām | vipraḥ | iha | avase | ahūta | stomaibhiḥ | aśvinā | ariprā | vṛtrahan'tamā | tā | naḥ | bhūtam | mayaḥ'bhuvā || 9 || he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'vipraḥ medhāvī stotā 'iha asmin yāge 'avase rakṣaṇārthaṃ 'stomaibhiḥ stotraiḥ 'vāṃ yuvām 'ā 'ahūta āhūtavān | hūyaterlaṅi 'lipisicihvaśca' iti caleraṅādeśaḥ | he 'ariprā | ripramiti pāpanāma | apāpau he 'vṛtrahantamā vṛtrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantatamau 'tā tau tādṛśau yuvāṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'mayobhuvā sukhasya bhāvayitārau 'bhūtaṃ bhavatam || ā yadvāṃ yoṣaṇā rathamatiṣṭhadājinīvasū | viśvānyaśvinā yuvaṃ pra dhītānyagacchatam || 10 || ā | yat | vām | yoṣaṇā | ratham | atiṣṭhat | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vam | viśvāni | aśvinā | yuvam | pra | dhītāni | agacchatam || 10 || he 'vājinīvasū | vājinī haviṣmatī yāgakriyā | tasyāṃ vidyamānasvāṃśālakṣaṇadhanāvaśvinau 'yoṣaṇā yoṣita sūryā ājidhāvanena triyamāṇā satī 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'rathaṃ 'yat yadā 'ā 'atiṣṭhat āsthitavatī ārūḍhavatī tadā he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'dhītāni dhyātānyabhilaṣitāni 'viśvāni sarvāṇi prakarṣeṇa 'agacchataṃ prāptam || || 26 || ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamāśvinā | vatso vāṃ madhumadvaco'śaṃsītkāṇvaḥ || 11 || ataḥ | sahasra'nirṇijā | rathena | ā | yātam | aśvinā | vatsaḥ | vām | madhu'mat | vacaḥ | aśaṃsīt | kāṇvaḥ | kaviḥ || 11 || he 'aśvinā aśvinau yeṣu lokeṣu yatra vartathe 'ataḥ asmātsthānāt 'sahasranirṇijā | nirṇigiti rūpanāma | suvarṇamayatayā bahuvidharūpayuktena 'rathena 'yātam āgacchatam | 'kāṇvaḥ kaveḥ putraḥ 'kaviḥ medhāvī 'vatsaḥ ṛṣiḥ 'vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ yuvayorthaṃ 'madhumat mādhuryopetaṃ 'vacaḥ vacanamuktam 'aśaṃsīt śaṃsitavān | yata evamata āgacchatamityarthaḥ || purumandrā puruvasū manotarā rayīṇām | stomaṃ me aśvināvimabhi vahnī anūṣatām || 12 || puru'mandrā | puruvasu iti puru'vasū | manotarā | rayīṇām | stomam | me | aśvinā | imam | abhi | vahnī iti | anūṣatām || || 12 || 'purumandrā bahumadau bahubhiḥ somaimardayitavyau vā 'puruvasū bahudhanau bahūnāṃ nivāsakau vā 'rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ 'manottarā mantārau dātārau | manyatestuci pṛṣodarādidvādrūpasiddhiḥ | 'nāmanya- tarasyām' iti raiśabdānāma udāttatvam | 'vahnī kṛtsnasya jagato voḍhārau īdṛśau 'aśvinau 'me mama 1. kha-bha-prāpayata |
imaṃ stomaṃ stotram abhi anūpātāṃ samyak stutamiti prāśaṃsipātām ||

ā no viśvānyaśvinā dhattaṃ rādhaṃsyahyūyā | kṛtaṃ naṃ ṛtviyāvato mā nau roradhataṃ nide || 13 || ā | naḥ | viśvāni | aśvinā | dhattam | rādhaṃsi | ahyūyā | kṛtam | naḥ | ṛtviya'vataḥ | mā | naḥ | roradhatam | nide || 13 || he aśvinā aśvinau ahayā ahayāṇi ahatikaraṇanyalajāhetūni praśastāni viśvāni sarvāṇi rādhaṃsi dhanāni naḥ asmabhyam ā dhattaṃ prayacchatam | api ca naḥ asmān ṛtvi- yāvataḥ | ṛtau kāle bhavaṃ prajotpādanarūpaṃ karma ṛtviyam | tadvataḥ kurutam | tathā nide nindāyai nindakāya vā naḥ asmān mā roradhataṃ mā vaśaṃ naiṣṭam ||

yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhyambare | ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātabhaśvinā || 14 || yat | nāsatyā | parā'vati | yat | vā | sthaḥ | adhi | ambare | arnaḥ | sahasra'nirṇijā | rathena | ā | yātam | aśvinā || 14 || he nāsatyā satyasvabhāvau satyasya netārau nāsikāprabhavau vāśvinau yat yadi parāvati dūra- deśe sthaḥ | yadvā yadi ca ambare | antikanāmaiṭat | samīpe sthaḥ | bhavathaḥ | adhi | sasabhya- rthānuvādī | ataḥ asmātsarvasmāt sthānāt sahasranirṇijā bahuvidharūpeṇa rathena he aśvinau āgacchatam ||

yo vāṃ nāsanyāvṛṣirgīrbhirvṛtso avīṃvṛdhat | tasmai sahasranirṇijamiṣaṃ dhattaṃ ghṛtaśrutam || 15 || yaḥ | vām | nāsatyau | ṛṣiḥ | gīḥ'bhiḥ | vattaḥ | avīṃvṛdhat | tasmai | sahasra'nirṇijam | iṣam | dhattam | ghṛta'śrutam || 15 || he nāsatyau yaḥ vatsāyaḥ ṛṣiḥ vāṃ yuvāṃ gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ avīṃvṛdhat avadhayat tasmai ṛṣaye sahasranirṇijaṃ bahuvidharūpaṃ ghṛtaśrutaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣarantīm iṣam ahaṃ dhattaṃ prayacchatam || || 27 ||

prāsmā ūrjaṃ ghṛtaśrutamaśvinā yacchataṃ yuvam | yo vāṃ sumnāya tustarvasuyādānunpatī || 16 || pra | asmai | ūrjam | ghṛta'śrutam | aśvinā | yacchatam | yuvam | yaḥ | vām | sumnāya | tustarvat | vasu'yāt | dānunaḥ | patī iti || 16 ||
he ^aśvinā aśvinau ^asmai stotre ^ghṛtaśrutaṃ ghṛtadhārayā yuktām ^ūrjaṃ balakaramannarasaṃ ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^pra ^yacchataṃ dattam|
he ^dānuspatī dānasyādhipatī ^vāṃ yuvāṃ ^sumnāya sukhārtha ^yaḥ ^tuṣṭa- vat stuyāt|
ā nau gantaṃ riśādasemaṃ stomaṃ purubhujā |
ā | naḥ | gantam | riśādasā | imam | stomam | puru'bhujā | kṛtam | naḥ | su'dhriyaḥ | narā | imā | dātam | abhiṣṭaye || 17 ||

he ^riśādasā riśatāṃ hiṃsatāṃ nirasitārau yadvā riśānāṃ hiṃsakānāmattārau bhakṣayitārau he ^purubhujā bahulasya ^haviṣo bhoktārau bahūnāṃ pālakau vā he aśvinau ^naḥ asmākam ^idaṃ ^stomaṃ stotram ^ā ^gantam abhigacchatam|
āgatya ca he ^narā netārau ^naḥ asmān ^sudhriyaḥ suśrīkān śobhanayā saṃpadā yuktān ^kṛtaṃ kurutam|
tadartham ^imā imāni puro vartamānāni pārthivāni ^abhiṣṭaye abhiprāyasya ^dātaṃ dattam|
ā | vām | viśvābhiḥ | ūtibhiḥ | priya'medhāḥ | ahūpata | rājantau | adhvarāṇām | aśvinā | yārma'hūtiṣu || 18 ||
he ^aśvinā aśvinau ^yāmahūtiṣu yāmānāṃ yātṝṇāṃ devānāṃ hūtirāhvānaṃ yeṣu yāgeṣu teṣu ^priya- medhāḥ priyayajñā etatsaṃjñā ṛṣayaḥ ^adhvarāṇāṃ yajñānāṃ ^rājantau īśvarau|
'aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām' ( tai. brā. 3. 2. 2. 1 ) iti hi brāhmaṇam|
īdṛśau ^viśvābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ ^ūtibhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ sahitau ^vāṃ yuvām ^ā ^ahūpata āhvayan astuvannityarthaḥ ||
ā nau gantaṃ mayobhuvāśvinā śaṃbhuvā yuvam |
ā | naḥ | gantam | mayaḥ'bhuvā | aśvinā | śam'bhuvā | yuvam | yaḥ | vām | vipanyū iti | dhīti'bhiḥ | gīḥ'bhiḥ | vatsaḥ | avīvṛdhat || 19 ||
he ^aśvinā aśvinau ^mayobhuvā mayasaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitārau ^śaṃbhuvā rogāṇāṃ śamasya bhāvayitārau ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^naḥ asmān ^ā ^gantam āgacchatam|
he ^vipanyū stutyāvaśvinau ^yaḥ ^vatsaḥ stotā ^vāṃ yuvāṃ ^dhītibhiḥ karmabhiḥ paricaraṇaiḥ ^gīrbhiḥ stutibhiśca ^avīvṛdhat avardhayat tānsmāniti pūrvatrānvayaḥ ||
yābhiḥ| kaṇvam| medha'atithim| yābhiḥ| vaśam| darśa'trajam| yābhiḥ| go'rśayam| āvatam| tābhiḥ| naḥ| avatam| narā || 20 ||
he aśvinau yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ kaṇvam ṛṣiṃ medhātithiṃ ca āvatam arakṣatam|
tathā cāmnātaṃ—‘śayave cinnāsatyā śacībhirjaṃsuraye stathyaṃ pipyathurgām’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 22) iti|
he narā netārau tābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ naḥ asmān avataṃ rakṣatam||
yābhiḥ| narā| trasadasyum| āvatam| kṛtye| dhane| tābhiḥ| su| asmān| aśvinau|
kavī krāntadarśanāvaśvinau ṛtasya satyasyodakasya yajñasya vā hetubhūtaiḥ padamabhiḥ yaiḥ padaiḥ jīvebhyaspari |
' ā nūnam ' ityekaviṃśatyṛcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ śaśakaṇasyārṣamaśvidevatyam |
viṃśayekaviṃśayau dvitīyā- tṛtīye ceti catasro gāyatryaḥ prathamā caturthī pañcadaśī pañcadaśī ceti pañca bṛhatyaḥ pañcamī kakup ' madhyamaścetakap ' (anu. 5. 3) ityuktalakṣaṇasaṃjñātvāt |
daśamī triṣṭubekādaśī virāḍdvādaśī jagatī śiṣṭā anuṣṭubhaḥ |
tathā cānukrāntam— ' ā nūnaṃ saikā śaśakaṇo'nye gāyatryāvupāce cādyā caturthī ṣaṣṭhī caturdaśyāce ca bṛhatyaḥ pañcamī kakubdāśyādyāstriṣṭubbirāḍjagattyaḥ ' iti |
sūyate hi— ' ā nūnamaśvinā taṃ vāṃ ratham ' (ābha. śrau. 9. 11) iti ||

ā nūnamaśvinā yuvaṃ vṛtasya gantavase | prāsmai yacchatamavukaṃ pṛthu cchardiryutaṃ yā arātayaḥ || 1 || ā | nunam | aśvinā | yuvam | vṛtasya | gantam | avase | pra | asmai | yacchatam | avukam | pṛthu | chardiḥ | yutam | yāḥ | arātayaḥ || 1 ||
he aśvinā aśvinau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ vṛtasya stotumama avase rakṣaṇārthaṃ nūnam avaśyam ā gantam āgacchatam |
āgatya ca asmai ṛṣaye avukaṃ bādhakarahitaṃ pṛthu vistīrṇaṃ chardiḥ gṛhaṃ pra yacchataṃ pradattam |
tathā yāḥ arātayaḥ adānaśīlāḥ śatrubhūtāḥ prajāstāḥ yuyutaṃ stotumyaḥ pṛthakkurutam ||
yadantarikṣe yadivi yatpaśva mānuṣaॉ anu | nṛmṇaṃ tadvattamaśvinā || 2 || yat | antarikṣe | yat | divi | yat | pañca | mānuṣān | anu | nṛmṇam | tat | dhattam | aśvinā || 2 ||
antarikṣe gandharvādibhiḥ sevite madhyame loke yat nṛmṇaṃ dhanamasti |
pañcavidhā manuṣyā niṣādapañcamāścatvāro varṇā yatra vartante tatra ceha loke yat nṛmṇaṃ dhanamasti |
he aśvinau tat trividhaṃ nṛmṇaṃ dhanaṃ dhattam asmabhyaṃ pratyacchatam ||
ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvinā viprāsaḥ parimamṛśuḥ | evetkāṇvasya bodhatam || 3 || ye | vām | daṃsāṃsi | aśvinā | viprāsaḥ | pari | mamṛśuḥ | eva | ita | kāṇvasya | bodhatam || 3 ||
he aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandhīni daṃsāṃsi karmāṇi paricaraṇātmakāni ye viprāsaḥ viprā medhāvino yajamānāḥ parimamṛśuḥ parimṛśanti punaḥpunaḥ spṛśanti |
yathā tadīyāni paricaraṇāni yuvāṃ jānīthaḥ evet evameva kāṇvasya kaṇvaputrasya mama paricaraṇaṃ bodhatam avagacchatam ||
1. kha-bha- tadānīṃtanāni; jha- tadādīnāni; ta- tadīnāni; na- tadānāni |

ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pariṃ sicyate | ayaṃ somo madhumānvājinīvasū yenaṃ vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ ||4|| ayama | vām | gharmaḥ | aśvinā | stomena | pariṃ | sicyate | ayama | somaḥ | madhu'mān | vājinī'vasū iti vājinī'vasū | yena | vṛtram | ciketathaḥ ||4||
he aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandhī ayaṃ gharmaḥ pravargya stomena stotreṇa ṛksāmarūpeṇa pari sicyate ārdrīkriyate |
yathā yuvayostṛptikaro bhavati tathā kriyata ityarthaḥ |
sa stomena stotratvena payasā pari sicyate āsicyate vāṃ yuvayortham |
api ca he vājinīvasū annavaddhanau ayaṃ somaḥ tātīyasavaniko madhumān mādhuryavān yuvābhyāṃ dīyate |
yena yuvāṃ vṛtram āvarakaṃ śatruṃ ciketathaḥ hantavyatayā jānīthaḥ |
yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoṣadhīṣu purudaṃsā kṛtam | tena māviṣṭamaśvinā ||5|| yat | apsu | yat | vanaspatau | yat | oṣadhīṣu | puru'daṃsā | kṛtam | tena | mā | aviṣṭam | aśvinā ||5||
he purudaṃsā bahukarmāṇavaśvinau apsu udakeṣu yat bheṣajaṃ kṛtaṃ yuvāmakāraṣṭam |
vanaspatiṣu vṛkṣeṣu yat ca bheṣajaṃ yuvāmakuraitam |
oṣadhīṣu oṣaḥ pāka āsu dhīyate ityoṣadhayo vrīhādayaḥ ||
vrīhādiṣvoṣadhīṣu ca yat bheṣajaṃ kṛtaṃ yuvāmakāraṣṭam |
he aśvinā aśvinau tena sarvaṇa bheṣajena mā mām aviṣṭaṃ rakṣatam |

yannāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yadvā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ | ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhirvinadhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||6|| yat | nāsatyā | bhuraṇyathaḥ | yat | vā | devā | bhiṣajyathaḥ | ayama | vām | vatsaḥ | mati'bhiḥ | na | vindate | haviṣmantam | hi | gacchathaḥ ||6||
he nāsatyā satyasvabhāvāvaśvinau yat yau yuvāṃ bhuraṇyathaḥ sarvaṃ jagatpoṣayathaḥ |
yadvā yau vāṃ yuvāṃ bhiṣajyathaḥ sarvasya prāṇijātasya bheṣajaṃ rogopaśamanaṃ kuruthaḥ |
tau vāṃ yuvām ayaṃ vatsaḥ stotā matibhiḥ mananīyaiḥ kevalaiḥ stotraiḥ na vindate na vindate na labhate |
haviṣmantaṃ havirbhiryuktaṃ stotāraṃ hi yuvāṃ gacchathaḥ |
tasmādyuvāṃ havirbhiryuktaḥ stotraiḥ prasīdatha iti bhāvaḥ ||
sūyate hi--'ā nūnamaśvinorṛṣiriti gabhya ā sute siñcata śriyamityāje' (ādha. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||
ā | nūnam | aśvinoḥ | ṛṣiḥ | stomam | ciketa | vāmayā | ā | somam | madhumat | tamam | gharmam | siñcāt | atharvaṇi || 7 ||
he aśvinau yadā yuvāmāgaccheyāthāṃ tadānīṃ yuvayoḥ 'aśvinoḥ 'stomaṃ stotram 'ṛṣiḥ mantradraṣṭā 'vāmayā vananīyayotkṛṣṭayā' buddhyā 'nūnam avaśyam 'ā 'ciketa abhijānīyāt |
tathā 'madhumattamam atiśayena madhuraṃ 'somaṃ 'gharmaṃ pravargyasambandhi gharmākhyaṃ haviśca 'atharvaṇi ahiṃsake agnau |
yat | vām | kakṣīvān | uta | yat | vi'aśvaḥ | ṛṣiḥ | yat | vām | dīrgha'tamaḥ | juhāva | pṛthī | yat | vām | vainyaḥ | | sadaneṣu | eva | ita | ataḥ | aśvinā | cetayethām || 10 ||
he aśvinau vāṃ yuvāṃ kakṣīvān ṛṣiḥ yat yathā juhāva tuṣṭāva |
uta api ca vyaśvaḥ etatsaṃjñaḥ ṛṣiśca yat yathā juhāva |
yat yathā ca vāṃ yuvāṃ dīrghatamāḥ ṛṣirjuhāva |
sadaneṣu yajñagṛhe vainyaḥ venasya putraḥ pṛthī etatsaṃjño rājarṣiḥ vāṃ yuvāṃ yat yathā juhāva tuṣṭāva |
evet evameva stuvato mama ataḥ idaṃ stotram |
yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūta̭ ja̭gatpā uta na̭stanūpā |
ᐡyat ᐢyadā ᐣaham ᐤaśvinau ᐥvājasātaye ᐦsaṃgrāmārthaṃ ᐧhuveya ᐨāhvayeya ᐩatha ᐪidānīṃ ᐫtāvā- gacchatamiti śeṣaḥ |
ᐬpṛtsu ᐭpṛtanāsu ᐮsaṃgrāmeṣu ᐯturvaṇe ᐰśatrūṇāṃ ᐱhiṃsane ᐲyat ᐳsahaḥ ᐴśatrūṇāmabhibhavitṛ rakṣaṇam ᐵaśvinoḥ ᐶtat ᐷavaḥ ᐸrakṣaṇaṃ ᐹśreṣṭhaṃ ᐺpraśastatamam |
ā nūnaṃ yātam aśvinemā hurvāni vāṃ hitā |
ime somāso arci turvaśe yadāvime kaṇveṣu vāmartha ||
ā | nūnam | yātam | aśvinā | imā | hurva
pra | bodhaya | uṣaḥ | aśvinau | pra | devi | sunṛte | mahi | pra | yajña'hota: | ānuṣak | pra | madāya | śrava: | bṛhat || 17 ||
he <sup>v</sup>devi dānādiguṇayukte he <sup>v</sup>sūnṛte suhu netri he <sup>v</sup>mahi mahati itthaṃmahābhāgā tvamaśvinau <sup>v</sup>pra bodhaya|
he <sup>v</sup>yajñahota: yajñānāṃ yaṣṭavyānāṃ devānāmāhūtarhotarvāṃ <sup>v</sup>ānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ satataṃ yathā bhavati tathāśvinau stutibhi: <sup>v</sup>pra bodhaya|
tathā <sup>v</sup>madāya aśvinormedotpādanārthaṃ <sup>v</sup>bṛhat mahat <sup>v</sup>śrava: śravaṇīyaṃ somalakṣaṇamasmasmābhi: kalpitam ||

yaduṣo yārsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase | ā hāyamaśvino rathau vṛtiryāti nupāyyam || 18 || yat | uṣa: | yārsiṃ | bhānunā | sam | sūryeṇa | rocase | ā | ha | ayam | aśvino: | ratha: | vṛti: | yāti | nu'pāyyam || 18 ||
he <sup>v</sup>uṣa: <sup>v</sup>bhānunā dīptyā saha <sup>v</sup>yat yadā <sup>v</sup>yāsi gacchasi tadānīṃ <sup>v</sup>sūryeṇa <sup>v</sup>saṃ rocase samyagdīpyase|

api ca tasmin samaye <sup>v</sup>aśvino: <sup>v</sup>ayaṃ <sup>v</sup>ratha: <sup>v</sup>nṛpāyyaṃ yat nṛbhirnṛbhirṛtvigbhi: pālanīyaṃ <sup>v</sup>vṛti: yajñagṛham <sup>v</sup>ā yāti <sup>v</sup>ha āgacchati khalu ||

yadāpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhū ūdhabhi: | yadvā vāṇīranūṣata pra devyanto aśvinau || 19 || yat | ā'pītāsa: | aṃśava: | gāva: | na | duhū | ūdhabhi: | yat | vā | vāṇī: | anūṣata | pra | dev'yantaḥ | aśvinau || 19 ||

<sup>v</sup>yat yadā <sup>v</sup>āpītāsa: ā samantāt pītavarṇā: <sup>v</sup>aṃśava: somalatā: <sup>v</sup>ūdhabhi: <sup>v</sup>gāvo <sup>v</sup>na gāva iva <sup>v</sup>duhe rasaṃ <sup>v</sup>duhate' |
<sup>v</sup>yadvā yadā ca <sup>v</sup>devayantaḥ devān kāmayamānā ṛtvija: <sup>v</sup>vāṇī: vāca: stutī: <sup>v</sup>anūṣata astuvan |
pra yumnāya pra śavase pra nṛpāhyāya śarmaṇe | pra dakṣāya pracetasā || 20 || pra | yumnāya | pra | śavase | pra | nu'srhāya | śarmaṇe | pra | dakṣāya | pra'cetasā || 20 ||
1. kha-ma- saṃduhate; gha-duhate; jha-ta1-4-asaṃduhate; na-saṃ saṃduhate |
yat | nunam | dhībhiḥ | aśvinā | pituḥ | yonā | ni'sīdayaḥ | yat | vā | sujñebhiḥ | ukthyā || 21 ||
he aśvinau pituḥ pālayitudyulokasya saṃbandhini yonau yonau sthāne yat yadi dhībhiḥ karmabhiḥ saha niṣīdathaḥ nivasathaḥ |
yadvā yadi vā he ukthyā ukthyau praśastau sujñebhiḥ sujñaiḥ sukhaiḥ saha nivasathaḥ |
pituḥ pālayitu- ryajamānasya saṃbandhini yonau yajñagṛhe dhībhiḥ stutibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yadi nivasathaḥ yadi ca sujñaiḥ sukha- karairvimiśra saha nivasathaḥ tadāgacchatam |
nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre' (niru. 1. 7) iti ||
'yatsthaḥ' iti ṣaḍcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kaṇvaputrasya pragāthasyārṣamāśvinam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'yatsthaḥ ṣaṭ pragātho'paśyadbṛhatī madhyejyotistriṣṭu- bāstārapaṅktiḥ pragāthaḥ' iti |
prātaranuvākāśvine kratau bārhate chandasyāśvinaśastre cedaṃ sūktam |
subhyate hi—'dyumnī vāṃ yatstha iti bārhatam' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti ||

yatstho dīrghaprasabhani yadvāde raucane divaḥ | yadvā samudre adhyākṛte gṛhe'ta ā yātamaśvinā || 1 || yat | sthaḥ | dīrgha'prasabhani | yat | vā | adaḥ | rocane | divaḥ | yat | vā | samudre | adhi | ā'kṛte | gṛhe | ataḥ | ā | yātam | aśvinau || 1 ||
prasīdanti eṣu devā iti prasabhāno yajñagṛhāḥ |
dīrghā āyatāḥ prasabhāno yasmin tasmi~lloke yat yadi sthaḥ bhavataḥ vartathe |
yadvā yadi vā adaḥ amuṣmin divaḥ dyulokasya saṃbandhini rocane rocamāne sthāne bhavataḥ |
ataḥ tritayādapi sthānāt he aśvinau ā yātam āgacchatam ||

yadvā yajñaṃ marnave saṃmimiksathurevetkāṇvasya bodhatam | bṛhaspatiṃ viśvāndevā~ ahaṃ huve indrāviṣṇū aśvināvāśuṣerhasā || 2 || yat | vā | yajñam | marnave | sam'mimiksathuḥ | eva | it | kāṇvasya | bodhatam | bṛhaspatim | viśvān | devān | aham | huve | indrāviṣṇū iti | aśvinau | āśu'ṣerhasā ||2||

he aśvinau yadvā yathā vā yena vā prakāreṇa marnave prajāpataye yajamānāya yajñaṃ saṃmimiksathuḥ saṃsikkavantau yuvāṃ kṛtavantau evait evameva kāṇvasya kaṇvagotrasya mama yajñaṃ kartuṃ bodhatam avagacchatam |
api ca bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhatāṃ devānāṃ patiṃ devapurohitaṃ viśvān sarvān mitrādīn devān ca indrāviṣṇū ca āśuṣehasā śīghrārthau |
śīghraṃ sarvatra śabda- mānau stūyamānau aśvinau ca ahaṃ huve āhvaye ||
1. kha-bha-yadyadā; gha-yadi | 2. kha-śa-asmin tasmin; gha-yasmin | 3. jha-ta1-2-śa-' vā ' nāsti | 4. jha-ta1-2-4-ya-śa-devān | 5. kha-bha-śabdamānau; śa-śiṣyamāṇī |

tyā nvaśvinā huve sudaṃsasā gṛbhe kṛtā | yayorasti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṃ deveṣvapyāryam || 3 || tyā | nu | aśvinā | huve | sudaṃsasā | gṛbhe | kṛtā | yayoḥ | asti | pra | naḥ | sakhyam | deveṣu | adhi | āpyam || 3 || tyā tyoṃ pūrvoktaguṇāvaśvinau nu kṣipram aham huve āhvayāmi | kīdṛśau | sudaṃsasā śobhanakarmāṇau gṛbhe grahe' grahaṇāyāsmābhirdattānāṃ haviṣāṃ svīkārayāsmabhyaṃ dhanadānāya vā kṛtā kṛtau prādurbhūtau deveṣu madhye | adhiḥ saptamyarthānuvādī | yayoḥ aśvinoḥ āpyam āsamyaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ sakhyaṃ sakhitvaṃ pra asti prabhavati utkarṣeṇa vartate tau huva ityanvayaḥ ||

yayoradhi pra yajñā asure santi sūryaḥ | tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhāmiryā pirbataḥ somyaṃ madhu || 4 || yayoḥ | adhi | pra | yajñāḥ | asure | santi | sūryaḥ | tā | yajñasya | adhvarasya | pracetasā | svadhāmiḥ | yā | pirbataḥ | somyam | madhu || 4 || yayoḥ aśvinoḥ adhi upari yajñāḥ jyotiṣṭomādayaḥ sarve yāgāḥ pra santi prabhavanti | chinnasya yajñaśiraso'śvibhyāṃ saṃdhānāt | tathā ca ' yajñasya śiro'cchidyata ' ityupakramya taittirīyakaṃ- ' tāvetadyajñaśiraḥ pratyadhattāṃ yadāśvino gṛhṇate yajñasya niṣkṛtyai ' ( tai. saṃ. 6. 4. 9. 1 ) iti | asure stotrarahite'pi deśe yayośca sūryaḥ stotāraḥ santi tāvaśvinau adhvarasya hiṃsāpratyavāya- rahitasya yajñasya jyotiṣṭomādeḥ pracetasā prakṛṣṭaṃ jñātārau svadhāmiḥ balahetubhiḥ stutibhirāhvayāmīti śeṣaḥ | yā yāvaśvinau somyaṃ somamayaṃ madhu madhuraṃ somarasaṃ pibataḥ ||

yadvāśvināvapāktaprākstho vājinīvasū | yadduhyavyanavi turvaśe yadau huve vāmatha mā gatam || 5 || yat | adya | aśvinau | apāk | yat | prāk | sthaḥ | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū | yat | duhyaviṃ | anavi | turvaśe | yadau | huve | vām | artha | mā | ā | gatam || 5 || he aśvinau adya idānīṃ yat yadi apāk pratīcyāṃ diśi sthaḥ bhavathaḥ vartathe | he vājinīvasū annavaddhanau yat yadi prāk prācyāṃ diśi sthaḥ bhavathaḥ | yat yadi vā duhyaprabhṛtiṣu caturṣu stotṛṣu saṃnihitau bhavathaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra saṃnihitau vāṃ yuvāṃ huve ahamāhvayāmi | atha anantarameva mā mām ā gatam āgacchatam ||

yadantarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yadvā ime rodasī anu | yadvā svadhāmiradhi tiṣṭhatho rathamata ā yātamaśvinā || 6 || yat | antarikṣe | patathaḥ | puru'bhujā | yat | vā | ime iti | rodasī iti | anu | yat | vā | svadhāmiḥ | adhi'tiṣṭhathaḥ | ratham | ataḥ | ā | yātam | aśvinā || 6 ||
he purubhujā bahūnāṃ pālayitārau bahulahaviṣo bhoktārau vā yat yadi antarikṣe pathaḥ gacchathaḥ |
yadvā yadi vā ime rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau anulakṣya gacchathaḥ |
yadvā yadi vā svadhābhiḥ ātmīyaistejobhirbalairvā sārthaṃ ratham adhitiṣṭhathaḥ rathe upaviśyaḥ |
ataḥ sarvasmāt sthānāt he aśvinau ā yātam āgacchatam ||
'tvamagne' iti daśarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūkaṃ kaṇvagotrasya vatsasyārṣamābheyam |
tathā coktaṃ—' ṣaṭsakā- ṣṭakairvardhamānā viparītā pratiṣṭhā' (pi. sū. 3. 14-15) iti |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'tvamagne daśa vatsa ābheye gāyatre'ntyā triṣṭubādhā pratiṣṭhāpādhā vardhamānā' iti |
sūyate hi—'tvamagne vratapā ityuttamāmudaret' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'tvamagne vratapā asi yaddo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni' (āśva. śrau. 3. 13) iti ||

tvama̭gne॒ vrata॒pā a̭si॒ deva॒ ā ma॒rtyḙṣvā | tvaṃ ya॒jñeṣvīḍya̭ḥ || 1 || tvam | agne | vrata॒pāḥ | a॒si॒ | devaḥ | ā | ma॒rtyḙṣu | ā | tvam | ya॒jñeṣu | īḍyaḥ || 1 || he agne deva dyotamānaḥ tvaṃ martyeṣu manuṣyeṣu ca deveṣu ca madhye vratapāḥ asi | vratānāṃ karmaṇāṃ rakṣitā bhavasi | ataḥ kāraṇāt yajñeṣu tvam īḍyaḥ stutyo'si ||

tvama̭si॒ praśa̭syo॒ vida̭theṣu॒ saha̭ntya | agne॒ rathī̭radhva॒rāṇām || 2 || tvam | a॒si | pra'śa̭syaḥ | vida̭theṣu | sa॒ha॒ntya | agne | rathīḥ | a॒dhva॒rāṇām || 2 || he sahantya śatrūṇāmabhibhavitaḥ agne vidatheṣu yajñeṣu tvaṃ praśasyaḥ stutyaḥ asi | adhvarāṇāṃ yāgānāṃ rathīḥ netā ca bhavasi ||

sa tva̭ma॒smada॒pa dviṣo̭ yu॒yodhi॒ jāta̭vedaḥ | adḙvīra॒gha a̭rā॒tīḥ || 3 || saḥ | tvam | a॒smat | apa | dviṣaḥ | yu॒yodhi | jātaḥ'vedaḥ | adḙvīḥ | agne | arā̭tīḥ ||3|| he jātavedaḥ jātānāṃ veditaḥ agne saḥ pūrvvakaguṇaḥ tvam asmat asmattaḥ dviṣaḥ dveṣṭṝn apa yuyodhi pṛthakuru | adevīḥ āsurīḥ arātīḥ śatrusenāśca pṛthakuru ||

anti॒ citsa̭nta॒mahaṃ ya॒jñaṃ ma̭rtyasya ri॒paḥ | nopa̭ veṣi jātavedaḥ || 4 || anti | cit | santa̭m | aha̭m | ya॒jñam | ma̭rtyasya | ri॒paḥ | na | upa̭ | veṣi | jātaḥ'vedaḥ ||4|| he jātavedaḥ anti cit antike'pi santaṃ bhavantaṃ samīpe vidyamānamapi ripaḥ asmacchatroḥ martyasya manuṣyasya yajñaṃ nopa veṣi ahaśabdo'vadhāraṇe | naiva kāmayase ||

martā̭ a॒martya̭sya te॒ bhūri॒ nāma̭ manāmahe | vi॒prāso̭ jā॒tavḙdasaḥ || 5 || martāḥ | a॒martya̭sya | te | bhūri̭ | nāma̭ | ma॒nāma॒he | vi॒prāsaḥ | jā॒ta'vḙdasaḥ || 5 || martāḥ manuṣyāḥ viprāsaḥ medhāvino vayaṃ he agne jātavedasaḥ jātānāṃ vedituḥ amartyasya maraṇarahitasya devasya bhūri vistṛtaṃ nāma stotraṃ manāmahe jānīmaḥ | kumaṃ iti yāvat || 5 ||

vipram | viprāsaḥ | arbase | devam | martāsaḥ | ūtaye | agnim | gīḥ'bhiḥ | havāmahe || 6 || viprāsaḥ medhāvinaḥ martāsaḥ martā manuṣyā vayaṃ vipraṃ medhāvinaṃ devaṃ dānādiguṇayuktam abhim avase havirbhistarpayitum ūtaye asmākaṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ havāmahe āhvayāmahe || ābhiplavikepuktheyeṣu tṛtīyasavane 'ā te vatsaḥ' iti vaikalpikaḥ stotriyastṛcaḥ | sūtritaṃ ca— 'ā te vatso mano yamadāpre sthūraṃ rathi bhara' (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||

he indra tvadīyau haryatā haryatau kāntau harī haraṇaśīlāvaśvau divedive pratidinaṃ yadā yasmin kāle vāvṛdhāte pravṛddhau babhūvatuḥ ādit anantarameva tvayā viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni yemire niyamyante sma ||
yadā | te | mārutīḥ | viśaḥ | tubhyam | indra | ni'yemire | āt | it | te | viśvā | bhuvanāni | yemire || 29 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥtubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ ᵥmārutī: mārutyo' marud‌rūpā: ᵥte tvadīyā: ᵥviśa: prajā: ᵥyadā yasmin kāle ᵥniyemire niyacchanti bhūtajātāni |
yadā | sūryyam | amum | divi | śukram | jyoti: | adhāraya: | āt | it | te | viśvā | bhuvanāni | yemire || 30 ||
he indra ᵥamuṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ ᵥśukraṃ nirmalaṃ ᵥjyoti: dyotamānaṃ ᵥsūrya sarvasya prerakaṃ śobhanavīryaṃ vādityaṃ ᵥdivi dyuloke jagata: prakāśanāya ᵥyadā yasmin kāle ᵥadhāraya: dhāritavānasi |
imāṃ te indra suṣṭutiṃ vipraṃ iyarti dhītibhi: |
imām | te | indra | su'stutim | vipram | iyarti | dhīti'bhi: | jāmim | padā'iva | pipratīm | pra | adhvare || 31 ||

he ᵥindra ᵥvipra: medhāvī stotā ᵥadhvare yajñe ᵥimāṃ purovartinīṃ ᵥpipratīṃ pūjayantīṃ prīṇayantīṃ vā ᵥsuṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ ᵥdhītibhi: karmabhi: paricaraṇai: sārdhaṃ ᵥte tvāṃ ᵥpra ᵥiyarti prerayati pragama- yati |
ᵥjāmiṃ ᵥpadeva yathā bandhubhūtaṃ puruṣamutkṛṣṭāni padāni sthānāni prāpayati tadvat ||
yat | asya | dhāmani | priye | sam'īcīnāsa: | asvaran | nābhā | yajñasya | dohanā | pra | adhvare || 32 ||
ᵥadhvare yajñe ᵥasya indrasya ᵥdhāmani sthāne tejasi vā ᵥpriye prīṇitavye sati ᵥsamīcī- nāsa: saṃgatā: stotāra: ᵥyat yadā ᵥpra ᵥasvaran prakarṣeṇāstuvan |
'athālī- ndrasya priyā dhāmāni ' (tai. brā. 3. 5. 7. 6) iti hi nigama: |
ᵥnābhā nābhau pṛthivyā nābhisthānīye madhye ᵥyajñasya yajanasādhanasya somasya ᵥdohanā dohane dohanādhikaraṇe'- bhivasthāne |
su'vīryam | su'aśvyam | su'gavyam | indra | daddhi | na: | hotā'iva | pūrva'cittaye | pra | adhvare || 33 ||
ᵥsuvīryaṃ śobhanavīryopetaṃ ᵥsvaśvyaṃ śobhanāśvasaṃghene ca yuktaṃ ᵥsugavyaṃ śobhanagosaṃghayuktaṃ ca dhanaṃ he ᵥindra ᵥna: asmabhyaṃ ᵥdaddhi dadasva |
ahaṃ ca 'adhvare yāge 'hoteva yathā mānuṣo' hotarvid stauti evameva 'pūrvacittaye pūrvajñānāyānyebhyaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ pūrvamevāsmatstotraparijñānāya prāśaṃsipamiti śeṣaḥ ||
tatra 'indraḥ suteṣu' iti trayastriṃśadṛcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya nāradasyārṣamauṣṇihamaindram|
mahāvrate niṣkevalye auṣṇihatvācchītau pūrvasūktena sahokto viniyogaḥ|
tṛtīye paryāye''cchāvākaśastre 'indraḥ suteṣu' iti tracaḥ stotriyaḥ|
suyate hi— 'indraḥ suteṣu someṣu ya indra somapātamaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
indraḥ suteṣu someṣu kratuṃ punīta ukthyam| vide vṛdhasya dakṣaso mahānhi ṣaḥ||1|| indraḥ| suteṣu| someṣu| kratum| pu

he ॰givaṇaḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhirvananīya saṃbhajanīya ॰indra ॰te tubhyaṃ tvadartham ॰hyaṃ purovartinī ॰suvvataḥ somābhivavaṃ kurvaṃto yajamānasya saṃbandhinī ॰rātiḥ ṛtvigbhirdīyamānā somāhutiḥ ॰kṣarati āhavanīyaṃ prati gacchati |
tvaṃ ca tathā ॰mandānaḥ mandamāno modamānastyupyan ॰asya ॰barhiṣaḥ yajñasya ॰vi ॰rājasi viśeṣeṇaśipe |

nūnaṃ tadindra daddhi no yatvāṃ sunvanta īmahe | rayiṃ naścitramā bharā svarvidam ||5|| nūnam | tat | indra | daddhi | naḥ | yat | tvā | sunvantaḥ | īmahe | rayim | naḥ | citram | ā | bhara | svaḥ'vidam || 5 ||
he indra ॰nūnam avaśyaṃ ॰tat dhanaṃ ॰naḥ asmabhyaṃ ॰daddhi dadasva |
api ca ॰citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ ॰svarvivaṃ sarvasya lambhakaṃ yadvā svargasya veditāramāstikaṃ ॰rayi putraṃ ॰naḥ asmabhyam ॰ā ॰bhara āhara3 |
stotā yatte vircarṣaṇirtipraśardhayadgiraḥ | vyāhavānu rohate juṣanta yat ||6|| stotā | yat | te | vi'carṣaṇiḥ | ati'praśardhayat | giraḥ | vyāḥ'iva | anu | rohate | juṣanta | yat || 6 ||
he indra ॰vircarṣaṇiḥ viśeṣeṇa draṣṭā ॰stotā ॰te tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ ॰giraḥ stutīḥ ॰yat yadā ॰ati- praśardhayat atiśayena praśardhayitnīrakarot |
॰yat yadā ca tā giraḥ ॰juṣanta tvāmesevanta apriyanvan vā tadā ॰yathāva śākhā iva yathaikasmin vṛkṣe bahvyaḥ śākhā upari prarohanti tathā ॰anu ॰rohate stutyā sarve guṇāstvayi prarohanti |
pratnurvarjanayā giraḥ śṛṇudhi jariturhavam | mademade vavakṣiyā sukṛtvane ||7|| pratnu'vat | janaya | giraḥ | śṛṇudhi | jarituḥ | havam | made'made | vavakṣiya | su'kṛtvane ||7||
he indra ॰pratnavat purā yathā stotṛbhyo'pekṣitaphalapradānena stutīrjanayasi evamidānīmapi ॰giraḥ stutīḥ ॰janaya utpādaya |
tādṛśastvaṃ ॰mademade somena tarpaṇe tarpaṇe sati ॰sukṛtvane śobhanakartre yajamānāya ॰vavakṣiya apekṣitaṃ phalaṃ vahasi dadāsītyarthaḥ |
krīḻantyasya sunṛtā āpo na pravatāṃ yatīḥ | ayā dhiyā ya ucyate patirdivaḥ ||8|| krīḻanti | asya | sunṛtāḥ | āpaḥ | na | pra'vatā | yatīḥ | ayā | dhiyā | yaḥ | ucyate | patiḥ | divaḥ || 8 ||
<sup>v</sup>divaḥ svargasya <sup>v</sup>pāteḥ pālayitā <sup>v</sup>yaḥ indraḥ <sup>v</sup>ayā anayā <sup>v</sup>dhiyā stutyā <sup>v</sup>ucyate pratipādyate aseyandrasyetyanvayaḥ ||
uto patirya ucyate kṛṣṭīnāmeka idṛśī | namovṛdhairavasyubhiḥ sute raṇa || 9 || uto iti | patiḥ | yaḥ | ucyate | kṛṣṭīnām | ekaḥ | it | vaśī | namaḥ'vṛdhaiḥ | avasyu'bhiḥ | sute | raṇa || 9 ||
<sup>v</sup>uto api ca <sup>v</sup>vaśī vaśayitā <sup>v</sup>eka <sup>v</sup>it eka eva <sup>v</sup>kṛṣṭīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ <sup>v</sup>patiḥ pālayiteti <sup>v</sup>yaḥ indraḥ <sup>v</sup>ucyate |
<sup>v</sup>namovṛdhaiḥ namasā stotreṇa haviṣā vā vardhayitṛbhiḥ <sup>v</sup>avasyubhiḥ rakṣaṇecchubhiḥ |
sa tvaṃ pūrvokte <sup>v</sup>sute abhiṣute some <sup>v</sup>raṇa ramasva |
he stotaḥ tamindraṃ sute some stuhi' |

stuhi śrutaṃ vipaścitaṃ harī yasya prasakṣaṇā | gantāraṃ dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ namasvirnaḥ || 10 || stuhi | śrutam | vipaḥ'ścitam | harī iti | yasya | pra'sakṣaṇā | gantāra | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛham | namasvirnaḥ || 10 ||
he stotaḥ <sup>v</sup>vipaścitaṃ viśiṣṭajñānaṃ <sup>v</sup>śrutaṃ viśvataṃ prakhyātaṃ tamindraṃ <sup>v</sup>stuhi praśaṃsa |

<sup>v</sup>yasya indrasya <sup>v</sup>harī aśvau <sup>v</sup>prasakṣaṇā śatrūṇāṃ prasahanaśīlau <sup>v</sup>namasvirnaḥ haviṣmataḥ <sup>v</sup>dāśuṣaḥ dattavato yajamānasya <sup>v</sup>gṛhaṃ <sup>v</sup>gantāraṃ gamanaśīlau ca tamindraṃ stuhīti saṃbandhaḥ |
tutujāno mehemate'śvaibhiḥ pṛṣitapsubhiḥ | ā yāhi yajñamāśubhiḥ śamiddhi tai || 11 || tutujānaḥ | mahe'mate | aśvaibhiḥ | pṛṣitapsu'bhiḥ | ā | yāhi | yajñam | āśu'bhiḥ | śam | it | hi | tai || 11 ||

sa tādṛśa he indra <sup>v</sup>tutujānaḥ tvaramāṇaḥ san <sup>v</sup>pṛṣitapsubhiḥ snigdharūpaiḥ <sup>v</sup>āśubhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ <sup>v</sup>aśvaibhiḥ aśvaiḥ <sup>v</sup>yajñam asmadīyam <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>yāhi āgaccha |
<sup>v</sup>hi yasmāt <sup>v</sup>te tava tasmin yajñe <sup>v</sup>śamit sukhaṃ vidyata eva |
indra śavṭha satapate rayiṃ guṇatsu dhāraya | śravaḥ sūrībhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanam || 12 || indra | śavṭha | sat'pate | rayim | guṇat'su | dhāraya | śravaḥ | sūri'bhyaḥ | amṛtam | vasu'tvanam || 12 ||
he <sup>v</sup>śaviṣṭha balavattama <sup>v</sup>satapate satāṃ pālayitaḥ <sup>v</sup>indra <sup>v</sup>guṇatsu asmāsu <sup>v</sup>rathi dhanaṃ <sup>v</sup>dhāraya avasthāpaya |
api ca <sup>v</sup>sūribhyaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ <sup>v</sup>amṛtam anaśvaraṃ <sup>v</sup>vasutvanaṃ vyāptimata <sup>v</sup>śravaḥ annaṃ yaśo vā dehīti śeṣaḥ ||
harve tvā sūra udite harve mṛṣyadine divaḥ |

havai | tvā | sūrai | uta'ite | havai | madhyaṃdine | divaḥ | juṣāṇaḥ | indra | sarsi'bhiḥ | naḥ | ā | gṛhi || 13 || he ᵥindra ᵥsure sūrye ᵥudite udayaṃ prāpte sati prātaḥsavane ᵥtvāṃ ᵥhave āhvaye | tathā ᵥdivaḥ divasasya ᵥmadhyaṃdine madhyabhāge mādhyaṃdinasavane tvāṃ ᵥhave āhvaye | he indra sa tvaṃ ᵥjuṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ san ᵥsasibhiḥ sarpaṇaśīlairaśvaiḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥā ᵥgahi āgaccha ||

ā tū gahi pra tu drava matsvā sutasya gormataḥ | tantuṃ tanuṣva purvya yathā vide || 14 || ā | tu | gṛhi | pra | tu | drava | matsva | sutasya | go'maṃtaḥ | tantum | tanuṣva | purvyam | yathā | vide || 14 || he indra ᵥtu kṣipram ᵥā ᵥgahi āgaccha | āgatya ca ᵥtu kṣipraṃ ᵥpra ᵥdrava | somo yatra nivasati taṃ deśaṃ prati śīghraṃ gaccha | gatvā ca ᵥgomataḥ govikāraiḥ payaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ śrayaṇadravyairyuktasya ᵥsutasya abhiṣutasya somasya pānena ᵥmatsva mādya hṛṣṭo bhava | tadanantaraṃ ᵥyathā ahaṃ ᵥvide upalabhe tathā ᵥpūrvyaṃ pūrvaiḥ kṛtaṃ ᵥtantuṃ vistṛtaṃ yajñaṃ ᵥtanuṣva samyanniṣpādaya | phalotpādanasamarthaṃ kurvityarthaḥ ||

yacchakrāsi parāvati yardvāvati vṛtrahan | yadvā samudre anrhaso'vitedasi ||15|| yat | śakra | asi | purā'vati | yat | arvā'vati | vṛtra'han | yat | vā | samudre | andhasaḥ | avitā | it | asi || 15 || he ᵥśakra śakendra ᵥparāvati dūradeśe ᵥyat yadi ᵥasi bhavasi | he ᵥvṛtrahan ᵥyat yadi vā ᵥarvāvati samīpe bhavasi vartase | ᵥyadvā yadi vā ᵥsamudre jaladhāvantarikṣe vā vartase | tasmāt sarvasmāt sthānādāgatya ᵥandhasaḥ annasya somalakṣaṇasya pānena ᵥavitedasi rakṣitaiva bhavasi ||15||

indraṃ vardhantu no gira indraṃ sutāsa indavaḥ | indraṃ haviṣmatīrviśo arāṇiṣuḥ ||16|| indram | vardhantu | naḥ | giraḥ | indram | sutāsaḥ | indavaḥ | indrai | haviṣmatīḥ | viśaḥ | arāṇiṣuḥ || 16 || ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥgiraḥ stutirūpā vācaḥ ᵥindraṃ ᵥvardhantu vardhayantu | ᵥsutāsaḥ abhiṣutāḥ ᵥindavaḥ somāścāsmadīyāḥ tam ᵥindraṃ vardhayantu | ᵥhaviṣmatīḥ haviṣmatyo havirbhiḥpuroḍāśādibhi- ryuktāḥ ᵥviśaḥ prajāstasmin ᵥindre ᵥarāṇiṣuḥ araṃsiṣuḥ ||
tamidviāṃ avustyavaḥ pravatvatīmīrūtibhiḥ | indraṃ kṣoṇīravardhayannvāiva ||17|| tam | it | viprāḥ | avustyavaḥ | pravatvatībhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | indram | kṣoṇīḥ | avardhayan | vayāḥ'iva || 17 ||
vviprā: medhāvina: vavasyava: rakṣaṇakāmā: slotāra: vtamit tameva vindraṃ vpravasvatībhi: prakarṣeṇābhigantrībhi: vūtibhi: tṛtikarībhirāhutibhi: stutibhirvā vardhayanti|
tadupalakṣitā: sarve lokā: vyathāhya vṛkṣasya śākhā iva tadadhīnā: santa: vavadhayan vardhayanti |
trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāsau yajñamatanata | tamidvardhantu no gira: sudāvṛdham ||18|| tri'kadrukeṣu | cetanam | devāsa: | yajñam | atata | tam | it | vardhantu | na: | gira: | sudā'vṛdham || 18 ||
