indra tvamvitedasītyā stuvato adrivaḥ | ṛtādiyarmi te dhiyaṃ manoyujam || 26 || indra̭ | tvam | a॒vi॒tā | it | a॒si॒ | ityā | stu॒va॒taḥ | a॒dri॒vaḥ | ṛ॒tāt | i॒yarmi̭ | te॒ | dhiya̭m | ma॒na॒ḥ'yuja̭m || 26 || he ᵥadrivaḥ vajravan ᵥindra ᵥtvam ᵥityā itthamena prakāreṇa ᵥstuvataḥ stotraṃ kurvato yaja- mānasya ᵥavitedasi rakṣitaiva bhavasi | yata evamataḥ kāraṇādahamapi ᵥṛtāt yajñādetoḥ ᵥmano- yujaṃ mananīya stotreṇa prāpyāṃ ᵥte tvadīyāṃ ᵥdhiyam anugrahabuddhim ᵥiyarmi prāpnomi | yadvā | ṛtāt satyabhūtāttvataḥ stotreṇa yuktaṃ tvatprītikaraṃ karmāhaṃ prāpnomi ||

iha tyā sadhamādyā yujānaḥ somapītaye | harī indra pratadvasū abhi svara ||27|| iha | tyā | sa॒dha॒'mādyā̭ | yu॒jā॒naḥ | soma̭'pītaye | ha॒rī॒ iti̭ | indra̭ | pra॒ta॒dvasū॒ iti̭ pra॒ta॒t'vasṷ̄ | a॒bhi | sva̭ḥ || 27 || he ᵥindra ᵥiha asmin yāge ᵥsomapītaye somapānāya ᵥabhi ᵥsvara abhigaccha | kiṃ kurvan | ᵥtyā tau tau prasiddhau ᵥsadhamādyā tvayā saha havirbhirmādayitavyau tarpayitavyau ᵥpratadvasū pratatavasū vistīrṇadhanau īdṛśau ᵥharī tvadīyāvaśvau ᵥyujānaḥ rathena saṃyojayan ||

abhi svarantu ye tarva rudrāsaḥ sakṣat śriyam | uto murutvatīrviśau abhi prayaḥ || 28 || abhi | sva॒ra॒ntu | ye | tarva̭ | ru॒drāsa̭ḥ | sa॒kṣat | śriya̭m | u॒to iti̭ | ma॒ru॒tvatī̭ḥ | vi॒śaḥ | a॒bhi | pra॒ya̭ḥ || 28 || ᵥabhi ᵥsvarantu abhigacchantu te he indra ᵥtava anucarāḥ ᵥrudrāsaḥ rudraputrāḥ ᵥye marutaḥ santi | api ca te ᵥśriyaṃ śrayaṇīyamimaṃ yajñaṃ ᵥsakṣata sacantu prāpnuvantu | ᵥuto api ca ᵥmarutvatīḥ marudbhi- ryuktāḥ ᵥviśaḥ anyā api daivīḥ prajāḥ ᵥprayaḥ | annāmaitat | asmadīyaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannamabhigacchantu ||

imā asya pratūrtayaḥ padaṃ juṣanta yadvi | nābhā yajñasya saṃ dadhurthā vide || 29 || imāḥ | a॒sya | pra॒'tūrtaya̭ḥ | pada̭m | ju॒ṣa॒nta | yat | di॒vi | nā॒bhā | ya॒jñasya̭ | sam | da॒dhuḥ | yathā̭ | vi॒de || 29 || ᵥasya indrasya saṃbandhinyaḥ ᵥimāḥ pūrvoktā marudādirūpāḥ prajāḥ ᵥpratūrtayaḥ prakarṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsisyaḥ satyaḥ ᵥpadaṃ sthānaṃ ᵥjuṣanta asevanta | ᵥdivi dyuloke ᵥyat sthānamanyairdurjñāpamasti tatpada- mityarthaḥ | api ca tāḥ ᵥyajñasya jyotiṣṭomādeḥ ᵥnābhā nābhau nābhisthānīye havirdhāna uttaravedyāṃ vā ᵥsaṃ ᵥdadhuḥ saṃnidadhate | ᵥyathā yena prakāreṇa ᵥvide vinde apekṣitaṃ dhanaṃ labhe tathetyarthaḥ | yadvā | vide jñānāya yathāsmākaṃ dakṣāvaraṃ² jñānaṃ bhavati tathetyarthaḥ ||

ayaṃ dīrghāya cakṣase prāci prayatyadhvaraṃ | mimīte yajñamānuṣagvicakṣya || 30 || ayaṃ | dī॒rghā̭ya | ca॒kṣa॒se | prā॒ci | pra॒'yati̭ | a॒dhva॒re | mi॒mī॒te | ya॒jñam | ā॒nu॒ṣa॒k | vi॒'ca॒kṣva || 30 ||

prāci prācīne prāgāyate yajñagṛhe adhvare hiṃsārahite yajñe prayati gacchati pravartamāne sati ayam indraḥ pravartamānaṃ taṃ yajñamānupak anuṣakmānupūrvyeṇa vicakṣya viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭvā mimīte niṣpādayati|

vṛṣāyamindra te rathaṃ uto te vṛṣaṇā harī | vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato vṛṣā harvaḥ || 31 || vṛṣā | ayam | indra | te | rathaḥ | uto iti | te | vṛṣaṇā | harī iti | vṛṣā | tvam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | vṛṣā | harvaḥ || 31 ||
he indra te tvadīyaḥ ayaṃ rathaḥ vṛṣā kāmānāṃ varṣitā |
uto api ca te tava harī aśvau vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇau varṣitārau |
he śatakrato bahukarman bahuprajña vendra tvaṃ ca vṛṣā varṣitā kāmānām |
tathā havaḥ tvadviṣayamāhvānaṃ ca vṛṣā varṣitā |
kimu vaktavyaṃ tvadīyā rathādayo varṣantīti bhāvaḥ ||
vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ | vṛṣā yajño yaminvasi vṛṣā harvaḥ ||32|| vṛṣā | grāvā | vṛṣā | madaḥ | vṛṣā | somaḥ | ayam | sutaḥ | vṛṣā | yajñaḥ | yam | invasi | vṛṣā | harvaḥ || 32 ||
he indra tvadīyaḥ somapānajanyaḥ madaḥ ca vṛṣā varṣitā |
sutaḥ tvadarthamabhiṣutaḥ ayaṃ somaḥ ca vṛṣā varṣitā |
yaṃ yajñam invasi tvaṃ prāpnoṣi sa ca yajñaḥ vṛṣā abhīṣṭasya phalasya varṣitā |

vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñścitrābhirūtibhiḥ | vāvandya hi pratiṣṭuti vṛṣā harvaḥ ||33|| vṛṣā | tvā | vṛṣaṇam | huve | vajrin | citrābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | vavandya | hi | prati'stutim | vṛṣā | harvaḥ || 33 ||
he vajrin vajravadindra vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ varṣitāraṃ tvāṃ vṛṣā varṣitā haviṣāmāserāhaṃ citrābhiḥ cāyanīyābhirnānāvidhābhirvā ūtibhiḥ tṛptikarībhiḥ stutibhiḥ huve āhvaye |
hi yasmāttvaṃ pratiṣṭutiṃ tvāmabhilakṣya kṛtaṃ stotraṃ vavandya vanasi saṃbhajasi atastvadīyaḥ havaḥ āhvānaṃ vṛṣā varṣitā |
havo havyo vṛṣā varṣitā tvaṃ yasmāt stutiṃ vanasi tasmāt huva ityarthaḥ ||
yadindrāṃha' iti pañcadaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ gopūkyaśvasūkinoḥ kāṇvagotrayorārṣaṃ gāyatra- maindram |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'yadindra pañconā gopūkyaśvasūkinau kāṇvāyanau' iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūyate—'yadindrāṃha yathā tvaṃ pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmiti sūkte' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 5) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'yadindrāṃha pra te mahe' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
yadindrāṃha yathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it | stotā me gorṣā syāt || 1 || yat | indra | aham | yathā | tvam | īśīya | vasvaḥ | ekaḥ | it | stotā | me | go'rṣā | syāt || 1 ||
he indra yathā tvam eka it eka eva kevalaṃ vastvaḥ vasunaḥ dhanasya īśiṣe evam aham api yat yadi īśīya aiśvaryayuktaḥ syāṃ tadānīṃ me mama stotā gosakhā syāt gobhiḥ sahito bhavet |
īśvarasya tava stotā kuto hetorgosahito na bhavet api tu bhavedityabhiprāyaḥ 2 ||
śikṣeyam | asmai | ditsaiyam | śacī'pate | manīṣiṇe | yat | aham | go'rpatiḥ | syām ||2||
he śacīpate śaktimabhindra asmai manīṣiṇe manasa īśire stotre ditsaiyaṃ dātumiccheyam |
tadanantaraṃ śikṣeyaṃ prārthitaṃ dhanaṃ dadyāṃ ca |
yat yadi ahaṃ gopatiḥ gavāmadhipatiḥ syāṃ bhaveyaṃ tvatprasādāditi śeṣaḥ ||
dhenuḥ | te | indra | sūnṛtā | yajamānāya | sunvate
subhyate hi—'vyantarikṣamatiracchayāvādhasya sunvata iti tṛcāḥ paryāsāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 7.2) iti |
ahargaṇeṣu dvitīyādiṣvahaḥsvapi tasyaiva tasminneva śastre'yaṃ paryāsastṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'paryāsānka- druto'harahaḥśasyānīti' hotrakā dvitīyādiṣveva' (āśva. śrau. 7. 1) iti ||

vyantarikṣamatiranme somasya rocanā | indro yadabhinadvalam || 7 || vi | antarikṣam | atirat | made | somasya | rocanā | indraḥ | yat | abhinat | valam ||7|| vsomasya pānena vmade harṣe sati vrocanā rocamānam vantarikṣam ayam vindraḥ vvi vatirat vyavardhayat | vyat yasmātkāraṇāt vvalam āvṛtya sthitamasuraṃ meghaṃ vā vabhinat vyadārayat ||

udgā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvanguhā satīḥ | arvāñcaṃ nunude valam || 8 || ut | gāḥ | ājat | aṅgiraḥ'bhyaḥ | āviḥ | kṛṇvan | guhā | satīḥ | arvāñcam | nunude | valam || 8 || vaṅgirobhyaḥ ṛṣibhyo valāncaraiḥ paṇibhirapahṛtāḥ vgāḥ vut vājat udgamayat | kiṃ kurvan | vguhā guhāyāṃ bile vsatīḥ vidyamānāḥ yathā na dṛśyante tathā paṇibhirgūḍhāstā gāḥ vāviṣkṛṇvan prakāśayan | api ca paṇīnāmadhipatiṃ vvalam asuramapi varvāñcam adhomukhaṃ vnunude preritavān ||

indreṇa rocanā divo dṛḻahāni dṛṃhitāni ca | sthirāṇi na parāṇude || 9 || indreṇa | rocanā | divaḥ | dṛḻahāni | dṛṃhitāni | ca | sthirāṇi | na | parā'ṇude || 9 || vdivaḥ dyulokasya saṃbandhīni vrocanā rocamānāni devagṛhātmakāni nakṣatrāṇi vindreṇa vdṛḻahāni dṛḍhāvayavāni balavanti kṛtāni vdṛṃhitāni vca dṛḍhīkṛtāni | yathaikatra naiścalyenāvatiṣṭhante tathā kṛtānītyarthaḥ | yadvā | 'dṛha dṛhi vṛhi vṛddhau' | dṛṃhitāni vardhitāni cetyarthaḥ | api ca vsthirāṇi sthāstūni dṛḍhāni tāni vna vparāṇude parānodanīyāni na bhavanti | na kenāpi sthānāt pracyāvayituṃ śakyānītyarthaḥ | | 'nuda preraṇe' | asmāt 'kṛtyārthe' iti kenapratyayaḥ |3 ||

apāmūrmirmadabhiva stoma indrājirāyate | vi te madā arājiṣuḥ || 10 || apām | ūrmiḥ | mardana'iva | stomaḥ | indra | ajira'dyate | vi | te | madāḥ | arājiṣuḥ || 10 || vapāṃ samudrāṇām vūrmiḥ taraṅgaḥ vmadaśva yathā mādyuparyupari jāyate | he vindra vstomaḥ tvadīyaṃ stotraṃ tathā vajirāyate | ajiraḥ kṣipragāmī | sa ivācarati | api ca vte tvadīyāḥ vmadāḥ stotrajanyāḥ somapānajanyāśca vvi varājiṣuḥ viśeṣeṇa rājante dīpyante || || 15 ||
tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsyukthavardhanaḥ | stotṛṇāmuta bhadrakṛt || 11 || tvam | hi | stoma'vardhanaḥ | indra | asi | uktha'vardhanaḥ | stotṛṇām | uta | bhadra'kṛt || 11 ||
he indra tvaṃ hi tvaṃ khalu stomavardhanaḥ stomena trivṛtpañcadaśādinā vardhanīyaḥ asi|
uta api ca stotṛṇām asmākaṃ bhadrakṛt bhadrasya kalyāṇasya phalasya kartāpi tvamevāsi||

indram it keśinau harī soma'peyāya vakṣataḥ| upa yajñaṃ su'rādhasam ||12|| indram| it| keśinau| harī iti| soma'peyāya| vakṣataḥ| upa| yajñam| su'rādhasam ||12|| keśinau keśinau| mūrdhajāni lomāni keśāḥ| tadvanto harī aśvau surādhasaṃ śobhanadhanam indramit indrameva yajñam upa asmadyajñaṃ prati somapeyāya somapānārthaṃ vakṣataḥ vahatām| padvā| yajñaṃ yajñyamindramupavahatām ||
apām phenena namuceḥ śiraḥ indro'vartayaḥ| viśvā yadajayaḥ spṛdhaḥ ||13|| apām| phenena| namuceḥ| śiraḥ| indra| ut| avartayaḥ| viśvāḥ| yat| ajayaḥ| spṛdhaḥ ||13||
purā kilendro'surādhipā namucimasuraṃ grahītuṃ na śaśāka|
tvāṃ visṛjāmi rātrāvahani ca śuṣkeṇārdreṇa vāyudhena yadi māṃ mā hiṃsīriti|
sa indrastena visṛṣṭaḥ sañjhorātrayoḥ saṃdhau śuṣkādrvilakṣaṇena phenena tasya śiraścheda|
he indra apām phenena vajrībhūtena namuceḥ asurasya śiraḥ udavartayaḥ śarīrāduddhatamavartayaḥ|
yat yadā viśvāḥ sarvāḥ spṛdhaḥ spardhamānā āsurīḥ senāḥ ajayaḥ jitavānasi|

māyābhiḥ rutsirsipsata indra dyāmā'rukṣat| ava dasyū~radhunthāḥ || 14 || māyābhiḥ| ut| sirsipsataḥ| indra| dyām| ā'rukṣataḥ| ava| dasyū~n| adhunthāḥ ||14|| --- he indra tvam ava adhunthāḥ avāṅmukhaṃ preritavānasi ||

asunvāmindra saṃsadaṃ viṣvācīṃ vyanāśaya| somapā uttarau bhavan || 15 || asunvām| indra| sam'sadam| viṣvācīm| vi| anāśayaḥ| soma'pāḥ| ut| taraḥ| bhavan ||15|| he indra tvaṃ somapāḥ somasya pātā bhūtvā uttaraḥ utkṛṣṭataraḥ bhavan asunvāṃ somābhiṣavahīnāṃ saṃsadaṃ janasaṃhatiṃ viṣvācīṃ parasparavirodhena viṣu nānā gantrīṃ vyanāśayaḥ viśeṣeṇa nāśayasi || || 16 ||
sūyate hi—'tambabhi pra gāyatetyuttamāmuddharati' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 5) iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—'tambabhi pra gāyata vayamu tvāmpūvyaṃ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||
tambabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ| indraṃ gīrbhistviṣamā vivāsata || 1 || tam| ū~ iti| abhi| pra| gāyata| puru'hūtam| puru'stutam| indram| gīḥ'bhiḥ| tviṣam| ā| vivāsata || 1 ||

ᵛpuruhūtaṃ bahubhirāhūtaṃ ᵛpuruhūtaṃ bahubhiḥ stutaṃ ᵛtamu tamevendraṃ ῾ha stotāraḥ ᵛabhi ᵛpra ᵛgāyata abhimukhaṃ prakarpeṇa studhvam | etadeva spaṣṭayati | ᵛtaviṣaṃ mahāntam ᵛindraṃ ᵛgīrbhiḥ vāgbhiḥ ᵛā ᵛvicāsata paricarata || yasya dvibarha~so bṛhatsaho dādhāra rodasī | girī~ra~o apaḥ svarvṛṣatvanā || 2 || yasya | dvibarha~saḥ | bṛhat | sahaḥ | dādhāra | rodasī iti | girīn | ajñān | apaḥ | svaḥ | vṛṣatvanā || 2 || ᵛdvibarha~saḥ dvayoḥ sthānayoḥ parivṛḍhasya ᵛyasya indrasya ᵛbṛhat mahat ᵛsahaḥ balaṃ ᵛrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵛdādhāra dhārayati | chāndaso liṭ | tujāditvādabhyāsadīrghaḥ | tathā ᵛajñān kṣipra- gamanān ᵛgirīn parvatān meghān vā ᵛsvaḥ saraṇaśīlāḥ ᵛapaḥ udakāni ca ᵛvṛṣatvanā vṛṣatvena vīryeṇa yasyendrasya balaṃ dhārayati tatrāvasthāpayati | tambabhīti pūrvayā saṃbandhaḥ sa tvamityuttarayā vā || sa rājasi puruṣṭuta~ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase | indra jaitrā śravasyā ca yantave || 3 || saḥ | rājasi | puru'stuta | ekaḥ | vṛtrāṇi | jighnase | indra | jaitrā | śravasyā | ca | yantave || 3 || he ᵛpuruṣṭuta bahubhiḥ stuta ᵛindra ᵛsaḥ pūrvoktaguṇastvaṃ ᵛrājasi dīpyase īśiṣe vā | api ca tvam ᵛekaḥ sahāyarahitaḥ 2 kevala eva san ᵛvṛtrāṇi āvarakāṇi śatrujātāni ᵛjighnase hatavānasi | kimartham | jaitrāṇi3 jetavyāni dhanāni ᵛśravasyā śravasyāni śravaṇīyānyasāni yadvā śravaṇāhāṇi yaśāṃsi ᵛca ᵛyantave yantuṃ niyantuṃ svādhīnaṃ kartum || ābhiplavikeṣvapyeṣu tṛtīyasavane brahmaśastre ‘taṃ te madam’ iti tṛco vaikalpikaḥ stotriyaḥ | sūyate hi—‘taṃ te madaṃ guṇīmasi tambabhi pra gāyata’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti || taṃ te madaṃ guṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtsu sāsahim | u lokakṛtnumadrivo haridhriyam || 4 || tam | te | madam | guṇīmasi | vṛṣaṇam | pṛt'su | sāsahim | ū~ iti | loka'kṛtnum | adrivaḥ | hari'dhriyam || 4 || he ᵛadrivaḥ vajravacchindra ᵛte tvadīyaṃ ᵛtaṃ ᵛmadaṃ somapānajanitaṃ harṣaṃ ᵛguṇīmasi guṇīmaḥ praśaṃsāmaḥ | ‘gṛ śabde’ | krayādiḥ | ‘pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ’ | ‘idanto masi’ iti masa hakāragamaḥ | kīdṛśam | ᵛvṛṣaṇaṃ varṣitāraṃ kāmānāṃ ᵛpṛtsu saṃgrāmeṣu ᵛsāsahiṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ ᵛlokakṛtnuṃ lokasya sthānasya kartāraṃ ᵛharidhriyaṃ harimyāmśvābhyāṃ śrayaṇīyaṃ sevyam | uśabdaḥ samuccaye4 padapūraṇe vā || yena jyotīṃṣyāyave marnave ca vivediya | mundāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi || 5 || yena | jyotīṃṣi | āyave | marnave | ca | vivediya | mundānaḥ | asya | barhiṣaḥ | vi | rājasi ||5|| he indra ᵛyena ātmīyena madena ᵛāyave aurvaśeyāya ᵛmanave vivasvataḥ putrāya ᵛca ᵛjyotīṃṣi sūryādīni vṛtrādibhirāvṛtāni taddharaṇena ᵛvivediya alambhayaḥ | prajñāpitavān prakāśitavānasītyarthaḥ | 1. kha-gha-ta-bhara-ca | 2. gha-asahāyaḥ | 3. gha-jaitrā | 4. ga-ṇaṣā samuccaye; ta-na-bhara-yeṣāṃ samuccaye; bha1-3-sarveṣāṃ samuccaye |
tena madena ᵥmandānaḥ modamānasvam ᵥbhasya ᵥbarhiṣaḥ vṛdatya yajñasya ᵥvi ᵥrājasi viśeṣeṇaśiṣe |
anena barhiṣā vṛdena' haṣyan vi rājasi viśeṣeṇa dīpyase ||
tadudyā citta ukthino'nu ṣuvanti pūrvathā | vṛṣapalīrapo jaṃyā divedive || 6 || tat | agha | cit | te | ukthinaḥ | anu | ṣuvanti | purvathā | vṛṣa'patnīḥ | apaḥ | jaya | dive'dive || 6 ||
he indra ᵥte tvadīyaṃ ᵥtat prasiddhaṃ balam ᵥagha ᵥcit adyāpi ᵥpūrvathā pūrvasminkāla iva ᵥukthinaḥ śakhinaḥ stotāraḥ ᵥanu ᵥṣuvanti krameṇa praśaṃsanti |
sa ᵥtvaṃ ᵥvṛṣapatnīḥ vṛṣā varṣitā parjanyaḥ patiryāsāṃ tādṛśīḥ ᵥapaḥ ᵥdivedive pratidivasaṃ ᵥjaya svāyattaṃ kuru ||
tav tyadindriyaṃ bṛhattav śuṣmamuta kratum | vajraṃ śiṣāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam ||7|| tav | tyat | indriyam | bṛhat | tav | śuṣmam | uta | kratum | vajram | śiṣāti | dhiṣaṇā | vareṇyam || 7 ||
he indra ᵥtyat2 tat prasiddham ᵥindriyam indrasya liṅgaṃ ᵥbṛhat prabhūtaṃ vīryaṃ ᵥdhiṣaṇā stutiḥ ᵥśiṣāti niḥiti tīkṣṇīkaroti |
tathā ᵥtava tvadīyaṃ ᵥśuṣmaṃ śoṣakaṃ balam ᵥuta api ca ᵥkratuṃ prajñānaṃ balaṃ karma vā ᵥvareṇyaṃ varaṇīyaṃ ᵥvajram āyudhaṃ ca stutistīkṣṇīkaroti ||
tav dyaurindra pausyai pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ | ᵥtvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvira ||8|| tav | dyauḥ | indra | pausyam | pṛthivī | vardhati | śravaḥ | ᵥtvām | āpaḥ | parvatāsaḥ | ca | hinvira ||8||
he ᵥindra ᵥtava tvadīyaṃ ᵥpausyaṃ balaṃ ᵥdyauḥ ᵥvardhati vardhayati |
taṃ ᵥtvām ᵥāpaḥ udakāni antarikṣāṇi ᵥparvatāsaḥ parvatāḥ parvavanto meghāḥ ᵥca girayaśca vā ᵥhinvira prīṇayanti svāmittvena prāpnuvanti vā ||
tvāṃ viṣṇurbṛhatkṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ | tvāṃ śardho madyanu mārutam ||9|| tvām | viṣṇuḥ | bṛhan | kṣayaḥ | mitraḥ | gṛṇāti | varuṇaḥ | tvām | śardhaḥ | ᵥmadati | anu | mārutam || 9 ||
he indra ᵥbṛhan mahān ᵥkṣayaḥ nivāsahetuḥ ᵥviṣṇuḥ ᵥmitraḥ ᵥvaruṇaḥ ca ᵥtvāṃ ᵥgṛṇāti stauti |
tathā ᵥmārutaṃ marutsambandhi ᵥśardhaḥ balaṃ ᵥtvām ᵥanu ᵥmadati tava madamanulakṣya paścānmā- yati |
tvaṃ vṛṣā janānāṃ maṃheṣṭha indra jajñiṣe | satrā viśvā svapatyāni dadhiṣe ||10|| tvam | vṛṣā | janānām | maṃheṣṭhaḥ | indra | jajñiṣe | satrā | viśvā | su'apatyāni | dadhiṣe ||10||

he ᵥindra ᵥvṛṣā varṣitā ᵥtvaṃ ᵥjanānāṃ devajanānāṃ madhye ᵥsaṃhiṣṭhaḥ dātṛttamaḥ ᵥjajñiṣe prādurbhavasi | ata eva ᵥviśvā sarvāṇi ᵥsvapatyāni śobhanaiḥ putrādibhiḥ sahitāni ᵥsatrā saha ᵥdadhiṣe dātuṃ dhārayasi | dadāsi vā || 18 || satrā tvaṃ puruhuta eko vṛtrāṇi tośase | nānya indrātkaraṇaṃ bhūyaṃ invati ||11|| satrā | tvam | puru'stuta | ekaḥ | vṛtrāṇi | tośase | na | anyaḥ | indrāt | karaṇam | bhūyaḥ | invati || 11 ||

he ᵥpuruhuta bahubhiḥ stutendra ᵥtvam ᵥekaḥ asahāya eva san ᵥsatrā | mahanmaitat | mahānti ᵥvṛtrāṇi śatrujātāni | yadvā | satreti sahāyai | sahaiva yugapadevaikayatnenaiva ᵥtośase hinasti | tośatirvadhakarmā | akartuṃ śaktānīti bhāvaḥ | api cāsmāt ᵥindrāt ᵥanyaḥ kaścit ᵥbhūyaḥ bahu- taraṃ ᵥkaraṇaṃ karma vṛtravadhādikaṃ ᵥna ᵥinvati na prāpnoti | indra ᵥeva kartuṃ śaknotīti bhāvaḥ || yadindra manmaśastavā nānā harvanta ūtaye | asmākebhirnṛbhirattrā svarjaye || 12 || yat | indra | manma'śaḥ | ᵥtvā | nānā | harvante | ūtaye | asmākebhiḥ | nṛ'bhiḥ | atra | svaḥ | jaya || 12 ||

he ᵥindra ᵥyat yasmin saṃgrāme tvāṃ ᵥmanmaśaḥ manmanā ᵥstotreṇa ᵥnānā bahuprakāraṃ ᵥharvante āhvayanti | kimartham | ᵥūtaye rakṣāyai | ᵥatra asmin saṃgrāme ᵥasmākebhiḥ asmākairasmadīyaireva ᵥnṛbhiḥ netṛbhiḥ stotṛbhirāhūtaḥ san ᵥsvaḥ śatrubalaṃ ᵥjaya abhibhava || araṃ kṣayāya no mahe viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan | indraṃ jaitrāya harṣayā śacīpatim ||13|| aram | kṣayāya | naḥ | mahe | viśvā | rūpāṇi | ā'viśan | indram | jaitrāya | harṣaya | śacī'patim || 13 ||
he stotaḥ ᵥmahe mahate ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥkṣayāya gṛhanāmaiṭat |
gṛhārtham ᵥaram alaṃ paryāptaṃ ᵥviśvā viśvāni vyāptāni ᵥrūpāṇi indragatāni guṇajātāni ᵥāviśan stutyā vyāpyanvan ᵥśacīpatim |
tameva ᵥindraṃ ᵥjaitrāya jetavyadhanātha ᵥharṣaya toṣaya |
‘pra samnājam’ iti dvādarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktamirimbiṭhināgnaḥ kāṇvasyārṣaṃ gāyatramaindram |
anu- kramyate hi—’ pra samnājaṃ dvādaśerimbiṭhiḥ ’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—’ pra samnājamupa kramasvā bhara ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
mahāvrate'pi niṣkevalya etadādike dve sūkte uparitanasthānyaṃ dvacaṃ varjayitvā |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ—’ pra samnājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmiti sūkte uttarasyottame uddharati ’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 5) iti ||
pra samnājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ |
2. kha-dadhiṣe stotatamau jajñiṣe prādurbhavasi; ga-dadhiṣe sarvebhyo; ta-na- śa-dadhiṣe stotatamau jajñiṣe prādurbhavasi ata eva viśvā sarvābhyo; bha-dadhiṣe stotubhyo |
5. ga-manmanā manmanā; ta-bha-manmanā manmanā; na-manmanā manmanā |
pra | sam'rājam | carṣaṇīnām | indram | stota | navya̭m | gīḥ'bhiḥ | nara̭m | nu'saha̭m | maṃ hiṣṭham || 1 ||
^carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye ^samprājamānaṃ yadvā manuṣyāṇāmadhīśvaram ^indraṃ he stotāraḥ ^pra ^stota prakarṣeṇa stuta |
^gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ ^navyaṃ stutyaṃ ^naraṃ netāraṃ ^nṛpāhaṃ nṛṇāṃ śatrumanuṣyāṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ ^maṃhiṣṭhaṃ dātṛtamam ||
yasmi̭n | u॒kthāni̭ | ra॒ṇyanti̭ | viśvā̭ni | ca | śrava॒syā | a॒pām | ava̭: | na | sa̭mu॒dre || 2 ||
^yasmin indre ^ukthāni śastrāṇi ^raṇyanti ramante ^viśvāni sarvāṇi ^śravasyā śravasyāni śravaṇīyāni havirlakṣaṇānyannāni ^ca ramante |
tam | sṷ'stu॒tyā | ā | vi̭vāse | jyeṣṭha̭'rājam | bha॒re | kṛ॒tanṷm | ma॒haḥ | vā॒jina̭m | sa॒ni'bhya̭ḥ ||3||
^bhare saṃgrāme ^mahaḥ mahato vṛtravadhādeḥ ^kṛnuṃ kartāraṃ ^vājinam annavantaṃ balavantaṃ vā |
yasya̭ | a॒nūnā̭ḥ | ga॒bhīrā̭ḥ | madā̭: | u॒rava̭ḥ | ta॒rutrā̭ḥ | ha॒rṣu॒manta̭ḥ | śūra̭'sātau || 4 ||

^yasya indrasya ^madāḥ somapānajanitāḥ ^anūnāḥ anyūnāḥ ^gabhīrāḥ gāmbhīryeṇopetāḥ ^uravaḥ vistīrṇāḥ ^tarutrāḥ śatrūṇāṃ tārakāḥ ^śūrasātau śūrasaṃbhajanīye saṃgrāme ^harṣumantaḥ harṣa- yuktāḥ saṃgrāmotsukā bhavanti |
tam | it | dha॒neṣṷ | hi॒teṣṷ | iva̭ | a॒kārya̭ | ha॒vante | yeṣā̭m | indra̭ḥ | te | ja̭yanti || 5 ||
^dhaneṣu ^hiteṣu śatruṣu nihiteṣu prāptavyeṣu satsu ^tamin taṃ pūrvoktaguṇamevendram ^adhivākāya adhivacanāya pakṣapātavacanāya ^havante stotāra āhvayanti |
tam | it | yauta̭naiḥ | ā॒rya̭nti | tam | kṛ॒tebhi̭ḥ | ca॒rṇaya̭ | e॒ṣaḥ | indra̭ḥ | va॒riva̭ḥ'kṛt || 6 ||
indro bruvendra ṛṣindraḥ puru puruhūtaḥ | mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ || 7 || indraḥ | bruva | indraḥ | ṛṣiḥ | indraḥ | puru | puru'hūtaḥ | mahān | mahībhiḥ | śacībhiḥ || 7 ||
sa eva ᐁindraḥ ᐁṛṣiḥ draṣṭā sarvasyāryajātasya |
saḥ ᐁindraḥ ᐁpuru bahulaṃ ᐁpuruhūtaḥ bahubhirāhūtaśca ᐁmahībhiḥ mahatībhiḥ ᐁśacībhiḥ kriyābhirvṛtraghādi- rūpābhiḥ ᐁmahān prabhūto bhavati ||
sa stomyaḥ sa havyaḥ sutyaḥ satvā tuvikūrmiḥ | ekaścitsabhṛmibhūtiḥ || 8 || saḥ | stomyaḥ | saḥ | havyaḥ | sutyaḥ | satvā | tuvi'kūrmiḥ | ekaḥ | cit | san | abhi'bhūtiḥ || 8 ||
ᐁsaḥ eva ᐁhavyaḥ hātavyaśca ᐁsatyaḥ satsu sādhuravittasvabhāvo vā ᐁsatvā śatrūṇāmavasādayitā ᐁtuvikūrmiḥ bahukarmā |
yata evamataḥ kāraṇāt ᐁekaścitsan asahāyo'pi bhavan ᐁabhibhūtiḥ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitā tiraskartā bhavati ||
tamarkebhistaṃ sāmabhistaṃ gāyatrairdharṣarṇayaḥ | indraṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ || 9 || tam | arkebhiḥ | tam | sāmabhiḥ | tam | gāyatraiḥ | carṣarṇayaḥ | indram | vardhanti | kṣitayaḥ || 9 ||
ᐁcarṣarṇayaḥ draṣṭāro mantrāṇāṃ ᐁkṣitayaḥ manuṣyāḥ ᐁtaṃ indram ᐁarkebhiḥ arcanasādhanairyajurūpairmantraiḥ ᐁvardhanti vardhayanti |
tathā ᐁgāyatraiḥ gāyatryādicchandoyuktaiḥ śakvarūpairapagītairmantraiḥ ᐁtam eva ᐁindraṃ hotāro vardhayanti ||
praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartrīṃ jyotiḥ samatsu | sasahāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān || 10 || pra'netāram | vasyaḥ | acchā | kartrīm | jyotiḥ | samatsu | sasahāṃsam | yudhā | amitrān || 10 ||
ᐁvasyaḥ vasīyaḥ praśastaṃ vasu dhanam ᐁacchā ābhimukhyena ᐁpraṇetāraṃ prāpayitāraṃ ᐁsamatsu saṃgrāmeṣu śatrunirasanena ᐁjyotiḥ prakāśaṃ jayalakṣaṇaṃ ᐁkartrīṃ karaṇaśīlam |
ᐁyudhā yuddhena ᐁamitrān śatrūn ᐁsasahāṃsam abhibhūtavantam |
sa naḥ papriḥ pārayati svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ | indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ || 11 || saḥ | naḥ | papriḥ | pārayati | svasti | nāvā | puru'hūtaḥ | indraḥ | viśvāḥ | ati | dviṣaḥ || 11 ||
ᐁpapriḥ prātā pūrayitā ᐁpuruhūtaḥ bahubhirāhūtaḥ ᐁsaḥ ᐁindraḥ ᐁviśvāḥ sarvāḥ ᐁdviṣaḥ dveṣṭrīḥ prajāḥ ᐁnaḥ asmān ᐁnāvā taraṇasādhanena ᐁsvasti kṣemena ᐁati pārayati atipārayatu ||
sa tvaṃ na indra vājaibhirdaśasya ca gātuyā ca | acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi || 12 || saḥ | tvam | naḥ | indra | vājaibhiḥ | daśasya | ca | gātu'yā | ca | acchā | ca | naḥ | sumnam | neṣi || 12 ||
he indra saḥ tādṛśaḥ tvam naḥ asmabhyaṃ vājebhiḥ balaiḥ daśayasva ca dhanaṃ prayaccha ca |
tathā naḥ asmān sujñaṃ sukhaṃ ca accha neṣi abhiprāya ||
anukramyate hi—'ā yāhi pañconā pragāthāntam' iti |
anyaṃ pragāthaṃ varjayitvā śiṣṭasya mahāvrata ukto viniyogaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome prātaḥsavane brahmaśastra ādhāḥ ṣaṭ‌caḥ stotriyānurūpāthāḥ |
sūyate hi—'ā yāhi supumā hi ta iti ṣaṭ stotriyānurūpāvanantarāḥ sapta' (āśva. śrau. 5. 10) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani prātaḥsavana ādyastṛco'sminneva śastre ṣaḻahastotriyasaṃjñaka āvāpārthaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā yāhi supumā hi ta indramindrāthino bṛhat' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti ||
ā yāhi supumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam |
ā | yāhi | supuma | hi | te | indra | somam | piba | imam | ā | idam | barhiḥ | sadaḥ | mama || 1 ||
he indra tvam ā yāhi āgaccha |
te tvadarthaṃ supuma hi abhiṣutavantaḥ khalu somaṃ vayam |
tadarthaṃ mama madīyam idaṃ barhiḥ vedyāmāstīrṇam ā sadaḥ āsīda abhiniṣīda ||
ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā |
ā | tvā | brahmayujā | harī | iti | vahatām | indra | keśinā | upa | brahmāṇi | naḥ | śṛṇu || 2 ||
he indra brahmayujā brahmaṇā mantreṇa yujyamānau keśinā keśinau keśavantau harī haraṇaśīlāvaśvau tvā tvām ā vahatām abhiprayatām |
tvaṃ cāsmadyajñamupetya naḥ asmākaṃ brahmāṇi stotrāṇi śṛṇu stotrāṇi gṛhāṇa |
brahmāṇaḥ | tvā | vayam | yujā | somapāḥ | indra | sominaḥ | mutaḥ'vantaḥ | havāmahe || 3 ||
he indra brahmāṇaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ vayaṃ tvā tvāṃ yujā yogyena stotreṇa havāmahe āhvayāmahe |
ā | naḥ | yāhi | suta'vataḥ | asmākam | su'stutīḥ | upa | piba | su | śiprin | andhasaḥ || 4 ||
he indra sutavataḥ abhiṣutasomayuktānasmān ā yāhi abhigaccha |
tataḥ asmākaṃ sambandhīni suṣṭutīḥ śobhanāni stotrāṇyupagaccha jānīhi |
he suśiprin śobhanaśirastrāṇa śobhanahanuka vendra andhasaḥ annasya somalakṣaṇasya svāṃśakṣaṇaṃ mārgaṃ piba |
ā tai siñcāmi kukṣyoranu gātrā vi dhāvatu | gubhāya jihvayā madhu || 5 || ā | tai | siñcāmi | kukṣyoḥ | anu | gātrā | vi | dhāvatu | gubhāya | jihvayā | madhu || 5 ||
he indra tai tava kukṣyoḥ udarayoḥ |
tathā ca śrūyate—'obhā kukṣī pṛṇatā vātraṃghaṃ ca mādhonaṃ ca' iti |
sa cāsik somau gātrāṇi śarīravayavāni hastapādādīni sarvānyanukrameṇa vi dhāvatu vyāpnotu |
tvaṃ ca madhu madhuraṃ mayā sicyamānaṃ somaṃ jihvayā rasanendriyeṇa gubhāya gṛhaṇa |
'chandasi śāyajapi' iti graha uttarasya bhaḥ śāyajādeśaḥ |
svāduṣṭe astu saṃsude madhumāntve tarva | somaḥ śamastu te hṛde || 6 || svāduḥ | te | astu | sam'sude | madhu'mān | tanvai | tarva | somaḥ | śam | astu | te | hṛde || 6 ||
saṃsude samyak suṣṭhu dātre he indra te tubhyaṃ madhumān mādhuryavānayaṃ somaḥ svāduḥ astu ruciro bhavatu |
tava hṛde hṛdayāya ca saḥ somaḥ śamastu sukhajanakaṃ bhavatu ||
ayamu tvā vicarṣaṇe janīrivā saṃvṛtaḥ | pra soma indra sarpatu || 7 || ayam | ū~ iti | tvā | vi'carṣaṇe | janīḥ | iva | abhi | sam'vṛtaḥ | pra | somaḥ | indra | sarpatu || 7 ||
he vicarṣaṇe vidvaṣṭaḥ indra janīriva janayo jāyā iva tā yathā śuklaiḥ vastraiḥ saṃvṛtā bhavanti evaṃ saṃvṛtaḥ pathaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ śrayaṇadravyairāvṛtaḥ ayaṃ somaḥ abhi pra sarpatu abhigacchatu |
tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhurandhaso made | indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate || 8 || tuvi'grīvaḥ | vapa'udaraḥ | su'bāhuḥ | andhasaḥ | made | indraḥ | vṛtrāṇi | jighnate || 8 ||
vapodaraḥ pīvarodaraḥ yathā bahavaḥ somāḥ pītā antarbhavanti tathā vistṛtajaṭhara ityarthaḥ |
subāhuḥ śobhanabāhurevaṃ guṇakaḥ indraḥ andhasaḥ annasya somātmakasya made harṣe sati vṛtrāṇi śatrujātāni jighnate hinasti ||
indra prehi purastvaṃ viśvasyeśāna orjasā | vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahañjahi || 9 || indra | pra | ihi | puraḥ | tvam | viśvasya | īśānaḥ | orjasā | vṛtrāṇi | vṛtra'han | jahi || 9 ||
he indra ojasā balena viśvasya sarvasya jagataḥ īśānaḥ svāmī bhavan tvaṃ puraḥ asmākaṃ purastāt prehi pragaccha prāpnuhi |
he vṛtrahan vṛtrāṇāmāvarakāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hanta vṛtrāṇi asmadīyāni śatrujātāni jahi vināśaya ||
sūyate hi—'dīrghaste asvaṅkuśo bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī' (ābha. śrau. 3. 13) iti ||
1. ga-ta-bha-iti sa cāsik | 2. ga-ta-bha-'sa cāsik' nāsti | 3. bha-gātrā gātrāṇi | 4. ya-sarvānyanukrameṇa | 5. ga-prahe | 6. ga-bha-somastvāṃ | 7. ga-vapāvudaraḥ | ma. 1-40

dīrghastai astvaṅkuśo yenā vasuṃ prayacchasi | yajamānāya sunvate || 10 || dīrghaḥ | te | astu | aṅkuśaḥ | yena | vasuṃ | prayacchasi | yajamānāya | sunvate || 10 || he indra te tava aṅkuśaḥ sunirākarṣaṇasādhanamāyudhaṃ dīrghaḥ astu āyato bhavatu | yathā dūrasthamapi vastu vyāpnoti tathāyāmavān bhavatvityarthaḥ | yena aṅkuśena sunvate somābhivaṃ kurvate yajamānāya vasu dhanamāhṛtya prayacchasi dadāsi || || 23 || dvitīye paryāye hotuḥ śastre 'ayaṃ ta indra' iti stotriyastṛcaḥ | sūtritaṃ ca—'ayaṃ ta indra somo'yaṃ te mānuṣe jane' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||

ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto ardhi barhiṣi | ehīmasya dravā piba || 11 || ayam | te | indra | somaḥ | ni'pūtaḥ | ardhi | barhiṣi | ā | ihi | īm | asya | drava | piba || 11 || he indra te tubhyaṃ tvadartham a
etatsaṃjo ᵥyaḥ kraturasti ᵥasmin kuṇḍapāyye kratau ᵥmanaḥ svāmasm ᵥā ᵥni ᵥdadhe |
abhito vartamānāḥ kuṇḍapāyināmāna ṛṣayaḥ purā ni dadhire |

vāstauṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃsatraṃ somyānām | drupso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnāmindro munīnāṃ sakhā || 14 || vāstauḥ | pate | dhruvā | sthūṇā | aṃsatram | somyānām | drupsaḥ | bhettā | purām | śaśvatīnām | indraḥ | munīnām | sakhā || 14 ||
he ᵥvāstauṣpate gṛhapate ᵥsthūṇā gṛhādhārabhūtaḥ stambhaḥ ᵥdhruvā sthirā bhavatu |
ᵥsomyānāṃ somārhāṇāṃ somapādināṃ' vāsmākaṃ ᵥaṃsatram aṃsatrāṇamaṃsopalakṣitasya² kṛtsnaśarīrasya ᵥāyakaṃ rakṣakaṃ balaṃ bhavatu |
api ca ᵥdrupsaḥ dravaṇaśīlaḥ somaḥ tadvān |
ᵥśaśvatīnāṃ bahūnāṃ ᵥpurām asurapurīṇāṃ ᵥbhettā vidārayitā evaṃbhūtaḥ ᵥindraḥ ᵥmunīnāṃ ṛṣīṇā-masmākaṃ ᵥsakhā mitrabhūto bhavatu ||

pradākusānuryajato gaveṣaṇa ekaḥ sannabhi bhūyasaḥ | bhūrṇimaśvaṃ nayatujā puro gubhendraṃ somasya pītayai || 15 || pradāku'sānuḥ | yajataḥ | go'eṣaṇaḥ | ekaḥ | san | abhi | bhūyasaḥ | bhūrṇim | aśvam | nayat | tujā | puraḥ | gubhā | indram | somasya | pītayai || 15 ||

evaṃguṇako ya indraḥ ᵥekaḥ ᵥsan asahāyaḥ kevala eva san ᵥbhūyasaḥ bahutarānchatrūnabhibhavati ᵥbhūrṇiṃ bharaṇaśīlam ᵥaśvaṃ vyāpnuvantaṃ tam ᵥindraṃ ᵥsomasya ᵥpītaye pānārtha ᵥpuraḥ asmākaṃ purastāt ᵥnayat nayati prāpayati |
yathā voḍhāramaśvaṃ durgrahaṃ pāśenanayanti evamuktena prakāreṇa mahāprabhāvamindraṃ stutyā stotānayatītyarthaḥ ||
tathā cānukramyate—‘idaṃ ha dvyadhikādityamauṣṇihamatyaṣṭyabhyāṃ parābhisūryānilānām’ iti |
idaṃ ha nūnameṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ | ādityānāmpūrthyaṃ savīmani || 1 || idam | ha | nūnam | eṣām | sumnam | bhikṣeta | martyaḥ | ādityānām | apūrvyam | savīmani || 1 ||

ᵥidaṃ ᵥha idānīṃ khalu ᵥnūnam avaśyam ᵥādityānām aditaḥ putrāṇām ᵥeṣāṃ devānāṃ mitrādīnāṃ ᵥsavīmani prasave preraṇe sati ᵥmartyaḥ manuṣyaḥ stotā ᵥapūrvyam abhinavaṃ ᵥsumnaṃ sukhakaraṃ dhanaṃ ᵥbhikṣeta yāceta |

anarvāṇo hyeṣāṃ panthā ādityanām | adabdhāḥ santi pāyavaḥ sugevṛdhaḥ ||2|| anarvāṇaḥ | hi | eṣām | panthāḥ | ādityanām | adabdhāḥ | santi | pāyavaḥ | suge'vṛdhaḥ ||2|| ^eṣām ^ādityānāṃ ^panthāḥ panthāno mārgāḥ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti jasaḥ suḥ | ^anarvāṇaḥ apratyutāḥ parairapratigatāḥ ata eva ^adabdhāḥ ahiṃsitāśca ^santi bhavanti | ^hi yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ^pāyavaḥ pālayitāraste mārgāḥ ^sugevṛdhaḥ sugame sukhe viṣaye vardhakā bhavantu ||

tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā | śarma yacchantu sapratho yadīmahe ||3|| tat | su | naḥ | savitā | bhagaḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | śarma | yacchantu | sa'prathaḥ | yat | īmahe || 3 || savitrādyaścatvāro devāḥ ^saprathaḥ sarvataḥ pṛthu vistīrṇaṃ ^tat ^śarma sukhaṃ gṛhaṃ vā ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^su suṣṭhu ^yacchantu dadatu | ^yat śarma ^īmahe vayaṃ yācāmahe ||

devebhirdevyadite'riṣṭabharman gahi | smatsūrībhiḥ purupriye suśarmabhiḥ || 4 || devebhiḥ | devi | adite | ariṣṭa'bharman | ā | gahi | smat | sūrībhiḥ | puru'priye | suśarmabhiḥ || 4 || he ^devi dānādiguṇayukte he ^ariṣṭabharman ahiṃsitabharaṇe he ^purupriye bahubhiḥ priyamāṇe he evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭe ^adite ^sūrībhiḥ prājñaiḥ ^suśarmabhiḥ susukhaiḥ ^devebhiḥ devairātmīyaiḥ putraiḥ sārdham | smaditi nipāta: śobhanārthaḥ | ^smat śobhanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ^ā ^gahi āgaccha ||

te hi putrāso adittervidudveṣāṃsi yotave | aṃhościdrurucakrayo'nehasaḥ || 5 || te | hi | putrāsaḥ | aditeḥ | viduḥ | dveṣāṃsi | yotave | aṃhaḥ | cit | uru'cakrayaḥ | anehasaḥ || 5 || ^aditeḥ ^putrāsaḥ putrāḥ ^te ^hi te khalu mitrādyo devāḥ ^dveṣāṃsi dveṣṭṛṇi rākṣasādīni ^yotave pṛthakkartuṃ ^viduḥ jānanti | ‘vido laṭo vā’ iti vida uttarasya jherasādeśaḥ | tathā ^uru- cakrayaḥ vistīrṇasya karmaṇaḥ kartāraḥ ^anehasaḥ anāhantāro rakṣakāste ^aṃhościt āhananaśīlāt pāpādapi yotave pṛthakkartuṃsmān jānanti || || 25 ||

aditino divā paśumaditirnaktamadvayāḥ | aditiḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā ||6|| aditiḥ | naḥ | divā | paśum | aditiḥ | naktam | advayāḥ | aditiḥ | pātu | aṃhasaḥ | sadā'vṛdhā || 6 || ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^paśum ^aditiḥ adīnā akhaṇḍanīyā vā devamātā ^divā ahani ^pātu rakṣatu | tathā ^advayāḥ bāhyābhyantarabhedena prakāradvayarahitā sarvadaikamakārā kapaṭarahitā sā ^aditiḥ ^naktaṃ rātrau cāsmadīyaṃ gavādipaśujātaṃ rakṣatu | tathāsmānapi ^aṃhasaḥ pāpāt pātu rakṣatu | kena sādhanena | ^sadāvṛdhā sarvadā vṛddhimatātmīyena rakṣaṇena ||
uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyā gamata | sā śaṃtāti mayaskaradapa sridhaḥ ||7|| uta | syā | naḥ | divā | matiḥ | aditiḥ | ūtyā | ā | gamata | sā | śaṃ'tati | mayaḥ | karata | apa | sridhaḥ | || 7 ||
^uta api ca ^syā sā pūrvoktā ^matiḥ mantrī mantavyā stotavyā vā ^aditiḥ ^ūtyā rakṣayā sārdha ^divā ahani ^naḥ asmān ^ā ^gamata āgacchatu |
āgatya ca ^śaṃtāti śāntikaraṃ ^mayaḥ sukhaṃ ^sā aditiḥ ^karat karotu |
uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā śaṃ naḥ karato aśvinā | yuyuyātāmito rapo apa sridhaḥ ||8|| uta | tyā | daivyā | bhiṣajā | śam | naḥ | karataḥ | aśvinā | yuyuyātām | itaḥ | rapaḥ | apa | sridhaḥ | || 8 ||
^uta api ca ^tyā tau prasiddhau ^daivyā deveṣu bhavau ^bhiṣajā cikitsakau īdṛśau ^aśvinā aśvinau ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^śaṃ sukhaṃ rogāṇāṃ śamanaṃ vā ^karataḥ kurutām |

śamabhiragnibhiḥ karaccha nastapatu sūryaḥ | śaṃ vāto vātvarapā apa sridhaḥ ||9|| śam | agnibhiḥ | agni'bhiḥ | karata | śam | naḥ | tapatu | sūryaḥ | śam | vātaḥ | vātu | arapāḥ | apa | sridhaḥ | || 9 ||
^agnibhiḥ svavibhūtyā vibhijñairhyatyādibhiḥ ^agniḥ devaḥ ^śaṃ ^karat asmākaṃ rogaśānti sukhaṃ vā karotu |
^sūryaḥ sarvasya preraka ādityaśca ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^śaṃ sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ^tapatu pradīppatām |
^vātaḥ vāyuśca ^arapāḥ apāpaḥ san ^śaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ca ^vātu anuvartatām |
apāmīvāmapa sridhamapa sedhata durmatim | ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ ||10|| apa | amīvām | apa | sridham | apa | sedhata | duḥ'matim | ādityāḥ | yuyotana | naḥ | aṃhasaḥ | || 10 ||
api ca he ^ādityāḥ ādityāḥ ^naḥ asmān ^aṃhasaḥ pāpāt ^yuyotana pṛthakkurūta |
‘āmantritaṃ pūrvaṃ- mavidyamānavat’ iti pūrvasyāmantritasyāvidyamānatvena padādaparatvātsyāghāto na bhavati ||
yuyota | śarum | asmata | ā | ādityāsaḥ | uta | amartim | ṛdhak | dveṣaḥ | kṛṇut | viśva'vedasaḥ || 11 ||
he ādityāḥ ᵥśaruṃ hiṃsakam ᵥasmadā asmattaśca ᵥyuyota pṛthakuruta |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥamarti durbuddhiṃ ca pṛthakuruta |
he ᵥviśvavedasaḥ sarvadhanāḥ sarvajñā vā ᵥdveṣaḥ dveṣacchatrūn ᵥṛdhak pṛthak ᵥkṛṇut kuruta |
tatsu naḥ śarma yacchatādityā yanmumocati | enasvantaṃ cidenasaḥ sudānavaḥ ||12|| tat | su | naḥ | śarma | yacchata | ādityāḥ | yat | mumocati | enasvantam | cit | enasaḥ | ᵥsudānavaḥ || 12 ||
he ᵥādityāḥ ᵥtat ᵥśarma sukhaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥsu suṣṭhu ᵥyacchata datta |
he ᵥsudānavaḥ śobhanadānāḥ yuṣmadīyaṃ ᵥyat śarma ᵥenasvantaṃ ᵥcit pāpinamapi stotāram ᵥenasaḥ pāpāt ᵥmumo- cati mocayati tadyacchatetyanvayaḥ ||

yo naḥ kaścidririkṣati rakṣatvenaṃ martyaḥ | svaiḥ ṣa evaiṃ ririṣīṣṭa yurjanaiḥ ||13|| yaḥ | naḥ | kaḥ | cit | ririkṣati | rakṣaḥ'tvenaṃ | martyaḥ | svaiḥ | saḥ | evaiḥ | | ririṣīṣṭa | yuḥ | janaiḥ || 13 ||
ᵥyaḥ ᵥkaścit ᵥmartyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥrakṣatvena rakṣobhāvena piśācādyātmanā ᵥriri- kṣati jihiṃsipati |
ᵥsaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥsvaiḥ ᵥevaiḥ ātmīyaireva ceṣṭitaiḥ ᵥririṣīṣṭa hiṃsito bhūyāt |
sa janaḥ svaireva gamanairyuḥsaṃ gacchan hiṃsito bhavatu ||

samittamaghamaśvadhuḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ ripum | yo asmatrā durhaṇāvā~ urpa drayuḥ ||14|| sam | ita | tam | agham | aśvavat | duḥ'śaṃsam | martyam | ripum | yaḥ | ᵥasmatrā | duḥ'harṇāvān | urpa | drayuḥ || 14 ||
ᵥduḥśaṃsaṃ dukkīrtiṃ ᵥripuṃ śatruṃ ᵥtaṃ ᵥmartyaṃ ᵥit manuṣyameva ᵥaghaṃ pāpaṃ ᵥsam ᵥabhavat samyagbyāmotu |
ᵥyaḥ martyaḥ ᵥasmatrā asmāsu asmadviṣaye ᵥdurhaṇāvān duṣṭahananavān upajāyate ᵥdrayuḥ dvābhyāṃ prakārābhyāṃ yuktaśca bhavati |
yaścāsmadviṣaye kapaṭo bhavati tamapi pāpaṃ byāpnotviti² ||
pākutrā sthana devā hutsu jānītha martyam | urpa drayuṃ cādrayuṃ ca vasavaḥ ||15|| pāku'trā | sthana | devāḥ | | hṛta'su | jānītha | martyam | urpa | drayum | ca | adrayum | ca | vasavaḥ || 15 ||
2. ga-pratyakṣakṛto hitaṃ vadati parokṣe ahitaṃ vadati taṃ ripumiti pūrvatrānvayaḥ |
he devā: dānādiguṇayuktā ādityā yūyaṃ pāktrā pākeṣu vipaktreṣu stotṛṣu sthana bhavata |
yata evamata: kāraṇāt hyasu ātmīyeṣu hṛdayeṣu hyasu dviprakārakaṃ kapaṭinaṃ ca advayuṃ ca tadvilakṣaṇaṃ kāpavyarahitaṃ ca martya manuṣyamupetya vasava: vāsakā: jānītha avagacchatha ||
ā | śarma | parvatānām | ā | uta | apām | vṛṇīmahe | dyāvākṣāmā | āre | asmat | rapa: | kṛtam || 16 ||
parvatānāṃ meghānāṃ girīṇāṃ vā saṃbandhaṃ śarma sukhaṃ vayam ā vṛṇīmahe ābhimukhyena saṃbhajāmahe |
uta api ca apām udakānāṃ ca |
he dyāvākṣāmā dyāvāpṛthivyau asmat āre asmatto viprakṛṣṭe deśe rapa: pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ kurutam |
te nau bhadreṇa śarmaṇā yuṣmākaṃ nāvā vasava: |
te | na: | bhadreṇa | śarmaṇā | yuṣmākam | nāvā | vasava: | ati | viśvāni | du:itā | pipartana || 17 ||
he vasava: vāsayitāra: ādityā: te pūrvoktaguṇā yūyaṃ bhadreṇa śobhanena śarmaṇā sukhena yuṣmākaṃ nāvā na: asmān viśvāni sarvāṇi duritā durgamanāni ati pipartana pipata atipārayata ||
tuce tanāya tatsu no drāghīya āyurjīvaseṃ |
tuce | tanāya | tat | su | na: | drāghīya: | āyu: | jīvaseṃ | ādityāsa: | su'mahasa: | kṛṇotana || 18 ||

he ādityāsa: adita: putrā: sumahasa: śobhanatejaskā: na: asmākaṃ tuce putrāya tanāya tattanāya pautrāya ca jīvase jīvanāya drāghīya: dīrghatamaṃ tat prasiddham āyu: jīvitaṃ su suṣṭhu kṛṇotana kuruta ||
yajño hīḻo vo antara ādityā asti mṛḻata |
yajña: | hīḻa: | va: | antara: | ādityā: | asti | mṛḻata | yuṣme iti | it | va: | api | ṣmasi | su'jātyai || 19 ||
gantavya: prāptavyo'smābhiranuṣṭhita: yajña: va: yuṣmā- kam antara: asti antike vartamāno bhavati |
va: yuṣmākaṃ sajātyai sajātatve jñātitve bāndhave vartamānā vayaṃ yuṣme it yuṣmāsveva api ṣmasi sarvadā bhavāmo'pi |
bṛhat | varūtham | marutām | devam | trātāram | aśvina | mitram | īmahe | varuṇam | svastaye || 20 ||
^marutāṃ devānāṃ svāmināṃ ^trātāraṃ pālayitāraṃ ^devam indram ^aśvinā aśvinau ca ^mitraṃ ^varuṇaṃ ca ^bṛhat prauḍhaṃ ^varūthaṃ śītatāpādinivārakaṃ gṛhaṃ ^svastaye avināśāya ^īmahe yācāmahe ||
anehaḥ | mitra | aryaman | nṛ'vat | varuṇa | śaṃsyam | tri'varūtham | marutaḥ | yanta | naḥ | chardiḥ || 21 ||

he ^mitra he ^aryaman he ^varuṇa he ^marutaḥ te sarve yūyam ^anehaḥ ahiṃsitaṃ ^nṛvat nṛbhiḥ putrādibhirupetaṃ ^śaṃsyaṃ stutyaṃ ^trivarūthaṃ trayāṇāṃ śītatāpavarṣāṇāṃ nivārakaṃ yadvā tribhūmikaṃ ^chardiḥ gṛhaṃ ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^yanta yacchata dattetyarthaḥ ||
ye ciddhi mṛtyurbandhav ādityā marnavaḥ smarsi |
ye | cit | hi | mṛtyu'bandhavaḥ | ādityāḥ | marnavaḥ | smarsi | pra | su | naḥ | āyuḥ | jīvasai | tiretana || 22 ||

he ^ādityāḥ ^ye ^cit ye ca vayaṃ ^manavaḥ manuṣyāḥ ^hi yasmāt ^mṛtyubandhavaḥ ^smasi mṛtyoryamasya bandhubhūtāḥ pratyāsannamaraṇāma bhavāmaḥ ato hetīsteṣāṃ ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^jīvase jīvanaya cirakālāyavasthānāya ^āyuḥ jīvitaṃ ^su ^pra ^tiretana śobhanaṃ pravardhayata ||
‘ taṃ gṛdhaṃya ’ iti saptatriṃśacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya sobharerārṣam |
‘ piturna putraḥ ’ eṣā saptaviṃśī dvipadā vijñātakṣarā virāṭ |
ṣaṭtriṃśī saptatriṃśī ca trasadasyunāmno rājño dāmastṛtirūpatvāttadevatāke |
tathā cānu- krāntaṃ—‘ taṃ gṛdhaṃya saptatriṃśat sobharerāgneyaṃ kākubhaṃ prāgātha ha piturna dvipadānye kakupyaktau trasa- dasyordānastutistatpūrve uṣṇiksatobṛhatvāvādityetyeyaḥ ’ iti |
taṃ gṛdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire |
tam | gṛdhaya | svaḥ'naram | devāsaḥ | devam | aratim | dadhanvire | deva'trā | havyam | ā | ūhire || 1 ||
^svarṇaraṃ sarvasya netāraṃ sarvayajamānaiḥ karmādau nītaṃ vā |
asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarāya pūrvyam ||
vibhūta'rātim | vipra | citra'śauciṣam | agnim | īḻiṣva | yanturam | asya | medhasya | somyasya | sobhare | pra | īm | adhvarāya | pūrvyam || 2 ||
he ᵥvipra medhāvin ᵥsobhare etatsaṃjña ṛṣe ᵥadhvarāya yāgāya ᵥīm imam ᵥagniṃ ᵥpra ᵥīḻiṣva prastuhi |
ᵥvibhūtarātiṃ vyāptadhanaṃ prabhūtadānaṃ vā ᵥcitraśauciṣaṃ cāyanīyatejaskaṃ vicitradīsikaṃ vā ᵥsomyasya somasādhyasya ᵥasya ᵥmedhasya yajñasya ᵥyanturaṃ niyantāraṃ ᵥpūrvyaṃ ciraṃtanam ||
ābhiplāvikeṣvāgneyeṣu tṛtīyasavane praśāstuḥ śāstre 'yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā' ityādikau pragāthau vaikalpiko stotriyānurūpau |
sūtritaṃ ca—'yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavamahe yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī' (ādha. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||
yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavamahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam |
yajiṣṭham | tvā | vavamahe | devam | deva'trā | hotāram | amartyam | asya | yajñasya | su'kratum || 3 ||
he agne ᵥyajiṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭatamaṃ ᵥtvā ᵥvavamahe vṛṇīmahe saṃbhajāmahe |
ᵥdevatrā deveṣu madhye ᵥdevam atiśayena dānādiguṇayuktaṃ ᵥhotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāram ᵥamartyam avināśam ᵥasya ᵥyajñasya yāgasya ᵥsukratuṃ suṣṭhu kartāram ||
sa nau mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi ||
ūrjaḥ | napātam | su'bhagam | su'dīditim | agnim | śreṣṭha'śociṣam | saḥ | naḥ | mitrasya | varuṇasya | saḥ | apām | ā | sumnam | yakṣate | divi || 4 ||
havilakṣaṇenānnenāpo jāyante agniśśauciṣavanaspatebhya eṣa jāta iti caturthyam |
ᵥsubhagaṃ śobhanadhanaṃ ᵥsudīditiṃ suṣṭhu dīpayitāraṃ ᵥśreṣṭhaśociṣaṃ praśastamatejaskam ᵥagniṃ staumīti śeṣaḥ |
ᵥsaḥ tādṛśo'gniḥ ᵥnaḥ asmadarthaṃ ᵥdivi dyotamāne devajane dhuloke vā ᵥmitrasya devasya ᵥvaruṇasya ca ᵥsumnaṃ sukham ᵥā abhilakṣya ᵥyakṣate yajatu |
tathā ᵥsaḥ agniḥ ᵥapām adevatānāṃ sumnamabhiyajatu ||
yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī yo vedena dadāśa matau agnaye |
yaḥ | sam'idhā | yaḥ | ā'hutī | yaḥ | vedena | dadāśa | matau | agnaye | yaḥ | namasā | su'adhvaraḥ || 5 ||
1. ga-na-ma-tvāṃ; gha-tvā tvā | 2. gha-na-ma-avināśinaṃ | 3. bha-jāyata | 4. ga-gha-na-ma-dīpayaṃta |
iyaṃ pākyajñapraśaṃsāpareti bhagavatāśvalāyanena brāhmaṇāntarapradarśanena vyākhyātā (āśva. gṛ. 1. 1.4-5) |
yaḥ mataḥ manuṣyaḥ samidhā pālāśādinedhmena apraye adhyarthaṃ dadāśa paricarati |
yaḥ ca āhutī āhutyā ājyādisādhyayā paricarati |
yaḥ ca vedena vedādhyayanena brahmayajñena paricarati |
yaḥ ca svadhvaraḥ śobhanenādhvareṇa jyotiṣṭomādinā yuktaḥ san namasā agnena carupuroḍāśādinābhaye dadāśa agnyartha paricarati |

tasyedvanto raṃhayanta āśvastasya ghubhritaṃ yaśaḥ | na tamaṃho devakṛtaṃ kutaścana na martyakṛtaṃ naśat || 6 || tasya | it | arventaḥ | raṃhayante | āśvaḥ | tasya | ghubhrita'tamam | yaśaḥ | na | tam | ahaḥ | deva'kṛtam | kutaḥ | cana | na | martya'kṛtam | naśat || 6 || yaḥ pūrvoktaḥ tasyeta tasyaiva āśvaḥ vyāpanaśīlāḥ arventaḥ aśvāḥ raṃhayante vegaṃ kurvanti | śatrūn prasahanta ityarthaḥ | ghubhritamaṃ dīptimattamaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiśca tasya eva bhavati | yadvā | ghubhrimiti dhananāma | dhanavattamaṃ yaśo'nnaṃ ca tasya bhavati | api ca devakṛtam devaiḥ kṛtam ahaḥ pāpaṃ kutaścana kasmādapi hetoḥ taṃ na naśat na prāpnoti | na martyakṛtaṃ manuṣyaiḥ kṛtam ||

svamaryo vo agnibhiḥ syārma sūno sahasa urjāṃ pate | suvīrastvamasmayuḥ || 7 || su'agnayaḥ | vaḥ | agni'bhiḥ | syārma | sūno iti | sahasaḥ | ūrjām | pate | su'vīraḥ | tvam | asma'yuḥ || 7 || he sahasaḥ sūno balasya putra | agnibhiḥ balena madhyamāno jāyate | he ūrjāṃ pate annānāṃ havirlakṣaṇānāṃ svāminnagne vaḥ | vacanavyatyayaḥ | tavāvayavabhūtaiḥ agnibhiḥ gārhapatyādibhirvayaṃ svaprayaḥ śobhanāprikāḥ | syāma bhavema | suvīraḥ śobhanairvīrairupetaḥ tvaṃ ca asmayuḥ asmān kāmayamāno bhava ||

praśaṃsamāno atithirna mitriyo'bhī ratho na vedyaḥ | tve kṣemāso api santi sādhavastvaṃ rājā rayīṇām || 8 || pra'śaṃsamānaḥ | atithiḥ | na | mitriyaḥ | agniḥ | rathaḥ | na | vedyaḥ | tve iti | kṣemāsaḥ | api | santi | sādhavaḥ | tvam | rājā | rayīṇām || 8 || praśaṃsamānaḥ stuvan atithirna atithiriva | yadvā | vyatyayena karmaṇi kartṛpratyayaḥ | praśasya- mānaḥ saḥ agniḥ mitriyaḥ mitrāṇāṃ stotṝṇāṃ hito bhavati | tathā ratho na ratha iva vedyaḥ labhanīyo'bhīṣṭaphalasādhanatvena jñātavyo vā | uttaro'rdharcaḥ pratyakṣakṛtaḥ | he agne tve tvayi sādhavaḥ sādhakāḥ samīcīnāḥ kṣemāsaḥ dhāraṇāni api santi bhavanti | tathā rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ tvam eva rājā īśvaro bhavasi |

so addhā dāśvadhvare agne marttaḥ subhaga sa praśasyaḥ | sa dhībhirastu sanitā || 9 || saḥ | addhā | dāśu'adhvaraḥ | agne | marttaḥ | su'bhaga | saḥ | praśasyaḥ | saḥ | dhībhiḥ | astu | sanitā || 9 ||
he ˅subhaga śobhanadhana agne ˅sa: eva ˅praśastya: praśaṃsanīya: ślāghanīyaśca bhavatu |
yasya tvamūrdhvo ˅adhvarāya tiṣṭhasi kṣayadvīra: sa sādhate |
yasya | tvam | ˅ūrdhva: | ˅adhvarāya | tiṣṭhasi | kṣayat'vīra: | sa: | sādhate | sa: | ˅arvat'bhi: | ˅sanitā | sa: | ˅vipanyu'bhi: | sa: | ˅śūrai: | ˅sanitā | kṛtam ||10||

he agne ˅yasya yajamānasya ˅adhvarāya yāganiṣpādanāya ˅tvam ˅ūrdhva: udyukta: san ˅tiṣṭhasi avatiṣṭhase ˅sa: yajamāna: ˅kṣayadvīra: nivasanbhirivairairvā vīrai: putrādibhirupeta: san ˅sādhate sarvaṃ- kartavyaṃ sādhayati |
˅sa: tādṛśo jana: ˅arvadbhi: aśvai: ˅kṛtaṃ niṣpāditaṃ jayādikaṃ ˅sanitā saṃbhajanaśīlo bhavati |
yasya | ˅agni: | ˅vapu: | gṛhe | stomam | cana: | dadhīta | ˅viśva'ārya: | ˅havyā | vā | veviṣt | viṣa: ||11||
rūpavān dīpti- mān ˅agni: ˅stomaṃ stotraṃ ˅cana: annaṃ ca havilakṣaṇaṃ ˅dadhīta dhārayet |
havyāni havīṃṣi ca ˅viṣa: vyāsān devān ˅veviṣt prāpayet |
viprasya vā stuvata: sahaso yaho makṣūtamatasya rātiṣu |
viprasya | vā | stuvata: | sahasa: | yaho iti | makṣūt'tamasya | rātiṣu | ˅ava: ˅daivam | ˅upari ˅'matyam | kṛdhi | vaso iti | vividuṣa: | varca: ||12||

he ˅sahaso ˅yaho balasya putrāgne ˅viprasya medhāvina: ˅stuvata: stotu: ˅vā ˅rātiṣu havi- rdāneṣu ˅makṣūtamatasya śīghratamasya yadvā ˅vividuṣa: jñātavato'bhijñasya ˅vaca: vacanaṃ he ˅vaso vāsakāgne ˅avodevaṃ devānamavastāt ˅uparimatyaṃ martyānāmupariṣṭācca ˅kṛdhi kuru |
7. kha- ta-na-bha-śa-vipanyubhi: stotṛbhi: kṛtaṃ ca sa (‘sa’ nāsti-kha-ta-śa ) sanitā bhavati |
śūrai: śauryopetai: mṛtyai: kṛtaṃ ca sa sanitā bhavati (bhavatu-śa) |
yaḥ | agnim | havyadātibhiḥ | narmaḥbhiḥ | vā | sudakṣam | ā'vivāsati | girā | vā | ajira'śauciṣam || 13 ||

payaḥ yajamānaḥ 'havyadātibhiḥ haviṣāṃ dānaiḥ 'namobhiḥ namaskāraiḥ 'vā 'sudakṣaṃ śobhanabalam 'agnim 'āvivāsati paricarati 'girā 'vā stutyā vā 'ajiraśociṣaṃ kṣipragāmitejaskaṃ tamagniṃ paricarati sa samṛddho bhavatīti śeṣaḥ ||
samidhā yo niśitī dāśvadaditi dharmabhirasya martyaiḥ |
viśvetta dhībhiḥ subhago janā~ ati yuṣmairudraiva tāriṣat ||

su'idhā | yaḥ | ni'śitī | dāśat | aditima | dharma'bhiḥ | asya | martyaiḥ | viśvā | it | saḥ | dhībhiḥ | su'bhagaḥ | janān | ati | yuṣmaiḥ | udraḥ'iva | tāriṣat ||14|| payaḥ 'martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ 'asya agneḥ 'dhāmabhiḥ śarīraiḥ gārhapa
te | gha | ita | agne | su'ādhyaḥ | ye | tvā | vipra | ni'dadhire | nṛ'cakṣasam | viprāsaḥ | deva | su'kratum || 17 ||
he 'agne 'te 'ghet ta eva khalu 'svādhyaḥ śobhanādhyānā bhavanti |

he 'vipra medhāvin 'deva dyotamānāgne 'ye 'viprāsaḥ viprā medhāvina ṛtvijaḥ 'nṛcakṣasaṃ nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭāraṃ 'sukṛtaṃ sukarmāṇaṃ śobhanaprajñaṃ vā 'tvā tvāṃ 'nidadhire nidadhati yāgārtha gārhapatyādisthāneṣvādhānasaṃskāreṇa sthāpa- yanti te 'ghetyanvayaḥ ||
ta idedi~ subhaga ta āhutiṃ te sotuṃ cakrire divi |
ta iḍājaibhirjiyurmahaddhanaṃ ye tve kāmaṃ nyerire ||
te | ita | vedam | su'bhaga | te | ā'hutim | te | sotum | cakrire | divi | te | ita | vājaibhiḥ | jiyuḥ | mahat | dhanam | ye |
he agne ᵥvṛtratarye saṃgrāme ᵥbhadraṃ śobhanaṃ ᵥmanaḥ ᵥkṛṇuṣva asmākaṃ kuru |
ᵥyena manasā tvaṃ ᵥsamatsu saṃgrāmeṣu ᵥsāsaḥ bhṛśaṃ śatrūnabhibhavasi |
api ca ᵥśardhatām abhibhavatāṃ śatrūṇāṃ ᵥbhūri bhūrīṇi sthirāṇi' haṭhānyapi ᵥava ᵥtanuhi avāñci kuru |
vayaṃ ca ᵥabhiṣṭibhiḥ abhyeṇ‌sādhanairhavirbhiḥ stotraiśca ᵥte tvāṃ ᵥvanema saṃbhajemahi |
te tava prasā- dāt abhiṣṭibhiḥ abhīṣṭaiḥ phalairvanema saṃgacchemahi ||
īḻai girā manurhitaṃ yaṃ devā dūtameratiṃ naiyare | yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhanam || 21 || īḻai | girā | manuḥ'hitam | yam | devāḥ | dūtam | aratim | ni'erira | yajiṣṭham | havya'vāhanam || 21 ||
ᵥgirā vācā stutirūpayā ᵥmanuhitaṃ manunā prajāpatinā yajamānenāhitaṃ tamabhim ᵥīḻe staumi |
ᵥyajiṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭatamaṃ ᵥhavyavāhanaṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhāraṃ ᵥaratim aryamīśvaraṃ vā ᵥdūtaṃ devānāṃ dūtye vartamānam |
ᵥyam agniṃ ᵥdevāḥ ᵥneyare nitarāṃ prerayanti ||

tigmajambhāya taruṇāya rājate prayo gāyasyagnaye | yaḥ piśatai sūnṛtābhiḥ suvīryamamṛdhatebhirāhutaḥ || 22 || tigma'jambhāya | taruṇāya | rājate | prayaḥ | gāyasi | agnaye | yaḥ | piśatai | sūnṛtābhiḥ | su'vīryam | agniḥ | ghṛtebhiḥ | ā'hutaḥ || 22 ||
ᵥtigmajambhāya tīkṣṇajvālāya ᵥtaruṇāya nityayune ᵥjarāmaraṇarahitāya ᵥrājate rājamānāya ᵥagnaye ᵥprayaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ᵥgāyasi he stotaḥ |
ᵥyaḥ ᵥagniḥ ᵥsūnṛtābhiḥ priyasatyātmikābhirvāgbhiḥ stutaḥ ᵥghṛtebhiḥ ghṛterājyaiḥ ᵥāhutaḥ abhihutaśca san ᵥsuvīryaṃ śobhana- vīryaṃ ᵥpiśate ākṣipayati stotṛbhiḥ saṃyojayati |
ābhipluvikepukdhyeṣu praśāstṛḥ śastre yadā 'bhro naḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 19. 19) iti pragāthaḥ stotriyaḥ tadānīṃ 'yadī ghṛtebhiḥ' iti pragātho'nurūpaḥ |
yadī ghṛtebhirāhuto vāśīmagnibharata ut ca | asuraiva nirṇijam || 23 || yadi | ghṛtebhiḥ | ā'hutaḥ | vāśīm | agniḥ | bharate | ut | ca | arve | ca | asuraḥ'iva | niḥ'nirṇijam || 23 ||
ᵥghṛtebhiḥ ghṛtaiḥ ᵥāhutaḥ abhihuto'yam ᵥagniḥ ᵥyadi yadā yasminkāle ᵥvāśīm |
vācaṃ śabdam ᵥucca ūrdhvaṃ ca ᵥava ᵥca avāñca ᵥbharate saṃpādayati |
vāśīṃ vāśanaśīlāṃ śabdakāriṇīṃ jvālāmuddarati udgamayatyūrdhvamukham ava ca bharate avāṅmukhaṃ ca harati upasaṃharati |
ᵥasuraiva raśmīnāṃ kṣeptā sūryo yathā ᵥnirṇijam ātmīyaṃ rūpamuparitaneṣu lokeṣu prakāśatayodgamayati adhastaneṣu cāvāṅmukhaṃ gamayati tadvaduccanīcabhāvanayāgnisteja udgamayati |

yo havyānairayat manurhito deva āsā sugandhinā | vivāsate vāryāṇi svadhvaro hotā devo amartyaḥ || 24 || yaḥ | havyāni | airayat | manuḥ'hitaḥ | devaḥ | āsā | su'gandhinā | vivāsate | vāryāṇi | su'adhvaraḥ | hotā | devaḥ | amartyaḥ || 24 || yaḥ | manurhitaḥ manunā prajāpatināhitaḥ | devaḥ dyotamāno'gniḥ | sugandhinā śobhanagandha- yukena | āsā āsyena | havyāni asmadīyāni havīṃṣi | airayat devānprati prerayati | svadhvaraḥ śobhana- yajñaḥ | hotā devānāmāhvātā | devaḥ dīpyamānaḥ | amartyaḥ maraṇarahitaḥ so'gniḥ | vāryāṇi varaṇīyāni dhanāni | vivāsate paricarate | yajamānāya prayacchatīti śeṣaḥ ||

yadagre martyastvaṃ syāmahaṃ mitramaho amartyaḥ | sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta || 25 || yat | agre | martyaḥ | tvam | syām | aham | mitra'mahaḥ | amartyaḥ | sahasaḥ | sūno iti | ā'huta || 25 || he sahasaḥ | sūno balasya putra | āhuta ghṛtairabhihuta he mitramahaḥ anukūladīsiman | agne martyaḥ maraṇadharmā | ahaṃ yat yadi | tvaṃ syāṃ tvadupāsanayā tvadrūpamāpanno bhaveyam | 'ye' yathā- yathopāsate te² tadeva bhavanti' iti śruteḥ | tadyaham amartyaḥ³ deva eva bhaveyamiti || 33 ||

na tvā rāsīyābhiśastaye vaso na pāputvārya santya | na mai stotāmatīvā na duhitaḥ syādagre na pāparyā || 26 || na | tvā | rāsīya | abhi'śastaye | vaso iti | na | pāpa'tvārya | santya | na | me | stotā | amati'vā | na | duḥ'hitaḥ | syāt | agne | na | pāparyā || 26 || he vaso vāsakāgne | tvā tvām | abhiśastaye abhiśaṃsanāya mithyāpavādāya hiṃsāyai vā | na rāsīya nākrośayeyam | 'rās śabde' | he santya saṃbhajanīyāgne | pāpatvāya tvāṃ na rāsīya | me madīyaḥ stotā cānabhimatvavacanena tvāṃ na ākrośayatu | ata eva amatīvā | amatiraśobhanā buddhiḥ | tadvān api ca | duhitaḥ śatruhe | agne asmākaṃ na syāt na bhavatu | ata eva pāpayā⁴ aśobhanayā buddhyā saḥ na bādhatām ||

piturna putraḥ subhṛto duroṇa ā devā~ etu pra ṇo haviḥ || 27 || pituḥ | na | putraḥ | su'bhṛtaḥ | duroṇe | ā | devān | etu | pra | naḥ | haviḥ || 27 || piturna putraḥ pituḥ putra ivāsmākaṃ subhṛtaḥ suṣṭhu bhartā | yadvā | pitrā putra ivāsmābhiḥ samyagbhṛto havirbhiḥ poṣitaḥ | ayamagniḥ putra ivāsmākaṃ subhṛtaḥ | duroṇe yajñagṛhe devān ā abhilakṣya naḥ asmākaṃ haviḥ pra etu pra gamayatu | yadvā abhiraitu āgacchatu | asmadīyaṃ haviśca devān prāpnotu ||
1. ma-yaṃ | 2. ta-bha-'te' nāsti | 3. jha-ta1-2-maraṇadharmarahito | 4. kha-gha-ta-na-śa-ata eva pāpayā; bha-kīdṛśaḥ stotā |

tavāharmaya ūtibhirnediṣṭhābhiḥ saceya joṣamā vamo | sadā devasya martyaḥ ||28|| tava | aham | agne | ūtibhiḥ | nediṣṭhābhiḥ | saceya | joṣam | ā | vaso iti | sadā | devasya | martyaḥ || 28 || he vaso vāsaka agne nediṣṭhābhiḥ antikatamābhiḥ ṛjugāminībhirvā devasya tava ūtibhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ahaṃ stotā sadā sarvadā joṣam ā saceya prītamabhiseveya || tava kratvā saneyaṃ tava rātibhiragne tava praśastibhiḥ | tvāmidāhuḥ pramatiṃ vaso mamāgne harṣasva dātave || 29 || tava | kratvā | saneyam | tava | rātibhiḥ | agne | tava | praśastibhiḥ | tvām | it | āhuḥ | pramatim | vaso iti | mama | agne | harṣasva | dātave || 29 || he agne tava kratvā tvadīyena paricaraṇarūpeṇa karmaṇā saneyaṃ tvāṃ saṃbhajeyam | etadeva viśa- dayati | tava rātibhiḥ tvadīya

ᵛindhānaḥ saṃdīpayan evaṃbhūtaḥ ᵛtava somaḥ ᵛā ᵛdade tumyaṃ homāyādhvaryuṇādīyate | api ca ᵛtvaṃ ᵛmahīnāṃ mahatīnām ᵛupasāṃ ᵛpriyaḥ mitrabhūtaḥ ᵛasi | upasi hyabhayo homāya prajvātsyante | tathā ᵛkṣapaḥ kṣapāyā rātreḥ saṃbandheṣu ᵛvastuṣu ᵛrājasi prakāśase | yadvā | rātrisaṃbandheni vastūni padārtha- jātāni tvaṃ prakāśayasi || tamāganm sobharayaḥ sahasramuṣkaṃ svabhiṣṭimarvase | samrājaṃ trāsadesyavam || 32 || tam | ā | aganm | sobharayaḥ | sahasra'muṣkam | su'abhiṣṭim | avaṃse | su'arājam | trāsadesyavam || 32 || ᵛsobharayaḥ ṛṣayo vayam ᵛavase rakṣaṇāya ᵛtam agnim ᵛāganma havirbhiḥḥ stutibhiśca prāptā abhūma | kīdṛśam | ᵛsahasramuṣkam | muṣṇanti tamāṃstyapaharantīti muṣkāṇi tejāṃsi | bahutejaskaṃ ᵛsvabhiṣṭaṃ śobhanābhyeṣaṇaṃ ᵛsamrājaṃ samyagrājamānaṃ ᵛtrāsadesyavam | trasadasyunāma rājarṣiḥ | tasya stotṛtvatvena saṃbandhinam || yasya te agne anye agnaya upakṣito vayāiva | vipo na dyumnā ni yuve janānāṃ tarva kṣatrāṇi vardhayan || 33 || yasya̭ | te | agne | anye | agnayaḥ | upa'kṣitaḥ | vayāḥ'iva | vipaḥ | na | dyumnā | ni | yuve | janānām | tarva | kṣatrāṇi | vardhayan || 33 || he ᵛagne ᵛyasya ᵛte tava ᵛanye ᵛagnayaḥ ᵛvayāiva vṛkṣasya śākhā iva ᵛupakṣitaḥ samīpe nivasanto bhavanti ᵛjanānāṃ janimatāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye'haṃ tasya ᵛtava ᵛkṣatrāṇi balāni stutyā ᵛvardhayan ᵛvipo ᵛna | stotṛnāmaiṭatat | anye stotāra iva ᵛdyumnā dyotamānanyajñāni yaśāṃsi vā ᵛni ᵛyuve nitarāṃ prāpnomi | tvatprasādāllabhayetyarthaḥ || yarmādityāso aduhaḥ pāraṃ nayatha matyaim | maghonāṃ viśveśāṃ sudānavaḥ ||34|| yam | ādityāsaḥ | aduhaḥ | pāram | nayatha | matyaim | maghonām | viśveśām | su'dānavaḥ ||34|| he ᵛaduhaḥ adrogdhāraḥ he ᵛsudānavaḥ ḥ he ᵛādityāsaḥ aditaḥ putrā mitrādayaḥ ᵛmaghonāṃ haviṣmatāṃ ᵛviśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ madhye ᵛyaṃ ᵛmatyaṃ manuṣyaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵛpāraṃ ᵛnayatha ārabdhasya karmaṇaḥ samāptiṃ prāpayatha | sa tatphalaṃ labhata ityarthaḥ || yūyaṃ rājānaḥ kaṃ ciccarṣaṇīsahaḥ kṣayantaṃ mānuṣā~ anu | vayaṃ te vo varuṇa mitrāryamantasyāmedhṛtasya rthyaḥ || 35 || yuyam | rājānaḥ | kam | cit | carṣaṇi'sahaḥ | kṣayantam | mānuṣām | anu | vayam | te | vaḥ | varuṇa | mitra | aryaman | syāma | it | ṛtasya | rathyaḥ || 35 || he ᵛrājānaḥ rājamānā he ᵛcarṣaṇīsahaḥ śatrubhūtānāmabhibhavitāra ādityāḥ ᵛyūyaṃ ᵛmānuṣānanu manuṣyān yajamānānulakṣya ᵛkṣayantaṃ kṣapayantaṃ ᵛkaṃ ᵛcit kamapi śatruṃ sarvamapi śatruvargamabhibhavatheti 1. kha-tana-satsu; bha-vastuṣu ācchādakeṣu tamaḥsu satsu tvaṃ; śa-madatsu | 2. gha-sudānavaḥ : śobhanadānāḥ | ka. 3-41
manuṣyeṣu' yajamāneṣu kṣayantaṃ stutīnāmīśvaraṃ kaṃ cit kamapi stotāraṃ mā yūyaṃ gacchata |

anvānukrama- ṇikā—'vayamu dvyūnānye dvace citrasya dānastutiḥ' iti |
'kākubhaṃ prāgātha ha' ityuktatvātsyāpi sūktāyujaḥ kakubho yujaḥ sato- bṛhatyaḥ |
ukthye brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre 'vayamu tvām' iti pragāthaḥ stotriyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'vayamu tvāmapūrvya yo na idamidaṃ pureti pragāthau' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 1 ) iti |
ābhiplavike'pyukthye'pi tṛtīyasavane brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsino vaikalpiko'yaṃ stotriyaḥ pragāthaḥ |
asminneva śastre 'tvaṃ na indrā bhara' iti pragātho yadā stotriyaḥ tadā 'vayamu tvā' ityanurūpatṛcasyādyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'vayamu tvāmapūrvya yo na idamidaṃ purā yāhīma indava iti samāhāryo'nurūpaḥ' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti ||

acchā | ca | tvā | enā | narmasā | vadāmasi | kim | muhuḥ | cit | vi | dīdhayaḥ | santi | kāmāsaḥ | hari'śvaḥ | dadiḥ | tvam | smaḥ | vayam | santi | naḥ | dhiyaḥ || 6 || he indra acchā ca api cā ābhimukhyena va enā etena namasā stotreṇa havirlakṣaṇenānnena vā saha tvā tvāṃ vadāmasi abhivadāmaḥ | 'cavāyoge prathamā' iti na nighātaḥ | tvaṃ tu muhuḥ muhurmuhuḥ kiṃ kasmāddhetoḥ vi dīdhayaḥ | vipūrvo dīdhitiśrintane | vicintayasi | 'dīdhīṅ dīsidevanayoḥ' | vyatyayena parasmaipadaṃ lugabhāvaśca | kimarthaṃ yūyaṃ vadatheti cet | harivaḥ haritāśvavan he indra asmākaṃ kāmāsaḥ putrapaśvādiviṣayāḥ kāmāḥ santi kāmāḥ santu | ahaṃ na prayacchāmīti cet | tvaṃ tu dadiḥ dhanādidātā khalu | tasmāt vayaṃ tvatsaṃnidhau smaḥ bhavāmaḥ | kiṃca naḥ asmākaṃ dhiyaḥ karmāṇi ca tava samīpe santi tiṣṭhanti | tato dhanādilābhārthaṃ tvāṃ vadāma ityarthaḥ ||
nūnā irdinra te vayamūtī abhūma nahi na tai adrivaḥ |

nūnāḥ | it | indra | te | vayam | ūtī | abhūma | nahi | nu | te | adrivaḥ | viśvā | purā | parīṇasaḥ || 7 || he indra te tava ūtī ūthyai rakṣaṇe vayaṃ nūnā it nūtanā eva abhūma bhavāmaḥ | adrivaḥ vajrin he indra purā pūrvaṃ tvāṃ parīṇasaḥ | suṣṭhuvyatyayaḥ | parīṇasaṃ parito vyāptaṃ mahāntaṃ veti nahi viśvā na jānīmaḥ | nu saṃprati tu te tvāṃ mahāntamiti jānanto vayaṃ bhavatā rakṣyā iti ||
viśvā sakhitvamuta śūra bhojyaṃ mā te tā vajribhīmahe |
uto samasminbhā śiśīhi no vaso vājai suśiprā gormati ||

ukthye brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre ‘yo na idamadam’ ityayaṃ pragātho'nurūpaḥ |
ābhipalvikepukthyeṣu tṛtīyasavane brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsiśastre ‘tvaṃ na indrā bhara’ iti pragāthe stotriye satyanurūpataḥ samāhāryaḥ |
tatraiyaṃ ‘yo na ida- midam’ iti dvitīyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yo na idamadaṃ purā yāhīma indava iti samāhāryo'nurūpaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||
yo ne idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu vaḥ stuṣe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||9|| yaḥ | naḥ | idam'idam | purā | pra | vasyaḥ | ā'nināya | tam | ū~ iti | vaḥ | stuṣe | sakhāyaḥ | indram | ūtaye ||9||
vsakhāyaḥ samānasthānā he ṛtvijyajamānāḥ vyaḥ indraḥ vpurā pūrvamidaṃ darśanīyatayā vidyamānaṃ vvasyaḥ vasīyaḥ |
praśastaṃ vasu vnaḥ asmān vprāṇināya prakarṣeṇītavān vtamu tameva dhanānāmānetāram vindraṃ vvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ dhanalābhārtham vūtaye rakṣaṇāya ca vstuṣe sobharirahaṃ staumi ||

haryaśvaṃ satarpati carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi pmā yo amandata | ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam ||10|| hari'aśvam | sat'patim | carṣaṇī'saham | saḥ | hi | pmā | yaḥ | amandata | ā | tu | naḥ | saḥ | vayati | gavyam | aśvyam | stotṛ'bhyaḥ | magha'vā | śatam ||10||

vharyaśvaṃ haritavarṇāśvopetaṃ vsatpati svaprakāśādhikyena satāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ patiṃ satāṃ śreṣṭhānāṃ patiṃ vā vcarṣaṇīsahaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ śatrubhūtānāṃ manuṣyāṇāmabhivavitāraṃ vsa vhi vpmā sa khalu janaḥ stauti |
vyaḥ janaḥ vamandata tato labdhadhanaḥ saṃstuto bhavati sa enaṃ tuṣyati |
evaṃ sati vmaghavā dhanavān vsaḥ indraḥ vśataṃ vgavyamaśvyam anekaṃ gavāśvasaṃghaṃ vstotṛbhyaḥ vnaḥ asmabhyaṃ vtu kṣipram vā vvayati āprāyayatu |
tato labdhavādikā vayaṃ cainaṃ stuma iti ||

mā teṃ amājuro yathā murāsa indra sakhyai tvāvataḥ | ni ṣadāma sacā sute ||15|| mā | te | amā'juraḥ | yathā | murāsaḥ | indra | sakhyai | tvā'vataḥ | ni | sadāma | sacā | sute || 15 || he ᵥindra ᵥte somābhiṣavamakurvantaste gṛheḥ' putraiḥ pautrairdhanādibhiśca saha jīrṇā bhavanti | tathā vayamamājuro na bhavāma | katham | ᵥsacā ṛtvigbhiḥ saha ᵥsute abhiṣute some vayaṃ tu ᵥni ᵥṣadāma nivasāma' | tasmāt somadānena tvayā saha sakhibhāvaṃ kurma ityarthaḥ || || 3 || mā teṃ godatra nirarāma rādhasa indra mā teṃ gṛhāmahi | dṛḻhā cidaryaḥ pra mṛśāmyā bhera na teṃ dāmānaṃ ādabhe || 16 || mā | te | go'datra | niḥ | arāma | rādhasaḥ | indra | mā | te | gṛhāmahi | dṛḻhā | cit | aryaḥ | pra | mṛśa | abhi | ā | bhara | na | te | dāmānaṃ | ā'dabhe || 16|| he ᵥgodatra stotṛṇāṃ gavādidānaśīla he ᵥindra ᵥte tava svabhūtā vayaṃ ᵥrādhasaḥ dhanān ᵥmā ᵥnirarāma mā nirgamāma | ataileṃḍi 'satiṃśāstyatibhyaśca' ityādeśaḥ | 'ṛdaśo'ṅi' iti guṇaḥ | sarvadā tvatto dhanāḍhyā² bhavāma | kiṃca ᵥte tava svabhūtā vayaṃ dhanaṃ prayacchāma | kasmāccit ᵥmā ᵥgṛhāmahi mā gṛhlīmaḥ | api tu tvatta eva dhanaṃ gṛhlīma ityarthaḥ | praheleṃḍi 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śaḥ | ṅisvātsaṃprasāraṇam | ᵥaryaḥ svāmī tvaṃ ᵥdṛḻhā ᵥcit dṛḍhānyapi vinaśvarāṇi dhanāni ᵥpra ᵥmṛśa prakarṣeṇāsmāsu sthāpaya | kiṃca ᵥabhi ābhimukhyena ᵥā ᵥbhara dhanādibhiḥ samantādasmān poṣaya | ᵥte tava ᵥdāmānaḥ tāni dānāni ᵥna ᵥādabhe na kaiścidapi ādambhituṃ śakyante | tasmāt dānādiyuktānasmān kurvityarthaḥ || indro vā ghediyaṃmudhaṃ sarasvatī vā subhagā dadarvasuṃ | tvaṃ vā citra dāśuṣe ||17|| indraḥ | vā | ghe | it | iyat | mṛdham | sarasvatī | vā | su'bhagā | dadiḥ | vasuṃ | tvam | vā | citra | dāśuṣe || 17 || atra citrasya dānaṃ stauti | citro nāma rājā sarasvatītīra indrārthaṃ yāgamakṛta | tatra mantra- dṛṣṭarvibahudhalābhāndhametāvahvanaṃ ko vā prāyacchaditi vikalpayate | ᵥdāśuṣe indrāya havīṃṣi datta- vate mahyam ᵥindro ᵥvā ᵥghet indra eva kiṃ khalvetāvata' ᵥmaghaṃ mahanīyaṃ dhanaṃ ᵥdadiḥ prāyacchat | yadvā ᵥsubhagā śobhanadhanā ᵥsarasvatī nadī ᵥvasu dhanaṃ dadiḥ kiṃ prāyacchat | athavā ᵥcitra etannāmaka he rājan ᵥtvaṃ ᵥvā etāvahvanaṃ mahaṃ prādā iti || citra idrājā rājakā idanyake yake sarasvatīmanu | parjanyaiva tatanudvi vṛṣṭyā sahasramuyutā dadat || 18 ||

tripragāthādi bṛhatyanuṣṭubekādaśyādye kukummadhyejyotiṣī’ iti | prātaranuvāka āśvine kratau bārhate chandasyāśvina- śastre cādyāḥ saptarcaḥ | sūtritaṃ ca—‘o tyamaha ā rathamiti sapta’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 15 ) iti || o tyamah ā rathama॒dhā daṃsi̭ṣṭhamūtaye | yama̭śvinā suha॒vā ru॒drava̭rtanī ā sū॒ryāyai॒ tastha̭thuḥ || 1 || o iti | tyam | ahne | ā | ratham | agha | daṃsiṣṭham | ūtaye | yam | aśvinā | su'havā | rudravartanī iti rudra'vartanī | ā | sūryāyai | tasthathuḥ || 1 || he aśvinau ᐯdaṃsiṣṭham atyantadarśanīyaṃ yadvātiśayena śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitāraṃ ᐯtyaṃ taṃ yuvayoḥ ᐯratham ᐯūtaye rakṣaṇāya
