ā yātaṃ somapītaye pibataṃ dāśuṣe gṛhe ||
ayam | vām | adribhiḥ | sutaḥ | somaḥ | narā | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū | ā | yātam | somapītaye | pibatam | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛhe || 8 ||

<sup>v</sup>narā sarvasya netārau yadvā stotṝṇāṃ dhanasya netārau <sup>v</sup>vṛṣaṇvasū varṣaṇaśīladhanavantau he aśvinau <sup>v</sup>vāṃ yuṣmadartham <sup>v</sup>adribhiḥ grāvabhiḥ <sup>v</sup>ayaṃ <sup>v</sup>somaḥ <sup>v</sup>sutaḥ abhiṣutaḥ |
āgatya ca <sup>v</sup>dāśuṣaḥ havirdattavato yajamānasya <sup>v</sup>gṛhe yajñasthāne somaṃ yuvāṃ <sup>v</sup>pibatam ||
ā hi ruhatamaśvinā rathe kośe hiraṇyaye vṛṣaṇvasū |
ā | hi | ruhatam | aśvinā | rathe | kośe | hiraṇyaye | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū | yujjāthām | pīvarīḥ | iṣaḥ || 9 ||
<sup>v</sup>vṛṣaṇvasū varṣaṇaśīladhanau he <sup>v</sup>aśvinā aśvinau <sup>v</sup>hiraṇyaye hiraṇmayarajjvādiyukte <sup>v</sup>kośe āyudhādīnāṃ kośasthāne ramaṇaśīle <sup>v</sup>rathe |
tataḥ <sup>v</sup>pīvarīḥ pāvayitṝn sthūlāni vā <sup>v</sup>iṣaḥ annāni <sup>v</sup>yujāthāṃ asmāsu yojayatam ||
tābhino makṣu tūryamaśvinā gataṃ bhiṣajyataṃ yadāturam ||
yābhiḥ | paktham | avathaḥ | yābhiḥ | adhigum | yābhiḥ | babhrum | vijobhasam | tābhiḥ | naḥ | makṣu | tūryam | aśvinā | ā | gatam | bhiṣajyatam | yat | āturam || 10 ||
he aśvinau <sup>v</sup>yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ <sup>v</sup>paktham etannāmakaṃ rājānam <sup>v</sup>avathaḥ rakṣathaḥ |
etān sarvān yaiḥ pālanairavathaḥ <sup>v</sup>tābhiḥ tai rakṣaṇaiḥ <sup>v</sup>makṣu kṣipraṃ <sup>v</sup>tūryaṃ tūrṇa <sup>v</sup>naḥ
kiṃca ˅yat ˅āturaṃ rogādisahitamasmākaṃ putrādikaṃ prati ˅bhiṣajyataṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ kurutam |

yadadhi̭gā॒vo a॒dhi̭gū i॒dā ci॒dahaṷ a॒śvinā̭ ha॒vāma̭he | va॒yaṃ gī॒rbhirvvi̭panya॒vaḥ ||11|| yat | a॒dhi̭'gā॒vaḥ | a॒dhi̭gū i॒tyadhi̭'gū | i॒dā | ci॒t | a॒haḥ | a॒śvinā̭ | ha॒vāma̭he | va॒yam | gīḥ'bhiḥ | vi॒pa॒nya॒vaḥ || 11 ||

˅adhigāvaḥ aśatagamanāḥ karmasu tvaramāṇāḥ ˅vipanyavaḥ medhāvinaḥ ˅vayam ˅adhigū aśata- gamanau saṃgrāme śatrūvadhārthaṃ tvarayā gacchantau ˅aśvinā aśvinau yuvām ˅ahaḥ divasasya ˅idā ˅cit idānīmeva prātaḥkāle ˅gīrbhiḥ stutilakṣaṇābhirvāgbhiḥ ˅yat yadā ˅havāmahe yuvāmāhvayāmastadā tābhirūtibhirasmānāgacchatamityuttaratra saṃbandhaḥ ||

tābhi̭ryā॒taṃ vṛ॒ṣaṇo̭rpa me॒ havai̭ vi॒śvapsṷ̄ vi॒śvavā̭ryam | i॒ṣā maṃhi̭ṣṭhā puru॒bhūta̭mā na॒rā yā॒bhiḥ krivi̭ṃ vā॒vadhṷstābhi̭rā ga̭tam ||12|| tābhiḥ | ā | yā॒tam | vṛ॒ṣaṇaṷ | u॒pa | me॒ | hava̭m | vi॒śva'psṷ̄m | vi॒śva'vā̭ryam | i॒ṣā | maṃhi̭ṣṭhā | pu॒ru॒'bhṷ̄tamā | na॒rā | yā॒bhiḥ | krivi̭m | va॒vadhṷḥ | tābhi̭ḥ | ā | ga॒tam ||12||
stotraśastrātmakatvena nānārūpaṃ ˅viśvavāryaṃ sarvairdevairvvaraṇīyaṃ ˅me madīyaṃ ˅havaṃ yuṣmadviṣayamāhvānam ˅ā abhimukhīkṛtya ˅tābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ˅upa ˅yātaṃ yuvāmāgacchatam |

havīṃṣīcchantau ˅maṃhiṣṭhā maṃhiṣṭhāvatiśayena dhanānāṃ dātārau ˅purubhūtamā purubhūtabhau yuddheṣvatyantaṃ purudhā bhavantau bahudhātiśayena bahūnāṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitārau bhavantau ˅kriviṃ kūpaṃ prati ˅yābhiḥ ūtibhirudakāni ˅vāvadhuḥ avardhayata |
kūpapatito vandano māthābhiḥ kūpaṃ pūrayitvā yuvābhyāmutthāpitaḥ khalu |

tāvi̭dā ci॒dahā̭nāṃ tāva॒śvinā̭ vanda॒māna॒ upa̭ bruve | tā ū॒ namo̭bhi॒rīma̭he ||13|| tau | i॒dā | ci॒t | a॒hā̭nām | tau | a॒śvinā̭ | va॒nda॒māna̭ḥ | u॒pa | bru॒ve | tau | ū॒ iti̭ | namo̭'bhiḥ | ī॒ma॒he || 13 ||
˅tau saṃgrāme āyudhāni stotṛbhyo dhanāni vā vistārayantau pūrvoktau ˅aśvinā aśvinau ˅ahā- nām aham ˅idā ˅cit idānīmeva prātaḥkāle ˅vandamānaḥ abhivādanaṃ kurvan san ˅upa ˅bruve tayoḥ samīpe staumi |
tataḥ ˅tā ˅u tāveva ˅namobhiḥ havirbhiḥ stotrairvā ˅īmahe vayaṃ dhanādikaṃ yācāmahe ||

tāvi̭ddo॒ṣā tā u॒ṣāsa̭ṃ śu॒bhaspatī̭ tā yā॒maṃrṷdravartanī | mā no̭ ma॒rtīya̭ ri॒pave॒ vāji̭nīvasū॒ puro̭ ru॒drāva̭rti khyatam ||14|| tau | it | do॒ṣā | tau | u॒ṣāsa̭m | śu॒bhaḥ | patī̭ iti | tā | yā॒man | ru॒dra'va̭rtanī iti ru॒dra'va̭rtanī || mā | naḥ | ma॒rtīya̭ | ri॒pavḙ | vā॒ji॒nī॒vasū॒ iti̭ vā॒jinī̭'vasū | puraḥ | ru॒drā | a॒ti̭ | khya॒tam || 14 ||

śubhaspatī udakasya pālayitārau rudravartanī yuddhe rodanaśīlamārgī stūyamānamārgī vā tāvitva tāvevāśvinau doṣā doṣāyāṃ rātrau tau eva upasi uṣaḥkāle tāvaśvinau yāman yāmyahani ca sarveṣu kāleṣu vayamaśvināvāhvayāmaḥ |
evaṃ sati vājinīvasū annadhanau rudrau he aśvinau martāya manuṣyāya ripave śatrave naḥ asmān paraḥ parastāt mā ati ryyataṃ mā mṛtam |
ā sugmyāya sugmyaṃ prātā rathaināśvinā vā sakṣaṇī | huve piteva sormarī ||15|| ā | sugmyāya | sugmyam | prātariti | rathaina | aśvinau | vā | sakṣaṇī iti | huve | pitā'iva | sormarī || 15 ||
vā api ca sakṣaṇī sevanīyaśīlau aśvinau aśvinau yuvāṃ sugmyāya sukhāhāya mahyaṃ sugmyaṃ sukhaṃ prātaḥkāle rathena āvahatam |
tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ piteva yathā mama pitā ājuhāva tadvadahamāhvayāmi ||

manojavasā vṛṣaṇā madacyutā maśuṃgamābhirūtibhiḥ | ārāttāccidbhūtamusme avase pūrvībhiḥ purubhojasā || 16 || manaḥ'javasā | vṛṣaṇā | mada'cyutā | maśum'amābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | ārāttāt | cit | bhūtam | asme iti | avase | pūrvībhiḥ | puru'bhojasā || 16 ||
he manojavasā manovacchīghraṃ gacchantau vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇau dhanānāṃ varṣitārau madacyutā |

teṣāṃ cyāvayitārau purubhojasā bahūnāṃ bhoktārau rakṣakau yadvā bahūn stotṛn dhanādibhirbhojayantau he aśvinau maśuṃgamābhiḥ śīghraṃ gacchantībhiḥ ūtibhiḥ 2 rakṣābhiḥ pūrvībhiḥ bahubhiḥ 2 asme asmākam avase rakṣaṇāya ārāttāccit antika eva bhūtam bhavatam ||
ā no aśvāvadaśvinā vṛtiryāsiṣṭaṃ madhupātamā narā | gomatsā hiraṇyavat ||17|| ā | naḥ | aśva'vat | aśvinau | vṛtiḥ | yāsiṣṭam | madhu'pātamā | narā | go'mat | dastrā | hiraṇyavat || 17 ||
madhupātamā atiśayena madhoḥ somasya pātārau narā netārau dastrā sarvadarśanīyau he aśvinau naḥ asmākaṃ vṛtiḥ vartante'treti vartirgṛham |
tat aśvāvat aśvayuktaṃ gomat gavādiyuktaṃ hiraṇyavat suvarṇakanādiyuktaṃ kṛtvā ā yāsiṣṭam āgacchatam |
asmān prati vartiryajña- māgaṃm aśvādiyuktaṃ kṛtvāgacchatam |

suprāvargaṃ suvīryaṃ suṣṭu vāryaṃmānādhṛṣṭaṃ rakṣasvinau | asminvāmāyane vājinīvasū viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi || 18 || su'prāvargam | su'vīryam | suṣṭu | vāryam | anādhṛṣṭam | rakṣasvinau | asmin | ā | vām | ā'yānai | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū | viśvā | vāmāni | dhīmahi || 18 ||
'asya etādṛśo'gneḥ 'ajaraṃ jarārahitaṃ punaḥpunarmadhyamānatvādbhūtaṃ havirbhirvardhamānatvādbhavaṃ vā 'śociḥ tejaḥ 'ut 'asyāt unnatabhūta ||
udu tiṣṭha svadhvara starvā no devyā kṛpā | abhiṣyā bhāsā bṛhatā śuśukniḥ || 5 || ut | ū~ iti | tiṣṭha | su'adhvara | starvāḥ | devyā | kṛpā | abhi'khyā | bhāsā | bṛhatā | śuśukniḥ || 5 ||
'svadhvara śobhanayajña he agne 'abhiṣyā abhimukhaṃ gacchantyābhitaḥ prasiddhayā vā 'bṛhatā bṛhatyā 'bhāsā dīpyā 'śuśukniḥ |

ṛtāvānamṛtayavo yajñasya sādhanaṃ girā | upo enaṃ jujuṣurmmasapade || 9 || ṛta'vānam | ṛta'yavaḥ | yajñasya | sādhanam | girā | upo iti | enam | jujuṣuḥ | namaḥ | pade || 9 || ṛtāyavaḥ yajñakāmā he yajamānāḥ ṛtāvānaṃ yajñavantaṃ yajñasya sādhanaṃ sādhanabhūtam enam agniṃ namasaḥ haviṣaḥ pade sthāne yajñāṅge vā girā stutilakṣaṇayā vācā upo jujuṣuḥ upā- sedhvam || 'tiḍāṃ tiḍo bhavanti' iti madhyamapuruṣasya prathamapuruṣādeśaḥ ||

acchā no aṅgirastamaṃ yajñārsā yantu saṃyataḥ | hotā yo asti viśvā yaśastamaḥ || 10 || acchā | naḥ | aṅgiraḥ'tamam | yajñārsāḥ | yantu | sum'yataiḥ | hotā | yaḥ | asti | viśva | ā | yaśaḥ'tamaḥ || 10 || saṃyataḥ stutyādibhinirnimitāḥ naḥ asmākaṃ yajñārsāḥ yajñāḥ aṅgirastamam aṅgirasāṃ viśiṣṭamabhim acchā ābhimukhyena ca yantu gacchantu | yaḥ agniḥ viśva manuṣyoṃ hotā homaniṣpādakaḥ san ā sarvataḥ yaśastamaḥ | lusamatyarthīyaḥ | yaśasvitamaḥ asti bhavati tamagniṃ yantvanvayaḥ || ||10||

agne tvaṃ tye añjerandhānāso bṛhadbhāḥ | aśvāiva vṛṣaṇastaviṣīyaravaḥ || 11 || agne | tvam | tye | añjara | indhānāsaḥ | bṛhat | bhāḥ | aśvāḥ'iva | vṛṣaṇaḥ | taviṣīḥ'yavaḥ || 11 || ajara jarārahita he agne indhānāsaḥ indhānā dīdhyamānāḥ bṛhat bṛhanto mahāntaḥ tye te sarva- gatāḥ tava tvadīyāḥ bhāḥ bhāso raśmayaḥ vṛṣaṇaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣitāraḥ santaḥ taviṣīṣavaḥ balamācaranto bhavanti | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | aśvāiva yathā vṛṣaṇo retasaḥ sektāro'śvā balamācaranto bhavanti tadvat ||

sa tvaṃ na ūrjāṃ pate rayiṃ rāsva suvīryam | prāva nastokaṃ tanaye samatsvā || 12 || saḥ | tvam | naḥ | ūrjām | pate | rayim | rāsva | su'vīryam | pra | ava | naḥ | toke | tanaye | samat'su | ā || 12 || ūrjāṃ annānāṃ pate svāmin he agne saḥ tathāvidhaḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ suvīryaṃ śobhana- vīryopetaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ rāsva dehi | naḥ asmākaṃ toke putre tanaye | tanoti vistārayati putramiti tanayaḥ | pautraḥ | tasminvartamānaṃ dhanaṃ samatsu saṃgrāmeṣu ca yat rakṣitavyaṃ dhanaṃ tacca prāva prakarṣeṇa rakṣa | anena putrapautraprārthanaṃ karoti ||

yadvā u viprapatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśi | viśvedbhiḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati || 13 || yat | vai | ū~ iti | vipra'patiḥ | śitaḥ | su'prītaḥ | manuṣaḥ | viśi | viśvā | it | agniḥ | prati | rakṣāṃsi | sedhati || 13 ||
1. kha-gha-1-tana-bha-1-2-śa-evamagni | 2. ga-'ca' nāsti | 3. ga-ta-bha-tye sarvagatāste tava | 4. kha-ta-na-bha-1-2-pumiti; ga-śa-kulamiti | 5. ga-bhaṭairvijetavyaṃ |

viṣpatiḥ viśāṃ pālayitā 'śitaḥ havirbhistīkṣṇīkṛtaḥ so'gniḥ 'suprītaḥ suṣṭhu prītaḥ san 'manuṣyaḥ manuṣyasya 'viśi niveśane gṛhe 'yadya yadā khalu vartate tadānīm 'agniḥ 'viśvet viśvānyeva tasya bādhakāni 'rakṣāṃsi 'prati 'vedhati hinasti || ‘bidhu galyām’ | auvādikaḥ | 'u prasiddhau || śṛṇume navasya me stomasya vīra viṣpate | ni māyinastarpuṣā rakṣasau daha ||14|| śṛṇu | agne | navasya | me | stomasya | vīra | viṣpate | ni | māyinaḥ | tarpuṣā | rakṣasaḥ | daha || 14 || 'vīra śatrūṇāṃ vināśayitarvīryavan 'viṣpate viśāṃ pālayitarhe 'agne 'navasya idānīṃ kriyamāṇatvātūtanaṃ 'me madīyaṃ 'stomasya stotrasyādikaṃ 'śṛṇu śrutvā 'māyinaḥ māyāvinaḥ 'rakṣasaḥ karmavighnakāriṇo rākṣasān 'tapuṣā tāpakena tejasā 'ni 'daha nitarāṃ bhasmīkuru || śṛṇu | ‘snātsyā- dyaśca’ iti nipātitaḥ | vakāralopaśchāndasaḥ || na tasya māyayā cana ripurīśīta martyaḥ | yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātibhiḥ||15|| na | tasya | māyayā | cana | ripuḥ | īśīta | martyaḥ | yaḥ | agnaye | dadāśa | havyadātibhiḥ || 15 || 'martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ 'ripuḥ śatruḥ | caneti nipātasamudāyo'pyarthe | 'māyayā 'cana māyayāpi 'tasya janasya 'na 'īśīta īśvaro na bhavati | 'yaḥ janaḥ 'havyadātibhiḥ haviṣāṃ dātṛbhirṛtvigbhiḥ 'agnaye 'dadāśa havīṃṣi prayacchati | tasya ripurnāstītyarthaḥ || || 11 || vyaśvastavā vasuvidamukṣṇayuraprīṇādṛṣiḥ | maho rāye tapte tvā sarmidhīmahi ||16|| vi'aśvaḥ | tvā | vasu'vidam | ukṣṇayuḥ | aprīṇāt | ṛṣiḥ | mahaḥ | rāye | tam | ū~ iti | tvā | sam | idhīmahi || 16 || 'ukṣṇayuḥ dhanānāṃ settāramātmana icchan yadvā vṛṣṭisettāramicchan 'vyaśvaḥ 'ṛṣiḥ etannāmako mama pitā 'vasuvidaṃ vasūnāṃ dhanānāṃ lambhakaṃ 'tvā tvām 'aprīṇāt dhanādiprāptyartha havirbhistoṣayat | tathā vayamapi 'mahaḥ mahate 'rāye dhanāya 'tamu tathāvidhameva 'tvā tvāṃ 'samidhīmahi samyagjāyā- dihavirbhirdīpayema || uśanā kāvyastvā ni hotoramasādayat | āyaji tvā manave jātavedasam ||17|| uśanā | kāvyaḥ | tvā | ni | hotāram | asādayat | ā'yajim | tvā | manave | jāta'vedasam || 17 || he agne 'kāvyaḥ kaviputraḥ 'uśanā etannāmaka ṛṣiḥ 'manave rāśe | tasya gṛha ityarthaḥ | 'āyajim ābhimukhyena yaṣṭāraṃ 'jātavedasaṃ jātaprajñaṃ 'tvā tvām | punastvāśabda ādarārthaḥ | tvāmeva 'hotāraṃ homaniṣpādakaṃ 'ni 'asādayat nitarāmupāveśayat || viśve hi tvā sujoṣaso devāso dūtamata | śruṣṭī deva prathamo yajñiyo bhuvaḥ||18||

viśvḙ | hi | tvā̭ | su॒'jo॒ṣasa̭ḥ | de॒vāsa̭ḥ | du॒tam | a̭rkata | śru॒ṣṭī | de॒va | pratha̭maḥ | ya॒jñiya̭ḥ | bhuva̭ḥ || 18 || he agne viśve sarve devāḥ sajopasaḥ saṃgatāḥ santaḥ asmākaṃ havīṃṣyānayatīti vicārya tvā | hiravadhāraṇe | tvāmeva vṛtaṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhāraṃ dūtam akrata akārṣuḥ | tataḥ deva dyotamāna he agne prathamaḥ devānāṃ mukhyabhūtastvaṃ śruṣṭī | śruṣṭīti kṣipranāma | kṣipraṃ yajñiyaḥ devānāṃ havirdātṛtvena yajñārhaḥ bhuvaḥ bhūyāḥ ||
i॒maṃ ghā̭ vī॒ro a̭mṛ॒taṃ dū॒taṃ kṛ̭ṇvīta ma॒rtya̭ḥ | pā॒vaka̭ṃ kṛ॒ṣṇava̭rtina॒ṃ vihā̭yasam || 19 || i॒mam | gha | vī॒raḥ | a॒mṛ॒tam | dū॒tam | kṛ॒ṇvīta | ma॒rtya̭ḥ | pā॒vakam | kṛ॒ṣṇa'va̭rtina

āmirvidhemāgnaye jyeṣṭhābhirśvavat | maṃhiṣṭhābhirmitibhiḥ śukraśauciṣe || 23 || āmiḥ | vidhema | agnaye | jyeṣṭhābhiḥ | vyaśvavat | maṃhiṣṭhābhiḥ | matibhiḥ | śukra'śauciṣe || 23 || viśvamanānāmakā vayaṃ ᵥjyeṣṭhābhiḥ praśastatamābhiḥ ᵥmaṃhiṣṭhābhiḥ pūjyatamābhiḥ ᵥābhiḥ sūkta- rūpābhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᵥśukraśauciṣe jvalattejase ᵥagnaye ᵥvidhema paricarema | kathamiva | ᵥvyaśvavat | yathā vyaśvo'smākaṃ pitā agniṃ stutibhiḥ paryacarat tadvadvayamapi paricarema ||

nunamarca vihāyase stomaॅbhiḥ sthūrayūpavat | ṛṣai vaiyaśva damyāyāgnaye || 24 || numam | arca | vi'hāyase | stomaibhiḥ | sthūrayūpa'vat | ṛṣe | vaiyaśva | damyāya | agnaye || 24 || ᵥvaiyaśva vyaśvasya putra he viśvamanānāmaka ᵥṛṣe ᵥvihāyase mahate ᵥdamyāya dame gṛhe'raṇībhiḥ madhyamānatvena bhavāya | yadvā | yajamānagṛhāṇāṃ bādhaparihāreṇa hitāya | ᵥagnaye ᵥnūnaṃ saṃprati ᵥstomaॅbhiḥ trivṛtpañcadaśādilakṣaṇaiḥ stomaiḥ ᵥarca stuhi | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | ᵥsthūrayūpavat | yathā sthūrayūpo nāmaśirenamabhimānaṃ tadvadarcaityarthaḥ ||

atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ sunuṃ vanaspatīnām | viprā agnimarvase pratnamīḻate || 25 || atithim | mānuṣāṇām | sunum | vanaspatīnām | viprāḥ | agnim | arbase | pratnam | īḻate || 25 || ᵥviprāḥ medhāvino yajamānāḥ ᵥmānuṣāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇām ᵥatithim atithisvarūpaṃ ᵥvanaspatīnāṃ ᵥsunuṃ vanaspatirūpābhiraraṇībhirjātamānatvena teṣāṃ sunuṃ ᵥpratnaṃ purātanamevaṃvidham ᵥagnimavase karmarakṣaṇāya ᵥīḻate stutibhiḥ stuvanti || || 13 ||

maho viśvaॉ abhi ṣṭo'bhi havyāni mānuṣā | agne ni ṣatsi namasādhi barhiṣi||26|| mahaḥ | viśvān | abhi | sataḥ | abhi | havyāni | mānuṣā | agne | ni | satsi | namasā | adhi | barhiṣi || 26 || he ᵥagne ᵥmahaḥ karmakartṛttvena mahataḥ ᵥviśvān sarvān ᵥsataḥ stotrakaraṇārthaṃ vartamānān stotṛn ᵥabhi abhitastvaṃ ᵥnamasā stutyatayā ᵥbarhiṣi ᵥadhi ᵥni ᵥṣatsi niṣīda | tathā ᵥmānuṣā manuṣyasambandhīni ᵥhavyāni havīṃṣi ᵥabhi abhitastāni svīkṛtaṃ niṣīda ||
vasvā no vāryā puru vasva rāyaḥ | puruspṛhaḥ | suvīryasya prajāvato yaśasvataḥ ||27|| vasvā | naḥ | vāryā | puru | vasva | rāyaḥ | puru'spṛhaḥ | su'vīryasya | prajā'vataḥ | yaśasvataḥ || 27 ||
kiṃca adhi barhiṣi yajñe namasā stoteṇa haviṣā ca saha ( saha vā tvamiha-ga ) niṣatsi nitarāṃ sīda |
he agne ^vāyā~ vāyāṃsi varaṇīyāni ^puru puruṇi bahūni gavādīni ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^vasva prayaccha |
^suvīryasya śobhana- vīryopetaṃ ^prajāvataḥ putrapautrādisahitaṃ ^yaśasvataḥ kīrtimacca dhanaṃ no'smabhyaṃ ^vasva prayaccha |

tvaṃ va̭ro su॒ṣāmṇo̭'gne॒ janā̭ya॒ coda̭ya | sa॒dā va॒so ra॒tiṃ ya̭viṣṭha॒ śaśva̭te || 28 || tvam | va̭ro iti | su॒ṣāmṇḙ | a॒gne | janā̭ya | coda̭ya | sa॒dā | va॒so iti | ra॒tim | ya̭viṣṭha | śaśva̭te || 28 ||
^varo sarvairviraṇīya ^vaso śatrūṇāṃ vāsayitaḥ ^yaviṣṭha punaḥpunarjāyamānatvena yuvatama he ^agne ^tvaṃ ^suṣāmṇe susāmne |
sakhāyaḥ | ā | śiṣāmahi | brahma | indrāya | vajriṇe | stuṣe | oṃ iti | su | vaḥ | nṛ'tamāya | dhṛṣṇave || 1 ||
^sakhāyaḥ : mitrabhūtā he ṛtvijaḥ ^vajriṇe vajrahastāya ^indrāya ^brahma kartavyametatsūkarūpaṃ stotram ^ā ^śiṣāmahi vayam āśāsmaḥ |
tatra ^vaḥ : sarveṣābheva yuṣmākamarthāya ^nṛtamāya sarveṣāṃ netṛtamāya yadvā saṃgrāmeṣvā- yudhādīnāṃ netṛtamāya ^dhṛṣṇave śatrūṇāṃ gharṣaṇaśīlāya tasmā indrāyahāmeva ^su suṣṭhu ^stuṣe staumi ||
śarvasā haṃsi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā | mṛdhairmadhono ati śūra dāśasi || 2 || śarvasā | hi | asi | śrutaḥ | vṛtra'hatyena | vṛtra'hā | mṛdhaiḥ | maghonaḥ | ati | śūra | dāśasi || 2 ||
he indra tvaṃ ^śavasā balena ^śrutaḥ prasiddhaḥ ^asi bhavasi |
^śūra śauryavan he indra ^maghonaḥ maghavato dhanavataḥ puruṣāt ^mṛdhaiḥ tvadīyairdhanaiḥ ^ati atikramya ^dāśasi stotṛbhyo'smabhyaṃ prayacchasi ||
sa naḥ stavān ā bhara rayi citraśravastamam | nireke cidyo harivo vasurdadiḥ ||3|| saḥ | naḥ | stavānaḥ | ā | bhara | rayim | citraśravaḥ'tamam | nireke | cit | yaḥ | hari'vaḥ | vasuḥ | dadiḥ || 3 ||
he indra ^saḥ tathāvidhastvaṃ ^stavānaḥ asmābhiḥ stūyamānaḥ san ^citraśravastamam atiśayena nānāvidhājñopetaṃ ^rayi putraṃ dhanaṃ vā ^naḥ asmabhyam ^ā ^bhara saṃpādaya |
tadvan he indra ^yaḥ tvaṃ ^nireke ^cit nirgamana eva ^vasuḥ śatrūṇāṃ vāsayitā bhavasi |
ā nirekamuta priyamindra darṣi janānām | dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo stavamāna ā bhara ||4|| ā | nirekam | uta | priyam | indra | darṣi | janānām | dhṛṣatā | dhṛṣṇo iti | stavamānaḥ | ā | bhara || 4 ||
vivṛttya ca ^dhṛṣṇo gharṣaṇaśīla^ he indra ^stavamānaḥ stotṛbhi- rasmābhiḥ stūyamānaḥ san ^dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṭena manasā saha ^ā ^bhara taddhanamasmabhyaṃ dehi ||
na tai śūnyaṃ na dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varanta āsuraḥ | na paribādhau harivo garviṣṭiṣu ||5|| na | tai | śūnyam | na | dakṣiṇam | hastam | varante | āsuraḥ | na | pari'bādhau | hari'vaḥ | go'iṣṭiṣu || 5 ||
he hariba aśvavindra āmuḥ saṃgrāma ābhimukhyena kartāraḥ pratiyoddhāraḥ gaviṣṭiṣu paṇibhirapahatānāmaṅgirasāṃ gavāmanveṣaṇeṣu te tava savyaṃ hastaṃ na varante na nivārayanti |
tathā dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ ca na nivārayanti |
kiṃca paribādhaḥ parito bādhamānā vṛtrādayo'surāśca tava savyadakṣiṇahastau na nivārayanti |
saṃgrāmeṣu tvayā sarve śatravaśchinnāhastāḥ sarvato gacchantu |
ā smā kāmaṃ jariturā manaḥ pṛṇa ||
ā | tvā | gobhiḥ'iva | vrajam | gīḥ'bhiḥ | ṛṇomi | adri'vaḥ | ā | sma | kāmam | jarituḥ | ā | manaḥ | pṛṇa || 6 ||
he adrivaḥ vajravanninra gīrbhiḥ stutilakṣaṇābhirvāgbhiḥ tvā tvām ā ṛṇomi prāpnomi |
indraṃ | yathā | hi | asti | te | apari'itam | nṛto iti | śarvaḥ | amṛktā | rātiḥ | puru'huta | dāśuṣe || 9 ||
he nṛto sarvasyāntaryāmitayā nartayitaḥ indra te tvadīyaṃ śavaḥ balaṃ yathā aparitam asti śatrubhiraparigatamabhyāsaṃ bhavati |
tathā he puruhūta purubhirbahubhirāhutendra dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya rātiḥ dhanādidānam amṛktā śatrubhirahiṃsitaṃ bhavati |
tvatto labdhaṃ yajamānasya dhanaṃ śatravo na hiṃsanti |
yathā tvadīyabalasya rakṣaka evaṃ tasya dhanasyāpi rakṣaka ityarthaḥ ||
ā vṛṣasva mahāmaha mahe nṛtama rādhase |
ā | vṛṣasva | mahā'maha | mahe | nu'tam | rādhase | duḻahaḥ | cit | draha | magha'van | magharttaye || 10 ||
he mahāmaha atiśayena sarvaiḥ pūjanīya nṛtama netṛmendra mahe mahate rādhase śatrūnāṃ saṃsādhakāya balāya balārtham ā vṛṣasva svodaramāsiñca |
he maghavan dhana- vannindra somapānena mattaḥ san duḻahaścit dṛḍhāni parairabādhitānyapi śatrupurāṇi maghattaye maghānāṃ dhanānāṃ lābhāya draha jighāṃsa |
nu | anyatra | cit | adri'vaḥ | tvat | naḥ | jagmuḥ | ā'śarsaḥ | margha'van | śṛgdhi | tava | tat | naḥ | ūti'bhiḥ || 11 ||
he adrivaḥ vajravannindra tvaṃ dhanavān dātā cetyaparijñāya naḥ asmadīyāni āśasaḥ āśāṃ- sanāni abhilāṣāḥ tvat tvattaḥ anyatra devādyau nu cit purā jagmuḥ agacchan |
ata eva he maghavan dhanavannindra tava tvadīyaṃ tat śatrupuravidāraṇalabdhaṃ dhanam ūtibhiḥ tvadrakṣaṇaiḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ śṛgdhi dehi |
nahi | aṅga | nṛto iti | tvat | anyam | vindāmi | rādhase | rāye | ghumnāya | śarvase | ca | girvaṇaḥ || 12 ||

he nṛto nartayitaḥ girvaṇaḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhirvandanīya saṃbhajanīyendra rādhase balasaṃsādhakāthā- jñāya rāye dhanāya ghumnāya dyotamānāya yaśase śarvase vardhakāya balāya ca tvat tvattaḥ anyaṃ nahi vindāmi na labhe |
ā | indum | indrāya | siñcat | pibāti | somyam | madhum | pra | rādhasā | codayāte | mahi'tvanā || 13 ||
he ṛtvija: vhantuṃ spandanaśīlaṃ somamindrārtham' vā vsiñcata āśrayaṇadravyeṇa secanaṃ kuruta |
tata: vsomyaṃ somamayaṃ vmadhu madakaraṃ sāṃmarasaṃ vpibāti pibatu |
pītvā ca sa indra: vmahitvanā svamahatvenaiva vrādhasā annena saha dhanādikaṃ stotṛbhya: vpra vcodayate prakarṣeṇa codayati |
mahasvayuktena rādhasā annena saha stotṛn pracodayati |
upè harīṇāṃ patiṃ dakṣaṃ puśvantaṃmabhavam | nūnaṃ śrudhi stuvato aśvyasya || 14 || upè iti | harīṇām | patim | dakṣam | puśvantam | añjavam | nūnam | śrudhi | stuvata: | aśvyasya || 14 ||
vharīṇāṃ haritavarṇānāmaśvānāṃ vpatiṃ pālayitāraṃ vdakṣaṃ vardhakaṃ svabalaṃ vpuśvantam |
tasya putrasya vstuvata: stotraṃ kurvato mama sambandhinīṃ2 tvadviṣayāṃ stutiṃ vnūnaṃ saṃprati vśrudhi śṛṇu ||
nahya̭ purā cana jajñe vīrata̭rastvat | nakīṃ rāyā naivathā na bhandanā || 15 || nahi | aṅga | purā | cana | jajñe | vīra'tara: | tvat | naki: | rāyā | na | eva'thā | na | bhandanā || 15 ||

he indra vtvat tvatta: vpurā pūrvaṃ vvīratara: sāmarthyavān kaścit vnahi vjajñe jāta:3 khalu | vaṅga prasiddhau | tvameva sāmarthyavān jāta ityartha: | kiṃñca tvatto'pi vrāyā dhanena samartha: vnaki: na kaścidasti | tathā vevathā' śatrupurāṇi saṃgrāmaṃ vā prati gamanena tvatto'dhika: vna jāta: | yadvā | evathā | ava rakṣaṇādiṣu | akārasyaikāraśchāndasa: | auṇādiko'thapratyaya: | śaraṇāgatānāṃ stotṛṇāṃ cāvanena tvatto'dhiko nāsti | kiṃca vbhandanā | bhandati: stutikarmā | stutyā ca tvadadhika: vna jāta: | dhanavān rakṣaka: stutyaśca tvatto'nyo na jajña iti || || 17 ||
'edu maghava:' iti tṛca: pūrvokte brāhmaṇacchaṃsiśastre vaikalpiko'nurūpa: |
sūtritaṃ ca—'edu maghavò madantarameto nindraṃ stavāma sakhāya: ' ( ādha. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti ||

edu maghavò madantaraṃ siśva vāṃghavyo andhasa: | evā hi vīra: stavate sadāvṛdha: || 16 || ā | it | ū~ iti | maghava: | madina'taram | siśva | vā | adhvaryo iti | andhasa: | eva | hi | vīra: | stavate | sadā'vṛdha: || 16 ||
he vadhvaryo adhvarasya netrartvik vmaghava: madakarasya vandhasa: somalakṣaṇasyānnasya vmadi- ntaram atyarthaṃ mādayitṛtamaṃ somarasameva vā vsiñca indrārthamabhiṣuṇu |
yadvā sarvadā svabalasya vardhako'yam veva indra: vstavate vhi stotraśastrādibhi: stūyate khalu |
1. gha-bhara-°mindrāyaidārthaṃ | 2. bha-sambandhinī he iṃdra | 3. gha-bha-na jāta: | 4. jha-ta1-4-ya- eva yathā; ga2-eva tathā |
indraṃ sthātāharīṇāṃ narkiṣṭe purvyastutim | udānaṃś śavasā na bhandanā || 17 || indraṃ | sthātāḥ | harīṇām | narkiḥ | te | purvya'stutim | ut | ānaṃś | śavasā | na | bhandanā || 17 ||
he harīṇāṃ sthātāḥ aśvānāmadhiśrātaḥ indra te tvadīyāṃ purvyastutiṃ pūrvaiṛṣibhiḥ kṛtāṃ stutim |
idānīṃtanaiḥ kriyamāṇāmapi stutiṃ nakiḥ na kaścit śavasā balena udānaṃś vyāpnoti |
kiṃca bhandanā sarvaiḥ prārthanīyatvāt pūjanīyena dhanena stutyā vā tvadīyāṃ stutiṃ na kaścidatikrāmati |
taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śruvasyavaḥ | aprāyubhiryajñairbhirvāvṛdhenyam || 18 || tam | vaḥ | vājānām | patim | ahūmahi | śruvasyavaḥ | aprāyu'bhiḥ | yajñaiḥ | vṛdhenyam || 18 ||

evaṃvidhamanuṣyayuktaiḥ yajñaiḥ yajñaiḥ etādṛśamanuṣyairvā vāvṛdhenyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ vājānām annānāṃ patiṃ svāminaṃ vaḥ yaṣṭavyasaṃbandhena yuṣmadīyaṃ taṃ tādṛśamindraṃ śravasyavaḥ vayamannakāmāḥ santaḥ ahūmahi āhūyāmaḥ |
pūrvokta eva śabde 'eto nvindram' ityetau tacau vaikalpikau stotriyānurūpau |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāyaḥ stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavat' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti ||

eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāyaḥ stomyaṃ naram | kṛṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it ||19|| eto iti | nu | indram | stavāma | sakhāyaḥ | stomyam | naram | kṛṣṭīḥ | yaḥ | viśvāḥ | abhi | asti | ekaḥ | it || 19 ||
he sakhāyaḥ samānasthānā mitrabhūtā vā he ṛtvijaḥ nu kṣipram eto āgacchataiva |
stomyaṃ stomārhaṃ naraṃ sarvasya netāraṃ tam indraṃ stavāma stotraṃ karavāma |
yaḥ indraḥ eka it eko'sahāya' eva san viśvāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṭīḥ śatrusenāḥ abhyasti abhivadati |
agorudhāya gaviṣe dhukyāya dasyuṃ varcaḥ | ghṛtātsvādīyau madhuśca vocata ||20|| agauḥ'rudhāya | go'iṣe | dhukyāya | dasyum | varcaḥ | ghṛtāt | svādīyaḥ | madhu | ca | vocata || 20 ||
he ṛtvijaḥ agorudhāya gāḥ stutī ruṇaddhiti gorudhaḥ |
tādṛśāya ata eva gaviṣe stotrāṇīcchate dhukyāya dīpyamānāyendrāya dasyuṃ darśanīyaṃ ghṛtāt svādutarādājyāt madhuśca svādīyaḥ atiśayena svādubhūtaṃ vacaḥ stotrarūpaṃ vākyaṃ vocata ṛta |
ṛtvigbhiḥ kṛtaṃ karma yajamāno'pi kṛtavān bhavatīti madīyamindraviṣayaṃ vaco vākyaṃ vocata iti |
tadāha' bhagavānāśvalāyanaḥ—' vaca eva ma idaṃ ghṛtācca madhunnaśca svādīyo'sti prītiḥ svādīyo'stvityeva tadāha' (āśva. gṛ. 1. 1. 5) iti ||
yasyārmitāni vīryā̭ na rādhaḥ parya̭tave | jyotirna viśva̭mabhyasti dakṣiṇā || 21 || yasya̭ | armitāni | vīryā̭ | na | rādhaḥ | pari̭'etave | jyoti̭ḥ | na | viśva̭m | abhi̭ | asti̭ | dakṣiṇā || 21 ||
^yasya indrasya ^vīryā vīryāṇi vṛtrahananādilakṣaṇāni^ sāmarthyāni ^amitāni asya iyanti sāmarthyāni^ nānyānīti parimitāni na bhavanti |
tathā yasyendrasya ^rādhaḥ dhanaṃ ^paryaṃtave^ śatrubhiḥ parigantuṃ prāptuṃ śakyaṃ ^na bhavati |
ata eva yasya^ ^dakṣiṇā dhanadānaṃ ^viśvamabhyasti sarvaṃ stotrajanamabhibhavati |
yathāntarikṣaṃ sarvalokaṃ pidhāya tiṣṭhati tadvat stotrajanaṃ dhanadānena pidhatta ityarthaḥ^ ||

stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavadanūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yarmam | aryo gayaṃ maṃhemānaṃ vi dāśuṣe || 22 || stuhi | indra̭m | vyaśva̭'vata | anūrmim | vājina̭m | yarmam | arya̭ḥ | gaya̭m | maṃhemānam | vi | dāśuṣḙ || 22 ||
yathā vyaśvo^ viśvamanasaḥ^ pitā indramastaut tadvat stuhītyarthaḥ |
stutaśca ^aryaḥ^ svāmī indraḥ ^dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya ^maṃhamānaṃ pūjyamānaṃ ^gayaṃ dhanam |
gṛham asti cet devā havirbhiḥ pūjyante |
evā nūnamṷpa stuhi vairyaśca daśamaṃ navam | suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām || 23 || eva | nūnam | upa | stuhi | vairyaśca | daśa̭m | nava̭m | mu'vidvāṃsam | carkṛtyam | caraṇīnām || 23 ||
he ^vaiyaśca vyaśvasya putra viśvamanaḥ ^caraṇīnāṃ^ manuṣyāṇāṃ dehe sthitānāṃ navānāṃ prāṇānāṃ ^daśamaṃ daśasaṃkhyāpūrakam |
tatra mantraḥ—' nava vai puruṣe prāṇā manuṣyeṣu vartamānā indrasteṣāṃ daśadhā bhavatīndrasyātmānaṃ daśadhā carantam' iti |

yadvā yena dattaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ śatrujanamabhi- bhavati yena (etat-ga) dattaṃ ( 'dattaṃ' nāsti-ga-na-bha) dhanamādāya asataḥ (mahataḥ-ga-bha; sata:-ta3; sarvataḥ-bha3) śatrubhirbhavatītyarthaḥ ( 'bhavatītyarthaḥ-kha-ta-bha3-śa) |
8. kha- stutibhiḥ suniyatavyaḥ; ga-na-bha-arthibhiḥ stotṛbhiśca niyaṃtavyaḥ; gha-ta1-2-stutibhiḥ stotṛbhiḥ suni- yaṃtavyaḥ; śa-arthibhiḥ stotṛbhiḥ suniyaṃtavyaḥ |
9. ga-vyaśvarṣistava; gha-vyaśvo nāma tava; na-bha1-2- vyaśvo vāmiti va; bha3-vyaśvo vāgmī tava |
11. kha-śuciṃdraśasaṃ; ta-na- śuciṃdrapraśaṃsaṃ; bha-śucipraśaṃsyaṃ; śa-suvidvāṃsaṃ praśaṃsaṃta |

suṣṭhu sarvaṃ jānantaṃ cakraṃ bhūyo bhūyaḥ kāryeṣu sarvainamaskartavyamevaṃvidhamindram eva nūnam idānīm upa stuhi samīpe stuhi || vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam | aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva ||24|| vettha | hi | niḥ ṛtīnām | vajra hasta | pari vṛjam | ahaḥ ahaḥ | śundhyuḥ | pari padām iva || 24 || idānīmṛṣirindraṃ sambodhyāha | he vajrahasta vajrayuktahastendra nirṛtīnām upadravakāriṇāṃ rakṣāsāṃ parivṛjaṃ parivarjanam | hiravadhāraṇe | tvameva vettha jānīye | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ |
tasmāt rakṣaso jātāt ahaṃsaḥ pāparūpādudravāt mucat muñcati |
rākṣasa enaṃ na bādhate kiṃ punastaṃ hantītyarthaḥ |
api ca yaḥ indraḥ sasa sindhuṣu gaṅgāyāsu nadīṣu |
teṣu vartamānamānāṃ stotṛṇām āryāt dhanādikaṃ prerayet |
he tuvintraṇa bahudhanendra dāsasya upakṣapayiturasurasya vadhaḥ hananasādhanamāyudhaṃ nīnamaḥ namaya ||
yathā varo suṣāmne sanibhya āvarho rayim |

he varo varunāmaka rājan suṣāmne susāmne supāmākhyaṃ rājānaṃ svapitaramuddiśya tasyottamalokaprāptyarthaṃ sanibhyaḥ bhikṣāmāṇebhyaḥ ā kośādāhṛtya rathi dhanaṃ yathā purā avahaḥ prāptavānasi ata evamidānīṃ vyaśvebhyaḥ vyaśvaputrebhyaḥ 2 asamabhyaṃ dhanamāvaha |
ayaṃ tṛco'pyupasya iti śaunakoktaṃ— yathā varo suṣāmṇa ityuttama- svaupasastvacaḥ' iti |
tadvati he upaḥ tvaṃ cāsmabhyaṃ dhanaṃ prayaccha |

he subhage śobhanadhane vājinīvati aśvavati he upaḥ yathā tvaṃ suṣāmṇe susāmanāmne mama pitre dhanaṃ datvā tenaiva suṣāmṇā sanibhyo yācamā- nebhyo dhanaṃ yathā prāptavatyasi tena yathā dānakārayaḥ evaṃ mahyamapi dhanaṃ datvā vyaśvebhyaḥ |
vyaśvaputrāya viśvamanase dhanaṃ prāpayeti mayārpa dānaṃ karoṣi |
ā nārthasya dakṣiṇā vyaśvā etu sominaḥ |

ā | nārthasya | dakṣiṇā | vi'aśvān | etu | sominaḥ | sthūram | ca | rādhaḥ | śata'vat | sahasra'vat || 29 || anayā dhanampirādattavānityāha | nārthasya | narahito naryaḥ | tasyāpatyaṃ nārthaḥ | tasmāt sambandhamātre 'tasyedam' ityaṇa | tasya sominaḥ somavato yajamānasya | yadvā | vyaśvānāṃ viśeṣaṇam | tādṛśasya varoḥ dakṣiṇā dānaṃ somavataḥ vyaśvān vyaśvaputrānsmān ā etu āgacchatu | kiṃca sthūraṃ sthūlaṃ śatavatsahasravat śatasahasradhanayuktaṃ rādhaḥ annaṃ ca asmānāgacchatu ||

yat | tvā | pṛcchāt | ījānaḥ | kuhyā | kuhyā'kṛte | eṣaḥ | apa'śritaḥ | valaḥ | go'matīm | ava | tiṣṭhati || 30 || idānīmuṣasaṃ saṃbodhyābhidhīyate | he kuhyākṛte sa varaḥ kuha kutra tiṣṭhatītyicchayā abhilakṣaṇapravṛttarjijñāsubhiḥ puraskṛta | kuhaśabdāt kyac | etādṛśe he upaḥ tvā tvāṃ yat yadā
1. ga-yopi vā; gha-vā api ca; na-bha1-3-vyepi ca; bha3-yopi ca |
kaścit ᵥpṛcchāt pṛcchati ᵥījānaḥ iṣṭavān varaḥ ᵥkuhayā ka tiṣṭhatīti yadā pṛcchati tadānīm ᵥapa- śritaḥ sarvairāśritaḥ |
yadā yācamānā āgacchanti tadā dauvārikā na pratibadhnanti- tyarthaḥ |
ᵥeṣo eṣa varaḥ ᵥgomatīm etannāmikāṃ nadīm |
tasyāstīre ᵥava ᵥtiṣṭhati iti tadānīṃ tvaṃ kathayasi ||
atreyamankramaṇikā—‘tā vāṃ caturviṃśatimaṃtrā- varuṇaṃ daśamyādyāstitro vaiśvadevya upāntyoṣṇigagarbhā’ iti |
tā vāṃ viśvasya gopā devā deveṣu yajñiyā | ṛtāvānā yajase pūtadakṣā || 1 || tā | vām | viśvasya | gopā | devā | deveṣu | yajñiyā | ṛta'vānā | yajame | pūta'dakṣā ||1||
he mitrāvaruṇau ᵥviśvasya sarvasya lokasya ᵥgopā gopāyitārau ᵥdevā devau dyotanaśīlau ᵥdeveṣu madhye ᵥyajñiyā yajñārhau ᵥtā tau tādṛśau ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ haviṣpradānārthaṃ yajamānaṃ bhajathaḥ |
ata eva he viśvamanaḥ ᵥṛtāvānā ṛtāvānau satyavantau yajñavantau vā pūtadakṣau śuddhabalau |
āvāṃ balavantā- viti vacanamātreṇa balavantau na bhavataḥ kintu yathārthatvena sāmarthyavantau |
mitrā tanā na rathyāᵥ varuṇo yaśca sukratuḥ | sanātsujātā tanayā dhṛtavratā ||2|| mitrā | tanā | na | rathyā | varuṇaḥ | yaḥ | ca | su'kratuḥ | sanāt | su'jātā | tanayā | dhṛta'vratā || 2 ||
ᵥsukratuḥ śobhanakarmā ᵥyaḥ ᵥvaruṇaḥ sukarmā ᵥmitrā ᵥca mitrāvaruṇau |
tādṛśau rathyau rathavantau ᵥsanāt cirādeva ᵥsujātā sujātau śobhanajanmānau |
ᵥtanayā tanayau aditeḥ putrau ᵥdhṛtavratā dhṛtavratau dhṛtakarmāṇau tā yajasa iti pūrveṇa samanvayaḥ ||
tā mātā viśvavedasāsuryāya pramahasā | mahī jajānāditiṛtāvarī || 3 || tā | mātā | viśvavedasā | asuryāya | pra'mahasā | mahī | jajāna | aditiḥ | ṛta'varī ||3||
viśvāni sthāvara- jaṅgamātmakāni sarvāṇi vidaturjānīta iti viśvavedasau |
ᵥpramahasā pramahasau prakṛṣṭatejaskau ᵥtā tau tādṛśau mitrāvaruṇau ᵥmahī mahatī ᵥṛtāvarī satyavatī ᵥmātā devamātā ᵥaditiḥ ᵥjajāna janayā- māsa |
4. ga-yuvāṃ balavantāviti vacanamātreṇa balavantau na bhavataḥ |
kintu yajñārthatvena sāmarthyavantau yajñavantau vā pūtadakṣau śuddhabalau yuvāṃ balavantau iti vacanamātreṇa |
mahantā | mitrāvaruṇā | sam'rājā | devau | asurā | ṛta'vānā | ṛtam | ā | ghoṣataḥ | bṛhat || 4 ||
^mahantā guṇādhikyena mahāntau ^sannājā samnājāau samyagdīpyamānau ^asurā asurau bala- vantau |
ṛtāvānā satyavantau mitrāvaruṇau ^devau ^bṛhat stotra- śastrādinā mahāntam ^ṛtaṃ yajñam ^ā ^ghoṣataḥ svadīpyā prakāśayataḥ |

napātā śavaso mahaḥ | sūnū dakṣasya sukratū | supradānū iṣo vāstavadhi kṣitaḥ || 5 || napātā | śavasaḥ | mahaḥ | sūnū iti | dakṣasya | sukratū iti su'kratū | supradānū iti supra'dānū | iṣaḥ | vāstu | adhi | kṣitaḥ || 5 ||
'dakṣa vṛddhau śīghrārthe ca' iti dakṣo vegaḥ |
tau ^sukratū śobhanakarmāṇau ^supradānū prastutadhanādidānau mitrāvaruṇau ^iṣaḥ ajñasya ^vāstu^ nivāsasthāne ^adhi ^kṣitaḥ adhivasata: |
saṃ yā dānūni yemathurdivyāḥ | pārthivīriṣaḥ | nabhasvatīrā vāṃ carantu vṛṣṭayaḥ || 6 || sam | yā | dānūni | yemathuḥ | divyāḥ | pārthivīḥ | iṣaḥ | nabhasvatīḥ | ā | vām | carantu | vṛṣṭayaḥ || 6 ||
he^ mitrāvaruṇau yau yuvāṃ ^dānūni deyāni dhanāni ^saṃ ^yemathuḥ asmāsu saṃyacchataṃ tathā ^divyāḥ divyāni divi bhavāni ^pārthivīḥ pṛthivyāmutpannāni ^iṣaḥ annāni saṃyacchatam |
vṛṣṭya- bhāve kathamannaṃ labhyata iti cet taducyate |
adhi yā bṛhato divo'bhi yūtheva paśyataḥ | ṛtāvānā samnājā narmase hitā || 7 || adhi | yā | bṛhataḥ | divaḥ | abhi | yūthā'iva | paśyataḥ | ṛta'vānā | sam'rājā | narmase | hitā || 7 ||
yathā vṛṣabho goyūthāni rantum ^abhi abhimukhaṃ paśyati tadvadetau svavīryeṇāsurān hatvā devān modayituṃ paśyata ityarthaḥ |
kīdṛśau ^ṛtāvānā satyavantau ^samnājā samnājāau samyagdīpya- mānau ^namase haviṣe ^hitā hitau priyau paśyata iti ||
6. ga-yau yuvāṃ dānūni deyāni dhanāni saṃ yemathuḥ samyak prayacchathaḥ divyāḥ pārthivīriṣaḥ divyāni pārthivāni cānnāni tava yuvāṃ nabhasvatīrudakavatyaḥ vṛṣṭayaḥ ācarantupatiṣṭhantu |

ma. 8 a. 4. sū. 25 ] ṣaṣṭho'ṣṭakaḥ 677 ṛta'rvānā | ni | sedat | sāmra'rājyāya | sukratū iti su'kratū | dhṛta'vratā | kṣatriyā | kṣatram | āśatuḥ || 8 || vṛtāvānā ṛtāvānau satyavantau vsukratū śobhanakarmāṇau suprajñau vā mitrāvaruṇau vsāmrājyāya sāmrājyārthaṃ vni vbhedatuḥ nyasīdatām | tathā mantraḥ — ‘ni pasāda dhṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pasyāsvā sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 25. 10) iti | vdhṛtavratā dhṛtavratau dhṛtakarmāṇau vkṣatriyā kṣatriyau balavantau vkṣatra balam vāśatuḥ ānaśāte vyāptuta ityarthaḥ || akṣaṇvindrātuvittarātulbaṇena cakṣasā | ni cinimiśantāṃ nicirā ni cikyatuḥ ||9|| akṣaṇa | cit | gātuvitta'tarā | anulabaṇena | cakṣasā | ni | cit | miṣantāṃ | ni'cirā | ni | cikyatuḥ || 9 || vakṣaṇaścit cakṣuṣo'pi pūrvaṃ vgātuvittarā gātuvittarāvatiśaye
ariṣyantaḥ pālanavatvāt kenāpyabādhitāḥ vayam agmate stotṝṇāṃ yaṣṭṝṇāṃ cāhisakāya sudānave śobhanadānāya viṣṇave ravamahavena sarvavyāpakāyaitannāmakāya devāya stutiṃ kurmaḥ |
svayamevāsahāyaḥ san divi saṃgrāme vā yātīti svayāvān |
sindho stotṝn prati dhanānāṃ syandanaśīla viṣṇo pūrvacittaye |
mantrā- ntare'pi tathā śravaṇāt—‘sā cittibhirni hi cakāra martyam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 164. 29) iti |
pūrva prārabdhakarmaṇe yajamānāya tadartha śrudhi asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu ||
tadvārthaṃ vṛṇīmahe variṣṭhaṃ gopayatyam | mitro yatpānti varuṇo yadaryamā || 13 || tat | vāryam | vṛṇīmahe | variṣṭham | gopayatyam | mitraḥ | yat | pānti | varuṇaḥ | yat | aryamā || 13 ||
variṣṭham urutaraṃ gopayatyaṃ sarveṣāṃ rakṣakaṃ yataiḥ pālanīyaṃ vā vāryaṃ sarvairvandanīyaṃ tat dhanaṃ vṛṇīmahe vayaṃ saṃbhajāmahe |
yat dhanaṃ mitraḥ sarveṣāṃ mitrabhūtaḥ varuṇaḥ śatrūṇāṃ vārayitā aryamā sarvadā gacchan etannāmakākhyo devāḥ pānti pālayanti |
uta naḥ sindhurapāṃ tanmarutastadaśvinā | indro viṣṇūmīḍhāṃsaḥ sujorṣasaḥ || 14 || uta | naḥ | sindhuḥ | apām | tat | marutaḥ | tat | aśvinā | indraḥ | viṣṇuḥ | mīḍhāṃsaḥ | sujorṣasaḥ || 14 ||
uta api ca apām udakānāṃ sindhuḥ syandanaśīlaḥ parjanyaḥ naḥ asmadīyaṃ tat dhanaṃ rakṣatu |
tathā indraḥ viṣṇū ca mīḍhāṃsaḥ kāmānāṃ settāra ete sarve devāḥ sajorṣasaḥ saṃgatāḥ santo'smadīyaṃ dhanaṃ rakṣantu |
ete devā asmabhyaṃ dhanaṃ datvā pālayantvityarthaḥ ||

te hi ṣmā vunuṣo naro'bhimātiṃ kāryasya cit | tigmaṃ na kṣodaḥ pratighnanti bhūrṇayaḥ || 15 || te | hi | sma | vunuṣaḥ | naraḥ | abhimātim | kāryasya | cit | tigmam | na | kṣodaḥ | pratighnanti | bhūrṇayaḥ || 15 ||

vunuṣaḥ vananīyāḥ saṃbhajanīyāḥ naraḥ netāraḥ te hi ṣmā te khalu devāḥ bhūrṇayaḥ kṣipa- gamanāḥ santaḥ kayasya cit kasyacicchatroḥ abhimātim abhimānaṃ pratighnanti pratikūlaṃ yathā bhavati tathā hiṃsanti |
tigmaṃ na yathā tigmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ javena gacchat kṣodaḥ udakamagrataḥ sthitaṃ vṛkṣamunmūlayati tadvatsyābhimānaṃ ghnantītyarthaḥ ||
ayamekaṃ itthā puru caṣṭe vi viśapatiḥ | tasya vratānyanu vaśvarāmāsi || 16 || ayam | ekam | itthā | puru | caṣṭe | vi | viśapatiḥ | tasya | vratāni | anu | vaḥ | carāmasi || 16 ||
ᵥviṣpati: viśāṃ pālayitā anayormitrāvaruṇayo: ᵥeka: ᵥayaṃ mitra: ᵥpuru puruṇi bahūni ca ᵥuru urūṇi ca dravyāṇi ᵥdṛṣṭvā itthaṃ ᵥvi ᵥcaṣṭe svatejasā paśyati |
ᵥtasya mitrasya ᵥvratāni karmāṇi ᵥva: yuṣmadartham ᵥanu ᵥcarāmasi anucarāma: |
anu pūrvāṇyokyā sāmrājyasya saścima | mitrasya vratā varuṇasya dīrghaśrut ||17|| anu | pūrvāṇi | okyā | sām'rājyasya | saścima | mitrasya | vratā | varuṇasya | dīrgha'śrut || 17 ||

ᵥsāmrājyasya | samrājo bhāva: sāmrājyam | sāmrājyamasyāstīti sāmrājya: | ‘arśa- ādibhya: ’ ityacpratyaya: | sāmrājyavato varuṇasya ᵥpūrvāṇi purātanāni ᵥokyā | oko gṛham | tasmai hitāni karmāṇi vayaṃ ᵥ

tatsūryaṃ rodasī ubhe doṣā vastorupa bruve | bhojeṣvā abhyucara sadā || 21 || tat | sūryam | rodasī iti | ubhe iti | doṣā | vastauḥ | upa | bruve | bhojeṣu | asmān | abhi | ut | cara | sadā || 21 || ^sūrya suvīrya ^tat vāruṇaṃ maitraṃ ca teja: ^ubhe ^rodasī ubhe dyāvāpṛthivyau ca ^doṣā'| 'supāṃ suluk' iti dvitīyāyā luk | 'kālādhvanoḥ' iti dvitīyā | rātrau ^vastauḥ^2 ahani cāham ^upa ^bruve upastaumi | tvaṃ stūyamāno varuṇa: ^bhojeṣu dātṛṣu ^asmān ^sadā ^abhyucara sarvadābhimukhaṃ preraya | dātṛṣveteṣāṃ dāneṣvasmān purobhāvina: kurvityartha: ||

ṛjramukṣaṇyāyane rajataṃ harayāṇe | rathaṃ yuktamasanama suṣāmaṇi || 22 || ṛjram | ukṣaṇyāyane | rajatam | harayāṇe | ratham | yuktam | asanāma | su'sāmani || 22 || suṣāmaṇa: putro varuṇāna rājā | sa yahānaṃ prādāt viśvamanase tadasau viśvamanā ṛviranayā bhācaṣṭe | ^ukṣaṇyāyane | ukṣanāmā kaścidraro: pūrvaja: | tasya gotrāpatya ukṣaṇaśabdo'patya: | tadantāt phakpratyaya: | 'gau chāndasau | vṛddhibhāvo'pi 'saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranitya: ' iti na bhavati | tasya gotrāpatye ^harayāṇe śatrujīvitaiśvaryādiharaṇaśīlathāne etādṛśe ^suṣāmaṇi | bahuvapitṛśabdena putro'bhidhīyate | suṣāmaṇa: putre varau rājani dadati sati kimabhūta | ^ṛjram ṛjugāminaṃ ^rajataṃ rajatamatyaṃ rajatasadṛśaṃ vā ^yuktam aśvābhyāṃ yuktaṃ ^ratham ^asanama | eteṣāṃ mitrādīnāṃ3 prasādāt vayaṃ saṃbhaktavanto labdhavanto'bhūma ||

tā me aśvyānāṃ harīṇāṃ nitośanā | uto nu kṛtavyānāṃ nuvāhasā || 23 || tā | me | aśvyānām | harīṇām | ni'tośanā | uto iti | nu | kṛtavyānām | nu'vāhasā || 23 || ṛṣi: pratigṛhītāśvavāha^4 | ^harīṇāṃ haritavarṇānām ^aśvyānām aśvasaṃghānāṃ madhye ^nitośanā nitośanau | tośatihiṃsākarmā | śatrūṇāmatyantaṃ bādhakau ^uto api ca ^kṛtavyānāṃ yuddhakarmaṇi kuśalānāṃ ca svakuśalamiti bādhakau ^nuvāhasā nuvāhasau āyudhanetṝṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ voḍhārau ^tā tāvaśvau ^me mahyaṃ ^nu kṣipraṃ sauṣāmaṇe varuṇā dattau bhavetām ||

smadabhīśū kaśāvantā viprā naviṣṭhayā matī | maho vājināvarvantā sacāsanam || 24 || smadabhīśū iti smat'abhīśū | kaśā'vantā | viprā | naviṣṭhayā | matī | maha: | vājinau | arbantā | sacā | asanam || 24 || ṛṣiridānīṃ tāvaśvāvaprahīpamityāha | ^smadabhīśū | smatsumata | ukāralopaścāndasa: | śobhanarajjuyuktau yadvā śobhanaśarīrakāntau^5 ^kaśāvantā kaśāvantau kaśāyuktau ^viprā viprau medhā- vināmucitau | medhāvī stotā yathā stutyaṃ devaṃ stutibhi: prīṇayati tadvat saṃtoṣakau | ^maha: mahata: sauṣāmaṇya varo: saṃbandhinau ^vājinau śīghragamanavantau ^arbantā arbantau dvāvaśvau ^sacā saha
yugapadeva ᵥnaviṣṭhayā navataryā ᵥmatī matyā stutyā mitrādīn stuvan ᵥasanam|
atrānukramaṇikā—'yuvoḥ pañcādhikā vyaśvo vāṅgirasa āśvinaṃ viṃśayāthā vāyavyāstapūrvāścastro gāyabhyo'nyaikaviṃśayau ca viṃśanuṣṭup' iti|
āṅgiraso vyaśvo vaiśvo viśvamanā vā ṛṣiḥ|
ṣoḍaśyāthāśastro gāyabhyo viṃśanuṣṭubeviṃśī pañcaviṃśī ca gāyabhyau śiṣṭāḥ pūrvavaduṣṇihaḥ|
prātaranuvāka āśvine kratau auṣṇihe chandasyāśvinaśastre cāditaḥ pañcadaśarcaḥ|
sūtritaṃ ca—'yuvoru ṣū rathaṃ huva iti pañcadaśetyauṣṇiham' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti||
ā | vām | vāhiṣṭhaḥ | aśvinā | rathaḥ | yātu | śrutaḥ | narā | upa | stomān | turasya | darśathaḥ | śriye || 4 ||

he <sup>v</sup>narā sarvasya netārau <sup>v</sup>aśvinā aśvinau <sup>v</sup>vāṃ yuvayoḥ <sup>v</sup>vāhiṣṭhaḥ voḍhatamaḥ <sup>v</sup>śrutaḥ viśrutaḥ sarvatra prasiddhaḥ <sup>v</sup>rathaḥ <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>yātu asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ pratyāgacchatu |
tena rathena yuvāmāgatya <sup>v</sup>turasya kṣipraṃ stotraṃ kurvatastasya <sup>v</sup>stomān trivṛtpañcadaśādistomān <sup>v</sup>śriye tasyaiśvaryapradānāya <sup>v</sup>upa <sup>v</sup>darśathaḥ |

juhurāṇā cidaśvinā manyethāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū | yuvaṃ hi rudrā parṣatho ati dviṣaḥ || 5 || juhurāṇā | cit | aśvinā | ā | manyethāṃ | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇ'vasū | yuvam | hi | rudrā | parṣathaḥ | ati | dviṣaḥ || 5 ||
kuṭilān karmavighnakāriṇo māyā vino'pi śatrūn ā abhimukhyena manyethāṃ jānītam |
tato he rudrā saṃgrāme rodanaśīlau ruvantau vā aśvinau yuvam |
yuvāmeva dvipaḥ dveṣakāriṇaḥ tān śatrūn ati parṣathaḥ atītya saṃkleśayatam |

dastrā hi viśvamānuṣaḍmakṣūbhiḥ paridīryathaḥ | dhiyaṃjinvā madhuvarṇā śubhaspatīṃ || 6 || dastrā | hi | viśvam | ānuṣak | makṣū'bhiḥ | pari'dīryathaḥ | dhiyam'jinvā | madhu'varṇā | śubhaḥ | patī iti || 6 ||
ye yuvayo rūpaṃ paśyanti te tatraiva hṛṣṭā bhavantītyarthaḥ |

tādṛśau <sup>v</sup>śubhaspatī udakasya pālayitārau tādṛśau yuvāṃ <sup>v</sup>makṣūbhiḥ śīghragamanairaśvaiḥ <sup>v</sup>ānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā <sup>v</sup>viśvam ksvigmihavirvimiśra vyāptam |
upa no yātamāśvinā rāyā viśvapurṣā saha | maghavānā suvīrāvanapacyutā || 7 || upa | naḥ | yātam | aśvinā | rāyā | viśva'purṣā | saha | magha'vānā | su'vīrau | anapa'cyutā || 7 ||

he <sup>v</sup>aśvinā aśvinau <sup>v</sup>viśvapurṣā viśvasya sarvasya poṣakaṇa <sup>v</sup>rāyā dhanena <sup>v</sup>saha <sup>v</sup>naḥ asmadīyaṃ yajñam <sup>v</sup>upa <sup>v</sup>yātam upāgacchatam |
ā mai asya pratīvya 1 mindrnāsatyā gatam |
ā | me | asya | pratīvyam | indranāsatyā | gatam | devā | devebhiḥ | atha | sucanaḥ'tamā || 8 ||
atiśayena savaiḥ samavetavyau sevyamānau yuvāṃ pratīvyam |
punaḥpunarvidyanti bhakṣayanti havīṃṣi devā atreti pratīvīryajñaḥ |
me mama sambandhinaṃ yajñam atha asmin dine devebhiḥ devaiḥ sādham ā gatam āgacchatam |
me mama asya kriyamāṇasya stotrasya pratīvyaṃ pratigataṃ yathā bhavati tathābhisukhyenāyātam ||
vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmaha ukṣayantau vyaśvavat |
vayaṃ | hi | vām | havāmahe | ukṣayantaḥ | vyaśvavat | sumati'bhiḥ | upa | vigrā | iha | ā | gatam || 9 ||
vayaṃ vāṃ hi dhanādīnāṃ prastārau yuvāmeva havāmahe tallābhārthamāhvayāmaḥ |
yathāsmākaṃ pitā yuvāmeva stutvā dhanamalabhata tadvat |
he vigrā medhāvināvaśvinau sumatibhiḥ asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaiḥ kalyāṇaiḥ stotraiḥ saha |
iha asmin yāgadine upa ā gatam upāgacchatam ||
aśvinā svṛṣe stuhi kuvitte śravato havam |
aśvinā | su | ṛṣe | stuhi | kuvit | te | śravataḥ | havam | nedīyasaḥ | kūḻayātaḥ | paṇīn | uta || 10 ||

he ṛṣe viśvamanaḥ | aśvinā aśvinau devau su stuhi śobhanaṃ stuhi | tatastāvaśvinau te stotustava havam āhvānaṃ kuvit | kuviditi bahunāma | bahuvāraṃ śravataḥ śṛṇutām | ‘śru śravaṇe’ | levyaḍāgamaḥ | evaṃ tvayā stutāvaśvinau nedīyasaḥ antikatamān śatrūn kūḻayātaḥ hiṃsatām | uta api ca paṇīn etannāmakān agniṃrogavāmapanetṛn asurānapi hiṃsatām | ‘kuḍi dāhe’ | ṣyantsasya levyāḍāgamaḥ || || 27 ||
vaiyaśvasya śrutaṃ naroto meṃ asya vaidathaḥ |
vaiyaśvasya | śrutam | narā | uto | iti | me | asya | vaidathaḥ | su'joṣāḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā || 11 ||
he narā netārauśvinau vaiyaśvasya vyaśvaputrasya viśvamanaso samāhvānaṃ śrutaṃ śṛṇutām |
uta api ca me madīyama asya tadāhvānaṃ vaidathaḥ āsmīyatathā jānīthaḥ |
atha varuṇaḥ mitraḥ mitrāvaruṇau ca sajoṣā saṃgatau santau aryamā etannāmako devaśca madīyāhvānaṃ śrutvā mahyaṃ dhanādikaṃ prayacchantu ||
yuvā'dattasya | dhiṣṇyā | yuvā'nītasya | sūri'bhiḥ | ahaḥ'ahaḥ | vṛṣaṇu | mahai | śikṣatam || 12 ||
he ᵥdhiṣṇyā ᵥdhiṣṇyau ᵥdhiṣaṇāhīṃ stutyau vṛṣaṇau kāmānāṃ sektāravaśvinau' ᵥsūribhiḥ |

sūribhyaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ ᵥyuvādattasya yuvābhyāṃ ᵥvastotṛbhyo dīyate tat tathā ᵥyuvānītasya yuvābhyāṃ ᵥyastotṛbhyo nīyate tacca dhanādikam ᵥaharahaḥ ahyahani ᵥmajñaṃ vibhamanase stotraṃ kurvāṇāya yuvāṃ ᵥśikṣataṃ prayacchatam ||
yo vāṃ yajñebhirāṛto'dhivastrā vadhūriva | saparyantāṃ śubhe cakrāte aśvinā ||13|| yaḥ | vām | yajñebhiḥ | ā'vṛtaḥ | adhi'vastrā | vadhūḥ'iva | saparyantāṃ | śubhe | cakrāte iti | aśvinā || 13 ||
ᵥthaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵥyajñebhiḥ yajanaiḥ pūjanaiḥ yadvā yuṣmadviṣayairgātraiḥ ᵥāvṛtaḥ parivṛto bhavati |

ᵥadhivastrā upari nihitavastrā ᵥvadhūḥ2 anyena2 vastreṇa yathācchāditā bhavati tathāvṛto yadā bhavati tadā ᵥsaparyantā abhīṣṭapradānena taṃ paricaranto ᵥaśvinā aśvinau bhavantau taṃ manuṣyaṃ ᵥśubhre ᵥcakrāte maṅgale dhane kṛtavanto |
yo yuvābhyāṃ havīṃṣi prayacchati taṃ dhanādiyuktaṃ kurutamityarthaḥ ||
yo vāmuruvyacastamaṃ ciketati nṛpāyyam | vṛtiraśvinā pari yātamsmyū ||14|| yaḥ | vām | uruvyacaḥ'tamam | ciketati | nṛ'pāyyam | vṛtiḥ | aśvinā | pari | yātam | asmyū ityasmyū || 14 ||
he aśvinau ᵥuruvyacastamam atiśayena gṛheṣu bhūtaṃ vyāsaṃ ᵥnṛpāyyaṃ netṛtvyāṃ yuvābhyāṃ pātavyaṃ somaṃ ᵥthaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥvāṃ yuvābhyāṃ taṃ somaṃ dātuṃ ᵥciketati bhṛśaṃ jānāti tasya ᵥvṛtiḥ |
ᵥviśvamanasaṃ māṃ kāmayamānau yuvāṃ ᵥpari ᵥyātaṃ somapānāthaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ pratyāyātam ||

asmabhyaṃ su vṛṣaṇavasū yātaṃvṛtirnṛpāyyam | viṣudruhaiva yajñamhathurgirā ||15|| asmabhyam | su | vṛṣaṇa'vasū iti vṛṣaṇa'vasū | yātam | vṛtiḥ | nṛ'pāyyam | viṣudruhā'iva | yajñam | ūhathuḥ | girā || 15 ||
he ᵥvṛṣaṇavasū varṣaṇaśīladhanavantāśvinau ᵥasmabhyam asmadarthaṃ ᵥnṛpāyyaṃ netṛtvyāṃ pātavyaṃ somaṃ prati ᵥvṛtiḥ asmadīyaṃ gṛhaṃ prati ᵥsu ᵥyātaṃ yuvāṃ suṣṭhu āyātama |
ᵥgirā stutilakṣaṇayā vācā yuvāṃ ᵥyajñamhathuḥ manuṣyeṣu yajñasamāptiṃ prāpayathaḥ |
tena yathā vyādho mṛgamabhilaṣitaṃ deśaṃ prāpayati tadvat stutyā yajñavaikalyena samāptiṃ prāpayatha ityarthaḥ ||
prātaranuvāka āśvine kratau gāyatre chandasi 'vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānām' iti catasraḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāmiti catasra udīrāyāmā me havamiti gāyatram' (āśva. śrau. 4.15) iti ||
vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāṃ stomoṃ duto huvabharā | yuvābhyāṃ bhūtaaśvinā ||16|| vāhiṣṭhaḥ | vām | havānām | stomaḥ | dūtaḥ | huvat | nurā | yuvābhyām | bhūta | aśvinā || 16 ||
he narā narau sarvasya netārauśvinau havānāṃ stotṛṇāṃ stotrāṇāṃ madhye stomaḥ bāhiṣṭhaḥ yuvāmatiśayena vyāpanuvan madīyaḥ stomaḥ dūtaḥ dūtabhūtaḥ san huvat āhvayatu |
so'yaṃ madīyaḥ stomaḥ yuvābhyāṃ priyakaraḥ bhūtu bhavatu ||
yaddo divo arṇava iṣo vā madatho gṛhe | śrutinme amartyā || 17 || yat | adaḥ | divaḥ | arṇave | iṣaḥ | vā | madathaḥ | gṛhe | śrutam | it | me | amartyā || 17 ||
amuṣmin arṇave apāṃ sthāne yat yadi madathaḥ mādyathaḥ |
vā api ca iṣaḥ yuvāmicchato yajamānasya gṛhe yadi mādyathaḥ |
evaṃ cet he amartyā maraṇadharmarahitāmanuṣyoṃ vāśvinau me madīyaṃ stotraṃ śrutam yuvāṃ śṛṇutameva |
vāyavye paśau vapāyāḥ 'tava vāyo' ityeṣā vānvākyā|
sūtritaṃ ca-'pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā tava vāyavṛtaspate' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||
tarva vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmataradbhuta | avāṃsthā vṛṇīmahe || 21 || tarva | vāyo iti | ṛtaḥpate | tvaṣṭuḥ | jāmātaḥ | adbhuta | avāṃrsi | ā | vṛṇīmahe || 21 ||
tādṛśa adbhuta mahan vicitrakarman he vāyo tava tvadīyāni avāṃrsi pālanāni ā vṛṇīmahe vayamasmin paśūyāge saṃbhajāmahe ||
tvaṣṭurjāmātaṃraṃ vayamīśānaṃ rāya īṃmahe | sutārvanto vāyuṃ yumnā janāsaḥ || 22 || tvaṣṭuḥ | jāmātaram | vayam | īśānam | rāyaḥ | īṃmahe | suta'vantaḥ | vāyum | yumnā | janāsaḥ || 22 ||
ime janāsaḥ janāḥ vayaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ brahmaṇaḥ jāmātaram īśānaṃ sarveśvarametādṛśaṃ vāyuṃ sutavantaḥ abhiṣutasomāḥ rāyaḥ dhanam īṃmahe yācāmahe |
tena dattena vayaṃ yumnā dhanavantaḥ syāmeti śeṣaḥ ||
vāyavyatvace 'vāyo yāhi śivā divaḥ' ityādi ke dve ṛcau dvitīyātṛtīye |
sūtritaṃ ca-'vāyo yāhi śivā diva iti dve' (āśva. śrau. 7. 10) iti ||
vāyo yāhi śivā divo vahastvā su svaśvaryam | vahasva mahaḥ pṛthupakṣā rathe || 23 || vāyo iti | yāhi | śiva | ā | divaḥ | vahasva | su | su'aśvaryam | vahasva | mahaḥ | pṛthu'pakṣasā | rathe || 23 ||
sarvajyotiṣāṃ tvadādhāratvāt teṣāmādhāro bhūtvā dyuloke tāni sthāpayeti prārthyate |
śobhanāśaṃsadhaṃ rathaṃ su suṣṭhu vahasva sarvaṃto dikṣu prāpaya |
mahaḥ mahāstvaṃ pṛthupakṣā pṛthupārśvadvayayuktāvaśvāṃ rathe svakīye vahasva śatruhananārthaṃ saṃyojaya ||
vāyavye paśau puroḍāśahavidhaḥ 'tvāṃ hi supparastamam' iti dve anuvākye |
sūtritaṃ ca-'tvāṃ hi supparastamamiti dve kuvidaṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||
tvāṃ hi supparastamaṃ nuṣardaneṣu humhe | grāvāṇaṃ nāśvaṃpṛṣṭhaṃ maṃhanā || 24 || tvām | hi | supparaḥ'tamam | nu'sardaneṣu | humhe | grāvāṇam | na | aśvaṃ'pṛṣṭham | maṃhanā || 24 ||

he vāyo supparastamam | supma iti rūpanāma | ro matvarthīyaḥ | atiśayena śobhanarūpavantaṃ maṃhanā svakīyena mahatvena aśvapṛṣṭhaṃ sarvato vyāptapṛṣṭham | pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ lakṣayati | vyāptakṛtsnāṅgamityarthaḥ | tvām | hiravadhāraṇe | tvāmeva nuṣardaneṣu nṛsadaneṣu | naro'śvarasya netāra ṛtvijo'tra sīdantīti nṛsadanā yajñāḥ | teṣu humhe vayamāhvayāmaḥ | kathamiva | grāvāṇaṃ na | yathā somābhiṣavārthaṃ grāvāṇaṃ stutibhirāhvayanti tadvatvāṃ stutibhirāhvayāmaḥ ||

śunāsīrīye 'sa tvaṃ no deva' ityeṣā vāyoranuvākyā| sūtritaṃ ca—'sa tvaṃ no deva manaseśā- nāya prabhṛti yasta ānaṭ' (āśva. śrau. 2. 20) iti|| sa tvaṃ nau deva mana̭sā vāyo mandāno a̭gniyaḥ | kudhi vājā~ apo dhiyaḥ ||25|| saḥ | tvam | naḥ | deva | mana̭sā | vāyo iti̭ | mandānaḥ | a̭priyaḥ | kudhi | vājān | apaḥ | dhiyaḥ || 25 || he deva dyotamāna yadvā stotavya vāyo a̭gniyaḥ devānāṃ madhye mukhyo'grato gantāsi | tādṛśaḥ tvaṃ manasā mandānaḥ mandamānaḥ svayameva modamānaḥ san naḥ asmākaṃ vājān annāni apaḥ meghabhedenoṭkāni ca ubhayasminnasravā pradatte sati dhiyaḥ abhihotrādikarmāṇi ca kudhi kuru | kāryetyarthaḥ | || 30 || 'amirukthe' iti drāviśatyṛcaṃ saptamaṃ sūktam | atrānukramaṇikā—'amirukthe dyadhikā manurvaiśva- svato vaiśvadevaṃ ha prāgātham' iti | vivasvataḥ putro manurṛṣiḥ | prathamātṛtīyādyayujo bṛhatyo dvitīyā- caturthyādiyujaḥ satobṛhatyaḥ | idamādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ sūktānāṃ viśva devā devatā | sūktaviniyogo laiṅgikaḥ || amirukthe purohito grāvāṇo bahi̭radhvare | ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspata‌i~ devā~ avo varḙṇyam || 1 || a̭gniḥ | ukthe | puraḥ'hitaḥ | grāvāṇaḥ | bahi̭ḥ | adhvare | ṛcā | yāmi | marutaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ | pati̭m | devān | avaḥ | varḙṇyam || 1 || manuḥ prārthayate | ukthe stotraśastrātmake adhvare hisārahite'smin yajñe agniḥ purohitaḥ yajñārthaṃ purata uttaravedyāstvigbhirnihito'bhūt | tathā grāvāṇaḥ ca somābhiśavārthaṃ purato nihitāḥ | bahiḥ ca purato nihitāsāditam | evaṃ sāmagryāṃ satyāṃ marutaḥ ekonapañcāśanmarudgaṇān brahmaṇa- spatiṃ stotrasya pālayitārametannāmakaṃ devaṃ devān indrādīṃśca etān sarvān devān vareṇyaṃ varaṇīyaṃ bhajanīyam avaḥ rakṣaṇam ṛcā sūkarūpayā stutyā yāmi manurahaṃ yāceāmi | yācaterlaṭi rūpam | varṇalopaśchāndasaḥ || ā paśuṃ gāsi pṛthivīṃ vanaspata‌ī~nupāsā naktamoṣadhīḥ | viśve ca no vasavo viśvavedaso dhīnāṃ bhūta prāvitāraḥ || 2 || ā | paśum | gāsi | pṛthivīm | vanaspatīn | upasā | naktam | oṣadhīḥ | viśve | ca | naḥ | vasavaḥ | viśva'vedasaḥ | dhīnām | bhūta | pra'avitāraḥ || 2 || pūrvārdhena'bhiḥ saṃbodhyate paścādiśabdasadbhāvāt | he agne no'smadīye yajñe paśum agnīṣomīyaṃ paśuṃ prati ā gāsi āgacchasi | 'gāi gatau' | vyatyayena parasmaipadam | tathā pṛthivīm idaṃ devasadanaṃ prati kiṃca vanaspatīn mathanasādhanānanurūpān vanaspatīn prati tathā upāsā hotavyatvena upaḥkālaṃ tathā naktaṃ yaṣṭavyatayā rātriṃ ca prati kiṃca oṣadhīḥ | 'upa dāhe' atra mādanakarmā | oṣanti mādanyanenetyoṣaḥ somaḥ | sa dhīyate nidhīyate yeṣvityoṣadhayo | tān pratyāgacchasi | yadvā | oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntā latāḥ | tāḥ pratyāyāhi | athavā he stotaḥ paścādīn 1. bha-saṃbhajanīyaṃ | 2. kha-tan-tī ca; śa-gamlṛ | 3. ta-bha-upasā |
tato he vasava: vāsayitāra: viśvavedasa: sarvadhanā: sarvajñānā vā he viśve sarve'pi devā: na: asmadīyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ prāvitāra: bhūta |
anenābhinā saha yūyaṃ prakarṣeṇa rakṣakā bhavata |
pra sū na etavvaro'yā deveṣu pūrvyaḥ |
ādityeṣu pra varuṇe dhṛtavrate marutsu viśvabhānuṣu ||
pra | su | naḥ | etu | adhvaraḥ | amrā | deveṣu | pūrvyaḥ | ādityeṣu | pra | varuṇe | dhṛtavrate | marutsu | viśvabhānuṣu || 3 ||
purvyān purātanānindrādīn devān prati kriyamāṇatvāt yajño'pi pūrvya ityucyate |
tādṛśo mukhyaḥ naḥ asmadīyaḥ adhvaraḥ yajñaḥ amrā |
tasminnamrau sarveṣvanyeṣu deveṣu ca su suṣṭhu pra etu prakarṣeṇa gacchatu |
ādityeṣu aditaḥ putreṣvindrādiṣu dhṛtavate dhṛta-karmaṇi varuṇe ca viśvabhānuṣu sarvato vyāptajeskeṣu marutsu ca pra etu ||
viśve hi ṣmā manave viśvavedaso bhuvanadhuve riśadasaḥ |
viśve | hi | sma | manave | viśva'vedasaḥ | bhuvana | dhuve | riśadasaḥ | ariṣṭebhiḥ | pāyubhiḥ | viśva'vedasaḥ | yantā | naḥ | avukam | chardiḥ || 4 ||
tādṛśāḥ riśadasaḥ riśatāṃ hiṃsatāṃ śatrūṇāmasitāra upakṣapayitāro vā viśve hi ṣma sarve khalu devāḥ manave |
stotre manuṣyāya dhanaṃ datvā taṃ vardhayantu ityāśāste |
tato he viśvavedasaḥ sarvadhanāḥ sarvajñā vā devāḥ ariṣṭebhiḥ parairahiṃsitaiḥ pāyubhiḥ pālanaiḥ saha avukam |
tādṛśaṃ chardiḥ gṛhaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ yanta prayacchata |
ā nau adya samanasau gantā viśve sajoṣasaḥ |
ṛcā girā maruto devyadite sardane pastyai mahi ||
ā | naḥ | adya | sa'manasaḥ | gantā | viśve | sa'joṣasaḥ | ṛcā | girā | marutaḥ | devi | adita | sardane | pastyai | mahi || 5 ||
samanasaḥ sarveṣu stotreṣu samānamanaskāḥ viśve sarve devā yūyaṃ sajoṣasaḥ parasparaṃ saṃgatāḥ santaḥ girā śuśrūṣutayā prāptavyetyarthaḥ |
tayā ṛcā saha atha asmin yāgadine naḥ yaṣṭṝn asmān ā ganta āgacchata |
anantaraṃ he marutaḥ devi dyotamāne mahi mahati devānāṃ

2. kha-jha-ta-1-2-bha-pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu apratibaddhagamanaḥ san śatruhananārthaṃ praviśati tadvat |
kiṃca yo yajamānaḥ devānāmindrādīnāṃ mana idvadhāraṇe; ga-pṛtanāsu devānāṃ mana it ityavadhāraṇe; ta3-4-na-pṛtanā idvadhāraṇe |

asadatra suvīryamuta tyadāśvarvyam | devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iryakṣatyubhīdaryajano bhuvat || 18 || asat | atra | suvīryam | uta | tyat | āśu'arvyam | devānām | yaḥ | in | manaḥ | yajamānaḥ | iryakṣati | abhi | in | aryajanaḥ | bhuvat ||18||
ᵥyaḥ ᵥyajamānaḥ ᵥdevānāṃ ᵥmanaḥ yaṣṭumicchati ᵥatra asmin yajamāne ᵥsuvīryaṃ śobhanavīryo- petaṃ putrādikam ᵥasat bhavatyeva |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥāśvarvyam āśugamanāśaśvaṃyuktaṃ ᵥtyat tadbanā- dikaṃ tasmin yajamāne bhavati |
devānāṃ mano yo jano havirbhiryaṣṭumicchati yadvā pūjayitumicchati sa janaḥ ᵥayajvanaḥ sarvānabhibhavatyeva ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśa ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye ṣaṣṭhāṣṭake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
'paraṃ gāyatraṃ prāvatsapreḥ' iti paribhāṣayā gāyatrī chandaḥ |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake śaunakena sūtritaṃ— 'pra kṛtāntyujīṣiṇa ā ghā ye abhimandhate' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 3) iti |
atirātre prathame paryāye maitrāvaruṇaśastre 'pra kṛtāni' iti tṛco'nurūpaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'pra va indrāya mādanaṃ' pra kṛtāntyujīṣiṇaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
sūyate hi— 'prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣaditi pañcadaśa' (āśva śrau. 6. 4) iti |
daśame'hani prātaḥsavane'cchāvākavāde patnīyajamānasthāne 'prati śrutāya' iti tṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣaditi tṛcau' (āśva. śrau. 8. 12) iti |
ahīnāntargatasyātirātrasya prathame paryāye hotuḥ 'panya idupa gāyata' ityanurūpaḥ ||
he ᵥkaṇvāḥ 2 ᵥṛjīṣiṇaḥ ṛjīṣavataḥ ᵥsomasya ᵥkṛtāni karmāṇi ᵥindrasya ᵥgāthayā indrasya vācā ᵥmade asya made saṃjāte sati ᵥpra ᵥvocata prabrūta ||

yaḥ | subindam | anarśinam | piprum | dāsam | ahīśubham | vardhīt | ugraḥ | riṇan | apaḥ ||2|| yaḥ indraḥ ugraḥ udvūrṇastejasvī vā saḥ apaḥ udakāni riṇan prerayan subindaṃ subinda- nāmakaṃ śatrum anarśinam anarśinanāmakaṃ pipruṃ piprunāmakaṃ ca dāsaṃ ca ahīśubhaṃ ca śatruṃ vadhīt jaghāna ||

nyarbudasya viṣṭapaṃ vṛṣmāṇaṃ bṛhattastira | kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam || 3 || ni | arbudasya | viṣṭapam | vṛṣmāṇam | bṛhataḥ | tira | kṛṣe | tat | indra | pauṃsyam || 3 || he indra bṛhataḥ mahataḥ arbudasya meghasya vṛṣmāṇaṃ udakasya vārakaṃ viṣṭapaṃ sthānaṃ ni tira vidhya | tat prasiddhaṃ pauṃsyaṃ vrataṃ ca kṛṣe kuru ||

prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣtūrṇīśaṃ na gireradhi | huve suśipramūtaye || 4 || prati | śrutāya | vaḥ | dhṛṣat | tūṇīśam | na | gireḥ | adhi | huve | suśipram | ūtaye ||4|| he stotāraḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ śrutāya stutīnāṃ śravaṇāya rakṣaṇāya ca dhṛṣat śatrūn dhṛṣantaṃ suśipraṃ suhanumindraṃ prati huve hvayāmi | tūṇīśaṃ na | yathā dharme'bhitaptaḥ pumāstūrṇīśamudakam | tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘ tūṇīśamudakaṃ bhavati tūrṇamaśrute ’ ( niru. 5. 16 ) iti | gireradhi meghaṃ prati hvayati | ‘ parvato giriḥ ’ iti meghanāmasu pāṭhāt | tadvadityarthaḥ ||

sa goraśvasya vi vrajaṃ mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ | puraṃ na śūra darpasi || 5 || saḥ | goḥ | aśvasya | vi | vrajam | mandānaḥ | somyebhyaḥ | puram | na | śūra | darpasi || 5 || he śūra indra saḥ prasiddhastvaṃ mandānaḥ modamānaḥ goḥ aśvasya ca vrajaṃ nivāsasthānaṃ somyebhyaḥ somāhebhyaḥ puraṃ na śatrūṇāṃ nagarīmiva vi darpasi vivṛddhadvāraṃ karoṣi || || 1 ||

yadi me śaraṇaḥ suta ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ | ārādupa svadhā gahi || 6 || yadi | me | raraṇaḥ | sute | ukthe | vā | dadhase | canaḥ | ārāt | upa | svadhā | ā | gahi ||6|| he indra me mama sute abhipute some ukthe stotre vā yadi rāraṇaḥ ramase canaḥ annaṃ yadi ca dadhase mahyaṃ prayacchasi tarhi ārāt dūrāt svadhā annena upa ā gahi upāgaccha ||

vayaṃ ghā te api smasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ | tvaṃ nau jinva somapāḥ ||7|| vayam | gha | te | api | smasi | stotāraḥ | indra | girvaṇaḥ | tvam | naḥ | jinva | somapāḥ ||7|| he girvaṇaḥ gīrbhirvandanīya indra te tava api vayaṃ gha vayaṃ khalu stotāraḥ smasi bhavāmaḥ | he somapāḥ somasya pātarindra tvaṃ naḥ asmān jinva prīṇayasi ||
uta naḥ pitumā bhara saṃrāṇe avikṣitam | maghavanbhūri te vasu || 8 || uta | naḥ | pitum | ā | bhara | sam'rāṇe | avi'kṣitam | maghavan | bhūri | te | vasu ||8||
^uta api ca he ^maghavan ^saṃrarāṇaḥ saṃramamāṇasvam ^avikṣitam avikṣīṇa ^pitum annam |
uta no gormataskṛdhi hiraṇyavato aśvinaḥ | iḻābhiḥ saṃ rabhemahi || 9 || uta | naḥ | go'mataḥ | kṛdhi | hiraṇya'vataḥ | aśvinaḥ | iḻābhiḥ | sam | rabhemahi || 9 ||
^uta api ca he indra ^naḥ asmān ^gomataḥ gobhinaḥ ^kṛdhi kuru |
bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe suprakaratnamutaye | sādhuṃ kṛṇvantamarvase || 10 || bṛbat'uktham | havāmahe | supra'karatnam | ūtaye | sādhum | kṛṇvantam | avase || 10 ||
^avase lokasya pālanāya ^sādhu ^kṛṇvantaṃ sādhu kurvantaṃ ^bṛbadukthaṃ mahadukthamindraṃ ^havāmahe hvayāmaḥ |
tathā ca yāskaḥ — ‘bṛbaduktho mahaduktho vaktavyamasmā uktham’ (niru. 6. 4) iti ||
yaḥ saṃsthe cicchatakraturādīṃ kṛṇoti vṛtrahā | jaritṛbhyaḥ puruvasuḥ || 11 || yaḥ | sam'sthe | cit | śata'kratuḥ | āt | īm | kṛṇoti | vṛtra'hā | jaritṛbhyaḥ | puru'vasuḥ || 11 ||
^yaḥ prasiddha indraḥ ^saṃsthe saṃgrāme ^śatakratuḥ bahukarmā bhavati api ca ^āt anantaram ^īm idaṃ śatruvadhādikaṃ ^kṛṇoti karoti ^cit eva ayamindraḥ ^vṛtrahā śatrūṇāṃ hantā bhavati |
sa neḥ śakraścidā śakrdārnavā~ antarābharaḥ | indro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ ||12|| saḥ | naḥ | śakraḥ | cit | ā | śakrat | dāna'vān | antara'ābharaḥ | indraḥ | viśvābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ || 12 ||
yo rāyo'vanirmehāntasupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā | tamindramabhi gāyata || 13 || yaḥ | rāyaḥ | avaniḥ | mahān | su'pāraḥ | sunvataḥ | sakhā | tam | indram | abhi | gāyata || 13 ||
^yaḥ indraḥ ^rāyaḥ dhanasya ^avaniḥ pālakaḥ ^mahān sarvottamaḥ ^supāraḥ śobhanapāraśca bhavati |
yaśca ^sunvataḥ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvato yajamānasya ^sakhā priyo bhavati |

ā॒ya॒ntāra̭ṃ ma॒hi sthi॒raṃ pṛ̭ta॒nāsu॒ śravo̭ji॒tam | bhū॒rīśā̭na॒moja̭sā || 14 || ā॒'ya॒ntāra̭m | ma॒hi | sthi॒ram | pṛ̭ta॒nāsṷ | śrava̭ḥ'ji॒tam | bhū॒reḥ | īśā̭nam | oja̭sā || 14 || ^āyantāram āgantāraṃ ^mahi mahāntaṃ ^pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu ^sthiram acalaṃ ^śravojitaṃ śravaso jetāram ^ojasā balena ^bhūraiḥ bahodhanasya ^īśānam īśvaramabhigāyata ||

naki̭rasya śa॒cīnā॒ṃ niya̭ntā su॒nṛtā̭nām | naki̭rva॒ktā na dā॒diti̭ || 15 || naki̭ḥ | a॒sya | śa॒cīnā̭m | ni'ya̭ntā | su॒nṛtā̭nām | naki̭ḥ | va॒ktā | na | dā॒t | iti̭ || 15 || ^asya indrasya ^sūnṛtānāṃ śobhanānāṃ ^śacīnāṃ karmaṇām | 'dhīḥ śacī' iti karmanāmasu pāṭhāt | ^nakiḥ na kaścit ^niyantā niyāmakaḥ | ayamindraḥ ^na ^dāditi na prayacchatīti ^nakirvaktā na kaścidvadati | kiṃtu sarvo'pi jano'yaṃ pradātetyeva bravītītyarthaḥ || || 3 ||

na nūnaṃ brahmaṇārpaṇaṃ prāśūnāmasti sunvatām | na somo̭ a॒pratā॒ papḙ || 16 || na | nūna̭m | bra॒hmaṇa̭ḥ'a॒rpam | prā॒śūnā̭m | a॒sti | su॒nvatā̭m | na | soma̭: | a॒pratā̭ | papḙ || 16 || ^prāśūnām | ye somaṃ prāpnuvanti te prāśavaḥ | teṣāṃ somaṃ ^sunvatāṃ ^brahmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇānām ^ṛṇaṃ devarṇaṃ ^na ^nūnam ^asti na khalu vidyate | tathā ca śrūyate— 'eṣa vā aṇuṇo yaḥ putrī yajvā brahmacārīvāsī' (tai. saṃ. 6. 3. 10. 5) iti | kiṃca ^apratā avistīrṇadhanena ^somaḥ ^na ^pape na pīyate | prabhūtadhanenaiva somaḥ pīyata ityarthaḥ ||

pa॒nya i̭du॒rpa gā̭ya॒ta pa॒nya u॒kthāni̭ śaṃsata | bra॒hmā kṛ̭ṇota॒ pa॒nya i̭t || 17 || pa॒nyaḥ | it | u॒rpa | gā॒ya॒ta | pa॒nyaḥ | u॒kthāni̭ | śa॒ṃsa॒ta | bra॒hmā | kṛ॒ṇo॒ta | pa॒nyaḥ | it || 17 || he upagātāraḥ ^panya ^it stutya evendre ^upa ^gāyata upagānaṃ kuruta | kiṃca ^panye^2 evendre ^ukthāni stotrāṇi ^śaṃsata | he stotāra iti śeṣaḥ | ^panye ^it stutya evendre brahmaṇyanyāni stotrāṇi ^kṛṇota kuruta ||

pa॒nya ā da̭di॒raccha॒tā sa॒hasrā̭ vā॒jyarva̭taḥ | i॒ndro yo ya॒rva̭no vṛ॒dhaḥ || 18 || pa॒nyaḥ | ā | da॒di॒rat | śa॒tā | sa॒hasrā̭ | vā॒jī | arva̭taḥ | i॒ndraḥ | yaḥ | ya॒rva̭naḥ | vṛ॒dhaḥ || 18 || ^yaḥ ^vājī balavān ^śatā vīrāṇāṃ śatāni ^sahasrā sahasrāṇi ca ^ā ^dadi॒rat ābhi- mukhyena dārayati so'yam ^indraḥ śatrubhiḥ ^arvataḥ ^panyaḥ stutyo bhavati | ^yajvanaḥ vidhiniṣṭavato yajamānasya ^vṛdhaḥ vardhayitā ca bhavati ||
vi pū॒ cara̭ sva॒dhā anṷ kṛ॒ṣṭīnā̭ma॒nvāhṷvaḥ | i॒ndra pi̭ba su॒tānā̭m || 19 || vi | su | cara̭ | sva॒dhā | anṷ | kṛ॒ṣṭīnā̭m | anṷ | ā॒'hu॒vaḥ | i॒ndra | pi॒ba | su॒tānā̭m || 19 ||
4. gha-pustake'sya mantrasya bhāṣyameva vidyate-he upagātāraḥ panya it stutya eva indrastasmin sāmāni upagāyata |
he hotāraḥ panye tasminnindre ukthāni stotrāṇi śaṃsata |
he adhvaryavaḥ panye it tasminnevendre brahmā ajñāni kṛṇota kuruta juhuta |
he ᵥindra ᵥāhuva: āhvātavyastvaṃ ᵥkṛṣṭīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ᵥsvadhā: havīṃṣi ᵥanu ᵥsu suṣṭhu ᵥvi ᵥcara|

piba svadhainavāmṛta yastudhye sarcā| utāyamindra yastarva || 20 || piba| svaᵥdhainavāṇām| uta| ya:| tudhye| sarcā| uta| ayam| indra| ya:| tarva ||20|| he ᵥindra ᵥsvadhainavānāṃ svadhainavān svabhūtapayaso dheno: saṃbandhana: somān| dhenvā krītāni- sthyartha:| tathā ca śrūyate—‘dhenvā krīṇāti’ (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 10. 2) iti| ᵥuta api ca ᵥya soma: ᵥtudhye udake| ‘bulaṃ tubhyam’ ityudakanāmasu pāṭhāt| ᵥsacā saṃsṛṣṭa: tamapi somaṃ ᵥpiba| ᵥuta api ca ᵥya: soma: ᵥtava tvadīya: tvāmuddiśya gṛhīta: sa: ᵥayaṃ tvayā pātavya iti śeṣa: || 4 ||

atīhi manyuṣāviṇaṃ suṣuvāṃsamupāraṇa| imaṃ rātaṃ sutaṃ piba || 21 || ati| ihi| manyuᵥsāvinam| susuᵥvāṃsam| upaᵥaraṇe| imam| rātam| sutam| piba ||21|| he indra ᵥmanyuṣāviṇaṃ krodhena somaṃ sunvantam ᵥatīhi atigaccha| tathā ᵥupāraṇe| brāhmaṇā upetya yasmin deśe na ramante sa upāraṇa:| tasmin deśe ᵥsupuvāṃsaṃ sunvantam atīhi| ᵥimaṃ ᵥrātaṃ brāhmaṇopadravarahite deśe asmābhirdattamitaṃ ᵥsutaṃ somaṃ ᵥpiba ||

ihi tisra: parāvata ihi pañca janā~ ati| dhenā indrāvacārkṣat || 22 || ihi| tisra:| parāᵥvata:| ihi| pañca| janān| ati| dhenā:| indra| avaᵥcārkṣat ||22|| he ᵥindra ᵥdhenā: asmadīyā: stutī: ᵥavaccukṛśat yo'paśyat sa tvaṃ ᵥparāvata: dūrāt| ‘āre parāvata:’ iti dūranāmasu pāṭhāt| ᵥtiṣṭha: agrapṛṣṭhapārśvadiśa: ᵥihi gaccha| anena agrata: pṛṣṭhata: pārśvataśca indrasyāgamanamāśāste| api ca ᵥpañca ᵥjanān manuṣyān ᵥati ᵥihi atigaccha| yadvā| gandharvā: pitaro devā asurā rakṣāṃsi ca pañcajanā:| tānatīhītyartha:| tathā ca yāska:—‘gandharvā: pitaro devā asurā rakṣāṃsītyeke catvāro varṇā niṣāda: pañcama ityaupamanyava:’ (niru. 3. 8) iti ||

sūryo raśmi yathā sujā tvā yacchantu me gira:| nimnamāpo na sadhryak || 23 || sūrya:| raśmim| yathā| suja| ā| tvā| yacchantu| me| gira:|| nimnam| āpa:| na| sadhryak || 23 || he indra ᵥsūrya: ᵥyathā ᵥraīima raśmīn kiraṇānaścapragrahān vā visṛjati tathā mahyaṃ dhanaṃ visṛja| api ca ᵥme madīyā: ᵥgira: stutaya: ᵥsadhyak saha tvām ᵥā ᵥyacchantu| ᵥnimnamāpo ᵥna| yathā nimnaṃ deśamāpa: saha parigṛhṇanti tadvadityartha: ||

adhvaryuvā tu hi viśva somaṃ vīrārya śipriṇe| bharā sutasya pītaye || 24 || adhvaryo iti| ā| tu| hi| siñca| somam| vīrārya| śipriṇe| bhara| sutasya| pītaye ||24|| he ᵥadhvaryo ᵥśipriṇe hanūmate ᵥvīrāya śūrāyendrāya ᵥsomaṃ ᵥtu ᵥhi kṣiprameva ᵥā ᵥsiñca| ᵥsutasya sutaṃ somaṃ ᵥpītaye pānāya ca ᵥbhara āhara ca ||
ya u॒graḥ phali̭gaṃ bhina॒tsi॒na॒dhrvāsṛ̭jat | yo go॒ṣu॒ pa॒kaṃ dhā॒raya̭t ||25|| yaḥ | u॒graḥ | phali̭gam | bhina॒t | nya̭k | si॒ndhūn | ava̭'asṛjat | yaḥ | go॒ṣṷ | pa॒kam | dhā॒raya̭t || 25 ||

payaḥ : 'ugraḥ udakārthaṃ 'phaligaṃ megham | 'raivataḥ phaligaḥ ' iti meghanāmasu pāṭhāt | 'bhinat abhinat | 'sindhūn apaśca antarikṣāt 'nyak arvāk 'avāsṛjat | 'yaḥ ca 'goṣu 'pakaṃ payaḥ 'dhārayat adhārayat | sa indra ityarthaḥ || 5 ||
a॒hanvṛ॒tramṛ̭cī॒ṣama॒rṇavā̭bhama॒hīśṷrvam | hi॒menā̭vidhya॒darbṷdam ||26|| a॒han | vṛ॒tram | ṛ॒cī॒ṣama̭ḥ | au॒rṇa'vā̭bham | a॒hī'śṷrvam | hi॒mena̭
‘ vayaṃ gha tvā ’ ityekonaviṃśatyṛcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya medhyātitherārṣaṃ bṛhatīcchandaskam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘ vayaṃ ghaikonā medhyātithirbārhataṃ trigāyatryanuṣṭubantam ’ iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake śaunakena sūyate—‘ vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta iti pañcadaśa mo ṣu tvā vāghataścane- tyetasya dvipadāṃ coddharati ’ ( ai. ā. 5. 2. 4 ) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyandinasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre ‘ vayaṃ gha tvā ’ iti tṛco vaikalpikaḥ stotriyaḥ |
tathā ca sūtraṃ—‘ vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ ka īṃ veda sute sacā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta iti tisro bṛhatyaḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 5 ) iti |
tasminneva śastre ‘ ka īṃ veda ’ iti vaikalpiko'nurūpaḥ |
vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
vayam | gha | tvā | suta'vantaḥ | āpaḥ | na | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | pavitrasya | pra'sravaṇeṣu | vṛtra'han | pari | stotāraḥ | āsate || 1 ||
he vṛtrahan indra tvā tvāṃ vayaṃ gha vayaṃ khalu sutāvantaḥ somamabhiputavantaḥ āpo na āpa iva pravaṇamabhigacchāmaḥ |
pavitrasya somānāṃ prasravaṇeṣu vṛktabarhiṣaḥ stīrṇabarhiṣaḥ stotāraḥ ca tvāṃ paryupāsate ||
svaranti tvā sute naro vasī nireka ukthinaḥ |
kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svandīva vaṃsagaḥ ||
svaranti | tvā | sute | naraḥ | vaso iti | nireke | ukthinaḥ | kadā | sutam | tṛṣāṇaḥ | okaḥ | ā | gamaḥ | indra | svandīva | vaṃsagaḥ || 2 ||
he vaso vāsayitarindra tvā tvāṃ sute abhipute some nireke nirgamane ukthinaḥ naraḥ netāraḥ svaranti śabdayante |
api cendraḥ sutaṃ somaṃ prati tṛṣāṇaḥ tṛṣyan svandīva svabhūtaśabda iva vaṃsagaḥ vanarnāyagamano vṛṣabhaḥ śabdaṃ kurvan kadā okaḥ sthānam ā gamata ||
kaṇvaibhiḥ | vṛṣṇe iti | ā | dhṛṣat | vājam | darṣi | sahasriṇam | piśaṅga'rūpam | maghavan | vi'carṣaṇe | makṣu | go'mantam | īmahe || 3 ||
sahasriṇaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākaṃ vājam ā darṣi dehi |

hāridraveva patatho vanedupa somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ | sajorṣā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trivartiryātamaśvinā || 7 || hāridravā'iva | patathaḥ | vanā | it | upa | somam | sutam | mahiṣā'iva | ava | gacchathaḥ | sa'jorṣā | uṣasā | sūryeṇa | ca | triḥ | vartiḥ | yātam | aśvinā || 7 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ ᵥsutam abhiputaṃ ᵥsomam ᵥupa ᵥpatathaḥ ᵥhāridravāviva⁵ yathā hāridravau pakṣiṇau ᵥvanā vanānyūdakānī' | 'vāḥ vanam' ityudakanāmasu pāṭhāt | upapataḥ | tadvadityarthaḥ | ᵥmahiṣāviva⁶ yathā viprāsitau mahiṣāvudakanyupagacchataḥ ᵥtathā ᵥsutaṃ ᵥsomam ᵥava ᵥgacchathaḥ | ᵥupasā ᵥsūryeṇa ᵥca saṃgatau ᵥtrivartiḥ trimārgaṃ ᵥyātaṃ ca ||
