haṃsāviva patatho adhvagāviva somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāvaṃ gacchathaḥ | sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa ca trivṛttīrthītamimanā || 8 || haṃsau'iva | patathaḥ | adhvagau'iva | somam | sutam | mahiṣā'iva | arve | gacchathaḥ | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | triḥ | vṛtiḥ | yātam | aśvinā || 8 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ haṃsāviva yathā haṃsau adhvagāviva yathā ca pathikāvudakaṃ gacchataḥ tathā vegena sutaṃ somaṃ patathaḥ | siddhamanyat ||

iyenāviva patatho havyadāṃtaye somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāvaṃ gacchathaḥ | sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa ca trivṛttīrthītamimanā || 9 || iyenau'iva | patathaḥ | havya'dāṃtaye | somam | sutam | mahiṣā'iva | arve | gacchathaḥ | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | triḥ | vṛtiḥ | yātam | aśvinā || 9 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ iyenāviva yathā iyenau gaganaṃ gacchataḥ tathā vegena sutaṃ somaṃ havyadāṃtaye yajamānārthaṃ patathaḥ | siddhamanyat ||

pibaṃtaṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ cā caṃ gacchataṃ prajāṃ ca dhṛtaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam | sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa cojaṃ no dhattamaśvinā || 10 || pibaṃtam | ca | tṛpṇutam | ca | ā | ca | gacchatam | prajāṃ | ca | dhṛtam | draviṇam | ca | dhattam | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | ūrjam | naḥ | dhattam | aśvinā || 10 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ somaṃ pibaṃtaṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ ca tṛpyataṃ ca | pānārthaṃ tṛpyataṃ ca ā gacchatam | somaṃ pītvā tṛptau saṃntau yuvāmasmabhyaṃ prajāṃ ca dhṛtaṃ dhārayatam | draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ ca dhattam | upasā sūryeṇa ca saṃgatau naḥ asmabhyaṃ ūrjaṃ balaṃ ca dhattam ||

jayaṃtaṃ ca pra stṛtaṃ ca pra cāvataṃ prajāṃ ca dhṛtaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam | sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa cojaṃ no dhattamaśvinā || 11 || jayaṃtam | ca | pra | stṛtam | ca | pra | ca | avatam | prajāṃ | ca | dhṛtam | draviṇam | ca | dhattam | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | ūrjam | naḥ | dhattam | aśvinā || 11 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ jayaṃtaṃ śatrūna ca jayatam | pra stṛtaṃ stotṛn ca pra cāvatam asmāṃśca prarakṣatam | anyat siddham ||
hataṃ ca śatrūnyatataṃ ca mitriṇaḥ prajāṃ ca dhṛtaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam |
sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa cojaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||

hṛtam | ca | śatrūn | yatatam | ca | mitriṇaḥ | pra'jām | ca | dhattam | draviṇam | ca | dhattam | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | ūrjam | naḥ | dhattam | aśvinā || 12 || he aśvinau yuvāṃ vaśatrūn vaca hatam | utāpi ca vayatataṃ vamitriṇaḥ maitriyuktān vaca gaccha- tam | siddhamanyat || || 15 ||

mitrāvaruṇavantā uta dharmavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam | sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā || 13 || mitrāvaruṇa'vantau | uta | dharma'vantā | marutvantā | jarituḥ | gacchathaḥ | havam | sa'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | ādityaiḥ | yātam | aśvinā || 13 || vauta api ca he aśvinau yuvāṃ vamitrāvaruṇavantā mitrāvaruṇayuktau vadharmavantā dharmayuktau ca vamarutvantā marunmiyuktau ca vajarituḥ sto
he aśvinau yuvāṃ vbrahma brāhmaṇaṃ vjinvataṃ prīṇayatam |
vuta api ca vdhiyaḥ karmāṇi vjinvatam |
vupasā vsūryeṇa vca saṃgatau vsunvataḥ yajamānasya vsomaṃ pibatamityarthaḥ |
kṣetraṃ jinvatamuta jinvataṃ nṛnhataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ |
sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā |
kṣetram | jinvatama | uta | jinvatama | nṛn | hatam | rakṣāṃsi | sedhatam | amīvāḥ | su'joṣasau | upasā | sūryeṇa | ca | somam | sunvataḥ | aśvinā || 17 ||
he aśvinau yuvāṃ vkṣatra kṣatriyaṃ vjinvataṃ | vuta api ca vnṝn yoddhṝn vjinvataṃ | siddhamanyat ||
dhenurjinvatamuta jinvataṃ viśoṃ hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ |
sajoṣasā upasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā |

raśmī̭riva yacchatamadhva॒ra~ upa̭ śyā॒vāśva̭sya sunva॒to mada̭cyutā | sajo̭ṣasā u॒ṣasa॒ḥ sūryḙṇa cāśvinā tiro̭ahyam || 21 || raśmīn'i̭va | yacchatam | a॒dhva॒rān | upa̭ | śyā॒va'a̭śvasya | sunva̭taḥ | mada̭cyutā | sa'jo̭ṣasau | u॒ṣasā̭ | sūryḙṇa | ca | a॒śvinā̭ | tira̭ḥ'a̭hyam || 21 || he aśvinau' śyāvāśvasya mama 'adhvarān' raśmīniva yathāpragrahāṃstadvat 'upa' 'yacchatam' upagacchatam | siddhamanyat ||

a॒rvāgratha॒ṃ ni ya̭cchataṃ piba̭taṃ somya॒ṃ madhṷ | ā yā̭tamaśvinā gaṃtamava॒suvī̭ma॒haṃ hṷve dhatta॒ṃ ratnā̭ni dā॒śuṣḙ || 22 || a॒rvāk | ratha̭m | ni | ya̭cchatam | piba̭tam | so॒myam | madhṷ | ā | yā̭tam | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga̭tam | a॒va॒suḥ | vā॒m | a॒ham | hu॒ve | dha॒ttam | ratnā̭ni | dā॒śuṣḙ || 22 || he aśvinau vāṃ svīyaṃ 'ratham' 'arvāk' asmadabhimukhaṃ 'ni' 'yacchatam' | 'somyaṃ' somamayaṃ 'madhu' amṛtaṃ ca 'pibatam' | 'yajñam' 'ā' 'yātaṃ ca' | somaṃ prati 'ā' 'gatam' āgacchataṃ ca | 'avasuḥ' rakṣaṇakāmaḥ 'ahaṃ' śyāvāśvaḥ 'vāṃ' 'huve' hvayāmi | 'dāśuṣe' havīṃṣi prayacchate mahyaṃ 'ratnāni' 'dhattaṃ' dhārayatam ||

namo̭vāke prasthite a॒dhva॒re na̭rā viva̭kṣaṇasya pī॒tayḙ | ā yā̭tamaśvinā gaṃtamava॒suvī̭ma॒haṃ hṷve dhatta॒ṃ ratnā̭ni dā॒śuṣḙ || 23 || namo̭'vāke | pra'sthi̭te | a॒dhva॒re | na॒rā | viva̭kṣaṇasya | pī॒tayḙ | ā | yā̭tam | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga̭tam | a॒va॒suḥ | vā॒m | a॒ham | hu॒ve | dha॒ttam | ratnā̭ni | dā॒śuṣḙ || 23 || he aśvinau 'narā' netārau yuvāṃ 'vivakṣaṇasya' havanaśīlasya' mama 'prasthite' 'namovāke' | namaskārāya procyate sa namovākaḥ | tasmin 'adhvare' yajñe | tathā ca brāhmaṇam—'ubhayaṃ saha vā etadyajña eva yassūktavākaśca namovākaśca' ( śa. brā. 1. 9. 1. 4 ) iti | 'pītaye' somapānāya 'ā' 'yātam' | siddhamanyat ||

svāhā̭kṛtasya tṛmpataṃ su॒tasya̭ de॒vāva̭ndhasaḥ | ā yā̭tamaśvinā gaṃtamava॒suvī̭ma॒haṃ hṷve dhatta॒ṃ ratnā̭ni dā॒śuṣḙ || 24 || svāhā̭'kṛtasya | tṛ॒mpa॒tam | su॒tasya̭ | de॒vau | a॒ndhasa̭ḥ | ā | yā̭tam | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga̭tam | a॒va॒suḥ | vā॒m | a॒ham | hu॒ve | dha॒ttam | ratnā̭ni | dā॒śuṣḙ || 24 || he aśvinau 'devau' yuvāṃ 'sutasya' abhiṣutasya 'svāhākṛtasya' hutasya 'andhasaḥ' somasya 'tṛmpataṃ' tṛpyatam | siddhamanyat || || 17 ||
1. gha-aśvinau madacyutā śatrūṇāṃ madasya cyāvayitārau yuvāṃ sunvataḥ |

janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ piba somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jayaḥ samapsujinamarutvā~ indra satvate ||4|| janitā | divaḥ | janitā | pṛthivyāḥ | piba | somam | madāya | kam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | yam | te | bhāgam | adhārayan | viśvāḥ | sehānaḥ | pṛtanāḥ | uru | jayaḥ | sam | apsu'jit | marutvān | indra | satva'pate || 4 || he indra tvaṃ divaḥ dyulokasya janitā janako'si | pṛthivyāḥ ca janitā asi | siddhamanyat ||

janitāśvānāṃ janitā gavāmasi piba somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jayaḥ samapsujinamarutvā~ indra satvate ||5|| janitā | aśvānām | janitā | gavām | asi | piba | somam | madāya | kam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | yam | te | bhāgam | adhārayan | viśvāḥ | sehānaḥ | pṛtanāḥ | uru | jayaḥ | sam | apsu'jit | marutvān | indra | satva'pate || 5 || he indra tvam aśvānāṃ janitā janakaḥ asi | gavāṃ ca janitā asi | siddhamanyat ||

atrīṇāṃ stomamadrivo mahaskṛdhi piba somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jayaḥ samapsujinamarutvā~ indra satvate ||6|| atrīṇām | stomam | adrivaḥ | mahaḥ | kṛdhi | piba | somam | madāya | kam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | yam | te | bhāgam | adhārayan | viśvāḥ | sehānaḥ | pṛtanāḥ | uru | jayaḥ | sam | apsu'jit | marutvān | indra | satva'pate || 6 || he adrivaḥ adriman atrīṇāṃ stomaṃ mahaskṛdhi pūjitaṃ kuru | siddhamanyat ||

śyāvāśvasya sunvattathā śṛṇu yathāśrṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ | pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka iṣupā indra brahmāṇi vardhayan ||7|| śyāva'aśvasya | sunvataḥ | tathā | śṛṇu | yathā | aśṛṇoḥ | atreḥ | karmāṇi | kṛṇvataḥ | pra | trasadasyum | āvidha | tvam | ekaḥ | it | nṛ'sahau | indra | brahmāṇi | vardhayan || 7 || he indra tvaṃ sunvataḥ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvataḥ śyāvāśvasya mama stutiṃ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ kurvataḥ atreḥ yathāśṛṇoḥ aśrauṣīḥ tathā śṛṇu | api ca tvameka it eka eva nṛṣāhe yuddhe brahmāṇi stotrāṇi kāmaiḥ vardhayan trasadasyuṃ pra āvidha ||
‘predaṃ brahma’ iti saptacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktamātrayasya śyāvāśvasyārṣam |
tathā ca sūtraṃ—'predaṃ brahmaṇvo madāya' (āśva. śrau. 7. 12) iti ||
predaṃ brahma̭ vṛtratūrye॒ṣvāvi̭tha pra su॒nva॒taḥ | śacī̭pata indra॒ viśvā̭bhirū॒tībhi̭ḥ || 1 || mādhya̭ndinasya | sa॒rva॒na॒sya | vṛ॒tra॒ha॒n | e॒dya॒ | piba̭ | so॒ma॒sya | va॒jri॒vaḥ || 1 ||
he śacīpate indra tvaṃ vṛtratūryeṣu saṃgrāmeṣu idaṃ brahma imān brāhmaṇān viśvābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ2 rakṣābhiḥ pra āviya prarakṣa |
sunvataḥ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvato yajamānāṃśca pra āviya |
api ca he anedya aninya vajrivaḥ vajrin vṛtrahan indra mādhyandinasya savanasya saṃbandhanaṃ somasya somaṃ piba ||
sehānaṃ u॒graṃ pṛ̭ta॒nā a॒bhi dṷhaḥ śacī̭pata indra॒ viśvā̭bhirū॒tībhi̭ḥ ||

kṣemasya ca prayujaśca tvamīśiṣe śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya sarvasya vṛtrahannanedha pibā somasya vajrivaḥ || 5 || kṣemasya | ca | pra'yujaḥ | | ca | tvam | īśiṣe | śacī'pate | indra | viśvābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya | sarvasya | vṛtra'han | anedha | piba | somasya | vajri'vaḥ || 5 ||
api ca he śacīpate indra sarvasya jagataḥ kṣemasya prayujaśca prayogasya ca |

kṣatrāya tvamarvasi na tvamāvitha śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya sarvasya vṛtrahannanedha pibā somasya vajrivaḥ || 6 || kṣatrāya | tvam | avasi | na | tvam | āviṣa | śacī'pate | indra | viśvābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya | sarvasya | vṛtra'han | anedha | piba | somasya | vajri'vaḥ || 6 ||
he śacīpate indra tvaṃ kṣatrāya jagato balāya bhavasi |
tvaṃ na āviya kenāpi na rakṣyase |

iyāvāśvasya rebhatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇotreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ | pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka inupāhā indra kṣatrāṇi vardhayan || 7 || iyāva'aśvasya | rebhataḥ | tathā | śṛṇu | yathā | aśṛṇoḥ | atreḥ | karmāṇi | kṛṇvataḥ | pra | trasadasyum | āviṣa | tvam | ekaḥ | ita | nu'sahyai | indra | kṣatrāṇi | vardhayan ||7||
he indra rebhataḥ stuvataḥ iyāvāśvasya mama stutiṃ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ atreḥ yathā aśṛṇoḥ tathā śṛṇu |
api ca kṣatrāṇi balāni kāmaiḥ vardhayan yuddhe tvamekaḥ eva trasadasyuṃ pra āviya ||
'yajñasya hi' iti daśarcamamaṃ sūktaṃ iyāvāśvasyārṣaṃ gāyatramindrāgni- devatākam |
sūtritaṃ ca—'yajñasya hi stha ityacchāvākasya' (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani prātaḥsavane 'yajñasya hi sthaḥ' iti ṣaḻahastomatriyasaṃjñakattvaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'indrāgnī yuvāmimaṃ yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijatyacchāvākasya' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti |
sūyate hi—'iyāvāśvasya sunvat iti tṛcāḥ paryāsāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti ||
yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā sastrī vājeṣu karmasu | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam || 1 || yajñasya | hi | sthaḥ | ṛtvijā | sastrī | vājeṣu | karmasu | indrāgnī iti | tasya | bodhatam ||1||

he ᵥindrāgnī ᵥsakhī śuddhau yuvāṃ ᵥyajñasya ᵥṛtvijā ᵥṛtvijau ᵥsthaḥ bhavathaḥ ᵥhi| ᵥvājeṣu yuddheṣu ᵥkarmasu copatiṣṭhantāvindrāgnī ᵥtasya taṃ māṃ tasya mama stutiṃ vā ᵥbodhataṃ jānītam || tośāsā rthayāvānā vṛtrahaṇāparājitā | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam || 2 || tośāsā | ratha'yāvānāṃ | vṛtra'hanā | aparā'jitā | indrāgnī iti | tasya | bodhatam || 2 || he ᵥindrāgnī ᵥtośāsā śatrūna hiṃsantau ᵥrathayāvānā rathena gacchantau ᵥvṛtrahaṇā vṛtrasya hantārau ᵥaparājitā kenāpyaparājitau ᵥtasya taṃ māṃ ᵥbodhatam || idaṃ vāṃ madiraṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhinaraiḥ | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam || 3 || idam | vām | madiram | madhu | adhukṣan | adri'bhiḥ | naraiḥ | indrāgnī iti | tasya | bodhatam || 3 || he ᵥindrāgnī ᵥvāṃ yuvāmuddiśya ᵥnaraḥ yajñasya netāraḥ ᵥadribhiḥ grāvabhiḥ ᵥmadiraṃ madakaraṃ ᵥmadhu somātmakamatṛtam ᵥadhukṣan apūrayan | siddhamantyat || juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭayai sutaṃ somaṃ sadhastutī | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā || 4 || juṣethām | yajñam | iṣṭayai | sutam | somam | sadhastutī iti sadha'stutī | indrāgnī iti | ā | gatam | narā || 4 || he ᵥsadhastutī sahabhūtastutī ᵥnarā netārau ᵥindrāgnī ᵥyajñaṃ ᵥjuṣethāṃ sevethām | ᵥiṣṭaye yāgāya ᵥsutam abhiputaṃ ᵥsomaṃ ca ᵥā ᵥgatam āgacchatam || imā juṣethāṃ sarvanā yebhirhavyān yūhathuḥ | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā || 5 || imā | juṣethām | sarvanā | yebhiḥ | havyāni | ūhathuḥ | indrāgnī iti | ā | gatam | narā || 5 || he ᵥindrāgnī ᵥnarā netārau yuvāṃ ᵥyebhiḥ yeḥ savanaiḥ ᵥhavyāni ᵥūhathuḥ vahathaḥ tāni ᵥimā imāni ᵥsavanā savanāni ᵥjuṣethāṃ sevethām | ᵥā ᵥgataṃ ca || imāṃ gāyatravartaniṃ juṣethāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā || 6 || imām | gāyatra'vartanim | juṣethām | su'stutim | mama | indrāgnī iti | ā | gatam | narā || 6 || he ᵥindrāgnī narau yuvāṃ ᵥmama ᵥgāyatravartaniṃ gāyatramārgān ᵥimāṃ ᵥsuṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ ᵥjuṣethāṃ sevethām | ᵥā ᵥgataṃ ca || || 20 || prātaryāvabhirgātaṃ devebhirjenyāvasū | indrāgnī somapītaye || 7 || prātaryāva'bhiḥ | ā | gatam | devebhiḥ | jenyāvasū iti | indrāgnī iti | soma'pītaye || 7 || he ᵥjenyāvasū jetavyaśatrudhanau ᵥindrāgnī ᵥprātaryāvabhiḥ devaiḥ saha ᵥsomapītaye somasya pānāya ᵥā ᵥgatam āgacchatam || śyāvāśvasya sunvato'strīṇāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havam | indrāgnī somapītaye || 8 || 1. ga-ta-na-bha- 'yebhiḥ' nāsti|

śyāva'aśvasya | sunvataḥ | atrīṇām | śṛṇutam | havam | indrāgnī iti | soma'pītaye || 8 || he indrāgnī yuvāṃ sunvataḥ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvato yajamānasya śyāvāśvasya mama atrīṇām ṛtvijāṃ havam āhvānaṃ somasya pānāya śṛṇutam ||

evā vāmaha ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ | indrāgnī somapītaye || 9 || eva | vām | ahe | ūtaye | yathā | ahuvanta | medhirāḥ | indrāgnī iti | soma'pītaye || 9 || he indrāgnī vāṃ yuvāṃ yathā medhirāḥ prājñāḥ ahuvanta āhūtavantaḥ evamaham ūtaye rakṣaṇāya somasya pītaye ca ahe hvayāmi ||

āhaṃ sarasvatītorendrāmyoravau vṛṇe | yābhyāṃ gāyatramucyate || 10 || ā | aham | sarasvatī'vatoḥ | indrāgnyoḥ | avaḥ | vṛṇe | yābhyām | gāyatram | ṛcyate || 10 || yābhyāṃ yayorindrāgnyorartha gāyatraṃ sāma ṛcyate stūyate tayoḥ sarasvatīvatoḥ stutimatoḥ indrāgnyoḥ saṃbandha ava rakṣaṇam aham ā vṛṇe || || 21 || ‘abhimstoṣi’ iti daśacaṃ navamaṃ sūkaṃ kāṇvasya nābhākasyārṣam | ṣaḍṛcā mahāpaṅkti- śchandaḥ | agnirdevatā | anukrāntaṃ ca—‘abhimstoṣi nābhāka ātreyaṃ mahāpāṅktaṃ hi’ iti | viniyogo laiṅgikaḥ ||

agnimastoṣyugmiyamimīḻā yajadhyai | agnidevā a̭naktu na ubhe hi vidathai kavirantaścarati dūtya̭ṃ | nabhantāmanyake same ||11|| agnim | astoṣi | ṛgmiyam | agnim | īḻā | yajadhyai | agniḥ | devān | anaktu | naḥ | ubhe iti | hi | vidathe iti | kaviḥ | antariti | carati | dūtyam | nabhantām | anyake | same || 1 || ṛgmiyam arham agnim astoṣi staumi | api ca agni yajadhyai yaṣṭum īḻā stutyā staumītyarthaḥ | api ca agniḥ naḥ asmākaṃ vidathe yajñe devān havirbhiḥ anaktu | kaviḥ krāntadarśabhiḥ ubhe dyāvāpṛthivyau antaḥ dūtyaṃ havirvahanādilakṣaṇaṃ dūtakarma carati | anyake śatravo'pi same sarve nabhantām | nabhatihiṃsākarmā | agninā hiṃsyantām ||

nyagne narvasā varcastanuṣu śaṃsameṣām | nyarātī rarāṇāṃ viśvā aryo arātīrito yucchantvāmuro nabhantāmanyake same ||2|| ni | agne | narvasā | varcaḥ | tanūṣu | śaṃsam | eṣām | ni | arātīḥ | rarāṇām | viśvāḥ | aryaḥ | arātīḥ | itaḥ | yucchantu | ā'suraḥ | nabhantām | anyake | same || 2 || he agne tanūṣu asmākamdeṣu narvasā navatareṇa vacaḥ vacasā stotreṇa eṣāṃ śatrūṇāṃ śaṃsaṃ śaṃsanaṃ ni dahetyarthaḥ | rarāṇāṃ haviḥ prayacchatām arātīḥ śatrūṃśca ni daha | api ca viśvāḥ sarve aryaḥ abhigacchantaḥ āsuraḥ āmuḍhāḥ arātīḥ śatravaḥ itaḥ yucchantu gacchantu | siddhyanmat ||

agne manmāni tubhyaṃ kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na juhva āsani | sa deveṣu pra cikiddhi tvaṃ hyasi pūrvyaḥ śivo dūto vivasvato nabhantāmanyake same||3|| agne | manmāni | tubhyam | kam | ghṛtam | na | juhve | āsani | saḥ | deveṣu | pra | cikiddhi | tvam | hi | asi | pūrvyaḥ | śivaḥ | dūtaḥ | vivasvataḥ | nabhantām | anyake | same || 3 ||
he agne tubhyaṃ svadartham āsani āsye kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na yathā sukhakaraṃ ghṛtaṃ juhvatyanye tadvadaha- mapi tavāste manmāni mananīyāni stotrāṇi juhve juhomi |
saḥ tvaṃ deveṣu devānāṃ madhye pra cikiddhi asmadīyāḥ stutīrjānīhi |
api ca tvaṃ pūrvyaḥ pratnaḥ asi |

tacchuirvaryo dadhe yathāyathā kṛpuṇyati | ūrjāhutirvasūnāṃ śaṃ ca yośca mayo dadhe viśvasyai devahūtayai nabhantāmanyake same || 4 || tat | tata | agniḥ | vayaḥ | dadhe | yathā'yathā | kṛpuṇyati | ūrjā'āhutiḥ | vasūnām | śam | ca | yoḥ | ca | mayaḥ | dadhe | viśvasyai | devahūtayai | nabhantām | anyake | same || 4 ||
yathāyathā yadannaṃ kṛpuṇyati stotṛbhiryācyate tattat vayaḥ agniḥ dadhe stotṛbhyaḥ praya- cchati |
api ca ūrjāhutiḥ agnenāhūyamāno'gniḥ vasūnāṃ haviṣāṃ vāsakānāṃ yajamānānāṃ śaṃ śāntinimittaṃ yoḥ vipayayogajanitaṃ ca mayaḥ sukhaṃ dadhe karoti |
viśvasyai devahūtayai sarvasmai devānāṃ hvānāya ca bhavati |
yaḥ kaścanāpi devo yadi hūyate abhiraiva sarvaṃ karotītyarthaḥ |

sa ciketa sahīyasābhidhṛtreṇa karmaṇā | sa hotā śaśvatīnāṃ dakṣiṇābhirdhṛta iinoti ca pratīvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||5|| saḥ | ciketa | sahīyasā | agniḥ | citreṇa | karmaṇā | saḥ | hotā | śaśvatīnām | dakṣiṇābhiḥ | abhidhṛtaḥ | inoti | ca | pratīvyam | nabhantām | anyake | same || 5 ||
saḥ agniḥ sahīyasā abhibhāvukena citreṇa nānāvidhena karmaṇā vyāpāreṇa ciketa jñāyate |
saḥ agniḥ śaśvatīnāṃ bahūnāṃ devatānāṃ hotā hvātā dakṣiṇābhiḥ paśubhiśca abhidhṛtaḥ parivṛtaḥ pratīvyaṃ pratyetyavyaṃ śatrum inoti ca gacchati ca |

agnirjātā devānāṃmagnirveda martanāmapīcyam | agniḥ sa draviṇodā agnirdārā vyūrṇute svāhuto navīyasā nabhantāmanyake same ||6|| agniḥ | jātā | devānām | agniḥ | veda | martanām | apīcyam | agniḥ | saḥ | draviṇaḥdāḥ | agniḥ | dvārā | vi | ūrṇute | su'āhutaḥ | navīyasā | nabhantām | anyake | same || 6 ||
vdevānāṃ vjātā jātāni janmāni vagniḥ vetti'|
vmatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca vapīcyam guhyam vagniḥ vveda vetti |
vnavīyasā navatareṇa haviṣā vsvāhutaḥ samyaghutaḥ vagniḥ vdvārā dhanasya dvārāṇi vnyūrṇute ca |
sa mu॒dā kā॒vyā puru॒ viśva̭ṃ bhū॒meva̭ pu॒ṣyati̭ de॒vo de॒veṣṷ ya॒jñiyo॒ nabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||

a॒gniḥ | de॒veṣṷ | sa॒m'va̭suḥ | saḥ | vi॒kṣu | ya॒jñiyā̭su | ā | saḥ | mu॒dā | kā॒vyā | purṷ | viśva̭m | bhū॒mi'i̭va | pu॒ṣyati̭ | de॒vaḥ | de॒veṣṷ | ya॒jñiya̭ḥ | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 7 ||
vsaḥ agniḥ vyajñiyāsu yajñārhāsu vvikṣu prajāsvapi saṃvasuḥ3 |
kiṃca vsaḥ agniḥ vpuru bahūni vkāvyā karmāṇi vbhūmeva yathā bhūmiḥ vviśvaṃ tathā vmudā modena vpuṣyati |
vdeveṣu madhye vdevaḥ agniḥ vyajñiyaḥ yajñārhaśca bhavati |
yo a॒gniḥ sa॒ptamā̭nuṣaḥ śri॒to viśvḙṣu si॒ndhuṣṷ |
tamā̭ga॒nma tri॒pasya̭ṃ ma॒ndhātṷrda॒syuha̭nta॒magniṃ ya॒jñeṣṷ pu॒ṇyaṃ nabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||

yaḥ | a॒gniḥ | sa॒pta'mā̭nuṣaḥ | śri॒taḥ | viśvḙṣu | si॒ndhuṣṷ | tam | ā | a॒ga॒nma | tri॒'pasya̭m | ma॒ndhātṷḥ | da॒syu'ha̭nta॒mam | a॒gnim | ya॒jñeṣṷ | pu॒ṇyam | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 8 ||

vyo'gniḥ vsaptamānuṣaḥ4 vviśveṣu sarveṣu vsindhuṣu nadīṣu vśritaḥ vtripasyaṃ tristhānaṃ vmandhātuḥ yauvanāśvasya māndhātuḥ vdasyuhantaṃ dasyunāṃ hantāraṃ vyajñeṣu vpūdhyaṃ mukhyaṃ vtam vagniṃ vayam vāganma |
sa trī̭re॒kāda̭śā i॒ha yakṣa̭cca pi॒praya̭cca no vi॒pro dū॒taḥ pari̭ṣkṛto nabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||

a॒gniḥ | trīṇi̭ | tri॒'dhātṷnā | kṣeti̭ | vi॒dā | ka॒viḥ | saḥ | trīn | e॒kāda̭śān | i॒ha | ya॒kṣat | ca॒ | pi॒praya̭t | ca॒ | naḥ | vi॒praḥ | dū॒taḥ | pari̭'kṛtaḥ | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 9 ||
vkaviḥ kāntadarśī vagniḥ vtrīṇi tridhātūni tribandhanādīni pṛthivyādīni vvidā vedanī- yāni sthānāni vā vkṣeti āvasati |
api ca vsaḥ agniḥ vdūtaḥ devānāṃ vvipraḥ prājñaḥ vpariṣkṛtaḥ alaṃkṛtaśca san viha yajñe vtrīnekādaśān trayastriṃśaddevān vyakṣat yajatu |
vnaḥ asmān vpiprayacca kāmaiḥ pūrayatu ca |
1. kha-gha-jña-ta1-2-veda veti | 2. kha-ta-na-he deveṣu; ga-śa-yaḥ deveṣu | 3. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa- ā saṃvamuḥ | 4. gha-saptamānuṣaḥ saptahotā | 5. ta-na-mukhaṃ |
tvaṃ nau ag‍na āyṷṣu॒ tvaṃ de॒veṣṷ pū॒rvyaṃ va॒sva eka̭ irajyasi |
tvā॒māpa̭: pari̭sruta॒ḥ pari̭ yanti॒ svasai̭tavo॒ nabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||
tvam | naḥ | ag‍ne | āyṷṣu | tvam | de॒veṣṷ | pū॒rvyam | va॒svaḥ | eka̭: | i॒ra॒jya॒si | tvām | ā॒paḥ | pari̭srutaḥ | pari̭ | ya॒nti॒ | svasai̭tavaḥ | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 10 ||
he pū॒rvya ag‍ne tvam ekaḥ eva āyṷṣu manuṣyeṣu |
naḥ asmākaṃ vasvaḥ dhanasya irajyasi īśiṣe |
deveṣu api tvam eka eva vasva irajyasi |
api ca tvāṃ svasetavaḥ svabhūtasetavaḥ parisrutaḥ parisravantyaḥ āpaḥ pari yanti parigacchanti |
'indrāgnī yuvam' iti dvādaśarcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ nābhākasyārṣam |
dvitīyā ṣaṭpañcāśadakṣarā śakvarī dvādaśī triṣṭup śiṣṭā mahāpaṅktayaḥ |
tathā cānukrāntam—'indrāgnī dvādaśendrābhaṃ triṣṭubantaṃ dvitīyā śakvarī' iti |
tathā ca pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam—'ūrū indrāgnī yuva̭ su naḥ' (ai. ā. 5. 3. 1) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani tṛtīya- savane maitrāvaruṇe yadi mahāvālabhidaṃ śaṃsettadānīṃ mādhyandinasavane hotakāḥ svaśastra ārambhaṇīyābhya ūrdhvaṃ nābhākatvāvāpayeran |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tā hi madhyaṃ bharaṇāmityacchāvākaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyandinasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ 'pūrvīṣṭa indra' iti nābhākatvaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pūrvīṣṭa indropamātaya iti brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsī' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti ||
indrāgnī yuva̭ su na॒ḥ saha̭ntā॒ dāsa̭tho॒ rayi̭m |
yena̭ du॒hrā sa̭ma॒tsvā vī॒ḻu ci̭tsā॒hīṣī̭ma॒hyabhi̭rvane॒va vāta̭ i॒nnabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||

indrāgnī iti | yuva̭m | su | naḥ | saha̭ntā | dāsa̭thaḥ | rayi̭m | yena̭ | du॒hrā | sa॒ma॒tsu | ā | vī॒ḻu | ci̭t | sa॒hīṣī̭mahi | a॒gniḥ | vanā̭'iva | vāta̭: | it | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 11 ||
he indrāgnī sahantā śatrūnabhibhavantau yuva̭m yuvāṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ suṣṭhu dāsathaḥ dattam |
yena rayiṇā samatsu cit saṃgrāmeṣu dṛḍhā cit dṛḍhāni sthira- ṇyapi vīḻu śatrubalāni abhivaneva yathābhivanāni vāta it vātenābhibhavati tathā sahīṣīmahi abhibhavāma |
na॒hi vā̭ṃ va॒trayā̭mahe॒'thendra̭mi॒rjyāmaha̭ śa॒rviṣṭha̭ṃ nṛ॒ṇāṃ na̭ram |
sa na̭ḥ ka॒dā ci̭darva॒tā ga̭ma॒dvājā̭sātaye॒ gama̭dvājā̭sātaye॒ nabha̭ntāmanya॒ke sa̭me ||

na॒hi | vām | va॒trayā̭mahe | atha̭ | indra̭m | it | ya॒jāma॒he | śa॒rviṣṭha̭m | nṛ॒ṇām | na॒ram | saḥ | naḥ | ka॒dā | ci̭t | arva̭tā | ga॒ma॒t | vājā̭'sātaye | ga॒ma॒t | vājā̭'sātaye | nabha̭ntām | a॒nya॒ke | sa॒me || 12 ||
1. ta1-2-svasetava | 2. jñāta-su suṣṭhu | 3. gata-na-bha-' datta ' nāsti | 4. bha3-saṃgrāmeṣu |
he indrāgnī ˅vāṃ yuvāṃ ˅na ˅vavayāmahe vayaṃ dhanaṃ na yācāmahe|
˅atha ˅hi api tarhi ˅śaviṣṭham atiśayena balavantaṃ ˅nṛṇāṃ ˅naraṃ netṛṇāmapi netāram ˅indramit indrameva ˅yajāmahe|

tā hi maghyaṃ bharāṇāmindrāgnī adhikṣitaḥ | tā u kavitvanā kuvī pṛcchyamānā sakhīyate saṃ dhītamaśrutaṃ narā narbhantāmanyake saṃme || 3 || tā | hi | maghyam | bharāṇām | indrāgnī iti | adhikṣitaḥ | tau | ūṃ iti | kavitvanā | kuvī iti | pṛcchyamānā | sakhīyate | sam | dhītama | aśrutam | narā | narbhantām | anyake | saṃme || 3 || ˅tā tau prasiddhau ˅indrāgnī ˅bharāṇāṃ saṃgrāmāṇāṃ ˅madhyam ˅adhikṣitaḥ adhinivasataḥ ˅hi | atha pratyakṣastutiḥ| he ˅narā netārī ˅kavitvanā kavitvena ˅katrī krāntakarmāṇau ˅pṛcchyamānā kavijanaiḥ pṛcchyamānau ˅tā ˅u tāveva yuvāṃ ˅sakhīyate sakhitvamicchate yajamānāya ˅dhītaṃ tatkṛtaṃ karma ˅sam ˅aśrutam | siddhamanyat ||

abhyarca nabhākavadindrāgnī yajasā girā | yayorviśvamidaṃ jagadiyaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivī mahī ˅pasthai vibhuto vasu narbhantāmanyake saṃme ||4|| abhi | arca | nabhāka'vat | indrāgnī iti | yajasā | girā | yayoḥ | viśvam | idam | jagata | iyam | dyauḥ | pṛthivī | mahī | upa'sthai | vibhutaḥ | vasu | narbhantām | anyake | saṃme || 4 || he nābhāka ˅nabhākavadindrāgnī ˅yajasā yāgena ˅girā stutyā ca ˅abhyarcaṃ abhipūjayā | ˅yayoḥ indrāgnyoḥ ˅viśvaṃ sarvam ˅idaṃ ˅jagat tiṣṭhati | yayośca ˅upasthe ˅dvayaṃ ˅dyauḥ ˅mahī mahatī ˅pṛthivī ca dyāvāpṛthivyāvubhe ˅vasu dhanaṃ ˅vibhṛtaḥ dhārayataḥ | siddhamanyat ||

pra brahmāṇi nabhākavadindrāgnībhyāmirājyata | yā saptabudhramarṇavaṃ jihvābāramaporṇuta indra īśāna ojasā narbhantāmanyake saṃme ||5|| pra | brahmāṇi | nabhāka'vat | indrāgnī'bhyām | irājyata | yā | sapta'budhram | arṇavam | jihvā'bāram | apa'ūrṇuta | indraḥ | īśānaḥ | ojasā | narbhantām | anyake | saṃme || 5 || ˅brahmāṇi stotrāṇi ˅indrāgnībhyāṃ ˅nabhākavat ˅pra ˅irajyata nābhākaḥ prerayate | ˅yā yāvindrāgnī ˅saptabudhraṃ saptamūlaṃ ˅jihvābāraṃ pihitadvāram ˅arṇavaṃ ˅aporṇutaḥ tejobhirācchādayataḥ tayormadhye ˅ojasā balena ˅indraḥ ˅īśānaḥ īśvaro bhavati | siddhamanyat || 1. gha-ta-na-bha-pṛcchyamānau| 2. ta-na-bha-'yā' nāsti|

arpi vṛṣa purāṇavadvatairiva guṣpitamojo dāsya dambhaya | vayaṃ tadasya saṃbhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajemahi narbhantāmanyake saṃme || 6 || arpi | vṛṣa | purāṇa'vat | vrataiḥ | iva | guṣpitam | ojaḥ | dāsya | dambhaya | vayam | tat | asya | sam'bhṛtam | vasu | indreṇa | vi | bhajemahi | narbhantām | anyake | same ||6|| api ca he indra purāṇavat praśno yathā vratairiva yathā vahyāḥ guṣpitaṃ nirgatāṃ śākhāṃ vṛścati tathā śatrūṇāṃ vṛśca chedya | tadevāha | dāsya dāsanāmakasya śatroḥ ojaḥ balaṃ dambhaya nāśaya | atha parokṣastutiḥ | vayaṃ nābhākāḥ asya dāsya saṃbhṛtaṃ vasu indreṇa hetunā vi bhajemahi | siddhamanyat || || 24 ||
yadindrāgrī janā ime vihvayante tarnā girā |
asmākaibhirnirbhirvayaṃ sasahāma pratantyato vanuyāma vanuṣyato narbhantāmanyake
he ᵥharitra: ᵥvajrin ᵥsūno’ prerita: ᵥindra ᵥhinvasya prīṇayitu: ᵥvasva:¹ dīpakasya ᵥvīrasya ᵥāpuva: dhanānyupayacchata: ᵥte tava tā: ᵥupamātaya: upamānāni ᵥpūrvī: bahūni |
ᵥyā: ᵥna: ᵥdhiya: prajñāṃ ᵥsādhanta asādhayan |
uto nu cidya ojasā śuṣṇasyāṇḍāni bhedati jeṣṭasvarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same|
tam | śiśīt | suvṛkti'bhi: | tveṣam | sattvānam | ṛmiyam | uto iti | nu | cit | ya: | ojasā | śuṣṇasya | aṇḍāni | bhedati | jepat | sva:'vatī: | apa: | nabhantām | anyake | same || 10 ||
he stotāra: ᵥtveṣaṃ dīptaṃ ᵥsattvānaṃ saṃbhaktāraṃ dhanānām ᵥṛmiyaṃ ṛgaharmṛgbhi: stotavyaṃ ᵥtam indraṃ ᵥsuvṛktibhi: stutibhi: ᵥśiśīta saṃskṛtata |
ᵥuto ᵥnu ᵥcit api ca ᵥya: indra: ᵥojasā balena ᵥśuṣṇasya śuṣṇanāma kasyāsurasya ᵥaṇḍāni aṇḍajātānyapatyāni ᵥbhedati abhinat sa: ᵥsvarvatī: divyāni ᵥapa: salilāni ᵥjepat jayatu |
uto nu cidya ohaṃta aṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedatyai: svarvataripo nabhantāmanyake same|
tam | śiśīt | su'adhvaram | satyam | sattvānam | ṛviyam | uto iti | nu | cit | ya: | ohate | aṇḍā | śuṣṇasya | bhedati | ajai: | sva:'vatī: | apa: | nabhantām | anyake | same || 11 ||
he stotāra: ᵥsvadhvaraṃ suyajñaṃ ᵥsatyam adhināśaṃ ᵥsattvānaṃ saṃbhaktāram ᵥṛviyam ṛtau yaṣṭavyaṃ ᵥtam indraṃ ᵥśiśīta stutibhi: saṃskṛtata |
ᵥuto ᵥnu ᵥcit api ca ᵥya: indra: ᵥohate yajñaṃ prati gacchati ᵥśuṣṇasya ᵥaṇḍā aṇḍānyaṇḍajātāni ca ᵥbhedati³ bhinatti³ sa tvaṃ ᵥsvarvatī: divyāni ᵥapa: salilāni ᵥajai: ajaipī: |
tridhātunā śarmaṇā pātamusmānvayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām |
etra | indrāgni'bhyām | pitṛ'vat | navīya: | mandhātu'vat | aṅgirasa'vat | avāci | tri'dhātunā | śarmaṇā | pātam | asmān | vayam | syāma | pataya: | rayīṇām || 12 ||

ᵥeva evaṃ yābhyām ᵥindrāgnibhyāṃ ᵥpitṛvat nabhākavat ᵥmandhātuvat yauvanāśvamandhātuvacca ᵥaṅgirasvat aṅgirovacca ᵥnavīya: navataram ᵥavāci nābhākena mayā pāṭhitāvindrāgnī ᵥtridhātunā triparvaṇā ᵥśarmaṇā gṛheṇa ᵥna: ᵥasmān nābhākān⁴ ᵥpātaṃ rakṣatam |
ᵥvayaṃ ᵥrayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ ᵥpataya: svāmina: ᵥsyāma bhavema |
atreyamankramaṇikā—‘asmā ū ṣu daśa vāruṇaṃ tu’ iti|
cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyandinasavane maitrāvaruṇaśastra ārambhaṇīyāyā ūrdhvaṃ ‘sa kṣapaḥ’ ityayaṃ nābhākatvaḥ|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaja iti maitrāvaruṇaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yaḥ kakubho nidhāraya iti’ vā’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti||
asmā ū ṣu prarbhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ|
yo dhītā mānuṣāṇāṃ paśvo gāīva rakṣati narbhantāmanyake saṃme ||
asmai| ū~ iti| su| pra'bhūtaye| varuṇāya| marut'bhyaḥ| arca| viduḥ'tarebhyaḥ| yaḥ| dhītā| mānuṣāṇām| paśvaḥ| gāḥ'iva| rakṣati| narbhantām| anyake| saṃme || 1 ||
he stotaḥ ᵥsu ᵥprabhūtaye prakṛṣṭanāya ᵥasmai ᵥvaruṇāya ᵥviduṣṭarebhyaḥ viduttarebhyaḥ ᵥmarudbhyaḥ ca ᵥarca stuhi|
ᵥyaḥ varuṇaḥ ᵥdhītā karmaṇā ᵥmānuṣāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ᵥpaśvaḥ paśūn ᵥgāiva ᵥrakṣati|
tamu ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ|
nābhākasya praśastibhiḥ sindhūnāmupodaya saptsvasā sa madhyamo narbhantāmanyake saṃme ||
tam| ū~ iti| su| samanā| girā| pitṝṇām| ca| manma'bhiḥ| nābhākasya| praśasti'bhiḥ| yaḥ| sindhūnām| upa| ut'aye| sapta'svasā| saḥ| madhyam| narbhantām| anyake| saṃme || 2 ||
ᵥtamu tameva varuṇa ᵥsamanā samānayā ᵥgirā stutyā ᵥsu abhiṣṭaumi|
ᵥsindhūnāṃ syanda- mānānāṃ nadīnām ᵥupa samīpe ᵥyaḥ ᵥudaye udgacchati yaśca ᵥsaptasvasā ᵥsa ᵥmadhyamaḥ iti vāgbhi- rnirucyate|
ᵥanyake durdhiyaḥ śatravaḥ ᵥsame sarve ᵥnarbhantāṃ mā bhūvan|
tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘taṃ svabhi- ṣṭaumi samānayā girā gītvā stutyā pitṝṇāṃ ca mananīyaiḥ stomairnābhākasya praśastibhiḥ|
yaḥ syandamānāmāsāmupodaye saptasvasāramenamāha vāgbhiḥ sa madhyama iti nirucyate'thaiṣa eva bhavati|
narbhantāmanyake saṃme mā bhūvandhanyake sarve ye no dviṣanti durdhiyaḥ pāpa- dhiyaḥ pāpasaṃkalpāḥ’ (niru. 10. 5) iti||
sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje nyuso māyayā dadhe sa viśvaṃ pari darśataḥ|
saḥ| kṣapaḥ| pari| ṣasvaje| ni| ut| saḥ| māyayā| dadhe| saḥ| viśvam| pari| darśataḥ| tasya| venīḥ| anu| vratam| ut| tisraḥ| avardhayan| narbhantām| anyake| saṃme||3||
1. kha-ta-iti ca; ga-iti ceti; na-bha-iveti; śa-iti|
2. ga-ta-na-bhara-gacchati iva rakṣati; gha-rakṣati yathā gopālo gā rakṣati tadvat; bha1-gacchati|
vsaḥ varuṇaḥ vkṣapaḥ rātrīḥ vpari vpasvaje pariṣvajate |
api ca vdarśataḥ darśanīyaḥ vsaḥ varuṇaḥ vutsaḥ utsaraṇaśīlaḥ san vviśvaṃ vmāyayā karmaṇā vpari paritaḥ vni vdadhe nidadhāti |
kiṃca vtasya varuṇasya vvrataṃ karma vvenīḥ kāmayamānāḥ prajāḥ vtisraḥ vuṣaḥ triṣu prātarmādhyaṃdinaṃ sāyaṃ ca vanu vavadhayan anuvardhayanti |
sa mātā pūryaṃ padaṃ tadruṇasya saptyaṃ sa hi gopāḥveyoṃ nabhantāmanyake saṃme ||
yaḥ | kakubhaḥ | ni'dhārayaḥ | pṛthivyām | adhi | darśataḥ | saḥ | mātā | pūryam | padam | tat | varuṇasya | sapt‌yam | saḥ | hi | gopāḥ'iva | iryaḥ | nabhantām | anyake | saṃme || 4 ||
vyaḥ varuṇaḥ vpṛthivyāmadha ipṛthivyā upari vdarśataḥ darśanīyaḥ san vkakubhaḥ diśaḥ vnidhā- rayaḥ nidhārayati vsaḥ varuṇaḥ vmātā nirmātā |
vpūūryyaṃ pratnaṃ vpadaṃ svargakhyaṃ sthānaṃ vsapt‌yam asmā- bhiśca sarpaṇīyaṃ vtat vvaruṇasya svakṛtam |
api ca vsa vhi sa eva viryaḥ īśvaraḥ san vgopāḥiva gopāla iva paśūnāmasnākaṃ rakṣitā |
yo dhartā bhuvanānāṃ ya utsrāṇāmapīcyā veda nāmāni guhyā |
sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṃ dyauriva puṣyati nabhantāmanyake saṃme ||
yaḥ | dhartā | bhuvanānām | yaḥ | utsrāṇām | apīcyā | veda | nāmāni | guhyā | saḥ | kaviḥ | kāvyā | puru | rūpam | dyauḥ'iva | puṣyati | nabhantām | anyake | saṃme ||5||

vyaḥ varuṇaḥ vbhuvanānāṃ vdhatāṃ dhārayitā vyaḥ ca vutsrāṇāṃ devādhiṣṭhānabhūtānāṃ raśmīnām vapīcyā apīcyānyantarhitāni vguhyā guhyāni guhāyāṃ nihitāni vnāmāni vveda jānāti vsaḥ varuṇaḥ vkaviḥ prājñaḥ san vkāvyā kāvyāni kavikarmāṇi vpuru bahūni vrūpaṃ vdyauriva vpuṣyati |
tritaṃ jutī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṃyujai yuje aśvā~ ayukṣata nabhantāmanyake saṃme ||
yasmin | viśvāni | kāvyā | cakre | nābhiḥ'iva | śritā | tritam | jutī | saparyata | vraje | gāvaḥ | na | sam'yujai | yuje | aśvā̭n | ayukṣata | nabhantām | anyake | saṃme || 6 ||

vyasmin varuṇe vviśvāni sarvāṇi vkāvyā kāvyāni kavikarmāṇi vcakre vnābhiriva yathā rathasya cakre nābhistathā vśritā śritāni taṃ vtritaṃ trisyānaṃ varuṇaṃ vjūtī jūtyā kṣipraṃ vsaparyata he madīyā janāḥ paricarata |
vvraje goṣṭhe vgāvo vna yathā gāḥ vsaṃyuje saṃyogārthaṃ yuje |
saha sthāpayituṃ ᵥyuje yuñjanti tathāsmākamabhiyogāya ᵥaśvānayukṣata saparanā yuñjanti |
pari dhāmāni marmṛśadruṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrata nabhantāmanyake seme |
yaḥ | āsu | atkaṃḥ | ā'śaye | viśvā | jātāni | eṣām | pari | dhāmāni | marmṛśat | varuṇasya | puraḥ | gaye | viśve | devāḥ | anu | vratam | nabhantām | anyake | seme || 7 ||
---parimṛśataḥ ᵥvaruṇasya ᵥpuro ᵥgaye rathasya purastādbhavati tasya varuṇasya purastāt ᵥviśve sarve ᵥdevāḥ ᵥvrataṃ karma ᵥanu gacchantītyarthaḥ |
sa samudro apīcyasturo dyāmiba rohati ni yadāsu yajurdadhe |
yaḥ | śvetān | ardhi'nirnijaḥ | cakre | kṛṣṇān | arju | vratā | saḥ | dhāma | pūrvyam | mame | yaḥ | skambhena | vi | rodasī iti | ajaḥ | na | dyām | adhārayat | narbhantām | anyake | same || 10 ||

ᵥthaḥ varuṇaḥ ᵥnirnijaḥ ātmīyān raśmīna divā ᵥśvetān ᵥadhi ᵥcakraṃ adhikaroti tathā rātrau ᵥkṛṣṇān cakre ᵥsaḥ varuṇaḥ ᵥanu ᵥvratā karmāṇi lakṣmīrūpobhayavidhakamāṃnuguṇaṃ ᵥpūrvya ᵥdhāma antarikṣaṃ divaṃ vā ᵥmame nirmame |
api ca ᵥthaḥ ᵥskambhena antarikṣeṇa ᵥajo ᵥna yathā ādityaḥ ᵥdyāṃ dhārayati tathā ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥvi ᵥadhārayat vidhāyati sa varuṇa ityarthaḥ |
arcanānā ṛṣiḥ kāṇvo nābhāko vā ṛṣiḥ |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘astabhnāt ṣarca nānā vā traiṣṭubhamanthaṃ vā tṛcamāśvinamānuṣṭubhamapaśyat’ iti |
tathā sūtritam—‘astabhnādyāmasuro viśvavedā iti paridadhyāduttarayā vā’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 10) iti |
‘evā vandasva varuṇa̭ bṛhantaṃ tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamāna iti dve’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deveti nihite paridadhyāt’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 4) iti ||

astabhnād dyāmasuro viśvavedā armīmīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ | āsīddiśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍ viśvettāni varuṇasya vratāni || 1 || astabhnāt | dyām | asuraḥ | viśva'vedāḥ | armīmīta | varimāṇam | pṛthivyāḥ | ā | āsīdat | viśvā | bhuvanāni | samrāṭ | viśvā | ita | tāni | varuṇasya | vratāni ||1||
ᵥviśvavedāḥ viśvadhanaḥ ᵥasuraḥ balavān varuṇaḥ ᵥdyām ᵥastabhnāt |
tathā ᵥpṛthivyāḥ ca ᵥvarimāṇaṃ parimāṇam ᵥamimīta cakre |
evaṃ nirmitāni ᵥviśvā sarvāṇi ᵥbhuvanāni ᵥsamrāṭ bhūtvā ᵥāsīdat ca adhyatiṣṭhacca |
ᵥvaruṇasya ᵥtāni etāni ᵥvratāni karmāṇi ᵥvidhet viśvanyeva ᵥ |

evā vandasva varuṇa̭ bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīramṛtasya gopām | sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsatpātaṃ nau dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe || 2 || eva | vandasva | varuṇam | bṛhantam | namasya | dhīram | amṛtasya | gopām | saḥ | naḥ | śarma | tri'varūtham | vi | yaṃsat | pātam | naḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | upasthe ||2||
he stotaḥ ᵥbṛhantaṃ mahāntaṃ ᵥvaruṇam ᵥeva evaṃ ᵥvandasva stuhi |
ᵥamṛtasya ᵥgopāṃ gopā- yitāraṃ ᵥdhīraṃ prājñaṃ varuṇa ᵥnamasya namaskuru ca |
ᵥsaḥ varuṇaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥtrivarūthaṃ tristhānaṃ 1. kha-gha-ta-na-śa- ᵥpṛṣṭho viśvadevatākaḥ |

vśarma gṛhaṃ vvi vyaṃsat prayacchatu | vupasthe upasthāne vartamānān vna: asmān vdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau vpātaṃ rakṣatam || imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deva ṛtuṃ dakṣaṃ varuṇa saṃ śiṃśādhi | yayāti viśvā duritā taraima sutarmāṇamadhi nāvaṃ ruhema || 3 || imām | dhiyam | śikṣamāṇasya | deva | ṛtum | dakṣam | varuṇa | sam | śiṃśādhi | yayā | ati | viśvā | duḥ'itā | taraima | sutarmāṇam | adhi | nāvam | ruhema || 3 || he vdeva dyotamāna vvaruṇa vimāṃ vdhiyam idaṃ karma vśikṣamāṇasya anutiṣṭhato mama vṛtuṃ prajñānaṃ vdakṣaṃ balaṃ ca vsaṃ vśiṃśādhi tīkṣṇīkuru | vyayā nāvā yajñarūpayā vviśvā sarvāṇi vduritā duritāni vati vtarema tāṃ vsutarmāṇaṃ suṣṭhu tārayitrīṃ yajñarūpāṃ vnāvam vadhi vruhema vayamāruhema | duḥkhāsāgarataraṇe hetutvādyajño nau rityatra vyapadiśyate || ā vāṃ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhirviprā acyucyavu: | nāsatyā somapītaye narbhantāmanyake saṃme || 4 || ā | vām | grāvāṇaḥ | aśvinā | dhībhiḥ | viprāḥ | acyucyavuḥ | nāsatyā | soma'pītaye | narbhantām | anyake | same || 4 || he vnāsatyā satyau¹ satyapraṇetārau vā | tathā ca yāska:—‘satyāveva nāsatyāvitivarṇavābhaḥ satyasya praṇetārau’ (niru. 6. 13) iti | vaśvinā aśvinau vvāṃ yuvāṃ vsomapītaye somasya pānāya vviprāḥ prājñā ṛtvijaḥ vgrāvāṇaḥ somābhiṣavapāṣāṇāśca vdhībhiḥ karmabhiḥ svasvavyāpāraiḥ vacyucyavuḥ | abhigacchanti | siddhamanyat || yathā vāmatriraśvinā gīrbhirvipro ajauhavīt | nāsatyā somapītaye narbhantāmanyake saṃme || 5 || yathā | vām | atriḥ | aśvinā | gīḥ'bhiḥ | vipraḥ | ajauhavīt | nāsatyā | soma'pītaye | narbhantām | anyake | same || 5 || he nāsatyāśvinau vvāṃ yuvāṃ vvipraḥ prājñaḥ vatriḥ vyathā vgīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ vsomapītaye vajauhavīt tathāhamapi johavīmi || evā vāmaha ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ | nāsatyā somapītaye narbhantāmanyake saṃme || 6 || eva | vām | ahe | ūtaye | yathā | ahuvanta | medhirāḥ | nāsatyā | soma'pītaye | narbhantām | anyake | same || 6 || iyaṃ vyākhyātacarā || || 28 || || 5 ||
tatra 'ime viprasya' iti trayastriṃśadṛcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya virūpasyārṣaṃ gāyatramagnidevatākam |
tathā cānukrāntam—'ime trayastriṃśadvirūpa āṅgirasa āgneyaṃ tu' iti |
prātaranuvāka āgneye kratau gāyatre chandasyāśvinaśastre caitadādike dve sūkte |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'ime viprasyeti sūkte' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
tathā ca sūtritam—'apsumantāvājyabhāgāvapsavatre sadhiṣṭava' (āśva. śrau. 2. 13) iti |
śrūyate ca—'ukṣānnāya vaśānnāyetyāgnīdhro yajati' (ai. brā. 6. 10) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tvaṃ hyagne agninā tvamastuyudhamamīvāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 13) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'tvaṃ hyagne agninā taṃ marjayanta sukṛtam' (āśva. śrau. 2. 16) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastamāiyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotīti kāmāya' (āśva. śrau. 2. 10) iti |
tathā ca sūtritam—'tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastameti vājyāhutiṃ hutvā samāropayet' (āśva. śrau. 3. 10) iti |
ime viprasya vedhaso'gnerastṛtayajvanaḥ | giraḥ stomāsa īrate || 1 || ime | viprasya | vedhasaḥ | agne | astṛtayajvanaḥ | giraḥ | stomāsaḥ | īrate || 1 ||
ime asmadīyāḥ stomāsaḥ stotāraḥ viprasya medhāvinaḥ vedhasaḥ vidhātuḥ astṛtayajvanaḥ aṃhisitayajamānasya agneḥ giraḥ stutīḥ īrate prerayanti ||
asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vircarṣaṇe | agne janāmi suṣṭutim || 2 || asmai | te | pratiharyate | jātavedaḥ | vircarṣaṇe | agne | janāmi | suṣṭutim || 2 ||
he jātavedaḥ jātadhana vircarṣaṇe vidraṣṭaḥ agne asmai pratiharyate prayacchate te tubhyaṃ suṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ janāmi āṅgiraso'haṃ janayāmi ||
ārokā iva ghedaha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ | dadrvarnāni bapsati || 3 || ārokāḥ iva | gha | ita | aha | tigmāḥ | agne | tava | tviṣaḥ | dadrvabhiḥ | vanāni | bapsati || 3 ||
he agne tava tigmāḥ tīkṣṇāḥ tviṣaḥ dīptayaḥ ārokā iva ārocamānāḥ paśava iva dadbhiḥ dantaiḥ vanāni araṇyāni bapsati bhakṣayanti |
harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi | yatante vṛthaggnayaḥ || 4 || harayaḥ | dhūmaketavaḥ | vātajūtāḥ | upa | dyavi | yatante | vṛthak | agnayaḥ || 4 ||
harayaḥ haraṇaśīlāḥ vātajūtāḥ vātapreritāḥ dhūmaketavaḥ dhūmadhvajāḥ agnayaḥ upa dyavi antarikṣe vṛthak pṛthak yatante gacchanti |

ete | tye | vṛthak | amrayaḥ | iḍāsaḥ | sam | adṛkṣata | uṣasām'iva | ketavaḥ || 5 || ᐁete ᐁtye ete ᐁamrayaḥ ᐁvṛthak pṛthak ᐁiḍāsaḥ abhihotribhiḥ samiddhāḥ santaḥ ᐁuṣasāmiva ᐁketavaḥ upasāṃ prājñāpakā iva ᐁsamadṛkṣata samyagdṛśyante || 29 ||

kṛṣṇā rajā~si patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ | agniryadrodhati kṣami || 6 || kṛṣṇā | rajā~si | patsutaḥ | pra'yānai | jāta'vedasaḥ | agniḥ | yat | rodhati | kṣami ||6|| ᐁjātavedasaḥ agneḥ ᐁprayāṇe ᐁpatsutaḥ pattaḥ ᐁrajā~si pāṃsavaḥ kṛṣṇāni bhavanti | kadetyata āha | ᐁkṣami kṣamāyāṃ ᐁyat yadā ᐁagniḥ ᐁrodhati śuṣkān vanaspatīn niruṇaddhi ||

dhāsiṃ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīrbapsadmirana vāyati | punaryantaruṇīrapi || 7 || dhāsim | kṛṇvānaḥ | oṣadhīḥ | bapsat | agniḥ | na | vāyati | punaḥ | yan | taruṇīḥ | arpi || 7 || ᐁagniḥ ᐁoṣadhīḥ ᐁdhāsim annam | ‘śruta dhāsi’ ityannanāmasu pāṭhāt | ᐁkṛṇvānaḥ kurvan ᐁbapsat bhakṣayan ᐁna ᐁvāyati na śāmyati | ᐁpunaḥ ca ᐁtaruṇīḥ oṣadhīḥ ᐁapi ᐁyan gacchan bhavati | bhakṣayitumiti śeṣaḥ ||

jihvābhiraha nanmadarciṣā jajñaṇābhavan | agnivarneṣu rocate || 8 || jihvābhiḥ | aha | nanmat | arciṣā | jajñaṇā'bhavan | agniḥ | vaneṣu | rocate || 8 || ᐁagniḥ ᐁjihvābhiraha jvālābhireva ᐁnanmat vanaspatīnatyantaṃ namayan ᐁarciṣā tejasā ᐁjajñaṇābhavan jvalan | ‘jajñaṇābhavan mallamābhavan’ iti jvalatikarmasu pāṭhāt | ᐁvaneṣu araṇyeṣu ᐁrocate prakāśate ||

apasvagne sadhiṣva sauṣadhīrnu rudhyase | garbhe sajñāyase punaḥ || 9 || apsu | agne | sadhiḥ | tava | saḥ | oṣadhīḥ | anu | rudhyase | garbhe | san | jāyase | punariti ||9|| he ᐁagne yasya ᐁtava ᐁapsu ᐁsadhiḥ praveśasthānaṃ ᐁsaḥ tvam ᐁoṣadhīḥ ᐁanu ᐁrudhyase anu- rundhsi | ᐁpunaḥ ca tāsāṃ bhūmiṣṭhānāṃ ᐁgarbhe ᐁsan bhavan ᐁjāyase prādurbhavasi ||

udagne tava tadghṛtāddyī roṃcata āhutam | nisānaṃ juhvai mukhai || 10 || ut | agne | tava | tat | ghṛtāt | arciḥ | rocate | ā'hutam | nisānam | juhvai | mukhai || 10 || he ᐁagne ᐁtava ᐁghṛtāt ᐁāhutaṃ ᐁjuhvaḥ homasādhanabhūtāyāḥ sucaḥ ᐁmukhe ᐁnisānaṃ ᐁlihānaṃ ᐁtat ᐁarciḥ ᐁut ᐁrocate prakāśate || || 30 ||
ukṣāṇāya vaśānyāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhasai | stomairvidhemāgnaye || 11 || ukṣa'annāya | vaśā'annāya | soma'pṛṣṭhāya | vedhasai | stomaiḥ | vidhema | agnaye || 11 ||
tasmai vsomapṛṣṭhāya somaghṛtapṛṣṭhāya vvedhase vidhātre kāmānām vagnaye vstomaḥ vvidhama paricerama ||

uta tvā namasā vayaṃ hotarvareṇyakrato | agne samiddhīrimahe || 12 || uta | tvā | namasā | vayam | hotaḥ | vareṇyakrato iti vareṇya'krato | agne | samit'abhiḥ | īmahe || 12 || vuta api ca he vhotaḥ devānāṃ hrātaḥ vvareṇyakrato varaṇīyaprajña vagne vtvā tvāṃ vvayam āṅgirasāḥ vnamasā agnena haviṣā vsamidbhiḥ ca vīmahe yācāmahe ||

uta tvā bhṛguvacchuce manuṣvadaṃ āhuta | aṅgirasvaddhuvāmahe || 13 || uta | tvā | bhṛgu'vat | śuce | manuṣvat | agne | ā'huta | aṅgirasvat | havāmahe || 13 || he vśuce svabhāvataḥ śuddha vāhuta vagne vtvā tvāṃ vbhṛguvat yathā bhṛgustathā vmanuṣyat yathā ca manustathā vaṅgirasvat aṅgirovaca vhavāmahe ||

tvaṃ hyagne vipro vipreṇa sansatā | sakhā sakhyā samidhyase || 14 || tvam | hi | agne | agninā | vipraḥ | vipreṇa | san | sutā | sakhā | sakhyā | sam'idhyase || 14 || he vagne vvipraḥ medhāvī vsan vidyamānaḥ vsakhā ca vtvaṃ vvipreṇa satā vsakhyā vagninā vsamidhyase | tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ- 'tvaṃ hyagne agninā vipro vipreṇa sansateti vipra itaro vipra itaraḥ sannitaraḥ sannitaraḥ sakhā sakhyā samidhyasa ityeṣa ha vā asya svaḥ sakhā' (ai. brā. 1. 16) iti ||

sa tvaṃ viprāṃ dāśuṣe rayiṃ dehi sahasriṇam | agne vīravatīmiṣam || 15 || saḥ | tvam | viprāṃ | dāśuṣe | rayim | dehi | sahasriṇam | agne | vīra'vatīm | iṣam || 15 || he vagne vsaḥ prasiddhaḥ vtvaṃ vviprāya medhāvine vdāśuṣe haviṣāṃ pradātre yajamānāya vsahasriṇaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākaparimitaṃ vrayiṃ dhanaṃ vvīravatīṃ putrapautrādisahitam viṣam annaṃ ca vdehi || 13 ||

agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucitrata | imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva me || 16 || agne | bhrātariti | sahaḥ'skṛta | rohita'aśva | śuci'vrata | imam | stomam | juṣasva | me || 16 || he vagne vbhrātaḥ bhrātṛvadyajamānānāṃ mitrabhūta vsahaskṛta sahasā balena kṛta vrohidaśva lohita- varṇāśva vśucitrata śuddhakarmannagne vme āṅgirasasya mama vimaṃ vstomaṃ vjuṣasva sevasva ||

uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate | goṣṭhaṃ gāvīvāśata || 17 || uta | tvā | agne | mama | stutaḥ | vāśrāya | prati'haryate | goṣṭham | gāvī'iva | āśata || 17 || vuta api ca he vagne vtvā tvāṃ vmama āṅgirasasya vstutaḥ stutaḥ vvāśrāya vāśana- śīlāya vatsāya vpratiharyate pathaḥ kāmayamānāya dogdhuṃ vgoṣṭhaṃ vgāvaiva yathā gāvaḥ praviśanti tathā vāśata prāpnuvanti ||
1. gha-utāpi ca he | 2. gha-satā sādhunā | 3. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa- 'sahitāṃ | 4. jha-ta-1-2-3-me mama |

tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastam viśvā: sukṣitaya: pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemire || 18 || tubhyam | tā: | aṅgira:'tama | viśvā: | su'kṣitaya: | pṛthak | agne | kāmāya | yemire ||18|| he aṅgirastama aṅgirasāṃ śreṣṭha agne tubhyaṃ viśvā: sarvā: tā: prasiddhā: sukṣitaya: prajā: 1 kāmāya ātmana: kāmasiddhayarthaṃ pṛthak yemire niyacchanti ||

agniṃ dhībhirmanīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścita: | aṅgasadhāya hinvire || 19 || agnim | dhībhi: | manīṣiṇa: | medhirāsa: | vipa:'ścita: | aṅga'sadhāya | hinvire ||19|| manīṣiṇa: manasa īśvarā: medhirāsa: medhāvina: vipaścita: prājñā yajamānā: dhībhi: karmabhi: aṅgasadhāya aṅgasya bhajanāya agniṃ hinvire prīṇayanti ||

taṃ tvāmajameṣu vājinaṃ tanvānā agne adhvaram | vahniṃ hotāramīḻate || 20 || tam | tvām | ajameṣu | vājinam | tanvānā: | agne | adhvaram | vahnim | hotāram | īḻate ||20|| he agne vājinaṃ balinaṃ vahniṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhāraṃ hotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāraṃ taṃ prasiddhaṃ tvām ajameṣu gṛheṣu adhvaraṃ yajñaṃ tanvānā: vistārayanto yajamānā: īḻate stuvanti || || 32 ||

purutrā hi sahaḍusi viśo viśvā anu prabhu: | samatsu tvā havāmahe || 21 || purutrā | hi | saḥ'haḍu | asi | viśa: | viśvā: | anu | prabhu: | samatsu | tvā | havāmahe ||21|| he agne tvaṃ hi yata: prabhu prabhu: | sulopaśchāndasa: | purutrā bahuṣu pradeśeṣu viśvā: sarvā: viśa: prajā: anu sahaḍu samānadarśī asi ata: tvā tvāṃ samatsu saṃgrāmeṣu havāmahe hayāma:||

tamīḻiṣva ya āhuto'gnirvibhrājate ghṛtai: | imaṃ na: śṛṇavaddhavam || 22 || tam | īḻiṣva | ya: | ā'huta: | agni: | vi'bhrājate | ghṛtai: | imam | na: | śṛṇavat | havam ||22|| ya: agni: ghṛtai: saha āhuta: vibhrājate yaśca na: asmākam imaṃ havam āhvānaṃ śṛṇavat śṛṇoti tam agnim īḻiṣva stuhi ||

taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe śṛvantaṃ jātavedasam | agne ghantam apa dviṣa: || 23 || tam | tvā | vayam | havāmahe | śṛvantam | jāta'vedasam | agne | ghantam | apa | dviṣa: ||23|| he agne jātavedasaṃ jātadhanaṃ jātaprajñaṃ vā dviṣa: śatrūn apa ghantaṃ hiṃsantaṃ śṛvantam asmadīyamāhvānaṃ śṛṇavantaṃ ca tvāṃ vayam aṅgirasā: havāmahe ||
viśāma rājānamadbhutaṃ madhyakṣaṃ dharmaṇāmimam | agnimīḻe sa u śravat || 24 || viśām | rājānam | adbhutam | adhi'akṣam | dharmaṇām | imam | agnim | īḻe | sa: | ū~ iti | śravat || 24 ||
ᵛviśāṃ prajānāṃ ᵛrājānam īśvaram ᵛamṛtaṃ mahāntaṃ ᵛdharmaṇāṃ karmaṇām ᵛadhyakṣam anusaṃdhā- tāraṃ yaṃ ᵛimamabhimīḻe' staumi ᵛsa ᵛu sa evāgniḥ ᵛśravat asmadīyāṃ stutiṃ śṛṇotu |
agniṃ viśvāyuvepasaṃ marye na vājinaṃ hitam| sarmi na vājayāmasi ||25||
agnim | viśvāyuvepasam | martyam | na | vājinam | hitam | sarmim | na | vājayāmasi ||25||
ᵛviśvāyuvepasaṃ sarvagatabalam ᵛagniṃ ᵛvājinaṃ balinaṃ ᵛmartyaṃ ᵛna manuṣyamiva ᵛhitaṃ ᵛsarmiṃ ᵛna aśvamiva ᵛvājayāmasi stutibhirhavirbhiśca balinaṃ kurmaḥ|
ghnamughrāṇyapa dviṣo dahatrakṣāṃsi viśvahā| agne tigmena dīdihi ||26||
ghna | mṛdhrāṇi | apa | dviṣaḥ | dahan | rakṣāṃsi | viśvahā | agne | tigmena | dīdihi ||26||
he ᵛagne tvaṃ ᵛmṛdhrāṇi hiṃsakān ᵛdviṣaḥ dveṣṭṛn ᵛapa ᵛghna hiṃsan ᵛviśvahā sarvadā ᵛrakṣāṃsi ca ᵛdahan ᵛtigmena tīkṣṇena tejasā ᵛdīdihi dīpyasva |
yaṃ tvā janāṃsa indhate manuṣvadaṅgirastama| agne sa bodhi me varcaḥ ||27||
yam | tvā | janāsaḥ | indhate | manuṣvat | aṅgiraḥ'tama | agne | saḥ | bodhi | me | varcaḥ ||27||
he ᵛaṅgirastamagne ᵛyaṃ ᵛtvā tvāṃ ᵛjanāsaḥ janāḥ ᵛmanuvat yathā manustathā ᵛindhate dīpa- yanti ᵛsaḥ tvaṃ ᵛme madīyaṃ ᵛvacaḥ stutiṃ ᵛbodhi budhyasva |
yadagne divijā asyapmujā vā sahaskṛta| taṃ tvā gīrbhirhavāmahe ||28||
yat | agne | divi'jāḥ | asi | apsu'jāḥ | vā | sahaḥ'kṛta | tam | tvā | gīḥ'bhiḥ | havāmahe ||28||
he ᵛagne ᵛyat yastvaṃ ᵛdivijāḥ divi bhavaḥ ᵛasi bhavasi ᵛapsujā ᵛvā antarikṣajātaśca bhavasi ᵛsahaskṛtaḥ sahasā balena kṛtaścāsi ᵛtaṃ ᵛtvā tvāmagniṃ ᵛgīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᵛhavāmahe hayāmaḥ|
tubhyaṃ ghette janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak| dhāsiṃ hinvantyṛtave ||29||
tubhyam | gha | ita | te | janāḥ | ime | viśvāḥ | sukṣitayaḥ | pṛthak | dhāsim | hinvanti | ṛtave ||29||
he agne ᵛtubhyaṃ ᵛgha tvadarthameva ᵛte ᵛime mayā dṛśyamānāḥ ᵛjanāḥ ᵛviśvāḥ sarvāḥ ᵛsukṣitayaḥ prajāśca ᵛdhāsim ahaṃ haviḥ ᵛattave adanāya ᵛpṛthak ᵛhinvanti prerayanti |
te ghedagne svādhyo'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ| tarantaḥ syāma durgahā ||30||
te | gha | ita | agne | su'ādhyaḥ | arhāḥ | viśvā | nṛ'cakṣasaḥ | tarantaḥ | syāma | duḥ'gahā ||30||
he ᵛagne ᵛte ᵛghet tvadarthameva khalu vayaṃ ᵛsvādhyaḥ sukarmāṇaḥ santaḥ ᵛviśvā viśvāni ᵛahā ahāni ᵛnṛcakṣasaḥ draṣṭāraśca ᵛdurgāhā duḥkhena gāhitavyāni ᵛtarantaḥ ᵛsyāma bhavema |

agniṃ mandraṃ purupriyaṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam | hṛnmandrairbhīmahe || 31 || agnim | mandram | puru'priyam | śīram | pāvaka'śociṣam | hṛt'bhiḥ | mandraiḥ | īmahe || 3 1 || mandraṃ mādanaṃ purupriyaṃ bahupriyaṃ śīraṃ yajñeṣu śayanaśīlaṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ pāvakadīptim agniṃ hṛnbhiḥ manoharairmandraiḥ mādanaiḥ stotraiḥ īmahe yācāmahe ||

sa tvamagne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjansūryo na raśmibhiḥ | śardhantamāṃsi jighnase ||32|| saḥ | tvam | agne | vibhā'vasuḥ | sṛjan | sūryaḥ | na | raśmi'bhiḥ | śardhan | tamāṃsi | jighnase || 32 || he agne vibhāvasuḥ dīptidhanaḥ saḥ prasiddhaḥ tvaṃ sṛjan udyan sūryo na yathā sūrya- stathā raśmibhiḥ śardhan balaṃ kurvan tamāṃsi jighnase nāśayasi ||

agnḙ | sto॒ram | ju॒ṣasva̭ | me॒ | vardha̭sva | a॒nena̭ | ma॒nma̭nā | prati̭ | su॒'u॒ktāni̭ | ha॒rya̭ | na॒ḥ ||2|| he ⱽagne ⱽme ⱽāṅgirasasya mama ⱽstomaṃ stotraṃ ⱽjuṣasva sevasva | ⱽanena ⱽmanmanā mananīyena stotreṇa ⱽvardhasva ca | ⱽnaḥ asmākaṃ ⱽsūktāni ⱽprati ⱽharya kāmaya ca || a॒gniṃ dū॒taṃ pu॒ro da̭dhe ha॒vya॒vā॒hamṷpa bruve | de॒vā~ ā sā̭dayādiha || 3 || a॒gnim | dū॒tam | pu॒raḥ | da॒dhe | ha॒vya॒'vā॒ham | u॒pa | bru॒ve | de॒vān | ā | sā॒da॒yāt | i॒ha ||3|| ⱽdūtaṃ devānāṃ ⱽhavyavāhaṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhāraṃ ca ⱽagniṃ ⱽpuro ⱽdadhe puraskaromi | ⱽupa ⱽbruve upastaumi ca | so'gniḥ ⱽiha yajñe ⱽdevān ⱽā ⱽsādayāt āsādayatu || u॒ttai bṛ॒hanto̭ a॒rcaya̭: sa॒midhā̭nasya dī॒diva̭: | a॒gne śukrā̭sa īrate || 4 || u॒t | te॒ | bṛ॒hanta̭ḥ | a॒rcaya̭: | sa॒m'i॒dhānasya̭ | dī॒di॒vaḥ | a॒gne | śukrā̭saḥ | ī॒rate || 4 || he ⱽdīdivaḥ dīpta ⱽagne ⱽsamidhānasya samidhyamānasya ⱽte tava ⱽbṛhantaḥ mahāntaḥ ⱽśukrāsaḥ jvalantaḥ ⱽarcayaḥ dīptayaḥ ⱽuttai ⱽīrate || u॒pa tvā̭ ju॒hvo̭ ma॒rma ghṛ॒tācī̭ryantu ha॒ryata̭ | a॒gne ha॒vyā jṷṣasva naḥ || 5 || u॒pa | tvā̭ | ju॒hva̭ḥ | ma॒rma | ghṛ॒tācī̭: | ya॒ntu | ha॒ryata̭ | a॒gne | ha॒vyā | ju॒ṣasva̭ | na॒ḥ || 5 || he ⱽharyata kāmayamāna ⱽagne ⱽmama madīyāḥ ⱽghṛtācīḥ ghṛtamañjanyaḥ ⱽjuhvaḥ sucaḥ ⱽtvā tvām ⱽupa ⱽyantu | ⱽnaḥ asmākaṃ ⱽhavyā havyāni ⱽjuṣasva sevasva ca || || 36 || ma॒ndraṃ ho॒tāra̭mṛtvi॒jaṃ ci॒trabhā̭nuṃ vi॒bhāva̭sum | a॒gnīmī̭ḻe sa ṷ śravat || 6 || ma॒ndram | ho॒tāra̭m | ṛ॒tvi॒jam | ci॒tra'bhā̭num | vi॒bhā'va̭sum | a॒gnim | ī॒ḻe | saḥ | ū~ iti̭ | śra॒vat || 6 || ⱽmandraṃ mādanaṃ ⱽhotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāram ⱽṛtvijam ṛtau yaṣṭavyaṃ ⱽcitrabhānuṃ citradīptiṃ ⱽvibhāvasuṃ dīptidhanam ⱽagnim ⱽīḻe staumi | ⱽsaḥ agniḥ ⱽśravat asmadīyāṃ stutiṃ śṛṇotveva || pra॒tnaṃ ho॒tāra̭mīḍyaṃ ju॒ṣṭama॒gniṃ ka॒vikra̭tum | a॒dhva॒rāṇā̭ma॒bhi śri̭yam || 7 || pra॒tnam | ho॒tāra̭m | ī॒ḍyam | ju॒ṣṭam | a॒gnim | ka॒vi'kra̭tum | a॒dhva॒rāṇām | a॒bhi'śri̭yam || 7 || ⱽpratnaṃ purāṇaṃ ⱽhotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāram ⱽīḍyaṃ stutyaṃ ⱽjuṣṭaṃ prītaṃ sevitaṃ vā ⱽkavikratuṃ krāntakarmāṇam ⱽadhvarāṇāṃ yajñānām ⱽabhi śriyam abhiśrayitāramīḍyam ⱽagnim īḻe staumi || ju॒ṣā॒ṇo a̭ṅgirastame॒mā ha॒vyānyā̭nu॒ṣak | a॒gne ya॒jñaṃ na̭ya ṛ॒tuthā̭ || 8 || ju॒ṣā॒ṇaḥ | a̭ṅgiraḥ'tam | i॒mā | ha॒vyāni̭ | ā॒nu॒ṣak | a॒gne | ya॒jñam | na॒ya | ṛ॒tuthā̭ ||8|| he ⱽaṅgirastama aṅgirasāṃ śreṣṭha ⱽagne ⱽimā imāmyasmadīyāni ⱽhavyāni havīṃṣi ⱽānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ⱽjuṣāṇaḥ sevamāno bhava | ⱽṛtuthā kāle kāle ⱽyajñaṃ ca ⱽnaya || 1. taṃ-1-2-sādayāt | 2. kha-udgacchati udīrayate; ga-ta3-4-na-udīrayate; jha-ta1-2- udīrayate radgacchati; ya-udīrate udgacchati | 3. bha-modanaṃ | 4. gha-u śravat | 5. ta1- na-bha-abhiśriyatāṃ |

samidhāna uṃ santya śukraśoca ihā vaha | cikittvāndaivyaṃ janam || 9 || sam'idhānaḥ | ū~ iti | santya | śukra'śoce | iha | ā | vaha | cikittvān | daivyam | janam || 9 || he santya bhajanaśīla śukraśoce jvalahīte tvaṃ samidhāna u samidhyamāna eva daivyaṃ deva- sambandhinaṃ janaṃ cikittvān jānan iha yajñe ā vaha ||

vipraṃ hotārmadruhaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum | yajñānāṃ ketumīmahe || 10 || vipram | hotāram | adruham | dhūma'ketum | vibhāvasum | yajñānām | ketum | īmahe || 10 || vipraṃ medhāvinaṃ hoṭāraṃ devānāmāhvātāram adruhaṃ adroghāraṃ dhūmaketuṃ dhūmadhvajaṃ vibhāvasuṃ dīptidhanaṃ yajñānāṃ ketuṃ patākāsthānīyamagnim īmahe abhīṣṭaṃ yācāmahe || || 37 ||

agne ni pāhi nastvaṃ prati ṣma deva riśataḥ | bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta || 11 || agne | ni | pāhi | naḥ | tvam | prati | sma | deva | riśataḥ | bhindhi | dveṣaḥ | saha'kṛta || 11 || he sahaskṛta balena kṛta deva dīpta agne riśataḥ hiṃsakān naḥ asmān prati ni pāhi pratirakṣa | sma iti pūraṇaḥ | dveṣaḥ dviṣaḥ śatrūṃśca bhindhi vidāraya ||

agniḥ pratena manmanā śubhbhānastanvaṃ svām | kuviviprreṇa vāvṛdhe || 12 || agniḥ | pratena | manmanā | śubhbhānaḥ | tanvam | svām | kuviḥ | vipreṇa | vāvṛdhe || 12 || kaviḥ krāntakarmā agniḥ pratena purāṇena manmanā mananīyena stotreṇa svāṃ svakīyāṃ tanvaṃ tanumaṅgaṃ śubhbhānaḥ śobhayan vipreṇa medhāvinā stotrā vavṛdhe pravṛddho bhavati ||

ūrjo napātmā huve'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam | asmin‌yajñe svadhvare || 13 || ūrjaḥ | napāt‌ma | ā | huve | agnim | pāvaka'śociṣam | asmin | yajñe | mu'adhvare || 13 || ūrjaḥ annasya napātaṃ putraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ śodhakadīptim agniṃ svadhvare asurairatyantahiṃsthe asmin yajñe ā huve āhvayāmi ||

sa nau mitramahastvamagne śukrreṇa śociṣā | devairā satsi barhiṣi || 14 || saḥ | naḥ | mitra'mahaḥ | tvam | agne | śukrreṇa | śociṣā | devaiḥ | ā | satsi | barhiṣi || 14 || he mitramahaḥ mitrāṇāṃ pūjanīya agne saḥ tvaṃ śukrreṇa jvalatā śociṣā tejasā devaiḥ saha barhiṣi yajñe ā satsi āsīda ||

yo agniṃ tanvo3 dame devaṃ marteḥ saparyāta | tasmā ihīdyadasu || 15 || yaḥ | agnim | tanvaḥ | dame | devam | marteḥ | saparyāta | tasmai | ita | dīdyat | vasu || 15 || yaḥ martaḥ manuṣyaḥ dame gṛhe agniṃ devaṃ tanvaḥ dhanasya prāpyarthamiti śeṣaḥ | ‘bhojanaṃ tanā ’ iti dhananāmasu pāṭhāt | saparyati paricarati tasmā it tasmā eva vasu dhanaṃ dīdyat | so'gniḥ prayacchati || || 38 ||

agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati || 16 || agniḥ | mūrdhā | divaḥ | kakut | patiḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | ayam | apām | retāṃsi | jinvati ||16|| mūrdhā devānāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ divaḥ dyulokasya kakut ucchritaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ca patiḥ ayam agniḥ apāṃ retāṃsi sthāvarajaṅgamātmakāni bhūtāni jinvati prīṇayati ||

udagne śucayastava śukrā bhrājanta īrate | tava jyotīṃṣyarcayaḥ || 17 || ut | agne | śucayaḥ | tava | śukrāḥ | bhrājantaḥ | īrate | tava | jyotīṃṣi | arcayaḥ ||17|| he agne te tava śucayaḥ nirmalāḥ śukrāḥ śuklavarṇāḥ2 bhrājantaḥ dīpyamānāḥ arcayaḥ prabhāḥ tava jyotīṃṣi tejāṃsi ut īrate prerayanti ||

īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svarvateḥ | stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi || 18 || īśiṣe | vāryasya | hi | dātrasya | agne | svaḥ | patiḥ | stotā | syām | tava | śarmaṇi ||18|| he agne svarvateḥ svargasya svāmī tvaṃ vāryasya varaṇīyasya dātrasya dātavyasya dhanasya īśiṣe īśvaro'si | śarmaṇi sukhe nimitte tava stotā syāṃ bhaveyam ||

tvāmagne manīṣiṇastvāṃ hinvanti cittibhiḥ | tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ || 19 || tvām | agne | manīṣiṇaḥ | tvām | hinvanti | cittibhiḥ | tvām | vardhantu | naḥ | giraḥ ||19|| he agne tvāṃ manīṣiṇaḥ manasa īśvarāḥ stotāraḥ stutibhiḥ stuvantīti śeṣaḥ | kiṃca tvām eva cittibhiḥ karmabhiḥ hinvanti prīṇayanti naḥ asmākaṃ giraḥ stutayaḥ tvām eva vardhantu vardhayantu ||

adabdhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā | agneḥ sukhyaṃ vṛṇīmahe || 20 || adabdhasya | svadhā'vataḥ | dūtasya | rebhataḥ | sadā | agneḥ | sukhyam | vṛṇīmahe ||20|| he agne adabdhasya kenāpyahiṃsitasya svadhāvataḥ balavataḥ dūtasya devānāṃ rebhataḥ devān stuvatastava sukhyaṃ sadā vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe || ||39||

agniḥ śucivratamaḥ śucivipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ | śucī rocata āhutaḥ || 21 || agniḥ | śuci'vratatamaḥ | śuci'vipraḥ | śuciḥ | kaviḥ | śuciḥ | rocate | ā'hutaḥ ||21|| śucivratatamaḥ atiśayena śuddhakarmā śuciḥ śuddha eva vipraḥ medhāvī śuciḥ śuddhaḥ sakheva kaviḥ krāntakarmā śuciḥ eva āhutaḥ agniḥ rocate prakāśate ||

uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā | agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ || 22 || uta | tvā | dhītayaḥ | mama | giraḥ | vardhantu | viśvahā | agne | sakhyasya | bodhi | naḥ ||22|| uta api ca he agne tvā tvāṃ mama dhītayaḥ karmāṇi giraḥ stutayaśca viśvahā sarvadā vardhantu vardhayantu | naḥ asmākaṃ sakhyasya sakhyaṃ sakhyakarma stutyādikaṃ bodhi budhyasva ||

he ᵛagne ᵛtvaṃ ᵛdhīraḥ ᵛasi ᵛhi bhavasi khalu | ᵛagrasat haviṣī sīdan ᵛvipro ᵛna rodhāvīva ᵛjāgṛviḥ prajānāṃ hitakaraṇe jāgaraṇaśīlo'si | ᵛsadā ᵛhavi antarikṣe ᵛdīdayasi dīvyasi ca || purāyai duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhebhyaḥ kave | pra ṇ āyurvaso tira || 30 || purā | agne | duḥitebhyaḥ | purā | mṛdhebhyaḥ | kave | pra | naḥ | āyuḥ | vaso iti | tira ||30||
he ᵛvaso vāsaka ᵛkave kāntakaman ᵛagne ᵛduritebhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ ᵛpurā ᵛmṛdhebhyaḥ hiṃsakebhyaśca ᵛpurā |
yadā duritāni śatravaścāsmān hiṃsitumudyuñjate tataḥ prāgevetyarthaḥ |
ᵛnaḥ asmākam ᵛāyuḥ ᵛpra ᵛtira vardhaya ||
'ā ghā ye' iti dvicatvāriṃśadacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktam |
'paraṃ gāyatraṃ prāgvatsapreḥ' iti paribhāṣāyā gāyatrī chandaḥ |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam— 'ā ghā ye abhiminyata ā tū na indra kṣumantamiti sūkte' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 3) iti |
tathaiva 'atirātre' iti khaṇḍe sūyate— 'ā ghā ye abhiminyata iti saptadaśa' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
āmrayaṇa āmendrasya haviṣaḥ 'ā ghā ye' ityeṣā'nuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'ā ghā ye abhiminyate sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayanta iti stotram' (āśva. śrau. 2. 9) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'taddo gāya sute sacā stotramindrāya gāyata' (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti |
dvitīye paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ 'abhi tvā vṛṣabha' iti stotriyastricaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute'bhi pra gopatiṃ girā' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani prātaḥsavane 'bhindhi viśvāḥ' iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ palahastonatriyaḥ |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ— 'bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣa iti brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsinaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) iti ||
ā ghā ye abhiminyate stuṇanti barhiranuṣak | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||1|| ā | gha | ye | agnim | indrate | stuṇanti | barhiḥ | ānuṣak | yeṣām | indraḥ | yuvā | sakhā ||1||
ᵛye ṛṣayaḥ ᵛā ᵛgha ābhamukhyena khalu ᵛagniminyate dīpayanti ᵛyeṣāṃ ca ᵛyuvā nitya- taruṇaḥ ᵛindraḥ ᵛsakhā bhavati te ᵛānuṣak ānupūrvyeṇa ᵛbarhiḥ³ ᵛstuṇanti ||
bṛhandiṣma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā || 2 || bṛhan | ita | iṣmaḥ | eṣām | bhūri | śastam | pṛthuḥ | svaruḥ | yeṣām | indraḥ | yuvā | sakhā ||2||
ᵛeṣām ṛṣīṇām ᵛiṣmaḥ ᵛbṛhat mahān khalu ᵛbhūri bahu ca ᵛśastaṃ stotraṃ ᵛsvaruḥ ca ᵛpṛthuḥ mahān |
ayuṃ du iyudhā vṛtaṃ śūra ājati satvabhiḥ | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā || 3 || ayuṃ duḥ | ita | yudhā | vṛtam | śūraḥ | ā | ajati | satvabhiḥ | yeṣām | indraḥ | yuvā | sakhā ||3||
teṣvantarbhūtaḥ kaścit ᵛayuṃ du ᵛit prāgayodaiva san ᵛyudhā vṛtaṃ yoddhṛbhirderāvṛtaṃ śatruṃ ᵛsatvabhiḥ ātmīyairbalaiḥ ᵛśūraḥ san ᵛājati namayati ||

ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā daṃde jātaḥ pṛcchaddi mātaram | ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire || 4 || ā | bundam | vṛtra'hā | daṃde | jātaḥ | pṛcchat | iti | mātaram | ke | ugrāḥ | ke | ha | śṛṇvire ||4|| jātaḥ utpannaḥ | vṛtrahā indraḥ | bundam iṣuma | tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘bunda iṣurbhavati’ (niru. 6. 32) iti | ā dade | ādāya ca iṣuma | ugrāḥ udvarṇabalāḥ | ke ke ca śṛṇvire vīryeṇa viśvatā iti svamātaraṃ vi pṛcchat aprākṣīt ||

prati tvā śavasī vadadvirāvapso na yaudhiṣat | yastai śatruvamācuke || 5 || prati | tvā | śavasī | vadat | girau | apsaḥ | na | yaudhiṣat | yaḥ | te | śatru'tvam | ā'cuke || 5 || he indra tvā tvāṃ śavasī balavatī mātā prati vadat pratyavocat | yaste śatruvamācake kāmayate saḥ girau parvate apso na darśanīyo gaja i

he ᵥśakra ᵥindra yācamānā vayaṃ ᵥte tava ᵥdvipaḥ dveṣṭṛn ᵥpari ᵥvṛjyāma nopagacchema | kiṃtu ᵥte tava ᵥgomataḥ paśumataḥ ᵥdāvane abhīṣṭānāya ᵥaraṃ paryāptaṃ ᵥgamemet gacchemaiva || ||43|| śanaiściyantau adrivo'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ | vivakṣaṇā anehasaḥ || 11 || śanaiḥ | ᵥcit | yantaḥ | ᵥadri'vaḥ | ᵥaśva'vantaḥ | ᵥśata'gvinaḥ | ᵥvivakṣaṇāḥ | ᵥanehasaḥ ||11|| he ᵥadrivaḥ vajrin vayaṃ ᵥśanaiḥ mandaṃ mandaṃ ᵥyantaḥ gacchantaḥ ᵥaśvāvantaḥ aśvavantaḥ ᵥśatagvinaḥ bahudhanāḥ ᵥvivakṣaṇāḥ voḍhavyaṃ vahantaḥ ᵥanehasaḥ upadravarahitāśca santo gamemediti saṃbandhaḥ || ūrdhvā hi tai dvedidive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā | jaritṛbhyo vimaṃhate || 12 || ūrdhvā | hi | te | ᵥdvedidive | ᵥsahasrā | ᵥsūnṛtā | ᵥśatā | ᵥjaritṛ'bhyaḥ | ᵥvi'maṃhate || 12 || he indra ᵥte tava ᵥjaritṛbhyaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ ᵥsahasrā sahasrāṇi ᵥśatā śatāni ca ᵥūrdhvā ūrdhvāni mukhyāni ᵥsūnṛtā sūnṛtāni sādhanāni ᵥdvedidive anvahaṃ ᵥvimaṃhate yajamānaḥ prayacchati | maṃhatirdānakarmā || vidvā hi tvā dhanaṃjayemindra ḍhṛhā cidārujam | ādāriṇaṃ yathā garyam ||13|| vidvā | hi | tvā | ᵥdhanam'jayam | indraṃ | ᵥḍhṛhā | ᵥcit | ᵥā'rujam | ᵥā'dāriṇam | yathā | garyam || 13 || he ᵥindra ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥdhanaṃjayaṃ dhanānāṃ jetāraṃ ᵥḍhṛhā ᵥcit dṛḍhānāmapi śatrūṇām ᵥārujam ābhimukhyena bhaṅktāram ᵥādāriṇam ādatāraṃ ca ᵥyathā ᵥgaryaṃ gṛhamivāpadravebhyo rakṣakaṃ ca ᵥvidma jānīma || kukuhaṃ ciccā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇuvindavaḥ | ā tvā puṇi yadīmahe || 14 || kukuham | ᵥcit | tvā | ᵥkave | ᵥmandantu | ᵥdhṛṣṇo iti | ᵥindavaḥ | ā | tvā | ᵥpuṇim | yat | ᵥīmahe || 14 || he ᵥkave krāntakarman ᵥdhṛṣṇo dharṣakendra ᵥyat yadā ᵥparṇi payamānaṃ ᵥtvā tvām ᵥā ābhi- mukhyena ᵥīmahe abhīṣṭaṃ yācāmahe tadā ᵥkukuham ucchritaṃ ᵥtvā tvām ᵥindavaḥ ᵥcit somā api ᵥmandantu mādayantu || yastai revā~ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye | tasya no veda ā bhara || 15 || yaḥ | ᵥte | ᵥrevān | ᵥadāśuriḥ | ᵥpra'mamarṣa | ᵥmaghattaye | ᵥtasya | ᵥnaḥ | ᵥvedaḥ | ā | bhara ||15|| he indra ᵥmaghattaye dhanadānāya ᵥte tubhyaṃ ᵥyaḥ pumān ᵥrevān dhanavān san ᵥadāśuriḥ adāna- śīlaḥ ᵥpramamarṣa abhyasūyati ᵥtasya puṃsaḥ ᵥvedaḥ dhanaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyam ᵥā ᵥbhara āhara || ||44|| ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ | puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum || 16 || ime | ᵥū~ iti | tvā | ᵥvi | ᵥcakṣate | ᵥsakhāyaḥ | indra | ᵥsominaḥ | ᵥpuṣṭa'vantaḥ | ᵥyathā | ᵥpaśum ||16|| 1. gha-paṇimānāṃ | 2. ga-ta-bhara-kukuha cit; na-bha1-kukuha; bha3-kukuha ucchrita |
he ᵥindra ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥsominaḥ abhiṣutasomāḥ ᵥsakhāyaḥ ᵥima ᵥu ima eva khalvasmadīyā janāḥ ᵥpuṣṭāvantaḥ saṃbhṛtaghāsāḥ ᵥyathā ᵥpaśuṃ paśumiva ᵥvi ᵥcakṣate vipaśyanti ||

uta tvā̭dhira॒ṃ vaya̭ṃ śru॒tkarṇa̭ṃ sa॒ntamū॒tayḙ | du॒rādi॒ha ha̭vāmahe || 17 || uta | tvā̭ | a̭rdhiram | va॒yam | śru॒tkarṇa̭m | sa॒ntam | ū॒tayḙ | du॒rāt | i॒ha | ha̭vāmahe ||17|| ᵥuta api ca he indra ᵥabadhiram anupataśrotrendriyamata eva ᵥśrutkarṇaṃ śravaṇaparakarṇaṃ ᵥsantaṃ ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥvayaṃ triśokāḥ ᵥiha yajñe ᵥūtaye rakṣaṇāya ᵥdūrāt ᵥhavāmahe hayāmaḥ ||

yacchru॒yā ha॒maṃ ha̭ve॒ durma̭rṣa॒ṃ cakri̭yā u॒ta | bha̭ve॒rāpi॒rno a̭ntamaḥ || 18 || yat | śru॒yāḥ | i॒mam | ha̭vam | dṷḥmarṣam | ca॒kri॒yāḥ | u॒ta | bha̭veḥ | ā॒piḥ | na̭ḥ | a̭ntamaḥ ||18|| he indra ᵥyat yadi ᵥimam asmadīyaṃ ᵥhavam āhvānaṃ ᵥśruyāḥ śṛṇuyāḥ tarhi ᵥdurmarṣa śatrūṇāṃ duḥsahaṃ balaṃ ᵥcakriyāḥ kuryāḥ | ᵥuta api ca ᵥnaḥ asmākam ᵥantamaḥ antikatamaḥ ᵥāpiḥ bandhuḥ ᵥbhaveḥ ||

yacchi॒ddhi te॒ api̭ vya॒thirja̭gvā॒ṃso a̭rma॒hi | go॒dā i̭di॒ndra bo̭dhi naḥ || 19 || yat | ci॒t | hi | te॒ | api̭ | vya॒thiḥ | ja॒gvā॒ṃsaḥ | a̭rma॒hi | go॒dāḥ | it | i॒ndra | bo̭dhi | na̭ḥ || 19 || ᵥapi ᵥcit api ca he ᵥindra ᵥte tubhyaṃ ᵥyat yadā ᵥhi vyathiḥ dāridryeṇa vyathitāḥ ᵥjagvāṃsaḥ gantāro vayam ᵥamanmahi viṣṭumaḥ tadā ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥgodā ᵥit gavāṃ dātaiva bhavāmīti ᵥbodhi budhyasva ||

ā tvā̭ ra॒mbhaṃ na ji॒trayo̭ ra॒mbhā śa̭va॒saspa̭te | u॒śmasi॒ tvā sa॒dhastha॒ ā || 20 || ā | tvā̭ | ra॒mbham | na | ji॒traya̭ḥ | ra॒mbham | śa̭va॒saḥ | pa॒te | u॒śmasi̭ | tvā̭ | sa॒dhasthḙ | ā ||20|| he ᵥśavasaspate balasya pate ᵥtvā tvāṃ vayaṃ ᵥjitrayaḥ kṣīṇā vṛddhāḥ ᵥrambhaṃ ᵥna daṇḍamiva ᵥrambhaṃ rabhāmahe | tathā ca yāskaḥ—' ārabhāmahe tvā jīrṇā iva daṇḍam' ( niru. 3. 21 ) iti | api ca ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥsadhasthe yajñe ᵥuśmasi kāmayāmahe || || 45 ||

sto॒trami̭ndrā॒ya gā̭yata pu॒ruṇṷmṇāya sa॒tvanḙ | naki̭rya॒ṃ vṛ̭ṇvate yu॒dhi || 21 || sto॒tram | i॒ndrāya̭ | gā̭yata | pu॒ru'nṷmṇāya | sa॒tvanḙ | naki̭ḥ | yam | vṛ̭ṇvate | yu॒dhi || 21 || ᵥyam indraṃ ᵥyudhi yuddhe ᵥnakiḥ ᵥvṛṇvate ke'pi na vārayanti tasmai ᵥsatvane dānaśīlāya ᵥpurumṇāya bahudhanāya ᵥindrāya ᵥstotraṃ ᵥgāyata paṭhata ||

a॒bhi tvā̭ vṛṣa॒bhā su॒te su॒taṃ sṛ̭jāmi pī॒tayḙ | tu॒mpā vi̭ a॒śruhī̭ ma॒dam || 22 || a॒bhi | tvā̭ | vṛ॒ṣa॒bha | su॒te | su॒tam | sṛ̭jāmi | pī॒tayḙ | tu॒mpa | vi | a॒śruhī̭ | ma॒dam || 22 || he ᵥvṛṣabha indra ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥsute some'bhipute sati ᵥsutam abhiputaṃ somaṃ ᵥpītaye pānāya ᵥabhi ᵥsṛjāmi | ᵥtumpa tṛpya ᵥmadaṃ madakaraṃ ᵥvyaśruhi ca ||
1. jha-ta1-2-3-dāteva | 2. gha-pate iṃdra | 3. ga-ta-bha-rambhā | 4. kha-jha-ta1-bha-madakaraṃ smema |

mā tvā murā aviṣyavo mopahsvān ā dabhan | mākīṃ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ ||23|| mā | tvā | murāḥ | aviṣyavaḥ | mā | upa'hasvānaḥ | ā | dabhan | mākīm | brahma'dviṣaḥ | vanaḥ | || 23 || he indra tvā tvāṃ mūrāḥ mūrakā mūḍhā manuṣyāḥ | aviṣyavaḥ pālanakāmāḥ | mā ā dabhan mā hiṃsantu | upahasvānaḥ upahasanaparāśca mā bhavantu | brahmadviṣaḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ dveṣṭṛn mākīṃ vanaḥ mā bhajethāḥ ||

iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase | sarau gauro yathā piba || 24 || iha | tvā | go'parīṇasā | mahe | mandantu | rādhase | saraḥ | gauraḥ | yathā | piba || 24 || he indra tvā tvām iha yajñe goparīṇasā gavyena payasā saṃmiśritena somena mahe mahate rādhase dhanāya mandantu manuṣyā mādayantu | tvaṃ ca taṃ somaṃ yathā gauraḥ mṛgaḥ saraḥ pibati tathā piba ||

yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve | tā saṃsatsu pra vocata || 25 || yā | vṛtra'hā | parā'vati | sanā | navā | ca | cucyuve | tā | saṃsat'su | pra | vocata ||25|| vṛtrahā indraḥ parāvati dūre yā yāni sanā sanātanāni navā navāni nūtanāni ca dhanāni cucyuve preritavān tāni dhanāni saṃsatsu yajñeṣu sabhāsu vā pra vocata prabrūte vidvajjanaḥ || || 46 ||

arpibatkadruvaḥ sutamindraḥ sahasrabāhe | atrādediṣṭa pauṃsyam || 26 || arpibat | kadruvaḥ | sutam | indraḥ | sahasra'bāhe | atra | adediṣṭa | pauṃsyam || 26 || indraḥ kadruvaḥ kadrunāmakasyardheḥ saṃbandhin sutam abhiṣutaṃ somam apibat pītavān | sahasrabāhe sahasrabāhoḥ śatrūnvāhati śeṣaḥ | atra asminnavasare pauṃsyam indrasya vīryam adediṣṭa adīvyata ||

satyaṃ tatturvaśe yadau vidāno ahvayadhyam | vyānaṭ turvaṇe śarmī || 27 || mṛtyam | tat | turvaśe | yadau | vidānaḥ | ahvayadhyam | vi | ānaṭ | turvaṇe | śarmī ||27|| turvaśe rājñi yadau ca yadunāmne ca rājñi tat prasiddhaṃ yāgādilakṣaṇaṃ śami karma | 'śacī śamī' iti karmanāmasu pāṭhāt | satyaṃ paramārthaṃ vidānaḥ jānaṃstayoḥ prītyartham ahvayadhyam ahvayadhyanāmakaṃ tayoḥ śatruṃ turvaṇe saṃgrāme vyānaṭ vyāptavān ||
taraṇi vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gormataḥ | samānamu pra śaṃsipam || 28 || taraṇim | traḥ | janānām | tradam | vājasya | go'mataḥ | samānam | ū~ iti | pra | śaṃsipam ||28||
2. ga-pālakāmādabhan; jha-ta1-2-pālakāmā ādabhan; ta3-4-na-pālakāmā mādabhan; bha1- pālakāmāmādabhan |

he asmadīyā: puruṣā: vva: yuṣmākaṃ vjanānāṃ putrapautrādīnāṃ vtaraṇi tārakaṃ vtradaṃ śatrūṇāṃ tardayitāraṃ vgomata: paśumatojjhasya dātāraṃ cendraṃ vsamānamu sādhāraṇameva vpra vśaṃsiṣaṃ staumi || ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ na vartave uktheṣu tubhyāvṛdham | indraṃ some sarcā sute || 29 || ṛbhukṣaṇam | na | vartave | uktheṣu | tubhya'vṛdham | indram | soma | sarcā | sute || 29 || vṛbhukṣaṇaṃ mahāntaṃ vtubhyāvṛdham udakasya vardhayitāram | 'tubhyā burdharam' ityudakanāmasu pāṭhāt | vindraṃ vsome vsacā stotreṇa saha vsute abhiṣute sati vuktheṣu śastreṣu vvartave dhanaṃ varituṃ praśaṃsāmīti śeṣa: | vna iti saṃpratyarthe || ya: kuntadidvi yonyaṃ triśokāya giriṃ pṛthum | gobhyoṃ gātuṃ niraitave ||30|| ya

mā | naḥ | ekasmin | ārgasi | mā | dvayoḥ | uta | triṣu | vadhīḥ | mā | śūra | bhūriṣu ||34|| he śūra indra naḥ asmān ekasminnāgasi aparādhe mā vadhīḥ mā hiṃsīḥ | dvayoḥ āgasorapi mā vadhīḥ | uta api ca triṣu āgaḥsvapi mā hiṃsīḥ | bhūriṣu asaṃkhyāteṣvapyā- gaḥsu mā ca vadhīḥ ||

bibhayā hi tvādvata ugrādabhiprabhaṅgaṇaḥ | dusmādahamṛtīṣahaḥ || 35 || bibhaya | hi | tvādvataḥ | ugrāt | abhi'prabhaṅgaṇaḥ | dusmāt | aham | ṛti'sahaḥ ||35|| he indra tvādvataḥ tvatsadṛśāt ugrāt udghūrṇāt abhiprabhaṅgaṇaḥ śatrūṇāmabhiprahartuḥ dusmāt pāpānāmupakṣapayituḥ ṛtīṣahaḥ śatrukṛtāṃ hiṃsāṃ sahataḥ ahaṃ bibhaya hi || 48 ||

mā sakhyuḥ śūnamā vinde mā putrasya prabhuvaso | āvṛtvadbhūta te manaḥ ||36|| mā | sakhyuḥ | śūnam | ā | vinde | mā | putrasya | prabhuvaso iti prabhu'vaso | ā'vṛtvat | bhūta | te | manaḥ || 36 || he prabhuvaso prabhūtadhanendra te tava sakhyuḥ śūnaṃ vṛddhaṃ mā ā vide māvedayāmi | putrasya api śūnaṃ mā vide | tava manaḥ asmāsu āvṛtvat āvartanavat bhūtu bhavatu | punaḥpunaḥ sukhaṃ karotvityarthaḥ ||

ko nu maryā amaithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyamabravīt | jahā ko asmadīṣate ||37|| kaḥ | nu | maryāḥ | amaithitaḥ | sakhā | sakhāyam | abravīt | jahā | kaḥ | asmata | īṣate ||37|| ko nu kaḥ khalu he maryāḥ manuṣyāḥ amaithitaḥ medhatirākrośakarmā | anākṛṣṭa indrānyaḥ sakhā sakhāyaṃ prati jahā ahaṃ kaṃ jaghāna kaḥ vā asmata asmatto bhītaḥ īṣate palāyata iti abravīt vadati | indra evaitādṛśasya vacanasya vaktetyabhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca yāskaḥ—' medhatirākrośakarmā | apāpakaṃ jaghāna kamahaṃ jātu ko'smadītaḥ palāyate ' ( niru. 4. 2 ) iti | ' mā na ekasminnāgasi ' ityādikayā śrutyā nūnamṛṣimindra ājahāretyartharvismata iti ||

evārai vṛṣabhā sute'sinvanbhūryāvayaḥ | śvaghnīva nivatā caran || 38 || evārai | vṛṣabha | sute | asmin | bhūri | āvayaḥ | śvaghnī'iva | nivatā | caran || 38 || he vṛṣabha kāmānāṃ varṣakendra evārai | evāro nāma kaścit | tasmin sute abhiṣute some sati bhūri bahūni dhanāni asminvan na baddhan śvaghnī | śvaghnī kitavaḥ | tathā ca yāskaḥ—' śvaghnī kitavo bhavati svaṃ hanti '---' ( niru. 5. 22 )---' ||
ā te etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumatyathā | yadīṃ brahmabhya ihadeḥ ||39|| ā | te | etā | vacaḥ'yujā | harī iti | gṛbhṇe | sumata'rathā | yat | īm | brahma'bhyaḥ | it | dadaḥ || 39 ||
5. gha-ababhran śvaghnī kitava iva sa somaḥ tvāmeva prāptaḥ āvayaiḥ dṛśyamānāḥ sarve devā nivatā adhomukhāḥ saṃtaḥ ācarannirgatāḥ |
kha-saṃhate; ga-sahante; ta-na- saṃhate; bha1-3-svaṃ haṃ; bha2-svaṃ haṃtīti; śa-saṃhateti |
vte' tava vsumadrā kalyāṇarayau vvacoyujā mantreṇa yujyamānau vetā etau vharī aśvau vā vgṛmbhe |
vyat yasmāt tvaṃ vbrahmabhya vit brāhmaṇebhya eva vīm idaṃ dhanaṃ vdadaḥ dadāsi ||
bhindhi viśvā ap dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ |
bhindhi | viśvāḥ | ap | dviṣaḥ | pari | bādhaḥ | jahī | mṛdhaḥ | vasu | spāham | tat | ā | bhara ||40||
he indra tvaṃ vviśvāḥ sarvāḥ vdviṣaḥ dveṣṭīḥ śatrusenāḥ vapa vbhindhi vidāraya |
atastāsāṃ vspāhaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ vtat prasiddhaṃ vvasu vā vbhara asmabhyamāhara ||
yat | vīḻau | indra | yat | sthire | yat | parśāne | parā'bhṛtam | vasu | spāham | tat | ā | bhara || 41 ||

he vindra tvayā ca vvīḻau dṛḍhe paraiḥ kampayitumaśakye vyat dhanaṃ vparābhṛtaṃ vinyastaṃ vyat ca vsthire svayamacale parābhṛtaṃ vyat cāpi vparśāne vimarśanakṣame parābhṛtaṃ vtat vspāhaṃ vvasu vā vbhara ||
yasya | te | viśva'mānuṣaḥ | bhūraiḥ | dattasya | vedati | vasu | spāham | tat | ā | bhara ||42||

he indra vte tvayā'| vibhaktivyatyayaḥ | vdattasya dattaṃ vbhūraiḥ bahu vyasya yaddhanam | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | vviśvamānuṣaḥ sarvo manuṣyaḥ vvedati jānāti vtat vspāhaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ vvasu vā vbhara || || 49 ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye ṣaṣṭhāṣṭakaṃ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra 'tvāvataḥ ' iti trayastriṃśadacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktamapyuttrasya vaśālyasyārṣam |
'dadhāno gomadaśvavat ' ityeṣā pañcamī kakup aṣṭakadvādaśāṣṭakaiḥ pādai- rupetatvāt |
‘ya ṛṣvaḥ’ iti dvādaśī viparītā satobṛhatī prathamatṛtīyayoraṣṭākṣarā dvitīyacaturthayordvādaśākṣarā ca |
‘sa no vājeṣu’ iti trayodaśī caturviṃśatyakṣarā dvipadā |
‘abhi vo vīram’ iti caturdaśī pipīlikamadhyā bṛhatī |
‘dadī rekṇaḥ’ iti pañcadaśī kakubhyaṅkuśirā ‘traiṣṭubhajāgatacatuṣkāḥ kakubhyaṅku- śirā’ (anu. 5. 4) ityuktatvāt |
‘sanitaḥ susanitaḥ’ iti viṃśī viṣamapadā bṛhatī ‘navakāṣṭyekādaśyaṣṭino viṣamapadā’ (anu. 7. 8) ityuktatvāt |
‘gāvo na yūtham’ iti triṃśī viṃśatyakṣarā dvipadā virāḍ |
‘ā sa etu’ ityādibhiścatasṛbhiḥ kanītaputrasya pṛthuśravaso dānaṃ stūyate |
‘ā no vāyo’ ityādīnāṃ catasṛṇāṃ dvātriṃśacca vāyudevatā |

etatsarvamanukramaṇyāmuktaṃ- ‘tvāvatastrayastriṃśo'ṣṭya ā sa ādi kānītasya pṛthuśravaso dānastutirādyā pādanicṛt pañcamyādi kakuggāyatrī bṛhatyanuṣṭup satobṛhatī gāyatrī viparītottaraḥ pragātho dvipadā caturviṃśikā bṛhatī pipī- likamadhyā kakubhyaṅkuśirā virāḍjagatyupariṣṭādbṛhatībṛhatvaṃ viṣamapadottare paṅktī gāyatrī paṅktiḥ pragāthau ca vāyavyau gāyatrī dvipadoṣiṇap paṅktirvāyavyā gāyatrī’ iti |
tathā ca pañcamāraṇyake śaunakena sūtritaṃ—‘tvāvataḥ puruvasiviti vaśaḥ sanitaḥ susanirityetadantaḥ’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 5) iti ||

tvāvataḥ puruvaso va॒yami̭ndra praṇe॒taḥ | sa॒masi̭ sthā॒tarhrī̭ṇām || 1 || tvā̭va̭taḥ | pu॒ru॒va॒so॒ iti̭ pu॒ru॒'va॒so॒ | va॒yam | indra̭ | pra॒ṇe॒taḥ iti̭ pra॒'ne॒taḥ | sa॒masi̭ | sthā॒taḥ | hrī̭ṇām || 1 ||
he puruvaso bahudhanendra praṇetaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāraṃ prakarṣeṇa prāpayitaḥ indra tvāvataḥ tvatsadṛśasya |
he hrīṇām etatsaṃjñakā- nāmnāṃ sthātaḥ adhiṣṭhātaḥ ||
tvāṃ hi sa॒tyama̭drivo vi॒śva dā॒tāra̭mi॒ṣām | vi॒śva dā॒tāra̭ṃ ra॒yī॒ṇām || 2 || tvām | hi | sa॒tyam | a॒dri'vaḥ | vi॒śva | dā॒tāra̭m | i॒ṣām | vi॒śva | dā॒tāra̭m | ra॒yī॒ṇām || 2 ||
tadvacchindra tvāṃ satyaṃ niścayama iṣām annānāṃ dātāraṃ viśva jānīmaḥ |
ā yasya̭ te ma॒hi॒māna̭ṃ śa॒tambhṷ̄te śa॒takra̭to |
1. ga-ta-bha-śa-bṛhatī | 2. kha-ga-ta-bha-uṣṇip | 3. kha-gha-ta-na-bha-śa-kanīna | 4. ga-ityantametat | 5. kha-gha-jha-ta-2-bha-śa-pranetaḥ; ga-prāṇetaḥ | 6. na-jānīma |

ā | yasya̭ | tḙ | ma॒hi॒māna̭m | śata̭m'ūte | śata̭krato iti śata̭'krato | gīḥ'bhiḥ | gṛ॒ṇanti̭ | kā॒rava̭ḥ || 3 || he ᵥśatam‌ūte aparimitarakṣaṇa he ᵥśatakrato bahukarmayuktendra ᵥyasya ᵥte ᵥmahimānaṃ māhātmyaṃ ᵥkāravaḥ stotāraḥ ᵥgīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᵥgṛṇanti stuvanti svāmīṣṭāya ||

su॒nī॒tho gha॒ sa ma॒rtyo yaṃ ma॒ruto̭ yama̭rya॒mā | mi॒traḥ | pā॒ntya॒druha̭ḥ || 4 || su॒nī॒thaḥ | gha॒ | saḥ | ma॒rtyaḥ | yam | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | yam | a॒rya॒mā | mi॒traḥ | pā॒nti̭ | a॒druha̭ḥ ||4|| ᵥsa ᵥmartyaḥ manuṣyo yajamānaḥ ᵥsunīthaḥ suyajñaḥ sunayano vā bhavati | ᵥgha iti prasiddhau | sa ityuktaṃ kamityāha | ᵥyaṃ yajamānaṃ ᵥmarutaḥ devāḥ ᵥpānti rakṣanti ᵥadruhaḥ adrohakartāraḥ | tathā ᵥyamaryamā pāti | yaṃ ca ᵥmitraḥ pāti | sa evaṃ bhavatīti ||

da॒rdhāno̭ goma̭daśva̭tsu॒vīrya̭mādi॒tyarja̭ta edhate | sa॒dā rā॒yā pṷru॒spṛhā || 5 || da॒rdhāna̭ḥ | go'ma̭t | a॒śva̭'vat | su॒'vīrya̭m | ā॒di॒tya'rja̭taḥ | e॒dha॒te | sa॒dā | rā॒yā | pu॒ru॒spṛhā̭ || 5 || ᵥādityarjutaḥ ādityaprerita ādityānugṛhīto' yajamānaḥ ᵥgomat gobhirupetam ᵥaśvavat aśvairupetaṃ ᵥsuvīryaṃ śobhanavīryopetaṃ putraṃ ᵥdadhānaḥ dhārayan ᵥedhate vardhate ᵥsadā sarvadā | kiṃca ᵥpuruspṛhā bahubhiḥ spṛhaṇīyena ᵥrāyā dhanena sadaivadhate || || 5 ||

tamindraṃ dā॒rnamī̭mahe śa॒vasā̭nama॒bhīrva̭m | ī॒śāna̭ṃ rā॒ya ī̭mahe || 6 || tam | indra̭m | dā॒rnam | ī॒mahḙ | śa॒vasā̭nam | a॒bhīrva̭m | ī॒śāna̭m | rā॒yaḥ | ī॒mahḙ || 6 || ᵥtaṃ prasiddham ᵥindraṃ ᵥdānaṃ deyaṃ ᵥrāyaḥ dhanam ᵥīmahe yācāmahe | kīdṛśamindram | ᵥśavasānaṃ balamācarantam ᵥabhīrvam abhīrum ᵥīśānaṃ sarvasya svāminam ||

tasmi̭nhi sa॒ntyu॒tayo॒ viśvā̭ a॒bhīrnuḥ sa॒cā | tamā va̭hantu sa॒rmaya̭ḥ pu॒ruva̭suṃ ma॒dāya̭ ha॒raya̭ḥ su॒tam || 7 || tasmi̭n | hi | sa॒nti | ū॒taya̭ḥ | viśvā̭ḥ | a॒bhīrva̭ḥ | sa॒cā | tam | ā | va॒ha॒ntu | sa॒rmaya̭ḥ | pu॒ru'va̭sum | ma॒dāya̭ | ha॒raya̭ḥ | su॒tam || 7 || ᵥtasmin indre ᵥūtayaḥ gantavyaḥ ᵥviśvāḥ sarvāḥ ᵥabhīravaḥ akātarāḥ ᵥsacā sahāyabhūtā marudrūpāḥ senāḥ ᵥsanti bhavanti | athavā tasmin sarvāṃ rakṣaṇāḥ saha saṃbhavanti | ᵥtam indraṃ ᵥsasayaḥ sarpaṇaśīlāḥ ᵥharayaḥ aśvāḥ ᵥpuruvasuṃ bahudhanam | bahudhanapradamityarthaḥ | taṃ ᵥmadāya ᵥsutam abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ prati ᵥā ᵥvahantu āgamayantu ||
yastḙ ma॒do va̭re॒ṇyo ya indra̭ vṛ॒traha̭ntamaḥ |
yaḥ | te | madaḥ | vareṇyaḥ | yaḥ | indra | vṛtrahan'tamaḥ | yaḥ | ā'dadiḥ | svaḥ | nṛ'bhiḥ | yaḥ | pṛtanāsu | dustaraḥ || 8 ||
pūrvamantre madāya haraya ityuktaṃ sa madaḥ stūyate |
he indra te tava yaḥ madaḥ vareṇyaḥ varaṇīyaḥ |
yaḥ ca madaḥ saṃgrāme vṛtrahantamaḥ śatrūṇāmatiśayena hantā |
yaḥ ca ādadiḥ ādātā svaḥ svaraṇaṃ dhanaṃ nṛbhiḥ nṛbhyaḥ śatrubhyaḥ |
yaḥ ca pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu dustaraḥ anabhibhāvyaḥ |
yo duṣṭarau viśvavāra śravāyyo vājeṣvasti tarutā |
sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gumem gormati vraje ||
yaḥ | dustaraḥ | viśva'vāra | śravāyyaḥ | vājeṣu | asti | tarutā | saḥ | naḥ | śaviṣṭha | savanā | ā | vaso iti | gahi | gumem | go'rmati | vraje || 9 ||

he viśvavāra viśvairvarṇīyendra vājeṣu yuddheṣu yaḥ tava duṣṭaraḥ duḥkhena tarītuṃ śakyaḥ tarutā śatrūṇāṃ tārakaḥ asti bhavati he vaso vāsaka he śaviṣṭha atiśayena balavannindra saḥ tvaṃ naḥ savanā asmākaṃ savanāni ā gahi āgaccha |
vayaṃ ca gomati vraje gomantaṃ vrajaṃ gamema gacchema ||

gumyo iti | su | naḥ | yathā | purā | aśva'yā | uta | ratha'yā | varivasya | mahā'maha || 10 ||

yaḥ ! ṛṣvaḥ | śravayat'sakhā | viśvā | it | saḥ | veda | janima | puru'stutaḥ | tam | viśvai | mānuṣā | yugā | indram | havante | taviṣam | yata'ścucaḥ || 12 ||

he indra tvāṃ viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ vasūnāṃ dhanānām harayantam īśānam asya varṣasaḥ vārakasya kṛpayataḥ yuddhaṃ kalpayataḥ śatroḥ sāsahāṃsam abhivitāraṃ stuvata iti śeṣaḥ |

mahaḥ su vo aramiṣe stavāmahe mīḻahuṣe araṃgamāya jagmaye |

tadartha mīḻahuṣe sektre araṃgamāya saṃpūrṇagamanāya jagmaye gamana- śīlāya yajñaṃ prati evaṃbhūtāya devāya stavāmahe |

kiṃca tvā tvāṃ namasā namaskāreṇa girā stutyā ca gāye stuve ||

daśa śyāvā ṛdhadrayo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ | mathā nemiṃ ni vavṛtuḥ || 23 || daśa | śyāvāḥ | ṛdhat'rayaḥ | vītavārāsaḥ | āśavaḥ | mathā | nemim | ni | vavṛtuḥ || 23 || 'daśa daśasaṃkhyākāḥ 'śyāvāḥ śyāvavarṇāḥ 'āśavaḥ aśvāḥ 'nemiṃ rathanemiṃ 'ni 'vavṛtuḥ nivartayanti | rathaṃ vahantītyarthaḥ | 'idaṃśāste 'ṛdhadrayaḥ pravṛddhavegāḥ 'vītavārāsaḥ krāntabalāḥ prāsa- balā vā āśavaḥ 'mathāḥ' mathanaśīlāḥ ||

dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ | rathaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadanmaṃhiṣṭhaḥ sūrirabhūdvarṣiṣṭhakṛta śravaḥ || 24 || dānāsaḥ | pṛthu'śravasaḥ | kānītasya | su'rādhasaḥ | ratham | hiraṇyayam | dadat | maṃhiṣṭhaḥ | sūriḥ | abhūt | varṣiṣṭham | akuruta | śravaḥ || 24 || pūrvemantraiḥ pratipāditāni dhanāni' bandhūnāṃ piturvā purastānnirdiṣṭāśrāste | 'pṛthuśravasaḥ 'kānītasya 'surādhasaḥ śobhanadhanasya | yatastasya dhanaṃ kalpatamataḥ sa surādhāḥ | tasya 'dānāsaḥ dānāni dhanānīmāni | sa ca pṛthuśravāḥ pūrvamuktāni 'hiraṇyayaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ 'rathaṃ ca 'dadat prayacchan 'maṃhiṣṭhaḥ atiśayena dātā 'sūriḥ sarvasya prerakaḥ prājño vā 'abhūt bhavati bhavatu vā | 'varṣiṣṭham atiśayena pravṛddhāṃ 'śravaḥ kīrtim 'akuruta karoti karotu vā || 'ā no vāyo' ityeṣā pañcame'hani praugaśastre vāyavyatṛce tṛtīyā | 'ā no vāyo mahe tana ityekā rathena pṛthupājasā' (āśva. śrau. 7. 12) iti hi sūtritam ||
