ᐁdurgāṇi durgamanān pradeśānavaṭaghiṣyādikān ᐁyathā parivarjayanti tadvat |
ᐁuta api ca ᐁādityānām ᐁavasi rakṣaṇe ca syāma ||

pari̭hṛte॒danā॒ janaṷ yu॒ṣmāda̭ttasya vāyati | de॒vā a̭da॒bhramāśa॒ vo yamā̭dityā a॒heta̭nā॒neha̭sau va ū॒taya̭ḥ su॒ūta̭yo va ū॒taya̭ḥ ||6|| pari̭'hṛte | it | anā̭ | janḙ | yu॒ṣmā'da̭ttasya | vā॒yati̭ | de॒vāḥ | a॒da॒bhram | ā॒śa | vaḥ | yam | ā॒dityāḥ | a॒heta̭na | anḙhasaḥ | vaḥ | ū॒taya̭ḥ | su'ṷ̄tayaḥ | vaḥ | ū॒taya̭ḥ || 6 ||
ᐁparihṛtet paripaḍitenaiva taponiyamādinā ᐁanā prāṇayuktaḥ ᐁjanaḥ ᐁyuṣmādattasya yuṣmābhirdattaṃ dhanam |
he ᐁdevāḥ he ᐁāśavaḥ śīghragamanāḥ 3 yūyaṃ ᐁyaṃ yajamānam ᐁahetana prāpnutha saḥ 4 janaḥ ᐁadabhram analpaṃ dhanaṃ vāyati prāpnotīti saṃbandhaḥ ||

na taṃ ti॒gmaṃ ca̭na॒ tyajo̭ na drā॒sadṷbhi॒ taṃ gu॒ru | yasmā̭ u॒ śama̭ sa॒pratha॒ ārdityā̭so a॒rāgha̭va॒manḙhaso va ū॒taya̭ḥ su॒ūta̭yo va ū॒taya̭ḥ ||7|| na | tam | ti॒gmam | ca॒na | tyaja̭ḥ | na | drā॒sat | a॒bhi | tam | gu॒ru | yasmai̭ | ū~ iti̭ | śama̭ | sa॒'pratha̭ḥ | ā॒dityā̭saḥ | a॒rāgha̭vam | anḙhasaḥ | vaḥ | ū॒taya̭ḥ | su'ṷ̄tayaḥ | vaḥ | ū॒taya̭ḥ || 7 ||

ᐁtaṃ manuṣyaṃ ᐁtigmaṃ ᐁcana tīkṣṇameva santaṃ ᐁtyajaḥ | krodhanāmaitat | atra krodhāt prayujyamāna- māyudhamucyate | ᐁna ᐁdrāsat | ‘drā kutsāyāṃ gatau’ | kutsitaṃ nācchati 1 | na hinastītyarthaḥ | tathā ᐁtaṃ janaṃ ᐁguru pravṛddhamaparihārahaṃ duḥkhaṃ ᐁna drāsat na gacchati | he ᐁādityāḥ : ādityāḥ : ᐁsaprathaḥ :
1. ga-ta-na-bha-śa- ‘manoḥ’ nāsti | 2. ta-na-bha-śa-parihṛtādita | 3. gha-śīghragamanā ādityāḥ; 4. kha-ta-na-sa dhanaḥ; śa-yajamānaḥ | 5. na-śa- gacchati |

samānaprathanā: sarvataḥ pṛthubhūtā vā yūyaṃ yasmā ḍau yasmai yajamānāya | uśaśabda: pūraṇa: | śarma sukham 'arādhyam adatta taṃ ma’ drāsaditi || yuṣme devā arpi mpasi yudhyantaiva varmasu | yuyaṃ maho na enaso yuyamabhīdurupyatānehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ ||8|| yuṣme iti | devāḥ | arpi | mpasi | yudhyantaḥ'iva | varma'su | yuyam | mahaḥ | naḥ | enasaḥ | yuyam | abhīt | urupyata | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ || 8 || he devāḥ ādityāḥ yuṣme yuṣmāsu vayam api smasi api bhavema | yuṣmābhirapahitāḥ smetyarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | yudhyantaḥ śūrāḥ varmasu kavaceṣu yathā bhavanti tadvat | yuyaṃ naḥ asmān mahaḥ mahataḥ enasaḥ pāpāt urupyata rakṣata | tathā yūyam asmān abhīt alpādyenasaḥ urupyata || arditinaṃ urupyatarditiḥ śarma yacchatu | mātā mitrasya revatau'ryammo varuṇasya cānehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ ||9|| aditiḥ | naḥ | urupyatu | aditiḥ | śarma | yacchatu | mātā | mitrasya | revataḥ | aryamṇaḥ | varuṇasya | ca | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ || 9 || naḥ asmān aditiḥ akhaṇḍanīyā devamātā urupyatu rakṣatu | tathā aditiḥ śarma sukhaṃ yacchatu | aditirviśeṣyate | yā mātā nirmātrī | kasya | mitrasya revataḥ dhanavataḥ aryamṇaḥ varuṇasya ca | sā na urupyatviti || yadaivāḥ śarma śaraṇaṃ yadbhadraṃ yadanāturam | tridhātu yadvarūthyaṃ tadasmāsu vi yantanānehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ ||10|| yat | devāḥ | śarma | śaraṇam | yat | bhadram | yat | anāturam | tri'dhātu | yat | varūthyam | tat | asmāsu | vi | yantana | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ || 10 || he devāḥ ādityāḥ yat śarma sukhaṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇīyam | yat bhadraṃ sarvabhaṃjanīyam | yat anāturaṃ rogarahitam | yat tridhātu triguṇam | yadvarūthyam | varūthaṃ gṛham | tadarham | tat ūphaguṇaṃ śarma asmāsu vi yantana viyacchata || 8 || ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlādiva sparśaḥ | sutīrthamarvato yāthānu no neṣathā sugarmanehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ ||11|| 1. ta-na-tana; bha-nata; śa-tena | 2. ta-śa-pāpa; na-bha1-2- pāpa |
ādityāḥ | ava̭ | hi | ryata | adhi̭ | kū॒lāt'iva | sparśaḥ | su'tīrtham | arva̭taḥ | yathā̭ | anṷ | naḥ | nepatha | su'gam | anehasa̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ | su'ūtaya̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ || 11 ||
he ādityāḥ yūyam ava hi ryata ava hi paśyatādhastātsthitānasmān |
yathā kūlasthaḥ puruṣo'dhogatamudakaṃ jijñāsustatasthaṃ manuṣyāṃ vā vilokayitumavāpakṣyati tadvat |
tathā kṛtvā sutīrtha śobhanāvatāra- pradeśam arvataḥ aśvān yathā prāpayantyaśvarakṣakāstadvat naḥ asmān sugaṃ supanthānam anu nepatha anunayatha ||

neha bhadraṃ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta | garve ca bhadraṃ dhenavai vīrāya ca śravasyatai'nehasau va ūtayaḥ suūtayau va ūtayaḥ||12|| na | iha | bhadram | rakṣasvinḙ | na | atra'yai | na | upa'yai | uta | garve | ca | bhadram | dhenavai̭ | vīrāya̭ | ca | śravasyatḙ | anehasa̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ | mu'ūtaya̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ || 12 ||
he ādityāḥ iha bhūmau bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ sukhaṃ rakṣasvine rakṣo balam |
atrayai asmān hiṃsitumagacchate na bhavatu bhadram |
asmadvirodhino gavādi- kāya bhadraṃ na bhavatviti tasyārthaḥ ||

yadāviryadapīcya̭ṃ devāso asti duṣkṛtam | tritai tadviśvamāpatya āre asmaddhātanānehasau va ūtayaḥ suūtayau va ūtayaḥ||13|| yat | āvi̭ḥ | yat | apīcya̭m | devāsa̭ḥ | asti | duḥ'kṛtam | tritai | tat | viśva̭m | āptyḙ | ārḙ | asmat | dadhātana | anehasa̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ | su'ūtaya̭ḥ | vaḥ | ūtaya̭ḥ || 13 ||
he devāsaḥ devā ādityāḥ yadāviḥ yat pāpmāvirbhūtam asti 1 duṣkṛtaṃ yat ca apīcyam antarhitamasti |
tadviśvaṃ tadubhayam āptye tritai mayi mā bhūt |
kiṃtu asmat āre dūre dadhātana sthāpayata ||
tathā ca ‘svamamanojñaṃ dṛṣṭvā’ ityupakramya ‘yacca goṣu duḥsvapnyamiti pañcabhirādityamupatiṣṭheta’ (āśva. gṛ. 3. 6. 6) iti sūtritam ||

yacca goṣu duṣvapnyaṃ yaccāsme duhitardivaḥ | tritāya tadvibhāvaryāptvāya parā vahānehasau va ūtayaḥ ||14|| yat | ca | goṣu | duḥsvapnyam | yat | ca | asme iti | duhitaḥ | divaḥ | tritāya | tat | vibhā'vari | āptyāya | parā | vaha | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | || 14 ||
he divaḥ duhitaḥ uṣaḥ upodevate yacca goṣu asmadīyāsu duṣvapnyam anarthasūcakaṃ dṛṣṭam |
kiṃca yacca duṣvapnyam asme asmāsu dṛṣṭam |
gopīḍānimintakasmākaṃ pīḍānimintakaṃ ca yahuḥsvapnaṃ paśyāma ityarthaḥ |
he vyucchana- vati devi āpyāya tritāya parā vaha dūre parihara ||

niṣkaṃ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṃ vā duhitardivaḥ | trite duṣapnyaṃ sarvamāptye pari dadhasyanehasau va ūtayaḥ ||15|| niṣkam | vā | gha | kṛṇavate | srajam | vā | duhitaḥ | divaḥ | trite | duḥsvapnyam | sarvam | āptye | pari | dadhasi | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | || 15 ||
he divaḥ duhitaḥ uṣaḥ niṣkaṃ vā gha ābharaṇaviśeṣaṃ vā kṛṇavate kurvate svarṇakārāya yat duṣvapnyaṃ dṛṣṭam |
tasminnapi mālākāre mālānirmāṇasamaye yaduṣvapnyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadubhayaviṣayaṃ duḥsvapnam āptye apāṃ putre trite vartamānaṃ pari dadhasi upari dadhaḥ |
trite mayi yat duṣvapnyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tat svarṇakārāya mālākārāya vā pari dadhasi |

tadannāya tadapase taṃ bhāgamṛpaseduṣai | tritāya ca dvitāya coṣau duṣvapnyaṃ vahānehasau va ūtayaḥ ||16|| tata'annāya | tata'apase | tam | bhāgam | upa'seduṣai | tritāya | ca | dvitāya | ca | urṣaḥ | duḥsvapnyam | vaha | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | || 16 ||
yadeva jāgaravāvasthāyāṃ bhojyatvena prasiddhaṃ madhupāyasādi svame'pi tadevātra yasya saḥ |
yadevāpaḥ karma ninditaṃ jāgradavasthāyāṃ kriyate tadeva karmaṃ svame yasya sa tatkarmā |
syāṃśam ᵥupaseduṣe prāpnuvate ᵥtritāya ᵥdvitāya ᵥca he ᵥuṣaḥ devi ᵥduṣṣvapnyam añjhakarmaviṣayaṃ ᵥvaha anyatra prāpaya |
svame dṛṣṭaṃ madhubhojanādikaṃ jāgradavasthāanubhūtavat sukhakaraṃ bhavatvityarthaḥ |
yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatha ṛṇaṃ saṃnayāmasi |
evā duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye saṃ nayāmasyanehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ|
yathā | kalām | yathā | śapham | yathā | ṛṇam | sam'nayāmasi | eva | duḥ'svapnyam | sarvam | āptye | sam | nayāmasi | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ || 17 ||
saṃjñapitaṃ paśuṃ dānārthaṃ saṃskṛtavantaḥ ᵥyathā yena prakāreṇa ᵥkalāṃ ᵥśapham iti saṃdāyānyatra saṃnayanti |

yathā kalāṃ hṛdayādyavayavamavadānāhaṃ saṃnayanti yathā ca śaphaṃ śaphopalakṣitamanavadānāhaṃ śaphāsthyādikaṃ saṃnayanti ᵥyathā vā ᵥṛṇaṃ śanaiḥ saṃna- yanti ᵥeva evaṃ ᵥduṣṣvapnyaṃ ᵥsarvamāptye vartamānaṃ ᵥsaṃ ᵥnayāmasi saṃnayāmaḥ apasārayāmaḥ |
uṣo yasmāhuṣṣvapnyādabhaiṣmmā taducchatvanehasau va ūtayaḥ sukṛtayau va ūtayaḥ|
ajaiṣma | agha | asanām | ca | abhūma | anāgasaḥ | vayam | uṣaḥ | yasmāt | duḥ'svapnyāt | abhaiṣma | apa | tat | ucchatu | anehasaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ | su'ūtayaḥ | vaḥ | ūtayaḥ || 18 ||
ᵥasanāma ᵥca saṃbhajema ca sukhamaṃ sukhaṃ vā |
he ᵥuṣaḥ ᵥyasmāt ᵥduṣṣvapnyāt ᵥabhaiṣma bhītāḥ sma ᵥtat pāpam ᵥapa ᵥucchatu apagacchatu |
‘svādorabhakṣi’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya pragāthasyārṣa somadevatākaṃ traiṣṭubham |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘svādoḥ pañconā pragāthaḥ saumyaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ pañcamī jagata’ iti |
viśve yaṃ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṃcaranti |
svādoḥ | abhakṣi | vayasaḥ | su'medhāḥ | su'adhyaḥ | varivovit'tasya | viśve | yam | devāḥ | uta | martyāsaḥ | madhu | bruvantaḥ | abhi | sam'caranti || 1 ||
ahaṃ pragāthaḥ ᵥsumedhāḥ śobhanaprajñaḥ ᵥsvādhyaḥ svādhyayanaḥ sukarmā ᵥvarivovittasya atiśayena pūjāṃ labhamānasya ᵥsvādoḥ suṣṭudanīyasya svādubhūtasya ᵥvayasaḥ annasya |
yaṃ padaṃ 'viśve 'devāḥ sarve'pīndrādayaḥ 'uta api ca 'martyāsaḥ martyā manuṣyāḥ 'madhu 'bhuvantaḥ manoharametaditi śabdayantaḥ 'abhi 'saṃcaranti abhisaṃgacchante prāpnuvanti tadannamabhakṣīti |
tathā ca sūtritam—'antaśca prāgā aditirmaṃvāsi iyeno na yoniṃ sadanaṃ dhiyā kṛtam' (āśva. śrau. 4. 10) iti |
indvindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭhīva dhuramanu rāya ṛdhyāḥ |
antariti | ca | pra | argāḥ | aditiḥ | bhavāsi | ava'yātā | harasaḥ | daivyasya | indo iti | indrasya | sakhyam | juṣāṇaḥ | śrauṣṭhī'iva | dhuram | anu | rāye | ṛdhyāḥ ||2||
gatvā ca 'aditiḥ adhīnastvaṃ 'daivyasya 'harasaḥ krodhasya 'avayātā pṛthakartā 'bhavāsi bhavasi |
athavāśvo yathā dhuraṃ tvvābhimatedeśaṃ prāpayati tadvadasmān prāpaya |
'apāma somam' ityādike dve somapānottarakālīnāsthābhimarśane hṛdayābhimarśane ca krameṇa viniyukte |
tathā ca sūtritam—'apāma somamamṛtā abhūma śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indviti mukhahṛdaye abhimṛśeran' (āśva. śrau 5. 6) iti |
apāma | somam | amṛtāḥ | abhūma | a'ganma | jyotiḥ | avidāma | devān | kim | nūnam | asmān | kṛṇavat | arātiḥ | kim | ū~ iti | dhūrtiḥ | amṛta | martyasya || 3 ||
he 'amṛta' amarana soma tvām 'apāma pānaṃ karavāma |
'kimu kiṃ vā 'martyasya idānīṃ manuṣyabhūtasya mama 'dhūrtiḥ hiṃsakaḥ kiṃ kṛṇavat kuryāt |
śaṃ nau bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ |
sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyurjīvase soma tārīḥ |
śam | naḥ | bhava | hṛde | ā | pītaḥ | indo iti | pitā'iva | soma | sunave | su'śevaḥ | sakhā'iva | sakhyai | uru'śaṃsa | dhīraḥ | pra | naḥ | āyuḥ | jīvase | soma | tārīḥ || 4 ||

1. ga-śabdayantaḥ | 2. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa-tvaṃ | 3. ga-bha-dhṛtvā | 4. kha-ta-na-bha-1-2-praya; ga-naya; śa-rāya | 5. kha-ta-1-2-amṛta avida | 6. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa-artha tathābhūtān | 7. ta3-na bha1-cā; śa-ca |
he ᐁindo ᐁsoma asmābhi:1 ᐁpīta: tvaṃ ᐁna: asmākaṃ ᐁhṛde hṛdayāya ᐁśaṃ sukham ᐁā ᐁbhava |
ᐁpitā ᐁsūnave svātmajāya yathā sukhāya bhavati yathā vā ᐁsakhā ahitātsvārtha hite sthāpayitā sakhā sa svasasye yathā ᐁsuśeva: susukho bhavati |
kiṃca he ᐁuruśaṃsa bahubhirbahudhā vā śaṃsanīya bahukīrte ᐁsoma ᐁdhīra: dhīmāṃstvaṃ ᐁna: asmākaṃ ᐁjīvase jīvanāya ᐁāyu: āyuṣyaṃ ᐁpra ᐁtārī: pravardhaya2 ||
ime mā pītā yaśasaṃ uruṣyavo rathaṃ na gāva: samanāha parvasu |
te mā rakṣantu visrasaścaritrāduta mā svāmādyavayantvindava: ||

ᵥahāni ᵥsūryaḥ ᵥhava'| atra 'īṣaṇena vaiṣaṇena vārṣaṇena vā' (niru. 4. 7) ityādi niruktaṃ jñātavyam || soma rājanmṛḻayā naḥ svasti tarva smasi vratyāistasya viddhi | alarti dakṣa uta manyurindo mā nau aryo anukāmaṃ parā dāḥ || 8 || soma | rājan | mṛḻaya | naḥ | svasti | tava | smasi | vratyāḥ | tasya | viddhi | alarti | dakṣaḥ | uta | manyuḥ | indo iti | mā | naḥ | aryaḥ | anu'kāmam | parā | dāḥ || 8 || he ᵥsoma ᵥrājan ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥsvasti avināśāya ᵥmṛḻaya sukhaya ca | ᵥvratyāḥ vatino vayaṃ ᵥtava ᵥsmasi svabhūtāḥ smaḥ | ᵥtasya taṃ svakīyaṃ tava ᵥviddhi jānīhi | athavā tava tvamityarthaḥ | tvaṃ jānīhi | kiṃca he ᵥindo ᵥdakṣaḥ pravṛddho'smacchatruḥ ᵥalarti gacchati | ᵥuta api ca ᵥmanyuḥ krodhaḥ kruddho vā alarti | tādṛśasyobhayavidhasya ᵥaryaḥ areḥ ᵥanukāmaṃ yathākāmaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥmā ᵥparā ᵥdāḥ parādehi || tvaṃ hi nastanvaḥ soma gopā gātregātre niṣatthā nuccakṣāḥ | yattai vayaṃ pramināma vratāni sa nau mṛḻa susakhā deva vasyaḥ || 9 || tvam | hi | naḥ | tanvaḥ | soma | gopāḥ | gātre'gātre | ni'sattha | nu'cakṣāḥ | yat | te | vayam | pra'mināma | vratāni | saḥ | naḥ | mṛḻa | su'sakhā | deva | vasyaḥ || 9 || he ᵥsoma deva ᵥtvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥtanvaḥ tanorhasya ᵥgopāḥ ᵥhi rakṣitā khalu | ataḥ ᵥgātregātre sarveṣvaṅgeṣu ᵥnucakṣāḥ nṛṇāṃ karmanetṛṇāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ ᵥniṣattha niṣīdasi | ᵥyat yadyapi ᵥte tava ᵥvratāni karmāṇi ᵥvayaṃ ᵥpramināma hiṃsmaḥ | tathāpi he ᵥdeva ᵥsaḥ tvaṃ ᵥvasyaḥ śreṣṭhān ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥsusakhā śobhanasakhā san ᵥmṛḻa sukhaya || ṛdudareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyedaryaśca pītaḥ | arya yaḥ somo nyadhāyyasme tasmā indraṃ pratiramemyāyuḥ || 10 || ṛdudareṇa | sakhyā | saceya | yaḥ | mā | na | riṣyet | hari'aśva | pītaḥ | ayam | yaḥ | somaḥ | ni | adhāyi | asme iti | tasmai | indram | pra'tiram | emi | āyuḥ || 10 || ahaṃ pragāthaḥ ᵥṛdudareṇa udarābādhakena somena ᵥsakhyā saceya saṃgaccheya | saṃgato bhavāmi | 'ṛdudaraḥ somo mṛdudaraḥ' (niru. 6. 4) iti yāskaḥ | ᵥyaḥ somaḥ ᵥpītaḥ san ᵥmā māṃ ᵥna ᵥriṣyet na hiṃsyet he ᵥharyaśva indra | saumye sūkta indrasya kīrtanaṃ somasyendrasvāmikatvācca viruddham | ᵥyaḥ ᵥayaṃ ᵥsomaḥ ᵥasme asmāsu ᵥnyadhāyi nihito'bhūt ᵥtasmai somāya ᵥpratiram ᵥāyuḥ jaṭhare cirakālāvāsthānam ᵥindram ᵥemi yāce || || 12 || apu tyā asthuranirā amīvā niratrasantamapicīramaiṣuḥ | ā somo asmā~ aruhadvihāyā arganm yatra pratiranta āyuḥ || 11 || 1. gha-iva sa yathā varṣaṇena pravardhayati tadvat | 2. khata-na-bha-śa-eṣaṇena | 3. bhara-hiṃset; bha1-hiṃsat |
arpa | tyāḥ | asyuḥ | anīrāḥ | amīvāḥ | | niḥ | atrasan | tarmiṣīcīḥ | abhaiṣuḥ | | ā | somaḥ | | asmān | aruhat | vi'hayāḥ | | argan | yatra | pra'tirantai | āyuḥ | | 11 | |
tyāḥ tāḥ anīrāḥ prerayitumaśakyāḥ amīvāḥ balavatyaḥ pīḍāḥ |
yāḥ tarmiṣīcīḥ balavatyo'smān niḥ nitarām atrasan prāpnuvan kampayanti tathā abhaiṣuḥ |
yasmāt somaḥ vihāyāḥ mahān san asmān ā aruhat āgamat prāptavān ato'pāsthuriti bhāvaḥ |
yatra yasmin some pīte āyuḥ āyuṣyaṃ pratirante vardhayanti manuṣyāstaṃ somamagama iti ||
yo na induḥ pitaro hatsu pīto'martyo martya ā viveśa |
tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema maḻīke asya sumatau syāma ||
yaḥ | naḥ | induḥ | pitaraḥ | hatsu | pītaḥ | amartyaḥ | matirahitaḥ | martyān | ā | viveśa | tasmai | somāya | haviṣā | vidhema | maḻīke | asya | su'matau | syāma || 12 ||
he pitaraḥ yaḥ induḥ hatsu pītaḥ san amartyaḥ matirahitaḥ san āviveśa martyān naḥ asmān tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema paricarema |
asya somasya maḻīke sukhe sumatau cānugrahabuddhau ca syāma bhavema ||
mahāpitṛyajñe 'somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśam' ityatra 'tvaṃ soma' iti yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūrvvān' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti |
'tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna iti saumyasya' (āśva. śrau. 5. 19) iti hi sūtritam ||
tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha |
tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
tvam | soma | pitṛ'bhiḥ | sam'vidānaḥ | anu | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | ā | tatantha | tasmai | te | indo iti | haviṣā | vidhema | vayam | syāma | patayaḥ | rayīṇām || 13 ||
he soma tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ saṃgacchamānaḥ dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau anu ā tatantha krameṇa vistārayasi |
vayaṃ rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ patayaḥ syāma bhavema ||
trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ |
vayaṃ somasya viśvahe priyārsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||
trātāraḥ | devāḥ | adhi | vocata | naḥ | mā | naḥ | nidrā | īśata | mā | uta | jalpiḥ | vayam | somasya | viśvahe | priyārsaḥ | su'vīrāsaḥ | vidatham | ā | vadema || 14 ||
he trātāraḥ rakṣitāro he devāḥ naḥ asmān adhi vocata adhivacanaṃ kuruta |
kiṃca naḥ asmān nidrāḥ svamāḥ mā īśata īśvarā mā bhūvan bādhitum |
1. khata-na-bha-śa-'pīḍāḥ' nāsti | 2. khata-na-bha-1-2-śa-aparāme; gha-tyajaṃtu aparādhe | 3. ta-na-bha-śa-martau | 4. kha-ta-bha-'pīyameva |
vayaṃ somasya priyāsaḥ priyāḥ syāma viśvaha sarveṣvapyahaḥsu |
subīrāsaḥ śobhanaputrāḥ santaḥ vidathaṃ stotram ā vadema ābhimukhyena vadema |
'tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvataḥ' iti saumye paśau haviṣo'nuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhā yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām' (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti ||
tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvatau vayodhāstvaṃ svarvadā viśa nṛcakṣāḥ |
tvaṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣaḥ pāhi paścātāduta vā purastāt ||
tvam | naḥ | soma | viśvataḥ | vayaḥdhāḥ | tvam | svaḥ'vit | ā | viśa | nṛ'cakṣāḥ | tvam | naḥ | indo iti | ūtibhiḥ | sa'joṣaḥ | pāhi | paścātāt | uta | vā | purastāt ||15||
he soma tvaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ viśvataḥ sarvābhyo digbhyaḥ vayodhāḥ annadātā |
tathā tvaṃ svarvit svargalabhakaḥ nṛcakṣāḥ sarvamanuṣyadraṣṭā tvam ā viśa |
he indo tvaṃ sajoṣaḥ saha prīyamāṇaḥ san ūtibhiḥ saha |
taiḥ sahitaḥ san paścātāt paścāt uta vā purastāt ca pāhi ||
abhi pra veḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide |
yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā puruvasuḥ sahasreṇaiva śikṣati ||

śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrutikārthalakṣmī yo vikāsayati hṛdratam(? ॰tām) | sa pāyātścindānandaḥ sūryamaṇḍalago hariḥ || 'abhi pra vaḥ' iti daśarce prathamaṃ sūktaṃ praskaṇvasyārṣamaindram | anukrāntaṃ ca—'abhi pra daśa praskaṇvaḥ prāgāthaṃ tat' iti | ayujāṃ bṛhatī chandaḥ | yujāṃ satobṛhatī chandaḥ | viniyogaḥ sūtrādavagantavyaḥ || (1) ṛṣirātmānaṃ brūte | he praskaṇva vaḥ yuṣmākam | bahuvacanaṃ putrapautrābhiprāyeṇa | yuṣmatsvāmibhūtamindramabhilakṣya prācya prakarṣeṇa pūjaya | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā vide vidvāṃsaṃ svaguruṃ pūjayasi tadvat | kīdṛśam | surādhasam | śobhanaṃ rādho dhanaṃ yasya tam | ko'sāvindra ityucyate | ya indraḥ maghavā dhana-
vārāṇasīstharājakīyasaṃskṛtapāṭhaśālāyāḥ prāpte jha-saṃjñakalikhitapustake vālakhilyasūktānāṃ bhāṣyaṃ likhitamupalabhyate |
paraṃ vitareṣu sarveṣvapi pustakeṣvanupalambhān vyākhyāśailyā vibhinnatvānna naitatsāyaṇācāryakṛtamiti vyaktaṃ pratīyate |
etasmin viṣaye'smābhiḥ pṛṣṭā etapāṭhaśālādhikāriṇaḥ evaṃ likhanti—'etadastalikhitaṃ pāṭhaśālāyāḥ kṛte revānagare krītamāsīt |
abhi | pra | vaḥ | su'rādhasam | indram | arca | yathā | vide | yaḥ | jaritṛbhyaḥ | magha'vā | puru'vasuḥ | sahasreṇa'iva | śikṣati || 1 ||

śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe | gireriva pra rasā asya pinvira datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ || 2 || śatānīkā'iva | pra | jigāti | dhṛṣṇuyā | hanti | vṛtrāṇi | dāśuṣe | gireḥ'iva | pra | rasāḥ | asya | pinvira | datrāṇi | puru'bhojasaḥ || 2 ||

ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ | āpo na vajribhanvokyaṃ saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase || 3 || ā | tvā | sutāsaḥ | indavaḥ | madāḥ | ye | indra | girvaṇaḥ | āpaḥ | na | vajrin | anu | okyam | saraḥ | pṛṇanti | śūra | rādhase || 3 ||

anehasaṃ prataraṇaṃ vivakṣaṇaṃ maghavaḥ svādiṣṭhamīṃ piba | ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudrava tmanā dhṛṣat || 4 || anehasam | pra'taraṇam | vivakṣaṇam | maghavaḥ | svādiṣṭham | īm | piba | ā | yathā | mandasānaḥ | kirāsi | naḥ | pra | kṣudra'iva | tmanā | dhṛṣat || 4 ||
vān puruvasuḥ bahunāṃ vāsayitā jaritṛbhyaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ sahasreṇaiva aparimitameva śikṣati dadāti |
( 2 ) dhṛṣṇuyā śatrudharṣaṇaśīla indraḥ śatānīkeva aparimitānyeva ripusainyāni pra jigāti praka- ṣeṇa gacchati |
kiṃca ya indraḥ dāśuṣe havirdattavato yajamānasya vṛtrāṇi pāpāni śatrūn vā hanti nāśayati |
tasyāsya purubhojasaḥ bahupālakasyendrasya datrāṇi hiraṇyādīni dhanāni |
datramatra hiraṇyaṃ ‘marut datram’ iti hiraṇyanāmasu pāṭhāt |
pra pinvira prakarṣeṇa prīṇayanti tarpayanti jagat |
gireriva parvatasya meghasya vā saṃbandhino yathā rasāḥ jalāni jagat prīṇayanti tadvat ||

( 3 ) he girvaṇaḥ gīrbhirvandanīyendra madāḥ harṣakarāḥ ye indavaḥ somāḥ sutāsaḥ abhiṣutāḥ santi te he vajrin vajropeta he śūra śauryayuktendra okyaṃ samavayitumarhaṃ (? samavetumarhaṃ) tvā tvāmāpṛṇanti sarvataḥ pūrayanti |
( 4 ) he indra anehasaṃ yathākālam īm enaṃ somaṃ piba |
vivakṣaṇam atiśayena stutyaṃ maghavaḥ madhunaḥ sakāśādapi svādiṣṭhaṃ svādutamam |
yasya pānena mandasānaḥ havīṃdhi saṃbhajamānastvaṃ no'smabhyaṃ yajamānebhyaḥ yathā yathāvat phalamākirāsi kātsyrnena vikṣipasi |
dhṛṣat śatrudharṣaṇastvaṃ tmanā ātmanā svayameva kṣudrava dīnebhya iva tebhyo yathā pra dadāsi tadvat |

ā naḥ stoma̭mupa॒ drava̭ntyā॒no aśvā̭ na sa॒rtṛbhi̭ḥ | yaṃ tai sva॒dhāva̭ntsva॒daya̭nti॒ dhena̭va॒ indra̭ ka॒ṇveṣṷ rā॒taya̭ḥ || 5 || ā | naḥ | stoma̭m | upa̭ | drava̭t | hi॒yānā̭ḥ | aśvā̭ḥ | na | sa॒rtṛbhi̭ḥ | yam | te | sva॒dhā'va̭n | sva॒daya̭nti | dhena̭vaḥ | indra̭ | ka॒ṇveṣṷ | rā॒taya̭ḥ || 5 || || 14 ||

u॒graṃ na vī॒raṃ na̭ma॒sopa̭ sedima vi॒bhūtima̭kṣi॒tāva̭sum | u॒drīva̭ va॒jrinva̭to na si॒śvatḙ kṣa॒rantī̭ndra॒ dhīrtaya̭ḥ || 6 || u॒gram | na | vī॒ram | na॒masā̭ | upa̭ | sedima̭ | vi॒'bhūtima̭ | akṣi̭ta'vasam | u॒drī'i̭va | va॒jrin | a॒vata̭ḥ | na | si॒śvatḙ | kṣa॒ranti̭ | indra̭ | dhī॒taya̭ḥ || 6 ||

yadvai nūnaṃ yadvai ya॒jñe yadvai pṛthi॒vyāmadhi̭ | a॒to no̭ ya॒jñamāśṷbhi॒rmahḙmata u॒gra u॒grebhi̭rā ga॒hi || 7 || yat | ha | nu॒nam | yat | vā | ya॒jñe | yat | vā | pṛthi॒vyām | adhi̭ | a॒taḥ | naḥ | ya॒jñam | āśṷ'bhiḥ | ma॒he'ma̭te | u॒gra | u॒grebhi̭ḥ | ā | ga॒hi || 7 ||
( 5 ) he indra sa bhavān no'smadīyeḥ sotṛbhiḥ somābhiṣavakartṛbhiradhvaryādibhirvā'vibhiḥ kṛtaṃ stotraviśeṣam ā ābhimukhyena upa dravat upagacchatu samīpaṃ prāpnotu |
hiyānāḥ preyamāṇaḥ aśvā na aśva iva |
sa yathā abhilapitaṃ deśaṃ prāpnoti tadvat |
he svadhāvan annavannindra te tava svabhū- tāni dhenavaḥ tarpakāṇi kaṇveṣu asmāsu vartamānāni rātayaḥ havirdānāni yaṃ tvāṃ svadayanti svādayanti |
sa bhavān upa dravat iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||
( 6 ) he indra vīraṃ viśeṣeṇa śatrūn preyantaṃ tvāṃ namasā havirlakṣaṇenana saha |
yadvā namasā prahvībhāvena saha upa sedima śaraṇaṃ prāpnumo vayam |
taṃ yathā kecana dīnāḥ śaraṇaṃ prāpnuvanti tadvat |
kiṃca he vajrin vajravannindra siśvate svargādiphalasektre tumyaṃ tvadarthe dhītayaḥ asmadaṅgulayaḥ kṣaranti sravanti somarasam |
udakān (! udakavān) avato na kūpa iva |
sa yathā sasyādisektre jalaṃ kṣarati tadvat |
( 7 ) he mahemate pūjāsaktabuddhe indra yadva yatra kacit sthānaviśeṣe nūnaṃ niścitaṃ vartase |
yat yatra vā yajñe adhvare vartase |
yat yatra vā pṛthivyām adhi adhikaṃ vartase |
ataḥ asmātsthānaviśeṣāt ugraḥ udgūrṇabalastvam ugrebhiḥ udgūrṇabalaiḥ āśubhiḥ śīghragāmibhiraśvaiḥ no'smākaṃ yajñam ā gahi āgaccha ||

ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātāiva prasikṣaṇaḥ | yebhirarpatayaṃ manuṣaḥ purīyase yebhiviśvaṃ svarhaśe || 8 || ajirāsaḥ | harayaḥ | ye | te | āśavaḥ | vātāḥ'iva | pra'sikṣaṇaḥ | yebhiḥ | arpatayam | manuṣaḥ | pari'īyase | yebhiḥ | viśvam | svaḥ | dṛśe || 8 ||

etāvatasta īmaha indra sumnasya gormataḥ | yathā prāvau maghavanmedhyātithiṃ yathā nīpātithiṃ dhanai || 9 || etāvataḥ | te | īmahe | indra | sumnasya | go'mataḥ | yathā | pra | āvaḥ | magha'van | medhya'atithim | yathā | nīpa'atithim | dhanai || 9 ||

yathā kaṇvai maghavantrasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje | yathā gośarye asanorṛjiśnīndra gomaddhiraṇyavat || 10 || yathā | kaṇvai | magha'van | trasadasyavi | yathā | pakthe | daśa'vraje | yathā | go'śarye

pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamarcaṃ śakramamiṣṭaye | yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate || 1 || pra | su | śrutam | su'rādhasam | arca | śakram | abhiṣṭaye | yaḥ | sunvate | stuvate | kāmyam | vasu | sahasreṇa'iva | maṃhate || 1 ||

śatānīkā hetayau asya dustarā indrasya samidhau mahīḥ | girina bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yadīṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ || 2 || śata'anīkāḥ | hetayaḥ | asya | dustarāḥ | indrasya | sama'idhaḥ | mahīḥ | giriḥ | na | bhujmā | maghavat'su | pinvate | yat | īm | sutāḥ | amandiṣuḥ || 2 ||

yadīṃ sutāsa indavo'bhi priyamandiṣuḥ | āpo na dhāyi sarvaṃ ma ā vaso dughā'iva dāśuṣe || 3 || yat | īm | sutāsaḥ | indavaḥ | abhi | priyam | amandiṣuḥ | āpaḥ | na | dhāyi | sarvam | me | ā | vaso | iti | dughāḥ'iva | urpa | dāśuṣe || 3 ||
he puṣṭigo tvam abhiṣṭaye abhilaṣitasiddhaye taṃ śakraṃ sarvakarmasu śaktamindraṃ su suṣṭhu yathā tathā pra arca prakarṣeṇa pūjaya |
ya indraḥ munvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate stuvate stutiṃ kurvate yajamānāya kāmyaṃ kāminaṃ( ! kamanīyaṃ ) vasu dhanaṃ sahasreṇaiva asaṃkhyātameva maṃhate dadāti tam |
( 2 ) sutā abhiṣutāḥ somāḥ yadā īmenamindram amandiṣuḥ amādayan tadā asyendrasya hetayaḥ inasādhanānyāyudhāni maghavatsu havirlakṣaṇadhanavatsu yajamāneṣu pinvate |
sa yathā bhuvi jalāni samarpa tāṃ prīṇayati tadvat |
śatrudhanāharaṇaṃ tu ‘ śatruyatāmā bharā bhojanāni ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 4. 5 ) ityādiśrutiprasiddham |
( 3 ) he indra yadā sutāsaḥ abhiṣutāḥ indavaḥ somāḥ yaṃ( ! priyaṃ )vallabham īm enaṃ tvām abhi abhilakṣya amandiṣuḥ amādayan |
tadā he vaso vāsayatirandra tvayā dāśuṣe havirdattavate me mahyaṃ madarthe savanaṃ yajñaḥ upagamya ā dhāyi kātsyrnena saphalīkṛtaḥ |
havirdughā dhenavo yathā sānnāyyaseva- nādinā saphalīkriyante tadvat somapānādinā yajñaḥ saphalīkṛta ityarthaḥ ||

anehasa̭ṃ vo harvamānamūtaye ma॒dhva̭ḥ kṣaranti dhī॒taya̭ḥ | ā tvā̭ va॒so harvamānāsa inda̭va u॒rpa sto॒treṣṷ dadhire || 4 || anehasa̭m | vaḥ | harvamānam | ū॒tayḙ | ma॒dhva̭ḥ | kṣa॒ranti̭ | dhī॒taya̭ḥ | ā | tvā̭ | va॒so iti̭ | harvamānāsaḥ | inda̭vaḥ | u॒rpa | sto॒treṣṷ | da॒dhire || 4 ||

ā na̭ḥ soma̭ sva॒dhvara॒ īyā̭no a॒tyo na taṷśate | yaṃ tḙ sva॒dāva̭ntsva॒danti̭ gu॒rtaya̭ḥ pau॒re cha̭ndayase harvam || 5 || ā | na̭ḥ | soma̭ | su॒'a॒dhvarḙ | ī॒yā॒naḥ | a॒tyaḥ | na | taṷśate | yam | tḙ | sva॒dā'va̭n | sva॒danti̭ | gu॒rtaya̭ḥ | pau॒re | cha॒ndaya̭se | harvam || 5 || ||16||

pra vī̭ramu॒graṃ vi॒rvici̭ṃ dha॒nuspṛ̭taṃ vi॒bhūrti̭ rādha̭so ma॒haḥ | u॒drīva̭ va॒jrinva॒to va̭su॒tvanā॒ sadā̭ pī॒petha॒ dāśṷṣe || 6 || pra | vī̭ram | u॒gram | vi॒rvici̭m | dha॒nu'spṛ̭tam | vi॒'bhūrti̭m | rādha̭saḥ | ma॒haḥ | u॒drī'i̭va | va॒jrin | a॒vata̭ḥ | va॒su'tvanā̭ | sadā̭ | pī॒petha̭ | dāśṷṣe || 6 ||
( 4 ) he ṛtvijaḥ vaḥ yuṣmatsaṃbandhinyaḥ dhītayo'ṅgulayaḥ ūtaye rakṣārthe havamānaṃ stūyamānamindra- muddiśya madhvaḥ madhurarasaṃ somaṃ kṣaranti |
he vaso vāsayitarindra havamānāsaḥ stūyamānāḥ indavaḥ somāḥ stotreṣu nimitteṣu tvā tvām upa samīpe ā dadhire ābhimukhyena sthāpitavantaḥ ||
( 5 ) no'smākaṃ yajamānānāṃ saṃvandhini svadhvare śobhanayajñe some somapāne nimittabhūte sati atyo na satatagamanaśīlo'śva iva iyānaḥ gacchannindraḥ ā tośate asmacchatrūn hinasti |
he svadāvan āsvādana- kuśalendra te tava svabhūtāḥ gūrtayaḥ udyatāḥ stutayaḥ yaṃ tvāṃ svadanti ātmānamāsvādayanti sa tvaṃ paure purajanasamūhe havamātmanaḥ stutiṃ chandayase kāmayase |
( 6 ) he indra vīra viśeṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ prerayitāraṃ mahaḥ mahat rādhasaḥ rādho dhanam |
ugramūrjasvabalaṃ virviciṃ puṇyāpuṇyayorvibektāraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ dhanadātāraṃ vibhūrti vivithaiśvaryopetaṃ ( ! ) 'petaṃ yataḥ he vajrin vajra- vannindra tvaṃ dāśuṣe haviṣāṃ dātāram |
sadā sarvadā vasutvanā dhanadānena pīpetha āpyāyayasi |

yad nūnaṃ parāvati yadvā pṛthivyāṃ divi | yujāna indra haribhirhemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhir gahi || 7 || yat | ha | nūnam | purā'vati | yat | vā | pṛthivyām | divi | yujānaḥ | indra | haribhiḥ | mahe'mate | ṛṣvaḥ | ṛṣvebhiḥ | ā | gahi || 7 ||

rathirāso harayo ye tai asidha ojo vātasya piprati | yebhirni dasyuṃ manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ purīyase || 8 || rathirāsaḥ | harayaḥ | ye | te | asidhaḥ | ojaḥ | vātasya | piprati | yebhiḥ | ni | dasyum | manuṣaḥ | ni'ghoṣayaḥ | yebhiḥ | svaḥ riti svaḥ | | puri'īyase ||8||

yathā | kaṇvai | magha'van | medhe | adhvare | dīrgha'nīthe | darmūnasi | yathā | go'śarye | asisāsaḥ | adri'vaḥ | mayi | gotram | hari'śriyam ||10|| ||17|| || atha tṛtīyaṃ sūktam || yathā manau sāṃvaraṇau somarmindrārpibaḥ sutam | nīpātithau maghavanmeṣyātithau puṣṭigau śruṣṭigau sacā || 1 || yathā | manau | sāma'vaṃraṇau | somam | indra | arpibaḥ | sutam | nīpa'atithau | magha'van | medhya'atithau | puṣṭi'gau | śruṣṭi'gau | sacā || 1 || pārṣdvāṇaḥ praskaṇvaṃ samasādayacchayānaṃ jintrimudditam | sahasrāṇyasipāsadvāmṛṣṭisvavato dasyave vṛkaḥ || 2 || pārṣdvāṇaḥ | praskaṇvam | sam | asādayat | śayānam | jintrim | udditam | sahasrāṇi | asisāsat | gavām | ṛṣiḥ | tvā

svalpamapi śīghraṃ satyātre samarpitaṃ bahulībhūya īśvare saṃgata bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ |

( 8 ) ya indraḥ vadhaiḥ āyudhaprahāraiḥ kriviṃ vikṛtaṃ śuṣṇametannāmānamasuram ojasā balena nighoṣayan nitarāṃ śabdayan san abhi abhitaḥ pra prakarṣeṇa nanakṣe vyāpnoti sma |

tenendreṇa ruśame akalyāṇe arye arigaṇe tasmin tiraścit antarhitameva pavīravi |
he indra tubhyameva tvadarthameva saḥ asuragaṇe vidyamānaḥ rayiḥ nikhilalakṣaṇo dhanarāśiḥ ajyate prakṣipyate'rigaṇena |
asuragaṇe guptaṃ cakradānamapi indrāya nidhipradamabhavat tadā saptātre guptaṃ dhanadānaṃ mahāphaladaṃ syāditi kimu vaktavyamityāśayaḥ ||
viprāso medhāvino yajamānāḥ arkamarcanīyamindram ānucuḥ : arcanti |
madhumantaṃ madhurāmṛtasapetaṃ ghṛtaśrutaṃ jalasrāviṇaṃ meghabhedanena vṛṣṭiṃ kurvantamityarthaḥ |
asme asmāsu rayiḥ dhanarāśiḥ praprathe prathito bhavatu |
kiñcāsme asmāsu suvānāsaḥ abhiṣutā indavaḥ somāḥ santu |

'yathā manau vivasvati' iti daśarce caturthe sūktam āyavamaindram | anukrāntaṃ ca—'yathā manāvāyuḥ' iti | kāṇva āyurṛṣiḥ | indro devatā | ayujāṃ bṛhatī chandaḥ | yujāṃ satobṛhatī chandaḥ | viniyogaḥ sūtrādavagantavyaḥ ||
(1) he śakra samarthendra yathā yena prakāreṇa vivasvati vivasvataḥ putre vaivasvate manau vartamānaṃ sutamabhiṣutaṃ somam apibaḥ pītavānasi |
he indra parameśvara yathā ca trita etannāmake ṛṣau vartamānaṃ chandaḥ vedajātaṃ jujoṣasi bhṛśaṃ sevase |
tathā āyau etannāmake mayi sacā saha vartamānaṃ somaṃ chandolakṣaṇaṃ tadubhayaṃ saṃsevya mādayase ānandayasi māmātmānaṃ ca ||

pṛṣre medhyai mātiśvanīndraṃ suvāne amandathāḥ | yathā somaṃ darśiśre darśoṇye syūmaraśmārjūnasi || 2 || pṛṣre | medhyai | mātiśvani | indra | suvāne | amandathāḥ | yathā | somam | darśiśre | darśoṇye | syūmaraśmau | arjūnasi || 2 ||

yasya tvamindra stomeṣu cākano vājeṃ vājiñchatakrato | taṃ tvā vayaṃ sududhāmiva goduhau juhumasi śravasyavaḥ || 4 || yasya | tvam | indra | stomeṣu | cākanaḥ | vājeṃ | vājin | śatakrato iti śata'krato | tam | tvā | vayam | sududhām'iva | go'duhaḥ | juhumasi | śravasyavaḥ || 4 ||
yo nau dātā sa naḥ pitā mahā~ ugra īśānakṛt |
ayāmabhyugro maghavā puruvasurgorśvasye pra dātu naḥ ||

udayāstamayavyāpārairupalakṣitaḥ san trīṇi padā tribhiḥ pādaiḥ |
( 4 ) he vājin annavan he śatakrato bahukarmavannindra tvaṃ yasya yajamānasya stomeṣu stotreṣu nimitteṣu vāje havirlakṣaṇe anne ca nimittabhūte sati cākanaḥ |
tṛpyasi taṃ tādṛśaṃ tvā tvāmindra śravasyavaḥ |
godohvāraḥ sudoghnīṃ gāṃ prati yathā haritatṛṇādikaṃ dadati tadvat ||

sāmarthyāt mūrtīḥ indrasya pracurān mahato guṇāvatārā- nityarthaḥ |

(10) ya indraḥ bṛhatīḥ mahānti rāyaḥ hiraṇyādidhanāni samadhunuta samyakarot |

kiṃca gavāśiraḥ godugdhaṃ somāḥ tadrasāśca tamindraṃ samamandiṣuḥ |

( 2 ) he indra yastvaṃ divedive pratidinaṃ vāvṛdhānaḥ stutyaḥ atiśayena vardhamānaḥ san āyum etannāmānamṛṣim uttamam etatsaṃjamṛṣim atithigvam etatsaṃjamṛṣiṃ ca ardayaḥ varapradāne (1°pradānena) pīḍa- yasi |

ye indavaḥ somāḥ parāvati dūradeśe vartamānāḥ |

kiṃca bṛhat mahān yo'gniḥ śukeṇa śukena śociṣā tejasā sūraḥ suṣṭhu īrayitā prerakaḥ san rātrau bhuvi arocata dīpyate |
atha ca divā divi (?) dyotamāne svaloke sūryaḥ suṣṭhu prerayitādityaḥ arocata dīpyate |
‘ yuvaṃ devā ’ iti catūṛcaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya medhyasyāśvinaṃ traiṣṭubham |
anukramyate- ‘ yuvaṃ devā catuṣkaṃ medhya āśvinaṃ traiṣṭubham ’ iti |

( 1 ) he yajatrā yajanīyau pūjyau devau dyotamānāśvinau puṇyeṇa purā bhavena ṛtunā karmaṇā anugrahabuddhyā vā upetau yuvāṃ yuvāṃ prati rathena raṃhaṇasvabhāvena syandanena yuktāḥ saṃyuktā aśvāḥ taviṣaṃ balaṃ yathā bhavati tathā vahantīti śeṣaḥ |
tasmāt he nāsatyā nāsatyau satyabhūtau yuvāṃ śacībhiḥ anugrahalakṣaṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ saha idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanamuddiśya āgacchatamāgacchatam |
āgatya ca pibāthaḥ pibataṃ sobhamiti śeṣaḥ ||

yuvāṃ devānya ekādaśārsa: satyā: satyasya dadṛśe purastāt | asmākaṃ yajñaṃ sarvaṃ juṣāṇā pāta somamaśvinā dīrghamī || 2 || yuvām | devā: | traya: | ekādaśārsa: | satyā: | satyasya | dadṛśe | purastāt | asmākam | yajñam | sarvam | juṣāṇā | pātam | somam | aśvinā | dīrghamī iti dīrdi'abhī ||2||

punāyyaṃ tadaśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rjasa: pṛthivyā: | sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭhau sarvā~ ita upa yātaṃ pibadhyai || 3 || punāyyam | tat | aśvinā | kṛtam | vām | vṛṣabha: | diva: | rjasa: | pṛthivyā: | sahasram | śaṃsā: | uta | ye | go'iṣṭhau | sarvān | ita | tān | upa | yāta | pibadhyai ||3||

ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihito yajatremā girau nāsatyopa yātam | pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantame pra dāśvāṃsamavataṃ śacībhi: || 4 || ayam | vām | bhāga: | ni'hita: | yajatrā | imā: | gira: | nāsatyā | upa | yātam | pibatam | somam | madhu'mantam | asme iti | pra | dāśvāṃsam | avatam | śacībhi: ||4|| ||28||
( 2 ) he aśvināśvinau yuvāṃ dvau apare ca traya ekādaśaśa: trayastriṃśaddevā: |
te ca ‘aṣṭau vasava: ekādaśa rudrā dvādaśādityā: prajāpatiśca vaṣaṭkāraśca’ iti śrutiprasiddhā: |
sarve yūyaṃ satyā: yathārthabhūtā: santa: satyasāvitathasya yajñasya purastāt purodeśe dadṛśe dṛśyamānā bhavata |
taṃ tādṛśaṃ yajñaṃ yajanīyamadhvaraṃ juṣāṇā juṣamāṇau sevamānau yuvāṃ somam abhiṣutasomarasaṃ pātaṃ pibatama |
dīdi: atiśayena dīvya- māna: agni: jaṭharānalo yayostau tādṛśau |
( 3 ) he aśvināśvinau pṛthivyā: bhūmerheto: diva: dyulokāt sakāśāt rajasa: udakasya vṛṣabha: barṣitā sūryo'stīti yat tatsarvaṃ vāṃ yuvayo: kṛtaṃ karma punāyyaṃ stutyaṃ bhavati |
no cet tena tu svaraśmināḍībhi: bhūmerjalamākṛṣṭamasti |
yata evamata: gaviṣṭhau gavāmeṣaṇe nimitte sati te 1 prasiddhā: sahasrasaṃkhyākā: śaṃsā: |
tān sarvānt sarvānapi yajñān yuvāmupayātaṃ samīpe gacchatam |
( 4 ) he yajatrā yajanīyāvaśvinau ayaṃ purovartī vāṃ yuvayo: bhāga: bhajanīyo'ṃśa: somalakṣaṇa: nihita: niyamena sthāpita: |
kiṃca he nāsatyā nāsatyau satyabhūtāśvinau yuvāmimā: saṃnikṛṣṭā: gira: stutilakṣaṇā vāca: upayātaṃ samīpe gacchataṃ śrotum |
atha ca madhumantaṃ mādhuryopetaṃ somaṃ pibatam |
kiṃca asme asmākaṃ saṃbandhinaṃ dāśvāṃsaṃ havirdattavantaṃ yajamānaṃ śacībhi: abhimataphalapradānalakṣaṇai: karmabhi: pra avataṃ prakarṣeṇa rakṣatam |

yamutvijo bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sacetaso yajñamimaṃ vahanti | yo anucāno brāhmaṇo yukta āsītkā svittatra yajamānasya saṃvit || 1 || yam | ṛtvijaḥ | bahudhā | kalpayantaḥ | sa'cetasaḥ | yajñam | imam | vahanti | yaḥ | anucānaḥ | brāhmaṇaḥ | yuktaḥ | āsīt | kā | svit | tatra | yajamānasya | sa'vit || 1 ||

ekaṃ evāgnirbahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvamanu prabhūtaḥ | ekaivoṣāḥ sarvvamidaṃ vi bhātyekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvvam || 2 || ekaḥ | eva | agniḥ | bahudhā | sama'iddhaḥ | ekaḥ | sūryaḥ | viśvam | anu | pra'bhūtaḥ | ekā | eva | uṣāḥ | sarvvam | idam | vi | bhāti | ekam | vai | idam | vi | babhūva | sarvvam || 2 ||
jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadaṃ bhūrivāram |
citramaghā yasya yoge'dhijajñe taṃ vāṃ huve ati riktaṃ pibadhyai |
‘ yamutvijaḥ ’ iti trayātmakaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya medhyasyārṣaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ traiṣṭubham |
anukrāntaṃ ca- ‘ yamutvijatraṃ ’ vaiśvadevāya ṛtvikstutirvā ’ iti |
( 1 ) sacetasaḥ samānaprajñāḥ ṛtvijaḥ yamimaṃ yajñaṃ yajanīyakarmaviśeṣaṃ bahudhā anekaprakāreṇa kalpayantaḥ racayantaḥ santaḥ vahanti devān prāpayanti |
tamimaṃ yajñaṃ kurvan brāhmaṇaḥ ṛtvigalakṣaṇo vipraḥ yajñakarmaviśeṣe yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ āsīt |
yatra karmaṇi ṛtvigeva sāvadhāno'sti tatra yajamānasya prajñāpāṭavena kiṃ prayojanamasti |
( 2 ) ekaḥ kevala evāgniḥ dānādiguṇayukto devaḥ bahudhā vāḍavavaidyutādyanekaprakāreṇa samiddhaḥ samyak dīptāṃ bhavati |
tathā ekaḥ ekākī sūryaḥ prāṇināṃ suṣṭhu karmasverayitā devaḥ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagadanu anupraviśya |
‘ tatsṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat ’ ( tai. u. 2. 6) iti śruteḥ |
‘ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 115. 1) iti śruteḥ |
kiṃca ekā ekākitveva uṣāḥ tamo vivāsayantī devī sarvaṃ samastamidaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ jagat vi bhāti viśeṣeṇa dīpayati |
tasmādekaṃ vai ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma idamātrāhastambaparyantaṃ jagat vi babhūva viśeṣeṇābhavaditi yukta- miti śeṣaḥ |
yadāgnyādayo devā apyekākinaḥ santo'nekabhavanasamarthāstadā paraṃ brahma ekaṃ sadanakaṃ bhave- diti kimu vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ |
vo yuṣmākaṃ madhye atiriktaṃ niratiśayaṃ taṃ tacchabdavācyaṃ paramātmānaṃ pitradhyai somaṃ pātuṃ huve āhvayāmi |
yasya paramātmanaḥ yoge sevyasevakabhāvasaṃbandhe sati citramaghā |
citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ maghaṃ gavāśādilakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ yasyāḥ sā citramaghā |
1. anukramaṇyāmetannopalabhyate | maik.-pṛ. 31 draṣṭavyam || 2. ‘ ati | riktaṃ ’ iti padapāṭhaḥ |
jyotiṣmantam | ketu'mantam | tri'cakram | su'kham | ratham | su'sadam | bhūri'vāram | citra'maghā | yasya | yoge | adhi'jajñe | tam | vām | huve | ati | riktam | pibadhyai ||3||||29||
imāni vāṃ bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām |
yajñeyajñe ha sarvanā bhuraṇyatho yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ ||
imāni | vām | bhāga'dheyāni | sisrate | indrāvaruṇā | pra | mahe | suteṣu | vām | yajñe'yajñe | ha | sarvanā | bhuraṇyathaḥ | yat | sunvate | yajamānāya | śikṣathaḥ || 1 ||
yā sisratū rajasaḥ pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrurnakirādaiva ohate ||
pūjanīyānekadhanopetā lakṣmīḥ adhi jajñe adhikaṃ prādurabhūt yudhiṣṭhirādestam |
jyotiṣmantaṃ jyotiṣī sūryādīni prakāśyatvena santi yasya tam |
ketavaḥ prajñāḥ vipayāḥ santi yasya tam |
tricakraṃ triṣu bhūrādilokeṣu cakraṃ cakramaṇaṃ trivikramāvatāre yasya tam |
yadvā triṣu lokeṣu apratihataṃ cakraṃ sudarśanākhyaṃ yasya tam |
śobhane ātmasvarūpe sīdati tiṣṭhatīti supat supratiṣṭhaḥ tam |
‘ātmanaḥ kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati’ (bṛ. u. 2. 4. 5) iti śruteḥ ||
‘imāni vām’ iti saptarcamekādaśaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya suparṇasyāryamaindrāvaruṇaṃ jāgatam |
‘imāni vāṃ sapta suparṇa aindrāvaruṇaṃ jāgatam’ ityanukrāntatvāt |
(1) he indrāvaruṇā indrāvaruṇau imāni idānīṃ kṛtāni bhāgadheyāni bhavadaṃśabhūtāni caru- puroḍāśādihavīṃṣi vāṃ yuvāṃ prati sisrate prāptumicchanti |
ataḥ suteṣu abhiṣuteṣu someṣu satsu mahe mahate pūjanāya vāṃ yuvāṃ pra prārthaye |
yat yasmāt yajñeyajñe pratiyaraṃ savanā triṣvapi savaneṣu bhuraṇyatho ha gacchathaḥ khalu |
kiṃca sunvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ |

(2) he indrāvaruṇā indrāvaruṇau bhavantau yadā āstām oṣadhyādikartṛtvenāmṛtāṃ tadā ni:- sidhvarīḥ nitarāṃ maṅgalasvabhāvā oṣadhīḥ vrīhyādyā oṣadhayaḥ āpaḥ udakāni ca mahimānaṃ bhavato- rmāhātmyam āśata vyāpnuvanti |
kiṃca yā yau bhavantau rajaso'ntarikṣalokasya saṃbandhinḥ adhvano
ni:'sidhvarī: | oṣadhī: | āpa: | āstām | indrāvaruṇā | mahimānam | āśata | yā | sisrtu: | rajasa: | pāre | ardhana: | yayo: | śatru: | naki: | adeva: | ohate ||2||

satyaṃ tadindrāvaruṇā kuśasya vāṃ madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇī: | tābhirdāśvāṃsamavataṃ śubhaspatī yo vāmadabdho abhi pāti cittibhi: || 3 || satyam | tat | indrāvaruṇā | kuśasya | vām | madhva: | ūrmim | duhate | sapta | vāṇī: | tābhi: | dāśvāṃsam | avatam | śubha: | patī iti | ya: | vām | adabdha: | abhi | pāti | citti'bhi: || 3 ||

ghṛtapṛṣa: saumyā jīradānava: sapta svasāra: sadana ṛtasya | yā ha vāmindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaśrutāstābhirdhattaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam || 4 || ghṛta'pṛṣa: | saumyā: | jīra'dānava: | sapta | svasāra: | sadane | ṛtasya | yā: | ha | vām | indrāvaruṇā | ghṛta'śruta: | tābhi: | dhattam | yajamānāya | śikṣatam ||4||||30||
avaucāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyāṃ mahimānamindriyam |
mārgasya pāre paratīre sisrtu: yathecchaṃ saraṇaṃ kuruta: |
yayorbhavato: śatru: śātayitā adeva: devapratiyogī asurādi: naki: ohate na ko'pi tarkagocaro bhavati |
svecchayā viharatorbhavato: gatipratighātaka: śatru: na ko'pyastītyartha: ||

( 3 ) he indrāvaruṇā indrāvaruṇau yā: samasaṃkhyākā: sarpaṇasvabhāvā vā vāṇī: vācya: saptahotra- kāṇāṃ stutirūpā vāca: kuśasya etannāmno yajamānasya saṃbandhana: madhva: madhurasya somasya ūrmiṃ tadupalakṣitaṃ rasaṃ prati vāṃ yuvāṃ duhate prapūrayantīti yat tattvamavitathameva |
tasmāttābhirvāṇībhirhetubhūtābhi: yuvāṃ dāśvāṃsaṃ havirdattavantaṃ yajamānam avataṃ rakṣatam |
he śubhaspatī udakasya pālayitā- rāvandrāvaruṇau yo yajamāna: adabdha: kenāpyaṃhita: san cittibhi: prajñopalakṣitai: karmabhi: vāṃ yuvā- mabhi pāti sarvato rakṣati |
ṛtasya yajñasya sadane sthāne sapta saptasaṃkhyākā: svasāra: svayaṃsāriṇyo vācya: santi |
kiṃca he indrāvaruṇā indrāvaruṇau yā vācya: vāṃ yuvāmuddiśya ghṛtaśrutaḥ somarasasrāviṇyo bhavanti athavā ājyasrāviṇyo bhavanti |
tadarthaṃ ca yajamānāya śikṣatamabhi- mataṃ dattam ||
( 5 ) he indrāvaruṇā indrāvaruṇau tveṣābhyāṃ dīptābhyāṃ bhavadbhyāṃ saṃpāditaṃ mahimānaṃ kīrtiviśeṣaṃ vayaṃ mahate bṛhate saubhagāya aiśvaryāya abaucāma varṇayema |

tatra 'agna ā yāhi' iti viṃśatyṛcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ pragāthaputrasya' bhargasyārṣamāgneyam'|

avipro vā yadavidvipro vendra te varcaḥ | sa pra marmandatvā śatakrato prācāṃmanyo aha~sana || 9 || avipraḥ | vā | yat | avidhat | vipraḥ | vā | indra | te | varcaḥ | saḥ | pra | marmandat | tvā | śatakrato iti śata'krato | prācāṃmanyo iti prācāṃ'manyo | aham'asana || 9 || he indra te tava vacaḥ stotraṃ yat yaḥ avipro vā amedhāvyastutikuśalo vā vipraḥ medhāvī stutikuśalaḥ vā avidhat kuryāt | tvāṃ stautītyarthaḥ | saḥ stotā tvāyā tvayīcchayā sādhanena pra marmandat prakarṣeṇa modate | he śatakrato bahukarman he prācāṃmanyo prācīnakrodha | apratihata- krodhetyarthaḥ | na hīndrakrodhaṃ pratihanti kaścit | he aha~sana | saṃgrāme'hamityātmano mahattvaṃ prakāśayan yaḥ śatruṃ saṃbhajate sa tathoktaḥ | tādṛśendra ||

na pāpāsī manāmahe nārāyāso na jalahavaḥ | yadindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute sakhāyaṃ kṛṇavāmahai || 11 || na | pāpāsaḥ | manāmahe | na | arāyāsaḥ | na | jalahavaḥ | yat | it | nu | indram | vṛṣaṇam | sacā | sute | sakhāyam | kṛṇavāmahai || 11 || 1. tanna-paśupati |
vayamindraṃ ᵥpāpāsaḥ pāpā akṛtapuṇyā brahmacaryavratādirahitāḥ¹ ᵥna ᵥmanāmahe na mabhyāmahe |
tathā ᵥarāyāsaḥ arāyā adhanā vā ahaviṣkā vā ᵥna manāmahe |
ᵥna ᵥjahvaḥ ajvalanāḥ anapratho na manāmahe |
ᵥyadit yasmādeva kāraṇāt ᵥnu idānīṃ ᵥvṛṣaṇaṃ varṣakam ᵥindraṃ ᵥsute some'bhiṣute ᵥsacā sahitāḥ² ᵥsakhāyaṃ ᵥkṛṇavāmahai kurmaḥ tasmāt pāpādirahitā manāmahe |
atra ‘na pāpā mabhyāmahe’ (niru. 6. 25) ityādi niruktaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
he ᵥrādhasyate dhanasvāmin ᵥtvaṃ ᵥhi tvaṃ khalu ᵥmahaḥ mahataḥ ᵥrādhasaḥ dhanasya ᵥkṣayasya ca gṛhasya ᵥca' vardhayitā ᵥasi' hi khalu |
kasya rādhaso gṛhasya ᵥca' vardhaka ityucyate |
ᵥtaṃ tādṛśaṃ ᵥtvā ᵥvāṃ ᵥvayaṃ he ᵥmaghavajindra ᵥgirvaṇaḥ gīrbhirvandanīya ᵥsutāntaḥ abhiṣutasomāḥ ᵥhvamahe āhvayāmaḥ ||

indraḥ spaḻuta vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ | sa nau rakṣiṣcaraṃ sa madhyaṃ sa paścātpātu naḥ puraḥ || 15 || indraḥ | spaṭ | uta | vṛtra'hā | puraḥ'pāḥ | naḥ | vareṇyaḥ | saḥ | naḥ | rakṣiṣat | caramam | saḥ | madhyam | saḥ | paścāt | pātu | naḥ | puraḥ ||15|| ayam ᵥindraḥ ᵥspaṭ sarvasya jñātā | spaśatirjñānakarmā | ᵥuta ayaṃ ᵥvṛtrahā vṛtrahantā ᵥparaspāḥ parapālayitā ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥvareṇyaḥ varaṇīyaḥ | ᵥsaḥ indraḥ ᵥnaḥ asmākam | putramiti śeṣaḥ | ᵥrakṣiṣat rakṣatu | ᵥcaramaṃ putraṃ tathā sa rakṣiṣat | ᵥsaḥ ᵥmadhyamaṃ putraṃ ᵥrakṣiṣat | ᵥsaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥpaścāt rakṣiṣat | ᵥnaḥ ᵥpuraḥ purastāt rakṣiṣat || || 38 ||

tvaṃ naḥ paścādadharāduttarātpura indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ | āre asmatkṛṇuhi daivyaṃ bhayamāra āre hetīradaivīḥ || 16 || tvam | naḥ | paścāt | adharāt | uttarāt | puraḥ | indra | ni | pāhi | viśvataḥ | āre | asmat | kṛṇuhi | daivyam | bhayam | āre | hetīḥ | adaivīḥ || 16 || he ᵥindra ᵥtvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥpaścāt paścādbhāgāt ᵥpuraḥ pūrvabhāgāt ᵥadharāt adhobhāgāt | etaduparbhāgasyopalakṣaṇam | ᵥuttarāt uttarabhāgāt | etadakṣiṇasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | kiṃ bahunā ᵥviśvataḥ sarvasmāt pradeśāt ᵥni ᵥpāhi | he indra ᵥdaivyaṃ ᵥbhayam ᵥasmat asmattaḥ ᵥāre dūre ᵥkṛṇuhi kuru | tathā ᵥadaivīḥ āsurāṇi ᵥhetīḥ āyudhāni ᵥāre kṛṇuhi ||

adyādya śvaḥśva indra trāsvaṃ pure ca naḥ | viśvā ca no jaritṛnsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ || 17 || adya'adya | śvaḥ'śvaḥ | indra | trāsva | pure | ca | naḥ | viśvā | ca | naḥ | jaritṛn | sat'pate | ahā | divā | naktam | ca | rakṣiṣaḥ || 17 || ᵥadyādya yadyaśavdavācyamahasti tatra sarvatra evaṃ ᵥśvaḥśvaḥ ᵥtrāsva rakṣa | tathā ᵥpare ᵥca parasmistṛtīye'hani ca trāsva | he ᵥsatpate satāṃ pālaka ᵥviśvā sarvāṇyapi ᵥahā ahāni sarveṣvapyahaḥsu ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥjaritṛn ᵥrakṣiṣaḥ rakṣasi | tathā ᵥdivā ᵥnaktaṃ ᵥca rakṣiṣaḥ rakṣasi rakṣa vā ||
prabhaṅgī śūrau maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ saṃmiślo vīryāya kam |
ubhā tai bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ ||
1. ga-ta-śa- 'gṛhasya ca' nāsti | 2. kha-ga-ta-na-bha1-2-śa- 'asi' nāsti | 3. kha-ga-ta-śa- 'ca' nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ta-na-śa- 'sparśati' | 5. kha-ta-putraṃ sa |
pra'bhaṅgī | śūraḥ | magha'vā | tuvi'maṃghaḥ | sama'miṃkṣaḥ | vīryāya | kam | ubhā | te | bāhū iti | vṛṣaṇā | śatakrato iti śata'krato | ni | yā | vajram | mimikṣatuḥ ||8||
artha ᐯmaghavā indraḥ ᐯprabhaṅgī prabhañjanaśīlaḥ ᐯśūraḥ ᐯtuvīmaghaḥ prabhūtadhanaḥ ᐯsaṃmiṃkṣaḥ samyak miśrayitā |
he indra ᐯte ᐯubhā ubhāvapi ᐯbāhū ᐯvṛṣaṇā varṣakau kāmānāṃ he ᐯśatakrato bahuprajña ᐯyā yau ᐯvajram āyudhaṃ ᐯni ᐯmimikṣatuḥ parigṛhṇītaḥ ||
‘pro asmai’ iti dvādaśarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya pragāthasyā
ayaṃ ᵥjīradānuḥ kṣiprapradāna indraḥ ᵥahitena ayojitenāpreritana' ᵥcit ᵥarvatā araṇavatā- śvena ᵥsipāsati saṃbhakumicchati |
tasmādde' ᵥindra ᵥvīryāṇi sāmarthyāni ᵥkariṣyataḥ ᵥtava mahatvaṃ ᵥpravācyam |
ā yāhi kṛṇavāma tu indra brahmāṇi vardhanā |
yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākano bhadramiha śravasyate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
ā | yāhi | kṛṇavāma | te | indra | brahmāṇi | vardhanā | yebhiḥ | śaviṣṭha | cākanaḥ | bhadram | iha | śravasyate | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 4 ||

he ᵥindra ᵥā ᵥyāhi āgaccha | ᵥte4 ᵥkṛṇavāma | kim | ᵥbrahmāṇi parivṛḍhāni stuti- lakṣaṇāni karmāṇi | kīdṛśāni | ᵥvardhanā utsāhavardhakāni | ᵥyebhiḥ yaiḥ karmabhiḥ he ᵥśaviṣṭha ati- śayena balavannindra ᵥcākanaḥ kāmayase | kim | ᵥbhadraṃ kartum | kasmai | ᵥśravasyate abhramicchate stotre ||
tīvraiḥ somaḥ saparyato namaubhiḥ pratibhūṣato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
dhṛṣataḥ | cit | dhṛṣat | manaḥ | kṛṇoṣi | indra | yat | tvam | tīvraiḥ | somaḥ | saparyataḥ | namaḥbhiḥ | prati'bhūṣataḥ | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 5 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥdhṛṣataścit dhṛṣṭādapi ᵥdhṛṣat dhṛṣṭaṃ ᵥmanaḥ ᵥkṛṇoṣi |
ᵥyat yasmāt ᵥtvaṃ ᵥtīvraiḥ madajanakaḥ ᵥsomaiḥ ᵥsaparyataḥ pūjayataḥ' ᵥnamobhiḥ namaskāraiśca ᵥpratibhūṣataḥ alaṃkurvaṃto yajamānasyābhimaṃtaṃ ditsasīti6 śeṣaḥ ||
juṣṭvī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute yujaṃ bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
arva | caṣṭe | ṛcīṣamaḥ | avatān'iva | mānuṣaḥ | juṣṭvī | dakṣasya | sominaḥ | sakhāyam | kṛṇute | yujam | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 6 ||
ayamindraḥ ᵥṛcīṣamaḥ ṛcā stutyā' samastathā paricchinnaḥ san ᵥava ᵥcaṣṭe paśyatyanugraheṇā- smān |
ᵥmānuṣaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥavatān avaṭān kūpadipradeśān ᵥiva |
dṛṣṭvā ca ᵥjuṣṭvī prīta'yaṃ ᵥdakṣasya pravṛddhasya ᵥsominaḥ yajamānasya ᵥyujaṃ yujyamānaṃ ᵥsakhāyaṃ ᵥkṛṇute karoti |
tṛṣito manuṣyo jalapūrṇānavaṭāniva stutaḥ san paśyati somaṃ pātum |
paścādavekṣitaṃ taṃ yujyamānaṃ somaṃ juṣṭvī sevitvā dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kurute ||
viśvai ta indra vīryai devā anu kratuṃ daduḥ |
bhuvo viśvasya gopatiḥ puruṣṭuta bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

1. kha-jña-ta1-2-3-bhara-ayojitena preritana | 2. gha-tattasmādde | 3. gha-āgaccha ihāsmin yajñe | 4. gha-te tava | 5. ta-na-pūjataḥ | 6. kha-gha-ta1-2-diśasīti | 7. kha-gha-ta-śa-stutyaḥ | 8. kha-jña-ta1-2-kṛṇute kubate |
viśve | te | indra | vīryam | devāḥ | anu | kartum | dadhuḥ | bhuvaḥ | viśvasya | go'patiḥ | puru'stut | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 7 ||
he 'indra 'te tava 'vīrya sāmarthya 'kratuṃ prajñāṃ ca 'anu anusṛtya 'viśve sarve 'devāḥ 'dadhuḥ |
tava balena prajñayā ca te'pi balinaḥ prajñāvantaśca bhavantītyarthaḥ |
tādṛśastvaṃ 'gopatiḥ prasiddhānāṃ gavāmudakānāṃ stutivacaso vā patiḥ |
guṇe tadindra te śava upamaṃ devatāye |
yaddhaṃsi vṛtramojasā śacīpate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
guṇe | tat | indra | te | śavaḥ | | upa'mam | deva'tātaye | yat | haṃsi | vṛtram | ojasā | śacī'pate | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 8 ||
he 'indra 'te tava 'tat 'śavaḥ balam 'upamam antikaṃ 'devatātaye yajamānāya yajñārthaṃ vā 'guṇe stuve |
vide tadindraścetanamardha śruto bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
sarmanā'iva | vapuṣyataḥ | kṛṇvat | mānuṣā | yugā | vide | tat | indraḥ | cetanam | ardha | śrutaḥ | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 9 ||
'sarmaneva samānamanaskā yoṣidiva sā yathā 'vapuṣyataḥ vapuricchataḥ puruṣān 'kṛṇvat karoti svavaśān evamayamindraḥ 'mānuṣā manuṣyān 'yugā yugāni kālān saṃvatsarāyanartumāsādīn 'vide labhmayati |
'tat yuganirmāṇātmakaṃ karma 'indraḥ 'cetanaṃ sarvasya prajñāpakaṃ kṛtavāniti śeṣaḥ |
bhūriṃgo bhūri vāvṛdhurmadharvantava śarmaṇi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
ut | jñātam | indra | te | śavaḥ | | ut | tvām | ut | tava | kartum | bhūriṃgo iti bhūri'go | bhūri | vavṛdhuḥ | | margha'van | tava | śarmaṇi | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ || 10 ||

ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahantasaṃ yujyāva sunibhya ā | arātīvā cidadvi'nu nau śūra maṃsate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ || 11 || aham | ca | tvam | ca | vṛtra'han | sam | yujyāva | suni'bhyaḥ | ā | arāti'vā | cit | adri'vaḥ | anu | nau | śūra | maṃsate | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ ||11|| he vṛtrahan indra tvaṃ ca ahaṃ ca saṃ yujyāva saṃgatau bhavāva | kiyadavadhīti ucyate | sunibhya ā yāvatā kālena dhanāni labhyante tāvatkālam | nau saṃgatayoścāvayorhe adrivaḥ vajravan indra arātīvā adāno'pi janasvahatdhanasya anu maṃsate anumatiṃ karoti ||

satyamidvā u taṃ vayamindraṃ stavāma nānṛtam | mahā~ asunvato vadho bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||12|| satyam | it | vai | ūṃ iti | tam | vayam | indram | stavāma | na | anṛtam | mahān | asunvataḥ | vadhaḥ | bhūri | jyotīṃṣi | sunvataḥ | bhadrāḥ | indrasya | rātayaḥ ||12|| vayaṃ pragāthāḥ tam indraṃ satyamit satyameva stavāma nānṛtam asatyaṃ na stavāma | asmābhiruktā guṇāḥ satyā eva santu nānṛtā ityarthaḥ | stutyasyendrasya saṃbandhiva asunvataḥ ayaṣṭuḥ vadhaḥ mahān prabhūtau bhavati | bhūri jyotīṃṣi bahūn somān sunvataḥ abhiṣavaṃ kurvato yajamānasyendrakṛto'nugraho mahān bhavatītyarthaḥ || || 41 ||
atrānukramaṇikā— 'sa pūrvyo gāyatramādyā caturthyādidve saptamī cānuṣṭubhau gāyatre'nyā daivī triṣṭup' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ traya indrasya somā iti marutvatīyasya pratipadanucarau' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 1 ) iti ||

sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ venaḥ ṛtubhirānaje | yasya dvārā manuṣpitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje ||1|| saḥ | pūrvyaḥ | mahānām | venaḥ | ṛtubhiḥ | ānaje | yasya | dvārā | manuḥ | pitā | deveṣu | dhiyaḥ | ānaje || 1 || saḥ pūrvyaḥ mukhyaḥ mahānāṃ pūjyānāṃ yajamānānāṃ ṛtubhiḥ karmabhirnimittabhūtaiḥ venaḥ kāntasteṣāṃ haviḥ kāmayamānaḥ ānaje āgacchati | yasya indrasya dvārā dvārāṇi prāpyupāyāni dhiyaḥ karmāṇi deveṣu eteṣu madhye pitā sarveṣāṃ pālakaḥ manuḥ ānaje prāpa | ānajiḥ prāptikarmā ||

divo mānuṃ notsadantasomapṛṣṭhāso adrayaḥ | ukthā brahma ca śaṃsyā || 2 || divaḥ | mānam | na | ut | sadan | soma'pṛṣṭhāsaḥ | adrayaḥ | ukthā | brahma | ca | śaṃsyā || 2 || divaḥ dyulokasya mānaṃ nirmātāramindraṃ notsadan notsarjantu | ke | somapṛṣṭhāsaḥ somapṛṣṭhāḥ somābhiṣavakartāraḥ adrayaḥ grāvāṇaḥ | kiṃca ukthā ukthāni śastrāṇi brahma ca brahmāṇi stotrāṇi
yāni stotrāṇi śastrāṇi ca santi tānīndraṃ notsṛja- ntviti samanvayaḥ ||
sa vidvā~ aṅgirobhya indro gā avṛṇodarpa | stuṣe tadasya pauṃsyam || 3 || saḥ | vidvān | aṅgiraḥ'bhyaḥ | indraḥ | gāḥ | avṛṇot | arpa | stuṣe | tat | asya | pauṃsyam ||3||

sa pratnathā kavivṛdha indro vākasya vṛkṣaṇiḥ | śivo arkasya hominyasmatrā gantavase ||4|| saḥ | pratna'thā | kavi'vṛdhaḥ | indraḥ | vākasya | vṛkṣaṇiḥ | śivaḥ | arkasya | homini | asma'trā | gantu | arbase || 4 ||
^saḥ ^indraḥ ^pratnathā pratnavat pūrvasmin kāle yathā tadvidānīmapi ^kavivṛdhaḥ medhāvināṃ stotṛṇāṃ vardhayitā ^vākasya stotuḥ ^vṛkṣaṇiḥ voḍhā ^śivaḥ sukhakaraḥ ^arkasya |
tādṛśasya somasya ^homani home saḥ ^asmatrā asmāsu nimittabhūteṣu ^avase rakṣaṇāya ^gantu gacchatu ||

^yam indram ^arkāḥ stotāraḥ ^adhvaram ahiṃsakaṃ ^viduḥ jānanti tasminnindra iti ||

urvā mandantu stomāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ | ava brahmadviṣo jahi || 1 || uta | tvā | mandantu | stomāḥ | kṛṇuṣva | rādhaḥ | adri'vaḥ | ava | brahma'dviṣaḥ | jahi || 1 ||
he indra ^tvā tvāṃ ^stomāḥ stutayaḥ ^ut utkṛṣṭaṃ ^mandantu mādayantu |
^kṛṇuṣva kuru ^rādhaḥ dhanaṃ he ^adrivaḥ vajravannit indra asmabhyam |
padā paṇīrarādhaso ni bādhasva mahā~ asi | nahi tvā kaścana prati || 2 || padā | paṇīn | arādhasaḥ | ni | bādhasva | mavān | asi | nahi | tvā | kaḥ | cana | prati ||2||
^paṇīn lubdhān ^arādhasaḥ yaṣṭavyadhanarahitān kevaladhanān ^padā pādena atikramya ^ni’ nitarāṃ ^bādhasva |
^tvā tvāṃ tava ^kaścana kaścidapi devo'suro manuṣyo vā ^prati pratinidhiḥ sadṛśo ^nahi asti khalu ||
tvamīśiṣe sutānāmindra tvamasutānām | tvaṃ rājā janānām || 3 || tvam | īśiṣe | sutānām | indra | tvam | asutānām | tvam | rājā | janānām || 3 ||
ehi prehi kṣayau divyā ghoṣaścarṣaṇīnām | ome pṛṇāsi rodasī || 4 || ā | ihi | pra | ihi | kṣayaḥ | divi | ā'ghoṣan | carṣaṇīnām | ā | ubhe iti | pṛṇāsi | rodasī iti || 4 ||

he indra ^ehi āgaccha | tathā ^prehi pragaccha | ^divi dyulokāt | kim | ^kṣayaḥ nivāsam | kiṃ kurvan | ^āghoṣan śabdaṃ kurvan | kimartham | ^carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāmarthāya | athavā | haviḥ svīkṛtya prehi sukhena gaccha | divamāghoṣan yajamānaṃ stuvan | ^ubhe ^rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ^ā ^pṛṇāsi āpūrayasi tejasā vṛṣṭyā vā ||

tyaṃ citparvataṃ giriṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam | vi stotṛbhyo rurojitha || 5 || tyam | cit | parvtam | girim | śata'vantam | sahasriṇam | vi | stotṛ'bhyaḥ | rurojitha ||5|| he indra tvaṃ tyaṃ cit tam | ciditi pūraṇaḥ | parvtaṃ parvvantaṃ giriṃ megham | ubhayo- rmeghatvādeko yogarūḍho draṣṭavyaḥ | śatavantaṃ śatòdakavantaṃ tathā sahasriṇam aparimitavṛṣṭi meghaṃ stotṛbhyaḥ arthāya vi rurojitha viruja vajreṇa ||

vayamṷ tvā di॒vā su॒te va॒yaṃ nakta̭ṃ ha॒vāmahe | a॒smāka̭ṃ kā॒mamā̭ pṛṇa || 6 || vayam | ū~ iti | tvā | divā | sute | vayam | naktam | havāmahe | asmākam | kāmam | ā | pṛṇa ||6|| he indra vayaṃ tvā tvāṃ divā ahani sute some'bhiṣute havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | tathā vayaṃ naktaṃ havāmahe | āhūtaṃ āgatya asmākaṃ kāmama pṛṇa āpūraya || ||44||

ka॒sya vṛ̭ṣa॒bho yu॒vā tu॒vigrī̭vo a॒nāna̭taḥ | bra॒hmā kasta̭ṃ sa॒parya̭ti || 7 || kaḥ | syaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | yuvā | tuvi'grīvaḥ | anānataḥ | brahmā | kaḥ | tam | saparyati ||7|| syaḥ saḥ vṛṣabhaḥ varṣitā yuvā nityataruṇaḥ tuvigrīvaḥ vistīrṇakandharaḥ anānataḥ kadā- cidapyanavanata indraḥ ka kutra vartata iti ko jānātītyarthaḥ | kaḥ brahmā stotā tvā tvāṃ sapa- ryati pūjayati ||

ka॒sya svi॒tsava̭naṃ vṛ॒ṣā jṷju॒ṣvā~ arva̭ gacchati | i॒ndraṃ ka ṷ svi॒dā ca̭ke || 8 || kasya | svit | savanam | vṛṣā | jujuṣvān | arvā | gacchati | indram | kaḥ | ū~ iti | svit | ā | cake || 8 || kasya svit savanam | sviditi vicikitsāyām | vṛṣā varṣitendraḥ jujuṣvān prīyamāṇaḥ ava gacchati | ka u ko vā yajamānaḥ indram ā cake jānāti stotum | svit iti pūraṇaḥ ||

kaṃ tḙ dā॒nā a̭sakṣata vṛ॒traha̭nkaṃ su॒vīryā̭ | u॒kthe ka ṷ svi॒danta̭maḥ || 9 || kam | te | dānāḥ | asakṣata | vṛtra'han | kam | su'vīryā | ukthe | kaḥ | ū~ iti | svit | antamḥ || 9 || te tvāṃ dānāḥ yajamānairdattāḥ asakṣata sevante | he vṛtrahan vṛtrasya hantārindra kaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tvām ukthe śastrā suvīryā śobhanavīryāṇi stotrāṇyasakṣata | ka u svidantamaḥ vānti katamo bhavati yuddhe || dvitīye paryāye hotṛḥ śastre 'ayaṃ te mānuṣe' iti tṛco'nurūpaḥ | sūtritaṃ ca—'ayaṃ te mānuṣe jana udedabhi' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
1. 'kha-ta-na-ābhūta | 2. ga-ta3-4-na-śa- 'vistīrṇakandharaḥ' nāsti | 3. gha1-stotāraṃ vā; ca-stotā-taṃ tvāṃ; ya-stotā taṃ | 4. ga-asevanta | 5. kha-ta-śa-yuddhe dvitīye yuddhe |

ayaṃ te mānuṣe jane somaḥ puru ṣū sūyate | tasyehi pra dravā piba || 10 || ayam | te | mānuṣe | jane | somaḥ | puru ṣu | sūyate | tasya | ā | ihi | pra | drava | piba || 10 || paayaṃ pasomaḥ pate tvadartha tava svabhūto vā papuru ṣu manuṣyeṣu madhye pamānuṣe pajane mathi pasūyate | athavā pūrupāmasu rājasu sūyate | patasya | tamityarthaḥ | tam paehi āgaccha | āgatya ca pra padrava gṛhasamīpam | tathā kṛtvā papiba taṃ somam ||

ayaṃ te śaryaṇāvati suṣomāyāmadhi priyaḥ | ārjīkīye madinatamaḥ || 11 || ayam | te | śaryaṇā'vati | susomāyām | ādhi | priyaḥ | ārjīkīye | madina'tamaḥ || 11 || paayam asmābhirabhiṣutaḥ somaḥ pate tvāṃ pamadinatamaḥ mādayitṛtamaḥ | ayam paadhi śritaḥ āśritaḥ | kutreti taducyate | paśaryaṇāvati kurukṣetrastha jaghanādharbhave śaratṇopate sarasi | tassaraḥ kutra vartata iti ucyate | pasuṣomāyām etannāmikāyāṃ nadyām | sā ca kutra vartata iti taducyate | paārjīkīye etannāmake deśe | evamuktaprakāreṇānyataddeśe vartate yaḥ somaḥ sa evāyamabhiṣutaḥ | taṃ pibetyuttarānvayaḥ ||

tamadya rādhase mahe cāruṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye | ahīṃmindra dravā piba || 12 || tam | adya | rādhase | mahe | cārum | madāya | ghṛṣvaye | ā | ihi | īm | indra | drava | piba || 12 || pataṃ pūrvamantra upavarṇitaṃ pacāhaṃ caraṇaśīlaṃ somaṃ pamahe mahate parādhase asmākaṃ dhanāya tava paghṛṣvaye śatrūṇāṃ gharṣaṇaśīlāya pamadāya papiba | he paindra tadartha padrava gaccha śīghraṃ somapātraṃ prati | tadartham paīm idānīm paehi āgaccha || || 45 || ‘yadindra prāk’ iti dvādaśacaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ pragādhasyārṣaṃ gāyatramaindram | ‘yadindra’ ityanu- krāntam | viniyogo laiṅgikaḥ ||

yadindra prāgapāgududanyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ | ā yāhi tūyamāśubhiḥ || 1 || yat | indra | prāk | apāk | udak | nyak | vā | hūyasai | nṛ'bhiḥ | ā | yāhi | tūyam | āśu'bhiḥ || 1 || he paindra tvaṃ panṛbhiḥ karmanetṛbhirasmadīyairadhvarvādibhiḥ paprāk vā paapāgudak vā pamyagvā yataḥ pakutaścit pahūyase ataḥ patūyaṃ tūrṇam paāśubhiḥ āśugāmibhiraśvaiḥ paā yāhi āgaccha ||

yadvā prasravaṇe divo mādyāse svarnnare | yadvā samudre andhasaḥ || 2 || yat | vā | pra'sravaṇe | divaḥ | mādyāse | svaḥ'nare | yat | vā | samudre | andhasaḥ || 2 || payadvā athavā padivaḥ dyulokasya paprasravaṇe amṛtaniṣyandanasthāne pamādyāse mādyasi | yadvā pasvarṇare svargananaye vā bhūloke'nyasya yāgadeśe mādyasi | payadvā paandhasaḥ andho'nnam | tena tatkāraṇamudakaṃ lakṣyate | tasya pasamudre samundanāpādānabhūte'ntarikṣe mādyasi | tatra tatra vartamānamapi huva ityuttaratra saṃbandhaḥ ||

ā tvā gīrbhirhāmuhuṃ huve gāmiva bhojase | indra somasya pītayai || 3 || ā | tvā | gīḥ'bhiḥ | mahām | urum | huve | gām'iva | bhojase | indra | somasya | pītayai ||3|| he indra tvā tvāṃ gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ huve āhvayāmi | kīdṛśaṃ tvām | mahām mahāntam uruṃ prabhūtam | kimartham | somasya pītaye pānāya | hlāne dṛṣṭāntaḥ | bhojase bhogāya gāmiva ||

ā te indra mahimānaṃ harayo deva te mahaḥ | rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ || 4 || ā | te | indra | mahimānam | harayaḥ | deva | te | mahaḥ | rathe | vahantu | bibhrataḥ ||4|| he indra te tava mahimānaṃ māhātmyaṃ rathe bibhrataḥ dhārayantaḥ harayaḥ aśvāḥ ā vahantu | tathā he deva te mahaḥ tejaḥ rathe bibhrato'śvā ā vahantu | atra mahimno mahasaśca pṛthagāvahanāsaṃbhavātsābhyāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vahanityarthaḥ | athavā mahimānaṃ bibhrataste tvāṃ rathe vahantu maho bibhrataśca tvāṃ vahanviti yojyam ||

indre guṇīṣa u stuṣe mahā~ ugra īśānakṛt | ehi naḥ sutaṃ piba || 5 || indra | guṇīṣe | ū~ iti | stuṣe | mahān | ugraḥ | īśāna'kṛt | ā | ihi | naḥ | sutam | piba ||5|| he indra tvaṃ guṇīṣe uccyase | idaṃ dehīdaṃ kurviti | tathā stuṣe u stūyase ca | u iti cārthe | kīdṛśastvam | mahān guṇaiḥ pravṛddhaḥ | ugraḥ udbhaṭabalaḥ | īśānakṛt aiśvaryakartā | tādṛśastvam ehi āgaccha | āgatya ca naḥ sutaṃ somaṃ piba ||

sutārvantastva vayaṃ prayasvanto havāmahe | idaṃ nau barhirāsade || 6 || suta'vantaḥ | tvā | vayam | prayasvantaḥ | havāmahe | idam | naḥ | barhiḥ | ā'sadai ||6|| sutāvantaḥ abhiṣutasomavantaḥ prayasvantaḥ carupuroḍāśādyavantaśca vayaṃ tvā tvāṃ havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | kimartham | idaṃ naḥ asmadīyaṃ barhiḥ barhiṣi yajñe barhiṣi vā āsade āsādanāya || 46 ||

yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam | taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe || 7 || yat | cit | hi | śaśvatām | asi | indra | sādhāraṇaḥ | tvam | tam | tvā | vayam | havāmahe ||7|| he indra tvaṃ yacciddhi yasmāt khalu śaśvatāṃ bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ sādhāraṇaḥ asi | ciditi pūraṇaḥ | hīti prasiddhau | taṃ tādṛśaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ tvā tvāṃ vayaṃ havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | itarebhyaḥ pūrvamiti bhāvaḥ || prātaḥsavane 'idaṃ te somyam' iti hotuḥ prasthitayājyā | sūtritaṃ ca-'idaṃ te somyaṃ madhu mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe' (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||
idaṃ tai somyaṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ | juṣāṇa indra tarpiba || 8 || idam | te | somyam | madhu | adhukṣan | adri'bhiḥ | naraḥ | juṣāṇaḥ | indra | tat | piba ||8||
he indra te tvadartham idaṃ somyaṃ somasambandhi madhu adhukṣan atribhiḥ grāvabhira- bhivasādhaneḥ 1 naraḥ asmadīyā adhvardhvādayaḥ |
he indra tat madhu juṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ piba |
viśvā~ aryo vipaścito'ti hyastyūyamā gahi | asme dhehi śravo bṛhat || 9 || viśvā~ | aryeḥ | vipaḥ'citaḥ | ati | hyaḥ | tūyam | ā | gahi | asme iti | dhehi | śravaḥ | bṛhat || 9 ||
he indra aryaḥ svāmī tvaṃ viśvā~ vipaścitaḥ stotṛn ati hyaḥ atikramya paśya |
āgatya ca asme asmāsu bṛhat śravaḥ annaṃ yaśo vā dhehi |

dātā me pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā hiraṇyavīnām | mā devā maghavā riṣat || 10 || dātā | me | pṛṣatīnām | rājā | hiraṇya'vīnām | mā | devāḥ | maghavā | riṣat || 10 || hiraṇyavīnāṃ hiraṇyavītānāṃ pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā indraḥ me dātā bhavatu | he devāḥ maghavā indraḥ mā riṣat riṣṭo mā bhavatu ||

sahasre pṛṣatīnāmadhi candraṃ bṛhatputhu | śukraṃ hiraṇyamā dade || 11 || sahasre | pṛṣatīnām | adhi | candram | bṛhat | puthu | śukram | hiraṇyam | ā | dade || 11 || ahaṃ pṛṣatīnāṃ gavāṃ sahasre adhi upari dhāritaṃ bṛhat mahat pṛthu vistṛtaṃ candram āhlādakaṃ śukraṃ nirmalaṃ hiraṇyamā dade svīkaromīndreṇānītam ||

napāto durgahasya me sahasreṇa surādhasaḥ | śravo deveṣvakrata || 12 || napātaḥ | duḥ'gahasya | me | sahasreṇa | su'rādhasaḥ | śraveḥ | deveṣu | akrata || 12 || napātaḥ arakṣitasya durgahasya duḥkhaṃ gāhamānasya me sambandhino janāḥ sahasreṇa aparimitai- nendradattena gavādidhanena surādhasaḥ sudhanāḥ santaḥ deveṣu prīteṣu | indre prīta ityarthaḥ | śravaḥ annaṃ yaśo vā akrata | alabhantetyarthaḥ || || 47 ||
‘ tarobhirvaḥ ’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ pragāthaputrasya kalerārṣam |
prathamātṛtīyādyayujo bṛhatstho dvitīyācaturthyādiyujaḥ satobṛhatḥ pañcadaśī tvanuṣṭup |
tathā cānukramanikā— ‘ tarobhiḥ pañconā kaliḥ prāgāthaḥ ’ prāgāthamantyānuṣṭup ’ iti |
tathā ca pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ—‘ tarobhirvo vidadvasumityuttamāsuddharati ’ ( ai. ā. 5. 2. 4 ) iti |
tathā ca sutritaṃ— ‘ tarobhirvo vidadvasuṃ taraṇirisipāsatīti pragāthau stotriyānurūpau ’ ( āśva. śrau. 5. 16 ) iti |
sutritaṃ ca—‘ tarobhirvo vidadvasuṃ taraṇirisipāsati ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti |

1. gha-sādhanairabhipatavantaḥ ke | 2. gha-sarvān stotṛn | 3. gha-pṛṣatīnāmakṣṇāṃ | 4. kha-ga-gha-ta-na-śa- ‘ mahat ’ nāsti | 5. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-caṃdraṃ hi | 6. kha-gha-ta-na-bha-āhlādakaṃ hi | 7. kha-gha-jha-ta1-me mama | 8. ga-ta-na-śa-pragāthaputra | 9. kha-ga-ta1-3-na-pragāthaḥ | 10. kha-ga-bha-pragāthaḥ |

tara̭bhi॒rvo vi॒dadva̭sumi॒ndraṃ sa॒bādha̭ ū॒tayḙ | bṛha॒dyanta̭: su॒taso̭me a॒dhvarḙ huve bha॒raṃ na kā॒riṇa̭m || 1 || tara̭bhi: | va: | vi॒dat'va̭sum | i॒ndram | sa॒'bādha̭: | ū॒tayḙ | bṛha̭t | gā॒yanta̭: | su॒ta'so̭me | a॒dhvarḙ | huve | bha॒ram | na | kā॒riṇa̭m || 1 || he ṛtvija: <sup>v</sup>va: yūyaṃ <sup>v</sup>tarobhi: vegairabhyupetaṃ vegaireva vā <sup>v</sup>vidadvasuṃ dhanavedakam <sup>v</sup>indraṃ <sup>v</sup>sabādha: bādhāsahitā: <sup>v</sup>ūtaye rakṣaṇāya <sup>v</sup>bṛhat sāma etatsaṃjñaṃ <sup>v</sup>gāyanta: santa: paricarateti śeṣa: | kutreti taducyate | <sup>v</sup>sutasome sutasomake <sup>v</sup>adhvare yajñe somayāge | ahaṃ ca tamindraṃ <sup>v</sup>huve āhvayāmi | kamiva | <sup>v</sup>bharaṃ bhatāraṃ kuṭumbapoṣakaṃ <sup>v</sup>kāriṇaṃ hitakaraṇaśīlaṃ<sup>3</sup> yathā svahitakaraṇāyahvayanti putrādayastadvattathābhūtamindraṃ huva iti ||

na yaṃ du॒dhrā va̭rante na sthi॒rā mu॒ro madḙ su॒śipra̭mandha॒sa: | ya ā॒datyā̭ śa॒śamā̭nāya su॒nvate dā॒tā ja̭ri॒tra u॒kthya̭m || 2 || na | yam | du॒dhrā: | va॒ra॒nte॒ | na | sthi॒rā: | mu॒ra: | madḙ | su॒'śipra̭m | a॒ndhasa̭: | ya: | ā॒datyā̭ | śa॒śamā̭nāya | su॒nvatḙ | dā॒tā | ja॒ri॒tre | u॒kthya̭m || 2 || <sup>v</sup>yaṃ <sup>v</sup>suśipram indraṃ <sup>v</sup>dudhrā: dudharā asurādayo <sup>v</sup>na <sup>v</sup>varante na vārayanti saṃgrāme | tathā <sup>v</sup>sthirā: devā: <sup>v</sup>na varante | kiṃca <sup>v</sup>sura: maraṇasvabhāvā manuṣyā na varante | <sup>v</sup>andhasa: annasya<sup>4</sup> somasya<sup>5</sup> <sup>v</sup>made madāya somapānajanitāya <sup>v</sup>ādatya <sup>v</sup>ya: <sup>v</sup>śaśāmānāya śaṃsamānāya <sup>v</sup>sunvate abhiṣavaṃ kurvate <sup>v</sup>jaritre stotre ca <sup>v</sup>dātā bhavati | kim | <sup>v</sup>ukthyaṃ stutyaṃ dhanam | sa rejayatītyuttaratra saṃbandha: ||

ya: śa॒kro mṛ॒kṣo a̭śvyo॒ yo vā॒ kīrjo̭ hi॒ra॒ṇyaya̭: | sa ū॒rvasya̭ re॒jaya̭tyapā॒vṛti̭mi॒ndro ga॒vyasya̭ vṛ॒trahā̭ || 3 || ya: | śa॒kra: | mṛ॒kṣa: | a॒śvya: | ya: | vā | kīrjo̭: | hi॒ra॒ṇyaya̭: | sa: | ū॒rvasya̭ | re॒ja॒ya॒ti | a॒pa'vṛti̭m | i॒ndra: | ga॒vyasya̭ | vṛ॒tra'hā̭ || 3 || <sup>v</sup>ya: <sup>v</sup>śakra: indra: stotṛṇāṃ <sup>v</sup>mṛkṣa: śodhaka: paricaraṇīyo vā | yaśca <sup>v</sup>aśvya: | aśva- kuśalau'śvya: | athavā'śvya iti svārthiko yat | mṛkṣo'śva: prakṣālito'śva iva vartate | <sup>v</sup>yo <sup>v</sup>vā <sup>v</sup>kīrja: | kīja ityanutamāha | kimasya kathaṃ jāta iti va--- | yaśca <sup>v</sup>hiraṇyaya: hiraṇmayaśarīra: <sup>v</sup>sa: evamāśraryabhūta: <sup>v</sup>indra: <sup>v</sup>vṛtrahā <sup>v</sup>gavyasya gosamūhasya | kīdṛśasya | <sup>v</sup>ūrvasya bahulasya <sup>v</sup>apāvṛtim' apavaraṇīyaṃ <sup>v</sup>rejayati | kampayatītyartha: ||
vṛ॒jī sṷśi॒pro ha॒ryaśva̭ i॒tkara̭di॒ndra: kra॒tvā yathā̭ va॒śat ||
1. ghana-abhiṣutasomake | 2. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-tvadarthaṃ | 3. kha-ta-na-śa-sahitakaraṇaṃ; bha- svahitakaraṇaṃ | 4. kha-ta-ma-śa-<sup>6</sup> annasya somasya' nāsti | 5. kha-ta-na-bha-1-2-mādhṛti: |

nikhātam | cit | yaḥ | puru'saṃbhūtam | vasu | ut | ita | varpati | dāśuṣe | vajrī | su'śiprāḥ | hari'aśvaḥ | ita | karat | indraḥ | kratvā | yathā | vaśat || 4 || vnikhātaṃ vcit bhūmau khātvā sthāpitamapi vsaṃbhṛtaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ yāgadānādikaṃ kruvedhaśaṃ vpuru bahu vvasu dhanam vudidrapati udparatyeva' vdāśuṣe yajamānāya | evaṃ yo devaḥ karoti saḥ vvajrī vsuśiprāḥ suhanuḥ vharyaśva vit haritavarṇāśvayuktaḥ vindraḥ eva karoti | kenopādhinā | vkratvā karmaṇā yāgenopādhinā | vyathā vvaśat yena prakāreṇa prakāmayate tathā sa eva karoti ||

yadvāvantha puruṣṭuta purā cicchūra nṛṇām | vayaṃ tatta indra saṃ bharāmasi yajñamukthaṃ turaṃ varcaḥ || 5 || yat | vvantha | puru'stuta | purā | cit | śūra | nṛṇām | vayam | tat | te | indra | sam | bharāmasi | yajñam | uktham | turam | varcaḥ || 5 || he vpuruṣṭuta bahubhiḥ stutendra vśūra vikrānta vnṛṇāṃ netṛṇāṃ stotṛṇāṃ sakāśāt vpurā | vcit ityupamārthe | tathedānīmapi vyadvāvantha acīkamathāḥ vtat eva vvayaṃ vturaṃ tūrṇa vte tubhyam vindra vsaṃ vbharāmasi saṃbharāmaḥ | kiṃ taditi ucyate | vyajñaṃ yāgayogyaṃ haviḥ vukthaṃ śastraṃ vvacaḥ vācyam | tava priyatamaṃ haviḥ stotraṃ ca saṃbharāma ityarthaḥ || || 48 ||

sacā someṣu puruhūta vajrivo madāya dhṛkṣa somapāḥ | tvamiddhi brahmakṛte kāmyaṃ vasu deṣṭaḥ sunvate bhuvaḥ || 6 || sacā | someṣu | puru'huta | vajri'vaḥ | madāya | dhṛkṣa | soma'pāḥ | tvam | ita | hi | brahma'kṛtai | kāmyam | vasu | deṣṭaḥ | sunvate | bhuvaḥ || 6 || he vpuruhūta bahubhirāhūta he vvajrivaḥ vajravan vdhṛkṣa dhuman vsomapāḥ somasya pātaḥ tvaṃ vsomeṣu abhiṣuteṣu vmadāya vsacā saha bhaveti śeṣaḥ | vtvamit tvameva vbrahmakṛte stotrakartre vsunvate ca vkāmyaṃ kamanīyaṃ vvasu dhanaṃ vdeṣṭaḥ dātṛttamaḥ vbhuvaḥ bhavasi || cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyaṃdinasavane'cchāvākastre 'vayamenam' iti vaikalpiko'nurūpaḥ | tathā ca sūtritaṃ--' vayamenamidā hyo yo rājā carṣaṇīnām ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti ||

vayamenamidā hyo'pīpemeha vajriṇam | tasmā u adya saṃmanā sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute || 7 || vayam | enam | idā | hyaḥ | apīpema | iha | vajriṇam | tasmai | ū~ iti | adya | sumanāḥ | sutam | bhara | ā | nūnam | bhūṣata | śrute || 7 || vvayaṃ yajamānāḥ venam indraṃ vvajriṇam vidā idānīṃ vhyaḥ ca viha atra vapīpema āpyāyayāma somena | vtasmā vu vtasmā eva vadya atra vsamanā saṃgrāmātha vsutam abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ vbhara harata he adhvarvādyaḥ | vnūnam idānīṃ vśrute stotre śrute sati vā vbhūṣata ābhavatu āgacchatu ||

vṛkaścidasya vāruṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūpati | semaṃ naḥ stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā || 8 || vṛkaḥ | cit | asya | vāruṇaḥ | urā'mathiḥ | ā | vayuneṣu | bhūpati | saḥ | imam | naḥ | stomam | jujuṣāṇaḥ | ā | gahi | indra | pra | citrayā | dhiyā ||8|| vvṛkaścit steno'pi vvāruṇaḥ vārayitā sarvasya sannapi vurāmathiḥ śatrūṇāṃ mārge gacchatāṃ mathitā sannapi vasya indrasya vvayuneṣu mārgeṣu prajñāneṣu vā vā vbhūpati ānukūlyameva bhajate | atīva hiṃsro'pīndrasyānukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā | asyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | asumindrasudharūpo vṛko'pi vayuneṣu stotreṣvā bhūpati | vsaḥ svam vimaṃ vnaḥ vstomaṃ vjujuṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ vā vgahi āgaccha | he vindra vcitrayā vdhiyā karmaṇā stutilakṣaṇena nimittena vpra prakarṣeṇa ā gahi śīghramāgaccha || cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyaṃdinasavane'cchāvākaśāstra eva 'kadū nu' iti kadrapragāthaḥ | 'kadū nvāsyākṛtamiti kadrantaḥ pragāthāḥ ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti hi sūtritam ||

kadū nv syākṛtamindrasyāsti pauṃsyam | keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā || 9 || kat | ū~ iti | nu | asya | akṛtam | indrasya | asti | pauṃsyam | kena | ū~ iti | nu | kam | śromatena | na | śuśruve | januṣaḥ | pari | vṛtra'hā || 9 || vasya vindrasya vkadū nu kiṃ nu khalu vpauṃsyaṃ pauruṣam vakṛtam anācaritam vasti | sarvamapi vṛtravadhādikamanena kṛtameva itaḥ paraṃ na kiṃca pauṃsyaṃ kṛtyamastītyarthaḥ | loke svalpamapi yaḥ 'puṃstvaṃ' kuryāt sa tena stūyate'yaṃ tu na stuta etaducyate | vkeno nu vkaṃ kena khalu vśromatena śravaṇīyane2 puṃstvena vna vśuśruve na śrūyate | kiṃ katipayairevāhobhiḥ kṛtena netyāha | ayaṃ vvṛtrahā vṛtrasyātiprabalasya hantārya vjanuṣaḥ vpari janmaprabhṛti kriyamāṇaiḥ sāmarthyaiḥ śrūyate | vṛtrahatye- tatpuṃstvapradarśanadyotanāya | yathā vṛtrahananaṃ sarvaiḥ śrūyate tadvadanyānyapīti bhāvaḥ ||

kadū mahīradhṛṣṭā asya tarviṣīḥ kadū vṛtraghno astṛtam | indro viśvānbekanāṭau ahardṛśa uta kratvā puṇīrabhi || 10 || kat | ū~ iti | mahīḥ | adhṛṣṭāḥ | asya | tarviṣīḥ | kat | ū~ iti | vṛtra'ghnaḥ | astṛtam | indraḥ | viśvān | bekanāṭān | ahaḥ'dṛśaḥ | uta | kratvā | puṇīn | abhi || 10 || vkadū kadā" khalu vasya indrasya vtarviṣīḥ balāni vmahīḥ mahānti vadhṛṣṭāḥ adṛṣṭānya- dharṣakāṇi āsan | vkadu kadā nu khalu vvṛtraghnaḥ vṛtrahanturindrasya hantavyam vastṛtam ahiṃsitam- bhavat | na kadāciditya ------ 'haṃ abhavadityarthaḥ | athavāsya mahānti balāni senālakṣaṇāni kadāpyadhṛṣṭānyanyabalairahiṃsitāni tathā vṛtraghnaḥ6 śārīrikaṃ balamastṛtamanyairahiṃsyam | īdṛśena dvividhena
ekaṃ kārṣāpaṇamṛṇikāya prayacchan dvau mahāṃ dātavya - - - nayena darśayanti' tato dviṣandenaikaśabdena ca nāṭayantīti bekanāṭāḥ |
nanu sarve sūrya paśyanti ko'tiśaya iti ucyate |
ihaiva janmani sūrya paśyanti na janmāntare |
ṛtvā uta karmaṇaiva tāḍanādiṣyā- pāreṇaiva abhi bhavatīti śeṣaḥ |
preṣyān vādhuṣikāṃścaiva viprān śūdravadācaret ' ( manu. 8. 102 ) iti ||

vyaṃ ghā te apūrvyendra brahmāṇi vṛtrahan | purūtamāsaḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛti na pra bharāmasi || 11 || vayam | gha | te | apūrvyā | indra | brahmāṇi | vṛtrahan | purūtamāsaḥ | puruhūta | vajrivaḥ | bhṛtim | na | pra | bharāmasi || 11 ||

he indra vayaṃ gha khalu te tava apūrvyā nūtanāni brahmāṇi parivṛḍhāni stotrāṇi pra bharāmasi saṃbharāmaḥ purūtamāsaḥ bahutamā vayamivijyamānarūpeṇa vṛtrahan vṛtrasya hantaḥ puruhūta bahubhirāhūta he vajrivaḥ vajrayudhendra |

pūrvīściddhi tve tuvikūrminnāśaso harvanta indrotayaḥ | tiraścidaryaḥ savanā vaṃso gahi śaviṣṭha śṛdhi me havam || 12 || pūrvīḥ | cit | hi | tve iti | tuvi'kūrmin | ā'śasaḥ | harvante | indra | ūtayaḥ | tiraḥ | cit | aryaḥ | savanā | ā | vaso iti | gahi | śaviṣṭha | śṛdhi | me | havam ||12||
he tuvikūrmin bahukarman indra tve tvayi pūrvīḥ bahūni āśasaḥ āśaṃsanāni sthitāni tathā ūtayaḥ rakṣāśca tvayyavasthitā labdhuṃ harvante āhvayanti stotāro'nye |
ataḥ aryaḥ areḥ savanā savanāni tiraścit tiraskṛtya arīna vā tiraskṛtya asmatsavanānyabhilakṣya he vaso vāsakendra ā gahi āgaccha |
ato he śaviṣṭha atiśayena balavan me havaṃ śṛdhi śṛṇu ||

vyaṃ ghā te tve idindra viprā arpi ṣmasi | nahi tvadanyaḥ puruhūta kaścana maghavanmasti marditā || 13 || vayam | gha | te | tve iti | it | ū~ iti | indra | viprāḥ | arpi | smasi | nahi | tvat | anyaḥ | puruhūta | kaḥ | cana | maghavan | asti | marditā || 13 ||
he indra vayaṃ gha vayaṃ khalu te tava svabhūtā |
ataḥ sve itū tvadyeva viprā: medhā- vina: stotāra: api smasi |
he puruhūta tvadanya: kaścana he maghavan marḍitā sukhayitā na asti ||
tvaṃ nau a॒syā a̭rmate॒ruta॒ kṣudho̭'bhi॒śastḙrava॒ spṛdhi |
tvaṃ ne ū॒tī tava̭ ci॒trayā̭ dhi॒yā śi॒kṣā śaci̭ṣṭha gā॒tu॒vi॒t ||
tvam | na: | asyā: | armate: | uta | kṣudha: | abhi'śaste: | ava | spṛdhi | tvam | na: | ūtī | tava | citrayā | dhiyā | śikṣa | śaciṣṭha | gātu'vit || 14 ||
he indra tvaṃ na: asmān asyā amate: dāridryātmikāyā: uta api ca kṣudha: abhi- śaste: nindāyāśca sakāśāt ava spṛdhi avamocaya |
kiṃca tvaṃ na: asmabhyaṃ tava ūtī ūtyā citrayā dhiyā vicitreṇa karmaṇā śikṣa dehyabhimatam |
som i॒ddha: su॒to a̭stu॒ kala̭yo॒ mā bi̭bhītana |
soma: | ita | va: | suta: | astu | kalaya: | mā | bibhītana | apa | ita | eṣa: | dhvasmā | ayati | svayam | gha | eṣa: | apa | ayati || 15 ||

soma: suta: abhiputa: va: yuṣmākaṃ sambandhī astu ita bhavatvindrāya | he kalaya: | kalamaharṣerjñātaya: 1 putrāścātra sambodhyante | yūyaṃ mā bibhītana bhītā mā bhavata | bhītyabhāve kāraṇa- māha | eṣa dhvasmā dhvaṃsako rākṣasādi: apa ayati apagacchatyevendrasāmarthyāt | svayaṃ gha svayameva 2 eṣa: apāyati | u iti pūraṇa: | punaruktirdāḍhrghārtha | || 50 ||
atrānukramaṇikā—'tyānu saikā matsya: sāmado maitrāvaruṇirmānyo vā bahavo vā matsyā jālanaddhā: |
mitrāvaruṇayo: putro mānyo'thavā bahavo vā matsyā jālanaddhā: 3 santo bandhana- mokṣāyādityānastuvan |
'paraṃ gāyatraṃ prāgvatsapre:' iti paribhāṣāyā gāyatrī chanda: |
tyān | nu | kṣatriyān | ava | ādityān | yāciṣāmahe | su'mṛḻīkān | abhiṣṭaye || 1 ||
tyān tān ādityān kṣatriyān jātyā kṣatriyān ava rakṣaṇaṃ yāciṣāmahe yācā- mahe |
1. kha-gha-jña-ta1-2-śaviṣṭha balavan | 2. kha-ta-na-śa-kalitaharṣe:; gha-kalitaharṣā | 3. kha-ga-ta-na-śa- ahameva | 4. kha-ga-ta1-2-3-mātsya:; śa-mānya: | 5. na-jāle naddhā:; bha-jālena naddhā: |

mitro no atyaṃhatiṃ varuṇaḥ parṣadaryamā | ādityāso yathā viduḥ || 2 || mitraḥ | naḥ | ati | aṃhatim | varuṇaḥ | parṣat | aryamā | ādityāḥ | yathā | viduḥ ||2|| pamitraḥ | pavaruṇaḥ paaryamā pādityāḥ ādityāḥ | pa naḥ asmān paaṃhatim paati paparṣat atinayantu | te payathā paviduḥ yena2 prakāreṇa duḥsahaṃ jānanti tathāhi parṣaditi | itarapakṣe aṃhatiṃ pāpamati parṣaditi ||

teṣāṃ hi citramukthyaṃ varūtharmāsti dāśuṣe | ādityānāmṛtaṃ kṛtai || 3 || teṣām | hi | citram | ukthyam | varūtham | asti | dāśuṣe | ādityānām | arum kṛtai ||3|| pateṣām paādityānāṃ pahi khalu pacitraṃ cāyanīyam paukthyaṃ stutyaṃ pavarūthaṃ dhanam paasti padāśuṣe havirdātre paarukṛte alaṃkṛtai paryāptakāriṇe yajamānāya dātavyaṃ dhanamastīti ||

mā naḥ setuḥ siṣedhayaṃ mahe vṛṇaktu nuspariṃ | indra iddi śruto vaśī || 8 || mā | naḥ | setuḥ | siset | ayam | mahe | vṛṇaktu | naḥ | pari | indraḥ | it | hi | śrutaḥ | vaśī ||8|| naḥ asmān setuḥ bandhako jālaḥ mā siṣedhat mā badhnātu | naḥ asmān mahe mahate karmaṇe pari vṛṇaktu parivarjayatu jālāt | kaḥ | indra it indra eva śrutaḥ viśvataḥ vaśī sarvasya vaśīkartā | sa pari vṛṇaktu ||

mā nau mṛcā ripūṇāṃ vṛjinānāmaviṣayavaḥ | devā abhi pra mṛkṣata || 9 || mā | naḥ | mṛcā | ripūṇām | vṛjinānām | aviṣyavaḥ | devāḥ | abhi | pra | mṛkṣata ||9|| he aviṣyavaḥ rakṣitumicchantaḥ devāḥ naḥ asmān vṛjinānāṃ hisakānāṃ ripūṇāṃ mṛcā | mṛcihiṃsākarmā | 'yacchreṇa marcayatā supeśasā' (āśva. gṛ. 1. 17. 15) ityādiṣu tathā dṛṣṭatvāt | hiṃsakena jālena mā abhi pra mṛkṣata | abhimarśanamupari jālasya preraṇaṃ mā kuruta | yadvā | mṛcā jālena prāptā bādhā no'smākaṃ mā bhavatu | he devāḥ yūyaṃ ca parimārjayata pariharata || ādhāne pavamāneṣṭiṣu 'uta tvāmadite' ityanuvākyā | sūtritaṃ ca—'uta tvāmadite mahi mahīmū ṣu mātaram' (āśva. śrau. 2. 1) iti | āditye paśau vapāyā anuvākyeyameva | sūtritaṃ ca— 'uta tvāmadite mahaneho na uruvraje' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||

uta tvāmadite mahahaṃ devyupa bruve | sumuḻīkāmabhiṣṭaye || 10 || uta | tvām | adite | mahi | aham | devi | upa | bruve | su'muḻīkām | abhiṣṭaye ||10|| he mahi mahati adite devamātaḥ devi tvām ahaṃ matsyapakṣe matsyapramukho'ham upa bruve upetya staumi | kīdṛśīm | sumuḻīkāṃ suṣṭhu sukhayitrīma | kimartham | abhiṣṭaye abhimatāya ||52||

parṣi dīne gaṃbhīra ā~ ugraputre jighāṃsataḥ | mārkistokasya no riṣat || 11 || parṣi | dīne | gabhīre | ā | ugra'putre | jighāṃsataḥ | mārkiḥ | tokasya | naḥ | riṣat ||11|| he adite ā parṣi sarvataḥ pālayasi | dīne kṣīṇe gabhīre udake | udakanāmaitat 'gabhīraṃ gahanam' iti tatrāmasu pāṭhāt | ugraputre udgarṇāḥ putrā yasmin tat | tasminnudake jighāṃsataḥ hiṃsato jālaṃ tokasya asmākaṃ tanayasya tanayaṃ mākiḥ riṣat maiva hiṃsāṃ karotu || ādityasya paśau 'aneho naḥ' iti puroḍāśasyānuvākyā | sūtritaṃ ca—'aneho na uruvraje' ditirhajaniṣṭa' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||

aneho na uruvraja ūruci vi prasartave | kṛdhi tokārya jīvasai || 12 || anehaḥ | naḥ | uru'vraje | ūruci | vi | pra'sartave | kṛdhi | tokārya | jīvasai ||12|| anehaḥ apāpān naḥ asmān he uruvraje vistīrṇagamane | dūramiyamaditirbhūmipā gatā bhavatyativistṛtatvāt | athorugamane dhīre he ūruci ūrutvaṃ vi prasartave abhisaraṇāya kṛdhi 1. kha-gha-jha-ta-1-2-utāpi ca he | 2. gha-tara-3-śa-'tat' nāsti | 3. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-karoti | 4. ga-dūraṃ hi iyamaditiḥ; na-dūraṃ yaṃmaditiḥ; ta3-bha1-śa-dūraṃ yamaditiḥ; bha2-dūraṃ yamaditiḥ; bha3-dūraṃ yathā vrajati |

kuru| kasmai| ᵥtokāya putrāya matsyāya ᵥjīvase tasya jīvanāya| yathā jīvema putrāścituṃ tathorutvaṃ kurviti || ye mūrdhānaḥ kṣitīnāmadabdhāsaḥ svaryaśasaḥ | vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ || 13 || ye | mūrdhānaḥ | kṣitīnām | adabdhāsaḥ | sva'ryaśasaḥ | vratā | rakṣante | adruhaḥ || 13 || ᵥye ᵥmūrdhānaḥ sarveṣāṃ mūrdhasthānīyā ucchritāḥ ᵥkṣitīnāṃ manuṣyāṇām ᵥadabdhāsaḥ ahiṃsakāḥ ᵥsvayaśasaḥ svāyattakīrtayaḥ ᵥvratā vratānyasmadīyāni karmāṇi ᵥrakṣante pālayante ᵥadruhaḥ adrogdhāraḥ santaḥ || te na āsro vṛkāṇāmārdityāso mumocata | stenaṃ baddhamivāditte || 14 || te | naḥ | āsraḥ | vṛkāṇām | ādityāḥ | mumocata | stenam | baddham'iva | aditte || 14 || he ᵥādityāḥ ādityāḥ ᵥte yūyaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥvṛkāṇāṃ hiṃsakānāmādātṝṇāṃ vā ᵥāsraḥ āsyāt sakāśāt ᵥmumocata vimocanaṃ kuruta ᵥstenaṃ ᵥbaddhamiva | he ᵥadite tvaṃ ca mocayāsmāniti || apo ṣu ṇ iyaṃ śarurādityā arpa durmatiḥ | asmadetvarjaghnuṣī || 15 || apo iti | ṣu | naḥ | iyam | śaruḥ | ādityāḥ | arpa | duḥ'matiḥ | asmat | etu | arjaghnuṣī || 15 || he ᵥādityāḥ ᵥiyaṃ ᵥśaruḥ hiṃsikā prasitiḥ jālikapreritā ᵥajaghnuṣī ahiṃsantī satī ᵥasmat asmat ᵥsu suṣṭhu ᵥapo ᵥetu apagacchatveva | tathā ᵥdurmatiḥ duṣṭā matirapyajaghnuṣī asmattaḥ ᵥapa
