indrāya gāvaṃ āśiraṃ duduhe vajriṇe madhu | yatsīmupahare vidat || 6 || indrāya | gāvaḥ | ā'śiram | duduhe | vajriṇe | madhu | yat | sīm | upa'hure | vidat ||6|| ^indrāya ^gāvaḥ ^āśiram āśrayaṇasādhanaṃ payaādikaṃ ^madhu madakaraṃ ^duduhe duhate | kīdṛśāya | ^vajriṇe vajrayuktāyendrāya | ^yat yadā ^upahare samīpe vartamānaṃ madhu somarasaṃ ^sīṃ sarvataḥ ^vidat labhate tadā ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'udyadbrahmaṇasya viṣṭapamityeṣā pari- dhānīyā' (āśva. śrau. 6. 2) iti ||

udyadbrahmaṇasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛhaminrdraśca ganvahi | madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade || 7 || ut | yat | brahmaṇaḥ | viṣṭapam | gṛham | indraḥ | ca | ganvahi | madhvaḥ | pītvā | sacevahi | triḥ | sapta | sakhyuḥ | pade || 7 || ^yat yadā ^brahmaṇaḥ ^viṣṭapaṃ sūryasya sthānaṃ ^gṛhaminrdraśca ahaṃ cobhau ^ut ^ganvahi ucchacchāvaḥ tadānīṃ ^madhvaḥ madhuraṃ somarasaṃ ^pītvā ^sacevahi saṃsrau bhaveva | kutra | ^sakhyuḥ ^sarveṣāṃ sakhibhūtasyādityasya | ^triḥ ^sapta ityanena devalokānāmuttamamekaviṃśaṃ sthānamucyate ādityasyai- kaviṃśatvāt | tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ—'dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavastraya ime lokā asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ' (ai. brā. 1. 30) iti | tādṛśa ekaviṃśasthāne sacevahīti ||
pūrvokta eva śakte 'arcata' iti dvitīya ānuṣṭubhastṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'prapa vakṣiṣṭhabhamiśamarcata prācaṃta' (āśva. śrau. 6. 2) iti ||
arcata prācaṃta priyamedhāso arcata | arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇvarcata ||8|| arcata | pra | arcata | priya'medhāsaḥ | arcata | arcantu | putrakāḥ | uta | puram | na | dhṛṣṇu | arcata || 8 ||
mahataḥ ādityasya viṣṭapaṃ sthānaṃ; ga-brahmasyādityasya viṣṭapaṃ sthānaṃ; ta3-śa-brahmaṇasya viṣṭapaṃ sthānaṃ |
he adhvarvādayaḥ yūyamindram ᵥarcata pūjayata stutyā |
he ᵥpriyamedhāsaḥ priyamedhasambandhinastadvo yūyam ᵥarcata indram |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥpuraṃ ᵥna ᵥghṛṣṇu yathā puraṃ gharṣaṇaśīlamarcanti tādṛśamindram ᵥarcata ||
ava svarāti gargaro godhā pariṃ saniṣvaṇat |
ava | svarāti | gargaraḥ | godhā | pari | sanisvanat | piṅgā | pari | caniṣkadat | indrāya | brahma | uta | udyatam || 9 ||
ᵥgargaraḥ gargaradhvaniyukto vādyaviśeṣo yuddhe ᵥava ᵥsvarāti bhayaṃ śabdayati |
he varuṇa jalābhimānin deva tvaṃ sudevo'si yasya sudevasya te tava kākudaṃ tālu samudāyyaṃ sasa sindhavaḥ gaṅgāyāḥ sapta nadyaḥ anukṣaranti jihvāyāṃ sarvadā sravanti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'yo vyatīraphāṇayaditi tṛcā ānuṣṭubhāḥ' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 2 ) iti |

yo vyatīraphāṇayatsuyuktā~ upa dāśuṣe | tuko netā tadidvapurupamā yo amyucyata || 13 || yaḥ | vyatīn | aphāṇayat | su'yuktān | upa | dāśuṣe | tukaḥ | netā | tat | it | vapuḥ | upa'mā | yaḥ | amyucyata || 13 || yaḥ indraḥ vyatīn vividhagamanān suyuktān suṣṭhu rathe saṃbaddhāndhanān dāśuṣe havirdātre yajamānāya gantuṃ prāptum upa aphāṇayat upagamayati | phaṇatirgatikarmā | yadaivaṃ karoti tadit tadānīmeva takaḥ | takatirgata

ā | tu | su'śipra | dum'pate | ratham | tiṣṭha | hiraṇyayam | ardha | ghukṣam | sacevahi | sahasra'pādam | arugam | svasti'gām | anehasam || 16 || he vsuśipra suhano he vdaṃpate gṛhasvāmin | atra gṛho rathaḥ | tasya svāmin | vtu' 'tvaṃ' tāvat vratham vā vtiṣṭha | haviḥsvīkaraṇāntaraṃ paścādahamārohāmīti bhāvaḥ | kīdṛśam | vhiraṇyayaṃ hiraṇmayam | vadha tavārohaṇānantaramahampyārohābhau vsacevahi saṃgacchevahi | saṃgattau bhaveva | punaḥ' kīdṛśam' | vghukṣaṃ dīptaṃ rathaṃ vsahasrapādaṃ bahupādam varupam ārocamānaṃ vsvastigāṃ kuśalagamanam vanehasam apāpam || pūrvāhne pravargyaṃ 'taṃ dhemityā' ityeṣā | sūtritaṃ ca—'taṃ dhemityā namasvin iti prāgātthīṃ pūrvāhne' (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||

taṃ dhemityā namasvin upa svarājamāsate | arthaṃ cidasya sudhitaṃ yadetava āvartayanti dāvanai || 17 || tam | gha | īm | itthā | namasvin: | upa | sva'rājam | āsate | artham | cit | asya | su'dhitam | yat | etave | ā'vartayanti | dāvanai || 17 || vtaṃ vgha taṃ khalu vīm enamindram vitthā itthamena prakāreṇa vnamasvin: ajñavantaḥ stutivanto vādhvaryvādayaḥ vsvarājaṃ svayaṃ rājamānaṃ vā vupa vāsate sevante | tathā kṛtvā varthaṃ vcit araṇīyaṃ dhanaṃ vsudhitaṃ suhu sthāpitam vasya indrasya saṃbandhanaṃ prāpnuvantīti śeṣaḥ | kadeti āha | vyat yadā vebave asyendrasya gamanāya svayaṃ prāptuṃ vā vdāvane havirdānāya vāvarta- yanti stutayaḥ tadetyarthaḥ | athavāśvā vāvartayanti tadetyarthaḥ ||

anu pralasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām | pūrvāmanu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata || 18 || anu | pratnasya | okasaḥ | priya'medhāsaḥ | eṣām | pūrvām | anu | pra'yatim | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | hita'prayasaḥ | āśata || 18 || anayā stutimupasaṃharati | veṣāṃ devānāmindrādīnāṃ vpratnasya purāṇasya vokasaḥ sthānasya purāṇaṃ sthānaṃ vpriyamedhāsaḥ priyamedhāḥ vanu vāśata anuprāptāḥ | kīdṛśāḥ priyamedhāḥ | vpūrvāṃ mukhyaṃ' vprayatiṃ pradānam vanu lakṣīkṛtya vvṛktabarhiṣaḥ stīrṇadarbhāḥ vhitaprayasaḥ āsāditasomādi- haviṣkāḥ || || 7 || || 7 ||
tatra 'yo rājā' iti pañcadaśacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam |
atrānu- kramaṇikā—'yo rājā pañconā puruhanmā bārhataṃ tripragāthādyuṣṇiganuṣṭuppurauṣṇigantam' iti |
trayo- daśyuṣṇig caturdaśyanuṣṭup pañcadaśī purauṣṇigādyadvādaśakā aṣṭakā |
tathā ca pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ—' yo rājā carṣaṇīnāmityekādaśa ' ( ai. ā. 5. 2. 4 ) iti ||
viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā guṇe ||
yaḥ | rājā | carṣaṇīnām | yātā | rathebhiḥ | adhriguḥ | viśvāsām | tarutā | pṛtanānām | jyeṣṭhaḥ | yaḥ | vṛtrahā | guṇe || 1 ||
yaḥ indraḥ carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ rājā svāmī rathebhiḥ yātā gantā ca adhriguḥ adhrata- gamano'nyaiḥ viśvāsāṃ pṛtanānāṃ senānāṃ tarutā tārakaḥ |
indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmanvase yasya dvitā vidhurtarīṃ |
hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ ||
indram | tam | śumbha | puruhanman | avase | yasya | dvitā | vidhurtarīṃ | hastāya | vajraḥ | prati | dhāyi | darśataḥ | mahaḥ | dive | na | sūryaḥ || 2 ||
he puruhanman ṛṣe tvaṃ tam indraṃ śumbha haviṣpradānādinālaṃkuru |
yasya tava vidhurtari vidhāraka indre dvitā dvitva- mastyaupamanaupamyam |
tava śatrūn hantumagravaṃ tvadanugrahāyānaudhayaṃ ceti dvaitamasti |
hastāya karāya hananāya śatrūṇāṃ darśataḥ darśanīyaḥ mahaḥ mahān vajraḥ prati dhāyi pratinihito bhavati dive prakāśāya divasāya vā athavā divi dṛśyamānaḥ sūryaḥ iva ||
tasminneva śabde ' nakiṣṭam ' iti pragātho vaikalpikaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—' nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśasa tvā vṛhanto adrayaḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti ||
nakiḥ | tam | karmaṇā | naśat | yaḥ | cakāra | sadāvṛdham | indram | na | yajñaiḥ | viśvagūrtam | ṛvasam | adhṛṣṭam | dhṛṣṇu'ojasam || 3 ||
taṃ janamanyo marṣako janaḥ karmaṇā hananādidhyāpāreṇa nakiḥ naśat naiva vyāpnoti |
yaḥ indraṃ cakāra indramevānukūlaṃ yajñaiḥ sādhanaiḥ |
sadāvṛdhaṃ sadā vardhakaṃ viśvagūrtaṃ sarvaiḥ stutyam ṛvasaṃ mahāntam adhṛṣṭam anyaiḥ dhṛṣṇvojasaṃ dharṣakabalam ||
saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmau anonavuḥ ||

1. gha-bha-mu-rathebhī ratheḥ | 2. kha-gha-jña-ta-1-2-sarveṣāṃ saṃgrāmāṇāṃ; ga-ta-3-4-śa-"senānāṃ" nāsti | 3. kha-ta-śa-tatraupamyaṃ cihnaṃ | 4. kha-ta-1-"athavā" nāsti | 5. ga-dharṣako | 6. gha-bha-sarvadā |
aṣāḻaham | upram | pṛtanāsu | susaham | yasmin | mahīḥ | uru'jayaḥ | sam | dhenavaḥ | jāyamāne | anonavuḥ | dhāvaḥ | kṣāmaḥ | anonavuḥ || 4 ||
aṣāḻaham asoḍham ugram ūrṇabalaṃ pṛtanāsu śatrusenāsu sāsahim abhibhavitāraṃ staumītyarthaḥ |
yasmin indre jāyamāne mahīḥ mahatyaḥ urugrayaḥ bahuvegāḥ dhenavaḥ havirādinā prīṇayiṣyaḥ prajā gāva eva vā sam anonavuḥ samastuvan |
na kevalaṃ dhenava eva api tu dhāvaḥ dyulokāḥ kṣāmaḥ pṛthivyaśca sam anonavuḥ |
tṛtīye'hani niṣkevalye vairūpasāmapakṣe 'yadghāvaḥ' iti pragāthaḥ stotriyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'yadghāva indra te śataṃ yadindra yāvatasvamiti pragāthau stotriyānurūpau' (āśva. śrau. 7. 10) iti ||
yadghāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ |
na tvā vajrinsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātaṣṭa rodasī ||
yat | dhāvaḥ | indra | te | śatam | śatam | bhūmīḥ | uta | syuriti syuḥ | na | tvā | vajrin | muharttam | sūryāḥ | anu | na | jātam | aṣṭa | rodasī iti || 5 ||
he indra te tava pratimānārthaṃ yat yadi dhāvaḥ dyulokāḥ syuḥ tathāpi nāpnuvanti |
uta api ca bhūmīḥ bhūmyaste tava mūrtipratibimbāya śataṃ syuḥ tathāpi nāpnuvanti |
he vajrin tvā tvāṃ sahasraṃ sūryāḥ agaṇitā api sūryāḥ na anu bhavanti |
'na tatra sūryo bhāti' (ka. u. 5. 15) iti śruteḥ |
jātaṃ pūrvamutpannaṃ kiṃcana na aṣṭa nāpnute |
'jyāyānpṛthivyā jyāyānantarikṣājjyāyāndivo jyāyānebhyo lokebhyaḥ' (chā. u. 3. 14. 3) iti śruteḥ ||
ā paprāya mahimā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣanviśvaśa śavasā |
ā | paprāya | mahimā | vṛṣṇyā | vṛṣan | viśvā | śavasā | asmān | ava | maghavan | go'mati | vraje | vajrin | citrābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ || 6 ||
he vṛṣan abhimatavarṣakendra tvam ā paprāya āpūrayasi vyāpnoṣi |
viśvā sarvāṇi vṛṣṇyā varṣakāṇi balāni śatrusambandhīni |
tathā sati abhimatavarṣakeṇa mahatā balenāsmadīyāni balāni pūrayasītyarthaḥ |
atha tathā kṛtvā asmān gomati bahubhirgobhiryukte vraje śatrusambandhine nimitte satyasmān ava he vajrin vajrayukendra |
etagvā cidya etaśā yuyojate harī indro yuyojate ||

1. ga-samyagastuvan | 2. kha-tara-vā dyāvo; ta1-yā dyāvo | 3. gha-sūryāḥ anu na jātaṃ | 4. kha-gha-jña-ta1-2-śaviṣṭha balavan maghavan dhanavan he vṛṣan | 5. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-tvaṃ vṛṣā | 6. kha-ta-viśvāni | 7. kha-gha-ta-bha-1-2-śa-vajre |

na | sīm | adevaḥ | āpat | irṣam | dīrghāyo iti dīrgha'āyo | martyaḥ | eta'gvā | cit | yaḥ | etaśā | yuyojate | harī iti | indraḥ | yuyojate || 7 || he 'dīrghāyo nindyendra saḥ 'adevaḥ indrākhyadevarahitaḥ 'martyaḥ maraṇadharmā manuṣyaḥ 'sīṃ sarvam 'iṣam ahaṃ 'na 'āpat na prāpnoti | 'yaḥ martyo'syendrasya 'etagvā 'cit | etarvāvevāśvau bhavato'bhimatadeśagamanāya | 'etaśā 'etāśvau 'yuyojate yojayati rathe yajñaṃ gantum | yaśca 'indraḥ 'harī 'yuyojate taṃ na yaḥ stauti | sa na prāpnotīti samanvayaḥ ||

taṃ voṃ maho mahāvyamindraṃ dānārya sakṣaṇim | yo gādheṣu ya āraṇepu havyo vājeṣvasti havyaḥ || 8 || tam | vaḥ | mahaḥ | mahāvyam | indram | dānārya | sakṣaṇim | yaḥ | gādheṣu | yaḥ | ā'araṇepu | havyaḥ | vājeṣu | asti | havyaḥ || 8 || he ṛtvijaḥ 'mahaḥ mahāntaḥ 'vaḥ yūyaṃ 'taṃ 'mahāvyaṃ pūjyam 'indraṃ 'dānāya 'sakṣaṇiṃ sacamānaṃ paricarateti śeṣaḥ | 'yaḥ indraḥ 'gādheṣu udakeṣu 'havyaḥ 'asti āhvātavyo bhavati | 'yaḥ ca 'āraṇepu gantavyeṣu nimne'dakeṣu sthaleṣu vā havyo'sti | tathā 'vājeṣu saṃgrāmeṣu jayāya 'havyaḥ hrātavyo'sti bhavati ||

uddu ṣu ṇo vaso mahe mṛśasva śūra rādhase | uddu ṣu mahai maghavanmaghartya udindra śravase mahe || 9 || ut | ū~ iti | su | naḥ | vaso iti | mahe | mṛśasva | śūra | rādhase | ut | ū~ iti | su | mahai | magha'van | maghartye | ut | indra | śravase | mahe || 9 || he 'vaso vāsayitaḥ 'śūra indra tvaṃ 'naḥ asmān 'su suṣṭhu 'uddu 'mṛśasva unmṛśasvaiva | utthāpaya | kimartham | 'mahe mahate 'rādhase annāya | tathā he śūra 'maghavan indra 'ut mṛśasva 'mahe mahate 'maghattye dhanadānāya | tathā 'ut mṛśasva 'indra 'mahe mahatyai 'śravase kīrtyai ||

tvaṃ na indra ṛtayusvānido ni tṛmpasi | madhye vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇorvoni dāsaṃ śiśratho hathaiḥ || 10 || tvam | naḥ | indra | ṛta'yuḥ | tvā'nidaḥ | ni | tṛmpasi | madhye | vasiṣva | tuvi'nṛmṇa | ūrvoḥ | ni | dāsam | śiśrathaḥ | hathaiḥ || 10 || he 'indra 'ṛtayuḥ yajñakāmaḥ 'tvaṃ 'naḥ asmān 'tvānidaḥ | tvāṃ yo nindati saḥ | ayajana- meva nindā tava | tasmādayaṣṭuḥ sakāśāt 'ni nitarāṃ 'tṛmpasi prīṇayasi | tasya dhanamapahṛtyeti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ saṃtapyaṃ he 'tuvinṛmṇa prabhūtadhana sa 'tvaṃ tava 'ūrvoḥ 'madhye asmān 'vasiṣva | ūhyamā- cchādaya rakṣārtham | 'dāsam upakṣapayitāramasmadveṣiṇaṃ pāpaṃ vā 'hathaiḥ hananaḥ 'ni 'śiśrathaḥ mārayasi | athavā tvadvirodhinaṃ dāsasuraṃ ni śiśratho hananaḥ || || 10 ||
ava sva: sakhā dudhuvīta parvata: sumnāya dasyuṃ parvata: ||
anya'vratam | amānuṣam | arya'vānam | adeva'yum | ave | sva: | sakhā | dudhuvīta | parvata: | su'anāya | dasyum | parvata: || 11 ||
he indra 'anyavrataṃ' vyatiriktakarmāṇam' ata eva 'amānuṣaṃ mānuṣāṇāmindrayājināmapriyam 'ayajvānam ayaṣṭāram 'adevayum adevakarmāṇaṃ pāpinaṃ 'sva: svargāt 'ava 'dudhuvīta avacālaye- dityartha: |
yadyapyanyaṃ devamiṣṭvā svargaṃ prāpnoti sa: tathāpi' pātayati' ṛṣi: |
na kevalaṃ dhūnanamātramapi tu 'sumnāya suṣṭhu hantre mṛtyave 'dasyum uktalakṣaṇaṃ 'parvata: prerayatīti śeṣa: |
vabhūribhi: bahubhi: vaṛṣibhi: atīndriya- śaiṛtvigbhi: vabarhiṣmadbhi: yāgavadbhi: vastaviṣyase stūyase|
vayat ya indra: vaitthamekamekamit ekamekameva vatsamityevaṃ bahūn vavassān stotumya: vaparādada: prayacchasi|
karṇagṛhā maghavā śauradevyo vatsaṃ nastribhya ānayat | ajāṃ sūrina dhātave || 15 || karṇa'gṛhā| maghavā| śaura'devya:| vatsam| na:| tribhya:| ā| anayat| ajām| sūri:| na| dhātave || 15 ||
ayaṃ vamaghavā indra: vatribhya: hiṃsakebhya: sakāśāt vaśauradevya:|
vatsasahitā asamabhyaṃ vakarṇagṛhya karṇe gṛhītvā vaānayat ānayat|
vasūrinaṃ preraka: svāmīva vadhānave pānāya vaajāṃ yathā sa ānayati karṇe gṛhītvā tadvaditi ||
'tvaṃ no agne' iti pañcadaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktam|
ādau nava gāyatryo daśamīdvādaśīcaturdaśyo bṛhasya ekādaśītrayodaśīpañcadaśya: satobṛhatya:|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'tvaṃ na: sudītipurumīḻhau tayorvānyatara āgneyaṃ tu tripragāthāntam' iti|
prātaranuvāka āgneye kratau gāyatre chandasyāśvinaśastre cādito navarca:|
tathā ca sūtritaṃ—'tvaṃ no agne mahobhiriti nava' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti ||
tvaṃ no agne mahobhi: pāhi viśvasyā arāte: | uta dviṣo martyasya || 1 || tvam| na:| agne| maha:'bhi:| pāhi| viśvasyā:| arāte:| uta| dviṣa:| martyasya || 1 ||
he vaagne vatvaṃ vana: asmān vamahobhi: pūjābhirhavirdhanairvā vapāhi rakṣa|
vaviśvasyā: bahuvidhāt vaarāte: adātu: sakāśāt adānādvā pāhi|

saḥ | naḥ | viśvebhiḥ | devebhiḥ | ūrjaḥ | napāt | bhadra'śoce | rayim | dehi | viśva'vāram ||3|| he agne 'saḥ stutyastvaṃ 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'vasvo vasu dhanamupa māsi prayacchasi | he 'ūrjau 'napāt balasya nasanaṃ pātayitarvā he 'bhadraśoce stutyaprakāśa | tadevādāryaṃ punarāha | 'rathi dhanaṃ 'viśvavāraṃ sarvairviraṇīyaṃ dhanaṃ 'dehi | athavā yadrūpa māsi asmabhyaṃ dātuṃ taddhanaṃ gṛhādilakṣaṇaṃ tacca rathi dānāī gohiraṇyādikaṃ ca dehītyapunarūktiḥ ||

na tame agne arātayo martaṃ yuvanta rāyaḥ | yaṃ trāyase dāśvāṃsam || 4 || na | tam | agne | arātayaḥ | martam | yuvanta | rāyaḥ | yam | trāyase | dāśvāṃsam || 4 || he 'agne 'taṃ stotāram 'arātayaḥ adānaśīlā dveṣiṇaḥ 'rāyaḥ rathimantaḥ2 'na 'yuvanta na pṛthakurvanti | rāyo dhanādvā na yuvanta | 'yaṃ 'dāśvāṃsaṃ havirdātāraṃ3 trāyase pālayase ||

yaṃ tvaṃ vipra medhasātāvaṃ hiṇoṣi dhanāya | sa tavotī goṣu gantā || 5 || yam | tvam | vipra | medha'sātau | agne | hinoṣi | dhanāya | saḥ | tava | ūtī | goṣu | gantā ||5|| he 'agne 'vipra 'tvaṃ 'yaṃ martya 'medhasātau yajñasya saṃbhajane 'hinoṣi prerayasi 'dhanāya gavā- didhanalābhāya 'saḥ yajamānaḥ 'tava 'ūtī ūtyā rakṣaṇena 'goṣu 'gantā bhavati | gomān bhavatītyarthaḥ || || 11 ||

tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīramagne dāśuṣe martaya | pra ṇo naya vasyo accha || 6 || tvam | rayim | puru'vīram | agne | dāśuṣe | martaya | pra | naḥ | naya | vasyaḥ | accha || 6 || he 'agne 'tvaṃ 'dāśuṣe havirdattavate martyāya yajamānāya 'rayiṃ dhanaṃ 'puruvīraṃ bahubhirvairairyuktaṃ prayacchasi | ataḥ 'naḥ asmānapi 'vasyaḥ vasīyo dhanam 'accha abhiptrāptuṃ 'pra 'ṇaya prāpaya ||

uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ | durādhye' martaya || 7 || uruṣya | naḥ | mā | parā | dāḥ | agha'dyate | jāta'vedaḥ | duḥ'ādhyai | martaya || 7 || he 'jātavedaḥ jātavidya jātadhana vāme 'naḥ asmān 'uruṣya rakṣa | 'uruṣyatī rakṣākarmā' (niru. 5. 23) iti yāskaḥ | 'mā 'parā 'dāḥ mā parādehasmān | kasmā iti sa ucyate | 'aghāyate avaṃ pāpamicchate 'durādhye durādhyānāya durvicintakāya hiṃsābuddhaye 'martaya manuṣyāya ||

upa stṛṇītamatraye himena gharmamaśvinā | anti ṣaḍbhūtū vāmarvaḥ || 3 || upa | stṛṇītam | atraye | himena | gharmam | aśvinā | anti | sat | bhutu | vām | arbaḥ ||3||

kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmatuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ |
1. gha-na-bha-he mitrāvaruṇā | 2. gha1-vyāpnotu nu śārṅga; ya-vyāpnoti | 3. jña-ta1-2-bha-’ vā ’ nāsti | 4. ta-bha1-2-śa-udaka; bha3-udake |
kuha̭ | sthaḥ | kuha̭ | ja॒gmathuḥ | kuha̭ | śye॒nā'i̭va | pe॒thuḥ | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: || 4 ||
he aśvinau yuvāṃ kuha ka sthaḥ bhavataḥ |
idānīṃ kuha ka kutra jagmathuḥ gacchathaḥ svecchayā |
kuha ka vā śyeneva śyenādiva śīghrapatanau santo pethuḥ patathaḥ |
yadya॒ kahi̭ kahi̭ ci॒cchru॒yārta॒mima̭ṃ ha॒rvam | anti̭ pa॒ddta॒ vāmarva̭: || 5 || yat | adya | kahi̭ | kahi̭ | ci॒t | śu॒śrū॒yārta̭m | i॒mam | ha॒rvam | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: || 5 ||
yat yasmāt nirdhāyate'ta adya asmin kāle kahi kasminnapi deśe kahi kasminnapi kāle imaṃ havam asmadīyamāhvānaṃ śuśrūyātaṃ śṛṇuyātam ||
a॒śvinā̭ yā॒muha̭rtamā ne॒diṣṭha̭ṃ yā॒myāpya̭m | anti̭ pa॒ddta॒ vāmarva̭: || 6 || a॒śvinā̭ | yā॒muha̭rtamā | ne॒diṣṭha̭m | yā॒mya'ā̭pyam | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: ||6||
yāmahurtamā atiśayena kāle hātavyau aśvinā aśvinau yāmi |
nediṣṭham antikatamam āpyaṃ bāndhavaṃ ca yāmi tayoḥ ||
a॒rva॒nta॒matrye॒ gṛha̭ṃ kṛ॒ṇuta॒ṃ yu॒vama̭śvinā | anti̭ pa॒ddta॒ vāmarva̭: || 7 || a॒rva॒ntam | atryḙ | gṛha̭m | kṛ॒ṇu॒tam | yu॒vam | a॒śvinā̭ | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: ||7||
he aśvinā yuvaṃ yuvām atrye atryāgāre dahyamānāya arvantaṃ rakṣantaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutaṃ kṛtavantau |
ve॒rethḙ a॒bhimā̭ta॒po va̭rte॒ vula̭va॒trayḙ | anti̭ pa॒ddta॒ vāmarva̭: || 8 || ve॒rethḙ iti | a॒bhimā̭ta॒paḥ | va̭rte | vula̭gu | atryḙ | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: ||8||
he aśvinau valgu manohara vadate stuvate atrye ātapaḥ ātapādīṣyāt agni verethe āvārayatum ||
pra sa॒ptava̭dhi॒rāśa̭sā॒ dhārā̭ma॒reśā̭yata | anti̭ pa॒ddta॒ vāmarva̭: || 9 || pra | sa॒ptava̭dhiḥ | ā'śa̭sā | dhārā̭m | a॒meḥ | a॒śāya̭ta | anti̭ | sa॒t | bhu॒t | vā॒m | arva̭: ||9||
saptavadhiḥ maharṣirhe aśvinau yuvayoḥ āśāsā āśaṃsanena stutyā mañjūṣāyā nirgatya ameḥ dhārāṃ tasyāṃ mañjūṣāyāṃ pra aśāyata āśāyayat |
saptavadheḥ peṭikāntaḥpraveśo'śvinoranugrahādgirāmaśca ‘vi jihīṣva vanaspate’ (ṛ. saṃ. 5. 78. 5) ityatra spaṣṭamuktam ||

ihā gaṃtaṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutaṃ me imaṃ havam | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ || 10 || iha | ā | gatam | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū | śṛṇutam | me | imam | havam | anti | sat | bhut | vām | avaḥ || 10 || he 'vṛṣaṇvasū varṣaṇadhanāvaśvinau 'iha asmin yajñe 'ā gatam āgacchatam | tadarthaṃ 'me 'sama 'imaṃ 'havaṃ 'śṛṇutam || 19 ||

kimidaṃ vāṃ purāṇavajaratoriva śasyate | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ || 11 || kim | idam | vām | purāṇa'vat | jarataḥ'iva | śasyate | anti | sat | bhut | vām | avaḥ || 11 || he aśvinau 'vāṃ yuvayorarthamāgamanaya 'purāṇavat purāṇayorivavṛddhayoriva | tadevā | 'jaratoriva 'śasyate | punaḥpunarāgacchatamiti śasyate | 'kimidam | yathā loke vṛddho jīrṇo bahuvāra- māhūto'pi nāgacchati tadvayuvāmapītyarthaḥ | 'evamanāgamādbravīti ||

samānaṃ vāṃ sajātyaṃ samāno bandhuraśvinā | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ || 12 || samānam | vām | sa'jātyam | samānaḥ | bandhuḥ | aśvinā | anti | sat | bhut | vām | avaḥ || 12 || he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ parasparaṃ 'sajātyaṃ samānajātisvaṃ 'samānam ekameva | ubhayorapyaśvarūpāyāḥ sūryapanyā utpatteḥ sajātyam | tathā yuvayoḥ 'bandhuḥ bandhakaḥ suvaḥ 'samānaḥ eka eva | athavarṣirahaṃ samāna eka eva bandhuḥ ||

yo vāṃ rajāṃsyaśvinā rathau viyāti rodasī | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ ||13|| yaḥ | vām | rajāṃsi | aśvinā | rathaḥ | vi'yāti | rodasī iti | anti | sat | bhut | vām | avaḥ || 13 || 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'yaḥ 'rathaḥ asti sa rathaḥ 'rajāṃsi lokān 'rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ca 'viyāti viśeṣeṇa gacchati | atastena rathena śīghramāgacchatamiti śeṣaḥ ||

ā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrairupa gacchatam | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ ||14|| ā | naḥ | gavyebhiḥ | aśvyaiḥ | sahasraiḥ | upa | gacchatam | anti | sat | bhut | vām | avaḥ || 14 || he aśvinau 'naḥ asmān 'sahasraiḥ aparimitaiḥ 'gavyebhiḥ gosamūhaiḥ 'aśvyaiḥ aśvasamūhaiśca 'upa 'gacchatam ||
mā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrairati ruyatam | anti ṣaḍjūtū vāmavaḥ ||15|| 1. kha-ta-śa-varṣaṇadharmo; ga-vṛṣaṇadhanā'| 2. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-samaṃ | 3. ga-ta-na-bha-śa- 'gavyebhiḥ' nāsti |

mā | naḥ | gavyebhiḥ | aśvyaiḥ | sahasraibhiḥ | ati | hyatam | anti | sat | bhūtu | vām | arbhaḥ || 15 || he aśvinau gavyebhiḥ gosamūhaiḥ aśvyaiḥ aśvasamūhaiḥ sahasrebhiḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakaiḥ mā asmān ati hyatam | atīti pratītyasminnarthe | mā nivārayatamimyarthaḥ || aruṇapspṛśā abhudakajyortirkṛtāvarī | anti ṣaḍbhūtu vāmarvaḥ || 16 || aruṇapspṛśaḥ | upāḥ | abhut | arkeḥ | jyotiḥ | ṛta'varī | anti | sat | bhūtu | vām | arbhaḥ || 16 || he aśvinau uṣāḥ aruṇapspṛḥ śubhravarṇā abhūt bhavati | na kevalaṃ svayam | jyotiḥ tejaḥ akaḥ karoti anti sarvataḥ ṛtāvarī ṛtavyuṣāḥ || aśvinā su vicārkaśadṛkṣaṃ paraśumā~iva | anti ṣaḍbhūtu vāmarvaḥ || 17 || aśvinā | su | vi'cākeśat | vṛkṣam | paraśumān'iva | anti | sat | bhūtu | vām | arbhaḥ || 17 || su vicākeśat atyantaṃ dīpyamānaḥ sūryo'gnivāṃ vṛkṣaṃ paraśumāniva sa yathā śakalayati tadvattamau niśārayatīti śeṣaḥ | dṛṣṭāntasāmarthyādevaṃ labhyate | yasmādevaṃ tasmāt aśvinā aśvinā- vāhya iti śeṣaḥ || puraṃ na dhṛṣṇavā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśa | anti ṣaḍbhūtu vāmarvaḥ || 18 || puram | na | dhṛṣṇo iti | ā | ruja | kṛṣṇayā | bādhitaḥ | viśa | anti | sat | bhūtu | vām | arbhaḥ || 18 || he dhṛṣṇo dharṣaka sasravre tvaṃ kṛṣṇayā ākarṣayā viśa praveśayantyā peṭikayā bādhitaḥ tvaṃ tato nirgatya tāmeva ā ruja pīḍaya aśvinoranugrahāt | evaṃ svayaṃ svātmānaṃ preṣyati | athavā gopavanaḥ sasravremevaṃ bravīti | vāṃ yuvayoḥ avaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ gamanaṃ vā samīpe | tatra triṣu vargeṣu anti pat | ityuttaro'rdharco'nvitapadādhyāhāreṇa yojyaḥ || || 20 || 'viśoviśo vaḥ' iti pañcadaśarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktam | atreyamanukramaṇikā—'viśoviśo vaḥ pañcanāpreyaṃ svanuṣṭumlāstacāścatvāro'nyāstistro'nuṣṭubha ārṣasya śrutavarṇo dānastutiḥ |' iti | anuvattegopavana ṛṣiḥ | āditastriṣu ṛceṣu sarvāḥ prathamā anuṣṭubho dvitīyānutīye prāgvatsapraparibhāṣayā gāyatryau trayodaśyādyāstistro'nuṣṭubhaḥ | asyottarasya cāmirdevatā | anyāstisraḥ śrutavarnāmno rājño dānastutiḥ | vyomaviśvadevastupañcaśāradīyeṣvidaṃ sūktāmyaśastram | sūtritaṃ ca—'viśoviśo vo atithibhityādyam' (āśva. śrau. 9. 8) iti || viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purūpriyam | agniṃ vo duryaṃ varcaḥ stuṣe śuṣasya manmabhiḥ || 1 ||
1. kha-bha-śa-tejaskāḥ | 2. gha-satyavyuṣāḥ | 3. ga-'tvaṃ' nāsti | 4. gha-pīḍaya dṛṣṭataḥ puraṃ na yathā pura śatruḥ pīḍayati tadvat |

viśaḥ'viṃśaḥ | vaḥ | atithim | vāja'yantaḥ | puru'priyam | agnim | vaḥ | duryam | varcaḥ | stuṣe | śuṣasya | manma'bhiḥ || 1 || he anya ṛtvijo yajamānāśca ᵥvaḥ yūyaṃ ᵥvājayantaḥ amicchantaḥ ᵥviśoviśaḥ sarvasyāḥ prajāyāḥ ᵥatithiṃ pūjyaṃ ᵥpurupriyaṃ bahupriyam ᵥagniṃ stutyā paricarateti śeṣaḥ | ahaṃ ca ᵥvaḥ yuṣmadarthaṃ ᵥduryaṃ guhā hitaṃ ᵥvacaḥ ᵥstuṣe ᵥśuṣasya sukasya lābhāya | kaiḥ sādhanaiḥ | ᵥmanmabhiḥ mananīyaiḥ stotraiḥ ||
yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim | praśaṃsanti praśastibhiḥ ||2|| yam | janāsaḥ | haviṣmantaḥ | mitram | na | sarpiḥ'āsutim | pra'śaṃsanti | praśastibhiḥ ||2||

sabādho yaṃ janā ime'gniṃ huṇyemirīḻate | juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ || 6 || su'bādhaḥ | yam | janāḥ | ime | agnim | huṇyebhiḥ | īḻate | juhvānāsaḥ | yataḥ'srucaḥ ||6|| vhame vsabādhaḥ bādhasahitā aśvarvādyaḥ vyam vagniṃ vhṛdyebhiḥ havirbhiḥ vīḻate stuvanti | kīdṛśā janāḥ | vjuhvānāsaḥ yāgaṃ kurvāṇāḥ vyatasrucaḥ tadarthaṃ dhṛtasrugdaṇḍāḥ | tamāganmeti samanvayaḥ ||

iyaṃ te navyasī matiregre adhāyyasmadā | mandra sujātaṃ sukṛto'mūra dasmātithe || 7 || iyam | te | navyasī | matiḥ | agre | adhāyi^1 | asmat | ā | mandra | su'jāta | su'kṛtaḥ iti su'kṛtaḥ | amūra | dasma | atithe || 7 || he vagne viyam idānīṃ kriyamāṇā vnavyasī navatarā stutiḥ vte tava svabhūtā vasmat asmāsu vadhāyi' dhṛtābhūt | vayaṃ tava stutiṃ kurma ityarthaḥ | he vmandra modamāna vsujāta śobhanajanana vsukṛto śobhanakarman vamūra amūḍha vdasma darśanīya vatithe atithivat pūjya ityarthaviśeṣaṇāni ||

sā tai agne śaṃtamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā | tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ || 8 || sā | te | agne | śam'tamā | caniṣṭhā | bhavatu | priyā | tayā | vardhasva | su'stutaḥ || 8 || he vagne vsā asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇā stutiḥ^2 vśaṃtamā atyantaṃ sukhakarā^3 vcaniṣṭhā atiśayenā- jhavatī vte tava vpriyā vbhavatu | vtayā stutyā vsuṣṭutaḥ suṣṭhu stutaḥ san vvardhasva pravṛddho bhava ||

sā yumnyumninī bṛhadupopa śravasi śraveḥ | dadhīta vṛtratūrye || 9 || sā | yumnaiḥ | yumninī | bṛhat | upa'upa | śravasi | śraveḥ | dadhīta | vṛtra'tūrye || 9 || vsā asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇā stutiḥ vyumnaiḥ dyotamānairdhanaiḥ asmabhyaṃ^4 pradeyaiḥ vdyumninī annavatī vśravasi^5 pūrvasmin vidyamāne'nne^6 punarapi vbṛhat mahat vśravaḥ annam vupopa^7 dadhīta punarapari^8 dhārayatu | kutreti ucyate | vvṛtratūrye saṃgrāme | śatroḥ sambandhīti yāvat ||

aśvamidvāṃ rathaprāṃ tveṣamindraṃ na satpatim | yasya śravāṃsi tūrvatha panyaṃ panyaṃ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ || 10 || aśvam | it | gām | ratha'grām | tveṣam | indram | na | sat'patim | yasya | śravāṃsi | tūrvatha | pandyam'pandyam | ca | kṛṣṭayaḥ || 10 || vgāṃ gantāram vaśvamit | icchuda ivārthe | aśvamiva | taṃ yathā stuvate tathetyarthaḥ | vrathaprāṃ rathānāmasmadīyānāṃ pūrayitāraṃ dhanaiḥ tathā vtveṣaṃ dīptamagniṃ vsatpatiṃ satāṃ pālakam vindraṃ vna indramivamaṃ

1. gha-ā adhāyi | 2. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa-'stutiḥ' nāsti | 3. ga-sukhakarī bha-sukhakaro | 4. ta-bha-śa-curasmabhyaṃ | 5. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-astramyaṃ suthravāsi; gha-suśravasi | 6. jha-ta1-2-vidyamānojai; ta3-4-vidyamānoja; jha-avidyamānotra | 7. ta-bha-śa-upa | 8. ga-bha-punarapi |
^yasya agnerbalena ^śravāṃsi ajñāni śatrusaṃbandhīni ^tvaṃvatha tathā ^pamyaṃpamyaṃ ^ca yadyat stutyaṃ dhanamasti tadapi tūrvatha hiṃstha |

yaṃ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭadye aṅgira: | sa pāvaka śrudhī havam || 11 || yam | tvā | gopavana: | girā | caniṣṭat | agne | aṅgira: | sa: | pāvaka | śrudhi | havam || 11 || he ^agne ^yaṃ ^tvā tvāṃ ^gopavana: ^ṛṣi: ^girā stutyā ^caniṣṭat atiśayenānnapradātāra- makarot ^sa: tādṛśāme ^aṅgira: sarvatra gantaraṅgirasāṃ madhya eka vā ^pāvaka śodhaka ^havaṃ gopavanasya ^śrudhi śṛṇu ||

yaṃ tvā janāsa īḻate sabādho vājasātaye | sa bodhi vṛtratūrye || 12 || yam | tvā | janāsa: | īḻate | su'bādha: | vājasātaye | sa: | bodhi | vṛtratūrye || 12 || he agne ^yaṃ ^tvā tvāṃ ^janāsa: janā: stotāro vā ^vājasātaye annasya lābhāya ^sabādha: nirbandha-rūpabādhopetā:^ santaḥ ^īḻate stuvanti ^sa: tvaṃ ^vṛtratūrye vairināśanāya pāpakṣayāya vā ^bodhi budhyasva | athavā vṛtratūrye saṃgrāme bodhi ||

ahaṃ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti | śardhāṃsīva stukāvināṃ mukṣā śīrṣā caturṇām || 13 || aham | huvāna: | ārkṣe | śrutarvaṇi | mada'cyuti | śardhāṃsi'iva | stukā'vinām | mukṣā | śīrṣā | caturṇām || 13 || ^aham ṛṣi: ^huvāna: hūyamāno yajñidakṣārthaṃ ^śrutarvaṇi etannāmni rājani ^madacyuti śatrūṇāṃ madasya cyāvayitari ^stukāvinām | stukāvina ūrṇāvava: | stuka: keśasaṃghāta: | tadtāṃ ^śardhāṃsīva ucchitāni lomānīva tāni yathā spṛśanti tadvat ^vṛkṣā vṛkṣāṇi | vṛśyanta iti vṛkṣā: keśā: | tadvanti vṛkṣāṇi ^śīrṣā^ śīrṣaṇi śirāṃsi | keṣām | ^caturṇāṃ śrutarvaṇā pradattānāmaśvānāṃ śirāṃsyunmajāmīti śeṣa: | athavā vṛkṣā vṛkṣeṇa | aśnasādhanatvādkṣo hasta: | tenonmajāmi^ ||

māṃ catvāra āśava: śarviṣṭhasya draviṇava: | surathāso abhi prayo vakṣanvayo na tubhyam || 14 || mām | catvāra: | āśava: | śarviṣṭhasya | draviṇava: | su'rathāsa: | abhi | praya: | vakṣan | vaya: | na | tubhyam || 14 || ^māṃ ^śaviṣṭhasya atiśayenāśvata: śrutarvaṇo rājña: saṃbandhana: ^catvāra: ^āśava: aśvā: ^draviṇava: gamanaśīlā: ^surathāsa: śobhanarathā aśvā: ^praya: ahaṃ śatrūṇāṃ prati ^abhi ^vakṣan abhivahanti | ^vayo^ ^na ^tubhyam^ | bhujyuṃ yathāśvābhyāṃ preritāśvatastro nāva: svagṛhaṃ prāpayan tadvaditi ||
5. kha- ta1-2-na-turbhyaṃ; ga-tu ubhyaṃ; gha-tubhyaṃ na; ta3-4-tuma; bha-ugra; jha-śa-tubhyaṃ |
satyam | it | tvā | mahe'nadi | paruṣṇi | arvā | dediśam | na | īm | āpaḥ | aśva'dātaraḥ | śarviṣṭhāt | asti | martyaiḥ || 15 ||
he 'mahenadi' 'paruṣṇi etannāmike 'tvā tvāṃ 'satyamit satyameva 'ava 'dediśam ādiśāmi vadāmi |
he 'āpaḥ 'īm asmāt 'śaviṣṭhāt balavattamācchu- tarvaṇo'dhikaḥ 2 kaścit 'aśvadātaraḥ aśvānāṃ dātṛttamaḥ 'martyaḥ 'na 'asti |
'yuktvā hi' iti ṣoḍaśarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya virūpasyārṣaṃ gāyatramābheyam |

ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspateḥ | mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām || 4 || ayam | agniḥ | sahasrinaḥ | vājasya | śatinaḥ | patiḥ | mūrdhā | kaviḥ | rayīṇām ||4|| `va`ayamagniḥ `va`śatinaḥ `va`sahasrinaḥ: coktasaṃkhyopetasya `va`vājasya annasya `va`patiḥ svāmī `va`mūrdhā śirovadunnata: śreṣṭha: `va`kaviḥ medhāvī `va`rayīṇāṃ dhanānāmapi patiriti śeṣaḥ | tadubhayaṃ prayacchatvityarthaḥ ||

taṃ nemimṛbhavau yathā namasva sahūtibhiḥ | nedīyo yajñamaṅgiraḥ || 5 || tam | nemim | ṛbhavaḥ | yathā | ā | namasva | sahūti'bhiḥ | nedīyaḥ | yajñam | aṅgiraḥ ||5|| he `va`aṅgiraḥ tvaṃ `va`sahūtibhiḥ samānāhvānairanyairdevaiḥ saha `va`nedīyaḥ antikatamaṃ `va`yajñam `va`ā `va`namasva `va`ānamaya | `va`ṛbhavaḥ `va`nemiṃ rathamiva || || 24 ||

tasmai nūnamabhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā | vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim || 6 || tasmai | nūnam | abhi'dyave | vācā | vi'rūpa | nityayā | vṛṣṇe | codasva | su'stutim ||6|| he `va`virūpa nānārūpaitannāmaka maharṣe tvaṃ `tasmai` prasiddhāya `va`abhidyave abhigatadīsaye `va`vṛṣṇe varṣakāyāgnaye `va`nityayā utpattirahitayā `va`vācā mantrarūpayā `va`suṣṭutiṃ `va`nūnam idānīṃ `va`codasva stuhītyevamṛṣiḥ svātmānaṃ bravīti yajamāno vā hotāraṃ virūpam ||

kaṣu ṣvidasya sernayāgnerapākacakṣasaḥ | paṇi goṣu starāmahe || 7 || kam | ū~ iti | svit | asya | sernayā | agneḥ | apāka'cakṣasaḥ | paṇim | goṣu | starāmahe || 7 || `va`asya `va`agneḥ `va`apākacakṣasaḥ analpacakṣaso'gneḥ `va`senayā jvālārūpayā `va`goṣu nimitteṣu `va`kamu `va`ṣvit kaṃ `khalu` `va`paṇiṃ `va`starāmahe | staraṇaṃ `va`hisanam | idānīṃ balinamabhibhavetyarthaḥ ||

mā nau devānāṃ viśaḥ prasnātīrvostrāḥ | kṛśaṃ na hāsuryāḥ || 8 || mā | naḥ | devānām | viśaḥ | prasnātīḥ'iva | ustrāḥ | kṛśam | na | hāsuḥ | aghnyāḥ ||8|| `va`devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ `va`viśaḥ prajābhūtān paricārakān `va`naḥ asmān `va`mā hāsīt abhirmā parityajatu | `va`prasnātīḥ `va`ustrāḥ `va`iva payaḥ kṣarantīrgāv iva | tā yathā na muñcanti | ubhayamapi na parityajatvityarthaḥ | kimiba | `va`kṛśam alpaṃ svavatsam `va`aghnyāḥ gāvau yathā `va`na `va`hāsuḥ na parityajanti tadvat ||
mā naḥ samasya dudhyaiḥ paridveṣo aṃhutiḥ | ūrmine nāvamā vadhīt || 9 || mā | naḥ | samasya | duḥ'dhyaiḥ | pari'dveṣaḥ | aṃhutiḥ | ūrmiḥ | na | nāvam | ā | vadhīt ||9||
4. kha-staraṇiṃsaka; ga-staraṇīṃ hiṃsanaṃ; jha-ta3-staraṇi hiṃsaka; ta4-na-bha-śa-staraṇaṃ hiṃsakaṃ |

namaste agne orjase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ | amairamitramardaya || 10 || namaḥ | te | agne | orjase | gṛṇanti | deva | kṛṣṭayaḥ | amaiḥ | amitram | ardaya || 10 || he 'agne 'deva 'te tubhyaṃ 'namaḥ 'gṛṇanti namaskāraśabdamuccārayanti | kimartham | 'orjase balāya | ke | 'kṛṣṭayaḥ manuṣyā yajamānāḥ | ato'hamapi gṛṇāmītyarthaḥ | tathā 'amaiḥ balaiḥ 'amitraṃ śatrum 'ardaya nāśaya || || 25 || grāmyeṇābhinā vaitānikasya saṃsarge'gnaye saṃvargāyeṣṭiḥ kāryā | tatra 'kuvitsu naḥ' ityanuvākyā 'mā no asmin' iti yājyā | sūtritaṃ ca—'kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye mā no asminmahādhane' (ādha. śrau. 3. 13) iti ||

kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim | urukṛdu ru ṇaskṛdhi || 11 || kuvit | su | naḥ | go'iṣṭaye | agne | sam'veṣiṣaḥ | rayim | uru'kṛt | uru | naḥ | kṛdhi || 11 || he 'agne tvaṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'gaviṣṭaye gavāmeṣaṇāya 'kuvit bahu 'rayiṃ dhanaṃ 'saṃveṣiṣaḥ saṃprāpaya | 'urukṛt tvaṃ 'naḥ asmān 'uru 'kṛdhi kuru ||

mā nau asminmahādhane parā varbhārabhṛdyathā | saṃvargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya || 12 || mā | naḥ | asmin | mahā'dhane | parā | vark | bhāra'bhṛt | yathā | sam'vargam | sam | rayim | jaya || 12 || 'naḥ asmān 'asmin 'mahādhane saṃgrāme 'mā 'parā 'vark mā parityākṣīḥ | 'bhārabhṛdyathā | bhāravāhī yathā bhāramante parityajati tadvat | 'saṃvargaṃ śatrubhyaḥ sahācchadyamānaṃ 'rayiṃ dhanaṃ 'saṃ 'jaya asmadartham ||

anyamasmaddviyā iyamagne siṣaktu ducchunā | vardhī no amavacchavaḥ || 13 || anyam | asmat | dviyāḥ | iyam | agne | siṣaktu | ducchunā | vardhī | naḥ | ama'vat | śavaḥ || 13 || he 'agne tvadīyā 'iyaṃ 'ducchunā bādhakasaṃhatiḥ 'asmat 'anyam astotāraṃ 'dviyāḥ bhayāya 'siṣaktu sevatām | tvaṃ ca 'naḥ asmākam 'amavat balopetaṃ 'śavaḥ vegaṃ 'vardha vardhaya saṃgrāme ||

yasyājuṣanmasvinḥ śamīmadurmakhasya vā | taṃ ghedabhirdhudhāvati || 14 || yasya | ajuṣan | namaḥ'svinaḥ | śamīm | adaḥ'makhasya | vā | tam | gha | it | agniḥ | vṛdhā | avati || 14 || 'yasya 'namasvinaḥ namaskāravataḥ 'adurmakhasya 'vā adṛṣṭayāgasya vā 'śamīṃ karma 'ajuṣan asevata 'taṃ 'ghet tameva yajamānaṃ saṃgrāme 'abhirdhudhāvati viśeṣeṇa gacchati | ato namoyuktā adurmakhāśca bhavāmeti bhāvaḥ ||

vibhrā hi tai purā vayamagnai pituryathāvasaḥ | ardhā te sumnamīmahe || 16 || vibhra | hi | te | purā | vayam | agne | pituḥ | yathā | avasaḥ | ardha | te | sumnam | īmahe || 16 || he ᵥagne ᵥpituḥ pālakasya ᵥte tava ᵥavasaḥ avo rakṣaṇaṃ ᵥpurā ᵥyathā tathedānīmapīti ᵥvibhra | ᵥadha3 tat ᵥte2 tava ᵥsumnaṃ sukham ᵥīmahe yācāmahe | athavā pituryatheti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | pituḥ pālanaṃ putro yathā vetti tathetyarthaḥ || || 26 ||
‘imaṃ nu māthinam’ iti dvādaśarcaṃ saptamaṃ sūktam |
tathā cānukāntam—‘imaṃ nu dvādaśa kurusutiḥ kāṇvaḥ ’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘imaṃ nu māthinaṃ huve lyamu vaḥ satrāsāham ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 8 ) iti ||

imaṃ nu māthinaṃ huve indramīśānamojasā | marutvantaṃ na vṛtraseṃ || 1 || imam | nu | māthinam | huve | indram | īśānam | ojasā | marutvantam | na | vṛtraseṃ || 1 || ᵥimaṃ ᵥmāthinaṃ prajñāvantam ᵥojasā svabalena ᵥīśānaṃ sarvasya svāminaṃ ᵥmarutvantaṃ ᵥna | neti saṃpratyarthe | marudbhistadantamidānīm ᵥindraṃ ᵥvṛtrase śatrūṇāṃ chedanāya ᵥhuve āhvayāmi ||

ayamindro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ | vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || 2 || ayam | indraḥ | | marut'sakhā | vi | vṛtrasya | abhinat | śiraḥ | vajreṇa | śata'parvaṇā ||2|| ᵥayamindro4 ᵥmarutsakhā marudyuphaḥ ᵥvṛtrasya ᵥvi ᵥabhinat vyacchinat ᵥśiraḥ ᵥvajreṇa ᵥśataparvaṇā śatasaṃdhinā4 ||

vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtramairayat | sṛjansamudriyā apaḥ || 3 || vavṛdhānaḥ | marut'sakhā | indraḥ | | vi | vṛtram | airayat | sṛjan | samudriyāḥ | apaḥ || 3 || ayam ᵥindraḥ ᵥvāvṛdhānaḥ vardhamānaḥ ᵥmarutsakhā marutsahāyaḥ ᵥvṛtraṃ meghaṃ ᵥvi ᵥairayat vidārita- vān | kiṃ kurvan | ᵥsamudriyāḥ | samudramantarikṣam | tatsambandhinyaḥ ᵥapaḥ ᵥsṛjan ||

sūtritaṃ ca—'ayaṃ ha yena vā idamupa no haribhiḥ sutam' (āśva. śrau. 8. 8) iti ||

ayaṃ ha yena vā idaṃ sarvaṃmarutvatā jitam | indreṇa somapītaye || 4 || ayam | ha | yena | vai | idam | svaḥ | marutvatā | jitam | indreṇa | soma'pītaye || 4 || 'ayaṃ ha' khalvinadraḥ 'yena vai yena khalu 'marutvatā marudbhiyuktena 'indreṇa 'idaṃ 'svaḥ svargākhyaṃ sthānamidaṃ svaḥ sarvaṃ karma vā yadedaṃ sarvaṃ jagat 'jitam | kimartham | 'somapītaye somapānāya ||

marutvantamṛjīṣiṇamojasvantaṃ virāpśinam | indraṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe || 5 || marutvantam | ṛjīṣiṇam | ojasvantam | vi'rāpśinam | indram | gīḥ'bhiḥ | havāmahe ||5|| 'marutvantaṃ marudbhirudvantam 'ṛjīṣiṇam | abhipūtaśeṣa ṛjīpaḥ | sa ca tṛtīyasavane punaḥ sūyate | tadvantam 'ojasvantam | ojo nāmāṣṭamī daśā | śarīravṛddhayupetamityarthaḥ | 'virāpśinam | mahannāmaitat | mahāntamevamahānubhāvam 'indraṃ 'gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ 'havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ ||

indraṃ pratnena manmanā marutvantaṃ havāmahe | asya somasya pītaye || 6 || indram | pratnena | manmanā | marutvantam | havāmahe | asya | somasya | pītaye || 6 || 'marutvantaṃ 'indraṃ 'pratnena purāṇena 'manmanā mananīyena stotreṇa 'havāmahe 'asya 'somasya 'pītaye pānāya ||
pañcame'hani marutvatīye 'marutvaॉ indra mīḍhvaḥ' iti tṛco nividdhānīyāḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'marutvaॉ indra mīḍhvastamindraṃ vājayāmasi' (āśva. śrau. 8. 8) iti ||

marutvaॉ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṃ śatakrato | asmin‌yajñe puruṣṭuta || 7 || marutvān | indra | mīḍhvaḥ | piba | somam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | asmin | yajñe | puru'stuta || 7 || ha 'mīḍhvaḥ phalasya vṛṣṭervā saṃktaḥ 'śatakrato bahukarman 'indra 'tvaṃ 'marutvān 'somaṃ 'piba 'asmin 'yajñe he 'puruṣṭuta bahubhirāhūta ||

tubhyedindra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ | hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ || 8 || tubhyam | it | indra | marutvate | sutāḥ | somāsaḥ | adri'vaḥ | hṛdā | hūyante | ukthinaḥ ||8|| he 'adrivaḥ vajravan 'indra 'marutvate 'tubhyeta tubhyameva 'somāsaḥ 'sutāḥ abhiṣutāḥ | te ca 'ukthinaḥ śaśvantaḥ 'hṛdā' manasā bhaktyā 'hūyante tvadartham ||

ā no bhara vyañjanaṃ gāmaśvamabhyañjanam | sacā manā hiraṇyayā || 2 || ā | naḥ | bhara | vi'añjanam | gām | aśvam | abhi'añjanam | sacā | manā | hiraṇyayā ||2||

uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā puruṇi dhṛṣṇavā bhara | tvaṃ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso || 3 || uta | naḥ | karṇa'śobhanā | puruṇi | dhṛṣṇo iti | ā | bhara | tvam | hi | śṛṇviṣe | vaso iti || 3 ||

ayaṃ krunturgṛbhīto viśvajidudbhidatsomaḥ | ṛṣirvipraḥ kāṇvena || 1 || ayam | kruntuḥ | argṛbhītaḥ | viśva'jit | ut'bhid | ita | somaḥ | ṛṣiḥ | vipraḥ | kāṇvena || 1 ||

nahanyaṃ balākaraṃ marḍitāraṃ śatakrato| tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya || 1 || nahi| anyam| balā| akaram| marḍitāram| śatakrato iti śata'krato| tvam| na:| indra| mṛḻaya || 1 || he 'śatakrato 'vatta: 'anyaṃ 'marḍitāraṃ sukhayitāraṃ 'balā bad satyaṃ 'na 'akaraṃ na karomi| tasmāddhe 'indra 'tvaṃ 'na: asmān 'mṛḻaya ||

yo na: śaśvatpurāvithāmdho vājasātaye| sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya || 2 || ya:| na:| śaśvat| purā| āvitha| amṛdha:| vāja'sātaye| sa:| tvam| na:| indra| mṛḻaya || 2 || 'ya: 'amṛdha: ahiṃsaka: 'na: asmān 'vājasātaye annalābhāya 'purā pūrvam 'āvitha rakṣitavān| he 'indra 'sa 'tvaṃ 'na: asmān 'śaśvat madā 'mṛḻaya sukhaya' ||

kimuṅ radhracodana: sunvānasyāvitedasi| kuvitsvindra ṇa: śarka: || 3 || kim| aṅga| radhra'codana:| sunvānasya| avitā| ita| asi| kuvit| su| indra| na:| śarka: || 3 || he 'indra tvaṃ 'radhracodana:| radhraṃ rādhakaṃ codayatīti radhracodana:| tādṛśastvaṃ 'sunvānasya 'avitedasi rakṣaka eva bhavasi| ata: 'na: asmākaṃ 'kuvit bahu 'su su 'śaka: aśaka: śakko bhava'| bahu dhanaṃ kurvityartha:| asmān vā bahu kurviti ||

indrḙ | pra | na̭ḥ | ra॒tham | a॒va | pa॒ścāt | ci॒t | sa॒ntam | a॒dri॒'va̭ḥ | pu॒ra॒stā̭t | e॒nam | me॒ | kṛ॒dhi॒ || 4 || he <sup>v</sup>indra <sup>v</sup>naḥ <sup>v</sup>rathaṃ <sup>v</sup>pra <sup>v</sup>ava rakṣa | kīdṛśaṃ ratham | <sup>v</sup>paścāccitsantam | cidapyarthe | asmatsānarathānāṃ paścādbhūtampi <sup>v</sup>enaṃ <sup>v</sup>me rathaṃ he <sup>v</sup>adrivaḥ vajravannindra <sup>v</sup>purastāt vartamānāṃ <sup>v</sup>kṛdhi kuru ||

indra dṛhasva pūrasi bhadrā taṃ eti niṣkṛtam | iyaṃ dhīrṛtviyāvatī || 7 || indrḙ | dṛ॒ha॒sva | pṷ̄ḥ | a॒si॒ | bha॒drā | te॒ | e॒ti॒ | ni॒ḥ'kṛta̭m | i॒yam | dhī̭ḥ | ṛ॒tviya̭'vatī ||7|| he <sup>v</sup>indra tvaṃ <sup>v</sup>dṛhasva dṛḍho bhava saṃgrāme | tvaṃ <sup>v</sup>pūrasi puramasi | yathā puramavicalitaṃ tadvadbhavasi | athavā | asmadīye yajñe dṛḍho bhava | tvaṃ punaranyayajñajigamiṣurmā bhūḥ | tvaṃ pūḥ pūrakaḥ kāmānāmāsi | kimatra vidhata iti ceducyate | <sup>v</sup>niṣkṛtaṃ niṣkṛtāraṃ <sup>v</sup>te tvāṃ <sup>v</sup>bhadrā kalyāṇī <sup>v</sup>iyaṃ <sup>v</sup>dhīḥ stutiḥ kriyā vā <sup>v</sup>ṛtviyāvatī | ṛtuśabdaḥ kālopalakṣakaḥ | svakālopetā satī <sup>v</sup>eti gacchati | yadvā | te niṣkṛtaṃ sthānameti ||

mā sīmavṛdha ā bhāgurvī kāṣṭhā hitaṃ dhanam | apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ || 8 || mā | sī̭m | a॒vṛ॒dhe | ā | bhā॒k | u॒rvī | kā॒ṣṭhā | hi॒tam | dhana̭m | a॒pa | a॒vṛ॒ktāḥ | a॒ra॒tnaya̭ḥ ||8|| <sup>v</sup>mā <sup>v</sup>asmān <sup>v</sup>sīṃ sarvataḥ <sup>v</sup>avadhaḥ nindā <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>bhāk mābhajatu | prāpnotu na kutaścit | pāparahitān kurvityarthaḥ | kiṃca <sup>v</sup>urvī <sup>v</sup>kāṣṭhā bahvantarālamājyantaḥ | 'ājyanto'pi kāṣṭhocyate kāntvā sthitā bhavati' (niha. 2. 15) iti yāskaḥ | tatra <sup>v</sup>hitaṃ nihitaṃ śatrusambandhi <sup>v</sup>dhanam asmākaṃ bhavasthityarthaḥ | <sup>v</sup>aratnayaḥ aramamāṇāḥ śatravaḥ <sup>v</sup>apāvṛktāḥ <sup>v</sup>santviti śeṣaḥ ||

1. ga-he indra; gha-haṃto he iṃdra | 2. kha-ga-ta-śa-cet | 3 gha-vājayuḥ .... <sup>0</sup>micchan | 4. na-bha-taismādasmān | 5. gha-jetṛnsmān kṛdhi | 6. kha-ta-tasmāt | 7. kha-ta-bha-śa-bhavaṃti | 8. kha-apāvṛttāḥ; jha-ta3-4-ma-apāvṛttāḥ |
turīyaṃ nāme yajñiyaṃ yadā karastaduśmasi | ādityapartina ohase || 9 || turīyam | nāma | yajñiyam | yadā | karaḥ | tat | uśmasi | āt | ita | patiḥ | naḥ | ohase ||9||
he indra tvaṃ yajñiyaṃ yajñasambandhi turīyaṃ caturtha nāma yadā karaḥ karoṣi taduśmasi kāmayāmahe |
āditya anantarameva nāmakāmānantarameva patiḥ pālakastvaṃ naḥ asmān ohase vahasi prāpayasi |
nakṣatranāma guhyaṃ nāma prakāśaṃ nāmeti trīṇi nāmāni somayājīti turīyaṃ nāma tacca yajñiyam ||

avīvṛdhadhra amṛtā amandīkṛgṛdevā uta yāśca devīḥ | tasmā u rārdhaḥ kṛṇutaḥ praśastaṃ prātamakṣu dhiyāvasurjagamyāt || 10 || avīvṛdhat | vaḥ | amṛtāḥ | amandīt | eka'dhuḥ | devāḥ | una | yāḥ | ca | devīḥ | tasmai | ū~ iti | rārdhaḥ | kṛṇutaḥ | pra'śastam | prātaḥ | makṣu | dhiyā'vasuḥ | jagamyāt ||10||
he devāḥ he amṛtāḥ amaraṇaḥ vaḥ yuṣmānyam avīvṛdhat vardhayati stutyā amandīt tarpayati somena ekadhuḥ ṛṣiraham |
uta api ca he devīḥ devyo devapatnyaḥ yāśca yūyaṃ stha yuṣmānyavīvṛdhadandīcca |
tasmai rādhaḥ dhanaṃ praśastaṃ pravṛddhaṃ kṛṇutaḥ kuruta |
prātaḥ prātareva makṣu kṣipraṃ dhiyāvasuḥ karmadhana indraḥ jagamyāt āgacchatu |
tatra 'ā tū na indra' iti navarcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ kaṇvaputrasya kusīdina ārṣaṃ gāyatramaindram |
tathā cānukramyate—'ā tū na nava kusīdī kāṇvaḥ' iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ ca śaunakena—'ā tū na indra dyumantamiti sūkte sūddohāḥ' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 3) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā tū na indra dyumantamā pra drava parāvataḥ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
ā tū na indra dyumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya | mahāhastī dakṣiṇena || 1 || ā | tū | naḥ | indra | kṣu'mantam | citram | grābham | mam | gṛbhāya | mahā'hastī | dakṣiṇena ||1||
he indra mahāhastī mahāhastavān tvaṃ tu tadānīmeva naḥ asmabhyaṃ dātuṃ dyumantaṃ śabdavantam |
citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ grābhaṃ grāhakaṃ grahaṇārhaṃ vā dhanaṃ dakṣiṇena hastena ā saṃ gṛbhāya ābhimukhyena saṃgṛhāṇa ||
vibhrā hi tvā tuvikūrmi tuvideṣṇaṃ tuvimagham | tuvimātramavaubhiḥ || 2 || vibhrā | hi | tvā | tuvi'kūrmim | tuvi'deṣṇam | tuvi'magham | tuvi'mātram | avaḥ'bhiḥ ||2||
he indra tvā tvāṃ hi jānīmaḥ khalu |
tuvikūrmi bahukarmāṇaṃ tuvideṣṇaṃ bahupradeyaṃ tuvimaghaṃ bahudhanaṃ tuvimātraṃ bahupramāṇam avobhiḥ yuktam ||
nuhi tvā śūra devā na martīso ditsantam |
1. kha-gha-ta-na-bha-śa-yajñasaṃbandhinaṃ | 2. ta-na-śa-somenaikaḥ; bha-māsenaikaḥ | 3. kha-ta-na-bha-śa-'tve tu' nāsti | 4. bha-stutami0 | 5. kha-na-tuvīmaghaṃ | ka. 3-56
nahi | tvā | śūra | devāḥ | na | martāsaḥ | ditsantam | bhīmam | na | gām | vārayante ||3||
he śūra indra tvā tvāṃ ditsantaṃ dātumicchantaṃ devāḥ na nahi vārayante na nivārayanti |
tathā martāsaḥ martyā api na vārayante |
bhīmaṃ na gāṃ bhayajanakaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yavase pravṛttamiva |
taṃ yathā vārayituṃ na śaknuvanti tadvat ||
tathā ca sūtritam—'eto nvindraṃ stavāmeśānaṃ mā no asminmaghavan' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
eto iti | nu | indram | stavāma | īśānam | vasvaḥ | svārājam | na | rādhasā | madhiṣmaḥ | naḥ || 4 ||
he asmadīyā janāḥ eto āgacchataiva nu kṣipram |
vasvaḥ vasunaḥ dhanasya īśānaṃ svāminaṃ svārājaṃ svayameva rājamānaṃ svarge rājamānaṃ vā |
naḥ asmān indreṇānugṛhītān rādhasā dhanenānyo dhanī na madhiṣmat na bādhatām |
pra stauṣdurpa gāsiṣcchravatsāmaṃ gīyamānam | abhi rādhasā jugurat ||5|| pra | stauṣt | urpa | gāsiṣt | śravat | sāmaṃ | gīyamānam | abhi | rādhasā | jugurat ||5||
prastutvā ca gāsiṣt upagānaṃ ca karotu |
tadarthaṃ gīyamānaṃ sāma stotraṃ śravat śṛṇotu |
rādhasā dhanena ca yukto'smān abhi jugurat abhigṛṇātu svīkurviti ||
ā nau bhara dakṣiṇenābhi savyena pra mṛśa | indra mā no vasonarbhīk ||6|| ā | naḥ | bhara | dakṣiṇena | abhi | savyena | pra | mṛśa | indraṃ | mā | naḥ | vasoḥ | niḥ | bhāk ||6||
he indra naḥ asmabhyam ā bhara |
āhṛtya dakṣiṇena savyena ca hastenobhābhyāṃ hastābhyām abhi pra mṛśa |
naḥ asmān vasoḥ dhanāt mā mā nirbhāk mā nirbhākṣīḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā tadasmai nabhyam' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||
urpa kramustva bhera dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām | adāśūstarasya vedaḥ ||7|| urpa | kramusva | ā | bhara | dhṛṣatā | dhṛṣṇo iti | janānām | adāśūḥ | tarasya | vedaḥ || 7 ||
ga-pustake'sya mantrasya ābhyamevaṃ vidyate-sotā indraṃ prastotṛ |
rādhasā dhanena prasādhanena vā yukto'smānbhijuguradabhigṛṇātu svīkurviti |
he indra tvam upa kramasva dhanaṃ pratyupagaccha |
he dhṛṣṇo dharṣaka śatrūṇāṃ dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṭena cetasā yuktaḥ san ā bhara āhara ca |
janānāṃ madhye adāśūarasya atyantamādātṛmasya vedaḥ dhanam ||
indra ya u nu te asti vājo vipraibhiḥ sarnitvaḥ |
indra | yaḥ | ū~ iti | nu | te | asti | vājaḥ | vipraibhiḥ | sarnitvaḥ | asmābhiḥ | su | tam | sanuhi || 8 ||
he indra yaḥ vājaḥ ahaṃ vipraibhiḥ medhāvibhiḥ sarnitvaḥ saṃbhajanīyaḥ te tava asti taṃ vājam asmābhiḥ yācitaḥ san asmabhyaṃ vā su suṣṭhu sanuhi dehi ||
sadyaḥ'juvaḥ | te | vājāḥ | asmabhyam | viśva'candrāḥ | vaśaiḥ | ca | makṣu | jarante || 9 ||
he indra te tava vājāḥ asmabhyaṃ sadyojuvaḥ śīghraṃ gantāro bhavantu |
asmadīyāśca janāḥ vaśaiḥ kāmairanekairyuktāḥ makṣu śīghraṃ jarante stuvanti ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśa ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye ṣaṣṭhāṣṭake pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
‘ā pra drava’ iti navacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktam |
ṛpistrā- nyasmāt’ iti paribhāṣāyā kāṇvaḥ kusīdhṛṣiḥ |
dvitīye rātriparyāye maitrāvaruṇaśastre ‘ā pra drava’ iti tṛco'jurūpaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā pra drava parāvato nahyaṃ baḻākaramityaṣṭau’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
ā | pra | drava | parāvataḥ | arvā'vataḥ | ca | vṛtra'han | maghavan | prati | pra'bharmaṇi || 1 ||
he vṛtrahan apāmāvarakasya vṛtrāsurasya hantarhe indra prabharmaṇi |
prakṛṣṭāni bharmāṇi bharaṇāni paśugrahādisaṃpādānāni yasmin sa prabharmā yajñaḥ |
prakṛṣṭāḥ karmaṇi kuśalā bharmāṇo devānāṃ haviṣpradānena poṣakā ṛtvijo yasminniti sa tathoktaḥ |
etādṛśe yajñe maghavan madakarān somān prati parāvataḥ viprakṛṣṭāt dūrasthādeśādapi arvāvataśca samīpasthādeśādapi ābhimukhyena pra drava tvaṃ tvarayāgaccha |
tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāsau mādayiṣṇavaḥ | pibā dudhryathauciṣe || 2 || tīvrāḥ | somāsaḥ | ā | gahi | sutāsaḥ | mādayiṣṇavaḥ | piba | dudhry | yathā | ociṣe ||2||
tvaṃ ॰yathā ॰dudhry dhṛṣṭatprītau pragalbhaḥ saṃstān ॰ūciṣe' samavaiṣi sevase |
dudhryiti 'dhṛṣṭyā prāgalbhye' ityasmāt 'ṛtvigdadhṛk' ityādinā kinpratyayānto nipātyate |
indra śrudhi su me hava̭masme sutasya॒ goma̭taḥ | vi pītiṃ tṛ॒tima̭śruhi || 6 || indra̭ | śrudhi | su | me | hava̭m | asme iti̭ | sutasya̭ | go'ma̭taḥ | vi | pīti̭m | tṛ॒tim | a॒śruhi || 6 ||
he indra me madīyaṃ havaṃ tvadviṣayamāhvānaṃ su suṣṭhu śrudhi śṛṇu |
tathā asme asmābhiḥ sutasya abhiṣutasya gomataḥ gavyakṣīravataḥ |
tādṛśasya somasya pītiṃ pānaṃ vi aśruhi vividhaṃ prāpnuhi |
tṛtīye paryāya evācchāvākaśastre ‘ya indra camaseṣu’ iti tṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ya indra cama- seṣvā somaḥ pra vaḥ satām’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti
‘devānām’ iti navarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ kāṇvasya kusīdina ārṣaṃ gāyatraṃ vaiśvadevam|
sūtritaṃ ca-‘devānāmidava iti vaiśvadevam’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 10) iti|

devānāmidavau mahattadā vṛṇīmahe vayam| vṛṣṇāmasmabhyamūtayai|| 1|| devānām| ita| arvā:| mahat| tat| ā| vṛṇīmahe| vayam| vṛṣṇām| asmabhyam| ūtayai||1|| he devā:| vdevānāṃ svatejasā sarvato dīpyamānānām| vit evārthe| yuṣmākameva vmahat vyāptaṃ mahanīyaṃ vā vava: pālanaṃ yadvidyate tat vvṛṣṇāṃ kāmānāṃ varṣitṝṇāṃ yuṣmākaṃ svabhūtaṃ vtat rakṣaṇaṃ yajamānā: vvayam vā vvṛṇīmahe samantātsambhajāmahe| kimartham| vasmabhyamūtaye| pūrvamasmabhya- masmadarthamiti sādhāraṇyenoktvā tadviśinaṣṭi ūtaya iti| asmākaṃ pālanāyeti||

te na: santu yuja: sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā| vṛdhāsaśca pracetasa:||2|| te| na:| santu| yuja:| sadā| varuṇa:| mitra:| aryamā| vṛdhāsa:| ca| praḍcetasa:||2|| vte devā: vvaruṇa: śatrūṇāṃ nivāraka: vmitra: sarveṣāṃ mitrabhūta: varyamā satataṃ gacchan eta- nnāmakāste trayo devā: vsadā sarvadā sarveṣu kāleṣu vna: asmākaṃ vyuja: sahāyā: vsantu bhavantu| agnihotrādikarmaṇi indrādidevā: sahagamanādijñapparisamāpanānteṣu sāhāyyaṃ kurvantvityartha:| tata: vpracetasa: prakṛṣṭajñānā:| yadvā| ceta: stotram| śobhanastutaya:|’ te devā: vvṛdhāsa: vardhakā: vca asmākaṃ dhanādidānena vardhayitāraśca santu||

atiṃ no viṣpitā puru naubhirapo n parṣatha| yūyamṛtasya rathya:||3|| atiṃ| na:| viṣpitā| puru| naubhi:| apa:| na| parṣatha| yūyam| ṛtasya| rathya:||3|| vṛtasya satyasya yajñasya vā he vrathya: netāro devā:| yadvā| ṛtasyeti sambandha--- tvātkāṃkṣipyate| yajñasya sādhakā he rathyo rathavanto devā: vviṣpitā viṣpitāni viprāsāni vita- tāni vpuru| supoluka| puruṇi bahūni śatrubalāni karmāṇi vā vna: asmān vati vparṣatha pāraṃ samāptiṃ rakṣarṇairamayatav| tatra dṛṣṭānta:v| vnaubhirapo vna| yathā nāvikoḍapa udakāni naubhirnāṃ- stīraṃ prati prāpayati tadvat||

vāmaṃ nau astavaryamanvāmaṃ varuṇa śaṃsam| vāmaṃ hyavaṇīmahe||4|| vāmam| na:| astu| aryaman| vāmam| varuṇa| śaṃsam| vāmam| hi| ā'vaṇīmahe||4|| he varyaman deva vvāmaṃ vananīyaṃ saṃbhajanīyaṃ dhanaṃ vna: asmākam vastu bhavatu| he vvaruṇa vśaṃsyaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃsanīyaṃ stutyaṃ vvāmaṃ dhanamasmākamastu| kuta:| vhi| hiśabdo hetau| yasmātkāraṇādarthyaṃ vvāmaṃ dhanaṃ yuṣmān vāvaṇīmahe yācāmaha ityartha:| tasmātno'stvityāśāste||
vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāso riṣādasa:| nemādityā aghasya yat||5||
3. kha-jña-ta1-2-bha-ya-balāni cet teṣāṃ (‘balāni ..teṣāṃ’ nāsti-bha1) vadhena atīya gamayata (gameyata-jña-ta1-2-bha) karmāṇi cet nosmadīyāni karmāṇi pāraṃ samāptiṃ rakṣaṇairga- bhayata|
vāmasya | hi | pra'cetasaḥ | īśānāsaḥ | riśādasaḥ | na | īm | ādityāḥ | aghasya | yat ||5||
he pracetasaḥ prakṛṣṭajñānāḥ śobhanastutayo vā he riśādasaḥ riśatāṃ hiṃsatāṃ śatrūṇāmasitāraḥ kṣesāro devā yūyaṃ vāmasya vananīyasya dhanasya īśānāsaḥ īśānāḥ |
tato he ādityāḥ aditaḥ putrā devāḥ īm enaṃ yācamānaṃ māṃ taddhanaṃ na prāpnotu yat dhanam aghasya pāpasya saṃbandhvi vidyate ||

vyam | it | vaḥ | sudānavaḥ | kṣiyantaḥ | yāntaḥ | adhvan | ā | devāḥ | vṛdhāya | humahe ||6|| he sudānavaḥ śobhanadānā he devāḥ kṣiyantaḥ gṛheṣvabhirothārthaṃ nivasantaḥ adhvan | supa luk | adhvani samidāharaṇārthaṃ yāntaḥ gacchanto'pi vayaṃ vaḥ it yuṣmāneva vṛdhāya havirbhirvardha- nāya humahe āhūyāmaḥ | yadvā | vayaṃ gṛheṣu gṛhābhirgamanakāle mārgeṣu ca vṛdhāyāsmākaṃ dhanādi- bhivardhanāyāhvayāmaḥ ||

adhi | naḥ | indra | eṣām | viṣṇo iti | sajātyānām | ita | marutaḥ | aśvinā || 7 || he indra viṣṇo marutaḥ he aśvinā aśvinau he indrādayo devāḥ sajātyānām | samānāyāṃ jātau bhavāḥ sajātyā bhrātṛmitrādayaḥ | teṣām eṣāṃ madhye naḥ asmān adhi ita yūyaṃ stutya- tayādhigacchata ||
he sudānavaḥ śobhanadānā ādityāḥ adha atha asmattyāgamananānantaraṃ vayaṃ samānyā sāmānyena |
pūrvaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sāṃhatyena tataḥ dvitā dvidhā dviprakāreṇa ca mātuḥ aditeḥ garbhe saṃjātaṃ yadyuṣmākaṃ bhrātṛtvaṃ vidyate tadidānīṃ vayaṃ pra bharāmahe |

sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ dvaṃdvaśo jananaṃ taittirīyake spaṣṭamabhihitam— ‘aditiḥ putrakāmā sādhyebhyo devebhyo brahmaudanamapacat’ (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 5 6) ityupakramya ‘tasyai pūṣā cārmamā cājāyatām’ ityādinā ||
yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ |

yuyam | hi | stha | sudānavaḥ | indrajyeṣṭhāḥ | abhidyavaḥ | adha | cit | vaḥ | uta | bruve ||9|| pūrvo'dhaṃdhaḥ siddhaḥ | he sudānavaḥ śobhanadānā devāḥ indrajyeṣṭhāḥ | indro jyeṣṭho mukhyo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | sarve devā indranetṛkā ityarthaḥ | tādṛśāḥ abhidyavaḥ abhigatadīsayaḥ yūyaṃ hi stha asmadyajñe bhavatha khalu | hi prasiddhau | adha cit athānantarameva vaḥ yuṣmān ahaṃ bruve staumi | uta api ca punaḥpunaḥ staumītyarthaḥ || || 4 ||
'preṣṭhaṃ vaḥ' iti navacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ kaveḥ putrasyośanasa ārṣaṃ gāyatramāgneyam |
prātaranuvāka āgneye kratau gāyatre chandasyāśvinaśastre cedaṃ sūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'gukṣvā hi preṣṭhaṃ vaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
ābhiprāvikeṣukthyeṣu maitrāvaruṇe 'preṣṭhaṃ vaḥ' iti nṛco vaikalpikaḥ stotriyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭha bhārata' (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||

preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam | agniṃ rathaṃ na vedyam || 1 || preṣṭham | vaḥ | atithim | stuṣe | mitram'iva | priyam | agnim | ratham | na | vedyam ||1|| he yajamānāḥ 'preṣṭhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ dhanadānena priyatamam 'atithiṃ yuṣmābhiratithivatpūjyam | yadvā | 'ata sātatyagamane' |
he deva dyotamāna agne varāya sarvairvareṇīyāya mamyave śatrūnatimantyamānāya te tubhyaṃ kayā kīdṛśyā vācā upastutim upastotramahaṃ bhareyam |
dāśa̭m kasya॒ marna̭sā॒ ya॒jñasya̭ sa॒haso̭ ya॒ho | kadu voca॒ idaṃ na̭rmaḥ || 5 || dāśa̭m | kasya̭ | marna̭sā | ya॒jñasya̭ | sa॒hasa̭ḥ | ya॒ho iti̭ | kat | ū~ iti̭ | vocḙ | i॒dam | na̭rmaḥ || 5 ||
balena niṣpadyamānatvādbalasya putra he agne kasya kīdṛśasya yajñasya yajñavato yajanīyadevavato yajamānasya manasā yuktāḥ santo havīṃṣi tubhyaṃ vayaṃ dāśama prayacchema |
kiṃca tubhyam idaṃ namaḥ havirnamaskāraṃ vā kat kadā voce ahaṃ vadāmi |
ṛṣiḥ kadā yakṣyāmi kadā stoṣyāmītyṛṣiṃ pṛcchati |
adhā̭ tvaṃ hi nū॒karo॒ viśvā̭ a॒smabhya̭ṃ su॒kṣitī̭ | vā̭ja॒dravi̭ṇaso gi॒raḥ || 6 || adha | tvam | hi | naḥ | karaḥ | viśvā̭ | a॒smabhya̭m | su॒kṣitī̭ | vā̭ja॒dravi̭ṇasaḥ | gi॒raḥ || 6 ||

he agne adha anantaraṃ tvam | hiravadhāraṇe | tvameva asmabhyaṃ karaḥ kuru | dehītyarthaḥ | karoteḥ leṭyaḍāgamaḥ | kimityapekṣayāmāha | naḥ asmadīyāḥ giraḥ tvaddipayāḥ viśvāḥ sarvāḥ stutīrevaṃ kuru yathā sukṣitīḥ | kṣiyanti nivasantyatreti kṣitayo gṛhāḥ | śobhananivāsāḥ | yadvā | kṣitayo manuṣyāḥ | kalyāṇaputrapautrādiyuktāḥ | tathā vājadraviṇasaḥ annayuktadhanavatīḥ | athavā vājo dīptiḥ | sarvato dīptadhanāśra kuru | tvamasmābhiḥ stutaḥ san gṛhaputrāndhanādīni dehītyarthaḥ ||
kasya̭ nūna॒ṃ parī̭ṇaso॒ dhiyaṷ jinvasi॒ daṃpa̭te | goṣā̭tā॒ yasya̭ te gi॒raḥ || 7 || kasya̭ | nūna̭m | parī̭ṇasaḥ | dhiya̭ḥ | ji॒nvasi̭ | daṃ'pate | go'sā̭tā | yasya̭ | te | gi॒raḥ || 7 ||
he daṃpate yadā gārhapatye vartase tadā jāyāpatisvarūpo'si |
tathāvidha he agne nūnam idānīṃ kasya kīdṛśasya janasya parīṇasaḥ bahūn dhiyaḥ karmāṇi jinvasi prīṇayasi |
yasya te tava saṃbandhinyaḥ giraḥ stutayaḥ gomātā gosātā gavāṃ lābhe bhavanti khalu |
he agne tvamidānīṃ kasya karmāṇi prīṇayasi |
sūtritaṃ ca—'taṃ ma̭ja̭yanta su॒kṛta̭ṃ ya॒jñena̭ ya॒jña- ma̭ya̭janta de॒vāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 2. 16) iti ||
taṃ ma̭ja̭yanta su॒kṛta̭ṃ pu॒rovā̭na॒māji̭ṣu | kṣeṣu kṣayḙṣu vā॒jina̭m || 8 || tam | ma̭ja̭yanta | su॒kṛta̭m | pu॒raḥ'vā̭nam | ā॒jiṣṷ | kṣeṣu | kṣayḙṣu | vā॒jina̭m || 8 ||
1. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa-vastubhyaṃ | 2. kha-ta-na-bha-kadā vā | 3. kha-ta-nivasaṃtītyatreti | 4. kha-ga-ta-3-bha-śa-dīptaḥ | 5. kha-ta-1-2-na-bha-śa-daṃpate gṛhapate | 6. jha-devā iti paridadhyāt |

'sukṛtaṃ śobhanaprajñaṃ sukarmāṇaṃ vā 'ājiṣu saṃgrāmeṣu 'puroyāvānaṃ śatruhananārthaṃ purata eva gantāraṃ 'vājinaṃ balavantaṃ tādṛśamabhi' yajamānāḥ 'sveṣu ātmīyeṣu 'kṣayeṣu gṛheṣu 'marjayanta nimaṃtritamabhi- malaṃkurvanti |
kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhirnakiye ghanti hanti yaḥ | agre suvīraṃ edhate || 9 || kṣeti | kṣemebhiḥ | sādhubhiḥ | nakiḥ | yam | ghanti | hanti | yaḥ | agre | suvīraḥ | edhate ||9||
he 'agre yo manuṣyaḥ 'sādhubhiḥ sādhayadbhiḥ 'kṣemebhiḥ pālanaiḥ saha 'kṣeti svagṛhe nivasati |
tathā 'yaṃ janaṃ 'nakiḥ na kecana 'ghanti na hiṃsanti |
tataḥ sa stotā 'suvīraḥ śobhanaputrādiyuktaḥ san 'edhate ātmīyagṛheṣu dhanādibhirvardhate ||
'ā me havam' iti navacaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktam |
tathā cānukrāntam—'ā me kṛṣṇa āśvinaṃ hi' iti |
prātaranuvāka āśvine kratau gāyatre chandasyāśvinaśastre cedaṃ sūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—'udīrāthāmā me havam' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti ||
ā me haveṃ nāsatyāśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye || 1 || ā | me | havam | nāsatyā | aśvinā | gacchatam | yuvam | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 1 ||

he 'nāsatyā | asatyamanayornāstīti nāsatyau | tādṛśau he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'me madīyaṃ 'havam āhvānaṃ śrutvā | yadvā | havam | hūyate'treti havo yajñaḥ | kevalasthādhikaraṇe'p chāndasaḥ | madīyaṃ yajñaṃ prati 'madhvaḥ madakarasya 'somasya 'pītaye pānāya tadartham 'ā 'gacchatam ||
imaṃ me stormaśvinaṃ me śṛṇutaṃ havam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye || 2 || imam | me | stomam | aśvinā | imam | me | śṛṇutam | havam | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye ||2||
he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'me madīyam 'imaṃ 'stomaṃ stotraṃ 'kiṃca 'me madīyam 'imam idamāgamanaviṣayaṃ 'havam āhvānaṃ ca 'śṛṇutam ||
ayaṃ vāṃ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye || 3 || ayam | vām | kṛṣṇaḥ | aśvinā | havate | vājinīvasū iti vājinīvasū | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 3 ||

he 'vājinīvasū annayuktadhanau | atreniranuvādārthaḥ | yadvā | vājo vajanaṃ kriyā | tadvatī vājinī | tadyuktadhanavantau he 'aśvinā aśvinau 'ayaṃ 'kṛṣṇaḥ nāma mantradraṣṭā ṛṣiḥ 'vāṃ yuvāṃ 'havate stutibhirāhvayati | kimartham | 'madhvaḥ 'somasya 'pītaye iti ||
śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavaṃ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye || 4 || śṛṇutam | jarituḥ | havam | kṛṣṇasya | stuvataḥ | narā | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 4 ||
1. ta- 'hananārthaṃ vā | 2. bha-taṃ tādṛśa | 3. kha-ta-śa- 'yaḥ 'nāsti | 4. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-kṣa-stotraṃ vā |
he narā narī sarvasya netārāvaśvinau jarituḥ |
jarituḥ stavanaśīlasya saṃprati stuvataḥ stotraṃ kurvataḥ kṛṣṇasya etannāmakasyaparye saṃbandha havaṃ yuṣma- dviṣayamāhvānaṃ śṛṇutam |
jarituranyadevānāṃ stotuḥ stuvata idānīṃ yuvayoḥ stotrakāriṇastasya havaṃ śṛṇutam |
chardiḥ | yantam | adābhyam | viprāya | stuvate | narā | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 5 ||
he narā netārāvaśvinau viprāya medhāvine ata eva stuvate stotraṃ kurvate kṛṣṇāyarye adābhyam |
stotre gṛhe dīyamāne sati tadā sa somaṃ yuvābhyāṃ prayacchati ||
gacchatam | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛham | itthā | stuvataḥ | aśvinā | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 6 ||
he aśvinā aśvinau itthā itthamananena prakāreṇa stuvataḥ yuvayoḥ stotraṃ kurvataḥ dāśuṣaḥ havīṃṣi dattavato yajamānasya gṛhaṃ prati gacchataṃ yuvāmāgacchatam |
yujñāthām | rāsabham | rathe | vīḻuaṅge | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye||7||
dṛḍhāṅgopete' svarathe rāsabhaṃ śabdāyamānametannāmakamaśvaṃ yujñāthāṃ saṃyojayatam |
trivandhureṇa | trivṛtā | rathena | ā | yātam | aśvinā | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye || 8 ||

he aśvinā aśvinau trivandhureṇa triphalakāsaṃghaṭitana trivṛtā trikoṇena | yadvā | trivṛtā | trīṇi kavacādibhirāvavaraṇāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tena rathena asmadyajñaṃ prati ā yātaṃ yuvāmāga- cchataṃ ca | śiṣṭaṃ gatam ||
nū me॒ giro̭ nāsa̭tyāśvi॒nā prā॒vata̭ṃ yu॒vam |
nu | me | giraḥ | nāsatyā | aśvinā | pra | avatam | yuvam | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītaye ||9||
he nāsatyā asatyarahitau he aśvinā aśvinau me madīyāḥ giraḥ stutilakṣaṇā vācaḥ prati yuvaṃ yuvāṃ nu kṣipraṃ prāvataṃ prakarṣeṇāgacchatam |
madhvaḥ madakarasya somasya pītaye pānāya tadartham |
sarve devāḥ stutibhirāhūtāḥ santo yajñaṃ pratyāgacchantīti gacchataṃ rakṣataṃ ceti yuktaṃ bhavati ||
1. kha-bha1-dṛḍha ādyaṃgopete; ga-ta-bhara-dṛḍhā ādyaṃgopete; śa- dṛḍhāṃgopete |
‘ubhā hi dastrā’ iti pañcarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktam |
triśvako nāma kṛṣṇasya putraḥ kṛṣṇa eva varṣiḥ |
tathānukramyate—‘ubhā hi pañca viśvako vā kārṣṇirjāgatam’ iti |
ubhā hi dastrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvobhā dakṣasya varcaso babhūvathuḥ |
tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanukṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
ubhā | hi | dastrā | bhiṣajā | mayaḥ'bhuvā | ubhā | dakṣasya | varcasaḥ | babhūvathuḥ | tā | vām | viśvakaḥ | havate | tanu'kṛthe | mā | naḥ | vi | yauṣṭam | sakhyā | mumocatam ||1||
yadā narā aśvinau stuvanti tadā tau teṣāṃ bhītimapanayata ityarthaḥ |
tādṛśau ata eva ‘mayobhuvā mayasaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitārau ‘ubhā parasparaṃ dvitvasaṅkhyāpūrakau ‘ubhā ubhau dvau yuvāṃ ‘dakṣasya etannāmasya prajāpateḥ ‘vacasaḥ stuteḥ saṃbandhinau babhūvathuḥ |
tasmāt ‘naḥ asmākaṃ ‘sakhyā sakhyāni yaṣṭayaṣṭa- vyatayā jātāni sakhitvāni ‘mā ‘vi ‘yauṣṭaṃ mā pṛthakurutam |
atra viṣṇāpanāmānaṃ putramuddiśya tasya pitā viśvako yuvāmāhvayatītyātmānamāha |
viśvakasya pitā kṛṣṇo nāmarṣimaṃ putro viśvakaḥ putrārthaṃ yuvāmadhihvayatīti vadati ||
kathā nūnaṃ vāṃ vimanā upa stavadhurvaṃ dhiyaṃ dadhurvasyeṣṭaye |
tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanukṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
kathā | nūnam | vām | vi'manāḥ | upa | stavat | dhiyam | dadhuḥ | vasyaḥ'iṣṭaye | tā | vām | viśvakaḥ | havate | tanu'kṛthe | mā | naḥ | vi | yauṣṭam | sakhyā | mumocatam ||2||
he aśvinau ‘vimanāḥ etannāmaka ṛṣiḥ ‘nūnaṃ purā ‘kathā kathaṃ ‘vāṃ yuvām ‘upa ‘stavata kathamupāstaut |
tasyābhilaṣi- tasyeṣṭaye'dhigamanāya yadvā’ vasiṣṭhanasyeṣṭaye’ prāptaye ‘dhiyaṃ buddhiṃ vimanase ‘dadhuḥ |
yuvaṃ hi ṣmā purubhujamedhatuṃ viṣṇāpve dadhurvasyeṣṭaye |
tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanukṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
yuvam | hi | sma | puru'bhujā | imam | edhatum | viṣṇāpve | dadhuḥ | vasyaḥ'iṣṭaye | tā | vām | viśvakaḥ | havate | tanu'kṛthe | mā | naḥ | vi | yauṣṭam | sakhyā | mumocatam ||3||
3. kha-yadvāvasiṣṭaḥ ga-bha3-yadvā viśiṣṭaḥ; ta-na-bhara-mu-yadvāvaśiṣṭaḥ; śa-yadvā avaśiṣṭaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ mukhyatvāt tadgrahaṇe 'sarve devā gṛhītā bhavanti |
uta tyaṃ vīraṃ dhanasāgṛjīṣiṇaṃ dūre citsantaṃmarvase havāmahe |
yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pituryathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ saruyā mumocatam ||
uta | tyam | vīram | dhana'sām | ṛjīṣiṇam | dūre | cit | santam | avase | havāmahe | yasya | svādiṣṭhā | su'matiḥ | pituḥ | yathā | mā | naḥ | vi | yauṣṭam | saruyā | mumocatam ||4||
he aśvinau 'uta api ca 'vīraṃ karmaṇi samarthaṃ 'dhanasāṃ dhanānāṃ saṃbhaktāram 'ṛjīṣiṇam |
tadantaṃ 'dūre 'cit dūra eva 'santaṃ bhavantaṃ vinaṣṭamiva 'tyaṃ taṃ viṣṇāpavam 'avase asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya 'havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ |
kiṃca 'yasya putrasya pautrasya vā 'sumatiḥ śobhanā stutiḥ 'svādiṣṭhā svādutamā |
ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgamuruviyā vi prapathe |
ṛtaṃ sāsāha mahi citpṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ saruyā mumocatam ||
ṛtena | devaḥ | saviā | śam'āyate | ṛtasya | śṛṅgam | uruviyā | vi | prapathe | ṛtam | sāsāha | mahi | cit | pṛtanyataḥ | mā | naḥ | vi | yauṣṭam | saruyā | mumocatam ||5||
he aśvinau 'devaḥ 'dyotanān : 'savitā sarvasya svasvakamaṇi preraka etannāmako devaḥ 'ṛtena satyena 'śamāyate sāyaṃkāle svakiraṇasamūhaṃ śamayati |
tato'nantaraṃ sa eva savitā 'ṛtasya satyasya 'śṛṅgam agram 'urviyā uru vistīrṇaṃ yathā bhavati tathā prātaḥkāle 'vi 'prapathe viśeṣeṇa prathayati |
kiṃca 'pṛtanyataḥ pṛtanāmicchataḥ saṃyuyutsoḥ śatroḥ 'mahi 'cit mahadapi balam 'ṛtaṃ satyaṃ 'svayamevābhibhavati |
tathā cānukramyate—' yugmī ṣaḍvāsiṣṭho vā yugmīkaḥ : priyamedho vā prāgāthaṃ ha ' iti |
1. ga-u-sū- 'vadyośratuḥ | 2. śa-tadgrahaṇe | 3. gha-upārjitaḥ abhidhutasomaḥ; jha-taya-bha-śa- ṛjīṣopārjitobhidhutasomaḥ | 4. ga-prītikāriṇī | 5. kha-ta-bha-śa-devī | 6. gha-satya sāsāha |
vāśabdādyadobhāvapi na syātāṃ tadā prakṛta āṅgirasa: kṛṣṇa eva ṛṣi: |
prātaranuvāka āśvine kratau bārhate chandasyāśvinaścedaṃ sūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ghunnī vāṃ yatstha iti bārhatam ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti ||
ghunnī vāṃ stomau aśvinā krivinaṃ sekū ā gaṃtam |
madhva: sutasya sa dvivi priyo narā pātaṃ gaurāvireriṇe ||
ghunnī | vām | stoma: | aśvinā | krivi: | na | sekai | ā | gatam | madhva: | sutasya | sa: | dvivi | priya: | narā | pātam | gaurau'iva | iriṇe || 1 ||
he aśvinau aśvinau ayamanupakṣīṇastotro ghunnīka etannāmaka ṛṣi: vāṃ yuvayo: stoma: stotā bhavati |
yuṣmatstutau kṛtāyāṃ stotrāṇi nālpībhavanti’ kiṃtu punarvardhanta ityartha: |
kūpo yathā seke udakasecane vṛṣṭau bhavantyāṃ nālpodako bhavati tadvat |
vāṃ yuvayo: stomo yuṣmadviṣayā stutiryukthyabhavati khalu |
stotre kṛte tasmā annādikaṃ prayacchata ityartha: |
he narā narau netārauśvinau sa: ayaṃ stotā divi dyotamāne asmin yajñe sutasya abhisutasya madhva: madakarasya somasya priya: stotrakāritvena priyatamo bhavati |
tatastena sutaṃ somaṃ pātaṃ yuvāṃ śīghramāgasya pibatam |
gaurāvi va yathā tṛṣitau gaurāvivanāmako mṛgau iriṇe taṭākādiṣūdakapānārthaṃ śīghramāgacchatastadvat ||
pibataṃ gharmaṃ madhumantamaśvinā barhi: sīdataṃ narā |
tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṃ vedasā vaya: ||
pibatam | gharmam | madhu'mantam | aśvinā | barhi: | sīdatam | narā | tā | mandasānā | manuṣa: | duroṇe | ā | ni | pātam | vedasā | vaya: || 2 ||
taddhantaṃ gharmaṃ mahāvīrapātragataṃ kṣīraṃ pibataṃ somaṃ ceti |
he narā narau netārau sarvasya he aśvinau barhi: barhiṣi yajñe ā sīdatam upaviśatam |
pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ vyākhyāya prathamapādo vyākhyāya: |

kiṃca manuṣa: manuṣyasya duroṇe gṛhabhūte'smin devayajane mandasānā somapānena modamānau tā tau pūrvoktalakṣaṇau yuvāṃ vedasā puroḍāśādilakṣaṇena haviṣā saha vaya: somarūpamannaṃ ā āgatya ni pātaṃ nipibatam |
vedasā dhanena saha vayo'smākamāyurni pātaṃ nitarāṃ rakṣatam ||
tā vṛtiryātumapa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ diviṣṭiṣu ||
3. kha-jha-ta2-bha1-2-alpodakā bhavati; ga-ta1-3-4-alpodakā bhavati; śa-astyodakā bhavati |
ā | vām | viśvābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | priya'medhāḥ | ahūṣata | tā | vṛtiḥ | yātam | upa | vṛta'barhiṣaḥ | juṣṭam | yajñam | diviṣṭiṣu || 3 ||
yaṣṭāra ṛṣīrvā ᵥviśvābhirūtibhiḥ sarvaiḥ pālanaiḥ saha |

ᵥtā tau yuvāṃ ᵥvṛttabarhiṣaḥ āstaraṇārthaṃ chinnabarhiṣo yaṣṭuḥ sambandhi ᵥjuṣṭaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ sevitaṃ payāṃsaṃ vā ᵥyajñaṃ yajanīyaṃ haviḥ prati ᵥdiviṣṭiṣu divasānāma- hāmāgamanameṣu prātaḥkāleṣu yaśeṣu vā ᵥvatiḥ |
tat ᵥupa ᵥā ᵥyātaṃ haviḥsvīkaraṇārthaṃ yuvāmāgacchatam ||
pibaṃtaṃ somaṃ madhumantamāśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ sumata |
tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṃ divo gantaṃ gaurāviberiṇam ||

atra kanyā snānārthamāgasya somaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhakṣayati takṣaṇajo dhvaniriva na tu prāṇāṃ somābhipavadhvaniriti |
kimarthaṃ nivartase tvaṃ tu somapānāya gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ prati gacchasi |
idānīmatrāpi mama daṃṣṭrābhyāmabhiputaṃ somaṃ piba dhānādīṃśca bhakṣayeti |
atrāgataṃ tvāmindra 'iti 'na jānāmi tvayi gṛhamāgate bahumānaṃ kariṣyāmītīndramuktvātra samāgata indra eva nānya iti niścitya svāsthe nihitaṃ somamāha |
he soma tvamāgatāyendrāya pūrva śanaistata: kṣipraṃ parikṣaveti |
tata indrastāṃ kāmayitvā tasyā āsya eva daṃṣṭrābhiputaṃ soma- mapāt |
tata indreṇa some pīte sati tvagdoṣadāhaṃ bhartrā parityaktā satīdānīmindreṇa saṃgatetyapālā- yāmukāyāmindrastāṃ vyājahāra |
kiṃ kāmayase tadahaṃ kariṣyāmītyukte sā varamacīkamata |

mama pituḥ śiro romavarjitaṃ tasyoparaṃ kṣetraṃ phalādirahitaṃ mama guhyasthānamapyaromaśametāni romaphalādiyuktaṃ kurvityuktāyāṃ tapitṛśiraḥsthitaṃ0 khalatimapahāya kṣetraṃ ca phalādiyuktaṃ kurvatasthāsvagdoṣaparihārāya svakīyarathacchidre śakaṭasya yugasya ca chidraṃ etāṃ trivāraṃ niśkarṣa |
tasyāḥ pūrvāpahatā yā tvak śalyako dvitīyā godhā tṛtīyā kṛkalāso'bhūt |

1. ga-uktaguṇo'sti | 2. ta-bha1-2-sapracetasaṃ; śa-pracetasaṃ | 3. kha-ta1-2-3-4-bhara-1-śa- dānaṃ; jha-bha1-dhanaṃ dānaṃ | 4. kha-ga-ta-kṛtaṃ kṛtyāneti; śa-kṛte kṛtatyaneti | 5. jha-kṛttireveti | 6. kha-ta-śa-pratyāgamayat; bha1-2-pratyagamayat | 7. jha-°dhvaniriti | 8. ga-ta-bha-śa-svāmindramiti | 9. ga-iṃdraḥ somaṃ | 10. ga-ta-°śiraḥsthitāṃ | 11. bha1-2-ya-eṣo'rthaḥ krameṇa |
astaṃ bharaṃtyabravīdiṃdrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā ||
kunyā | vāḥ | av'yatī | somam | api | sutā | avidat | astam | bharantī | abravīt | iṃdrāya | sunavai | tvā | śakrāya | sunavai | tvā || 1 ||
vāḥ udakaṃ prati avāyatī snānārthamabhyagacchantī kanyā apālā nāma strī sutā sutau mārge somamapi avidat alabhata |
latārūpaṃ taṃ somam astaṃ gṛhaṃ prati bharantī āharantī sā somam abravīt |
he soma tvā tvām iṃdrāya sunavai mama dantairevā- bhipuṇavai |
punahaṃ soma tvā tvāṃ śakrāya samarthāyendrāya sunavai idānīmevābhipava karavai |
eṣo'rthaḥ śāṭyāyanabrāhmaṇe spaṣṭamabhihitaḥ- 'sā tīrthamabhyavahantī somāṃśumavindattaṃ samakhādatasya ha' grāvāṇa iva dantā uduḥ |
sa indra ādravat grāvāṇo vai vadantīti |
sā tamabhivyājahāra kanyā vārvāyatī somamapi sutāvidatyasyai ta idaṃ grāvāṇa iva dantā vadantīti viditvendraḥ parāḍāvartata |
tamabravīdasau ya eṣi vīraka ityādinā' iti ||
asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ vicārkaśat |
asau | yaḥ | eṣi | vīrakaḥ | gṛham'gṛham | vi'cārkaśat | imam | jambha'sutam | piba | dhānā'vantam | karambhaṇam | apūpa'vantam | ukthinam || 2 ||
he indra vīrakaḥ vīraḥ samarthastvaṃ yaḥ asau tvaṃ vicārkaśat |
ayarthaṃ dīpyamānaḥ san gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ yajamāna- gṛhaṃ prati somapānāya tvam eṣi gacchasi |
atastvamapi jambhasutaṃ mama dantairabhiputam imaṃ somaṃ piba |
tadantaṃ karambhaṇaṃ saktumantam apūpa- vantaṃ puroḍāśādisahitam ukthinaṃ stotrādiyuktametādṛśaṃ somamatraiva pibeti |
sā somena saha dhānādīnāvedayat stotraṃ cākārṣīdityarthaḥ ||
ā cana tvā cikitsāmodhiṃ cana tvā nemasi |
ā | cana | tvā | cikitsāmaḥ | adhi | cana | tvā | na | imasi | śanaiḥ'iva | śanakaiḥ'iva | iṃdrāya | indo iti | pari | srava || 3 ||
tvā tvām ā cikitsāmaḥ jñātumicchāma eva |
iha mārga evāgataṃ tvā tvāṃ na na adhi imasi nādhigacchāmaḥ |
mama gṛhamāgacchantaṃ tvāmindra iti na jānīma evetya- thaḥ ||

1. kha-ta-śa- 'sā' nāsti | 2. ta-bha1-2-daṃte vājaṃ dhanaṃ; bha3-daṃtairjātaṃ; śa-daṃtavādyamāne | 3. ga-grāvadhvaniriti | 4. bha-ha vā | 5. kha-ta-bha1-udhuḥ; bha2-ūdhaḥ; bha3-ūrdhvaḥ; śa-ucuḥ | 6. kha-ta-bha1-2-śrutāvidaṃ |
pālā tamindramuktvā svāsthe sthitaṃ somaṃ pratyāha|
he vindro kṣaraṇaśīla soma asmā āgatāya vindrāya tadarthaṃ pūrvaṃ vśanaiḥ mandaṃ mandaṃ tataḥ vśanakairiva|
kṣiprameva tvaṃ vpari vsva madīyadaṃṣṭrābhirabhipūyamāṇaḥ san paritaḥ kṣareti |
tathā yajñeṣvapi prāvabhirabhipūyamāṇaḥ somaḥ prathamaṃ śanaiḥ parisravati tataḥ śanakaiḥ kṣipramiti tadabhiprāye- ṇoktam |
tata indra etadvākyaṃ śrutvā tadānīmevamabhiputaṃ somaṃ yajñasthānīyādapālāmukhādevādāsīt |
uktārthaḥ : śāvyāyanakavāhmaṇe spaṣṭamabhyadhāyi—‘anādriyamāṇaiv tamabravīdā cana tvā cikitsā- mo'dhi cana tvā nemasīti |
purā māṃ sarvayarcāpālā stautītyupaparyātavartata śanairiva śanakairibendrāyendo pari sraveti ha vā asya mukhātsomaṃ niradhayatsomapītha iha vā asya bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān kṣīmupajighrati’ iti ||
kuvit | śarkat | kuvit | karat | kuvit | naḥ | vasyasaḥ | karat | kuvit | pati'dviṣaḥ | yatīḥ | indreṇa | sam'gamamahe || 4 ||
sa indraḥ vkuvit bahuvāramasmān vśakata śaktān samarthān karotu |
kiṃca vkuvit bahu cāsmabhyaṃ vkarat karotu |
kiṃca sa vevendraḥ vnaḥ asmān vkuvit bahukṛtvaḥ vvasyasaḥ vasīyaso'tiśayena vasumataḥ karotu |

pūrvaṃ vkuvit bahu vpatidviṣaḥ tvadgopālapatibhirbhartṛbhi- rbahuvāraṃ dviṣṭā ata eva vyatīḥ patibhyaḥ sakāśādito gacchantyo vayaṃ kaiścidapyanūyamānāḥ satyaḥ saṃprati vindreṇa saha vsaṃgamāmahai saṃgacchāsahai |
imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya |
imāni | trīṇi | viṣṭapā | tāni | indra | vi | rohaya | śiraḥ | tu | tasya | urvarām | āt | idam | me | upa | udare || 5 ||
indreṇa kiṃ kāmayase tadāsyāmītyuktā sā varamanayā prārthayate |
he vindra vimāni vtrīṇi viṣṭapāni sthānāni santi |
vtāni trīṇi sthānāni vvi vrohaya utpādaya |
vāt anantaraṃ vme mama vupadare upodarasya samīpe yat vidaṃ sthānam |

sābravīdimāni trīṇi viṣṭapeti khalatirhāsya pitā sa taṃ hākhalatiṃ cakārorvarā hāsya na jajñe so ha jajña upasthe hāsya romāṇi nāsustānyu ha jajñira ityasyottarā bhūyase nirvacanāyāsau ca yā naḥ’ iti ||
3. kha- tara-karotu tadāhama; jha-bhara-śa-karotu tadāha sa; ta1-tvadāhama |

asau ca yā na̭ urvarādimāṃ tanva̭ṃ marma | atho̭ tatasya yacchiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi || 6 || asaṷ | ca | yā | na̭ | urvarā̭ | āt | imām | tanva̭m | marma | atho̭ iti | tatasya̭ | yat | śira̭ḥ | sarvā̭ | tā | romaśā | kṛdhi || 6 || uktamevārthamanayā vivṛṇoti | 'naḥ asmākaṃ pituḥ 'yā 'asau 'urvarā yadidamuparaṃ kṣetramasti | 'āt anantaraṃ 'mama 'imāṃ 'tanvam idaṃ tvadupadaṣṭaṃ gṛhasthānam | 'atho athāpi ca 'tatasya tātasya 'yacchiraḥ romavarjitamasti etāni 'sarvāṃ sarvāṇi tānīmāni trīṇi sthānāni 'romaśā romaśāni 'kṛdhi kuru || khe ratha̭sya khe'nasaḥ khe yuga̭sya śatakrato | apālāmindra triṣpūtvakṛṇoḥ sūrya̭tvacam || 7 || khe | ratha̭sya | khe | ana̭saḥ | khe | yuga̭sya | śatakrato iti śata'krato || apālām | indra | triḥ | pūtvī | akṛṇoḥ | sūrya̭tvacam || 7 || anayāpālāṃ sūryasadṛśaprabhāmakarodityāha | he 'śatakrato he śatasaṃkhyākayajña bahuvidhaprajña vā he 'indra 'rathasya svakīyasya 'khe pṛthutare chidre tathā 'anasaḥ śakaṭasya 'khe tadapekṣayālpe chidre 'yugasya 'khe cālpatare sūkṣme chidre rathaśakaṭayugānāṃ chidreṣu tvadoṣaparihārāya 'triḥ trivāraṃ niṣkarṣaṇena 'pūtvī śodhayitvā tataḥ 'apālām etannāmikāmatrisutāṃ brahmavādinīṃ 'sūryatvacaṃ sūryasamānatvacam 'akṛṇoḥ akaroḥ | kalyāṇatarūpabhājamakarorityarthaḥ | śāṭhyāyanabrāhmaṇe spaṣṭamabhihitaḥ'—'tāṃ khe rathasyātha- bṛhatsā godhābhavattāṃ khe'nasa'tyebṛhatsā saṃliṣṭā'bhavattadepābhyanūcyate khe rathasya khe'nasa iti | tasyai ha yatkalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tadrūpamāsa' iti | svadoṣāpanayanāya akṣādidvāreṣvatikarṣaṇamiti | yastvadoṣadūṣitaḥ sabhettasūktaṃ paṭhati tasya 'tvadoṣamapagamayya sūryasadṛśakāntimindraḥ karotīti sūktaṃ praśasyate || || 14 || 'pāntamā vaḥ' iti trayastriṃśacca dvādaśaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya śrutakakṣasya sukakṣasya vārṣamaindram | ādyānuṣṭup śiṣṭā gāyatryaḥ | tathānukramyate—'pāntaṃ trayastriṃśacchutakakṣaḥ sukakṣo vādyānuṣṭup' iti | mahāvrate gāyatryṛcāśitau prathamāvarjamidaṃ sūktamuttaraṃ ca | pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ ca—'puruhūta puruhūtamiti doṣaḥ' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 3) iti | prathame rātriparyāye hotuḥ śastra ādyau tucau stotriyānu rūpau | sūtritaṃ ca—'pāntamā vo andhaso'pādu śipyandhasaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti || pāntu mā vo andhasa indramabhi pra gāyata | viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratuṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām || 1 || pānta̭m | ā | vaḥ | andha̭saḥ | indra̭m | abhi | pra | gāyata | viśva'saha̭m | śata'kra̭tum | maṃhi̭ṣṭham | carṣaṇīnām || 1 || he ṛtvijaḥ 'vaḥ yuṣmadīyaṃ 'andhasaḥ somalakṣaṇamannam 'ā 'pāntam abhimukhyena pibantam | 'pā pāne' | chāndasaḥ śapo luk | 'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpante' iti 'na 1. ja-asau ca yāsā | 2. gha-ttā tānīmāni | 3. khata- 'mabhihitaḥ; bhā- 'mabhitā | 4. ga-yugādi | 5. ga-ta-kṣa- 'tasya' nāsti | 6. ga-ta1-2-4-bha- 'sadṛśaḥ; na- 'sadṛśaḥ | 7. ta-bha1-2-vikalpyante |
somamābhi- mukhyena pibantametādṛśam indraṃ pra gāyata prakarṣeṇābhiṣuta |
viśvasahaṃ sarveṣāṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtajātānāṃ vā ata eva śatakratuṃ bahuvidhaprajñānaṃ bahuvidhakarmāṇaṃ vā varṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ dhanasya dātṛtamam |
puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ gāthānyaṃ sanaśrutam | indra iti bravītana || 2 || puruhūtam | puruṣṭutam | gāthānyam | sanaśrutam | indraḥ | iti | bravītana || 2 ||

he ṛtvigyajamānāḥ puruhūtaṃ yajñeṣu bahubhirāhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ bahubhiḥ stotraśastrādibhiḥ stutam ata eva gāthānyaṃ gānayogyaṃ gātavyaṃ sanaśrutaṃ sanātanatayā prasiddhamevaṃvidhaṃ devam indra iti yūyaṃ bravītana brūyāta |
'brūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci' ityasya loṭi vyatyayena dhvamastanabādeśaḥ |
indra it mahānāṃ dātā vājānāṃ nṛtuḥ | mahā abhiṣvā yamata || 3 || indraḥ | it | naḥ | mahānām | dātā | vājānām | nṛtuḥ | mahān | abhi iṣu | ā | yamata || 3 ||

indra it pūrvoktalakṣaṇa indra eva naḥ asmabhyaṃ mahānāṃ mahatāṃ vājānām annānām | yadvā | mahānām | varṇavyatyayaḥ | maghānāṃ dhanānāṃ vājānāmajñānāṃ vā dātā bhavatu | kīdṛśaḥ | nṛtuḥ | 'nṛtṛśṛbhyoḥ kūḥ' (u. sū. 1. 91) iti kūpratyayaḥ | hrasvaśchāndasaḥ | sarvasya nartayitā | yadvā | nṛ naye | auṇādikastupratyayaḥ | dhātorhrasvaśchāndasaḥ | stotṛbhyo gavādinetā | ata eva mahān sa indraḥ abhiṣnu abhigatajānukamasmabhyam ā yamata āyacchatu dadātu | yadvā sa indro'bhiṣṭvasmadabhimukhamāgacchaddhanaṃ svahastayoḥ parigṛhṇāsmājjayatu | dhanaṃ yatvāsmabhyaṃ dadātvityarthaḥ ||
apādu śipyandhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ | indorindro yavāśiraḥ || 4 || apāt | oṃ iti | śiprī | andhasaḥ | sudakṣasya | prahoṣiṇaḥ | indoḥ | indraḥ | yava āśiraḥ || 4 ||
saḥ indraḥ eva prahoṣiṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa devān havirbhirjuhvataḥ sudakṣasya etannāmakasya ṛṣeḥ saṃbandhi yavā- śiraḥ |
yavairā- miśritaṃ yavaiḥ saha pakvam indoḥ sarvataḥ pātreṣu kṣarat andhasaḥ somalakṣaṇamannam apāt api- bat |
tambhi prācyutendraṃ somasya pītayai | tadiddharyasya vardhanam || 5 || tam | oṃ iti | abhi | pra | arcata | indram | somasya | pītayai | tat | it | hi | asya | vardhanam || 5 ||
4. kha-ta2-1-4bha1-2-śa-somāṃsamapibat; ga-somāṃśipabat; jha-ta1-somaṃ sāma pibat; bha3-somaṃ saṃpibat |
he ṛtvijaḥ tamu tameva indram abhi ābhimukhyena prārcata prakarṣeṇa stuta |
tadit tatsoma- pānameva asya indrasya vardhanaṃ vardhakaṃ bhavati khalu |
asya | pītvā | madānām | devaḥ | devasya | ojasā | viśvā | abhi | bhuvanā | bhuvat || 6 ||
devaḥ dyotamāna indraḥ asya asmābhirdīyamānasya somasya madānāṃ madakarān rasān pītvā pānaṃ kṛtvā |
asyaitaṃ somaṃ pītvā tathā madānāṃ madasādhanādīni bhakṣayitvā |
devasya graheṣu śobhamānasya yadvā devanśīlasya devaiḥ kāmyamānasya somasya pānajātena ojasā balena viśvā bhuvanā sarvāṇi bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni abhi bhuvat abhivati |
‘somasya tā mada indraścakāra’ (ṛ. saṃ. 2. 15. 2) ityādiṣu somapānamade sarvāṇi vṛtrahananādikarmāṇaṇa cakāretyevamatrāpi sarvāṇi bhūtābhibhavanādīni karmāṇyākārṣīditi ||
prathame paryāye hotuḥ śakhe ‘tyamu vaḥ satrāsāham’ ityādisūktaśeṣaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhamiti sūktaśeṣo'bhi tyaṃ meṣam’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
asauryāme'cchāvākā- tiriktokthe ‘tyamu vaḥ satrāsāham’ iti tṛco vaikalpikaḥ stotriyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tyamu vaḥ satrā- sāhaṃ satrā te anu kṛtya iti vā stotriyānurūpau’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti |
vyūḻahasya daśa- rātrasya caturthe'hani niṣkevalya epa eva tṛco nividdhānīyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘imaṃ nu māthinaṃ huve tyamu vaḥ satrāsāham’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 8) iti ||
tyam | oṃ iti | vaḥ | satrā'saham | viśvāsu | gīrṣu | ā'yatam | ā | dhyavayasi | ūtaye ||7||

yajamānaḥ stotāraṃ saṃbodhyāha | he stotaḥ satrāsāham | satrāśabdo bahuvācī | bahūnāma- bhibhavitāram | yadvā | śatrūn svabalena saṃgatya jetāram | vaḥ yuṣmadīyeṣu viśvāsu gīrṣu sarveṣu stotreṣu āyataṃ vistṛtam | sarvatrendra eva stūyate | tasmātteṣu vitataṃ tyam | u ityavadhāraṇe | tamevendram ūtaye asmadrakṣaṇāya ā cyāvayasi | ‘cyuṅ pluṅ gatau’ | tvadīyaiḥ stotrairyajñaṃ pratyābhimukhyenāgamaya ||
yudham | santama | anrvāṇam | soma'pām | anapa'cyutam | naram | avārya'kratum || 8 ||

yudhaṃ śatrūṇāṃ saṃprāhārakaṃ santama ata eva anarvāṇam anyairapratyuttamabhigataṃ tasmāt anapacyutaṃ saṃgrāmeṣu śatrubhirhiṃsitaṃ somapāṃ somasya pātāramasya somasya made sati avāryakratuṃ aṭaranivāraṇīyakarmāṇaṃ naraṃ sarvasya netāram |
śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvā~ ṛcīṣama |
1. gha-vardhana hi | 2. na-śobhanasya | 3. kha-tan-bha1-2-śa-saṃprasārakaṃ; gha-saṃpratārakaṃ | 4. jha-ta1-2-3-śa-’rabhivāraṇīya’ |
śikṣa | naḥ | indra | rāyaḥ | ā | puru | vidvān | ṛcīṣama | arba | naḥ | pāryai | dhanai || 9 ||

he ṛcīṣama stutyā sama | yadvā | 'īṣa gatihiṃsādarśaneṣu' | asmādamapratyayaḥ | sarvairgantavya darśanīya vā | uktaguṇopeta he indra vidvān sarvaviṣayajñānavāṃstvaṃ śatrubhyaḥ āhṛtya rāyaḥ dhanāni naḥ asmabhyaṃ puru bahuvāraṃ śikṣa prayaccha | yadvā | purviti rāyo viśeṣaṇam | bahūni dhanāni prayaccha | kiṃca pāryai | pārāḥ śatravaḥ | tatra bhave dhane ājihīrṣite śatrudhane naḥ asmān ava rakṣa | śatrūn hatvā taddhanenāsmān pālayetyarthaḥ ||
ataḥ | cit | indra | naḥ | upa | ā | yāhi | śatavājayā | iṣā | sahasravājayā || 10 ||
he indra ataścit asmāt dyulokādeva yadvāsmāt śatrusthānāt śatavājayā śatasaṃkhyāka- balayuktena tathā sahasravājayā |
sahasrasaṃkhyākannavatā bahubalākhyena iṣā annarasena yuktaḥ san naḥ asmān upā yāhi adhikamābhimukhyenāgaccha ||
aryām | dhīvataḥ | dhiyaḥ | arbadbhiḥ | śakra | godare | jayema | putsu | vajrivaḥ || 11 ||
