he ṛtvigyaṣṭāra: ▼śrutaṃ balavattayā prasiddhamata eva ▼vṛtrahantam atiśayena vṛtrahantāraṃ ▼śardha balabhūtaṃ vegavantaṃ vā etādṛśamindraṃ ▼carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ▼va: yuṣmākam ▼āśuṣe |
ayā dhiyā ca gavyuyā puruṇāmanu-puruṣṭuta | yatsomaisom ābhava: ||17|| ayā | dhiyā | ca | gavyuyā | puru'nāmana | puru'stuta | yat | somai'some | ā | ābhava: ||17||
nāmayanti stutyaṃ devaṃ vaśaṃ nayantīti nāma stotram |
ata eva ▼puruṣṭuta bahubhirabhiṣṭutendra ▼somaisome asmadīyeṣu someṣu tvaṃ yadā ▼ābhava: teṣāṃ pānārthaṃ samantādabhava: tadā vayam ▼ayā anayā |
▼gavyuyā gā ātmana icchantyā ▼dhiyā anayā buddhayā yuktā bhavema |
somaṃ pītavati tvayi vayaṃ gavādimuktā bhavemetyartha: ||
1. ga-āhantavyasya | 2. na-bha-tadrūpasya vṛtrasya | 3. ga-na-bha-nidadhāti sma | 4. kha-ta-bha- iti | 5. ga-prakarṣeṇāśuṣe |
bodhita'rmanāḥ | it | astu | naḥ | vṛtra'hā | bhūri'āsutiḥ | śṛṇotu | śakraḥ | ā'śirṣam || 18 ||
bahuṣu deśeṣvindrārthaṃ soma āsūyate'bhipū- yata iti tādṛśaḥ |
yasya manaḥ stotṛṇāmabhimataṃ budhyate jānātīti tathoktaḥ |
tataḥ śakraḥ saṃgrāme śatruhananasāmarthya indraḥ āśipam asmadīyāṃ stutimāśāsanaṃ vā śṛṇotu ||
jyotiṣṭome cāturvaiśike'hani mādhyaṃdine maitrāvaruṇasya ‘kayā tvaṃ na ūtyā’ iti tṛco'nurūpaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘hotrakāṇāṃ kayā naścitra ā bhuvat kayā tvaṃ na ūtyā’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti ||
kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan | kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara || 19 || kayā | tvam | naḥ | ūtyā | abhi | pra | mandase | vṛṣan | kayā | stotṛbhyaḥ | ā | bhara || 19 ||
he vṛṣan kāmānāṃ varṣitarindra kayā kena ūtyā |
kenābhigamanena naḥ asmān abhi abhitaḥ pra mandase prakarṣeṇa mādayasi |
asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ prati somapānārthamāgamena vā tvadīyastutiśravaṇārthamāgamena vā kadāsmān pramādayasīti |
kiṃca kayā kenābhigamanena stotṛbhyaḥ asmabhyaṃ dhanam ā bhara ābhi- bharṣītīndraṃ stotā pṛcchati ||
kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvān vṛṣabho raṇat | vṛtrahā somapītaye || 20 || kasya | vṛṣā | sute | sacā | niyutvān | vṛṣabhaḥ | raṇat | vṛtra'hā | soma'pītaye || 20 ||

vṛṣā indraḥ kasya yajamānasya sacā sute ṛgbhiḥ sahābhipūte some | anena taddvān yajño lakṣyate | kasya yajñe somapītaye somapānāya tadarthaṃ raṇat ramate | kīdṛśaḥ | niyutvān | nitarāṃ yuvanti miśrayanti svabalena śatrūniti niyuto marutaḥ | taddvān | yadvā | niyuta iti vāyorvāhanāśvāḥ | sa vāyuḥ kadācit saṃgrāma indrāya svāśvānadāt | taddvān | vṛṣabhaḥ dhanānāṃ pā vā varṣakaḥ | vṛtrahā vṛtrasya hantendraḥ kasya yajñe ramate | idānīṃ no'smadīyaṃ yāgaṃ pratyāgacchatu | yadvā | kasyādhvare ramate | na kutrāpi | kiṃtvasmadyajña eva somapānārthaṃ saṃkrīḍate || 24 ||
abhī ṣu ṇastvaṃ rayiṃ mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam | prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe || 21 || abhi | su | naḥ | tvam | rayim | mandasānaḥ | sahasriṇam | pra'yantā | bodhi | dāśuṣe || 21 ||
he indra tvaṃ mandasānaḥ asmābhirdattena somena modamānaḥ san sahasriṇaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākaṃ dhanaṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ su suṣṭhu abhi ābhara |
tvaṃ dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya prayantā dhanādeḥ pradātā karmaṇo niyantā vā bhavānīti bodhi budhyasva |

1. kha-ta-śa-atha | 2. kha-jha-ta-2-3-stotriṇā | 3. kha-ga-ta-na-bha-śa- ‘abhi’ nāsti | 4. kha-ga-gha-jña-ta-2-na-ma-ṛtvibhiḥ | 5. kha-ta-na-bha-2-śa- ‘vāhanāśvāḥ te; bha1- ‘vāhanāśvāḥ se; bha3- ‘vāhanāśvāstaiḥ | 6. kha-ta-na-bha-nāsmadīyaṃ | 7. kha-ta-yajñaṃ | 8. gha-rayiṃ dhanaṃ | 9. ga-hedhi tve |

palīvantaḥ sutā ima uśantau yanti nītayai | apāṃ jagmirniśumpaṇaḥ || 22 || palīvantaḥ | sutāḥ | ime | uśantaḥ | yanti | vītayai | apām | jagmiḥ | ni'cumpaṇaḥ ||22|| palīvantaḥ | somasekārthe patnyaḥ pālayitavya āpo vasatīvarya ekadhanāśca | tadantaḥ sutāḥ asmābhirabhiputāḥ ime gṛhasthāśramasasthāśca somāḥ uśantaḥ ātmanaḥ pānaṃ kāmayamānāḥ santaḥ yanti indraṃ gacchanti | kimartham | vītaye ātmanaḥ pānāya | kiṃca nicumpaṇaḥ | 'nicāmtapaṇaḥ' (niru. 5. 17) iti yāskaḥ | 'camu adane' | nicānto bhakṣitaḥ punaḥ prīṇayitā | yadvā | 'nicamanena prīṇāti' iti bhakṣaṇena tarpayatīti nicumpaṇaḥ | abhiputasya somasyāpsu prakṣepasaṃbhavāt sāmarthyādajīṣarūpaḥ somo gṛhyate | tādṛśaḥ somaḥ apāṃ jagmiḥ | apāmiti 'na lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhābhāvaśchāndasaḥ | apa ityarthaḥ | yadvā | apāṃ madhyaṃ vāpaḥ prati vā jagmirgamanaśīlaḥ sādhugantā vā | somaścendraṃ gacchati | sa śavamṛthakāla' ṛjīṣamapsu prāsyantīti vacanādapsujīṣarūpaḥ prakṣipyate | tadāha apāṃ jagmiriti ||

iṣṭā hotrā asukṣatendraṃ vṛdhāsau adhvare | acchāvabhṛthamorjasā || 23 || iṣṭāḥ | hotrāḥ | asukṣata | indram | vṛdhāsaḥ | adhvare | acchā | ava'bhṛtham | orjasā ||23|| apāṃ jagmiriti sāmarthyādavabhṛthadina eva ---- ra - vi - jaḥ kurvantītyuktam | tadaprasaṅgādāha | adhvare asmadīye yajñe vṛdhāsaḥ havirbhirendraṃ vardhayantaḥ iṣṭāḥ iṣṭavanto yāgaṃ kṛtavantaḥ saptasaṃsthākāḥ hotrāḥ hotrakāḥ avabhṛtham anyadivasam accha prati ojasā svatejasā sahitāḥ indram asukṣata visṛjanti | yāvadavabhṛthaṃ sahotrakā yajantīti ||

iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā | voḻahāmabhi prayo hitam || 24 || iha | tyā | sadha'mādyā | harī iti | hiraṇya'keśyā | voḻahām | abhi | prayaḥ | hitam ||24|| eṣā vyākhyātā (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 32. 29) | atrāpi vākyārtho vidhīyate | sadhamādyā indreṇa saha havirbhistarpayitavyau yadvā saṃgrāme saha mācantau hiraṇyakeśyā hiraṇyaskandhagatakeśavantau tyā tau prasiddhau harī haritavarṇāvetannāmakāvaśvau iha asmin yajñe hitaṃ -- vādiṣu nihitaṃ hitakaraṃ vā prayaḥ havīrūpamannamabhilakṣya voḻahām indraṃ vahatām | prāpayatāmiti ||

tubhyaṃ somāḥ sutā ime strīṇa barhirvibhāvaso | stotṛbhya indramā vaha || 25 || tubhyam | somāḥ | sutāḥ | ime | stīrṇam | barhiḥ | vibhāvaso iti vibhā'vaso | stotṛ'bhyaḥ | indram | ā | vaha || 25 || he vibhāvaso viśeṣeṇa bhāsamānavasumana | yadvā | viśiṣṭā bhā vibhāḥ prakṛṣṭadīsayaḥ | tā nivasantyatreti vibhāvasurabhiḥ | he tādṛśāme tubhyaṃ tvadartham ime somāḥ sutāḥ abhiputāḥ | tathā barhiḥ stīrṇam | tasmāt stotṛbhyaḥ asmabhyamasmadartham indraṃ somapānārtham ā vaha āhvaya | yajñaṃ prati prāpayetyarthaḥ || || 25 ||

ā te da॒kṣaṃ vi ro̭canā dadha॒tnā vi dā॒śuṣḙ | sto॒tṛbhya̭ indra॒marca̭ta || 26 || ā | te | da॒kṣam | vi | ro॒canā | da॒dhat | ratnā | vi | dā॒śuṣḙ | sto॒tṛbhya̭: | indra̭m | a॒rcata̭ || 26 ||
he yaṣṭaḥ dāśuṣe indrāya havirdattavate te tubhyaṃ rocanā rocanaṃ dīpyamānaṃ dakṣaṃ balam ā ābhimukhyena vi dadhat indro vidadhātu |
tathā ratnā ratnāni ca tubhyaṃ karotu |
he stotāra: stotṛbhya: indraviṣayastotrakāribhyo' yuṣmabhyaṃ ca balaratnādikamindra: kurutām |
tasmāt tam indraṃ yūyam arcata havirbhi: stutibhiśca pūjayata ||

ā tḙ dadhāmīndriyamu॒kthā viśvā̭ śa॒takra̭to | sto॒tṛbhya̭ indra mṛḻaya ||27|| ā | te | da॒dhāmi̭ | i॒ndri॒yam | u॒kthā | viśvā̭ | śa॒takra̭to iti śata'krato | sto॒tṛbhya̭: | indra̭ | mṛ॒ḻaya̭ || 27 ||
he śatakrato indra te tava indriyaṃ vīryavantaṃ somaṃ viśvā ukthā sarvāṇi stotrāṇi ā dadhāmi saṃpādayāmi |
he indra tvaṃ stotṛbhya: mṛḻaya sukhaya ||

bha॒draṃ bha̭draṃ na॒ ā bha̭ra॒ iṣa̭mūrjaṃ śa॒takra̭to | ya॒dindra̭ mṛ॒ḻayā̭si naḥ || 28 || bha॒dram'bha̭dram | na॒: | ā | bha॒ra | iṣa̭m | ū॒rjam | śa॒takra̭to iti śata'krato | yat | indra̭ | mṛ॒ḻayā̭si | na॒: || 28 ||
he śatakrato śatavidhakarman śataprajña vā indra bhadrabhadraṃ kalyāṇatamatha sukhotpādakaṃ vā dhanaṃ na: asmabhyam ā bhara āsaṃpādaya dehi |
tathā iṣam annam ūrjam annarasaṃ yadvā balavadannaṃ ca dehi |
na: asmān yat yadi mṛḻayāsi sukhayasi tarhi tadanādikaṃ dehīti |

sa no̭ viśvā॒nyā bha̭ra su॒vi॒tāni̭ śa॒takra̭to | ya॒dindra̭ mṛ॒ḻayā̭si naḥ || 29 || sa | na॒: | viśvā̭ni | ā | bha॒ra | su॒vi॒tāni̭ | śa॒takra̭to iti śata'krato | yat | indra̭ | mṛ॒ḻayā̭si | na॒: || 29 ||
he śatakrato indra sa: pūrvoktalakṣaṇastvaṃ viśvāni sarvāṇi suvitāni |
he indra yadi na: asmān sukhayasi tarhi dhanādisahitānbhyudayāna dehīti ||
tvāmi̭dvṛtrahantama su॒tāva̭ṃto havāmahe | ya॒dindra̭ mṛ॒ḻayā̭si naḥ || 30 || tvām | it | vṛ॒tra॒han'ta॒ma | su॒tā'va̭ntaḥ | havā̭mahe | yat | indra̭ | mṛ॒ḻayā̭si | na॒: || 30 ||
he vṛtrahantama atiśayena vṛtrasyāpāmāvarakasya hantarindra sutavantaḥ abhiṣutasomavanto vayam |
he indra naḥ asmān yadi sukhayasi tarhyāhvayāma iti ||
vyūḻahasya daśarātrasya ṣaṣṭhe'hani niṣkevalye 'upa no haribhiḥ' iti tṛco nividdhānīyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ayaṃ ha yena vā idamupa no haribhiḥ sutam' (āśva. śrau. 8. 8) iti ||
urpa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate | urpa no haribhiḥ sutam || 31 || urpa | naḥ | hari'bhiḥ | sutam | yāhi | madānām | pate | urpa | naḥ | hari'bhiḥ | sutam ||31||
somānāṃ svāmibhindra haribhiḥ 'ā śatena haribhiḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 2.18.6) ityādiṣu bahūnāmaśvānāṃ śruterapi śatasahasrasaṃkhyakairdhaiḥ saha naḥ asmākaṃ yajñe sutam abhiṣutaṃ somam upa yāhi |
dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ | urpa no haribhiḥ sutam || 32 || dvitā | yaḥ | vṛtrahan'tamaḥ | vide | indraḥ | śata'kratuḥ | urpa | naḥ | hari'bhiḥ | sutam ||32||
vṛtrahantamaḥ atiśayena vṛtrasya hantā śatakratuḥ nānāvidhakarmā yaḥ indraḥ dvitā dvidhā vide vṛtravadhādyupakramā jagadrakṣaṇakāle śāntakarmeti dvipakāreṇa sarvairjñāyate |
karmaṇi vihitasya tapratyayasya 'lopasta ābhanepadeṣu' iti talopaḥ |
sa tvaṃ haribhiḥ saha sutaṃ somupayayāhi ||
tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanveṣā pātā somānāṃmi | urpa no haribhiḥ sutam || 33 || tvam | hi | vṛtrahan | eṣām | pātā | somānām | asi | urpa | naḥ | hari'bhiḥ | sutam ||33||
he vṛtrahan vṛtrasya pāpasya vā hantarindra |
yasmāt tvam eṣām asmadīyānāṃ somānāṃ pātā pānakartā asi bhavasi |
atastvam adhaiḥ saha somaṃ pātumupayāhi āgaccha ||
vyūḻahasya daśarātrasya navame'hani vaiśvadeve abhiplavatpṛṣṭhasya 'indra iṣe dadātu naste no ratnāni dhattana' iti dve ṛcāvārambhyau |
sūtritaṃ ca—'indra iṣe dadātu naste no ratnāni dhattanyekā dve ca' (āśva. śrau. 8. 11) iti ||
indraṃ iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇamṛbhuṃ rayim | vājī dadātu vājinam || 34 || indraḥ | iṣe | dadātu | naḥ | ṛbhukṣaṇam | ṛbhum | rayim | vājī | dadātu | vājinam ||34||
indraḥ evāsmābhiḥ stuta iṣṭaḥ san ṛbhukṣaṇam |
yāgādi- karmakaraṇena mahāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhrātṛṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vā |
rathi dātāram ṛbhuṃ somapānenāmartyatvaṃ prāptaṃ tādṛśametādṛśamakaṃ devaṃ naḥ asmabhyam ||

tatra 'gaurdhayati ' iti dvādaśarcamādyaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya bindunāmna: pūtadakṣanāmno vārṣa gāyatraṃ marudevatākam |
tathā cānukramyate—'gaurdhayati dvādaśa bindu: pūtadakṣo vā mārutam' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'asti somo ayaṃ suto gaurdhayati marutāmiti stotriyānurūpau' (āśva. śrau. 6. 7) iti ||

ayaṃ purovartī somaḥ sutaḥ marudarthamasmābhirabhiṣuta: asti vidyate | tasmāt bhasya | anvādeśe | enaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ svarāja: svayaṃ dīpyamānā: | svatejasā nānyadīyenetyartha: | tādṛśā: marutaḥ pibanti | uta api ca aśvinā aśvinau ca somaṃ pibata: ||
pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇa: |

pibanti | mitra: | aryamā | tanā | pūtasya | varuṇa: | tridhasthasya | jāḍavata: || 5 || na kevalaṃ maruta eva somapātāra: kiṃvete'pītyāha | mitra: sarveṣāṃ svasvakamaṇi pravartakatvāt sakhibhūta: aryamā ca varuṇa: du:khādīnāṃ śatrūṇāṃ vā varitā nivāraka: | etannāmakāvayo devā: tanā | tatūrṇāstṛkeneti tanaṃ daśāpavitram | 'supāṃ suluk0' iti tṛtīyāyā ālādeśa: | tanāyudāttaḥ | tanā pūtasya śodhitaṃ trisadhasthasya | saha tiṣṭhantyatreti sadhasthaṃ sthānam | droṇakalaśāvanīyapūta- bhṛdātmāni trīṇi sthānāni yasya taṃ tathoktaṃ tādṛśaṃ jāvata: | stutyajanavantamabhimaṃ somaṃ pibanti | dvitīyapārthe ṣaṣṭhya: ||
uto nvasya joṣamā~ indra: sutasya gomata: |
uto iti | nu | asya | joṣam | ā | indra: | sutasya | gomata: | prāta: | hotā'iva | matsati || 6 ||

uto api ca indra: sutasya asmābhirabhiputasya gomata: gavyairmiśraṇavata: asya | anvā- deśa: | pūrvadaśāpavitreṇa pūtasya somasya joṣaṃ pānarūpāṃ sevāṃ prāta: prāta:savane nu kṣipram ā matsati | madi stutyādiṣu | ābhimukhyena stauti | yadvā | somasevāṃ kāmayate | tatra dṛṣṭānta: | hoteva | yathā hotā prāta:savane devānabhiṣṭauti devān stotuṃ vābhivāñchati || || 28 ||
kat | atvipanta | sūrya: | tira: | ārpa:'iva | sirdha: | arpanti | pūta'dakṣasa: || 7 ||
āpaiva udakānīva tira: yathodakāni tiryagacchanti tadvistarīngataya: santaḥ |
kiṃca sirdha: śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakā hantārasta ime marutaḥ pūtadakṣasa: śuddha- balā: santaḥ kadā vā arpanti |
kat | va: | agha | mahān | devānām | ava: | vṛṇe | tanā | ca | dusma'varcasām ||8||
he marutaḥ mahān mahanīyānāṃ mahatāṃ vā tmanā ca ātmanaivālaṃkaraṇairvināpi dasmarcasāṃ darśanīyatejaskānāmat eva devānāṃ dyotamānānāṃ va: yuṣmākam ava: pālanaṃ kat kadāhaṃ vṛṇe |

atra ‘indro vai vṛtraṃ haniṣyan’ (ai. brā. 3. 20) ityādi brāhmaṇamanusaṃdheyam ||
tri: puṣṭitvā maruto vāvṛdhānā utsrāīva raśayau yajñiyāsa: |
upa tvema: kṛdhi nau bhāgadheyaṃ śubhaṃ ta enā haviṣā vidhema ||
triḥ | ṣaṣṭiḥ | tvā | marutaḥ | vavṛdhānāḥ | utsāḥ'iva | rāśayaḥ | yajñiyāsaḥ | urpa | tvā | ā | imaḥ | kṛdhi | naḥ | bhāga'dheyam | śubham | te | enā | haviṣā | vidhema || 8 ||
te ca taittirīyake 'ihaṃścānyāhaśca' (tai. saṃ. 4. 6. 5. 5) ityādinā navasu gaṇepu sasa sasa pratipāditāḥ |
'svatavāṃśca praghāsī ca sāṃtapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca śākī cojjeṣī' (vā. saṃ. 17. 85) iti khailikaḥ ṣaṣṭho gaṇaḥ |
itthaṃ trayaḥ- ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāḥ 'utsāhava 'rāśayaḥ gāva iva saṃghībhūtāste tvāṃ 'vāvṛdhānāḥ svabalena vardhitavantaḥ |
paścādvayamapi 'enā anena somalakṣaṇena 'haviṣā 'te tubhyaṃ 'śubhaṃ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ balaṃ 'vidhema |
tigmamāyudhaṃ marutāmanīkaṃ kasta indra prati vajraṃ dadharṣa |
anāyudhāso asurā adevāścakreṇa tā~ arpa vapa ṛjīṣin ||
tigmam | āyudham | marutām | anīkam | kaḥ | te | indra | prati | vajram | dadharṣa | anāyudhāsaḥ | asurāḥ | adevāḥ | cakreṇa | tān | arpa | vapa | ṛjīṣin || 9 ||
tatra 'marutāṃ trayaḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākānāṃ tvatsahāyānām 'anīkaṃ saṃghaṃ ca tvadīyaṃ 'vajraṃ ca 'kaḥ ko vā devo manuṣyo vā 'prati 'dadharṣa pratikūlamabhibhavati |
ata eva 'anāyudhāsaḥ dhanu- rādyāyudhavarjitāḥ 'adevāḥ devavarjitā devadviṣo ye 'asurāḥ santi he 'ṛjīṣin |
tadvacchindra 'tān asurān 'cakreṇa cakrasamānavīryeṇa cakrarūpeṇa vajreṇa vā 'apa 'vapa apagatān kuru |
maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktiṃ preraya śivartamāya paśvaḥ |
girvāise gira indrāya pūrvīrdhehi tanve kuvidaṅga vedat ||
maha | ugrāya | tavase | suvṛktim | preraya | śivartamāya | paśvaḥ | girvāise | giraḥ | indrāya | pūrvīḥ | dhehi | tanve | kuvit | aṅga | vedat || 10 ||
yadvā paśoratīndriyārthaṃ dṛṣṭamaṃ dhanādikaṃ dātuṃ gave sukhādikaṃ pradātumindrāya stutiṃ preraya |
he stotaḥ 'girvāise gīrbhiḥ stutibhirahamā- nāya 'indrāya 'pūrvīḥ bahvīḥ 'giraḥ stutīḥ 'dhehi kuru |

tanūstanayaḥ | tasmai putrāya svaśarīrāyātmane vā kuvit | bahunāmatat | bahu dhanam aṅga kṣipraṃ vevat lambhayatu dadātu | 'vidu lābhe' | levyaḍāgamaḥ | kuvicchabdayogādanighātaḥ || 33 || ukthavāhase vimbai manīṣāṃ duṇā na pāramīṃrayā nadīnām | ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvidṅga vedat || 11 || uktha'vāhase | vi'mbai | manīṣām | duṇā | na | pāram | īrayā | nadīnām | ni | spṛśa | dhiyā | tanvi | śrutasya | juṣṭatarasya | kuvit | aṅga | vedat || 11 || he stotaḥ ukthavāhase ukthaiḥ stotraśastrādibhirbrahyamānāya ata eva vimbe mahate yadvā śatrūṇāmabhibhavitra indrāyendrārthaṃ manīṣāṃ manasa īṣāṃ stutim īraya preraya | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | duṇā na yathā nāvikaḥ nadīnāṃ nadamānānāṃ saritāṃ pāraṃ tīraṃ prati pathikaṃ duṇā nāvā prāpayati tadvadindraṃ prati stutiṃ gamayeti2 | kiṃca ni spṛśa nitarāṃ dhanaṃ sparśaya gamaya tanvi ātmani putre vā | kīdṛśam | śrutasya sarvatra viśrutasya prasiddhasya juṣṭatarasya atyarthaṃ prīṇayiturindrasya svabhūtam | dhanaṃ dhiyā tvadīyayā stutyā karmaṇā vātmānaṃ gamaya | tatastvayābhidhuta indraḥ kuvit bahu dhanaṃ kṣipraṃ3 vedat lambhayatu dadātu || tadviddhi yatta indro jujoṣattuhi suṣṭutiṃ namasā vivāsa | upa bhūṣa jaritarmā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvaya vācai kuvidṅga vedat || 12 || tat | vi'viddhi | yat | te | indraḥ | jujoṣat | stuhi | su'stutim | namasā | ā | vivāsa | upa | bhūṣa | jaritaḥ | mā | ruvaṇyaḥ | śravarya | vācam | kuvit | aṅga | vedat || 12 || he ṛtvik tat somādihaviḥ stotraṃ vā vividdhi vyāpaya | tānīndrārthaṃ kurvityarthaḥ | te tava svabhūtaṃ yat haviḥ stotraṃ vā indraḥ jujoṣat svīkuryāt tatkuru | 'jupī prītisevanayoḥ' | leṭi śapaḥ śruḥ | aḍāgamaḥ | chāndasatvāt nābhyastasya iti guṇapratiṣedhābhāvaḥ | he stotaḥ suṣṭutiṃ sustutim | śobhanā stutiryasya sa tathoktaḥ | tādṛśamindraṃ stuhi | tathā namasā stotreṇa haviṣā vā ā vivāsa indramābhimukhyena paricara | vivāsatiḥ paricaraṇakarmā | loṭi rūpam | he jaritaḥ stotaḥ upa bhūṣa | 'bhūṣa alaṃkāre' | alaṃkṛto bhava | mā ruvaṇyaḥ dhanābhāvāt mā dhvanayaḥ | mā rodīrityarthaḥ | dhanāgamane kāraṇamāha | he stotaḥ vācaṃ stutimindraṃ śrāvaya jñāpaya | tatastvayā stuta indrastvamya kuvit bahu dhanaṃ kṣipraṃ4 prayacchatu || pṛṣṭhaṣaḍahatepūkathyepu5 tṛtīyasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsiśastre 'ava drapsaḥ' iti tṛcaḥ | sūtriṃtaṃ ca— 'ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhaditi tisro'cchā ma indramiti nityamaikāhikam' (āśva. śrau. 8. 3) iti || ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhadiyanaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | āvattamindraḥ śacyā dhamantamupa slehītīrmaṇā adhatta || 13 ||
1. kha-īrārthaṃ | 2. kha-gha-ta-bha-śa-gamayediti | 3. kha-gha-jña-ta1-2-aṃga kṣipraṃ | 4. gha-aṃga kṣipraṃ vedat | 5. kha-ta-śa-pūkteṣu; bha1-°pūkteṣu |
arva | drapsaḥ | aṃśumatīm | atiṣṭhat | iyānaḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ | daśabhiḥ | sahasraiḥ | ārvat | tam | indraḥ | śacyā | dharmantam | apa | snehitīḥ | nuḍmanāḥ | adhatta || 13 ||
kṛṣṇo nāmāsuro daśasahasrasaṃkhyairasuraiḥ parivṛtaḥ saṃśumatīnāma- dheyāyā nadyāstīre'tiṣṭhat2 |
tatra taṃ kṛṣṇamudakamadhye sthitamindro bṛhaspatinā sahāgacchat |
āgatya taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tasyānucarāṃśca bṛhaspatisahāyo jaghāneti |
drapsa ityudakakaṇo'bhidhīyate' sa tu somo 'drapsaścaskanda' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 17. 11) ityādiṣu somaparatvenoktatvāt |
ntīti vājiḥ saṃgrāmaḥ | tasmin yudhyata saṃharata | vākyabhedādanighātaḥ | kecit iṣyāmi vo marutaḥ iti paṭhanti | tatra he marutaḥ vo yuṣmānicchāmītyartho bhavati ||

ardha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe'dhārayattanvaṃ tiviṣāṇaḥ | viśvo adaivīrbyāicarantīrbṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe || 15 || ardha | drapsaḥ | aṃśumatyāḥ | upasthe | adhārayat | tanvam | tiviṣāṇaḥ | viśvaḥ | adaivīḥ | abhi | ā'carantīḥ | bṛhaspatinā | yujā | indraḥ | sasahe || 15 ||
vatha vdrapsaḥ vdrutagāmī kṛṣṇaḥ vaṃśumatyāḥ vnadyāḥ vupasthe vsamīpe vtiviṣāṇaḥ dīpya mānaḥ san vtanvam vātmīyaṃ vśarīram vadhārayat vparairahiṃsyatvena bibharti |
tathā ca nigamaḥ—‘kutsāya śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ ni barhīḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 16. 12) iti |
tathā he indra tvaṃ śacyā svakīyayā prajñayā karmaṇā vā gāḥ śatrūn hatvā teṣāṃ gāḥ avindaḥ alabhathāḥ |
tvaṃ ha tyadṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṃ ghno vṛtrāṇāṃ taviṣo babhūtha |
tvam | ha | tyat | vṛṣabha | carṣaṇīnām | ghnaḥ | vṛtrāṇām | taviṣaḥ | babhūtha | tvam | sindhūn | asṛjaḥ | tastabhānān | tvam | apaḥ | ajayaḥ | dāsapatnīḥ ||
saḥ | vṛtra'hā | indraḥ | carṣaṇi'dhṛt | tam | su'stutyā | havyam | huvema | saḥ | pra'avitā | magha'vā | naḥ | adhi'vaktā | saḥ | vājasya | śravasyasya | dātā ||2||
vṛtrahā vṛtrasya hantā saḥ indraḥ carṣaṇīdhṛt manuṣyāṇāṃ dhanādidānena poṣakaḥ bhavati |
tam indraṃ vayaṃ sustutyā śobhanayā stutyā huvema asmadyajñeṣvāhvayāmaḥ |
saḥ indraḥ prāvitā prakarṣeṇāsmākaṃ rakṣitā bhavati |
kiṃca maghavā dhanavānindraḥ naḥ asmākam adhivaktā adhikaṃ vaktā bahumānena vaktā bhavati |
kiṃca saḥ evendraḥ śravasyasya śravasaḥ kīrternimittasya vājasya annasya |

sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva | kṛṇvannapāṃsi naryā puruṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ || 21 || saḥ | vṛtra'hā | indraḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | sadyaḥ | jajñānaḥ | havyaḥ | babhūva | kṛṇvan | apāṃsi | naryā | puruṇi | somaḥ | na | pītaḥ | havyaḥ | sakhibhyaḥ || 21 ||
ṛbhubhiḥ saha kṣiyati niva- satīti tādṛśaḥ |
vṛtrahā saḥ indraḥ sadyaḥ tadānīmeva jajñānaḥ prādurbhavan havyaḥ sarvaiḥ stotṛbhiḥ yaṣṭṛbhirāhvātavyo babhūva |
tebhyo hitāni puruṇi bahūni apāṃsi karmāṇi kṛṇvan kurvan sakhibhyaḥ haviṣpradānenopakārakatvānmitrabhya ṛtvigbhyaḥ havyaḥ āhvātavyo havanayogyo vābhūt |
somo na yathā pītaḥ somo yaṣṭavyaḥ svargādiphalāni kurvan devairāhvātavyo bhavati tadvat ||
‘yā indra’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ kāśyapasya rebhasyārṣamendram |
śiṣṭā cānukramyate—‘yā indra pañconā rebhaḥ kāśyapo bārhatamatijagatpariṣṭhādvṛtrahyāvatajagatī triṣṭubjagatyantyantaḥ’ iti |
mahāvrate niṣkevalye bārhatanucāśītau ‘yā indra’ ityādikā narcaḥ |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūyate—‘yā indra bhuja ābhara iti nava sūdadohāḥ’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 4) iti |
cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyandinasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsino vaikalpikānurūpataccasya ‘yā indra’ ityādike dve dvitīyātṛtīye |
sūyate ca—‘tamindraṃ johavīmi yā indra bhuja ābhara ityekā dve ca’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti ||

yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvā asurebhyaḥ | stotāraminmaghavansya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ || 1 || yā | indra | bhujaḥ | ā | ābharaḥ | svaḥ'vān | asurebhyaḥ | stotāram | it | maghavan | asya | vardhaya | ye | ca | tve | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ || 1 ||
ṛṣirindraṃ prārthayate | he indra svarvān sukhavān svargavān vā | athavā svaḥśabdaḥ sarva- paryāyaḥ | sarvaṃ bhūtajātam | ātmana evotpannatvātsadrāt | evaṃguṇastvaṃ yāḥ yāni bhujaḥ bhoktavyāni
dhanāni ᵥasurebhyaḥ balavadbhyo rākṣasebhyaḥ ᵥābharaḥ āharaḥ tān hatvāhatavānasi |
ata eva he ᵥmaghavan dhanavannindra ᵥasya |
etasyāhatasya dhanasya dānena ᵥstotāramit tava stotrakāriṇameva ᵥvardhaya vṛddhimantaṃ kuru |
ᵥye ᵥca anye yaṣṭāraḥ ᵥsve svadarthaṃ ᵥvṛktabarhiṣaḥ stīrṇabarhiṣo bhavanti atastāṃśca dhanena vardhaya ||

yamindra dadhiṣe tvamaśvaṃ gāṃ bhāgamavyayam | yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmintaṃ dhehi mā paṇau || 2 || yam | indra | dadhiṣe | tvam | aśvam | gām | bhāgam | avyayam | yajamāne | sunvati | dakṣiṇā'vati | tasmin | tam | dhehi | mā | paṇau || 2 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥtvaṃ ᵥyam ᵥaśvaṃ gamanasādhanān harīn ᵥgām agnihotrakarmaṇi pathaḥpradānenopa- kārikā gāḥ ᵥavyayaṃ vyayarahitamaviśvaraṃ ᵥbhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ dhanam |
etān ᵥ śatrubhya āhatya ᵥdadhiṣe bibharṣi taṃ sarvaṃ ᵥsunvati somābhiṣavaṃ kurvati ᵥdakṣiṇāvati yajña ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇādeyatvena taddhati ᵥyajamāne yāgaṃ kurvāṇe ᵥtasmin ᵥtvaṃ ᵥdhehi |

ya īndra sastyavrato'nuṣvāpamadaivyuḥ | svaiḥ pa evairmuratapoṣyaṃ rayiṃ saṃnutadhehi taṃ tataḥ || 3 || yaḥ | indra | sasti | atrataḥ | anu'svāpam | adaiva'yuḥ | svaiḥ | saḥ | evaiḥ | muurat | poṣyam | rayim | sanutaḥ | dhehi | tam | tataḥ || 3 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥadevayuḥ devān yuṣmānakāmayamānaḥ ᵥavataḥ vratahitaḥ karmarahito bhūtvā ᵥanu- svāpam anuvṛttasvamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥyaḥ ᵥsasti svapiti |
ᵥsaḥ janaḥ ᵥsvaiḥ ātmīyaiḥ ᵥevaiḥ gamanairaiva ᵥpoṣyaṃ poṣaṇīyaṃ ᵥrayiṃ svīyaṃ dhanaṃ ᵥmumurat mārayatu vināśayatu |
amāgaṇpūṃtādibhistasya ᵥdhanaṃ naśyatu na tu devānāṃ haviṣpradāneneti |
sanutaḥ antarhite karmarahite kasmiściddeśe ᵥdhehi sthāpaya ||

yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvarti vṛtrahan | atastvā gīrbhiryugadindra keśibhiḥ sutāvā~ ā vivāsāti || 4 || yat | śakra | asi | purā'varti | yat | arvā'varti | vṛtra'han | ataḥ | tvā | gīḥ'bhiḥ | yu'gata | indra | keśi'bhiḥ | suta'vān | ā | vivāsāti || 4 ||

he ᵥśakra śatruhananasamarthendra ᵥyat yadā ᵥparāvati viprakṛṣṭe'tidūre dyuloke deśe ᵥasi vidyase he ᵥvṛtrahan vṛtrasya hantīndra ᵥyat yadi ᵥarvāvati arvācīne tasmādadhastātsthite tadapekṣayā samīpe deśe'ntarikṣe bhavasi tasmādapi ᵥataḥ asmāllokādvā ᵥyugata |

dyulokaṃ prati gacchadbhiḥ svabhāsā sarvato gacchadbhiḥ <sup>v</sup>keśabhiḥ keśavadbhirharibhiriva sthitābhiḥ <sup>v</sup>gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ <sup>v</sup>tvā tvāṃ <sup>v</sup>sutavān abhiṣutasomavān yajamānaḥ <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>vivāsati|
ātmīyaṃ yajñaṃ pratyāgamayati tvāmetaiḥ stotraiḥ paricaratīti vā|
yatpārthive sardane vṛtrahantam yadantarikṣa ā gahi ||
yat| vā| āsī| rocane| divaḥ| samudrasya| adhi| viṣṭapi| yat| pārthive| sardane| vṛtrahan'tam| yat| antarikṣe| ā| gahi || 5 ||
he indra <sup>v</sup>yadvā yadi vā <sup>v</sup>divaḥ dyulokasya <sup>v</sup>rocane dīpanaśīle sthāne’ bhavasi|
yadvā <sup>v</sup>samudrasya madhye <sup>v</sup>adhi adhigate <sup>v</sup>viṣṭapi viṣṭape tatsaṃbaddhe kasmiṃścit sthāne bhavasi|
he <sup>v</sup>vṛtrahantama atiśayena vṛtrasyāsurasya pāpasya vā hantarendra <sup>v</sup>yat yadi vā <sup>v</sup>pārthive pṛthivyāṃ bhave <sup>v</sup>sadane sthāne vidyase|
yatrakutra bhavasi tathāpyasmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ prati <sup>v</sup>ā <sup>v</sup>gahi āgaccha|
sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasaspate|
mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvata indra rāya parīṇasā ||
saḥ| naḥ| someṣu| soma'pāḥ| suteṣu| śavasaḥ| pate| mādayasva| rādhasā| sūnṛtā'vata| indra| rāyā| parīṇasā || 6 ||

he <sup>v</sup>somapāḥ somasya pātaḥ he <sup>v</sup>śavasaspate balasya pālayitaḥ <sup>v</sup>indra <sup>v</sup>saḥ pūrvoktalakṣaṇastvaṃ <sup>v</sup>suteṣu asmābhirabhiṣuteṣu <sup>v</sup>someṣu <sup>v</sup>naḥ asmān <sup>v</sup>rādhasā balasādhanenānnena <sup>v</sup>sūnṛtāvatā anṛta-rahitatvopetena <sup>v</sup>yadvā|
mā ne indra parā vṛṇagvā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ|
tvaṃ ne ūtī tvamindra āpyaṃ mā ne indra parā vṛṇak ||
mā| naḥ| indra| parā| vṛṇak| vā| naḥ| sadhamādyaḥ| tvam| naḥ| ūtī| tvam| indra| āpyam| mā| naḥ| indra| parā| vṛṇak || 7 ||
kiṃca he indra <sup>v</sup>naḥ asmān <sup>v</sup>tvam eva <sup>v</sup>ūtī ūtyā sthāpaya|
kicci' vā nipātitaḥ' | tvamevāsmākaṃ rakṣitā khalu | tathā tvamit | idvadhāraṇe | tvameva asmākam āpyaṃ jñātayam | tvameva bandhurityarthaḥ | ata eva mā na indra parā vṛṇak ityeṣa gatārthaḥ ||

asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu | kudhī jaritre maghavanvau mahadasme indra sacā sute || 8 || asme iti | indra | sacā | sute | ni | sada | pītaye | madhu | kudhi | jaritre | maghavan | arvāḥ | mahat | asme iti | indra | sacā | sute || 8 ||
he indra asme asmābhiḥ sacā saha sute abhiṣute some ni ṣada asmadīye yajñe niṣīda |
kiṃca he maghavan dhanavan indra mahat avaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ jaritre kṛdhi kuru |
asme indra sacā sute iti vyākhyātaḥ pādaḥ ||

na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ | viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūrasi na tvā devāsa āśata || 9 || na | tvā | devāsaḥ | āśata | na | martyāsaḥ | adrivaḥ | viśvā | jātāni | śavasā | abhibhūḥ | asi | na | tvā | devāsaḥ | āśata || 9 ||
he adrivaḥ vajravannindra tvā tvāṃ devāsaḥ tvadanye sarve devāḥ na āśata |
svakarmaṇā sva- balena vā na vyāpnuvanti |
na martyāsaḥ martyā manuṣyāśca na vyāpnuvanti |
viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi jātāni bhūtajātāni śavasā svabalenaiva abhibhūrasi |
tasmāt na tvā devāsa āśata iti gatārthaḥ ||

'atha te' iti dvādarcaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ bhṛgugotrasya nemasyārṣam |
'ayamasmi jaritaḥ' iti dvenendro nemasamīpametya svakīyaṃ māhātmyamavocat atastasya dvacasya sa evarṣiḥ 'yasya vākyaṃ sa ṛṣiḥ' (anu. 2. 4) iti nyāyāt |
tathā cānukrāntam— ayaṃ te dvādaśa namo bhārgavastraiṣṭubhaṃ ṣaṣṭhī jagatau paśastisro'nuṣṭubho'yamiti dvenendra ātmanamastau- dupāntye vācyau' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'yadvāgvadantyavicetanāni pataṅgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti |
pūrvokta eva paśau 'devīṃ vācam' iti haviṣo yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'devīṃ vācamajanayanta devā janīyanto nvagrava iti tisraḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'kanikradajjanuṣaṃ prabuvāṇa iti sūkte japeddevīṃ vācamajanayanta devā iti ca' (āśva. gṛ. 3. 10. 9) iti ||

ayaṃ te emi tanvā purastādviśvai devā abhi mā yanti paścāta | yadā mahyaṃ dīrgho bhāgamindrādinamayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi || 1 || ayam | te | emi | tanvā | purastāt | viśvai | devāḥ | abhi | mā | yanti | paścāta | yadā | mahyam | dīrghaḥ | bhāgam | indra | āt | it | mayā | kṛṇavaḥ | vīryāṇi || 1 || he vindra vte tava vpurastāt agrataḥ vtanvā putreṇa saha vayam aham vemi śatrūnabhibhavituṃ gacchāmi | tavāgrato gacchantaṃ māṃ vviśvai vdevāḥ tvayā saha vpaścāt vabhi vyanti abhigacchanti | vyadā tvaṃ vmahyaṃ bhārgavāya nemāya vbhāgaṃ śatruṣu sthitaṃ bhāgaṃ vdīrghaḥ dhārayasi vādit anantara- meva vmayā saha macchatrūnjetuṃ vvīryāṇi pauruṣāṇi vkṛṇavaḥ kuru | yadi śatruṣu sthitaṃ dhanaṃ mahyaṃ vitsasi^2 tarhi śatrujayārthaṃ gacchataḥ saputrasya mama sāhāyyaṃ kurviteti bhāvaḥ ||

dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣamagre hitastai bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ | asaśca tvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūrī || 2 || dadhāmi | te | madhunaḥ | bhakṣam | agre | hitaḥ | te | bhāgaḥ | sutaḥ | astu | somaḥ | asaḥ | ca | tvam | dakṣiṇataḥ | sakhā | me | adhā | vṛtrāṇi | jaṅghanāva | bhūrī || 2 || he indra vte tubhyaṃ vmadhunaḥ madakarasya somasya vbhakṣamagre prathamaṃ vdadhāmi dhārayāmi | vsutaḥ vabhiṣutaḥ vbhāgaḥ bhajanīyaḥ vsomaḥ vte tava hṛdaye vhitaḥ nihitaḥ vastu bhavatu | api ca vtvaṃ vme mama vdakṣiṇataḥ dakṣiṇapārśve vsakhā san vasaḥ sthito bhava | adha atha vbhūri bahūni vvṛtrāṇi asmadīyānchatrūn vjaṅghanāva tvamahaṃ cobhau āvāṃ hanvaḥ ||
pra su stomaṃ bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṃ yadi satyamasti |
nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṃ dadarśa kamabhi bravāma ||

pra | su | stoma̭m | bharata | vāja̭'yantaḥ | indra̭ya | sa॒tyam | yadi̭ | sa॒tyam | asti̭ | na | indra̭: | asti̭ | iti̭ | nermaḥ | oṃ iti̭ | tvaḥ | āha̭ | kaḥ | īm | dadarśa̭ | kam | abhi̭ | stuvāma || 3 ||
ᵛindrāya ᵛsatyaṃ satyabhūtaṃ ᵛstomaṃ ᵛsu suṣṭhu ᵛpra ᵛbharata |
ᵛnema ᵛu bhārgavo nema eva ᵛindraḥ nāma ᵛhvaḥ kaścit ᵛna ᵛasti iti ᵛāha |
ataḥ ᵛkaṃ vayam ᵛabhi ᵛṣṭvāma abhiṣṭumaḥ |
viśvā | ita | tā | te | sarvaneṣu | pra'vācyā | yā | cakrathai | magha'van | indra | sunvate | pārāvatam | yat | puru'saṃbhṛtam | vasu | apa'avṛṇoḥ | śarabhāya | ṛṣi'bandhave || 6 ||
svasamīpamāgatamindraṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtuṣṭa ṛṣirendrasya vividhāni karmāṇi dānaṃ ca ‘viśvattā te’ ityanena ṛcena stauti |
he maghavanindra tvaṃ savaneṣu yajñeṣu sunvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate yajamānāya yā yāni karmāṇi cakratha akaroḥ te tava tā tāni karmāṇi pravācyā pravaktavyāni viśvet anantānyeva |
kiṃca tvaṃ pārāvataṃ parāvatnāma kasya kasyacicchatroḥ svabhūtaṃ yat dhanamasti tat ṛṣibandhave śarabhāya śarabhanāmna ṛṣaye apāvṛṇoḥ apavṛtavānasi |
pra nūnaṃ dhāvatā pṛthaghe yo vo avāvarit |
ni ṣīṃ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajramindro apīpatat ||
pra | nūnam | dhāvata | pṛthak | na | iha | yaḥ | vaḥ | avāvarīt | ni | sīm | vṛtrasya | marmaṇi | vajram | indraḥ | apīpatat || 7 ||

yaḥ śatruḥ nūnam idānīṃ pra dhāvata pradhāvati pṛthak iha pṛthak tiṣṭhati ca vaḥ yuṣmān na avāvarīt na vicārayati ca tasya vṛtrasya śatroḥ marmaṇi marmasthāne indraḥ vajraṃ kuliśaṃ ni apīpatat nitarāmapātayat ||
divaṃ suparṇo gatvāya somaṃ vajriṇa ābharat ||
manaḥ'javāḥ | ayamānaḥ | āyasīm | atarat | puram | divam | su'parṇaḥ | gatvāya | somam | vajriṇe | ābharat || 8 ||
suparṇaḥ garutmān manojavāḥ manovegaḥ ayamānaḥ gacchan āyasīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ puraṃ nagarīm atarat atārīt |
tataḥ divaṃ svargaṃ gatvāya gatvā vajriṇe indrāya somam ābharat āharacca ||
samudre antaḥ śayata udrā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ |
samudre | antaḥ | iti | śayate | udrā | vajraḥ | | abhi'vṛtaḥ | bharanti | asmai | sam'udyataḥ | puraḥ'prasavaṇāḥ | balim || 9 ||
yaḥ vajraḥ samudre antaḥ samudrasya madhye śayate śete yaśca udrā udakena abhivṛtaḥ asmai vajrāya saṃyataḥ saṃgrāmasya |
puraḥprasavaṇāḥ purastādgacchataḥ śatravaḥ balim upahāraṃ bharanti dhārayanti |
catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi ka svitsyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma ||

v rāṣṭrī rājanaśīlā vdevānāṃ vmandrā mādayitrī' vā vyat yadā vvāk vavicetanāni vijñānarahitānaprajñātānarthān vvadantī prajñāpayantī vniṣasāda yajñe niṣīdati tadā vcatasraḥ diśaḥ prati vūrjam annaṃ vpayāṃsi tatkāraṇabhūtāni udakāni vduduhe |
vasyāḥ mādhyamikāyā vācaḥ svabhūtaṃ yat vparamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat vka vjagāma ka gacchatīti na dṛśyata ityarthaḥ |

tathā ca yāskaḥ—'yadvā- gadantyavicetanānvijñānāni rāṣṭrī devānāṃ niṣasāda mandrā madanā catasro'nu diśa ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi ka svitsyāḥ paramaṃ jagāmeti svapṛthivīṃ gacchatīti vā yadādityaraśmayo harantīti vā' (niru. 11. 28) iti ||

devī vācamajanayanta devāstāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti | sā nau mandreṣamūrjaṃ duhānā dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaitu || 11 || devīm | vācam | ajanayanta | devāḥ | tām | viśvarūpāḥ | paśavaḥ | vadanti | sā | naḥ | mandrā | iṣam | ūrjam | duhānā | dhenuḥ | vāk | asmān | upa | su'stutā | ā | etu || 11 || eṣā mādhyamikā vāk sarvaprāṇyantaḥpātā dharmābhivādinī bhavatīti vibhutimupadarśayati' | yāṃ vdevīṃ dyotamānāṃ mādhyamikāṃ vvācaṃ vdevāḥ mādhyamikāḥ vajanayanta janayanti vtāṃ vācaṃ vviśvarūpāḥ sarvarūpā vyaktavāco'vyaktavācaśca vpaśavo vvadanti | tatpūrvakaratvādvākpravṛtteḥ | vsā vvāk devī vmandrā madanā stutyā harṣayitrī vā vṛṣṭipradānenāsmabhyam viṣam annam vūrjaṃ payo- ghṛtādirūpaṃ rasaṃ ca vduhānā kṣarantī vdhenuḥ dhenubhūtā vsuṣṭutā asmābhiḥ stutā' vasmān nemān vupa vetu vupagacchatu | varṣaṇāyoyuktetyarthaḥ | tathā ca yāskaḥ—'devīṃ vācamajanayanta devāstāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti vyaktavācaścāvyaktavācaśca sā no madanāṃ ca rasaṃ ca duhānā dhenu- rvāgasmānupaitu suṣṭutā' (niru. 11. 29) iti ||

sakhai viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva dyaurdehi lokaṃ vajrāya viṣkambhe | hanāva vṛtraṃ riṇacāva sindhūnindrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ || 12 || sakhai | viṣṇo | iti | vi'taram | vi | kramasva | dyauḥ | dehi | lokam | vajrāya | vi'skambhe | hanāva | vṛtram | riṇacāva | sindhūn | indrasya | yantu | pra'save | vi'sṛṣṭāḥ || 12 || he vsakhe vviṣṇo tvaṃ vvitaram atyantaṃ vvi vkramasva vikramaṃ kuru | he vdyauḥ tvaṃ vvajrāya vajrasya vviṣkambhe viṣkambhanāya vlokam avakāśaṃ vdehi prayaccha | he viṣṇo tvaṃ cāhaṃ cobhau āvāṃ
tamimamarthaṃ saṃgṛhya ślokaiḥ śaunako darśayati— ‘ trīllokānbhivatsyaitān vṛtrastasthau svayā riṣā ||
tadetadakhilaṃ proktaṃ sakhe viṣṇo iti tvacā’ (bṛhade. 6. 121-124) iti ||

atrānukramyate—‘ ṛdhak ṣoḍaśa jamadagnibhārgavo maitrā- varuṇaṃ prāgāthaṃ tritriṣṭhubantaṃ tṛtīyādi gāyatrī satobṛhatī stotraṃ rājasvaksapādādityāśvinyau^ vāyavye sauyau^ bṛhatpyupasthā sūryaprabhāstutirvā pāvamānī gadye ’ iti |
‘ stotraṃ rājasu gāyata ’ iti pādena sahitā ‘ te hinvira ’ ityādidevatākā |
‘ ā me vacāṃsi iti dve adhidevatāke^ |
‘ ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśam ’ iti dve vāyvaidevatye |
‘ baṇmahā~ asi sūrya ’ iti dve sūryadevatāke |
saṃgrāmārthaṃ rājñaḥ saṃhanane^ ‘ pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ’ iti dve rājānaṃ vācayet |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ abhīvartaṃ vācayati pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇeti ca dve ’ (āśva. gṛ. 3. 12. 12) iti |
pṛṣṭhasya pañcame'hani prauge vāyavyatṛcasya ‘ ā no yajñaṃ ’ ityādike dve ṛcāvācaye |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśamiti dve ā no vāyo mahe tana ityekā ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 12) iti |
aśvinaṃ śaṃsipyan hotā ‘ baṇmahā~ asi sūrya ’ iti dvābhyāmiṃ juhuyāt |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ baṇmahā~ asi sūryati dvābhyāmindra vo viśvatasparīti ca ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ baṇmahā~ asi sūryodu tyaharśataṃ vapuriti pragāthau stotriyā- nurūpau ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 7) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ śrāyantaiva sūrya baṇmahā~ asi sūrya ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti |
madhuparke gāmutsṛjya ‘ mātā rudrāṇām ’ iti japet |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāmiti japitvotmutsṛjateyustvakṣan^ ’ (āśva. gṛ. 1. 24. 25) iti ||

ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatāṃtaye | yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāviṣtya ācuke havyadāṃtaye || 1 || ṛdhak | ityā | saḥ | martyaḥ | śaśame | deva'tāṃtaye | yaḥ | nūnam | mitrāvaruṇau | abhiṣṭaye | ā'cuke | havya'dāṃtaye || 1 ||

^thaḥ manuṣyaḥ ^nūnaṃ kṣipraṃ ^havyadāṃtaye haviṣā pradātre yajamānāya ^mitrāvaruṇau ^abhiṣṭaye abhimatasiddhayartham ^ācakre abhimukhī karoti ^saḥ ^martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ^ṛdhak satyam ^itthā itthaṃ ^devatātaye yajñārthaṃ ^śaśame haviḥ saṃskaroti ||
3. kha-ta-na-bha- rājasviti sapādā°; ga-rajasviti sapādā; śa-rājasvagiti sapādā |
8. kha-ta1-2-3- 4-na-japitvā gāmutsṛjatetyutsyan; bha-japitvā gāmutsṛtetyutsyan; śa-japitvā gāmutsṛtetyutstryan |

varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣā narā rājānā dīrghaśrutamā | tā bāhutā na daṃsanā ratheyataḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ || 2 || varṣiṣṭha'kṣatrau | uru'cakṣasā | narā | rājānā | dīrghaśruta'tamā | tā | bāhutā | na | daṃsanā | ratheyataḥ | sākam | sūryasya | raśmi'bhiḥ || 2 || varṣiṣṭhakṣatrau atiśayena vṛddhabalau urucakṣasā mahādarśanau narā netārau karmaṇāṃ rājānā dīpyamānau dīrghaśrutamā atiśayena vidvānau tā tau mitrāvaruṇau bāhutā na bhujāviva sūryasya raśmibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ sākaṃ saha daṃsanā daṃsanāni karmāṇi | 'amaḥ' daṃsaḥ ' iti karmanāmasu pāṭhāt | ratheyataḥ prāpnutaḥ | yathā bāhū saha karma prāpnutaḥ tathā mitrāvaruṇau saha yajñaṃ prāpnuta ityarthaḥ ||

pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇājiro dūto adravat | aryaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ || 3 || pra | yaḥ | vām | mitrāvaruṇā | ajiraḥ | dūtaḥ | adravat | aryaḥ'śīrṣā | made'raghuḥ ||3|| he mitrāvaruṇau vāṃ yuvām ajiraḥ gamanaśīlaḥ yaḥ yajamānaḥ pra adravat abhigacchati sa devānāṃ dūtaḥ bhavati | athaḥśīrṣā hiraṇyālaṃkṛtaśiraskaśca bhavati | maderaghuḥ madakare dhane gantā ca bhavati ||

na yaḥ saṃpṛcche na punarhavītve na saṃvādāya ramate | tasmāno adya samrateruruṣyataṃ bāhubhyāṃ na uruṣyatam || 4 || na | yaḥ | sam'pṛcche | na | punaḥ | havītve | na | sam'vādāya | ramate | tasmāt | naḥ | adya | sam'ṛteḥ | uruṣyatam | bāhu'bhyām | naḥ | uruṣyatam || 4 || yaḥ śatruḥ saṃpṛcche saṃpraśnāya na ramate na krīḍate na ca punaḥ havītve havanāya ramate na ca saṃvādāya ramate tasmāt śatroḥ samrateḥ saṃgrāmāt naḥ asmān adya uruṣyataṃ he mitrāvaruṇau yuvāṃ rakṣatam | kiṃca tasya śatroḥ bāhubhyāṃ naḥ asmān uruṣyataṃ rakṣatam ||

pra mitrāya prāryumṇe sacadhyamṛtāvaso | varūthyaṃ varuṇe chandyaṃ varcaḥ stotraṃ rājasu gāyata || 5 || pra | mitrāya | pra | aryamṇe | sacadhyam | ṛta'vaso | varūthyam | varuṇe | chandyam | varcaḥ | stotram | rājasu | gāyata || 5 || he ṛtavaso yajñadhana mitrāya sacadhyaṃ sevārthaṃ varūthyaṃ yajñagṛhaṃ bhava ca stotraṃ pra gāyata | aryamṇe ca pra gāyata | varuṇe chandyaṃ prīṇasādhanaṃ caitādṛśaṃ vacaḥ pra gāyata | pragāyata iti bahuvacanaṃ pūjārtham | etadeva darśayati | rājasu mitrādiṣu rājasu stotraṃ gāyata paṭhata | mitrādīnbhīprājñaḥ stuteti samudāyārthaḥ || 6 ||
1. kha-ga-jñāta-1-2-apaḥ apanaḥ | 2. kha-ta-na-bha-śā-gamanaśilopi; ga-gha-gamanaśilopi yo | 3. kha-ta-'na' nāsti | 4. kha-gha-bha-1-3-na ramate |

te hinvire arṷṇaṃ jenya̭ṃ vasveka̭ṃ pu॒traṃ ti॒sṛṇām | te dhā॒mānya̭mṛtā ma॒rtyānāma̭dabdhā a॒bhi ca̭kṣate || 6 || te | hi॒nvi॒re | a॒ru॒ṇam | je॒nyam | va॒sṷ | eka̭m | pu॒tram | ti॒sṛṇām | te | dhā॒māni̭ | a॒mṛtā̭: | ma॒rtyānā̭m | a॒dabdhāḥ | a॒bhi | ca॒kṣate || 6 ||
paaruṇam aruṇavarṇaṃ pajenyaṃ jayasādhanaṃ pavasu vāsakaṃ patisṛṇāṃ pṛthivyādīnām paekaṃ paputraṃ pate devāḥ pahinvire prerayanti trailokyasya tamonivāraṇāya |
kiṃca padabdhāḥ kenāpyahiṃsitāḥ paamṛtāḥ3 maraṇarahitāḥ3 pate devāḥ pamartyānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ padhāmāni sthānāni paabhi pacakṣate abhi paśyanti ||

ā me॒ vacā̭ṃsyudyatā ghuma̭ttāni ka॒rvā | u॒bhā yāta̭ṃ nāsatyā sa॒joṣā̭ prati॒ havyā̭ni vī॒tayḙ || 7 || ā | me॒ | vacā̭ṃsi | u॒t'dyatā | ghuma̭t'tāni | ka॒rvā | u॒bhā | yā॒tam | nā॒sa॒tyā | sa॒'joṣā̭ | pra॒ti | ha॒vyā̭ni | vī॒tayḙ || 7 ||

he panāsatyā nāsatyau satyasya praṇetārī4 pasajoṣā saṃgatau paubhā ubhau yuvāṃ pame jamadagnermama paudyatā udyatāni paghumattāni dīsatāmāni pavacāṃsi stotrarūpāṇi vākyāni pakarvā karmāṇi ca paā payātam |
kiṃca pahavyāni havīṃṣi pavītaye bhakṣaṇāya paprati gacchatam ||

ra॒tiṃ yadvā̭ma॒rakṣa̭saṃ ha॒vāmahe॒ yuvā̭bhyāṃ vā॒jinī̭vasū | prā॒cīṃ hotā̭raṃ pra॒tira̭ntāvi॒taṃ na̭rā gṛ॒ṇānā̭ jama॒dagni̭nā || 8 || ra॒tim | yat | vā॒m | a॒rakṣa̭sam | ha॒vā॒mahḙ | yu॒vā̭bhyām | vā॒jinī̭'vasū iti vājinī̭'vasū | prā॒cīm | hotā̭ram | pra॒'ti॒ra॒ntau | i॒tam | na॒rā | gṛ॒ṇānā̭ | jama॒t'a̭gninā || 8 ||
he pavājinīvasū annadhanāvaśvinau pavāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandha payat arakṣasaṃ rakṣovarjitaṃ dānamasti tat yadā pahavāmahe5 |
payuvābhyāṃ kriyamāṇā6 parātri dānaṃ havāmahe iti |
tadānīṃ paprācīṃ prāṅmukhāṃ pahotrāṃ stutiṃ papratirantau vardhayantau panarā netārau pajamadagninā ṛṣiṇā gṛṇānāṃ stūyamānau ca santo paitam āgacchatam ||

ā no̭ ya॒jñaṃ di॒vispṛ̭śaṃ vā॒yo yā̭hi su॒manma̭bhiḥ | a॒ntaḥ pa॒vitra̭ṃ u॒pari̭ śrī॒ṇāno̭'yaṃ śu॒kro a̭yāmi te || 9 || ā | na॒ḥ | ya॒jñam | di॒vi'spṛ̭śam | vā॒yo iti̭ | yā॒hi | su॒manma̭'bhiḥ | a॒ntaḥ | pa॒vitra̭m | u॒pari̭ | śrī॒ṇāna̭ḥ | aya̭m | śu॒kraḥ | a॒yāmi̭ | te || 9 ||

1. ga-ta-śa-jayanasādhanaṃ | 2. ga-na-bha2-3-tisṛṇāṃ | 3. kha-ga-ta1-2-3-śa-amaraṇāḥ sahitāḥ; jha-amṛtāḥ amaraṇasahitāḥ; na-amṛtāḥ amaraṇarahitāḥ | 4. na-bha-praṇetārī vā | 5. gha-jha-havāmahe yācāmahe | 6. ga-kriyamāṇaṃ |
he ᵥvāyo tvaṃ ᵥna: asmākaṃ ᵥdivispṛśaṃ taṃ ᵥyajñam ᵥā ᵥyāhi |
ᵥsumanobhi: sustutibhi: ᵥantaḥ ᵥpavitre pavitrasya madhye ᵥupari ᵥśrīṇāna: śriyamāṇo niṣicyamāna: ᵥayaṃ ᵥśukra:1 soma: ᵥte tubhyam ᵥayāmi niyata āsīditi ||

vetya̭dhva॒ryuḥ pṛthi॒bhī ra̭ji॒ṣṭhaiḥ prati̭ ha॒vyāni̭ vī॒tayḙ | a॒rdhā ni॒yutva̭ u॒bhaya̭sya naḥ pi॒ba śu॒ciṃ soma̭ṃ ga॒vāśi̭ram || 10 || veti | a॒dhva॒ryuḥ | pṛ॒thi॒'bhiḥ | ra॒ji॒ṣṭhaiḥ | prati̭ | ha॒vyāni̭ | vī॒tayḙ | a॒rdha | ni॒yutva̭ | u॒bhaya̭sya | naḥ | pi॒ba | śu॒cim | soma̭m | go'śi̭ram || 10 ||
he ᵥniyutva: niyutsaṃjñakāśvavan vāyo ᵥadhvaryu: havirdhānāt ᵥrajiṣṭhai: ṛjutamai: ᵥpathabhi: mārgai: ᵥveti gacchati |
ᵥvītaye bhakṣaṇāya tava bhakṣaṇāni ᵥhavyāni havīṃṣi ca ᵥprati nayatīti śeṣa: |
ᵥadha atha ᵥna: asmākaṃ saṃbandhanam ᵥubhayasya ubhayavidhaṃ somam |
ᵥśuci śuddhaṃ ᵥsomaṃ ᵥgavāśiraṃ gavyena payasā miśritaṃ ceti ||

ba॒ṇmahā~ a̭si॒ sūrya̭ ba॒ḻādi̭tya ma॒hā~ a̭si | ma॒hastḙ su॒to ma̭himā॒ pana̭syate॒'ddhā dḙva ma॒hā~ a̭si || 11 || baṭ | ma॒hān | a॒si | sūrya̭ | baṭ | ā॒di॒tya | ma॒hān | a॒si | ma॒haḥ | te॒ | sa॒taḥ | ma॒himā̭ | pa॒na॒syatḙ | a॒ddhā | de॒va | ma॒hān | a॒si || 11 ||
he ᵥsūrya tvaṃ ᵥmahān tejasādhika: ᵥbaṭ satyam |
he ᵥāditya adite: putra tvaṃ ᵥmahān balenāpyadhika:2 ᵥasi |
ᵥmaha: mahata: ᵥsata: bhavata: ᵥte ᵥmahimā mahasvaṃ ᵥpanasyate stotṛbhi: stūyate |
he ᵥdeva dyotanādiguṇayukta sūrya tvaṃ ᵥmahān vīryeṇā- pyadhika: ᵥasi bhavasi |

ba॒t sūrya̭ śra॒vasā̭ ma॒hā~ a̭si sa॒trā dḙva ma॒hā~ a̭si | ma॒hā de॒vānā̭masu॒ryaḥ pu॒rohi̭to vi॒bhu jyo॒tirā̭da॒bhyam || 12 || baṭ | sūrya̭ | śra॒vasā̭ | ma॒hān | a॒si | sa॒trā | de॒va | ma॒hān | a॒si | ma॒hā | de॒vānā̭m | a॒su॒ryaḥ | pu॒raḥ'hi̭taḥ | vi॒'bhu | jyo॒tiḥ | a॒dā॒bhyam || 12 ||
he ᵥsūrya tvaṃ ᵥśravasā śravaṇena ᵥmahān sarvāṃdhika: ᵥasi ᵥbaṭ satyam |
he ᵥdeva dyotamāna sūrya tvaṃ ᵥdevānāṃ madhye ᵥmahā mahatvena ᵥmahān adhika: ᵥasi ᵥsatrā satyameva |
kiṃca te ᵥjyoti: teja: ᵥvibhu mahat ᵥadāmyaṃ kenāpyahiṃsyaṃ ca ||
i॒yaṃ yā nī॒cyaki̭rṇī॒ rūpā̭ ro॒hiṇyā̭ kṛ॒tā |
iyam | yā | nīcīṃ | arkiṇīṃ | rūpā | rohiṇyā | kṛtā | citrā'īya | prati | adarśi | ā'yatī | antaḥ | dṛśa'su | bāhuṣu || 13 ||

^yā ^iyaṃ ^nīcī avāṅmukhī ^arkiṇī stuti- matī ^rūpā rūpavatī ^rohiṇyā prakāśayuktā ^kṛtā uṣāḥ ^sūryaprabhā votpāditā ^sā ^antaḥ brahmāṇḍasya madhye ^bāhuṣu bāhusthānīyāsu ^daśasu daśasaṃkhyākāsu dikṣu ^āyatī āgacchantī ^citreva citrā gauriva ^pratyadarśi sarvairadṛśyata ||
prajā ha tisro atyāramīyunya ^nyā arkamabhito viviśre |
bṛhadva tasthau bhuvaneṣvantaḥ parvamāno harita ā viveśa ||
pra'jāḥ | ha | tisraḥ | ati'āryam | īyuḥ | ni | anyāḥ | arkam | abhitaḥ | triviśre | bṛhat | ha | tasthau | bhuvaneṣu | antariti | parvamānaḥ | haritaḥ | ā | viveśa || 14 ||
yāḥ ^tisraḥ ^prajāḥ ^atyāyamīyuḥ atyāyamāyan ^anyāḥ tā imāḥ prajāḥ ^arkam arcanīya- mabhima ^abhito ^viviśre abhito niviṣṭāstato na parābabhūvuḥ |
tathā caitareyabrāhmaṇaṃ—'prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyuriti yā vai tā imāḥ prajā- stisro atyāyamāyantānīmāni vayāṃsi vajñāvagadhāśverapādāḥ |

nyanyā arkamabhito viviśra iti tā imāḥ prajā arkamabhito niviṣṭā imamevāgniṃ bṛhat tasthau bhuvaneṣvantarityada u eva bṛhadbhuvaneṣvantara- sāvādityaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśeti vāyureva pavamāno diśo harita āviṣṭaḥ' (ai. ā. 2. 1. 1) iti |

vājasaneyino'pyāmanti—'sa tapa'tapyata sa prajā asṛjata tā asya prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ parābabhūvustānīmāni vayāṃsi' ityupakramya 'prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyuriti yā amūḥ prajā atyāyan^ nyanyā^ arkamabhito viviśra ityabhirvā arkastamimāḥ prajā abhito niviṣṭāstā imāḥ parābhūtāḥ |
bṛhadva tasthau bhuvaneṣvantariti prajāpatimevaitadabhyanūktaṃ pavamāno harita ā viveśeti diśo vai haritastā ayaṃ pavamāna āviṣṭaḥ' (śa. brā. 2. 5. 1. 1-5) iti ||
mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ khasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ |
pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa ||
mātā | rudrāṇām | duhitā | vasūnām | svasā | ādityānām | amṛtasya | nābhiḥ | pra | nu | vocam | cikituṣe | janāya | mā | gām | anāgām | aditima | vadhiṣṭa || 15 ||

yā gauḥ ^rudrāṇāṃ marutāṃ ^mātā jananī ^vasūnāṃ ^duhitā putrī ^ādityānāṃ ^svasā bhaginī ^amṛtasya payasaḥ ^nābhiḥ āvāsasthānaṃ tām ^anāgām anāgasam ^aditim adīnāṃ ^gāṃ gorūpāṃ devīṃ ^mā ^vadhiṣṭa he janāḥ mā hiṃsiṣṭeti ^cikituṣe cetanāvate ^janāya ^nu idānīṃ ^pra ^vocam ahaṃ prāvocamiti śuśrūṣamāṇebhya upadeśaḥ ||
1. kha-uṣasā sūrye votpādyāditā prabhā; ga-na-bha-śa-uṣasā sūryeṇa votpāditā prabhā; ta-uṣasā sūrye votpāditā prabhā |
devīṃ devebhyaḥ paryyuṣāṃ gāmā mavṛkta matyoṃ dabhracetāḥ ||
vacaḥ'vidam | vācam | ut'īrayantīm | viśvābhiḥ | dhībhiḥ | upa'tiṣṭhamānām | debīm | devebhyaḥ | pari | ā'īyuṣīm | gām | ā | mā | avṛkta | matyaiḥ | dabhracetāḥ ||16||
vacovidaṃ vacaso lambhayitrīṃ vācam udīrayantīṃ payaḥ pītvā paścādvācamudīrayantīm |
kṣudhito hi jano na vācamudīrayati bhuktvā paścādudīrayati |
viśvābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ dhībhiḥ vāgbhiḥ upatiṣṭhamānāṃ devīṃ dyotamānāṃ devebhyaḥ devārthaṃ mā mām eyuṣīm avagacchantīṃ gāṃ dabhracetāḥ alpabuddhiḥ matyaiḥ manuṣyaḥ pari ā avṛkta parivarjayati ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ— 'tvamagne vyadhikā bhārgavaḥ prayogo bārhaspatyo vābhiḥ pāvakaḥ sahasaḥ sutayorvāggyogṛhapatiya- vidyuyorvā'nyatara āgneyaṃ tu' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tvamagne bṛhadya itiṣṭādaśarcastveti sūkte' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tvamagne bṛhadyo havyavāḻabhi- rajaraḥ pitā naḥ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 11) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā savaṃ savituryathā sa no rādhāṃsya bhara' (āśva. śrau. 2. 8) iti |
ābhilavikeṣūktheyeṣu tṛtīyasavane maitrāvaruṇasya 'agni vo vṛdhantam' iti vaikalpikaḥ stautriyastṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'agni vo vṛdhantame yaṃ yajñamadhvaram' (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti |
daśame'hani 'imaṃ no yajñam' iti stokasūktasya dvitīyasya sthāne 'agne ghṛtasya' ityeṣā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'stokasūktasya dvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ sthāne'gne ghṛtasya dhotibhirdhume suśrandra sarpiṣa ityete' (āśva. śrau. 8. 12) iti ||
tvam | agne | bṛhat | vayaḥ | dadhāsi | deva | dāśuṣe | kaviḥ | gṛhapatiḥ | yuvā ||1||
he deva dyotamāna agne kaviḥ krāntakarmā gṛhapatiḥ gṛhapālakaḥ yuvā niyatataruṇaḥ tvaṃ dāśuṣe haviṣā pradātre yajamānāya bṛhadyaḥ mahadannaṃ dadhāsi prayacchasītyarthaḥ ||
sa nu īḻānayā saha devā~ agne duvasyuvā |
saḥ | naḥ | īḻānayā | saha | devān | agne | duvasyuvā | cikit | vibhānā iti vi'bhāno | ā | vaha ||2||
he vibhāno viśiṣṭadīpte agne saḥ tvaṃ cikit jñātā san naḥ asmākaṃ duvasyuvā paricaraṇaśīlayā īḻānayā stuvatyā vācā saha devān ā vaha ||
tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya |
tvayā | ha | scit | yujā | vayam | codiṣṭhena | yaviṣṭhya | abhi | smaḥ | vāja'sātaye ||3||

he yaviṣṭhya yuvatamāgne codiṣṭhena atiśayena dhanānāṃ prerayitrā tvayā yujā scit ha sahāyenaiva vayaṃ bhārgavaḥ prayogo bārhaspatyāḥ pāvakā agnayo vā vājasātaye annalābhāya abhi ṣmaḥ śatrūnabhibhavema ||
aurvabhṛgu'vat | śucima | apravāna'vat | ā | huve | agnim | samudra'vāsasam || 4 ||
samudravāsasaṃ samudramadhyavartinaṃ vāḍavaṃ śuciṃ śuddham abhim aurvabhṛguvat yathā aurvabhṛguḥ apravānavat yathāpnavānaḥ tathā ā huve āhvayāmyaham ||
huve | vāta'svanam | kavim | parjanya'krandam | sahaḥ | agnim | samudra'vāsasam || 5 ||
vātasvanaṃ vātasadṛśadhvaniṃ kaviṃ krāntakarmāṇaṃ parjanyakrandaṃ parjanyasadṛśakrandanaṃ sahaḥ sahasvinaṃ vāḍavam abhi huve hvayāmi |
ā sarvaṃ savituryathā bhagasyeva bhujiṃ huve |
ā | savam | savituḥ | yathā | bhagasya'iva | bhujim | huve | agnim | samudra'vāsasam || 6 ||
savituḥ prerakasya devasya savaṃ yathā prasavamiva bhagasyeva bhujiṃ bhagasyeva devasya bhogamiva ca samudravāsasam agniṃ huve āhvayāmi ||
agnim | vaḥ | vṛdhantam | adhvarāṇām | puru'tamam | acchā | naptre | sahasvate || 7 ||
adhvarāṇām ahiṃsānāṃ balināṃ naptre bandhuṃ sahasvate balavantam |
vṛdhantaṃ jvālābhirvardhamānaṃ purutamam atiśayena bahum abhim ṛtvijaḥ vaḥ yūyam acchā abhigacchata ||
ayaṃ yathā na ābhuvat rūpeva takṣyā |
ayam | yathā | naḥ | ā'bhuvat | taṣṭā | rūpā'iva | takṣyā | asya | kratvā | yaśasvataḥ ||8||
ayam agniḥ naḥ asmān takṣyā vikartavyāni rūpeva tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi vardhakiriva yathā yena prakāreṇa ābhuvat ābhavati tathainamabhiprabhigacchatetyarthaḥ |
kiṃca vayam asya agre kratvā prajñānena yuktāḥ yaśasvataḥ yaśasvanto bhavāmeti śeṣaḥ ||
2. kha-ta1-3-bhārgavaḥ prayogāḥ; ga-tara-bha1-2-śa- bhārgavāḥ prayogāḥ; gha-mārgavādayaḥ; jha-bhārgavaḥ prayogaḥ; ta4-bhārgavaḥ prāyogāḥ; na-bhārgavāḥ prāyogāḥ |
5. kha-tara-prabhava; ga-prasavaṃ ca; gha- prabhavaṃ; jha-prasavatva; ta1-3-prabhavatva; ta4-prabhava ca; na-prabhavamiva; śa-prabhavaṃ ca |
9. kha-ta-na-bha2-vardhakiṃca; gha-vardhakaḥ iva; bha1- vardhakiva; hā-vardhakaḥ ca |

ayaṃ virvā abhi śriyo'bhirdeveṣu patyate | ā vājairupa no gamat || 9 || ayam | virvāḥ | abhi | śriyaḥ | agniḥ | deveṣu | patyate | ā | vājaiḥ | upa | naḥ | gamat ||9|| manuṣyāṇāṃ virvāḥ sarvāḥ śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ deveṣu devānāṃ madhye yaḥ ayam abhi abhi patyate abhigacchati so'gniḥ naḥ asmānapi vājaiḥ annaiḥ upa ā gamat upāgacchatu ||

viśveṣāmiha stuhi hotṝṇāṃ yaśastamam | agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam || 10 || viśveṣām | iha | stuhi | hotṝṇām | yaśaḥ'tamam | agnim | yajñeṣu | pūrvyam || 10 || viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ hotṝṇāṃ madhye yaśastamaṃ yaśasvitamaṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ mukhyam agnim iha asmadīye yajñe he stotaḥ stuhi || 10 ||

śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣvā | dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ || 11 || śīram | pāvaka'śociṣam | jyeṣṭhaḥ | yaḥ | dameṣu | ā | dīdāya | dīrghaśrut'tamaḥ || 11 || jyeṣṭhaḥ devānāṃ mukhyaḥ dīrghaśruttamaḥ atiśayena vidvān agniḥ dameṣu yajvanāṃ gṛheṣu ā dīdāya ādīpyate | taṃ śīram anuśāyinam | tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘anuśāyinamiti vāśinamiti vā’ (niru. 4. 14) iti | pāvakaśociṣaṃ pāvakadīptiṃ stuhītyarthaḥ ||

tamarvantaṃ na sānasiṃ gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam | mitraṃ na yātayajjanam || 12 || tam | arvantam | na | sānasim | gṛṇīhi | vipra | śuṣmiṇam | mitram | na | yātayat'janam || 12 || he vipra medhāvin stotaḥ arvantaṃ aśvamiva sānasiṃ saṃbhajanīyaṃ śuṣmiṇaṃ balinaṃ mitraṃ na sakhāyamiva yātayajjanaṃ śataśatrujanaṃ tam agniṃ gṛṇīhi stuhi ||

upa tvā jāmayo giro derdiśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ | vāyoranīke asthiran || 13 || upa | tvā | jāmayaḥ | giraḥ | derdiśatīḥ | haviṣkṛtaḥ | vāyoḥ | anīke | asthiran || 13 || he agne haviṣkṛtaḥ yajamānārthaṃ giraḥ stutayaḥ jāmayaḥ svasāra iva derdiśatīḥ tava guṇān diśantyaḥ tvā tvāmupatiṣṭhante | vāyoranīke samīpe tvāṃ samedhayantyaḥ asthiran atiṣṭhaṃśca ||

yasya tridhātvavṛtaṃ barhistathāvasaṃdinam | āpaścid dadha padam || 14 || yasya | tri'dhātu | avṛtam | barhiḥ | tasthau | asam'dinam | āpaḥ | cit | ni | dadhuḥ | padam || 14 || yasya agneḥ tridhātu triḥ avṛtam anāvṛtaṃ ca asaṃdinam abaddhaṃ ca | staraṇakāle hi barhirbaddhaṃ bhavati | barhistasthau āsanātha tiṣṭhati tasminnagnau āpaścit āpo'pi padaṃ ni dadhati | antarikṣā mādhyamike pade nidadhatītyarthaḥ ||
6. kha-jña-tara-3-4-bha1-2-trirvā avṛtamanāvṛtaṃ; ga-gha-amṛtamanāvṛtaṃ; ta1-trirvā avṛtaṃ; na-trirvāataṃnātṛtaṃ |
padaṃ devasya mīḻahuṣo'nādhṛṣṭābhirūtibhiḥ | bhadrā sūryaivopudak || 15 || padam | devasya | mīḻahuṣaḥ | anādhṛṣṭābhiḥ | ūtibhiḥ | bhadrā | sūryaḥ'iva | upa'dṛk || 15 ||
▼mīḻahuṣaḥ kāmānāṃ sektuḥ ▼devasya dyotamānasyāgneḥ ▼padaṃ sthānam ▼anādhṛṣṭābhiḥ śatrubhiḥ anādhṛṣṭābhiḥ ▼ūtibhiḥ rakṣābhirbhajanīyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
tathaivāsya ▼upadṛk upadṛṣṭirapi ▼sūryaiva yathā sūryastadvat ▼bhadrā manuṣyairbhajanīyā bhavati ||
agne ghṛtasya dhītibhistepāno deva śociṣā | ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca || 16 || agne | ghṛtasya | dhīti'bhiḥ | tepānaḥ | deva | śociṣā | ā | devān | vakṣi | yakṣi | ca || 16 ||
he ▼deva dyotamāna ▼agne ▼ghṛtasya dīptisādhanasyājyasya ▼dhītibhiḥ' nidhānaiḥ' ▼tepānaḥ tapan ▼śociṣā jvālayā ▼devān prati ▼ā ▼vakṣi āvaha ▼yakṣi yaja ▼ca ||
taṃ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṃ devāso aṅgiraḥ | havyavāhaṃmartyam || 17 || tam | tvā | ajanta | mātaraḥ | kavim | devāsaḥ | aṅgiraḥ | havya'vāham | amartyam || 17 ||
he ▼aṅgiraḥ agne ▼kaviṃ krāntakarmāṇam ▼amartyaṃ maraṇarahitaṃ ▼havyavāhaṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhāraṃ ▼taṃ prasiddhaṃ ▼havā tvāṃ ▼devāsaḥ devāḥ ▼mātaraḥ iva ▼ajananta janayanti ||
pracetasaṃ tvā kuve'gnai dūtaṃ vareṇyam | havyavāhaṃ ni pedire || 18 || pra'cetasam | tvā | kave | agne | dūtam | vareṇyam | havya'vāham | ni | medire || 18 ||
